examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo de shèjì nénggòu chéngshòu bā jí yǐshàng de dìzhèn.
examples.english: This bridge is designed to withstand earthquakes of magnitude 8 and above.

semanticNote: Degree, extent, or level — describes how far along or how intense something is. 程度 is versatile: 語言程度 (language level), 嚴重的程度 (degree of seriousness), 到某種程度 (to a certain extent). Distinct from 等級 (grade/rank, more formal classification).

examples.chinese: 她的中文程度已經到了可以看中文小說的階段。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén chéngdù yǐjīng dào le kěyǐ kàn Zhōngwén xiǎoshuō de jiēduàn.
examples.english: Her Chinese level has reached the point where she can read Chinese novels.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風造成的損害程度比預期的還要嚴重。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng zàochéng de sǔnhài chéngdù bǐ yùqī de hái yào yánzhòng.
examples.english: The degree of damage caused by this typhoon was more severe than expected.

semanticNote: Procedure or sequence of steps; also computer program. In formal/legal contexts: 法律程序 (legal procedure), 申請程序 (application process). In computing: 電腦程序 (computer program). Taiwan uses 程序 for both; 程式 is more specifically 'software program' in Taiwan's tech terminology.

examples.chinese: 申請護照需要按照一定的程序辦理，不能跳過任何步驟。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng hùzhào xūyào ànzhào yīdìng de chéngxù bànlǐ, bùnéng tiàoguò rènhé bùzhòu.
examples.english: Applying for a passport requires following a set procedure—no step can be skipped.

examples.chinese: 這個電腦程序出現了錯誤，需要工程師來修復。
examples.pinyin: Zhège diànnǎo chéngxù chūxiàn le cuòwù, xūyào gōngchéngshī lái xiūfù.
examples.english: This computer program has encountered an error and needs an engineer to fix it.

semanticNote: To suffer a loss; to get the short end of the stick; to be at a disadvantage. Can be material (lose money) or social (be taken advantage of). 吃虧 is used in both literal and figurative senses. 不吃虧 (won't take a loss) reflects Taiwan's pragmatic negotiating mindset. Taiwan traditional: 吃虧.

components.meaning: to eat; to suffer; to take in

examples.chinese: 這筆生意他吃了大虧，損失了將近百萬。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ shēngyi tā chī le dà kuī, sǔnshī le jiāngjìn bǎi wàn.
examples.english: He suffered a major loss on this deal—nearly a million dollars.

examples.chinese: 不懂法律的人在簽合約時往往容易吃虧。
examples.pinyin: Bù dǒng fǎlǜ de rén zài qiān hēyuē shí wǎngwǎng róngyì chīkuī.
examples.english: People who don't understand the law often get the short end of the stick when signing contracts.

semanticNote: A pond or small pool — naturally or artificially created. Common in rural Taiwan for fish farming (養魚池), irrigation, and decorative landscaping. Distinct from 湖 (lake, larger) and 水池 (pool, more constructed). 荷花池塘 (lotus pond) is a classic poetic image.

examples.chinese: 村子裡有一個古老的池塘，裡面養了很多魚。
examples.pinyin: Cūnzi lǐ yǒu yī gè gǔlǎo de chítáng, lǐmiàn yǎng le hěn duō yú.
examples.english: There is an old pond in the village where many fish are kept.

examples.chinese: 夏天的傍晚，孩子們喜歡在池塘邊捕青蛙。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de bàngwǎn, háizimen xǐhuān zài chítáng biān bǔ qīngwā.
examples.english: On summer evenings, children like to catch frogs by the pond.

semanticNote: Sooner or later; eventually; at some point. Used to indicate an outcome is inevitable, only the timing is uncertain. Often implies resignation or warning: 這問題遲早要解決 (this problem will have to be dealt with sooner or later). Very common in both speech and writing.

examples.chinese: 你的秘密遲早會被人知道，還不如現在坦白。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de mìmì chízǎo huì bèi rén zhīdào, hái bùrú xiànzài tǎnbái.
examples.english: Your secret will be found out sooner or later—you might as well come clean now.

examples.chinese: 這棟老房子遲早需要整修，現在開始存錢比較好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo fángzi chízǎo xūyào zhěngxiū, xiànzài kāishǐ cún qián bǐjiào hǎo.
examples.english: This old house will need renovation sooner or later—it's better to start saving money now.

semanticNote: To continue; to persist; to sustain over time. Describes ongoing action or conditions: 持續下雨 (continue raining), 持續增長 (sustained growth). Very common in news, reports, and weather forecasts. Taiwan traditional: 持續. Stronger commitment implied than 繼續 (to continue after a pause).

components.meaning: to hold; to maintain; to continue
to continue; to extend; to add

examples.chinese: 這波寒流將持續到本週末，請民眾注意保暖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bō hánliú jiāng chíxù dào běn zhōumò, qǐng mínzhòng zhùyì bǎonuǎn.
examples.english: This cold wave will continue through the weekend—residents are advised to keep warm.

examples.chinese: 台灣的出口量已持續成長超過十個月。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de chūkǒu liàng yǐ chíxù chéngzhǎng chāoguò shí gè yuè.
examples.english: Taiwan's export volume has been growing continuously for over ten months.

semanticNote: A ruler — the measuring instrument. Also called 直尺 (straight ruler). 捲尺 is a tape measure; 量角器 is a protractor. In Taiwan schools, 尺子 is a basic school supply. 尺 alone can mean a traditional unit of measurement (~30cm) as well as the tool.

examples.chinese: 請用尺子量一下這塊木板的長度。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng yòng chǐzi liáng yīxià zhè kuài mùbǎn de chángdù.
examples.english: Please use a ruler to measure the length of this plank.

examples.chinese: 文具盒裡有鉛筆、橡皮和一把尺子。
examples.pinyin: Wénjù hé lǐ yǒu qiānbǐ, xiàngpí hé yī bǎ chǐzi.
examples.english: The pencil case contains a pencil, an eraser, and a ruler.

semanticNote: Wing — of a bird, insect, or aircraft. 翅膀 is the ordinary noun; 羽翼 is more literary. Figuratively: 給孩子翅膀去飛翔 (give children wings to fly) is a common metaphor for nurturing independence. 雞翅 (chicken wing) in food contexts uses 翅 alone.

examples.chinese: 小鳥用力拍打翅膀，從樹上飛了起來。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoniǎo yònglì pāidǎ chìbǎng, cóng shù shàng fēi le qǐlái.
examples.english: The little bird flapped its wings hard and flew up from the tree.

examples.chinese: 父母的責任不只是保護孩子，還要給他們飛翔的翅膀。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ de zérèn bùzhǐshì bǎohù háizi, hái yào gěi tāmen fēixiáng de chìbǎng.
examples.english: A parent's responsibility is not just to protect their children, but also to give them wings to fly.

semanticNote: Multiple senses: (1) to rush forward; charge (衝); (2) to rinse; to flush with water (沖); (3) a thoroughfare (衝, as in 要衝). The simplified form 冲 covers all. In Taiwan traditional script: 衝 (rush) and 沖 (rinse/wash) are distinct — context clarifies which sense is intended.

components.meaning: to rush; to charge | to rinse; to flush

examples.chinese: 他一聽到消息，立刻衝出門去。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī tīng dào xiāoxi, lìkè chōng chū mén qù.
examples.english: As soon as he heard the news, he immediately rushed out the door.

examples.chinese: 吃完飯要記得用清水沖一下碗，方便等一下清洗。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn yào jìde yòng qīngshuǐ chōng yīxià wǎn, fāngbiàn děng yīxià qīngxǐ.
examples.english: After eating, remember to rinse the bowls with water so they're easier to wash later.

semanticNote: Battery charger; phone charger. An everyday modern noun. In Taiwan, 充電器 is the standard term; 變壓器 is a voltage adapter (different device). 無線充電 (wireless charging) and 快充 (fast charging) are related modern terms. Very common in everyday conversation.

examples.chinese: 我忘記帶充電器，手機快要沒電了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàngjì dài chōngdiànqì, shǒujī kuàiyào méi diàn le.
examples.english: I forgot to bring my charger—my phone is almost dead.

examples.chinese: 出國旅行前記得確認充電器是否支援當地的電壓。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng qián jìde quèrèn chōngdiànqì shìfǒu zhīchí dāngdì de diànyā.
examples.english: Before traveling abroad, remember to check whether your charger supports the local voltage.

semanticNote: Full; ample; sufficient. Used for preparation, evidence, sleep, opportunities, etc. 充分準備 (be fully prepared), 充分的理由 (sufficient reason), 充分休息 (get enough rest). As an adverb: 充分利用 (make full use of). A key exam colocation: 充分發揮 (give full play to).

examples.chinese: 在做這個決定之前，他收集了充分的資料和數據。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuò zhège juédìng zhīqián, tā shōují le chōngfèn de zīliào hé shùjù.
examples.english: Before making this decision, he gathered ample information and data.

examples.chinese: 學生應該充分利用圖書館的資源來提升自己。
examples.pinyin: Xuésheng yīnggāi chōngfèn lìyòng túshūguǎn de zīyuán lái tíshēng zìjǐ.
examples.english: Students should make full use of library resources to improve themselves.

semanticNote: To be brimming with; to be filled with; to be full of. Always takes an object that is abstract or a substance: 充滿希望 (full of hope), 充滿活力 (brimming with energy), 充滿危險 (fraught with danger). More emotional and vivid than 充分. Taiwan traditional: 充滿.

examples.chinese: 她的演講充滿熱情，深深打動了在場的每一個人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng chōngmǎn rèqíng, shēnshēn dǎdòng le zài chǎng de měi yī gè rén.
examples.english: Her speech was full of passion and deeply moved everyone present.

examples.chinese: 這條街道充滿了濃厚的歷史氛圍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào chōngmǎn le nónghòu de lìshǐ fēnwéi.
examples.english: This street is steeped in a rich historical atmosphere.

semanticNote: To repeat; to duplicate; repetition. 重複 can refer to repeating content (重複問題 — repeat a question), recurring patterns, or duplicate data (重複的記錄 — duplicate records). In formal usage: 避免重複 (avoid repetition). Taiwan traditional: 重複.

examples.chinese: 老師請同學不要在報告中重複相同的內容。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī qǐng tóngxué búyào zài bàogào zhōng chóngfù xiāngtóng de nèiróng.
examples.english: The teacher asked students not to repeat the same content in their reports.

examples.chinese: 他每天都重複同樣的作息，生活非常規律。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu chóngfù tóngyàng de zuòxī, shēnghuó fēicháng guīlǜ.
examples.english: He repeats the same daily routine every day—his life is very regular.

semanticNote: A pet. Pet ownership is common and socially significant in Taiwan — 毛小孩 (fur baby) is a popular term reflecting how pets are treated as family members. 寵物店 (pet shop), 寵物醫院 (veterinary clinic), 寵物旅館 (pet hotel). Taiwan traditional: 寵物.

components.meaning: to spoil; to favor; to pamper

examples.chinese: 她把寵物狗當成自己的孩子一樣疼愛。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ chǒngwù gǒu dàngchéng zìjǐ de háizi yīyàng téng'ài.
examples.english: She loves her pet dog like her own child.

examples.chinese: 台灣寵物經濟近年來快速成長，相關產業蓬勃發展。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān chǒngwù jīngjì jìnnián lái kuàisù chéngzhǎng, xiāngguān chǎnyè péngbó fāzhǎn.
examples.english: Taiwan's pet economy has grown rapidly in recent years, with related industries booming.

semanticNote: A drawer — as in a desk, cabinet, or dresser. An everyday noun. 抽屜 (traditional) is used in Taiwan. 拉開抽屜 (pull open a drawer), 放進抽屜 (put in the drawer). No significant figurative use; it is purely a physical object.

examples.chinese: 剪刀放在書桌右邊的抽屜裡。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎndāo fàng zài shūzhuō yòubiān de chōuti lǐ.
examples.english: The scissors are in the right drawer of the desk.

examples.chinese: 他翻遍了所有的抽屜，還是找不到那把鑰匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā fān biàn le suǒyǒu de chōuti, háishì zhǎo bú dào nà bǎ yàoshi.
examples.english: He searched through all the drawers but still couldn't find the key.

semanticNote: Abstract; not concrete. Used in philosophy (抽象概念 — abstract concept), art (抽象畫 — abstract painting), and everyday speech (太抽象了 — too abstract to understand). The opposite is 具體 (concrete, specific). A key vocabulary item in academic and intellectual contexts.

examples.chinese: 「自由」是個很抽象的概念，不同的人有不同的理解。
examples.pinyin: 'Zìyóu' shì gè hěn chōuxiàng de gàiniàn, bùtóng de rén yǒu bùtóng de lǐjiě.
examples.english: 'Freedom' is a very abstract concept—different people have different understandings of it.

examples.chinese: 他的解釋太抽象了，我還是不明白他在說什麼。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiěshì tài chōuxiàng le, wǒ háishì bù míngbái tā zài shuō shénme.
examples.english: His explanation was too abstract—I still don't understand what he's saying.

semanticNote: Ugly; unattractive; disgraceful. 醜 is the traditional character used in Taiwan. As an adjective for appearance: 醜陋 (ugly). In a social sense: 丟醜 (to embarrass oneself), 出醜 (make a fool of oneself). The Second Earthly Branch meaning (the Ox hour, 1–3 AM) is rarely needed at HSK5 level.

examples.chinese: 她覺得這件衣服的顏色搭配很醜，不想買。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè jiàn yīfú de yánsè dāpèi hěn chǒu, bù xiǎng mǎi.
examples.english: She thought the color combination of this outfit was ugly and didn't want to buy it.

examples.chinese: 人不應該只看外表，醜或美不代表一個人的價值。
examples.pinyin: Rén bù yīnggāi zhǐ kàn wàibiǎo, chǒu huò měi bù dàibiǎo yī gè rén de jiàzhí.
examples.english: People shouldn't judge only by appearance—looking ugly or beautiful doesn't define a person's worth.

semanticNote: Foul-smelling; stinky; stench (chòu — common reading). The literary reading xiù means 'smell; odor' (both good and bad, now archaic). In modern usage 臭 is always negative: 臭豆腐 (stinky tofu — a beloved Taiwan snack despite the name), 臭死了 (smells terrible). Distinct from 香 (fragrant).

examples.chinese: 夜市賣的臭豆腐聞起來很臭，但吃起來卻很香。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì mài de chòudòufu wén qǐlái hěn chòu, dàn chī qǐlái què hěn xiāng.
examples.english: The stinky tofu sold at night markets smells terrible, but it tastes delicious.

examples.chinese: 他運動完渾身臭汗，趕快去洗了個澡。
examples.pinyin: Tā yùndòng wán húnshēn chòu hàn, gǎnkuài qù xǐ le gè zǎo.
examples.english: He was covered in smelly sweat after exercising and quickly went to take a shower.

semanticNote: To publish (a book, magazine, etc.); publication. 出版社 (publishing house), 出版品 (publications). Taiwan has a robust independent publishing culture; the Taipei International Book Exhibition (台北國際書展) is a major annual event. Taiwan traditional: 出版.

components.meaning: to put out; to produce; to issue

examples.chinese: 這本書在台灣出版後，立刻成了暢銷書。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zài Táiwān chūbǎn hòu, lìkè chéng le chàngxiāo shū.
examples.english: After this book was published in Taiwan, it immediately became a bestseller.

examples.chinese: 她的第一本詩集由一家獨立出版社出版。
examples.pinyin: Tā de dì yī běn shījí yóu yī jiā dúlì chūbǎnshè chūbǎn.
examples.english: Her first collection of poems was published by an independent publisher.

semanticNote: Three distinct senses: (1) exit (出口 = the way out — physical space), (2) to speak (開口說話 — less common), (3) to export (goods). All three appear in context. Taiwan's economy is heavily export-oriented: 出口貿易 (export trade), 出口量 (export volume). Physical exit signs use 出口 throughout Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 火車站的出口在前方左側，請跟著指示走。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē zhàn de chūkǒu zài qiánfāng zuǒcè, qǐng gēnzhe zhǐshì zǒu.
examples.english: The train station exit is on the front left—please follow the signs.

examples.chinese: 台灣的半導體出口佔全球市場很大的比例。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de bàndǎotǐ chūkǒu zhàn quánqiú shìchǎng hěn dà de bǐlì.
examples.english: Taiwan's semiconductor exports account for a large share of the global market.

semanticNote: Outstanding; remarkable; excellent — describing people's performance or achievements that stand out. More specific to performance than 優秀 (excellent in general). 表現出色 (perform excellently) is the most common collocation. Positive; used in compliments and assessments.

examples.chinese: 她在這次比賽中表現出色，贏得了評審的一致好評。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè cì bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn chūsè, yíngdé le píngshen de yīzhì hǎopíng.
examples.english: She performed outstandingly in this competition and earned unanimous praise from the judges.

examples.chinese: 他是個出色的工程師，解決問題的能力非常強。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè chūsè de gōngchéngshī, jiějué wèntí de nénglì fēicháng qiáng.
examples.english: He is an outstanding engineer with exceptional problem-solving skills.

semanticNote: To show; to present (a document, ID, ticket, certificate) to someone in authority. Formal and specific: always involves showing something official to another person for inspection. 出示證件 (show identification), 出示護照 (present passport). Distinct from 展示 (to display/exhibit).

components.meaning: to show; to display; to indicate

examples.chinese: 進入這棟大樓需要在門口出示員工證。
examples.pinyin: Jìnrù zhè dòng dàlóu xūyào zài ménkǒu chūshì yuángōng zhèng.
examples.english: To enter this building you need to show your employee ID at the door.

examples.chinese: 警察攔下他後，要求他出示駕照和行照。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá lán xià tā hòu, yāoqiú tā chūshì jiàzhào hé xíngzhào.
examples.english: After pulling him over, the police asked him to present his driver's license and vehicle registration.

semanticNote: To attend; to be present at (a formal event — meeting, conference, ceremony, hearing). More formal than 參加. 出席率 (attendance rate), 出席人數 (number of attendees). 缺席 is the antonym (to be absent). Frequently used in government, legal, and academic contexts in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 總統親自出席了這次國際論壇的開幕典禮。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng qīnzì chūxí le zhè cì guójì lùntán de kāimù diǎnlǐ.
examples.english: The president personally attended the opening ceremony of this international forum.

examples.chinese: 會議規定所有成員都必須出席，不得無故缺席。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì guīdìng suǒyǒu chéngyuán dōu bìxū chūxí, bùdé wúgù quēxí.
examples.english: The meeting rules require all members to attend and prohibit unexcused absences.

semanticNote: Junior; primary; elementary — the first or lowest level of something. 初級班 (beginner's class), 初級課程 (introductory course). Opposite of 高級 (advanced). In the Taiwan education system, 初級中學 (junior high school, grades 7–9) is abbreviated to 國中.

examples.chinese: 這是一門初級中文課，適合完全沒有基礎的學生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī mén chūjí Zhōngwén kè, shìhé wánquán méiyǒu jīchǔ de xuésheng.
examples.english: This is a beginner Chinese class, suitable for students with no prior knowledge at all.

examples.chinese: 他的廚藝只有初級水準，但做的料理還算可口。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chúyì zhǐyǒu chūjí shuǐzhǔn, dàn zuò de liàolǐ hái suàn kěkǒu.
examples.english: His cooking skills are only at a beginner level, but the dishes he makes are still quite palatable.

semanticNote: Only if; unless — introduces the sole condition under which the main clause would be true. Pattern: 除非 A，否則/不然 B (unless A, otherwise B) or 除非 A，才 B (only if A, then B). Crucial logical connective for the exam. Distinguish from 只有 (only when) — they are often interchangeable.

examples.chinese: 除非你親自去道歉，否則她不會原諒你的。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi nǐ qīnzì qù dàoqiàn, fǒuzé tā bú huì yuánliàng nǐ de.
examples.english: Unless you go and apologize in person, she won't forgive you.

examples.chinese: 除非下大雨，我們每天都會去公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi xià dà yǔ, wǒmen měitiān dōu huì qù gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: Unless it rains heavily, we take a walk in the park every day.

semanticNote: Lunar New Year's Eve — the night before the first day of the Lunar New Year. One of the most important moments in Taiwan's cultural calendar. Families gather for 年夜飯 (reunion dinner), 守歲 (stay up to see in the new year), and 放鞭炮 (set off firecrackers). 除夕夜 adds the word for 'night.'

components.meaning: to get rid of; to remove

examples.chinese: 每年除夕，全家人都會聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chúxī, quánjiā rén dōu huì jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: Every Lunar New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers together for the reunion dinner.

examples.chinese: 台灣各地在除夕夜都會舉辦跨年倒數活動。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān gèdì zài chúxī yè dōu huì jǔbàn kuànián dàoshǔ huódòng.
examples.english: New Year's Eve countdown events are held throughout Taiwan on Lunar New Year's Eve.

semanticNote: To deal with; to handle; to process; to treat. Very versatile: 處理問題 (deal with a problem), 廢水處理 (wastewater treatment), 資料處理 (data processing), 處理食材 (prep ingredients). Also: sell at a reduced price (處理品 = clearance item). Taiwan traditional: 處理.

components.meaning: to manage; to deal with; place
to manage; to put in order; reason

examples.chinese: 客服部門負責處理顧客的投訴和退換貨需求。
examples.pinyin: Kèfú bùmén fùzé chǔlǐ gùkè de tóusù hé tuì huàn huò xūqiú.
examples.english: The customer service department is responsible for handling customer complaints and return/exchange requests.

examples.chinese: 這件事情很複雜，需要時間仔細處理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing hěn fùzá, xūyào shíjiān zǐxì chǔlǐ.
examples.english: This matter is very complex and needs time to be handled carefully.

semanticNote: To spread; to propagate; to disseminate. Used for diseases (病毒傳播), information, culture, and media. 傳播媒體 (mass media), 大眾傳播 (mass communication) — 傳播 is the core term for the communications field in Taiwan academia. Taiwan traditional: 傳播.

components.meaning: to transmit; to pass on; to spread
to broadcast; to sow; to spread

examples.chinese: 這個謠言在社群媒體上快速傳播，引發了大眾恐慌。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yáoyán zài shèqún méitǐ shàng kuàisù chuánbō, yǐnfā le dàzhòng kǒnghuāng.
examples.english: This rumor spread rapidly on social media and caused widespread panic.

examples.chinese: 大眾傳播學是台灣許多大學都有設立的熱門科系。
examples.pinyin: Dàzhòng chuánbō xué shì Táiwān xǔduō dàxué dōu yǒu shèlì de rèmén kēxi.
examples.english: Mass communication is a popular department at many universities in Taiwan.

semanticNote: To infect; to be contagious. 傳染病 (infectious disease; epidemic), 傳染給... (infect; pass to...), 具有傳染性 (contagious). The COVID-19 pandemic made this term extremely common in Taiwan's daily discourse (2020–2023). Taiwan traditional: 傳染.

components.meaning: to dye; to infect; to be contaminated

examples.chinese: 流感很容易傳染，所以冬天要勤洗手、戴口罩。
examples.pinyin: Liúgǎn hěn róngyì chuánrǎn, suǒyǐ dōngtiān yào qín xǐshǒu, dài kǒuzhào.
examples.english: The flu spreads easily, so in winter you should wash your hands frequently and wear a mask.

examples.chinese: 他確診後立刻居家隔離，避免將病毒傳染給家人。
examples.pinyin: Tā quèzhěn hòu lìkè jūjiā gélí, bìmiǎn jiāng bìngdú chuánrǎn gěi jiārén.
examples.english: After testing positive, he immediately went into home quarantine to avoid infecting his family.

semanticNote: Legend; myth; it is said that... As a noun: a legend or folk story passed down through generations. As a verb: it is said/reported that (传说他已经去了 — it is said he has already left). 民間傳說 (folk legend), 神話傳說 (mythology and legend). Taiwan traditional: 傳說.

components.meaning: to speak; to say; story; theory

examples.chinese: 根據台灣原住民的傳說，玉山是神靈居住的地方。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Táiwān yuánzhùmín de chuánshuō, Yùshān shì shénlíng jūzhù de dìfāng.
examples.english: According to the legends of Taiwan's indigenous peoples, Jade Mountain is where the spirits dwell.

examples.chinese: 傳說這座廟裡的神明非常靈驗，許多人特地來拜拜。
examples.pinyin: Chuánshuō zhè zuò miào lǐ de shénmíng fēicháng língyàn, xǔduō rén tèdì lái bàibai.
examples.english: It is said that the deity in this temple is very efficacious—many people make a special trip to pray.

semanticNote: Tradition; traditional. As a noun: 傳統 (a tradition; traditions). As an adjective: 傳統的 (traditional). Taiwan prides itself on preserving Chinese cultural traditions (廟會, 書法, 農曆節日) that the mainland discontinued during the Cultural Revolution. 傳統文化 and 傳統價值觀 are common in Taiwan discourse.

components.meaning: to pass on; to transmit through generations

examples.chinese: 台灣保留了許多中華傳統文化，如廟會、歌仔戲和布袋戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān bǎoliú le xǔduō zhōnghuá chuántǒng wénhuà, rú miàohuì, gēzǎixì hé bùdàixì.
examples.english: Taiwan has preserved many traditional Chinese cultural practices, such as temple festivals, opera, and puppet theater.

examples.chinese: 現代年輕人和傳統觀念之間的衝突，是台灣社會常討論的話題。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài niánqīngrén hé chuántǒng guānniàn zhī jiān de chōngtū, shì Táiwān shèhuì cháng tǎolùn de huàtí.
examples.english: The conflict between modern youth and traditional values is a topic frequently discussed in Taiwan society.

semanticNote: Window curtain. 窗簾 is the Taiwan traditional spelling. 拉上窗簾 (draw the curtains), 拉開窗簾 (open the curtains). Distinct from 百葉窗 (venetian blinds/shutters) and 窗紗 (window screen/mesh). An everyday household noun.

examples.chinese: 天亮了，她拉開窗簾讓陽光照進房間。
examples.pinyin: Tiān liàng le, tā lā kāi chuānglián ràng yángguāng zhào jìn fángjiān.
examples.english: When dawn came, she opened the curtains to let sunlight into the room.

examples.chinese: 睡覺前記得把窗簾拉上，這樣早上才不會太早被光線吵醒。
examples.pinyin: Shuìjiào qián jìde bǎ chuānglián lā shàng, zhèyàng zǎoshang cái bú huì tài zǎo bèi guāngxiàn chǎo xǐng.
examples.english: Remember to close the curtains before bed so you won't be woken up too early by the light in the morning.

semanticNote: To rush into; break through; to forge a path by confronting difficulties. 闖 has a bold, reckless energy: 闖入 (to barge in; to break into), 闖關 (to break through checkpoints; fight through levels in a game), 闖禍 (to cause trouble; get into mischief). The sense of carving one's way through obstacles is central. Taiwan traditional: 闖.

components.meaning: to rush in; to break through; to temper oneself

examples.chinese: 他年輕時獨自來到台北闖蕩，從零開始打拼事業。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí dúzì lái dào Táiběi chuǎngdàng, cóng líng kāishǐ dǎpīn shìyè.
examples.english: When he was young, he came to Taipei alone to make his way, building a career from scratch.

examples.chinese: 警察說有人闖入了鄰居家，現在正在調查中。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá shuō yǒu rén chuǎng rù le línjū jiā, xiànzài zhèngzài diàochá zhōng.
examples.english: The police said someone had broken into the neighbor's house and an investigation is underway.

semanticNote: To create; to bring something new into existence. More intentional and original than 做 or 製造. 創造力 (creativity; creative ability), 創造奇蹟 (create a miracle), 創造機會 (create opportunities). 創造 is the verb/noun used in Taiwan's innovation and education discourse. Taiwan traditional: 創造.

components.meaning: to create; to originate; to found
to make; to build; to construct

examples.chinese: 這位藝術家用廢棄材料創造出令人驚嘆的雕塑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā yòng fèiqì cáiliào chuàngzào chū lìng rén jīngtàn de diāosù.
examples.english: This artist used discarded materials to create stunning sculptures.

examples.chinese: 創造力是現代教育最重視的能力之一。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngzào lì shì xiàndài jiàoyù zuì zhòngshì de nénglì zhī yī.
examples.english: Creativity is one of the abilities most valued in modern education.

semanticNote: To blow (wind, a musical instrument, air); to puff. Also colloquially: to boast (吹牛 — blow an ox, i.e., talk big); and for relationships/deals: to fall through (事情吹了 — the deal fell through). 吹口哨 (to whistle), 吹頭髮 (to blow-dry hair) are common collocations.

components.meaning: to blow; to puff; to play (wind instrument)

examples.chinese: 海邊的風輕輕吹來，讓人感覺非常舒服。
examples.pinyin: Hǎibiān de fēng qīngqīng chuī lái, ràng rén gǎnjué fēicháng shūfú.
examples.english: A gentle breeze blew in from the sea, making everyone feel very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 他很會吹牛，說的故事一半都是誇大的。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn huì chuīniú, shuō de gùshi yī bàn dōu shì kuādà de.
examples.english: He's great at bragging—half of his stories are exaggerated.

semanticNote: Vocabulary; the stock of words in a language or someone's repertoire. 詞彙量 (vocabulary size), 擴充詞彙 (expand vocabulary), 詞彙學 (lexicology). Distinct from 詞語 (a word/phrase — individual item) and 語言 (language — broader). Taiwan traditional: 詞彙.

examples.chinese: 大量閱讀是擴充詞彙量最有效的方法之一。
examples.pinyin: Dàliàng yuèdú shì kuòchōng cíhuì liàng zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ zhī yī.
examples.english: Extensive reading is one of the most effective ways to expand your vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 這本教材的詞彙難度適合中級程度的學習者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn jiàocái de cíhuì nándù shìhé zhōngjí chéngdù de xuéxízhě.
examples.english: The vocabulary difficulty level of this textbook is suitable for intermediate learners.

semanticNote: To resign from a position; to quit a job. 辭職信 (resignation letter), 提出辭呈 (submit a resignation — more formal), 辭職不幹 (quit and be done with it — colloquial). Taiwan traditional: 辭職. Unlike 開除 (to fire/dismiss), 辭職 is always initiated by the employee.

components.meaning: to resign; to decline; to bid farewell

examples.chinese: 她因為受不了公司的文化，決定提出辭職。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shòu bú liǎo gōngsī de wénhuà, juédìng tíchū cízhí.
examples.english: Unable to tolerate the company culture, she decided to submit her resignation.

examples.chinese: 部長在記者會上宣布辭職，並對施政失誤表示道歉。
examples.pinyin: Bùzhǎng zài jìzhě huì shàng xuānbù cízhí, bìng duì shīzhèng shīwù biǎoshì dàoqiàn.
examples.english: The minister announced his resignation at a press conference and apologized for policy mistakes.

semanticNote: Besides; in addition; moreover. A transitional phrase used to add a further point or piece of information. More formal than 另外 and slightly more emphatic than 還有. Common in written Chinese and formal speeches in Taiwan. Typically appears at the start of a clause.

examples.chinese: 這裡的環境優美，交通也很便利。此外，生活機能完善，非常適合定居。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng yōuměi, jiāotōng yě hěn biànlì. Cǐwài, shēnghuó jīnéng wánshàn, fēicháng shìhé dìngjū.
examples.english: The environment here is beautiful and the transportation is convenient. In addition, the living amenities are excellent, making it ideal for settling down.

examples.chinese: 申請獎學金除了成績之外，此外還需要提交一封推薦信。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn chúle chéngjī zhīwài, cǐwài hái xūyào tíjiāo yī fēng tuījiànxìn.
examples.english: In addition to academic records, applying for the scholarship also requires submitting a recommendation letter.

semanticNote: Secondary; of lesser importance; subordinate. Used to contrast with 主要 (primary; main). 次要矛盾 (secondary contradiction — a Marxist political term still used in Taiwan analysis), 次要角色 (secondary character/role). The concept of hierarchy between 主 and 次 is fundamental in Chinese analytical writing.

examples.chinese: 這份計畫的主要目標是降低成本，次要目標是提升效率。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn jìhuà de zhǔyào mùbiāo shì jiàngdī chéngběn, cìyào mùbiāo shì tíshēng xiàolǜ.
examples.english: The primary goal of this plan is to reduce costs; the secondary goal is to improve efficiency.

examples.chinese: 在緊急情況下，次要的事情可以先放一邊。
examples.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, cìyào de shìqing kěyǐ xiān fàng yībiān.
examples.english: In an emergency, secondary matters can be set aside for now.

semanticNote: Exciting; thrilling; to stimulate; provocation. Three registers: (1) exciting/thrilling (坐雲霄飛車很刺激 — riding a roller coaster is thrilling); (2) to stimulate physically or economically (刺激消費 — stimulate consumption); (3) to provoke emotionally (刺激到他 — provoked/upset him). All three appear in HSK contexts.

components.meaning: to stab; to pierce; to irritate
to stir up; to excite; to stimulate

examples.chinese: 搭雲霄飛車真的很刺激，讓人又興奮又害怕。
examples.pinyin: Dā yúnxiāo fēichē zhēnde hěn cìjī, ràng rén yòu xīngfèn yòu hàipà.
examples.english: Riding a roller coaster is really thrilling—it makes you both excited and scared.

examples.chinese: 政府推出多項措施刺激國內消費，帶動經濟復甦。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū duō xiàng cuòshī cìjī guónèi xiāofèi, dàidòng jīngjì fùsū.
examples.english: The government launched multiple measures to stimulate domestic consumption and drive economic recovery.

semanticNote: Hasty; hurried; in a rush. Describes an action or state where there is little time and things are done quickly, often imperfectly. 匆忙中 (in the rush/haste of...), 匆匆忙忙 (in a great hurry — reduplicated form). Slightly negative — implies carelessness due to time pressure.

examples.chinese: 他匆忙出門，忘了帶鑰匙，只好按門鈴請室友開門。
examples.pinyin: Tā cōngmáng chū mén, wàng le dài yàoshi, zhǐhǎo àn ménlíng qǐng shìyǒu kāimén.
examples.english: He rushed out in a hurry and forgot his keys, so he had to ring the doorbell to ask his roommate to open the door.

examples.chinese: 不要匆忙做決定，這件事需要仔細考慮清楚。
examples.pinyin: Búyào cōngmáng zuò juédìng, zhè jiàn shì xūyào zǐxì kǎolǜ qīngchǔ.
examples.english: Don't make a hasty decision—this matter needs to be carefully thought through.

semanticNote: From now on; from this point forward; since then. Marks a turning point after which something is permanently changed. 從此以後 (from this time on; hereafter) is the full form. Often appears in narratives at a pivotal moment. Slightly literary; very common in both speech and written Chinese.

examples.chinese: 自從搬到台灣後，她從此愛上了這裡的食物和文化。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng bān dào Táiwān hòu, tā cóngcǐ ài shàng le zhèlǐ de shíwù hé wénhuà.
examples.english: Since moving to Taiwan, she has fallen in love with the food and culture here.

examples.chinese: 那次事故之後，他從此再也不騎摩托車了。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì shìgù zhīhòu, tā cóngcǐ zài yě bù qí mótuōchē le.
examples.english: After that accident, he never rode a motorcycle again.

semanticNote: Thus; thereby; as a result — connects a cause/method to its outcome. More formal than 所以. Pattern: [method/action], 從而 [result/purpose]. Very common in academic papers, formal reports, and argumentative writing. The apostrophe in cóng'ér is required because 而 (ér) begins with a vowel.

components.meaning: and then; thus; as a result

examples.chinese: 他每天堅持閱讀，從而大幅提升了自己的知識水平。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān jiānchí yuèdú, cóng'ér dàfú tíshēng le zìjǐ de zhīshì shuǐpíng.
examples.english: He persisted in reading every day, thereby greatly improving his level of knowledge.

examples.chinese: 降低生產成本可以提高競爭力，從而幫助企業在市場中取得優勢。
examples.pinyin: Jiàngdī shēngchǎn chéngběn kěyǐ tígāo jìngzhēng lì, cóng'ér bāngzhù qǐyè zài shìchǎng zhōng qǔdé yōushì.
examples.english: Reducing production costs can improve competitiveness, thereby helping enterprises gain an advantage in the market.

semanticNote: Previously; formerly; in the past; once upon a time. 從前 often carries a nostalgic or narrative tone — it can open a story (從前有一個... = once upon a time there was a...) or refer to the speaker's past (從前我住在台南). More evocative of the distant past than 以前 (before; previously — more neutral).

examples.chinese: 從前這裡是一片農田，現在已經變成了熱鬧的商業區。
examples.pinyin: Cóngqián zhèlǐ shì yī piàn nóngtián, xiànzài yǐjīng biàn chéng le rènào de shāngyèqū.
examples.english: This area used to be farmland; it has now become a bustling commercial district.

examples.chinese: 從前的我很害羞，不敢在人前說話，但現在完全變了。
examples.pinyin: Cóngqián de wǒ hěn hàixiū, bù gǎn zài rén qián shuōhuà, dàn xiànzài wánquán biàn le.
examples.english: I used to be very shy and didn't dare to speak in front of people, but I've completely changed now.

semanticNote: To engage in; to work in; to be involved in (a profession, field, or activity). Formal and specific to occupation or serious endeavors. 從事教育 (work in education), 從事研究 (conduct research), 從事志工服務 (do volunteer work). More formal than 做 or 工作; common on résumés and in interviews.

examples.chinese: 他大學畢業後，選擇從事醫療相關工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàxué bìyè hòu, xuǎnzé cóngshì yīliáo xiāngguān gōngzuò.
examples.english: After graduating from university, he chose to work in a healthcare-related field.

examples.chinese: 她從事記者工作超過二十年，走遍了世界各地。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngshì jìzhě gōngzuò chāoguò èrshí nián, zǒu biàn le shìjiè gèdì.
examples.english: She has been working as a journalist for over twenty years, traveling all over the world.

semanticNote: Rough; coarse; crude — for texture (皮膚粗糙 — rough skin; 表面粗糙 — rough surface) and quality (工作做得粗糙 — shoddy work; workmanship is rough). Opposite of 細膩 (fine; smooth; delicate). Common in beauty/skincare and craft/manufacturing contexts in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 長期在戶外工作讓他的雙手變得粗糙。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī zài hùwài gōngzuò ràng tā de shuāngshǒu biàn de cūcāo.
examples.english: Working outdoors for a long time made his hands rough.

examples.chinese: 這份報告的內容太粗糙，需要重新整理後再提交。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de nèiróng tài cūcāo, xūyào chóngxīn zhěnglǐ hòu zài tíjiāo.
examples.english: The content of this report is too rough—it needs to be reorganized before submission.

semanticNote: To promote; to advance; to facilitate (a cause, process, or relationship). Formal and nearly always used with abstract objects: 促進發展 (promote development), 促進健康 (promote health), 促進合作 (facilitate cooperation). Very common in Taiwan government and policy language. Taiwan traditional: 促進.

examples.chinese: 政府積極推動政策，以促進台灣的觀光業發展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jījí tuīdòng zhèngcè, yǐ cùjìn Táiwān de guānguāngyè fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The government is actively pushing policies to promote the development of Taiwan's tourism industry.

examples.chinese: 規律運動有助於促進血液循環，對身體健康很有益。
examples.pinyin: Guīlǜ yùndòng yǒuzhù yú cùjìn xuèyè xúnhuán, duì shēntǐ jiànkāng hěn yǒuyì.
examples.english: Regular exercise helps promote blood circulation and is very beneficial for health.

semanticNote: To urge; to impel; to cause; to push someone (or something) to do something. 促使 introduces the agent that drives change: 什麼促使他做出這個決定？ (What compelled him to make this decision?). More causal than 鼓勵 (encourage) — it describes what pushes something to happen, not just what motivates. Taiwan traditional: 促使.

components.meaning: to urge; to push; to press
to cause; to make; to use

examples.chinese: 這次失敗的經歷促使他更加努力，重新出發。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài de jīnglì cùshǐ tā gèngjiā nǔlì, chóngxīn chūfā.
examples.english: This experience of failure pushed him to work even harder and start fresh.

examples.chinese: 市場需求的改變促使企業不得不調整生產策略。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng xūqiú de gǎibiàn cùshǐ qǐyè bùdébù tiáozhěng shēngchǎn cèlüè.
examples.english: Changes in market demand compelled companies to adjust their production strategies.

semanticNote: Vinegar. 烏醋 (black vinegar) and 白醋 (white vinegar) are both common in Taiwan cuisine. Figurative use: 吃醋 (to feel jealous — lit. 'eat vinegar'; said of romantic jealousy). This figurative sense is important and tested at HSK5: 她看到丈夫和舊友說話就開始吃醋。

examples.chinese: 台灣的麵食通常會配一碟烏醋，增添風味。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de miànshí tōngcháng huì pèi yī dié wū cù, zēngtiān fēngwèi.
examples.english: Taiwanese noodle dishes are often served with a small dish of black vinegar to enhance the flavor.

examples.chinese: 她看到男友跟前女友說話，立刻開始吃醋。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn dào nányǒu gēn qián nǚyǒu shuōhuà, lìkè kāishǐ chī cù.
examples.english: She immediately got jealous when she saw her boyfriend talking to his ex-girlfriend.

semanticNote: To press; to urge; to hurry someone along; to rush (a person). 催 implies impatient pressure on another person: 催促 (to urge on), 催稿 (to press for a manuscript), 催眠 (hypnotize — lit. 'urge to sleep'). The object is always a person or a person-initiated action.

components.meaning: to urge; to press; to hurry

examples.chinese: 媽媽一直催我快點出門，說會來不及了。
examples.pinyin: Māmā yīzhí cuī wǒ kuàidiǎn chūmén, shuō huì láibují le.
examples.english: Mom kept urging me to hurry up and leave, saying we'd be late.

examples.chinese: 編輯打來電話催稿，但他還沒寫完最後一章。
examples.pinyin: Biānjí dǎ lái diànhuà cuī gǎo, dàn tā hái méi xiě wán zuìhòu yī zhāng.
examples.english: The editor called to press him for the manuscript, but he hadn't finished the last chapter yet.

semanticNote: To exist; existence. Both the verb and noun senses are common. Philosophical: 存在主義 (existentialism). Practical: 問題仍然存在 (the problem still exists), 感受到自己的存在 (feel one's own existence). A versatile word spanning philosophy, daily speech, and formal writing.

components.meaning: to exist; to store; to preserve
to be at; to exist; present

examples.chinese: 貧富不均的問題在許多國家都普遍存在。
examples.pinyin: Pínfù bùjūn de wèntí zài xǔduō guójiā dōu pǔbiàn cúnzài.
examples.english: The problem of wealth inequality exists widely in many countries.

examples.chinese: 她的藝術作品讓觀眾思考關於存在與意義的問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yìshù zuòpǐn ràng guānzhòng sīkǎo guānyú cúnzài yǔ yìyì de wèntí.
examples.english: Her artworks lead the audience to reflect on questions of existence and meaning.

semanticNote: Measure; step; action taken (especially official or policy-related). Almost always plural in concept: 採取措施 (take measures), 防疫措施 (epidemic prevention measures), 安全措施 (safety measures). A core term in Taiwan's government announcements, policy documents, and news coverage.

components.meaning: to implement; to carry out; to apply

examples.chinese: 政府宣布了一系列振興經濟的措施。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù le yī xìliè zhènxīng jīngjì de cuòshī.
examples.english: The government announced a series of measures to stimulate the economy.

examples.chinese: 學校針對校園霸凌問題，制定了更嚴格的防治措施。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhēnduì xiàoyuán bālíng wèntí, zhìdìng le gèng yángé de fángzhì cuòshī.
examples.english: The school has formulated stricter prevention measures to address the problem of campus bullying.

semanticNote: Two distinct senses: (1) to respond; to answer (when called or spoken to — 我叫他他不答應 — I called him but he didn't answer); (2) to promise; to agree to do something (答應幫忙 — promise to help). Both senses are tested. Taiwan traditional: 答應.

components.meaning: to answer; to respond; to reply

examples.chinese: 他答應了幫我搬家，但到時候又說沒空。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāying le bāng wǒ bānjiā, dàn dào shíhòu yòu shuō méi kōng.
examples.english: He promised to help me move, but when the time came he said he was too busy.

examples.chinese: 媽媽叫了她好幾聲，她才慢慢地答應了一聲。
examples.pinyin: Māmā jiào le tā hǎo jǐ shēng, tā cái màn màn de dāying le yī shēng.
examples.english: Her mom called her name several times before she slowly responded.

semanticNote: To achieve; to reach; to attain (a goal, standard, level). Always used with an abstract target: 達到目標 (achieve a goal), 達到標準 (meet a standard), 達到要求 (meet requirements). More purposive than 到 (to reach a place). Taiwan traditional: 達到.

components.meaning: to reach; to achieve; to attain

examples.chinese: 她的成績達到了申請獎學金的最低標準。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjī dádào le shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn de zuìdī biāozhǔn.
examples.english: Her grades have met the minimum standard for applying for a scholarship.

examples.chinese: 這次談判的目的是達到雙方都能接受的協議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn de mùdì shì dádào shuāngfāng dōu néng jiēshòu de xiéyì.
examples.english: The purpose of this negotiation is to reach an agreement that both parties can accept.

semanticNote: To work a part-time or temporary job; to do odd jobs. Common among students and young workers. 打工族 (part-time workers; gig workers), 寒假打工 (work a part-time job during winter break), 打工度假 (working holiday — a popular program for young Taiwanese traveling abroad). Very colloquial; used in everyday speech.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生利用暑假打工，賺取生活費。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuésheng lìyòng shǔjià dǎgōng, zhuànqǔ shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: Many university students work part-time jobs during summer vacation to earn living expenses.

examples.chinese: 他申請到澳洲打工度假，計畫出發前先學一些英文。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēnqǐng dào Àozhōu dǎgōng dùjià, jìhuà chūfā qián xiān xué yīxiē Yīngwén.
examples.english: He applied for a working holiday in Australia and plans to learn some English before departing.

semanticNote: To deal with; to have contact with; to interact with (usually people one must work with professionally or regularly). 和...打交道 = deal with ... The phrase implies ongoing or recurring interaction, often with some complexity or effort involved. 跟政府部門打交道 (deal with government agencies) is a common expression of frustration.

components.meaning: to engage in; to have dealings with

examples.chinese: 在這個行業，你每天都要和各式各樣的客戶打交道。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège hángyè, nǐ měitiān dōu yào hé gèshì gèyàng de kèhù dǎ jiāodao.
examples.english: In this industry, you deal with all kinds of clients every day.

examples.chinese: 跟政府部門打交道需要很大的耐心。
examples.pinyin: Gēn zhèngfǔ bùmén dǎ jiāodao xūyào hěn dà de nàixīn.
examples.english: Dealing with government departments requires a lot of patience.

semanticNote: To sneeze. A specific bodily action, rarely used figuratively. 打噴嚏 (traditional: 打噴嚏). In Taiwan folk belief, sneezing once means someone is thinking of you; twice means someone is criticizing you; three times means you have a cold. 花粉症 (hay fever) causes frequent 打噴嚏.

components.meaning: to make (a sound or physical action)

examples.chinese: 他對貓毛過敏，一靠近貓就忍不住打噴嚏。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì māo máo guòmǐn, yī kàojìn māo jiù rěnbuzhù dǎpēntì.
examples.english: He's allergic to cat fur—as soon as he gets near a cat, he can't help but sneeze.

examples.chinese: 她一直打噴嚏，可能是感冒了，最好去看一下醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí dǎ pēntì, kěnéng shì gǎnmào le, zuìhǎo qù kàn yīxià yīshēng.
examples.english: She keeps sneezing—she's probably come down with a cold and should see a doctor.

semanticNote: To ask about; to inquire; to look into (information about someone or something). 打聽 implies gathering information through questioning, often discreetly. 打聽消息 (inquire about news/info), 四處打聽 (ask around), 別到處打聽人家的私事 (don't go around prying into people's private affairs). Taiwan traditional: 打聽.

components.meaning: to listen; to hear; to inquire

examples.chinese: 她到處打聽這家餐廳的電話號碼，但一直查不到。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàochù dǎtīng zhè jiā cāntīng de diànhuà hàomǎ, dàn yīzhí chá bú dào.
examples.english: She asked around everywhere for the restaurant's phone number but couldn't find it.

examples.chinese: 他悄悄地去打聽那位新同事的背景。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiāoqiāo de qù dǎtīng nà wèi xīn tóngshì de bèijǐng.
examples.english: He quietly went to ask around about the new colleague's background.

semanticNote: Generous (with money or time); also: poised, natural, gracious in manner. Two distinct senses: (1) financially generous: 他很大方，請客從不計較。(2) confident and at ease in social situations: 舉止大方 (carry oneself with poise). Both meanings are tested. Contrast with 小氣 (stingy) and 拘謹 (restrained/awkward).

examples.chinese: 他做人很大方，朋友聚餐時常常搶著買單。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòrén hěn dàfang, péngyou jùcān shí chángcháng qiǎng zhe mǎi dān.
examples.english: He's a very generous person—whenever friends dine out together, he's always the first to grab the bill.

examples.chinese: 她第一次上台演講，舉止卻非常大方，讓人印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì shàngtái yǎnjiǎng, jǔzhǐ què fēicháng dàfang, ràng rén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: It was her first time giving a speech on stage, but she carried herself with great poise, leaving a strong impression.

semanticNote: A large building; edifice; mansion. Often appears in building names: 台北101大廈 (now 101 tower), 商業大廈 (commercial building). 大廈 implies impressive scale; distinguish from 大樓 (building — more neutral everyday term) and 豪宅 (luxury residence). Taiwan traditional: 大廈.

examples.chinese: 這棟大廈的頂樓有一間景觀餐廳，可以俯瞰整個城市。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng dàshà de dǐnglóu yǒu yī jiān jǐngguān cāntīng, kěyǐ fǔkàn zhěng gè chéngshì.
examples.english: The top floor of this building has a view restaurant where you can overlook the entire city.

examples.chinese: 公司搬進了市區中心一棟剛落成的現代化大廈。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bān jìn le shìqū zhōngxīn yī dòng gāng luòchéng de xiàndàihuà dàshà.
examples.english: The company moved into a newly completed modern high-rise in the city center.

semanticNote: Elephant. 大象 is a familiar word even from early Chinese learning. At HSK5 level, worth noting: Taiwan's Taipei Zoo (台北市立動物園) is famous for its Asian elephant population. 象 alone appears in many compounds: 象徵 (symbol), 印象 (impression), 氣象 (meteorology).

examples.chinese: 台北市立動物園的大象是最受小朋友歡迎的動物之一。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi shìlì dòngwùyuán de dàxiàng shì zuì shòu xiǎopéngyǒu huānyíng de dòngwù zhī yī.
examples.english: The elephants at Taipei Municipal Zoo are among the most popular animals with children.

examples.chinese: 大象的記憶力非常好，可以記住幾十年前認識的人。
examples.pinyin: Dàxiàng de jìyìlì fēicháng hǎo, kěyǐ jìzhù jǐ shí nián qián rènshi de rén.
examples.english: Elephants have excellent memories and can remember people they met decades ago.

semanticNote: Large-scale; large-sized. Always modifies a noun: 大型活動 (large-scale event), 大型企業 (large enterprise), 大型連鎖店 (large chain store). Opposite of 小型 (small-scale). Very common in news and business contexts. Does not stand alone as a predicate.

examples.chinese: 台北每年都會舉辦多場大型國際會議和展覽。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi měi nián dōu huì jǔbàn duō chǎng dàxíng guójì huìyì hé zhǎnlǎn.
examples.english: Taipei hosts many large-scale international conferences and exhibitions every year.

examples.chinese: 政府批准了一個大型交通基礎建設計畫。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ pīzhǔn le yī gè dàxíng jiāotōng jīchǔ jiànshè jìhuà.
examples.english: The government approved a large-scale transportation infrastructure plan.

semanticNote: Stupid; foolish; blank; dumbstruck; to stay/remain (in a place). 發呆 (stare blankly; zone out) is very common. 傻呆呆 (dumb and blank). 呆在家 (stay home) is colloquial. The 'dumbstruck/blank' sense (呆住了 — frozen in shock) is useful for narrative writing. Taiwan traditional: 呆.

examples.chinese: 她聽到這個消息，整個人呆住了，說不出話來。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, zhěng gè rén dāi zhù le, shuō bù chū huà lái.
examples.english: She froze when she heard the news and couldn't say a word.

examples.chinese: 他坐在那裡發呆，不知道在想什麼。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò zài nàlǐ fādāi, bù zhīdào zài xiǎng shénme.
examples.english: He sat there staring blankly, not sure what he was thinking about.

semanticNote: To represent; representative; delegate. 代表 functions as both verb (代表全隊接受獎項 — receive the award on behalf of the whole team) and noun (選出代表 — elect a representative). 代表大會 (congress; representative assembly) is a key political term. Very high frequency.

components.meaning: to represent; on behalf of; generation
to express; to indicate; form; list

examples.chinese: 這個獎項代表著社會對她多年努力的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiǎngxiàng dàibiǎo zhe shèhuì duì tā duō nián nǔlì de kěndìng.
examples.english: This award represents society's recognition of her years of effort.

examples.chinese: 他被選為班級代表，出席全校的學生代表大會。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi xuǎn wéi bānjí dàibiǎo, chūxí quánxiào de xuésheng dàibiǎo dàhuì.
examples.english: He was chosen as the class representative to attend the school-wide student council meeting.

semanticNote: To replace; to substitute for; to take the place of. 代替 takes a human or role as its object: 代替他出席會議 (attend the meeting in his place), 用...代替... (replace X with Y). Distinct from 取代 (to supersede/displace — more permanent) and 替代 (substitute — often used in compound nouns like 替代方案).

components.meaning: to replace; to substitute; instead of

examples.chinese: 今天老師生病了，由另一位老師代替上課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān lǎoshī shēngbìng le, yóu lìng yī wèi lǎoshī dàitì shàngkè.
examples.english: The teacher is sick today, so another teacher is substituting for the class.

examples.chinese: 你不能代替別人做決定，每個人都要為自己負責。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùnéng dàitì biérén zuò juédìng, měi gè rén dōu yào wèi zìjǐ fùzé.
examples.english: You can't make decisions for others—everyone has to be responsible for themselves.

semanticNote: A loan (from a bank or financial institution); to loan money. 申請貸款 (apply for a loan), 還貸款 (repay a loan), 房屋貸款 (mortgage — very common in Taiwan: abbreviated as 房貸), 學生貸款 (student loan). Taiwan traditional: 貸款. One of the most practically relevant financial terms.

examples.chinese: 他向銀行申請了貸款，才有辦法買下這間房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng yínháng shēnqǐng le dàikuǎn, cái yǒu bànfǎ mǎi xià zhè jiān fángzi.
examples.english: He applied for a bank loan in order to be able to buy this house.

examples.chinese: 這項創業貸款計畫可以幫助年輕人實現自己的創業夢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng chuàngyè dàikuǎn jìhuà kěyǐ bāngzhù niánqīngrén shíxiàn zìjǐ de chuàngyè mèng.
examples.english: This entrepreneurship loan program can help young people realize their dream of starting a business.

semanticNote: Treatment; conditions of work; pay; benefits. Covers both how someone is treated (受到不公平的待遇 — receive unfair treatment) and employment compensation (薪資待遇 — salary and benefits). In job postings and negotiations in Taiwan, 待遇 refers to the full compensation package. A key word for workplace contexts.

components.meaning: to treat; to deal with; to wait

examples.chinese: 她換工作的主要原因是對目前公司的薪資待遇不滿意。
examples.pinyin: Tā huàn gōngzuò de zhǔyào yuányīn shì duì mùqián gōngsī de xīnzī dàiyù bù mǎnyì.
examples.english: The main reason she's changing jobs is dissatisfaction with her current company's salary and benefits.

examples.chinese: 所有員工應當受到公平的待遇，不應因性別而有差異。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu yuángōng yīngdāng shòudào gōngpíng de dàiyù, bù yīng yīn xìngbié ér yǒu chāyì.
examples.english: All employees should receive fair treatment and there should be no differences based on gender.

semanticNote: To hold a post; to serve as; to take on a role. Formal: 擔任校長 (serve as principal), 擔任主席 (serve as chair). Always followed by a role or position. More formal than 做 or 當. Common in official bios, announcements, and résumés. Taiwan traditional: 擔任.

components.meaning: to bear; to shoulder; to take on
to appoint; to serve as; duty; position

examples.chinese: 她擔任公司董事長已有十二年，帶領公司穩健成長。
examples.pinyin: Tā dānrèn gōngsī dǒngshìzhǎng yǐ yǒu shí'èr nián, dàilǐng gōngsī wěnjiàn chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: She has served as the company's chairperson for twelve years, leading the company in steady growth.

examples.chinese: 這部電影由知名導演擔任監製，演員陣容也非常豪華。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yóu zhīmíng dǎoyǎn dānrèn jiānzhì, yǎnyuán zhènróng yě fēicháng háohuá.
examples.english: This film has a famous director serving as executive producer, and the cast is very star-studded.

semanticNote: Simple; pure; merely. Describes either (1) a person who is innocent and uncomplicated in character (他很單純 — he's naive and pure-hearted), or (2) a situation/motivation that is straightforwardly simple (單純是因為... — simply because...). As an adverb it means 'purely; simply; merely.' Taiwan traditional: 單純.

examples.chinese: 他是個很單純的人，從不計較太多，對人很真誠。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè hěn dānchún de rén, cóng bù jìjiào tài duō, duì rén hěn zhēnchéng.
examples.english: He is a very pure-hearted person—he never overthinks things and is very sincere with people.

examples.chinese: 我幫你單純是因為想幫忙，沒有任何其他的目的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ dānchún shì yīnwèi xiǎng bāngmáng, méiyǒu rènhé qítā de mùdì.
examples.english: I'm helping you simply because I want to—there's no other motive.

semanticNote: Monotonous; dull; lacking variety. Describes repetitive, unstimulating work, sounds, or environments. 生活單調 (a dull life), 色彩單調 (dull colors), 工作單調 (monotonous work). Opposite of 豐富 (varied; rich) and 多彩多姿 (colorful; varied). Taiwan traditional: 單調.

examples.chinese: 他的工作內容每天都一樣，感到非常單調乏味。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò nèiróng měitiān dōu yīyàng, gǎndào fēicháng dāndiào fáwèi.
examples.english: His work is the same every day—he finds it extremely monotonous and dull.

examples.chinese: 這幅畫的色彩太單調了，如果加些對比色會更好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà de sècǎi tài dāndiào le, rúguǒ jiā xiē duìbǐsè huì gèng hǎokàn.
examples.english: The colors in this painting are too monotonous—it would look better with some contrasting colors added.

semanticNote: Alone; by oneself; individually; on one's own. 單獨行動 (act alone), 單獨見面 (meet one-on-one), 單獨完成 (complete on one's own). More formal than 自己一個人. The sense of being separate from others — sometimes empowering, sometimes isolating — is central. Taiwan traditional: 單獨.

examples.chinese: 她第一次單獨出國旅行，一個人在歐洲待了三週。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì dāndú chūguó lǚxíng, yī gè rén zài Ōuzhōu dāi le sān zhōu.
examples.english: She traveled abroad alone for the first time, spending three weeks in Europe by herself.

examples.chinese: 主管想單獨和他談一談，讓其他人先離開。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔguǎn xiǎng dāndú hé tā tán yī tán, ràng qítā rén xiān líkāi.
examples.english: The supervisor wanted to speak with him one-on-one and asked the others to leave first.

semanticNote: Unit — both in measurement (公里是距離的單位 — kilometer is a unit of distance) and in Chinese institutional context: 工作單位 (work unit; employer) is a term from mainland China's system, also understood in Taiwan. In Taiwan the measurement sense is primary; the workplace sense is understood but less central.

examples.chinese: 國際單位制使用「公尺」作為長度的基本單位。
examples.pinyin: Guójì dānwèi zhì shǐyòng 'gōngchǐ' zuòwéi chángdù de jīběn dānwèi.
examples.english: The International System of Units uses 'meter' as the basic unit of length.

examples.chinese: 這項研究由政府相關單位協助資助。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū yóu zhèngfǔ xiāngguān dānwèi xiézhù zīzhù.
examples.english: This research was co-funded by the relevant government agencies.

semanticNote: Unit — as in a chapter/unit of a textbook, an episode of a show, or an apartment unit in a building. 第一單元 (Unit 1/Chapter 1), 住宅單元 (residential unit/apartment). In Taiwan, 幾樓幾號幾單元 is part of the address format for apartment buildings — 單元 identifies the staircase entrance.

examples.chinese: 這本教材共有十二個單元，每個單元有新詞和練習題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn jiàocái gòng yǒu shí'èr gè dānyuán, měi gè dānyuán yǒu xīncí hé liànxítí.
examples.english: This textbook has a total of twelve units; each unit has new vocabulary and practice exercises.

examples.chinese: 我住在這棟大樓的B單元三樓，歡迎來找我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài zhè dòng dàlóu de B dānyuán sān lóu, huānyíng lái zhǎo wǒ.
examples.english: I live on the third floor of Entrance B in this building—welcome to come visit.

semanticNote: To delay; to waste time; to hold up. 耽誤 implies time or opportunity is lost due to a delay or distraction. 耽誤時間 (waste time), 耽誤行程 (delay a trip/schedule), 耽誤學業 (disrupt one's studies). The object is what is wasted/delayed, not the person. Taiwan traditional: 耽誤.

components.meaning: to err; to miss; to delay

examples.chinese: 抱歉，我在路上遇到塞車，耽誤了一點時間。
examples.pinyin: Bàoqiàn, wǒ zài lùshàng yùdào sāichē, dānwu le yī diǎn shíjiān.
examples.english: Sorry, I got stuck in traffic and was delayed a bit.

examples.chinese: 這件事情不複雜，不要讓它耽誤了你正在做的重要工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing bù fùzá, búyào ràng tā dānwu le nǐ zhèngzài zuò de zhòngyào gōngzuò.
examples.english: This matter isn't complicated—don't let it delay the important work you're doing.

semanticNote: Coward. A direct insult or teasing term: 膽小鬼 (big fat scaredy-cat!). Often used playfully between friends or children, less often in formal contexts. 膽小 alone (adj.) = timid/cowardly; 膽大 = bold/daring. Memorize the compound: 膽 (gall bladder = courage in Chinese medicine) + 小 + 鬼 (ghost/creature). Taiwan traditional: 膽小鬼.

examples.chinese: 「你不敢去嗎？真是個膽小鬼！」朋友笑著對他說。
examples.pinyin: 'Nǐ bù gǎn qù ma? Zhēn shì gè dǎnxiǎoguǐ!' Péngyǒu xiào zhe duì tā shuō.
examples.english: 'You don't dare to go? What a coward!' his friend said with a laugh.

examples.chinese: 他以前是個膽小鬼，現在卻敢獨自去山區露營。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐqián shì gè dǎnxiǎoguǐ, xiànzài què gǎn dúzì qù shānqū lùyíng.
examples.english: He used to be a coward, but now he dares to go camping alone in the mountains.

semanticNote: Diluted; weak; bland (for taste — light, not salty/sweet enough); also pale (in color) or faint/light (of smells, feelings). 口味淡 (light/bland taste), 顏色淡 (pale color), 淡季 (off-season — when business is light), 感情淡了 (feelings faded). Opposite of 濃 (thick; strong; concentrated).

examples.chinese: 這道湯味道太淡，可以加點鹽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tāng wèidào tài dàn, kěyǐ jiā diǎn yán.
examples.english: This soup tastes too bland—you can add a little salt.

examples.chinese: 夏天是旅遊旺季，冬天則是淡季，遊客明顯減少。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān shì lǚyóu wàngjì, dōngtiān zé shì dànjì, yóukè míngxiǎn jiǎnshǎo.
examples.english: Summer is the peak tourist season; winter is the off-season, with noticeably fewer visitors.

semanticNote: Local; the local area; where something takes place. 當地人 (locals), 當地文化 (local culture), 當地時間 (local time). Very common in travel writing, news reports, and formal descriptions of events or phenomena in a specific place. Taiwan traditional: 當地.

examples.chinese: 旅遊時，多和當地人聊天，可以更了解這個地方的文化。
examples.pinyin: Lǚyóu shí, duō hé dāngdì rén liáotiān, kěyǐ gèng liǎojiě zhège dìfāng de wénhuà.
examples.english: When traveling, chatting with locals more will help you better understand the culture of the place.

examples.chinese: 這道料理使用的都是當地的新鮮食材，非常有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào liàolǐ shǐyòng de dōu shì dāngdì de xīnxiān shícái, fēicháng yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: This dish uses only fresh local ingredients—it's very distinctive.

semanticNote: Take care; be careful; watch out. 當心 is used as a warning or instruction: 當心滑倒！(Watch out — slippery!), 當心詐騙 (beware of scams). Slightly stronger than 小心 in urgency. Very common in public notices, safety warnings, and parental advice. Taiwan traditional: 當心.

components.meaning: to face; to respond to; right at

examples.chinese: 地板剛拖過，很滑，當心別跌倒！
examples.pinyin: Dìbǎn gāng tuō guò, hěn huá, dāngxīn bié diēdǎo!
examples.english: The floor was just mopped and is very slippery—watch out and don't fall!

examples.chinese: 近年來網路詐騙很猖獗，大家一定要當心。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái wǎnglù zhàpiàn hěn chāngjué, dàjiā yīdìng yào dāngxīn.
examples.english: Online scams have been rampant in recent years—everyone must be careful.

semanticNote: To block; to obstruct; to shield (dǎng). Also: gear/shift (as in a car — dàng). The blocking sense is most common at HSK5: 擋住視線 (block the view), 擋風 (block the wind), 擋不住 (can't stop/block). Taiwan traditional: 擋.

components.meaning: to block; to hinder; to screen | gear (automobile)

examples.chinese: 前面的大樹擋住了陽光，讓這裡非常涼快。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn de dà shù dǎngzhù le yángguāng, ràng zhèlǐ fēicháng liángkuai.
examples.english: The large tree in front is blocking the sunlight, making this spot very cool.

examples.chinese: 你站在那裡擋住了我的視線，能不能移一下？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhàn zài nàlǐ dǎngzhù le wǒ de shìxiàn, néng bùnéng yí yīxià?
examples.english: You're standing there blocking my view—could you move a bit?

semanticNote: Director (film, theater, TV); to direct. As a noun: 電影導演 (film director), 知名導演 (famous director). As a verb: 導演這部電影 (direct this film). Taiwan's film industry is internationally recognized — directors like 李安 (Ang Lee) and 侯孝賢 (Hou Hsiao-hsien) are household names. Taiwan traditional: 導演.

components.meaning: to guide; to direct; to lead
to perform; to act; to show

examples.chinese: 這部電影由知名導演李安執導，在國際上獲獎無數。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yóu zhīmíng dǎoyǎn Lǐ Ān zhídǎo, zài guójì shàng huòjiǎng wúshù.
examples.english: This film was directed by the renowned director Ang Lee and has won numerous international awards.

examples.chinese: 她的夢想是有一天能夠導演一部屬於自己的電影。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì yǒu yītiān nénggòu dǎoyǎn yī bù shǔyú zìjǐ de diànyǐng.
examples.english: Her dream is to one day direct a film of her own.

semanticNote: To lead to; to bring about; to cause (a negative outcome). 導致 is almost exclusively used for negative or undesirable results: 導致失敗 (lead to failure), 導致誤解 (cause a misunderstanding), 導致傷亡 (lead to casualties). It always introduces a consequence, never a goal. Taiwan traditional: 導致.

components.meaning: to lead; to guide; to cause
to cause; to lead to; to bring about

examples.chinese: 長期熬夜會導致免疫力下降，增加生病的風險。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè huì dǎozhì miǎnyì lì xiàjiàng, zēngjiā shēngbìng de fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: Staying up late for long periods can lead to a weakened immune system and increased risk of illness.

examples.chinese: 溝通不良往往會導致雙方產生誤會和衝突。
examples.pinyin: Gōutōng bùliáng wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì shuāngfāng chǎnshēng wùhuì hé chōngtū.
examples.english: Poor communication often leads to misunderstandings and conflict between both parties.

semanticNote: Islands (collective or plural); 島嶼 refers to islands in general or a group of islands. 島 is a single island; 嶼 is a small island. 台灣是個由多個島嶼組成的地方 — Taiwan is a place composed of multiple islands. Politically significant in Taiwan: 太平島 (Itu Aba), 澎湖群島 (Penghu Archipelago), 金門 (Kinmen), 馬祖 (Matsu). Taiwan traditional: 島嶼.

examples.chinese: 台灣由台灣本島及許多離島所組成，離島包括澎湖、金門等。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yóu Táiwān běndǎo jí xǔduō lídǎo suǒ zǔchéng, lídǎo bāokuò Pénghú, Jīnmén děng.
examples.english: Taiwan is composed of the main island and many outlying islands, including Penghu and Kinmen.

examples.chinese: 這片海域分布著數十個大大小小的島嶼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn hǎiyù fēnbù zhe shùshí gè dà dà xiǎo xiǎo de dǎoyǔ.
examples.english: Dozens of islands of various sizes are scattered across this sea area.

semanticNote: Having bad luck; be out of luck; unlucky. A colloquial and expressive word. 今天真倒霉！(Today is really unlucky!) 倒霉透了 (incredibly unlucky; down on one's luck). The character 霉 means 'mold/mildew' — literally 'falling into mold.' Used in complaint and commiseration, common in everyday speech.

examples.chinese: 今天真是倒霉，出門就下大雨，而且鑰匙也忘帶了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zhēn shì dǎoméi, chūmén jiù xià dà yǔ, érqiě yàoshi yě wàng dài le.
examples.english: Today is really unlucky—it started pouring the moment I left home, and I forgot my keys too.

examples.chinese: 他連輸了三場比賽，覺得自己最近運氣特別差，太倒霉了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lián shū le sān chǎng bǐsài, juéde zìjǐ zuìjìn yùnqì tèbié chà, tài dǎoméi le.
examples.english: He lost three matches in a row and felt his luck had been especially bad lately—so unlucky.

semanticNote: To arrive at; to reach (a destination). More formal than 到 alone. Used for destinations and standards: 到達台北 (arrive at Taipei), 到達目標 (reach a target), 到達頂峰 (reach the peak). Common in travel, logistics, and formal reporting. Taiwan traditional: 到達.

components.meaning: to reach; to attain; to achieve

examples.chinese: 飛機預計下午三點到達台北松山機場。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī yùjì xiàwǔ sān diǎn dàodá Táiběi Sōngshān jīchǎng.
examples.english: The plane is scheduled to arrive at Taipei Songshan Airport at 3 PM.

examples.chinese: 登山隊在日出前成功到達玉山的頂峰。
examples.pinyin: Dēngshān duì zài rìchū qián chénggōng dàodá Yùshān de dǐngfēng.
examples.english: The climbing team successfully reached the summit of Jade Mountain before sunrise.

semanticNote: Morals; morality; ethics; moral. 道德標準 (moral standards), 道德觀 (moral views), 道德爭議 (ethical controversy). In Taiwan, 道德 also refers to the school subject (formerly part of the curriculum). 不道德 (immoral) is a common criticism. Historically also refers to the Taoist concept of 道 (the Way) and 德 (virtue).

examples.chinese: 一個企業除了追求利潤，也應該承擔社會道德責任。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè qǐyè chúle zhuīqiú lìrùn, yě yīnggāi chéngdān shèhuì dàodé zérèn.
examples.english: A business, in addition to pursuing profit, should also take on social and ethical responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 他的行為違反了基本的道德準則，受到社會的強烈譴責。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi wéifǎn le jīběn de dàodé zhǔnzé, shòudào shèhuì de qiángliè qiǎnzé.
examples.english: His behavior violated basic moral principles and drew strong condemnation from society.

semanticNote: Reason; sense; argument; principle. 這話有道理 (that makes sense), 講道理 (be reasonable; talk sense), 不講道理 (unreasonable; won't listen to reason). 道理 also means a moral lesson: 這個故事告訴我們一個道理 (this story teaches us a lesson). Very common across all registers.

examples.chinese: 他說的很有道理，大家都被說服了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de hěn yǒu dàolǐ, dàjiā dōu bèi shuōfú le.
examples.english: What he said made a lot of sense and everyone was convinced.

examples.chinese: 小時候媽媽告訴我很多做人的道理，現在回想起來都很受用。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhòu māmā gàosù wǒ hěn duō zuòrén de dàolǐ, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐlái dōu hěn shòuyòng.
examples.english: When I was little, my mother taught me many life lessons, and thinking back on them now, they're all very useful.

semanticNote: To register; to check in; to enroll; registration. 登記 covers hotel check-in (辦理登記), household registration (戶籍登記), marriage registration (結婚登記), and event sign-up. In Taiwan, 戶籍登記 and 婚姻登記 are handled by the Household Registration Office (戶政事務所). Taiwan traditional: 登記.

components.meaning: to ascend; to register; to publish
to record; to note; to register

examples.chinese: 辦理入住時，請先到前台登記並出示護照。
examples.pinyin: Bànlǐ rùzhù shí, qǐng xiān dào qiántái dēngjì bìng chūshì hùzhào.
examples.english: When checking in, please go to the front desk to register and present your passport.

examples.chinese: 他們決定到戶政事務所辦理結婚登記。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng dào hùzhèng shìwùsuǒ bànlǐ jiéhūn dēngjì.
examples.english: They decided to go to the Household Registration Office to register their marriage.

semanticNote: To wait; to await; to expect (something to happen). More patient and enduring than 等 alone — 等待 implies a longer or more expectant wait. 等待機會 (wait for an opportunity), 等待結果 (wait for results). Often appears in more literary or emotional contexts: 等待愛情 (waiting for love).

components.meaning: to wait; to be equal to; et cetera
to wait; to stay; to treat

examples.chinese: 她在機場等待了兩個小時，才等到從美國回來的丈夫。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jīchǎng děngdài le liǎng gè xiǎoshí, cái děng dào cóng Měiguó huílái de zhàngfu.
examples.english: She waited at the airport for two hours before her husband returning from America finally arrived.

examples.chinese: 成功需要努力，同時也需要耐心等待機會的到來。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng xūyào nǔlì, tóngshí yě xūyào nàixīn děngdài jīhuì de dàolái.
examples.english: Success requires effort, but also patience in waiting for opportunities to arrive.

semanticNote: To equal; to be equivalent to (mathematics: =); also used figuratively: 這等於是在說謊 (this amounts to lying). 等於 is both a math symbol and a common logical/rhetorical connector. Taiwan traditional: 等於.

examples.chinese: 三加七等於十，這是最基本的算術。
examples.pinyin: Sān jiā qī děngyú shí, zhè shì zuì jīběn de suànshù.
examples.english: Three plus seven equals ten—this is the most basic arithmetic.

examples.chinese: 不回覆訊息有時候等於是默認對方的說法。
examples.pinyin: Bù huífù xùnxī yǒushíhòu děngyú shì mòrèn duìfāng de shuōfǎ.
examples.english: Not replying to a message sometimes amounts to tacitly accepting what the other person said.

semanticNote: To drip; drop (measure word for drops of liquid). 一滴水 (a drop of water), 一滴眼淚 (a teardrop), 滴滴答答 (drip drip — sound of dripping). As a verb: 水從天花板上滴下來 (water is dripping from the ceiling). Also known in Taiwan as the name of a ride-hailing app (滴滴出行), though less dominant there than in mainland China.

components.meaning: to drip; a drop; (mw for drops of liquid)

examples.chinese: 屋頂漏水了，雨水一滴一滴地落在地板上。
examples.pinyin: Wūdǐng lòu shuǐ le, yǔshuǐ yī dī yī dī de luò zài dìbǎn shàng.
examples.english: The roof is leaking—rainwater is dripping drop by drop onto the floor.

examples.chinese: 她感動地流下了兩滴眼淚，卻沒有說一句話。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǎndòng de liú xià le liǎng dī yǎnlèi, què méiyǒu shuō yī jù huà.
examples.english: Moved by the moment, she shed two tears but didn't say a word.

semanticNote: Really; indeed; certainly; truly. 的確 is used to confirm or emphasize that something is true, often conceding a point before adding nuance: 的確，這個方法有效，但也有缺點 (It's true this method works, but it has drawbacks too). More emphatic and literary than 確實 in some contexts. Taiwan traditional: 的確.

examples.chinese: 你說得的確有道理，但我們還需要考慮其他因素。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de díquè yǒu dàolǐ, dàn wǒmen hái xūyào kǎolǜ qítā yīnsù.
examples.english: What you said indeed makes sense, but we still need to consider other factors.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夏天的確非常炎熱，但颱風季也會帶來涼意。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān díquè fēicháng yánrè, dàn táifēng jì yě huì dài lái liángyì.
examples.english: Taiwan's summer is indeed very hot, but typhoon season also brings some cooling.

semanticNote: Enemy; foe. Both literal (military/political enemy) and figurative (biggest enemy = 最大的敵人 — often used for internal foes like fear, laziness). 化敵為友 (turn an enemy into a friend). Taiwan traditional: 敵人. In Taiwan's political context, 敵人 is used cautiously — 競爭對手 (competitor/rival) is preferred in business.

components.meaning: enemy; opponent; to be a match for

examples.chinese: 恐懼是我們前進道路上最大的敵人。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngjù shì wǒmen qiánjìn dàolù shàng zuìdà de dírén.
examples.english: Fear is the greatest enemy on our path forward.

examples.chinese: 雖然他們曾經是敵人，但多年後卻成為了好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tāmen céngjīng shì dírén, dàn duō nián hòu què chéng wéi le hǎo péngyǒu.
examples.english: Although they were once enemies, many years later they became good friends.

semanticNote: Authentic; genuine; true to the original (dìdao). 地道的台灣小吃 (authentic Taiwanese street food), 說的地道 (speak [a language] in an authentic, native way). As a noun with different tone: 地道 (dìdào) = underground tunnel. The adjective sense is primary at HSK5 level and reflects Taiwan's pride in authentic local culture.

examples.chinese: 他在台灣住了十年，說的台語非常地道。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Táiwān zhù le shí nián, shuō de Táiyǔ fēicháng dìdao.
examples.english: He has lived in Taiwan for ten years and speaks Taiwanese Hokkien very authentically.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳做的蚵仔煎非常地道，完全是古早味。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuò de ézǎijiān fēicháng dìdao, wánquán shì gǔzǎo wèi.
examples.english: The oyster omelet at this restaurant is very authentic—it's the true old-fashioned flavor.

semanticNote: Geography — both the academic subject and the physical characteristics of a place. 地理位置 (geographical location), 地理環境 (geographical environment), 地理課 (geography class). In Taiwan, 地理 is a required subject in high school and tested in university entrance exams (學測). 台灣地理 features mountains, plains, and coastline.

examples.chinese: 台灣的地理位置使它成為亞太地區的重要樞紐。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de dìlǐ wèizhì shǐ tā chéngwéi Yà-Tài dìqū de zhòngyào shūniǔ.
examples.english: Taiwan's geographical location makes it an important hub in the Asia-Pacific region.

examples.chinese: 地理老師帶我們研究台灣各地的氣候和地形差異。
examples.pinyin: Dìlǐ lǎoshī dài wǒmen yánjiū Táiwān gèdì de qìhòu hé dìxíng chāyì.
examples.english: The geography teacher led us to study the climatic and topographic differences across Taiwan.

semanticNote: An area; a region; a district. Broadly used in geographic, political, and administrative contexts. In Taiwan political discourse, 地區 is preferred over 國家 for politically sensitive entities: 台灣地區, 兩岸地區. In everyday speech, it means any defined geographic area: 山地地區 (mountainous area), 偏遠地區 (remote area). Taiwan traditional: 地區.

examples.chinese: 台灣東部地區多山，自然景觀非常壯麗。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān dōngbù dìqū duō shān, zìrán jǐngguān fēicháng zhuànglì.
examples.english: Eastern Taiwan has many mountains and its natural scenery is breathtaking.

examples.chinese: 偏遠地區的醫療資源較為不足，政府正積極改善。
examples.pinyin: Piānyuǎn dìqū de yīliáo zīyuán jiàowéi bùzú, zhèngfǔ zhèng jījí gǎishàn.
examples.english: Medical resources in remote areas are relatively insufficient, and the government is actively working to improve this.

semanticNote: Carpet; rug. 地毯 is the general term for floor coverings of textile material. 鋪地毯 (lay a carpet), 地毯式搜索 (carpet-bomb search; thorough search). In Taiwan interiors, hardwood or tile is more common than wall-to-wall carpet, but rugs (小地毯) are popular in living rooms.

examples.chinese: 客廳中間鋪了一張波斯地毯，顯得非常高雅。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng zhōngjiān pū le yī zhāng Bōsī dìtǎn, xiǎndé fēicháng gāoyǎ.
examples.english: A Persian rug was laid in the center of the living room, giving it a very elegant appearance.

examples.chinese: 警方對案發現場進行了地毯式搜索，找到了重要的證物。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng duì ànfā xiànchǎng jìnxíng le dìtǎn shì sōusuǒ, zhǎo dào le zhòngyào de zhèngwù.
examples.english: Police conducted a thorough search of the crime scene and found important evidence.

semanticNote: Position; status; standing (social, political, or institutional). 社會地位 (social status), 法律地位 (legal status), 國際地位 (international standing). 地位 refers to one's place in a hierarchy or system; it can be earned or assigned. Very common in Taiwan's social mobility and political discourse.

examples.chinese: 台灣半導體產業在全球供應鏈中具有不可替代的地位。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān bàndǎotǐ chǎnyè zài quánqiú gōngyìng liàn zhōng jùyǒu bùkě tìdài de dìwèi.
examples.english: Taiwan's semiconductor industry holds an irreplaceable position in the global supply chain.

examples.chinese: 她憑著多年的努力，在業界建立了相當高的地位。
examples.pinyin: Tā píngzhe duō nián de nǔlì, zài yèjiè jiànlì le xiāngdāng gāo de dìwèi.
examples.english: Through years of hard work, she has established a fairly high standing in the industry.

semanticNote: Earthquake. Taiwan is one of the world's most seismically active places — earthquakes are a daily reality. 芮氏規模 (Richter scale), 震央 (epicenter), 中央氣象局 (Central Weather Bureau, which issues alerts). 1999年921大地震 (the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake) is a defining national trauma. 地震 is immediately practical vocabulary for anyone in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣是地震頻繁的地區，平均每年發生數千次地震。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì dìzhèn pínfán de dìqū, píngjūn měi nián fāshēng shù qiān cì dìzhèn.
examples.english: Taiwan is an earthquake-prone region, with an average of thousands of earthquakes occurring every year.

examples.chinese: 昨天凌晨發生了一次芮氏規模五點八的地震，許多人從睡夢中驚醒。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān língchén fāshēng le yī cì ruìshì guīmó wǔ diǎn bā de dìzhèn, xǔduō rén cóng shuìmèng zhōng jīng xǐng.
examples.english: Early this morning a magnitude 5.8 earthquake occurred, jolting many people awake from sleep.

semanticNote: To hand over; to pass; to give (something to someone directly). 遞 implies physical handoff: 遞給他 (hand it to him), 遞交申請書 (submit an application — lit. 'hand deliver'), 遞眼色 (give a look; make eye contact to signal). More deliberate and direct than 給. Taiwan traditional: 遞.

components.meaning: to hand over; to pass; to deliver

examples.chinese: 她把整理好的文件遞給主管，等待對方審閱。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhěnglǐ hǎo de wénjiàn dì gěi zhǔguǎn, děngdài duìfāng shěnyuè.
examples.english: She handed the organized documents to her supervisor and waited for them to review.

examples.chinese: 他在會議中遞了一個眼色給同事，示意現在不是討論的好時機。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì zhōng dì le yī gè yǎnsè gěi tóngshì, shìyì xiànzài bú shì tǎolùn de hǎo shíjī.
examples.english: He gave his colleague a look during the meeting, signaling that now wasn't a good time to discuss it.

semanticNote: Dim sum; light refreshments; snacks. 點心 in Taiwan covers both Hong Kong-style dim sum (港式點心) and light snacks eaten between meals. Taiwan's breakfast shops (早餐店) and afternoon tea culture feature many 點心. Also used for pastries and small bites at formal tea gatherings. Taiwan traditional: 點心.

components.meaning: a dot; a little; to order

examples.chinese: 假日去吃港式點心是很多台灣家庭的傳統。
examples.pinyin: Jiàrì qù chī Gǎngshì diǎnxīn shì hěn duō Táiwān jiātíng de chuántǒng.
examples.english: Going out for Hong Kong-style dim sum on weekends is a tradition for many Taiwanese families.

examples.chinese: 她在下午喝茶時準備了幾樣精緻的點心招待客人。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xiàwǔ hē chá shí zhǔnbèi le jǐ yàng jīngzhì de diǎnxīn zhāodài kèrén.
examples.english: When having afternoon tea, she prepared several exquisite snacks to entertain the guests.

semanticNote: Battery — for devices. 充電 (recharge), 換電池 (replace the battery), 電池沒電了 (the battery is dead). 鋰電池 (lithium battery), 太陽能電池 (solar cell). Very common modern vocabulary. In Taiwan, 電池 回收 (battery recycling) is prominently promoted. Taiwan traditional: 電池.

examples.chinese: 遙控器的電池沒電了，需要換新的。
examples.pinyin: Yáokòngqì de diànchí méi diàn le, xūyào huàn xīn de.
examples.english: The remote control's battery is dead—it needs to be replaced.

examples.chinese: 台灣積極發展電動車產業，電池技術是關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān jījí fāzhǎn diàndòngchē chǎnyè, diànchí jìshù shì guānjiàn.
examples.english: Taiwan is actively developing the electric vehicle industry, with battery technology being the key.

semanticNote: Radio station; broadcasting station; transceiver. 廣播電台 (radio broadcast station), 地下電台 (underground/unlicensed station), 電台節目 (radio program). In Taiwan, radio remains popular for traffic updates, talk shows, and Taiwanese-language programming. Taiwan traditional: 電台.

examples.chinese: 他每天開車上班時都會收聽同一個廣播電台的早晨節目。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān kāichē shàngbān shí dōu huì shōutīng tóngyī gè guǎngbō diàntái de zǎochén jiémù.
examples.english: Every day on his drive to work, he listens to the same radio station's morning program.

examples.chinese: 這個電台的台語節目深受中南部聽眾的喜愛。
examples.pinyin: Zhège diàntái de Táiyǔ jiémù shēn shòu zhōngnánbù tīngzhòng de xǐ'ài.
examples.english: This station's Taiwanese-language programs are deeply loved by listeners in central and southern Taiwan.

semanticNote: To fish (with a rod); to angle. 釣魚 (go fishing) is a popular leisure activity in Taiwan, both at rivers and coastline. Figurative: 釣到大魚 (catch a big fish — land a big client), 釣金龜 (catch a rich person as a partner — Taiwanese colloquial). Taiwan traditional: 釣.

components.meaning: to fish with a rod; to angle

examples.chinese: 每到週末，爸爸喜歡帶著魚竿去河邊釣魚放鬆心情。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào zhōumò, bàba xǐhuān dài zhe yúgān qù hé biān diào yú fàngsōng xīnqíng.
examples.english: Every weekend, Dad likes to take his fishing rod to the riverside to fish and relax.

examples.chinese: 他在海邊釣了整整一個下午，一條魚都沒釣到。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hǎibiān diào le zhěngzhěng yī gè xiàwǔ, yī tiáo yú dōu méi diào dào.
examples.english: He fished at the seaside for a whole afternoon without catching a single fish.

semanticNote: Top; roof; peak (noun); to carry on one's head; to prop up; to push back against (verb); measure word for hats and helmets. 山頂 (mountain peak), 屋頂 (roof), 頂多 (at most), 頂不住 (can't hold out against). 一頂帽子 (a hat). Taiwan traditional: 頂.

components.meaning: top; roof; to carry on head; (mw for hats)

examples.chinese: 爬到山頂後，眼前的景色讓所有人都驚嘆不已。
