examples.pinyin: Pá dào shāndǐng hòu, yǎnqián de jǐngsè ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu jīngtàn bùyǐ.
examples.english: After climbing to the top of the mountain, the scenery before everyone left them in awe.

examples.chinese: 她頂著大太陽走了半小時才到車站，熱得滿頭大汗。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǐngzhe dà tàiyáng zǒu le bàn xiǎoshí cái dào chēzhàn, rè de mǎntóu dàhàn.
examples.english: She walked for half an hour under the blazing sun to reach the station, sweating profusely from the heat.

semanticNote: Animated film; cartoon. 動畫片 covers both movies and TV series. Taiwan has a strong anime fandom (日本動畫), and the word 動畫 is also used. 國產動畫 (domestically produced animation) is a growing field. Common collocations: 看動畫片 (watch a cartoon), 迪士尼動畫片 (Disney animated film). Taiwan traditional: 動畫片.

examples.chinese: 她小時候最喜歡看宮崎駿的動畫片，到現在還是百看不厭。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhòu zuì xǐhuān kàn Gōngqíjùn de dònghuàpiàn, dào xiànzài háishì bǎi kàn bù yàn.
examples.english: Her favorite thing as a child was watching Miyazaki's animated films, and she still never gets tired of them.

examples.chinese: 這部國產動畫片獲得了金馬獎的最佳動畫長片獎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù guóchǎn dònghuàpiàn huòdé le Jīnmǎ jiǎng de zuìjiā dònghuà chángpiàn jiǎng.
examples.english: This domestically produced animated film won the Golden Horse Award for Best Animated Feature.

semanticNote: To freeze; to be frozen; frozen (cold). 凍死了 (freezing to death — hyperbole for very cold), 凍結資產 (freeze assets — financial/legal), 豆花冰凍 (frozen tofu pudding — a Taiwan dessert). 冷凍 (deep freeze; frozen food) is a common compound. Taiwan traditional: 凍.

examples.chinese: 冰箱裡的豆腐凍了之後，口感會變得不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de dòufu dòng le zhīhòu, kǒugǎn huì biàn de bù yīyàng.
examples.english: After the tofu in the fridge freezes, its texture changes.

examples.chinese: 今天氣溫驟降，外面冷得快把人凍僵了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān qìwēn zhòujiàng, wàimiàn lěng de kuài bǎ rén dòng jiāng le.
examples.english: The temperature dropped sharply today—it's so cold outside you're practically frozen stiff.

semanticNote: A cave; a hole; a pit. 山洞 (cave in a mountain), 洞穴 (cave; cavern), 打洞 (drill a hole), 看穿洞見 (see through; have insight). Also used figuratively: 預算有個洞 (there's a hole in the budget). Taiwan has famous caves: 太魯閣峽谷 (Taroko Gorge) has numerous cave formations.

examples.chinese: 太魯閣峽谷中有許多天然形成的岩洞，景色非常壯觀。
examples.pinyin: Tàilǔgé xiágǔ zhōng yǒu xǔduō tiānrán xíngchéng de yándòng, jǐngsè fēicháng zhuàngguān.
examples.english: Taroko Gorge has many naturally formed rock caves, and the scenery is spectacular.

examples.chinese: 他的褲子在膝蓋處破了一個洞，看起來很狼狽。
examples.pinyin: Tā de kùzi zài xīgài chù pò le yī gè dòng, kàn qǐlái hěn lángbèi.
examples.english: There's a hole in the knee of his pants—he looks quite disheveled.

semanticNote: Tofu; bean curd. A fundamental ingredient in Taiwanese cuisine: 豆腐湯 (tofu soup), 麻婆豆腐 (mapo tofu), 臭豆腐 (stinky tofu), 豆花 (silken tofu pudding dessert). 豆腐 is also used metaphorically for someone who is soft/fragile: 豆腐心 (soft heart; kind-hearted person who acts tough). An extremely culturally important food in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣夜市的臭豆腐聞起來很特別，但當地人非常喜愛。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yèshì de chòudòufu wén qǐlái hěn tèbié, dàn dāngdì rén fēicháng xǐ'ài.
examples.english: The stinky tofu at Taiwan night markets has a distinctive smell, but locals love it.

examples.chinese: 她在超市買了板豆腐，打算回家做紅燒豆腐。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chāoshì mǎi le bǎn dòufu, dǎsuàn huíjiā zuò hóngshāo dòufu.
examples.english: She bought firm tofu at the supermarket and planned to go home and make braised tofu.

semanticNote: To tease; to amuse; funny (colloquial). 逗小孩 (amuse/play with a child), 逗笑了 (made someone laugh), 這個人真逗！(This person is really funny!). 逗 implies lighthearted teasing or entertainment. Also: to stay; to stop (archaic, now mainly in punctuation term 逗號 = comma). Taiwan traditional: 逗.

components.meaning: to tease; to amuse; funny; to provoke laughter

examples.chinese: 爸爸喜歡做鬼臉來逗小嬰兒，讓她咯咯地笑。
examples.pinyin: Bàba xǐhuān zuò guǐliǎn lái dòu xiǎo yīng'ér, ràng tā gēgē de xiào.
examples.english: Dad likes to make funny faces to amuse the baby, making her giggle.

examples.chinese: 他說了一個笑話，逗得大家哈哈大笑。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō le yī gè xiàohua, dòu de dàjiā hāhā dà xiào.
examples.english: He told a joke that had everyone laughing out loud.

semanticNote: Independent; to be independent; independence. 獨立 has personal (獨立思考 — think independently), institutional (獨立機構 — independent organization), and political senses. In Taiwan, 台灣獨立 (Taiwan independence) is a major political discourse. 獨立精神 (spirit of independence) is highly valued in Taiwan's educational culture. Taiwan traditional: 獨立.

examples.chinese: 培養孩子獨立生活的能力，是現代父母的重要責任。
examples.pinyin: Péiyǎng háizi dúlì shēnghuó de nénglì, shì xiàndài fùmǔ de zhòngyào zérèn.
examples.english: Cultivating children's ability to live independently is an important responsibility of modern parents.

examples.chinese: 這份報告由獨立的研究機構進行，以確保結果的客觀性。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào yóu dúlì de yánjiū jīgòu jìnxíng, yǐ quèbǎo jiéguǒ de kèguānxìng.
examples.english: This report was conducted by an independent research organization to ensure the objectivity of the results.

semanticNote: Unique; distinctive; one-of-a-kind. Always positive. 獨特的風格 (unique style), 獨特的文化 (distinctive culture), 獨特的魅力 (unique charm). Common in marketing, arts, and cultural discourse. Taiwan often uses 獨特 to describe its own fusion culture: 台灣獨特的文化特色. Taiwan traditional: 獨特.

examples.chinese: 台灣融合了閩南、客家、原住民及外來文化，形成了獨特的文化面貌。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rónghé le Mǐnnán, Kèjiā, yuánzhùmín jí wàilái wénhuà, xíngchéng le dútè de wénhuà miànmào.
examples.english: Taiwan has blended Minnan, Hakka, indigenous, and foreign cultures, forming a unique cultural landscape.

examples.chinese: 她的設計風格非常獨特，很快就在業界打出了名氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shèjì fēnggé fēicháng dútè, hěn kuài jiù zài yèjiè dǎchū le míngqì.
examples.english: Her design style is very unique—she quickly made a name for herself in the industry.

semanticNote: To spend (time); to pass (a period of time). 度過 emphasizes the experience of living through a period: 度過假期 (spend the holiday), 度過難關 (get through a difficult time), 度過美好的一天 (have a wonderful day). The time period is the object. Taiwan traditional: 度過.

examples.chinese: 他在歐洲度過了人生中最難忘的三個月。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Ōuzhōu dùguò le rénshēng zhōng zuì nánwàng de sān gè yuè.
examples.english: He spent the most unforgettable three months of his life in Europe.

examples.chinese: 在大家的鼓勵下，她終於度過了那段最艱難的時期。
examples.pinyin: Zài dàjiā de gǔlì xià, tā zhōngyú dùguò le nà duàn zuì jiānnán de shíqī.
examples.english: With everyone's encouragement, she finally got through that most difficult period.

semanticNote: To break; to snap; to sever; to decide; absolutely (in negatives). 斷了 (broken/snapped), 斷電 (power outage), 斷絕關係 (sever a relationship), 斷然拒絕 (flatly refuse). The sense of complete severance — physical or relational — runs through all uses. Taiwan traditional: 斷.

components.meaning: to break; to snap; to decide; absolutely

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，部分山區的電力中斷，需要幾天才能恢復。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, bùfen shānqū de diànlì zhōngduàn, xūyào jǐ tiān cái néng huīfù.
examples.english: After the typhoon, power was cut off in some mountainous areas and it will take several days to restore.

examples.chinese: 她和前男友徹底斷了聯繫，準備重新開始。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé qián nányǒu chèdǐ duàn le liánxì, zhǔnbèi chóngxīn kāishǐ.
examples.english: She completely cut off contact with her ex-boyfriend and is ready to start fresh.

semanticNote: A pile; heap; stack; crowd (noun); to pile up; to heap (verb); measure word for heaps/piles of things or groups of people. 一堆書 (a pile of books), 一堆人 (a crowd of people), 工作堆積如山 (work piled up like a mountain — idiom). Taiwan traditional: 堆.

components.meaning: pile; heap; crowd; to pile up; (mw for heaps)

examples.chinese: 桌上堆了一堆文件，她不知道從哪裡開始整理。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō shàng duī le yī duī wénjiàn, tā bù zhīdào cóng nǎlǐ kāishǐ zhěnglǐ.
examples.english: A pile of documents is stacked on the desk—she doesn't know where to start organizing.

examples.chinese: 假日的夜市裡擠了一大堆人，熱鬧非凡。
examples.pinyin: Jiàrì de yèshì lǐ jǐ le yī dà duī rén, rènào fēifán.
examples.english: On holidays, the night market is packed with a huge crowd—lively beyond compare.

semanticNote: To compare; to contrast; comparison; contrast. 對比 emphasizes differences: 形成對比 (form a contrast), 鮮明對比 (striking contrast), 對比色 (contrasting colors). Distinct from 比較 (to compare — can be looking for similarities or differences). Taiwan traditional: 對比.

examples.chinese: 這幅畫使用了強烈的色彩對比，視覺效果非常震撼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shǐyòng le qiángliè de sècǎi duìbǐ, shìjué xiàoguǒ fēicháng zhènhàn.
examples.english: This painting uses strong color contrasts, creating a visually striking effect.

examples.chinese: 和從前相比，她現在的生活狀況形成了鮮明的對比。
examples.pinyin: Hé cóngqián xiāngbǐ, tā xiànzài de shēnghuó zhuàngkuàng xíngchéng le xiānmíng de duìbǐ.
examples.english: Compared to before, her current living conditions form a striking contrast.

semanticNote: To treat; to deal with; to handle (someone or something). 對待 focuses on how one treats others or handles a situation: 公平對待 (treat fairly), 對待問題 (handle a problem), 以認真的態度對待 (approach with a serious attitude). More interpersonal and attitudinal than 處理 (to process/deal with). Taiwan traditional: 對待.

components.meaning: to treat; to deal with; to receive

examples.chinese: 不管身分高低，他對待每一位客戶都一視同仁。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shēnfèn gāodī, tā duìdài měi yī wèi kèhù dōu yī shì tóng rén.
examples.english: Regardless of social status, he treats every client equally.

examples.chinese: 我們應該以積極的態度對待生活中遇到的困難。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi yǐ jījí de tàidù duìdài shēnghuó zhōng yùdào de kùnnan.
examples.english: We should face the difficulties we encounter in life with a positive attitude.

semanticNote: The other party; the other side; the counterpart. Refers to whoever is on the opposite side of an interaction — in a conversation (對方沒有回應 — the other party didn't respond), negotiation, relationship, or dispute. Very common in formal, legal, and interpersonal contexts. Taiwan traditional: 對方.

examples.chinese: 在談判中，了解對方的立場和需求非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài tánpàn zhōng, liǎojiě duìfāng de lìchǎng hé xūqiú fēicháng zhòngyào.
examples.english: In a negotiation, understanding the other party's position and needs is very important.

examples.chinese: 她傳了訊息給前男友，但對方遲遲沒有回覆。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuán le xùnxī gěi qián nányǒu, dàn duìfāng chíchí méiyǒu huífù.
examples.english: She sent a message to her ex-boyfriend, but he took a long time to reply.

semanticNote: Opponent; adversary; rival; match. 遇到對手了 (met one's match), 強勁對手 (tough opponent), 競爭對手 (business competitor). In sports: 打敗對手 (defeat the opponent). In business, 對手 is often preferred over 敵人 (enemy) as it's less hostile in tone. Taiwan traditional: 對手.

examples.chinese: 這場棋賽中，他遇到了一位真正強勁的對手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng qísài zhōng, tā yùdào le yī wèi zhēnzhèng qiángjìng de duìshǒu.
examples.english: In this chess match, he met a truly formidable opponent.

examples.chinese: 兩家公司是市場上的主要競爭對手，彼此都在爭奪客源。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī shì shìchǎng shàng de zhǔyào jìngzhēng duìshǒu, bǐcǐ dōu zài zhēngduó kèyuán.
examples.english: The two companies are the main competitors in the market, each vying for customers.

semanticNote: Target; object (of an action or study); partner; boyfriend/girlfriend. 研究對象 (research subjects), 服務對象 (target audience), 找對象 (look for a partner/spouse — very common in Taiwan family discourse). The 'romantic partner' sense is widely used in conversation. Taiwan traditional: 對象.

examples.chinese: 這個廣告的目標對象是十八到三十歲的年輕族群。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guǎnggào de mùbiāo duìxiàng shì shíbā dào sānshí suì de niánqīng zúqún.
examples.english: The target audience for this advertisement is the young demographic aged 18 to 30.

examples.chinese: 媽媽一直在催她找個穩定的對象，盡快成家。
examples.pinyin: Māmā yīzhí zài cuī tā zhǎo gè wěndìng de duìxiàng, jǐnkuài chéngjia.
examples.english: Mom has been urging her to find a stable partner and start a family as soon as possible.

semanticNote: To exchange; to convert (currencies or vouchers). 兌換外幣 (exchange foreign currency), 兌換率 (exchange rate), 積分兌換禮品 (redeem points for gifts). Very practical for travel: Taiwan's airports and banks offer currency exchange (外幣兌換). Taiwan traditional: 兌換.

components.meaning: to exchange; to redeem; to convert
to exchange; to change; to swap

examples.chinese: 抵達台灣後，她在機場找了兌換窗口換了日幣。
examples.pinyin: Dǐdá Táiwān hòu, tā zài jīchǎng zhǎo le duìhuàn chuāngkǒu huàn le Rìbì.
examples.english: After arriving in Taiwan, she found a currency exchange booth at the airport to exchange her Japanese yen.

examples.chinese: 信用卡累積的點數可以兌換各種禮品或折扣。
examples.pinyin: Xìnyòngkǎ lèijī de diǎnshù kěyǐ duìhuàn gèzhǒng lǐpǐn huò zhékòu.
examples.english: The points accumulated on the credit card can be redeemed for various gifts or discounts.

semanticNote: Ton — the metric unit of weight (1,000 kg). Used in shipping, industry, and heavy loads: 三噸的貨物 (three tons of cargo), 排水量 (displacement tonnage for ships). 噸 is mostly a technical/formal measurement word; less common in daily speech than 公斤 or 公克. Taiwan traditional: 噸.

examples.chinese: 這艘貨輪的載重量超過十萬噸。
examples.pinyin: Zhè sōu huòlún de zàizhòng liàng chāoguò shí wàn dūn.
examples.english: This cargo ship has a load capacity of over 100,000 tons.

examples.chinese: 台灣每年進口大量的石油，以萬噸計算。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān měi nián jìnkǒu dàliàng de shíyóu, yǐ wàn dūn jìsuàn.
examples.english: Taiwan imports large amounts of petroleum every year, measured in tens of thousands of tons.

semanticNote: To crouch; to squat. 蹲下 (crouch down), 蹲廁所 (use the squat toilet — squat toilets 蹲式馬桶 are still common in Taiwan's public restrooms and older buildings). 蹲點 (stake out a location; do fieldwork at a location over time — journalism/research term). A practical, physical verb.

examples.chinese: 小孩子蹲在地上，仔細觀察著一隻小螞蟻。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi dūn zài dìshàng, zǐxì guānchá zhe yī zhī xiǎo mǎyǐ.
examples.english: The child crouched on the ground, carefully observing a tiny ant.

examples.chinese: 台灣很多公共廁所還有蹲式馬桶，初來乍到的外國人有時不太習慣。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hěn duō gōnggòng cèsuǒ hái yǒu dūnshì mǎtǒng, chū lái zhà dào de wàiguórén yǒushí bú tài xíguàn.
examples.english: Many public restrooms in Taiwan still have squat toilets—foreigners visiting for the first time sometimes find them unfamiliar.

semanticNote: Measure word for meals (一頓飯 — a meal); to pause; to stamp (one's feet); suddenly (頓時 — all at once). 頓 is primarily a measure word for meals in modern Mandarin, but the other senses appear: 頓了一下 (paused a moment), 頓時清醒 (suddenly came to one's senses). 頓悟 (sudden enlightenment) is a Buddhist-derived term. Taiwan traditional: 頓.

components.meaning: meal; to pause; to stamp; suddenly

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天至少在家吃一頓飯，維持家人感情。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zhìshǎo zài jiā chī yī dùn fàn, wéichí jiārén gǎnqíng.
examples.english: Dad has at least one meal at home every day to maintain family bonds.

examples.chinese: 她說話說到一半，頓了一下，才繼續往下說。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà shuō dào yī bàn, dùn le yīxià, cái jìxù wǎng xià shuō.
examples.english: She paused in the middle of speaking before continuing.

semanticNote: Thanks to; luckily. 多虧 introduces the person or circumstance that saved the day: 多虧了你的幫忙 (thanks to your help...). Always implies that without the named factor, things would have gone wrong. More emphatic than 幸虧 (fortunately); both express gratitude for avoidance of disaster. Taiwan traditional: 多虧.

examples.chinese: 多虧了你提醒，我才沒有忘記帶重要文件。
examples.pinyin: Duōkuī le nǐ tíxǐng, wǒ cái méiyǒu wàngjì dài zhòngyào wénjiàn.
examples.english: Thanks to your reminder, I didn't forget to bring the important documents.

examples.chinese: 多虧消防員及時趕到，才阻止了火勢蔓延。
examples.pinyin: Duōkuī xiāofángyuán jíshí gǎndào, cái zǔzhǐ le huǒshì mànyán.
examples.english: Thanks to the firefighters arriving in time, the fire was prevented from spreading.

semanticNote: Measure word for flowers, clouds, and similar rounded/clustered things. 一朵花 (a flower), 幾朵雲 (a few clouds), 一朵浪花 (a wave splash). Also used for ear in classical/literary Chinese (玉朵 — jade ear, literary). The flower/cloud use is the only practical HSK sense.

examples.chinese: 他在情人節送給她一大束玫瑰，足足有九十九朵。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài qíngrén jié sòng gěi tā yī dà shù méiguī, zúzú yǒu jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ.
examples.english: He gave her a large bouquet of roses for Valentine's Day—a full ninety-nine flowers.

examples.chinese: 天空中飄著幾朵白雲，景色非常宜人。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng zhōng piāo zhe jǐ duǒ báiyún, jǐngsè fēicháng yírén.
examples.english: A few white clouds drifted across the sky—the scenery was very pleasant.

semanticNote: To hide oneself; to take cover; to conceal oneself. More deliberate and prolonged than 躲 alone. 躲藏起來 (hide away), 無處躲藏 (nowhere to hide). Common in narrative contexts and in the game 躲貓貓 (hide-and-seek — Taiwan term; mainland: 捉迷藏). Taiwan traditional: 躲藏.

components.meaning: to hide; to avoid; to dodge

examples.chinese: 孩子們躲藏在沙發後面，等待媽媽來找他們。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen duǒcáng zài shāfā hòumiàn, děngdài māmā lái zhǎo tāmen.
examples.english: The children hid behind the sofa, waiting for Mom to come find them.

examples.chinese: 那隻小貓受到驚嚇後，立刻躲藏到床底下不出來了。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī xiǎo māo shòudào jīngxià hòu, lìkè duǒcáng dào chuáng dǐxia bù chūlái le.
examples.english: Startled, the kitten immediately hid under the bed and wouldn't come out.

semanticNote: Vile; horrible; extremely bad; adverse. 惡劣的天氣 (terrible weather), 惡劣的環境 (harsh conditions), 態度惡劣 (vile attitude), 惡劣行為 (reprehensible conduct). Stronger than 差 (bad) or 糟糕 (terrible) — 惡劣 implies something that is morally offensive or physically severe. Taiwan traditional: 惡劣.

examples.chinese: 由於天氣惡劣，這次登山活動被迫取消。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, zhè cì dēngshān huódòng bèipò qǔxiāo.
examples.english: Due to terrible weather, this mountain climbing activity was forced to be canceled.

examples.chinese: 他的態度非常惡劣，讓所有在場的人都感到十分不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidù fēicháng èliè, ràng suǒyǒu zài chǎng de rén dōu gǎndào shífēn bù shūfú.
examples.english: His attitude was extremely vile, making everyone present feel very uncomfortable.

semanticNote: Earring. 耳環 is the standard Taiwan term. 穿耳洞 (get ears pierced), 金耳環 (gold earring), 摘耳環 (take off earrings). Taiwan traditional: 耳環. In Taiwan fashion culture, 耳環 (earrings) are a common accessory discussed in beauty and styling contexts.

examples.chinese: 她戴著一對銀色的耳環，看起來非常優雅。
examples.pinyin: Tā dài zhe yī duì yínsè de ěrhuán, kàn qǐlái fēicháng yōuyǎ.
examples.english: She wore a pair of silver earrings, looking very elegant.

examples.chinese: 她十八歲時去穿了耳洞，第一次戴上了耳環。
examples.pinyin: Tā shíbā suì shí qù chuān le ěrdòng, dì yī cì dài shàng le ěrhuán.
examples.english: At eighteen she got her ears pierced and wore earrings for the first time.

semanticNote: To publish; to issue; to present; to make (a speech or statement). 發表論文 (publish a paper), 發表演說 (give a speech), 發表聲明 (issue a statement). More formal than 說 or 寫; implies public announcement to an audience. Taiwan traditional: 發表.

components.meaning: to publish; to issue; to put out
to express; to show; to present

examples.chinese: 她在學術期刊上發表了關於台灣原住民語言的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéshù qīkān shàng fābiǎo le guānyú Táiwān yuánzhùmín yǔyán de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: She published research findings on Taiwan's indigenous languages in an academic journal.

examples.chinese: 市長在記者會上發表了一份關於都市更新計畫的聲明。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng zài jìzhě huì shàng fābiǎo le yī fèn guānyú dūshì gēngxīn jìhuà de shēngmíng.
examples.english: The mayor issued a statement at the press conference regarding the urban renewal plan.

semanticNote: To worry about something; to be anxious about; to fret. 發愁 is more emotional and visible than 擔心 (worry — more cognitive). 為...發愁 (worry about...). Often describes visible or ongoing anxiety: 她整天愁眉苦臉 (she's been looking worried/gloomy all day). Taiwan traditional: 發愁.

components.meaning: to break out; to fall into a state

examples.chinese: 他為找不到工作而發愁，已經悶悶不樂好幾個星期了。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zhǎo bú dào gōngzuò ér fā chóu, yǐjīng mènmèn bú lè hǎo jǐ gè xīngqī le.
examples.english: He has been anxious about not finding a job and has been in low spirits for weeks.

examples.chinese: 不用發愁，辦法總比困難多，我們一定能解決的。
examples.pinyin: Búyòng fā chóu, bànfǎ zǒng bǐ kùnnan duō, wǒmen yīdìng néng jiějué de.
examples.english: Don't worry—there are always more solutions than problems; we will definitely figure it out.

semanticNote: Developed; advanced; flourishing; to prosper. 發達國家 (developed countries), 交通發達 (well-developed transportation), 經濟發達 (economically advanced). Also used as a verb: 他發達了 (he made it big; he became successful). Taiwan traditional: 發達.

components.meaning: to develop; to flourish; to grow

examples.chinese: 台灣的交通網絡非常發達，從台北到高雄高鐵只需九十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de jiāotōng wǎngluò fēicháng fādá, cóng Táiběi dào Gāoxióng gāotiě zhǐ xū jiǔshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: Taiwan's transportation network is very well-developed—taking the HSR from Taipei to Kaohsiung takes only 90 minutes.

examples.chinese: 他從路邊攤做起，後來生意越做越大，真的發達了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lùbiān tān zuò qǐ, hòulái shēngyi yuè zuò yuè dà, zhēnde fādá le.
examples.english: He started from a roadside stall, and later his business grew bigger and bigger—he truly made it.

semanticNote: To shiver; to tremble; to shudder. Can be from cold (冷得發抖 — shivering from cold), fear (嚇得發抖 — trembling from fright), or illness. 渾身發抖 (shaking all over), 發抖不已 (trembling incessantly). Very expressive verb; common in descriptive and narrative writing. Taiwan traditional: 發抖.

components.meaning: to tremble; to shake; to shudder

examples.chinese: 他站在台上演講時，緊張得手都在發抖。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài tái shàng yǎnjiǎng shí, jǐnzhāng de shǒu dōu zài fādǒu.
examples.english: While giving his speech on stage, he was so nervous his hands were trembling.

examples.chinese: 走進冷凍庫一會兒，她就冷得渾身發抖。
examples.pinyin: Zǒu jìn lěngdòngkù yī huìr, tā jiù lěng de húnshēn fādǒu.
examples.english: A few moments after entering the freezer, she was shivering all over from the cold.

semanticNote: To bring into play; to develop; to give full expression to (a skill, talent, or potential). 充分發揮 (give full play to), 發揮潛力 (realize one's potential), 發揮作用 (play a role; serve a function). One of the most common verbs for talking about performance and ability in Taiwan's education and workplace discourse. Taiwan traditional: 發揮.

components.meaning: to wave; to wield; to exhibit

examples.chinese: 考試時要放鬆心情，才能充分發揮自己的實力。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shí yào fàngsōng xīnqíng, cái néng chōngfèn fāhuī zìjǐ de shílì.
examples.english: You need to stay relaxed during the exam to fully demonstrate your abilities.

examples.chinese: 這份工作讓她有機會發揮自己在設計方面的才能。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò ràng tā yǒu jīhuì fāhuī zìjǐ zài shèjì fāngmiàn de cáinéng.
examples.english: This job gave her the opportunity to showcase her talent in design.

semanticNote: To invent; invention. 發明創造 (invention and creation), 重大發明 (major invention), 發明家 (inventor). 四大發明 (Four Great Inventions of China: paper, printing, gunpowder, compass) is a cultural touchstone known throughout Taiwan. Taiwan traditional: 發明.

components.meaning: clear; bright; to clarify; to bring to light

examples.chinese: 愛迪生是美國最偉大的發明家之一，他發明了電燈泡。
examples.pinyin: Àidíshēng shì Měiguó zuì wěidà de fāmíngjiā zhī yī, tā fāmíng le diàndēngpào.
examples.english: Edison is one of America's greatest inventors—he invented the light bulb.

examples.chinese: 這項新發明可能徹底改變人們的通訊方式。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn fāmíng kěnéng chèdǐ gǎibiàn rénmen de tōngxùn fāngshì.
examples.english: This new invention could completely change the way people communicate.

semanticNote: Receipt; invoice; bill of purchase. In Taiwan, 發票 refers specifically to the government-issued uniform invoice (統一發票), which doubles as a lottery ticket — a beloved and unique Taiwan institution. People often save 發票 specifically to check if they've won the bi-monthly lottery. Practical and culturally significant. Taiwan traditional: 發票.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，消費後記得索取統一發票，因為可以參加發票抽獎。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, xiāofèi hòu jìde suǒqǔ tǒngyī fāpiào, yīnwèi kěyǐ cānjia fāpiào chōujiǎng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, remember to ask for the uniform invoice after making a purchase, because you can enter the invoice lottery.

examples.chinese: 公司報帳需要附上原始發票，才能申請核銷。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bàozhàng xūyào fùshàng yuánshǐ fāpiào, cái néng shēnqǐng héxiāo.
examples.english: For company expense reimbursements, you need to attach the original receipt before you can apply for approval.

semanticNote: To make a speech; to speak (in a formal or public setting); statement. 發言人 (spokesperson), 發言機會 (opportunity to speak), 正式發言 (formal statement). 發言 implies speaking in an official or group context — not casual conversation. Taiwan traditional: 發言.

examples.chinese: 政府發言人在記者會上就此事做出了正式說明。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ fāyánrén zài jìzhě huì shàng jiù cǐ shì zuòchū le zhèngshì shuōmíng.
examples.english: The government spokesperson made an official statement on the matter at the press conference.

examples.chinese: 老師請每位同學都有機會上台發言，分享自己的看法。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī qǐng měi wèi tóngxué dōu yǒu jīhuì shàngtái fāyán, fēnxiǎng zìjǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.english: The teacher asked each student to have a chance to speak at the front and share their views.

semanticNote: A fine; to impose a monetary penalty. 開罰單 (issue a fine/ticket), 繳罰款 (pay a fine). In Taiwan, fines are used for traffic violations, littering, noise complaints, etc. The process: police 開單 → you pay at a 便利商店 (convenience store) or bank within the deadline. 罰款 is very practical Taiwan vocabulary. Taiwan traditional: 罰款.

examples.chinese: 他在禁止停車的地方停車，結果被開了一張罰款單。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jìnzhǐ tíngchē de dìfāng tíngchē, jiéguǒ bèi kāi le yī zhāng fákuǎn dān.
examples.english: He parked in a no-parking zone and ended up being issued a fine.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，騎機車不戴安全帽會被罰款，最高可達一千五百元。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, qí jīchē bú dài ānquánmào huì bèi fákuǎn, zuìgāo kě dá yīqiān wǔbǎi yuán.
examples.english: In Taiwan, riding a scooter without a helmet can result in a fine of up to 1,500 NT dollars.

semanticNote: Court of law; courthouse. 地方法院 (district court), 高等法院 (high court), 最高法院 (Supreme Court). Taiwan's judicial system has a three-tier court structure. 上法院 (take to court), 出庭 (appear in court). 法院 is the formal term; 法庭 refers more specifically to the courtroom. Taiwan traditional: 法院.

examples.chinese: 這起糾紛最終還是鬧上了法院，雙方各自聘請了律師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ jiūfēn zuìzhōng háishì nào shàng le fǎyuàn, shuāngfāng gèzì pìnqǐng le lǜshī.
examples.english: This dispute ultimately ended up in court, with both sides hiring their own lawyers.

examples.chinese: 台灣高等法院的裁決對整個司法體制具有重要的指標意義。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān gāoděng fǎyuàn de cáijué duì zhěng gè sīfǎ tǐzhì jùyǒu zhòngyào de zhǐbiāo yìyì.
examples.english: The Taiwan High Court's ruling has important benchmark significance for the entire judicial system.

semanticNote: To turn over; to flip; to capsize; to translate; to rummage through. 翻譯 (to translate), 翻牆 (climb over a wall; figuratively: circumvent internet censorship), 翻臉 (turn against someone; flip out in anger), 翻找 (rummage through looking for something). A very versatile verb with physical and figurative senses.

components.meaning: to turn over; to capsize; to translate; to rummage

examples.chinese: 她翻遍了整個包包，才找到那把鑰匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā fān biàn le zhěng gè bāobāo, cái zhǎodào nà bǎ yàoshi.
examples.english: She rummaged through her entire bag before finally finding the key.

examples.chinese: 這本小說已被翻譯成三十多種語言，在全球廣為流傳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō yǐ bèi fānyì chéng sānshí duō zhǒng yǔyán, zài quánqiú guǎngwéi liúchuán.
examples.english: This novel has been translated into more than thirty languages and is widely read around the world.

semanticNote: Prosperous; thriving; prosperity; boom. 繁榮的經濟 (thriving economy), 繁榮昌盛 (prosperous and flourishing — a common blessing phrase), 繁榮穩定 (prosperity and stability). Used in government policy language and formal discourse. Positive and often rhetorical in register. Taiwan traditional: 繁榮.

examples.chinese: 台灣在六○至九○年代經歷了「經濟奇蹟」，社會高度繁榮。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zài liùlíng zhì jiǔlíng niándài jīnglì le 'jīngjì qíjī', shèhuì gāodù fánróng.
examples.english: Taiwan experienced an 'economic miracle' from the 1960s to the 1990s, with society highly prosperous.

examples.chinese: 夜市是台灣經濟繁榮的縮影，吸引了無數國內外遊客。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì shì Táiwān jīngjì fánróng de suōyǐng, xīyǐn le wúshù guónèiwài yóukè.
examples.english: Night markets are a microcosm of Taiwan's economic prosperity, attracting countless domestic and international visitors.

semanticNote: On the contrary; instead; but actually (the opposite). 反而 marks an unexpected reversal: the result is contrary to what was expected. 越...反而越... (the more... the more [unexpectedly]...). Key discourse connector for academic and formal writing. The apostrophe in fǎn'ér marks the syllable boundary before the vowel-initial 而.

examples.chinese: 他以為努力解釋會讓事情變好，結果反而讓對方更生氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi nǔlì jiěshì huì ràng shìqíng biàn hǎo, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér ràng duìfāng gèng shēngqì.
examples.english: He thought hard explanations would make things better, but it actually made the other person angrier.

examples.chinese: 這道菜看起來很複雜，做起來反而很簡單。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài kàn qǐlái hěn fùzá, zuò qǐlái fǎn'ér hěn jiǎndān.
examples.english: This dish looks complicated, but it's actually quite simple to make.

semanticNote: Repeatedly; over and over; back and forth. 反覆 describes something done multiple times or in a cycle: 反覆練習 (practice over and over), 病情反覆 (the illness keeps recurring), 反覆無常 (fickle; constantly changing). Taiwan traditional: 反覆.

components.meaning: to cover; to overturn; to repeat

examples.chinese: 她反覆閱讀了這封信好幾遍，確認自己沒有理解錯誤。
examples.pinyin: Tā fǎnfù yuèdú le zhè fēng xìn hǎo jǐ biàn, quèrèn zìjǐ méiyǒu lǐjiě cuòwù.
examples.english: She read the letter over and over several times to confirm she hadn't misunderstood anything.

examples.chinese: 他的病情反覆，時好時壞，令家人十分擔心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bìngqíng fǎnfù, shí hǎo shí huài, lìng jiārén shífēn dānxīn.
examples.english: His condition kept recurring—sometimes better, sometimes worse—worrying his family greatly.

semanticNote: To react; to respond; reaction; response. 化學反應 (chemical reaction), 過敏反應 (allergic reaction), 做出反應 (make a response), 反應遲鈍 (slow reaction). Covers both physical/chemical and interpersonal senses. Distinguish from 反映 (to reflect/report on) — a common exam confusion. Taiwan traditional: 反應.

examples.chinese: 他反應很快，立刻接住了從桌上滑落的手機。
examples.pinyin: Tā fǎnyìng hěn kuài, lìkè jiē zhù le cóng zhuō shàng huá luò de shǒujī.
examples.english: He reacted quickly and immediately caught the phone as it slid off the table.

examples.chinese: 民眾對這項新政策的反應非常激烈，許多人表示強烈反對。
examples.pinyin: Mínzhòng duì zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè de fǎnyìng fēicháng jīliè, xǔduō rén biǎoshì qiángliè fǎnduì.
examples.english: The public reaction to this new policy was very intense, with many people expressing strong opposition.

semanticNote: To reflect; to mirror; to report on; reflection; feedback. 反映問題 (report a problem to authorities), 反映民意 (reflect public opinion), 作品反映社會現實 (the work reflects social reality). Key distinction from 反應: 反映 is about showing or reporting a situation; 反應 is about responding to it. Taiwan traditional: 反映.

components.meaning: to reflect; to project; to show

examples.chinese: 這部紀錄片真實反映了台灣農村的生活現況。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zhēnshí fǎnyìng le Táiwān nóngcūn de shēnghuó xiànkuàng.
examples.english: This documentary genuinely reflects the current state of life in Taiwan's rural areas.

examples.chinese: 居民向政府反映了路燈損壞的問題，希望盡快修復。
examples.pinyin: Jūmín xiàng zhèngfǔ fǎnyìng le lùdēng sǔnhuài de wèntí, xīwàng jǐnkuài xiūfù.
examples.english: Residents reported to the government about the broken streetlights, hoping for a quick repair.

semanticNote: Anyway; in any case; regardless. 反正 introduces a conclusion that holds regardless of the details: 反正已經這樣了，不如接受 (it's already like this anyway, might as well accept it). Often marks resignation or logical conclusion. Very common in casual speech; somewhat informal. Taiwan traditional: 反正.

examples.chinese: 反正你也不聽我的，我就不再多說了。
examples.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng nǐ yě bù tīng wǒ de, wǒ jiù bú zài duō shuō le.
examples.english: Since you never listen to me anyway, I won't say any more.

examples.chinese: 反正明天放假，今晚多玩一會兒也沒關係。
examples.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng míngtiān fàngjià, jīn wǎn duō wán yī huìr yě méi guānxi.
examples.english: It's a holiday tomorrow anyway, so it's fine to stay up and play a bit longer tonight.

semanticNote: Scope; range; limits; extent. 範圍 is a key academic and formal term: 研究範圍 (scope of research), 考試範圍 (exam scope — essential for every Taiwan student!), 職責範圍 (scope of duties), 超出範圍 (exceed the scope). Taiwan traditional: 範圍.

examples.chinese: 請問這次期末考試的考試範圍是哪幾個單元？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè cì qīmò kǎoshì de kǎoshì fànwéi shì nǎ jǐ gè dānyuán?
examples.english: Excuse me, which units does the scope of this final exam cover?

examples.chinese: 這個問題已經超出了我的職責範圍，你需要詢問其他部門。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǐjīng chāochū le wǒ de zhízé fànwéi, nǐ xūyào xúnwèn qítā bùmén.
examples.english: This issue falls outside my scope of duties—you need to ask another department.

semanticNote: Square; direction; side; party; recipe; (mw for square/cubic measures and for written prescriptions). 四方 (four directions), 雙方 (both parties/sides), 對方 (the other party), 方形 (square shape), 一方水土 (a region/locale and its culture). 方 appears in many important compounds but rarely stands alone in conversation.

examples.chinese: 談判中，雙方都表示願意繼續協商，尋求共識。
examples.pinyin: Tánpàn zhōng, shuāngfāng dōu biǎoshì yuànyì jìxù xiéshāng, xúnqiú gòngshí.
examples.english: In the negotiation, both parties expressed willingness to continue discussing and seek consensus.

examples.chinese: 中醫師開了一個方子，裡面有七八種藥材。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyīshī kāi le yī gè fāngzi, lǐmiàn yǒu qī bā zhǒng yàocái.
examples.english: The traditional Chinese medicine doctor wrote a prescription containing seven or eight medicinal herbs.

semanticNote: Plan; program; proposal; scheme (for addressing an issue or project). 制定方案 (develop a plan), 提出方案 (put forward a proposal), 替代方案 (alternative plan). 方案 is more actionable and specific than 計畫 (plan — broader) and more developed than 想法 (idea). The apostrophe in fāng'àn marks the vowel-initial syllable 'àn.

examples.chinese: 團隊提出了三個不同的解決方案，請管理層評估。
examples.pinyin: Tuánduì tíchū le sān gè bùtóng de jiějué fāng'àn, qǐng guǎnlǐcéng pínggū.
examples.english: The team proposed three different solutions and asked management to evaluate them.

examples.chinese: 如果這個方案行不通，我們需要盡快想出替代方案。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège fāng'àn xíng bùtōng, wǒmen xūyào jǐnkuài xiǎng chū tìdài fāng'àn.
examples.english: If this plan doesn't work out, we need to quickly come up with an alternative.

semanticNote: Way; style; manner; mode of doing something. 生活方式 (lifestyle), 溝通方式 (mode of communication), 學習方式 (learning style), 處理方式 (way of handling). Broader than 方法 (method — specific technique); 方式 emphasizes the approach or style more than the specific steps. Very high frequency across all registers.

examples.chinese: 每個人的學習方式不同，找到適合自己的才最重要。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xuéxí fāngshì bùtóng, zhǎodào shìhé zìjǐ de cái zuì zhòngyào.
examples.english: Everyone's learning style is different—what matters most is finding the one that suits you.

examples.chinese: 隨著科技進步，人們的溝通方式發生了很大的改變。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì jìnbù, rénmen de gōutōng fāngshì fāshēng le hěn dà de gǎibiàn.
examples.english: With advances in technology, the way people communicate has changed greatly.

semanticNote: To hinder; to hamper; to obstruct. 妨礙 implies creating obstacles for someone or something. 妨礙交通 (obstruct traffic), 妨礙公務 (obstruct official duties — a legal term in Taiwan), 妨礙他人 (interfere with others). The apostrophe in fáng'ài marks the vowel-initial syllable 'ài. Taiwan traditional: 妨礙.

components.meaning: to hinder; to hamper; to obstruct
to obstruct; to impede; to be in the way

examples.chinese: 在人行道上亂停的摩托車嚴重妨礙了行人的通行。
examples.pinyin: Zài rénxíngdào shàng luàn tíng de mótuōchē yánzhòng fáng'ài le xíngrén de tōngxíng.
examples.english: Scooters parked haphazardly on sidewalks seriously obstruct pedestrian traffic.

examples.chinese: 這件事不妨礙你繼續做自己的事，你不用為我擔心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù fáng'ài nǐ jìxù zuò zìjǐ de shì, nǐ bùyòng wèi wǒ dānxīn.
examples.english: This matter won't get in the way of you continuing to do your own things—don't worry about me.

semanticNote: To seem as though; as if; it's as if. 彷彿 introduces a simile or an impression: 彷彿回到了童年 (as if one had returned to childhood). More literary than 好像 in register; common in descriptive and narrative writing. Both 彷彿 and 仿佛 are used; Taiwan traditional: 彷彿.

components.meaning: to imitate; to resemble; as if

examples.chinese: 站在故宮門前，仿佛能感受到幾百年的歷史在眼前流過。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài Gùgōng ménqián, fǎngfú néng gǎnshòu dào jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ zài yǎnqián liú guò.
examples.english: Standing at the entrance to the Palace Museum, it's as if you can feel centuries of history flowing past before your eyes.

examples.chinese: 他說話的方式和已故的父親仿佛如出一轍。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de fāngshì hé yǐgù de fùqīn fǎngfú rú chū yī zhé.
examples.english: The way he speaks is as if it came from the same mold as his late father's.

semanticNote: Non-; un-; not be; wrongdoing; simply must (in 非...不可). 非正式 (informal), 非常 (extremely — lit. 'not ordinary'), 非法 (illegal), 非得...不可 (absolutely must). In formal writing, 非 is a literary negative. 非...不可 (must/have to; insist on) is a critical construction: 非去不可 (absolutely must go).

components.meaning: non-; not; wrong; must (in 非...不可)

examples.chinese: 這件事非做不可，拖下去只會更麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì fēi zuò bùkě, tuō xià qù zhǐ huì gèng máfan.
examples.english: This matter absolutely must be dealt with—putting it off will only make things more troublesome.

examples.chinese: 非法佔用他人土地是一種違法行為，可以依法提告。
examples.pinyin: Fēifǎ zhànyòng tārén tǔdì shì yī zhǒng wéifǎ xíngwéi, kěyǐ yīfǎ tígào.
examples.english: Illegally occupying another person's land is an unlawful act that can be prosecuted according to the law.

semanticNote: Soap (bar soap). 肥皂 specifically refers to bar soap; 洗手乳 or 洗手液 is liquid soap. 肥皂劇 (soap opera) — the name comes from the soap commercials that originally sponsored them in the US, adopted into Chinese. Taiwan traditional: 肥皂.

examples.chinese: 用肥皂和清水仔細洗手，是預防感染的最基本方法。
examples.pinyin: Yòng féizào hé qīngshuǐ zǐxì xǐshǒu, shì yùfáng gǎnrǎn de zuì jīběn fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Washing your hands carefully with soap and clean water is the most basic way to prevent infection.

examples.chinese: 她喜歡用天然手工肥皂洗臉，說對皮膚比較溫和。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān yòng tiānrán shǒugōng féizào xǐliǎn, shuō duì pífū bǐjiào wēnhé.
examples.english: She likes to wash her face with natural handmade soap, saying it's gentler on the skin.

semanticNote: Nonsense; rubbish; pointless words. 廢話 can be a noun (說廢話 — talk nonsense) or a mild exclamation expressing exasperation: 廢話！(Of course! / No duh! — sarcastic agreement with something obvious). Mildly rude but very common in informal speech. Taiwan traditional: 廢話.

examples.chinese: 「下雨了要帶傘。」「廢話！我早就知道了！」
examples.pinyin: 'Xià yǔ le yào dài sǎn.' 'Fèihuà! Wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le!'
examples.english: 'Bring an umbrella when it rains.' 'No duh! I already knew that!'

examples.chinese: 他說了半天廢話，一個重點也沒說到。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō le bàntiān fèihuà, yī gè zhòngdiǎn yě méi shuō dào.
examples.english: He talked for a long time but said nothing of substance—not a single key point.

semanticNote: Three senses: (1) to distinguish; to differentiate (分辨); (2) separately; respectively (分別說明 — explain separately); (3) to part ways; separation (分別時 — at parting; 久別 — long separation). All three are common and exam-tested. Taiwan traditional: 分別.

components.meaning: to differentiate; to part; other; separately

examples.chinese: 這兩個詞的意思很相近，很多人分不清它們的分別。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè cí de yìsi hěn xiāngjìn, hěn duō rén fēn bù qīng tāmen de fēnbié.
examples.english: These two words are very similar in meaning—many people can't distinguish the difference between them.

examples.chinese: 他們在機場分別後，就各自踏上了不同的人生旅途。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài jīchǎng fēnbié hòu, jiù gèzì tà shàng le bùtóng de rénshēng lǚtú.
examples.english: After parting at the airport, they each set off on their own different life journeys.

semanticNote: To be distributed (over an area); to be scattered; distribution. 分布廣泛 (widely distributed), 人口分布 (population distribution), 分布不均 (unevenly distributed). Very common in geography, ecology, and demographic contexts. Taiwan traditional: 分布.

components.meaning: to spread; to distribute; to deploy

examples.chinese: 台灣的原住民族分布在全島各地，尤其集中在山地和東部。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yuánzhùmínzú fēnbù zài quán dǎo gèdì, yóuqí jízhōng zài shāndì hé dōngbù.
examples.english: Taiwan's indigenous peoples are distributed throughout the island, with concentrations especially in the mountains and the east.

examples.chinese: 這種植物主要分布在熱帶雨林氣候的地區。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù zhǔyào fēnbù zài rèdài yǔlín qìhòu de dìqū.
examples.english: This plant is mainly distributed in areas with tropical rainforest climate.

semanticNote: To distribute; to assign; to allocate; distribution; allocation. 分配資源 (allocate resources), 分配任務 (assign tasks), 分配不公 (unfair distribution). 財富分配 (wealth distribution) is a major topic in Taiwan's political economy discourse. Taiwan traditional: 分配.

components.meaning: to divide; to share; to distribute
to match; to distribute; to allocate

examples.chinese: 老師將學生分成幾個小組，並分配了不同的任務。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiāng xuésheng fēnchéng jǐ gè xiǎozǔ, bìng fēnpèi le bùtóng de rènwù.
examples.english: The teacher divided the students into several groups and assigned different tasks to each.

examples.chinese: 如何公平地分配社會資源，是現代政府最重要的課題之一。
examples.pinyin: Rúhé gōngpíng de fēnpèi shèhuì zīyuán, shì xiàndài zhèngfǔ zuì zhòngyào de kètí zhī yī.
examples.english: How to fairly distribute social resources is one of the most important challenges for modern governments.

semanticNote: To break up (romantically); to part company. 分手 primarily refers to ending a romantic relationship in modern usage. Also: to part ways at the end of an outing (much less common in this sense now). 提出分手 (initiate a breakup), 分手後 (after the breakup). Very common in conversation and pop culture.

examples.chinese: 她和男友交往了三年，最後因為個性不合而分手。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé nányǒu jiāowǎng le sān nián, zuìhòu yīnwèi gèxìng bù hé ér fēnshǒu.
examples.english: She dated her boyfriend for three years but in the end broke up due to incompatible personalities.

examples.chinese: 分手不代表失敗，有時候放開才是對彼此最好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Fēnshǒu bú dàibiǎo shībài, yǒu shíhòu fàng kāi cái shì duì bǐcǐ zuì hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: Breaking up doesn't mean failure—sometimes letting go is the best choice for both people.

semanticNote: To analyze; analysis. 分析問題 (analyze a problem), 資料分析 (data analysis), 深入分析 (in-depth analysis). An essential term in academic writing and business. 分析師 (analyst). In Taiwan's education system, 分析能力 (analytical ability) is a major assessed competency. Taiwan traditional: 分析.

components.meaning: to split; to separate; to analyze

examples.chinese: 在做決定之前，我們需要仔細分析利弊得失。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuò juédìng zhīqián, wǒmen xūyào zǐxì fēnxī lìbì déshī.
examples.english: Before making a decision, we need to carefully analyze the pros and cons.

examples.chinese: 這份市場分析報告為公司的策略方向提供了重要參考。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn shìchǎng fēnxī bàogào wèi gōngsī de cèlüè fāngxiàng tígōng le zhòngyào cānkǎo.
examples.english: This market analysis report provided important reference for the company's strategic direction.

semanticNote: One after another; in succession; in large numbers; in profusion. 紛紛 describes a scenario where many people or things do something simultaneously or in rapid succession: 紛紛表示支持 (one by one expressed support), 紛紛落下 (falling one after another). Adds a sense of collective or cascading action. Taiwan traditional: 紛紛.

examples.chinese: 演唱會結束後，歌迷們紛紛上前想要和歌手合照。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì jiéshù hòu, gēmímen fēnfēn shàng qián xiǎng yào hé gēshǒu hézhào.
examples.english: After the concert ended, fans rushed forward one after another hoping to take photos with the singer.

examples.chinese: 秋天一到，樹葉就紛紛從枝頭落下，鋪滿了地面。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān yī dào, shùyè jiù fēnfēn cóng zhītóu luò xià, pū mǎn le dìmiàn.
examples.english: When autumn arrives, leaves fall from the branches one after another, carpeting the ground.

semanticNote: To strive; to struggle; to fight hard for a goal. 奮鬥 carries a heroic, determined connotation. 為夢想奮鬥 (strive for a dream), 奮鬥的精神 (spirit of perseverance), 繼續奮鬥 (keep striving). Very common in motivational contexts, New Year messages, and graduation speeches in Taiwan. Taiwan traditional: 奮鬥.

components.meaning: to exert oneself; to strive; to fight hard
to fight; to struggle; to contend

examples.chinese: 她從農村來到台北，獨自奮鬥多年，終於在業界闖出一片天。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng nóngcūn lái dào Táiběi, dúzì fèndòu duō nián, zhōngyú zài yèjiè chuǎngchū yī piàn tiān.
examples.english: She came from the countryside to Taipei and fought alone for many years, finally making a name for herself in the industry.

examples.chinese: 只要不放棄，持續奮鬥，夢想終有實現的一天。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào bú fàngqì, chíxù fèndòu, mèngxiǎng zhōng yǒu shíxiàn de yītiān.
examples.english: As long as you don't give up and keep striving, there will be a day when your dream comes true.

semanticNote: Style — the characteristic manner of an artist, writer, designer, or organization. 建築風格 (architectural style), 個人風格 (personal style), 日式風格 (Japanese style). Distinct from 方式 (manner/way) in that 風格 is about an identifiable aesthetic or characteristic approach. Taiwan traditional: 風格.

examples.chinese: 她的插畫風格非常獨特，融合了東方傳統與現代感。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chātú fēnggé fēicháng dútè, rónghé le dōngfāng chuántǒng yǔ xiàndài gǎn.
examples.english: Her illustration style is very unique, blending Eastern tradition with a modern sensibility.

examples.chinese: 九份老街保留了日治時代的建築風格，非常有特色。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔfèn lǎojiē bǎoliú le Rìzhì shídài de jiànzhú fēnggé, fēicháng yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: Jiufen's old street has preserved the architectural style of the Japanese colonial era and is very distinctive.

semanticNote: Scenery; landscape; natural view. 風景區 (scenic area), 欣賞風景 (admire the scenery), 風景如畫 (picturesque scenery — idiomatic). Very common in travel writing and daily conversation. Taiwan has famous 風景區: 阿里山, 日月潭, 太魯閣. Taiwan traditional: 風景.

examples.chinese: 日月潭的風景如詩如畫，每年吸引數百萬遊客前往。
examples.pinyin: Rìyuètán de fēngjǐng rú shī rú huà, měi nián xīyǐn shù bǎi wàn yóukè qiánwǎng.
examples.english: The scenery of Sun Moon Lake is like poetry and painting, attracting millions of visitors every year.

examples.chinese: 搭乘阿里山小火車欣賞沿途的山林風景，是很多旅客的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Dāchéng Ālǐshān xiǎo huǒchē xīnshǎng yántú de shānlín fēngjǐng, shì hěn duō lǚkè de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Taking the Alishan forest railway to enjoy the mountain scenery along the way is a dream for many travelers.

semanticNote: Social custom; folk custom; cultural practice. 風俗習慣 (customs and habits; traditions), 民間風俗 (folk customs), 婚喪風俗 (wedding and funeral customs). In Taiwan, 風俗 often refers to traditional practices surrounding festivals, lifecycle events, and local beliefs. 入境隨俗 (when in Rome... — lit. 'follow local customs when you enter a new place') is a common idiom. Taiwan traditional: 風俗.

examples.chinese: 台灣的喪葬風俗融合了佛道教傳統和民間信仰，非常複雜。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de sāngsàng fēngsú rónghé le Fó Dào jiào chuántǒng hé mínjiān xìnyǎng, fēicháng fùzá.
examples.english: Taiwan's funeral customs blend Buddhist and Taoist traditions with folk beliefs and are quite complex.

examples.chinese: 學中文不只是學語言，還要了解當地的文化和風俗。
examples.pinyin: Xué Zhōngwén bùzhǐshì xué yǔyán, hái yào liǎojiě dāngdì de wénhuà hé fēngsú.
examples.english: Learning Chinese isn't just about learning the language—you also need to understand the local culture and customs.

semanticNote: Risk; venture; hazard. 承擔風險 (take on risk), 降低風險 (reduce risk), 高風險 (high-risk). 風險管理 (risk management) is a major business discipline. In everyday speech: 這樣做有風險 (this approach is risky). Taiwan traditional: 風險.

examples.chinese: 投資股票有一定的風險，要在充分了解後再做決定。
examples.pinyin: Tóuzī gǔpiào yǒu yīdìng de fēngxiǎn, yào zài chōngfèn liǎojiě hòu zài zuò juédìng.
examples.english: Investing in stocks carries a certain level of risk—make sure you fully understand it before deciding.

examples.chinese: 創業需要勇氣，因為過程中必然要承擔各種風險。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngyè xūyào yǒngqì, yīnwèi guòchéng zhōng bìrán yào chéngdān gèzhǒng fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: Entrepreneurship requires courage, because the process inevitably involves taking on various risks.

semanticNote: Crazy; insane; frenzied; extremely popular; wild enthusiasm. 瘋狂 can describe mental illness (精神瘋狂), wild behavior (瘋狂行為), or enthusiastic fandom (他是個瘋狂的球迷 — he's a crazy fan). 瘋狂流行 (going viral; extremely popular). Very expressive and common in modern speech. Taiwan traditional: 瘋狂.

examples.chinese: 那部劇一上線就瘋狂流行，每個人都在討論。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù jù yī shàngxiàn jiù fēngkuáng liúxíng, měi gè rén dōu zài tǎolùn.
examples.english: The moment that drama launched it went viral—everyone was talking about it.

examples.chinese: 他為了追求自己的夢想，做了一個在旁人看來有點瘋狂的決定。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng, zuò le yī gè zài pángrén kàn lái yǒudiǎn fēngkuáng de juédìng.
examples.english: To pursue his dream, he made a decision that seemed a little crazy to those around him.

semanticNote: To satirize; to mock; sarcasm; satire; ironic. 諷刺小說 (satirical novel), 帶有諷刺意味 (carrying a satirical tone), 這真是諷刺！(This is truly ironic!). Used for both deliberate mockery/satire and for ironic situations where reality contradicts expectation. Taiwan traditional: 諷刺.

components.meaning: to satirize; to mock; to allude
to poke; to stab; to satirize

examples.chinese: 這部政治漫畫用誇張的手法諷刺了政府的腐敗行為。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù zhèngzhì mànhuà yòng kuāzhāng de shǒufǎ fěngcì le zhèngfǔ de fǔbài xíngwéi.
examples.english: This political cartoon uses exaggerated techniques to satirize the government's corrupt behavior.

examples.chinese: 他辛苦學了好幾年的技能，沒想到進入職場後根本用不上，真是諷刺。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīnkǔ xué le hǎo jǐ nián de jìnéng, méi xiǎngdào jìnrù zhíchǎng hòu gēnběn yòng bú shàng, zhēn shì fěngcì.
examples.english: He spent years painstakingly learning skills, only to find they were completely useless in the workplace—truly ironic.

semanticNote: To negate; to deny; to reject; negative; negation. 否定答案 (negative answer), 完全否定 (completely negate/reject), 否定自我 (deny/reject oneself). In grammar: 否定句 (negative sentence). Opposite of 肯定. Taiwan traditional: 否定.

components.meaning: to fix; to decide; to determine; definite

examples.chinese: 這份報告的結論否定了之前的研究假設。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de jiélùn fǒudìng le zhīqián de yánjiū jiǎshè.
examples.english: The conclusion of this report negated the previous research hypothesis.

examples.chinese: 不要輕易否定自己，每個人都有自己的獨特價值。
examples.pinyin: Búyào qīngyì fǒudìng zìjǐ, měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de dútè jiàzhí.
examples.english: Don't easily deny your own worth—everyone has their own unique value.

semanticNote: To deny; to declare something to be untrue; to repudiate. More formal and confrontational than 不承認 (not admit). 否認指控 (deny the accusations), 強烈否認 (strongly deny). Common in legal, political, and personal dispute contexts. Taiwan traditional: 否認.

components.meaning: to recognize; to acknowledge; to admit

examples.chinese: 他強烈否認曾經參與這起詐欺案，並要求警方澄清。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiángliè fǒurèn céngjīng cānyù zhè qǐ zhàqī àn, bìng yāoqiú jǐngfāng chénqīng.
examples.english: He strongly denied ever having been involved in this fraud case and demanded that police clarify the situation.

examples.chinese: 對方否認了所有的指控，聲稱自己是無辜的。
examples.pinyin: Duìfāng fǒurèn le suǒyǒu de zhǐkòng, chēngchēng zìjǐ shì wúgū de.
examples.english: The other party denied all the accusations and claimed to be innocent.

semanticNote: To support with one's hand; to steady someone; to help someone up. 扶老人過馬路 (help an elderly person cross the street), 扶著牆走 (steady oneself against the wall). A physically helpful gesture — implies using the hand to support or guide someone. 扶持 (to support and assist) is a related formal compound.

components.meaning: to support with hand; to help up; to steady

examples.chinese: 他看到老奶奶摔倒，立刻過去扶她起來。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn dào lǎonǎinai shuāidǎo, lìkè guòqù fú tā qǐlái.
examples.english: When he saw the old lady fall down, he immediately went over to help her up.

examples.chinese: 下山時路很滑，她緊緊地扶著旁邊的欄杆，一步一步走下去。
examples.pinyin: Xià shān shí lù hěn huá, tā jǐnjǐn de fú zhe pángbiān de lángān, yī bù yī bù zǒu xià qù.
examples.english: The path was slippery going down the mountain, so she held tightly to the railing beside her and took it one step at a time.

semanticNote: Clothing; costume; dress — formal or collective term. 服裝設計師 (fashion designer), 傳統服裝 (traditional clothing), 演出服裝 (performance costume). More formal than 衣服 (clothes — everyday). 服裝業 (fashion/clothing industry) is significant in Taiwan. Taiwan traditional: 服裝.

examples.chinese: 她從小就對服裝設計充滿熱情，大學選擇了時裝設計系。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù duì fúzhuāng shèjì chōngmǎn rèqíng, dàxué xuǎnzé le shízhuāng shèjì xì.
examples.english: She has been passionate about fashion design since childhood and chose fashion design as her university major.

examples.chinese: 劇組花了大量時間和心思在歷史劇的服裝設計上，力求逼真。
examples.pinyin: Jùzǔ huā le dàliàng shíjiān hé xīnsī zài lìshǐ jù de fúzhuāng shèjì shàng, lì qiú bīzhēn.
examples.english: The production team spent a lot of time and effort on the costume design for the historical drama, striving for authenticity.

semanticNote: Measure word for pictures, paintings, maps, and textile (一幅畫 — a painting; 一幅地圖 — a map). As a noun: width of cloth (幅寬 — fabric width). 大幅 as a prefix means significantly/greatly: 大幅提升 (significantly improve), 大幅下降 (drop sharply). Taiwan traditional: 幅.

examples.chinese: 博物館展出了一幅珍貴的清代山水畫，吸引大批民眾參觀。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū le yī fú zhēnguì de Qīngdài shānshuǐ huà, xīyǐn dà pī mínzhòng cānguān.
examples.english: The museum exhibited a precious Qing dynasty landscape painting, attracting large numbers of visitors.

examples.chinese: 這次新產品上市後，公司的銷售額大幅成長了三成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn shàngshì hòu, gōngsī de xiāoshòu'é dàfú chéngzhǎng le sān chéng.
examples.english: After the new product launched, the company's sales grew significantly by thirty percent.

semanticNote: To coach; to tutor; to give guidance (in study or skill). 課業輔導 (academic tutoring), 輔導老師 (counselor; guidance teacher), 輔導班 (cram school; tutoring class). In Taiwan, 補習班 and 輔導班 are both tutoring contexts; 輔導 also covers counseling: 心理輔導 (psychological counseling). Taiwan traditional: 輔導.

components.meaning: to assist; to supplement; to coach
to guide; to lead; to direct

examples.chinese: 她每週去輔導班學數學，成績進步了很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu qù fǔdǎo bān xué shùxué, chéngjì jìnbù le hěn duō.
examples.english: She goes to math tutoring every week and has improved a lot in her grades.

examples.chinese: 學校的輔導老師負責協助學生解決學習和心理上的困難。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de fǔdǎo lǎoshī fùzé xiézhù xuésheng jiějué xuéxí hé xīnlǐ shàng de kùnnán.
examples.english: The school counselor is responsible for helping students overcome academic and psychological difficulties.

semanticNote: Woman; women (formal/collective). 婦女 is the formal or institutional term for women, used in official documents, organizations, and policy. 婦女節 (International Women's Day — March 8), 婦女權益 (women's rights), 婦女會館 (women's community center). In everyday speech, 女性 (female) or 女生 (girl/woman) is more common. Taiwan traditional: 婦女.

examples.chinese: 三月八日是國際婦女節，台灣各地都會舉辦相關活動。
examples.pinyin: Sān yuè bā rì shì Guójì Fùnǚ Jié, Táiwān gèdì dōu huì jǔbàn xiāngguān huódòng.
examples.english: March 8 is International Women's Day, and related events are held throughout Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 政府制定了多項政策，以保障婦女在職場上的平等權利。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhìdìng le duō xiàng zhèngcè, yǐ bǎozhàng fùnǚ zài zhíchǎng shàng de píngděng quánlì.
examples.english: The government has formulated multiple policies to protect women's equal rights in the workplace.

semanticNote: To duplicate; to copy; to reproduce; to replicate. 複製文件 (copy a file), 複製貼上 (copy and paste — Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V), 複製模式 (replicate a model), 複製人 (clone). In digital contexts, 複製 is the standard term. 複製貼上 and 複製粘貼 are both used in Taiwan. Taiwan traditional: 複製.

components.meaning: to make; to manufacture; to produce

examples.chinese: 請把這份文件複製一份備用。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn fùzhì yī fèn bèiyòng.
examples.english: Please make a copy of this document to keep on hand.

examples.chinese: 這種商業模式很難複製，因為成功背後有很多隱性因素。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shāngyè móshì hěn nán fùzhì, yīnwèi chénggōng bèihòu yǒu hěn duō yǐnxìng yīnsù.
examples.english: This business model is hard to replicate because there are many hidden factors behind its success.

semanticNote: To reform; reform. 改革 implies systematic change to an institution, system, or policy. 教育改革 (education reform — a hot topic in Taiwan), 司法改革 (judicial reform), 改革開放 (Reform and Opening Up — the mainland's economic policy). Used for significant structural change, not minor improvements. Taiwan traditional: 改革.

components.meaning: to change; to correct; to reform
to reform; to change; leather; to expel

examples.chinese: 台灣歷經多次教育改革，課程內容和考試制度都有很大的變化。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān lì jīng duō cì jiàoyù gǎigé, kèchéng nèiróng hé kǎoshì zhìdù dōu yǒu hěn dà de biànhuà.
examples.english: Taiwan has undergone multiple education reforms, resulting in significant changes to curriculum content and examination systems.

examples.chinese: 面對日益嚴重的少子化問題，政府必須大力推動社會福利改革。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì rìyì yánzhòng de shǎozǐhuà wèntí, zhèngfǔ bìxū dàlì tuīdòng shèhuì fúlì gǎigé.
examples.english: Faced with the increasingly serious declining birth rate, the government must vigorously push forward social welfare reform.

semanticNote: To improve; to make better; improvement. 改進方法 (improve the method), 提出改進建議 (make suggestions for improvement), 有待改進 (still needs improvement). More specific and actionable than 改善 (improve — can be broader, less concrete) and 改革 (reform — systemic change). Taiwan traditional: 改進.

components.meaning: to change; to correct; to improve
to advance; to progress; to improve

examples.chinese: 老師指出了報告的幾個問題，希望他回去改進後再提交。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐchū le bàogào de jǐ gè wèntí, xīwàng tā huíqù gǎijìn hòu zài tíjiāo.
examples.english: The teacher pointed out several issues in the report and hoped he would go back and improve it before resubmitting.

examples.chinese: 公司根據客戶的意見對產品進行了多項改進。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī gēnjù kèhù de yìjiàn duì chǎnpǐn jìnxíng le duō xiàng gǎijìn.
examples.english: Based on customer feedback, the company made several improvements to the product.

semanticNote: To improve; to make better; improvement — often for conditions, relationships, or quality of life. 改善環境 (improve the environment), 改善關係 (improve relations), 生活得到改善 (life improved). Slightly broader and less process-focused than 改進 (improve a specific method/product). Taiwan traditional: 改善.

components.meaning: to change; to correct; to improve

examples.chinese: 政府投入大量資源改善偏鄉的交通和醫療條件。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tóurù dàliàng zīyuán gǎishàn piānxiāng de jiāotōng hé yīliáo tiáojiàn.
examples.english: The government has invested substantial resources to improve transportation and healthcare conditions in remote rural areas.

examples.chinese: 兩國關係在近年來有所改善，貿易往來也更加頻繁。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó guānxi zài jìnnián lái yǒusuǒ gǎishàn, màoyì wǎnglái yě gèngjiā pínfán.
examples.english: Relations between the two countries have improved in recent years, with trade exchanges also becoming more frequent.

semanticNote: To correct; to amend; to put right. 改正錯誤 (correct a mistake), 改正不良習慣 (correct bad habits). More specific than 改善 (improve) — 改正 targets specific errors or wrongs to fix them. Common in educational and self-improvement contexts. Taiwan traditional: 改正.

examples.chinese: 老師在作文上畫了紅線，標出需要改正的地方。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài zuòwén shàng huà le hóng xiàn, biāo chū xūyào gǎizhèng de dìfāng.
examples.english: The teacher drew red lines on the essay to mark the places that needed to be corrected.

examples.chinese: 知道自己的錯誤後，要勇於改正，不要一犯再犯。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào zìjǐ de cuòwù hòu, yào yǒngyú gǎizhèng, búyào yī fàn zài fàn.
examples.english: Once you know your mistakes, have the courage to correct them—don't keep making the same ones.

semanticNote: Lid; top; cover (noun); to cover; to build; to stamp (with a seal). 蓋飯 (rice with toppings — extremely popular in Taiwan), 蓋章 (affix a seal/stamp — essential for Taiwan's administrative culture), 蓋房子 (build a house), 蓋子 (lid/cap). The seal-stamping sense is especially practical: everything from bank forms to official documents requires a 蓋章. Taiwan traditional: 蓋.

components.meaning: lid; cover; to cover; to build; to stamp

examples.chinese: 辦理這份表格需要親自到場蓋章，無法代理。
examples.pinyin: Bànlǐ zhè fèn biǎogé xūyào qīnzì dào chǎng gài zhāng, wúfǎ dàilǐ.
examples.english: Processing this form requires a personal appearance to affix a seal—it cannot be done by proxy.

examples.chinese: 她用鍋蓋把湯鍋蓋上，讓湯繼續燜一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng guō gài bǎ tāng guō gài shàng, ràng tāng jìxù mèn yī duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: She covered the soup pot with the lid and let the soup continue to simmer for a while.

semanticNote: To summarize; to generalize; to encompass; general; broadly. 概括地說 (to put it generally; broadly speaking), 一言以蔽之，可以概括為... (summing it all up in one sentence...). Very common in academic and formal writing. 概括性 (generalizability). Taiwan traditional: 概括.

components.meaning: to include; to enclose; to embrace

examples.chinese: 這篇文章的主旨可以概括為：科技進步帶來機遇，也帶來挑戰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de zhǔzhǐ kěyǐ gàikuò wéi: kējì jìnbù dài lái jīyù, yě dài lái tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: The main theme of this article can be summarized as: technological progress brings opportunities as well as challenges.

examples.chinese: 概括地說，這次會議有兩個主要結論。
examples.pinyin: Gàikuò de shuō, zhè cì huìyì yǒu liǎng gè zhǔyào jiélùn.
examples.english: Broadly speaking, there were two main conclusions from this meeting.

semanticNote: Concept; idea; notion. 基本概念 (basic concept), 抽象概念 (abstract concept), 建立概念 (build an understanding of), 沒有概念 (have no idea; no sense of — colloquial). 概念 is the standard academic term for a mental construct or theoretical idea. Very common in education, philosophy, and everyday intellectual discourse.

components.meaning: thought; idea; to think; to read aloud

examples.chinese: 在學統計學之前，你應該先掌握機率的基本概念。
examples.pinyin: Zài xué tǒngjìxué zhīqián, nǐ yīnggāi xiān zhǎngwò jīlǜ de jīběn gàiniàn.
examples.english: Before studying statistics, you should first master the basic concept of probability.

examples.chinese: 他對時間沒什麼概念，約好幾點就遲到幾點，讓朋友很頭疼。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì shíjiān méi shénme gàiniàn, yuē hǎo jǐ diǎn jiù chídào jǐ diǎn, ràng péngyǒu hěn tóuténg.
examples.english: He has no sense of time—whenever they arrange to meet at a certain time, he's always late by that amount, much to his friends' frustration.

semanticNote: Straightforward; clear-cut; blunt; simply; just (do it). As an adjective: 他說話很乾脆 (he speaks in a direct, no-nonsense way). As an adverb: 乾脆就別去了 (just don't go then; might as well not go). The adverbial sense expresses decisiveness, often with a sense of cutting through complexity. Taiwan traditional: 乾脆.

examples.chinese: 與其猶豫不決，不如乾脆做個決定算了。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqí yóuyù bùjué, bùrú gāncuì zuò gè juédìng suàn le.
examples.english: Rather than being indecisive, you might as well just make a decision and be done with it.

examples.chinese: 他說話很乾脆，不喜歡拐彎抹角，大家都很欣賞他這一點。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn gāncuì, bù xǐhuān guǎiwān mòjiǎo, dàjiā dōu hěn xīnshǎng tā zhè yīdiǎn.
examples.english: He speaks in a very direct manner and doesn't like to beat around the bush—everyone appreciates this about him.

semanticNote: Dry; dryness; to dry out. 氣候乾燥 (dry climate), 皮膚乾燥 (dry skin), 乾燥的空氣 (dry air). Opposite of 潮濕 (damp/humid). In Taiwan, the northeast monsoon season (冬季東北季風) brings dry conditions to the north; the west coast is drier in winter. 乾燥機 (dryer; dehumidifier). Taiwan traditional: 乾燥.

examples.chinese: 台灣北部冬天的天氣比較乾燥，容易讓皮膚感到不適。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān běibù dōngtiān de tiānqì bǐjiào gānzào, róngyì ràng pífū gǎndào bú shì.
examples.english: The weather in northern Taiwan is relatively dry in winter, which can easily cause skin discomfort.

examples.chinese: 食物必須保存在乾燥的環境中，才不容易腐壞。
examples.pinyin: Shíwù bìxū bǎocún zài gānzào de huánjìng zhōng, cái bù róngyì fǔhuài.
examples.english: Food must be stored in a dry environment to prevent it from spoiling easily.

semanticNote: At once; hurriedly; lose no time. 趕緊 expresses urgency: do it right now without delay. 趕緊去做 (hurry up and do it), 趕緊就醫 (seek medical attention immediately). More urgent than 趕快 (hurry up) and implies the action is time-sensitive. Taiwan traditional: 趕緊.

components.meaning: to hurry; to rush; to catch up

examples.chinese: 他看到孩子摔倒，趕緊跑過去查看傷勢。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn dào háizi shuāidǎo, gǎnjǐn pǎo guòqù chákàn shāngshì.
examples.english: When he saw the child fall, he immediately ran over to check on the injuries.

examples.chinese: 眼看颱風快來了，大家趕緊把戶外的物品收進屋內。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnkàn táifēng kuài lái le, dàjiā gǎnjǐn bǎ hùwài de wùpǐn shōu jìn wū nèi.
examples.english: With the typhoon almost upon them, everyone quickly brought outdoor items inside the house.

semanticNote: At once; immediately; right away; quickly. 趕快 is a general urgency marker: 趕快走 (hurry up and leave), 趕快去 (go right away). Slightly less acute in tone than 趕緊 (which implies danger or critical timing). Very commonly used in commands and requests. Taiwan traditional: 趕快.

examples.chinese: 電影快開始了，我們趕快進去找位子吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng kuài kāishǐ le, wǒmen gǎnkuài jìnqù zhǎo wèizi ba.
examples.english: The movie is about to start—let's hurry in and find seats.

examples.chinese: 你趕快去道歉吧，拖越久越難開口。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gǎnkuài qù dàoqiàn ba, tuō yuè jiǔ yuè nán kāikǒu.
examples.english: Go and apologize quickly—the longer you wait, the harder it'll be to bring it up.

semanticNote: To feel grateful; to appreciate deeply; gratitude. 感激 is stronger and more heartfelt than 謝謝. 深深感激 (deeply grateful), 感激不盡 (eternally grateful; can't thank you enough). Used in formal thank-you letters, speeches, and whenever one wants to express sincere gratitude for a significant favor.

components.meaning: to arouse; to stir; intense feeling

examples.chinese: 她非常感激鄰居在她生病時幫忙照顧孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā fēicháng gǎnjī línjū zài tā shēngbìng shí bāngmáng zhàogù háizi.
examples.english: She is deeply grateful to her neighbor for helping to look after her children when she was sick.

examples.chinese: 感激您的幫助，讓我在台灣的生活順利許多。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnjī nín de bāngzhù, ràng wǒ zài Táiwān de shēnghuó shùnlì xǔduō.
examples.english: I am truly grateful for your help, which has made my life in Taiwan much smoother.

semanticNote: To feel; to experience; feeling; impression; sensation. 感受 is more subjective and embodied than 感覺 (feeling — can be more physical). 深刻的感受 (a deep/profound impression), 旅途的感受 (impressions from a journey), 分享感受 (share one's feelings). Very common in reflection writing and personal sharing in Taiwan.

components.meaning: to receive; to experience; to be affected

examples.chinese: 來台灣旅遊後，她深刻感受到這裡人們的熱情與友善。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān lǚyóu hòu, tā shēnkè gǎnshòu dào zhèlǐ rénmen de rèqíng yǔ yǒushàn.
examples.english: After visiting Taiwan, she profoundly experienced the warmth and friendliness of the people here.

examples.chinese: 請分享你對這部電影最深刻的感受。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng fēnxiǎng nǐ duì zhè bù diànyǐng zuì shēnkè de gǎnshòu.
examples.english: Please share your most profound impression of this film.

semanticNote: Impressions; reflections; thoughts (after an experience). 感想 refers to the thoughts and feelings one has after experiencing something — reading a book, attending an event, or going through an experience. 讀後感想 (impressions after reading), 發表感想 (share one's thoughts). A key genre in Taiwan's school writing: 參觀後的感想.

examples.chinese: 看完這部紀錄片後，老師要求每位同學寫下自己的感想。
examples.pinyin: Kàn wán zhè bù jìlùpiàn hòu, lǎoshī yāoqiú měi wèi tóngxué xiě xià zìjǐ de gǎnxiǎng.
examples.english: After watching this documentary, the teacher asked each student to write down their reflections.

examples.chinese: 你有什麼感想嗎？這次的台灣之行讓你印象最深的是什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng ma? Zhè cì de Táiwān zhī xíng ràng nǐ yìnxiàng zuì shēn de shì shénme?
examples.english: What are your impressions? What left the deepest impression on you during this trip to Taiwan?

semanticNote: To do manual labor; to work (physical tasks). 幹活兒 is colloquial and often refers to physical or practical work, not white-collar work. More common in northern/mainland Chinese speech; Taiwan also uses it, particularly for household chores or manual jobs. 幹活兒去 (get to work). The 兒 is a rhotacized suffix.

components.meaning: to do; to work; to engage in

examples.chinese: 週末他總是幫父親在院子裡幹活兒，修修這修修那的。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò tā zǒngshì bāng fùqīn zài yuànzi lǐ gàn huór, xiū xiū zhè xiū xiū nà de.
examples.english: On weekends he always helps his father do odd jobs in the yard—fixing this and fixing that.

examples.chinese: 工地上的工人們一大早就開始幹活兒了，很辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Gōngdì shàng de gōngrénmen yī dà zǎo jiù kāishǐ gàn huór le, hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.english: The workers at the construction site start working early in the morning—it's hard work.

semanticNote: Steel (钢) and iron (铁); steel. 鋼鐵 as a compound specifically means steel (more broadly: iron and steel industry). 鋼鐵業 (steel industry), 中鋼 (China Steel Corporation — Taiwan's major steelmaker, headquartered in Kaohsiung). Also used figuratively: 鋼鐵意志 (iron will; unwavering determination). Taiwan traditional: 鋼鐵.

examples.chinese: 中鋼是台灣最重要的鋼鐵企業，對製造業的發展貢獻很大。
examples.pinyin: Zhōnggāng shì Táiwān zuì zhòngyào de gāngtiě qǐyè, duì zhìzàoyè de fāzhǎn gòngxiàn hěn dà.
examples.english: China Steel is Taiwan's most important steel company and has contributed greatly to the development of the manufacturing industry.

examples.chinese: 她有著鋼鐵般的意志，面對任何困難都不輕易放棄。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒuzhe gāngtiě bān de yìzhì, miànduì rènhé kùnnan dōu bù qīngyì fàngqì.
examples.english: She has a will of steel—she never gives up easily when facing any difficulty.

semanticNote: Top quality; first rate; high class; upscale; high-end. 高檔餐廳 (upscale restaurant), 高檔品牌 (premium brand), 高檔住宅 (luxury residence). Often used in marketing and lifestyle contexts. 高檔 implies quality and prestige through price point. Opposite of 低檔 (low-end) and 平價 (affordable). Taiwan traditional: 高檔.

examples.chinese: 信義區有許多高檔的百貨公司和精品店，吸引許多消費者。
examples.pinyin: Xìnyì qū yǒu xǔduō gāodàng de bǎihuò gōngsī hé jīngpǐn diàn, xīyǐn xǔduō xiāofèizhě.
examples.english: The Xinyi District has many upscale department stores and luxury boutiques, attracting many consumers.

examples.chinese: 他送給她一個高檔的皮包作為生日禮物。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng gěi tā yī gè gāodàng de píbāo zuòwéi shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: He gave her a high-end leather bag as a birthday gift.

semanticNote: High-level; senior; advanced; high-grade. 高級官員 (senior official), 高級住宅 (luxury apartment), 高級餐廳 (fine-dining restaurant), 高中 (senior high school — short for 高級中學). The term is both hierarchical (rank: 高級職員 = senior staff) and qualitative (高級食材 = premium ingredients). Taiwan traditional: 高級.

examples.chinese: 他在公司擔任高級主管，負責監督整個亞太區的業務。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī dānrèn gāojí zhǔguǎn, fùzé jiāndū zhěng gè Yà-Tài qū de yèwù.
examples.english: He serves as a senior executive at the company, overseeing business across the entire Asia-Pacific region.

examples.chinese: 這家高級日本料理餐廳每人消費至少三千元台幣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gāojí Rìběn liàolǐ cāntīng měi rén xiāofèi zhìshǎo sānqiān yuán Táibì.
examples.english: At this high-end Japanese restaurant, each person spends at least 3,000 New Taiwan dollars.

semanticNote: To do; to make; to be engaged in — a colloquial, versatile verb. 搞清楚 (figure out; get clear on), 搞定 (handle it; get it done; sorted), 搞笑 (be funny; act silly), 搞砸了 (mess up; botch it). 搞 is informal and expressive; used widely in Taiwan's everyday speech. Avoid in formal writing.

components.meaning: to do; to make; to handle (colloquial)

examples.chinese: 你能不能幫我把這件事搞定？我實在沒有時間處理。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bùnéng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì gǎo dìng? Wǒ shízài méiyǒu shíjiān chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Can you help me get this thing sorted out? I really don't have time to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 我到現在還沒搞清楚這個問題的原因是什麼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào xiànzài hái méi gǎo qīngchǔ zhège wèntí de yuányīn shì shénme.
examples.english: I still haven't figured out what the cause of this problem is.

semanticNote: To say goodbye to; to bid farewell; to leave. 告別演出 (farewell performance), 告別式 (funeral ceremony; farewell service — used in Taiwan for 喪禮). More formal and emotive than 再見; implies a significant or final parting. 向...告別 (bid farewell to...). Taiwan traditional: 告別.

components.meaning: to tell; to inform; to say goodbye
to part; to leave; to separate

examples.chinese: 他在離開台灣前，一一向所有好朋友告別。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài líkāi Táiwān qián, yī yī xiàng suǒyǒu hǎo péngyǒu gàobié.
examples.english: Before leaving Taiwan, he said goodbye to all his close friends one by one.

examples.chinese: 畢業典禮是大家告別校園生活的重要時刻。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ shì dàjiā gàobié xiàoyuán shēnghuó de zhòngyào shíkè.
examples.english: The graduation ceremony is an important moment for everyone to bid farewell to campus life.

semanticNote: Especially; extraordinarily; particularly; additionally. 格外 emphasizes that something goes beyond the ordinary degree: 格外小心 (be especially careful), 格外興奮 (particularly excited). Slightly more formal and literary than 特別 (especially) but used in the same contexts. Cannot be used for negative extremes as naturally as 特別.

examples.chinese: 第一次到台灣的她，對一切都感到格外新鮮好奇。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì dào Táiwān de tā, duì yīqiē dōu gǎndào géwài xīnxiān hàoqí.
examples.english: Visiting Taiwan for the first time, she found everything especially fresh and fascinating.

examples.chinese: 今年的冬天格外寒冷，氣象局提醒民眾注意保暖。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de dōngtiān géwài hánlěng, qìxiàngjú tíxǐng mínzhòng zhùyì bǎonuǎn.
examples.english: This year's winter is exceptionally cold—the meteorological bureau reminded residents to keep warm.

semanticNote: Next door; the room or house adjacent. 隔壁鄰居 (next-door neighbor), 隔壁班 (the class next to yours), 隔壁房間 (the room next door). Very common in everyday conversation. In Taiwan's dense urban housing, knowing your 隔壁鄰居 is both practical and culturally significant — community relations.

components.meaning: separated; apart; on the other side

examples.chinese: 隔壁的阿姨很熱情，常常帶食物來跟我們分享。
examples.pinyin: Gébì de āyí hěn rèqíng, chángcháng dài shíwù lái gēn wǒmen fēnxiǎng.
examples.english: The auntie next door is very warm—she often brings food to share with us.

examples.chinese: 昨晚隔壁一直在唱歌，吵到我很晚才睡著。
examples.pinyin: Zuó wǎn gébì yīzhí zài chànggē, chǎo dào wǒ hěn wǎn cái shuìzháo.
examples.english: The people next door were singing all night yesterday and kept me up until very late.

semanticNote: Individual; specific; isolated; a very small number of; on a case-by-case basis. 個別差異 (individual differences), 個別情況 (individual/specific cases), 個別輔導 (one-on-one coaching). In formal contexts, 個別 qualifies that something applies only to specific cases, not all. Taiwan traditional: 個別.

examples.chinese: 大部分學生都能準時交作業，個別同學有遲交的情況。
examples.pinyin: Dàbùfen xuésheng dōu néng zhǔnshí jiāo zuòyè, gèbié tóngxué yǒu chí jiāo de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Most students turn in their homework on time, but a small number of students have been late with submissions.

examples.chinese: 如果有需要，老師也可以安排個別輔導時間。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu xūyào, lǎoshī yě kěyǐ ānpái gèbié fǔdǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: If needed, the teacher can also arrange individual tutoring sessions.

semanticNote: Individual; personal; oneself. 個人隱私 (personal privacy), 個人意見 (personal opinion), 個人電腦 (personal computer — PC). Very common in formal and everyday contexts. 個人 is both a noun (個人利益 — individual interests) and an adjective (個人的選擇 — personal choice). Taiwan traditional: 個人.

examples.chinese: 這只是我個人的看法，不代表整個團隊的意見。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì wǒ gèrén de kànfǎ, bú dàibiǎo zhěng gè tuánduì de yìjiàn.
examples.english: This is just my personal view and doesn't represent the opinion of the whole team.

examples.chinese: 台灣法律保護個人隱私權，未經同意不得任意蒐集個人資料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān fǎlǜ bǎohù gèrén yǐnsī quán, wèi jīng tóngyì bùdé rènyì sōují gèrén zīliào.
examples.english: Taiwan law protects individual privacy rights—personal data cannot be collected without consent.

semanticNote: Individuality; personality; character. 個性強 (strong personality), 個性開朗 (cheerful personality), 有個性 (has a distinctive character; has personality — positive). Taiwan traditional: 個性. In Taiwan culture, 個性 is often discussed in terms of interpersonal compatibility: 個性合不合得來 (whether personalities are compatible).

examples.chinese: 她個性開朗，到哪裡都能很快和別人打成一片。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng kāilǎng, dào nǎlǐ dōu néng hěn kuài hé biérén dǎchéng yī piàn.
examples.english: She has an outgoing personality—wherever she goes, she quickly fits in with others.

examples.chinese: 這兩個人個性差太多，很難長期相處在一起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè rén gèxìng chā tài duō, hěn nán chángqī xiāngchǔ zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: These two people's personalities are too different—it would be very hard for them to get along long-term.

semanticNote: Each; respective; on one's own. 各自獨立 (each independently), 各自回家 (each go home), 各自表述 (each state their own views — a politically significant phrase in cross-strait relations). Emphasizes the separateness or individuality of multiple parties doing their own thing.

examples.chinese: 飯後，大家各自散去，約定下次再聚。
examples.pinyin: Fàn hòu, dàjiā gèzì sàn qù, yuēdìng xià cì zài jù.
examples.english: After dinner, everyone went their separate ways, making plans to get together again next time.

examples.chinese: 兩岸對這個歷史問題各自有不同的詮釋。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng àn duì zhège lìshǐ wèntí gèzì yǒu bùtóng de quánshì.
examples.english: Both sides of the strait have their own respective interpretations of this historical issue.

semanticNote: Root; base; (mw for long, slender objects). 樹根 (tree root), 根源 (root cause; origin), 一根筷子 (one chopstick), 一根頭髮 (a strand of hair). The root metaphor is central: 根深蒂固 (deeply rooted; ingrained — idiom). Very productive in compounds: 根本 (fundamental), 根據 (based on; according to).

components.meaning: root; base; origin; (mw for long slender objects)

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，這棵大樹被連根拔起，橫倒在馬路上。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, zhè kē dà shù bèi lián gēn bá qǐ, héng dǎo zài mǎlù shàng.
examples.english: After the typhoon, this large tree was uprooted completely and lay fallen across the road.

examples.chinese: 她用兩根筷子夾起了一塊滑溜溜的豆腐，技術很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng liǎng gēn kuàizi jiā qǐ le yī kuài huáliu liū de dòufu, jìshù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: She picked up a slippery piece of tofu with two chopsticks—quite skillful.

semanticNote: Root; essence; fundamental; basic; (not) at all; simply. As a noun: 問題的根本 (the root of the problem). As an adjective: 根本問題 (fundamental issue). As an adverb (often negative): 根本不可能 (simply impossible), 根本沒有 (there simply isn't any). The negative adverbial use is very common in everyday speech.
