examples.chinese: 這個方法根本不管用，我們需要從根本上解決問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ gēnběn bù guǎnyòng, wǒmen xūyào cóng gēnběn shàng jiějué wèntí.
examples.english: This method simply doesn't work—we need to address the problem at its root.

examples.chinese: 根本原因是制度上的缺陷，光靠努力是不夠的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnběn yuányīn shì zhìdù shàng de quēxiàn, guāng kào nǔlì shì bùgòu de.
examples.english: The fundamental cause is a systemic flaw—relying on hard work alone is not enough.

semanticNote: Factory; plant; mill. 工廠 is any production facility. 代工廠 (contract manufacturing plant — crucial to Taiwan's export economy), 電子工廠 (electronics factory). Taiwan's manufacturing base, particularly in the electronics sector, defines much of its economic identity. Taiwan traditional: 工廠.

examples.chinese: 台灣有許多代工廠為全球知名品牌生產電子產品。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu xǔduō dàigōng chǎng wèi quánqiú zhīmíng pínpái shēngchǎn diànzǐ chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Taiwan has many contract manufacturing plants that produce electronic products for globally known brands.

examples.chinese: 工廠附近的居民反映噪音和廢氣污染問題嚴重。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng fùjìn de jūmín fǎnyìng zàoyīn hé fèiqì wūrǎn wèntí yánzhòng.
examples.english: Residents near the factory have reported serious problems with noise and exhaust pollution.

semanticNote: Engineer. 工程師 covers all engineering disciplines: 電機工程師 (electrical engineer), 軟體工程師 (software engineer — extremely high status career in Taiwan), 土木工程師 (civil engineer). Taiwan's tech industry (半導體, IC設計) makes 工程師 one of the most aspirational careers. Taiwan traditional: 工程師.

examples.chinese: 他是一位在台積電工作的半導體工程師，年薪相當高。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi zài Táijīdiàn gōngzuò de bàndǎotǐ gōngchéngshī, niánxīn xiāngdāng gāo.
examples.english: He is a semiconductor engineer working at TSMC, with a quite high annual salary.

examples.chinese: 許多台灣的工程師畢業後選擇到科技公司就業，薪資待遇優渥。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō Táiwān de gōngchéngshī bìyè hòu xuǎnzé dào kējì gōngsī jiùyè, xīnzī dàiyù yōuwò.
examples.english: Many Taiwanese engineers choose to work at tech companies after graduation, where the compensation packages are very generous.

semanticNote: Tool; instrument; utensil. 工具 covers both physical tools (工具箱 — toolbox) and abstract instruments (語言是溝通的工具 — language is a tool of communication). 工具書 (reference book — lit. 'tool book') is a specific compound. Very versatile across domains. Taiwan traditional: 工具.

components.meaning: tool; implement; to have; to possess

examples.chinese: 這本辭典是學習中文不可或缺的工具書。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn shì xuéxí Zhōngwén bùkě huòquē de gōngjù shū.
examples.english: This dictionary is an indispensable reference tool for learning Chinese.

examples.chinese: 工具箱裡有各種螺絲起子和扳手，修東西很方便。
examples.pinyin: Gōngjù xiāng lǐ yǒu gèzhǒng luósī qǐzi hé bānshǒu, xiū dōngxi hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: The toolbox contains various screwdrivers and wrenches, making it very convenient to fix things.

semanticNote: Worker; laborer. 工人 specifically refers to manual or industrial workers, as opposed to 員工 (employee — more general) or 白領 (white-collar). 工人階級 (working class), 外籍工人 (foreign worker — significant in Taiwan: tens of thousands of migrant workers from Southeast Asia). Taiwan traditional: 工人.

examples.chinese: 建築工地上的工人冒著酷暑工作，非常辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Jiànzhú gōngdì shàng de gōngrén màozhe kùshǔ gōngzuò, fēicháng xīnkǔ.
examples.english: Workers at construction sites labor under intense heat—it is very hard work.

examples.chinese: 台灣引進了許多外籍工人，支撐了製造業和農業的人力需求。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǐnjìn le xǔduō wàijí gōngrén, zhīchēng le zhìzàoyè hé nóngyè de rénlì xūqiú.
examples.english: Taiwan has brought in many foreign workers to support the labor demands of the manufacturing and agricultural sectors.

semanticNote: Industry; the industrial sector. 工業區 (industrial zone — Taiwan has many: 南科, 竹科, 中科), 重工業 (heavy industry), 輕工業 (light industry), 工業設計 (industrial design — prominent field in Taiwan). Taiwan traditional: 工業.

examples.chinese: 台灣的半導體工業在全球具有舉足輕重的地位。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de bàndǎotǐ gōngyè zài quánqiú jùyǒu jǔzú qīngzhòng de dìwèi.
examples.english: Taiwan's semiconductor industry holds a pivotal position globally.

examples.chinese: 工業革命徹底改變了人類社會的生產方式和生活型態。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyè gémìng chèdǐ gǎibiàn le rénlèi shèhuì de shēngchǎn fāngshì hé shēnghuó xíngtài.
examples.english: The Industrial Revolution completely transformed humanity's modes of production and ways of life.

semanticNote: To make public; to announce; to publicize (officially). 公佈 is the Taiwan traditional spelling. 公佈消息 (announce news), 公佈名單 (publish a list), 公佈成績 (release grades/results). More formal than 宣布 — 公佈 implies making information available to the general public through official channels. Taiwan traditional: 公佈.

components.meaning: to spread; to announce; to distribute

examples.chinese: 學校在官網上公佈了這次錄取學生的名單。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zài guānwǎng shàng gōngbù le zhè cì lùqǔ xuésheng de míngdān.
examples.english: The school published the list of admitted students on its official website.

examples.chinese: 衛生部門公佈了最新的流感疫情數據，提醒民眾注意預防。
examples.pinyin: Wèishēng bùmén gōngbù le zuìxīn de liúgǎn yìqíng shùjù, tíxǐng mínzhòng zhùyì yùfáng.
examples.english: The health department released the latest flu epidemic data and reminded the public to take preventive measures.

semanticNote: Public; open; to make public; to disclose. 公開資訊 (public information), 公開場合 (public setting), 公開聲明 (public statement), 公開化 (to become public/open). In Taiwan's increasingly transparent governance culture, 政府資訊公開 (government information disclosure) is a key concept. Taiwan traditional: 公開.

components.meaning: to open; to disclose; to make accessible

examples.chinese: 她決定在社群媒體上公開自己患病的消息，鼓勵有同樣困境的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng zài shèqún méitǐ shàng gōngkāi zìjǐ huànbìng de xiāoxi, gǔlì yǒu tóngyàng kùnjìng de rén.
examples.english: She decided to publicly disclose her illness on social media to encourage others facing the same situation.

examples.chinese: 政府資訊應該透明公開，讓民眾有知的權利。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zīxùn yīnggāi tòumíng gōngkāi, ràng mínzhòng yǒu zhī de quánlì.
examples.english: Government information should be transparent and public, giving citizens the right to know.

semanticNote: Fair; impartial; just; fairness. 公平競爭 (fair competition), 公平正義 (fairness and justice — a core value in Taiwan's civic discourse), 不公平 (unfair). 公平 is a foundational concept in Taiwan's legal, educational, and social systems. 公平交易委員會 (Fair Trade Commission) is a major regulatory body. Taiwan traditional: 公平.

examples.chinese: 這個制度對弱勢族群不公平，需要進行改革。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhìdù duì ruòshì zúqún bù gōngpíng, xūyào jìnxíng gǎigé.
examples.english: This system is unfair to disadvantaged groups and needs to be reformed.

examples.chinese: 體育競賽必須在公平的條件下進行，才能展現真正的實力。
examples.pinyin: Tǐyù jìngsài bìxū zài gōngpíng de tiáojiàn xià jìnxíng, cái néng zhǎnxiàn zhēnzhèng de shílì.
examples.english: Athletic competitions must be conducted under fair conditions in order to showcase true abilities.

semanticNote: Apartment building; apartment. 公寓 in Taiwan typically refers to older walk-up apartment buildings (without elevators), as opposed to 大樓 (high-rise with elevator). 頂樓加蓋公寓 (rooftop addition apartment — a common informal housing type in Taiwan). Renting a 公寓 is the norm for many young people and students in Taiwan's cities.

examples.chinese: 她在台北市中心租了一間兩房的公寓，月租三萬元。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Táiběi shì zhōngxīn zū le yī jiān liǎng fáng de gōngyù, yuè zū sān wàn yuán.
examples.english: She rented a two-bedroom apartment in central Taipei for 30,000 NT dollars per month.

examples.chinese: 這棟老公寓已有四十年歷史，雖然老舊，但價格相對親民。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo gōngyù yǐ yǒu sìshí nián lìshǐ, suīrán lǎojiù, dàn jiàgé xiāngduì qīnmín.
examples.english: This old apartment building is forty years old—although worn, its price is relatively affordable.

semanticNote: AD (Anno Domini); CE (Common Era). Used in dates: 公元前 (BC; BCE), 公元後 (AD; CE). Taiwan officially uses the Republic of China calendar (民國年), but 公元 is used alongside it in formal and international contexts. 公元2025年 = 民國114年. Both systems are in daily use in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣同時使用公元和民國紀年兩種曆法。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān tóngshí shǐyòng gōngyuán hé Mínguó jìnián liǎng zhǒng lìfǎ.
examples.english: Taiwan uses both the Common Era and the Republic of China calendar systems simultaneously.

examples.chinese: 根據史書記載，這座廟建於公元八百年左右。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǐshū jìzǎi, zhè zuò miào jiànyú gōngyuán bābǎi nián zuǒyòu.
examples.english: According to historical records, this temple was built around the year 800 CE.

semanticNote: Princess. 公主 is both the literal title (皇家公主 — royal princess) and a colloquial description: 被當公主一樣呵護 (pampered like a princess), 公主病 (princess syndrome — acting overly entitled). In Taiwan's internet culture, 公主病 is a mild criticism of someone who expects to be treated special. Taiwan traditional: 公主.

examples.chinese: 爸爸從小把女兒當公主一樣疼愛，什麼要求都盡量滿足。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cóng xiǎo bǎ nǚ'ér dāng gōngzhǔ yīyàng téng'ài, shénme yāoqiú dōu jǐnliàng mǎnzú.
examples.english: Dad has always doted on his daughter like a princess since she was little, doing his best to fulfill her every request.

examples.chinese: 這個童話故事講述了一位公主和勇敢騎士之間的愛情故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tónghuà gùshi jiǎngshù le yī wèi gōngzhǔ hé yǒnggǎn qíshì zhī jiān de àiqíng gùshi.
examples.english: This fairy tale tells the love story between a princess and a brave knight.

semanticNote: Function; feature; capability. 功能 refers to what something does or is able to do. 手機功能 (phone features), 大腦功能 (brain function), 多功能 (multi-functional), 功能性食品 (functional food). Very common in product descriptions, tech, and medicine. Taiwan traditional: 功能.

examples.chinese: 這款新手機有許多實用的功能，例如人臉辨識和夜間模式。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīn shǒujī yǒu xǔduō shíyòng de gōngnéng, lìrú rénliǎn biànshí hé yèjiān móshì.
examples.english: This new smartphone has many practical features, such as facial recognition and night mode.

examples.chinese: 大腦的記憶功能非常複雜，至今科學家還有許多未解之謎。
examples.pinyin: Dànǎo de jìyì gōngnéng fēicháng fùzá, zhìjīn kēxuéjiā hái yǒu xǔduō wèi jiě zhī mí.
examples.english: The brain's memory function is extremely complex—scientists still have many unsolved mysteries about it.

semanticNote: To congratulate. 恭喜 is formal and heartfelt. 恭喜恭喜 (congratulations! — repeated for emphasis, especially during Chinese New Year). 恭喜發財 (congratulations and may you prosper — classic New Year greeting). Also: 恭喜你考上了！(Congratulations on passing the exam!). Taiwan traditional: 恭喜.

examples.chinese: 恭喜你考上了台灣大學！這是你努力的成果。
examples.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐ kǎo shàng le Táiwān Dàxué! Zhè shì nǐ nǔlì de chéngguǒ.
examples.english: Congratulations on getting into National Taiwan University! This is the result of your hard work.

examples.chinese: 農曆新年期間，大家見面都互道「恭喜發財，新年快樂」。
examples.pinyin: Nónglì xīnnián qījiān, dàjiā jiàn miàn dōu hù dào 'Gōngxǐ fācái, xīnnián kuàilè'.
examples.english: During the Lunar New Year, everyone greets each other with 'Congratulations and may you prosper—Happy New Year!'

semanticNote: To contribute; to dedicate; contribution. 做出貢獻 (make a contribution), 貢獻良多 (contribute a great deal), 對社會的貢獻 (contribution to society). More formal and significant than 幫助 (help); implies giving something meaningful. 無私的貢獻 (selfless contribution). Taiwan traditional: 貢獻.

components.meaning: to offer; to dedicate; to contribute
to offer; to dedicate; to present

examples.chinese: 她將一生都奉獻給了教育事業，對社會貢獻良多。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāng yīshēng dōu fèngxiàn gěi le jiàoyù shìyè, duì shèhuì gòngxiàn liánduō.
examples.english: She dedicated her entire life to education and made an enormous contribution to society.

examples.chinese: 台灣的科技業對全球半導體供應鏈做出了不可或缺的貢獻。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de kējì yè duì quánqiú bàndǎotǐ gōngyìng liàn zuòchū le bùkě huòquē de gòngxiàn.
examples.english: Taiwan's tech industry has made an indispensable contribution to the global semiconductor supply chain.

semanticNote: To communicate; communication; to link/connect. 有效溝通 (effective communication), 溝通技巧 (communication skills), 缺乏溝通 (lack of communication). In Taiwan's workplace and relationship culture, 溝通 is considered foundational — 多溝通 (communicate more) is standard advice. Taiwan traditional: 溝通.

components.meaning: ditch; channel; to link; to connect
to connect; to flow through; to communicate

examples.chinese: 良好的溝通是維繫家庭關係最重要的基礎之一。
examples.pinyin: Liánghǎo de gōutōng shì wéixì jiātíng guānxi zuì zhòngyào de jīchǔ zhī yī.
examples.english: Good communication is one of the most important foundations for maintaining family relationships.

examples.chinese: 兩國之間的文化差異讓彼此的溝通增加了一定的難度。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó zhī jiān de wénhuà chāyì ràng bǐcǐ de gōutōng zēngjiā le yīdìng de nándù.
examples.english: The cultural differences between the two countries have added a degree of difficulty to communication between them.

semanticNote: To constitute; to compose; to make up; to amount to. 構成 is formal: 構成威脅 (constitute a threat), 由...構成 (be composed of...), 構成犯罪 (constitute a crime). In grammar: 詞語的構成 (word formation). Taiwan traditional: 構成.

components.meaning: to compose; to form; to make up
to become; to form; to constitute

examples.chinese: 台灣的多元族群共同構成了這個社會豐富的文化底蘊。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de duōyuán zúqún gòngtóng gòuchéng le zhège shèhuì fēngfù de wénhuà dǐyùn.
examples.english: Taiwan's diverse ethnic groups together constitute the rich cultural foundation of this society.

examples.chinese: 散布謠言並造成公眾恐慌，可能構成妨害社會秩序的罪行。
examples.pinyin: Sànbù yáoyán bìng zàochéng gōngzhòng kǒnghuāng, kěnéng gòuchéng fáng'ài shèhuì zhìxù de zuìxíng.
examples.english: Spreading rumors and causing public panic may constitute the crime of disturbing public order.

semanticNote: Paternal aunt; father's sister (unmarried or married). 姑姑 specifically means the father's sister — distinct from 阿姨 (mother's sister). In Taiwan's kinship terminology, the distinction between paternal and maternal relatives is important. 姑丈 = father's sister's husband. Taiwan traditional: 姑姑.

components.meaning: father's sister; aunt; nun; girl (for a short time)

examples.chinese: 我的姑姑住在台中，每年過年我們都會去她家拜年。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gūgu zhù zài Táizhōng, měi nián guòniándian wǒmen dōu huì qù tā jiā bàinián.
examples.english: My aunt (father's sister) lives in Taichung—every year during the New Year we go to her place to pay our respects.

examples.chinese: 姑姑買了一大堆玩具送給我，讓我高興壞了。
examples.pinyin: Gūgu mǎi le yī dà duī wánjù sòng gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ gāoxìng huài le.
examples.english: My aunt bought a whole pile of toys to give me—I was overjoyed.

semanticNote: Young woman; girl; unmarried woman. 姑娘 is slightly more colloquial and affectionate than 女生 or 女孩. 好姑娘 (a good girl/woman), 大姑娘 (a grown young woman). In Taiwan and across Chinese-speaking communities, 姑娘 can also be a term of address for a young woman one doesn't know well. Taiwan traditional: 姑娘.

examples.chinese: 那位姑娘熱心地幫老奶奶提了購物袋，讓旁觀者都讚不絕口。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi gūniang rèxīn de bāng lǎonǎinai tí le gòuwù dài, ràng pángguānzhě dōu zàn bù jué kǒu.
examples.english: That young woman kindly helped the old lady carry her shopping bags—onlookers couldn't stop praising her.

examples.chinese: 她是個懂事的好姑娘，從小就很獨立，從不讓父母操心。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè dǒngshì de hǎo gūniang, cóng xiǎo jiù hěn dúlì, cóng bù ràng fùmǔ cāo xīn.
examples.english: She is a sensible and good-hearted young woman—she has been independent since childhood and never worries her parents.

semanticNote: Ancient times; ancient; of antiquity. 古代歷史 (ancient history), 古代文明 (ancient civilization), 在古代 (in ancient times). Generally refers to the pre-modern era — in Chinese historical context often the pre-Qin period or the dynastic period broadly. Opposite of 現代 (modern times). Taiwan traditional: 古代.

examples.chinese: 在古代，台灣曾經是南島語族的故鄉，各族群在這片土地上生生不息。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, Táiwān céngjīng shì Nán Dǎo yǔzú de gùxiāng, gè zúqún zài zhè piàn tǔdì shàng shēngshēng bùxī.
examples.english: In ancient times, Taiwan was the homeland of the Austronesian peoples, with various groups thriving on this land.

examples.chinese: 故宮博物院收藏了許多珍貴的古代文物，吸引全球遊客參觀。
examples.pinyin: Gùgōng Bówùyuàn shōucáng le xǔduō zhēnguì de gǔdài wénwù, xīyǐn quánqiú yóukè cānguān.
examples.english: The Palace Museum houses many precious ancient artifacts, attracting visitors from around the world.

semanticNote: Classical; pertaining to classical antiquity or traditional high culture. 古典音樂 (classical music), 古典文學 (classical literature), 古典舞蹈 (classical dance), 古典風格 (classical style). In Taiwan, 古典 encompasses both Western classical music and Chinese classical tradition (古典詩詞 — classical poetry). Taiwan traditional: 古典.

examples.chinese: 她從小學習古典鋼琴，後來考入音樂學院深造。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xuéxí gǔdiǎn gāngqín, hòulái kǎo rù yīnyuè xuéyuàn shēnzào.
examples.english: She studied classical piano from a young age and later was admitted to a music academy for advanced study.

examples.chinese: 台北國家音樂廳每年舉辦許多古典音樂會，是愛樂者的聖地。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Guójiā Yīnyuètīng měi nián jǔbàn xǔduō gǔdiǎn yīnyuèhuì, shì àiyuè zhě de shèngdì.
examples.english: The National Concert Hall in Taipei holds many classical music concerts every year—it is a mecca for music lovers.

semanticNote: Shares; stock (market). 股票市場 (stock market), 買股票 (buy stocks), 股價 (stock price), 上市公司 (listed company). Investing in stocks (股票) is extremely popular in Taiwan — the Taiwan Stock Exchange (台灣證券交易所, TWSE) is one of Asia's major markets. 存股 (dividend stock investing) is a very common Taiwan financial strategy. Taiwan traditional: 股票.

examples.chinese: 他利用工作之餘研究股票投資，希望提早達到財務自由。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng gōngzuò zhī yú yánjiū gǔpiào tóuzī, xīwàng tígāo dádào cáiwù zìyóu.
examples.english: He researches stock investing in his spare time from work, hoping to achieve financial freedom earlier.

examples.chinese: 台積電的股票是台灣股市中最受投資人關注的標的之一。
examples.pinyin: Táijīdiàn de gǔpiào shì Táiwān gǔshì zhōng zuì shòu tóuzī rén guānzhù de biāodì zhī yī.
examples.english: TSMC's shares are one of the most watched stocks in Taiwan's stock market.

semanticNote: Bone; moral character (figurative). 骨頭 covers the literal anatomical sense (雞骨頭 — chicken bone; 骨頭斷了 — the bone is broken) and figurative: 有骨氣/硬骨頭 (have backbone; be principled). 懶骨頭 (lazybones). In Taiwan, 骨頭 is also used colloquially: 沒骨頭 (spineless; weak-willed). Taiwan traditional: 骨頭.

examples.chinese: 他跌倒後手腕骨頭受傷，需要打石膏靜養幾週。
examples.pinyin: Tā diēdǎo hòu shǒuwàn gǔtou shòushāng, xūyào dǎ shígāo jìngyǎng jǐ zhōu.
examples.english: After his fall, he injured the bones in his wrist and needs to be in a cast and rest for a few weeks.

examples.chinese: 她是個有骨氣的人，從來不向不公平的事情低頭。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè yǒu gǔqì de rén, cóng lái bù xiàng bù gōngpíng de shìqíng dītóu.
examples.english: She is a person with backbone—she never bows to unfairness.

semanticNote: To inspire; to hearten; to encourage; inspiration; encouragement. 鼓舞人心 (inspire people; heartening), 大受鼓舞 (greatly inspired/encouraged). 鼓舞 emphasizes emotional inspiration and uplift, stronger than 鼓勵 (encourage — can be more general). Used for rousing speeches, significant achievements, or role models. Taiwan traditional: 鼓舞.

components.meaning: to dance; to flourish; to inspire

examples.chinese: 她在奧運上獲得金牌的消息鼓舞了全台灣的人民。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Àoyùn shàng huòdé jīnpái de xiāoxi gǔwǔ le quán Táiwān de rénmín.
examples.english: The news of her winning a gold medal at the Olympics inspired the people of all Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 老師的一番話讓他深受鼓舞，決定繼續努力追求夢想。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yī fān huà ràng tā shēn shòu gǔwǔ, juédìng jìxù nǔlì zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: The teacher's words deeply inspired him and he decided to continue working hard to pursue his dream.

semanticNote: To applaud; to clap. 鼓掌 is always positive — clapping to show approval or celebration. 熱烈鼓掌 (applaud enthusiastically), 全場鼓掌 (the whole audience applauded). Common in speeches and performance contexts in Taiwan. 請大家鼓掌歡迎 (please welcome with applause) is a standard host phrase.

examples.chinese: 演講結束後，全場觀眾起立鼓掌，表達對講者的敬意。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, quánchǎng guānzhòng qǐlì gǔzhǎng, biǎodá duì jiǎngzhě de jìngyì.
examples.english: After the speech ended, the entire audience stood and applauded to express their respect for the speaker.

examples.chinese: 主持人說：「請大家熱烈鼓掌，歡迎今天的特別嘉賓！」
examples.pinyin: Zhǔchírén shuō: 'Qǐng dàjiā rèliè gǔzhǎng, huānyíng jīntiān de tèbié jiābīn!'
examples.english: The host said: 'Please give a warm round of applause to welcome today's special guest!'

semanticNote: Fixed; regular; stable; to fix; to fasten. 固定時間 (fixed/regular time), 固定收入 (fixed income), 固定工作 (steady job), 固定下來 (settle; stabilize). As a verb: 把架子固定在牆上 (fix the shelf to the wall). The sense of something set in place — literally or habitually — runs through all uses. Taiwan traditional: 固定.

components.meaning: to settle; to fix; determined; stable

examples.chinese: 他每天固定在早上七點起床，生活非常規律。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān gùdìng zài zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, shēnghuó fēicháng guīlǜ.
examples.english: He gets up at a fixed time of 7 AM every day—his life is very regular.

examples.chinese: 這份工作雖然薪水不高，但至少有固定的收入，比較穩定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò suīrán xīnshuǐ bù gāo, dàn zhìshǎo yǒu gùdìng de shōurù, bǐjiào wěndìng.
examples.english: Although this job doesn't pay well, at least it provides a fixed income—it's more stable.

semanticNote: To register (at a hospital or clinic); to check in; to send by registered mail. 掛號 is the key term for Taiwan's medical registration process. 網路掛號 (online appointment registration), 掛號費 (registration fee — typically low in Taiwan's National Health Insurance system). Taiwan traditional: 掛號.

components.meaning: to hang; to register; to enroll
number; name; to register; to mark

examples.chinese: 她肚子不舒服，先在網路上掛號，再去醫院看診。
examples.pinyin: Tā dùzi bù shūfú, xiān zài wǎnglù shàng guà hào, zài qù yīyuàn kànzhěn.
examples.english: She had a stomachache and first registered online before going to the hospital for an appointment.

examples.chinese: 這家大醫院的皮膚科非常熱門，掛號要提前好幾天預約。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā dà yīyuàn de pífūkē fēicháng rèmén, guà hào yào tíqián hǎo jǐ tiān yùyuē.
examples.english: The dermatology department at this major hospital is very popular—you need to register several days in advance.

semanticNote: Obedient; well-behaved; clever (of a child). 乖 is primarily used for children and pets: 乖孩子 (good child), 乖乖的 (being good; behaving). As a term of endearment, parents say 乖 to a child. It can also mean clever/docile in some contexts. 不乖 = naughty. Taiwan traditional: 乖.

examples.chinese: 媽媽說：「乖，先把飯吃完，再去玩。」
examples.pinyin: Māmā shuō: 'Guāi, xiān bǎ fàn chī wán, zài qù wán.'
examples.english: Mom said: 'Be good—finish your meal first, then you can go play.'

examples.chinese: 這隻狗非常乖，不會亂叫也不會亂跑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī gǒu fēicháng guāi, bú huì luàn jiào yě bú huì luàn pǎo.
examples.english: This dog is very well-behaved—it doesn't bark randomly or run around carelessly.

semanticNote: To turn a corner; to turn; to make a turn. 拐彎 is both literal (在路口拐彎 — turn at the intersection) and figurative (拐彎抹角 — beat around the bush; not speak directly). The literal sense is used for giving directions. Taiwan traditional: 拐彎.

components.meaning: to turn; to bend; to swindle

examples.chinese: 在下一個路口往左拐彎，走一百公尺就是郵局了。
examples.pinyin: Zài xià yī gè lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi wān, zǒu yī bǎi gōngchǐ jiùshì yóujú le.
examples.english: Turn left at the next intersection and walk 100 meters—that's where the post office is.

examples.chinese: 有什麼話直說就好，別拐彎抹角的，我聽得懂。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shénme huà zhí shuō jiù hǎo, bié guǎi wān mòjiǎo de, wǒ tīng de dǒng.
examples.english: Just say what you want to say—don't beat around the bush; I can understand you.

semanticNote: No wonder; so that's why. 怪不得 expresses understanding of a reason that was previously unclear: 怪不得她那麼累，原來昨晚沒睡 (no wonder she's so tired—she didn't sleep last night). Used to connect a newly discovered cause to a previously observed effect. Very common in casual conversation.

examples.chinese: 怪不得你說話沒力氣，原來你今天早上還沒吃飯。
examples.pinyin: Guài bu de nǐ shuōhuà méi lìqi, yuánlái nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang hái méi chīfàn.
examples.english: No wonder you sound so weak—so you haven't eaten breakfast today.

examples.chinese: 怪不得這道菜這麼好吃，原來是用台灣在地食材做的。
examples.pinyin: Guài bu de zhè dào cài zhème hǎochī, yuánlái shì yòng Táiwān zàidì shícái zuò de.
examples.english: No wonder this dish is so delicious—so it's made with local Taiwanese ingredients.

semanticNote: To close; to shut (a door, business, account, program). 關閉 is more formal and final than 關 alone. 關閉帳戶 (close an account), 關閉工廠 (shut down a factory), 關閉視窗 (close a window — on a computer). Also used for news: 店家關閉 (the shop has closed down). Taiwan traditional: 關閉.

components.meaning: to close; to lock; to shut
to close; to shut; to seal

examples.chinese: 請記得在離開辦公室前關閉所有的電腦視窗並關機。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jìde zài líkāi bàngōngshì qián guānbì suǒyǒu de diànnǎo shìchuāng bìng guānjī.
examples.english: Please remember to close all computer windows and shut down before leaving the office.

examples.chinese: 那家開了三十年的書店因房租太高而被迫關閉，讓許多書迷感到惋惜。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāi le sānshí nián de shūdiàn yīn fángjū tài gāo ér bèipò guānbì, ràng xǔduō shūmí gǎndào wǎnxī.
examples.english: That bookstore, which had been open for thirty years, was forced to close due to high rent—many book lovers felt sad to see it go.

semanticNote: To observe; to watch carefully; to survey; observation. 觀察 implies careful, systematic watching — for science, behavior analysis, or learning. 仔細觀察 (observe carefully), 長期觀察 (long-term observation), 觀察力 (powers of observation; perceptiveness). Taiwan traditional: 觀察.

components.meaning: to observe; to look; view; perspective
to inspect; to examine; to observe

examples.chinese: 科學家在野外觀察了候鳥的遷徙路線，記錄了大量寶貴的資料。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài yěwài guānchá le hòuniǎo de qiānxǐ lùxiàn, jìlù le dàliàng bǎoguì de zīliào.
examples.english: Scientists observed the migration routes of migratory birds in the wild and recorded a large amount of valuable data.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子觀察力很強，常常能發現別人忽略的細節。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi guānchá lì hěn qiáng, chángcháng néng fāxiàn biérén hūlüè de xìjié.
examples.english: This child has very strong powers of observation—she often notices details that others overlook.

semanticNote: Point of view; standpoint; viewpoint. 觀點 refers to a considered perspective on an issue. 提出觀點 (put forward a viewpoint), 交換觀點 (exchange viewpoints), 不同觀點 (different viewpoints). More intellectual than 看法 (opinion — more casual). Taiwan traditional: 觀點.

examples.chinese: 這個問題從不同角度來看，可以得出截然不同的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí cóng bùtóng jiǎodù lái kàn, kěyǐ dé chū jiérán bùtóng de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: Looking at this issue from different angles can lead to completely different viewpoints.

examples.chinese: 他的觀點雖然少數，但邏輯嚴謹，值得大家認真思考。
examples.pinyin: Tā de guāndiǎn suīrán shǎoshù, dàn luójí yánjǐn, zhídé dàjiā rènzhēn sīkǎo.
examples.english: Although his viewpoint is a minority one, it is logically rigorous and worth everyone's serious consideration.

semanticNote: Notion; thought; concept; idea (deeply held). 觀念 refers to ingrained beliefs or ways of thinking, often social or cultural: 傳統觀念 (traditional notion/mindset), 時間觀念 (sense of time; punctuality), 更新觀念 (update one's thinking). More about mindset than analytical framework (cf. 概念 — concept). Taiwan traditional: 觀念.

examples.chinese: 台灣年輕世代的觀念越來越開放，和上一代有很大的不同。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān niánqīng shìdài de guānniàn yuè lái yuè kāifàng, hé shàng yī dài yǒu hěn dà de bùtóng.
examples.english: The younger generation in Taiwan is becoming increasingly open-minded, very different from the older generation.

examples.chinese: 他的時間觀念很差，每次約好的時間都遲到，讓大家很頭疼。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shíjiān guānniàn hěn chà, měi cì yuēhǎo de shíjiān dōu chídào, ràng dàjiā hěn tóuténg.
examples.english: His sense of time is terrible—he's late every time they agree to meet, which frustrates everyone.

semanticNote: An official; officer; governmental; organ (of the body). 官員 (official; bureaucrat), 官方 (official; formal), 器官 (bodily organ). In Taiwan politics, 官 often carries a slight sense of bureaucratic authority or corruption in colloquial use: 當官 (to become an official), 官場 (the officialdom; political world). Taiwan traditional: 官.

examples.chinese: 這位官員因涉嫌貪汙遭到調查，引發社會高度關注。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi guānyuán yīn shèxián tānwū zāodào diàochá, yǐnfā shèhuì gāodù guānzhù.
examples.english: This official was investigated on suspicion of corruption, drawing significant public attention.

examples.chinese: 官方數據顯示，台灣的失業率已降至近年來的最低點。
examples.pinyin: Guānfāng shùjù xiǎnshì, Táiwān de shīyèlǜ yǐ jiàng zhì jìnnián lái de zuì dī diǎn.
examples.english: Official data shows that Taiwan's unemployment rate has fallen to its lowest point in recent years.

semanticNote: Tube; pipe; drinking straw. 管子 covers hollow cylindrical objects: 水管 (water pipe), 吸管 (straw for drinks), 輸油管 (oil pipeline). Taiwan banned single-use plastic straws (塑膠吸管) in stages starting in 2019. 紙吸管 (paper straw) and 環保吸管 (reusable straw) are very common in Taiwan now.

components.meaning: tube; pipe; to manage; to control

examples.chinese: 這家飲料店改用紙吸管，不再提供塑膠管子，響應環保政策。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yǐnliào diàn gǎi yòng zhǐ xīguǎn, bù zài tígōng sùjiāo guǎnzi, xiǎngyìng huánbǎo zhèngcè.
examples.english: This beverage shop has switched to paper straws and no longer provides plastic straws, in response to environmental policies.

examples.chinese: 廚房的水管漏水了，需要請水電師傅來修理。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng de shuǐguǎn lòu shuǐ le, xūyào qǐng shuǐdiàn shīfu lái xiūlǐ.
examples.english: The water pipe in the kitchen is leaking—we need to call a plumber to fix it.

semanticNote: Champion; first place winner. 冠軍 refers to the number one winner of a competition. 世界冠軍 (world champion), 奪得冠軍 (win the championship), 衛冕冠軍 (defending champion). Taiwan has produced notable world champions in badminton, taekwondo, baseball, and gaming esports. Taiwan traditional: 冠軍.

examples.chinese: 台灣代表隊在這屆世界棒球經典賽中勇奪冠軍，全國沸騰。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān dàibiǎoduì zài zhè jiè shìjiè bànqiú jīngdiǎnsài zhōng yǒng duó guànjūn, quánguó fèiténg.
examples.english: Taiwan's national team bravely won the championship at this World Baseball Classic, and the whole country erupted in celebration.

examples.chinese: 她奪得全國羽球冠軍後，隨即代表台灣出征國際賽事。
examples.pinyin: Tā duó dé quánguó yǔqiú guànjūn hòu, suíjí dàibiǎo Táiwān chūzhēng guójì sàishì.
examples.english: After winning the national badminton championship, she immediately represented Taiwan in international competitions.

semanticNote: Glossy; sleek; smooth (to the touch). 光滑的皮膚 (smooth skin), 光滑的表面 (smooth/glossy surface), 光滑的地板 (slippery smooth floor). Positive when describing skin, negative when describing floors (slippery hazard). Distinct from 平整 (even/flat) which focuses on levelness rather than texture. Taiwan traditional: 光滑.

examples.chinese: 她用了新的護膚品之後，臉上的皮膚變得光滑多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng le xīn de hùfū pǐn zhīhòu, liǎn shàng de pífū biàn de guānghuá duō le.
examples.english: After using the new skincare product, her facial skin became much smoother.

examples.chinese: 廁所剛拖過地，地面非常光滑，請小心行走。
examples.pinyin: Cèsuǒ gāng tuō guò dì, dìmiàn fēicháng guānghuá, qǐng xiǎoxīn xíngzǒu.
examples.english: The restroom floor was just mopped and is very slippery—please walk carefully.

semanticNote: To honor someone with one's presence; to visit (formal/polite). 光臨 is a formal welcome expression, primarily used by businesses and hosts: 歡迎光臨！(Welcome! — you hear this at every store in Taiwan). 蒞臨 is an even more formal variant for official visits. Taiwan traditional: 光臨.

components.meaning: to arrive; to come; to be present

examples.chinese: 歡迎光臨本店，請問有什麼我可以幫您的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng guānglín běn diàn, qǐngwèn yǒu shénme wǒ kěyǐ bāng nín de ma?
examples.english: Welcome to our store—is there anything I can help you with?

examples.chinese: 感謝各位嘉賓今晚撥冗光臨，讓這場活動更加圓滿。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnxiè gèwèi jiābīn jīn wǎn bōrǒng guānglín, ràng zhè chǎng huódòng gèngjiā yuánmǎn.
examples.english: Thank you to all guests for taking time out of your busy schedules to honor us with your presence tonight, making this event a greater success.

semanticNote: Bright; promising; light; illuminated. 光明的未來 (bright future), 光明磊落 (upright and straightforward — idiom), 黑暗與光明 (darkness and light). 光明 is often used metaphorically for hope, justice, and a positive future. 光明正大 (open and aboveboard; honest and fair) is a common idiom. Taiwan traditional: 光明.

examples.chinese: 只要你繼續努力，前途一定是光明的。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jìxù nǔlì, qiántú yīdìng shì guāngmíng de.
examples.english: As long as you keep working hard, your future will surely be bright.

examples.chinese: 她做事光明磊落，從不搞小動作，大家都很信任她。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì guāngmíng lěiluò, cóng bù gǎo xiǎo dòngzuò, dàjiā dōu hěn xìnrèn tā.
examples.english: She acts in an upright and straightforward manner, never doing things underhanded—everyone trusts her.

semanticNote: 光 (light) + 盤 (disc/plate) — a reflective optical disc. In Taiwan, 光碟 (guāngdié) is the standard term for CD/DVD, while 光盤 is more Mainland usage. Context determines whether it refers to a music CD, software disc, or data backup.

examples.chinese: 我在整理舊東西時找到了幾張裝有童年照片的光盤。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhěnglǐ jiù dōngxi shí zhǎodào le jǐ zhāng zhuāng yǒu tóngnián zhàopiān de guāngpán.
examples.english: While sorting through old things I found several CDs containing childhood photos.

examples.chinese: 以前買軟體都要靠光盤安裝，現在幾乎都改成線上下載了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián mǎi ruǎntǐ dōu yào kào guāngpán ānzhuāng, xiànzài jīhū dōu gǎichéng xiànshàng xiàzài le.
examples.english: Software used to be installed via disc; now almost everything has switched to online downloads.

semanticNote: 廣 (broad) + 場 (open space) — an open public space, typically in front of a major building or civic center. In Taiwan, 廣場 appears in names like 凱達格蘭大道 and shopping mall plazas; also used metaphorically in terms like 廣場恐懼症 (agoraphobia).

examples.chinese: 每逢選舉，各黨都會在廣場舉辦大型造勢晚會。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng xuǎnjǔ, gè dǎng dōu huì zài guǎngchǎng jǔbàn dàxíng zàoshì wǎnhuì.
examples.english: During every election, parties hold large rally events in public squares.

examples.chinese: 台北市政府廣場在新年倒數時總是擠滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Shì Zhèngfǔ guǎngchǎng zài xīnnián dàoshǔ shí zǒng shì jǐ mǎn le rén.
examples.english: Taipei City Hall plaza is always packed with people during the New Year countdown.

semanticNote: 廣 (broad) + 大 (large) — vast in scope, typically used for abstract or large-scale things: 廣大民眾 (the broad public), 廣大地區 (a vast area). Has a formal, elevated register; often seen in political or journalistic writing.

examples.chinese: 這項政策直接影響廣大勞工的薪資與退休金。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng guǎngdà láogōng de xīnzī yǔ tuìxiūjīn.
examples.english: This policy directly affects the wages and pensions of a vast number of workers.

examples.chinese: 颱風過境後，廣大的農業區受到嚴重的損失。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòjìng hòu, guǎngdà de nóngyè qū shòudào yánzhòng de sǔnshī.
examples.english: After the typhoon passed, vast agricultural areas suffered serious losses.

semanticNote: 廣 (broad) + 泛 (to float; widespread) — extensive in range, referring to scope or coverage rather than physical area. 廣泛關注 (wide attention), 廣泛應用 (widespread application). Differs from 廣大 (which emphasizes size) by emphasizing breadth of variety.

examples.chinese: 這款APP在台灣的青少年族群中獲得廣泛的使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn APP zài Táiwān de qīngshàonián zúqún zhōng huòdé guǎngfàn de shǐyòng.
examples.english: This app has gained widespread use among teenagers in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 她的研究涉及廣泛，從語言學到認知神經科學都有涉獵。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yánjiū shèjí guǎngfàn, cóng yǔyánxué dào rènzhī shénjīng kēxué dōu yǒu shèliè.
examples.english: Her research covers a wide range, touching on everything from linguistics to cognitive neuroscience.

semanticNote: 歸 (return; converge) + 納 (receive; take in) — inductive reasoning or summarization; to draw general conclusions from specific cases. Contrasted with 演繹 (deduction). Common in academic writing: 歸納法 (inductive method), 歸納出結論 (reach a conclusion by induction).

examples.chinese: 老師要我們把本學期學過的語法歸納成一張表格。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yào wǒmen bǎ běn xuéqī xuéguo de yǔfǎ guīnà chéng yī zhāng biǎogé.
examples.english: The teacher asked us to summarize all the grammar we learned this semester into a chart.

examples.chinese: 他在報告中歸納了三個導致失業率上升的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàogào zhōng guīnà le sān gè dǎozhì shīyèlǜ shàngshēng de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: In his report, he identified three main reasons contributing to the rise in unemployment.

semanticNote: 規 (compass; rule) + 矩 (carpenter's square; standard) — both physical measuring tools, hence 'established rules or conventions.' As a noun: 守規矩 (abide by the rules). As an adj: 這孩子很規矩 (this child is well-behaved/proper). The neutral tone on 矩 marks it as a set compound.

examples.chinese: 進廟拜拜有一定的規矩，要先上香，再行禮。
examples.pinyin: Jìn miào bàibài yǒu yīdìng de guīju, yào xiān shàngxiāng, zài xínglǐ.
examples.english: There are established customs when worshipping at a temple — you light incense first, then bow.

examples.chinese: 她從小受到嚴格的家教，做事一向規矩老實。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo shòudào yángé de jiājiào, zuòshì yīxiàng guīju lǎoshi.
examples.english: She received strict upbringing and has always been proper and honest in everything she does.

semanticNote: 規 (rule) + 律 (law; rhythm) — a natural law, pattern, or regularity that governs phenomena. 自然規律 (laws of nature), 生活規律 (regular routine). Also used as an adj: 生活很規律 (living a regular/disciplined life). Broader than 規則 (which is a man-made rule).

examples.chinese: 科學家研究地震的規律，希望有朝一日能夠預測災害。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā yánjiū dìzhèn de guīlǜ, xīwàng yǒu zhāo yī rì néng gòu yùcè zāihài.
examples.english: Scientists study the patterns of earthquakes, hoping one day to predict disasters.

examples.chinese: 準備考試期間，她每天作息非常規律，十點就寢、六點起床。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔnbèi kǎoshì qījiān, tā měitiān zuòxī fēicháng guīlǜ, shídiǎn jiùqǐn, liùdiǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: During exam prep, her daily routine was extremely regular — in bed by ten, up at six.

semanticNote: 規 (standard) + 模 (model; pattern; mold) — scale or scope of an operation, event, or organization. 大規模 (large-scale), 小規模 (small-scale), 規模經濟 (economies of scale). Neutral register; used in business, military, academic, and journalistic contexts.

examples.chinese: 台積電在台南擴廠的規模相當龐大，預計帶動上萬個就業機會。
examples.pinyin: Táijī Diàn zài Táinán kuò chǎng de guīmó xiāngdāng pángdà, yùjì dàidòng shàng wàn gè jiùyè jīhuì.
examples.english: TSMC's expansion in Tainan is on a massive scale, expected to create tens of thousands of jobs.

examples.chinese: 這次廟會活動的規模比往年更大，吸引了全台各地的信眾。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì miàohuì huódòng de guīmó bǐ wǎngnián gèng dà, xīyǐn le quán Tái gèdì de xìnzhòng.
examples.english: This year's temple festival was larger in scale than previous years, drawing devotees from across Taiwan.

semanticNote: 規 (rule) + 則 (principle; norm) — a man-made rule or regulation. As an adj: 規則圖形 (regular shape). Differs from 規律 (natural pattern) and 規矩 (social convention). Often appears in formal contexts: 交通規則 (traffic regulations), 比賽規則 (competition rules).

examples.chinese: 參加學測前，考生必須熟悉所有考場規則。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā xuécè qián, kǎoshēng bìxū shúxī suǒyǒu kǎochǎng guīzé.
examples.english: Before taking the college entrance exam, students must be familiar with all examination hall rules.

examples.chinese: 球隊因違反比賽規則而被取消資格，全隊成員都感到十分沮喪。
examples.pinyin: Qiúduì yīn wéifǎn bǐsài guīzé ér bèi qǔxiāo zīgé, quán duì chéngyuán dōu gǎndào shífēn jǔsàng.
examples.english: The team was disqualified for violating competition rules, and all members felt deeply discouraged.

semanticNote: 櫃 (cabinet; counter) + 台 (platform; counter) — a service counter in a bank, hotel, pharmacy, or shop. In Taiwan written 櫃台 (traditional). Also appears in compound 櫃台小姐 (counter clerk). Not used for a bar (酒吧) or shop front (門市).

examples.chinese: 請到三號櫃台辦理存款手續，不需要再重新排隊。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dào sān hào guìtái bànlǐ cúnkuǎn shǒuxù, bù xūyào zài chóngxīn páiduì.
examples.english: Please proceed to counter number 3 for deposit procedures — you don't need to queue again.

examples.chinese: 她在藥局的櫃台向藥師詢問感冒藥的使用方式。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yàojú de guìtái xiàng yàoshī xúnwèn gǎnmào yào de shǐyòng fāngshì.
examples.english: She asked the pharmacist at the counter about how to take the cold medicine.

semanticNote: To roll (of a ball or cylinder); to boil (of water); colloquially 'get lost!' (滾開). In Taiwan: 水滾了 (the water has boiled) is common in everyday speech. The rude imperative 滾! is recognized but context is important; it can also appear in 滾動 (rolling) which is entirely neutral.

examples.chinese: 鍋裡的水已經滾了，可以把麵放進去了。
examples.pinyin: Guō lǐ de shuǐ yǐjīng gǔn le, kěyǐ bǎ miàn fàng jìnqù le.
examples.english: The water in the pot is already boiling — you can put the noodles in now.

examples.chinese: 那顆石頭從山坡上滾下來，差點砸到正在登山的遊客。
examples.pinyin: Nà kē shítou cóng shānpō shàng gǔn xiàlái, chàdiǎn záo dào zhèngzài dēngshān de yóukè.
examples.english: That rock rolled down the hillside and nearly hit hikers who were climbing.

semanticNote: 鍋 — a cooking pot, pan, or wok. In Taiwan: 火鍋 (hot pot), 電鍋 (electric rice cooker, an iconic Taiwanese kitchen appliance made by Tatung 大同). Colloquially 背鍋 means 'to take the blame' (carry the pot). Measure word: 一鍋湯 (one pot of soup).

examples.chinese: 大同電鍋是台灣家家戶戶廚房裡幾乎都有的必備家電。
examples.pinyin: Dàtóng diànguō shì Táiwān jiājiāhùhù chúfáng lǐ jīhū dōu yǒu de bìbèi jiādiàn.
examples.english: The Tatung electric cooker is an essential appliance found in almost every kitchen in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 天氣變涼，朋友們相約去吃火鍋，大家圍著一個大鍋聊得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn liáng, péngyǒumen xiāngyuē qù chī huǒguō, dàjiā wéizhe yī gè dà guō liáo de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: As the weather cooled, friends arranged to eat hot pot together, happily chatting around the big pot.

semanticNote: 國慶節 — National Day. In Taiwan, this falls on October 10 (雙十節, Double Ten Day), commemorating the 1911 Wuchang Uprising that led to the founding of the Republic of China. In Taiwan the full name is 中華民國國慶日. Distinct from the PRC's October 1 National Day.

examples.chinese: 雙十國慶節當天，總統府前廣場舉行了盛大的國慶典禮與閱兵。
examples.pinyin: Shuāng shí guóqìng jié dāngtiān, Zǒngtǒng Fǔ qián guǎngchǎng jǔxíng le shèngdà de guóqìng diǎnlǐ yǔ yuèbīng.
examples.english: On National Day (Double Ten), a grand ceremony and military parade were held in front of the Presidential Office.

examples.chinese: 每年國慶節放假一天，許多人趁機出去旅遊或回鄉探親。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián guóqìng jié fàngjià yī tiān, xǔduō rén chènjī chūqù lǚyóu huò huí xiāng tànqīn.
examples.english: National Day is a one-day holiday each year; many people take the opportunity to travel or visit family.

semanticNote: 國 (nation) + 王 (king) — a king of a monarchic state. In Taiwan, 國王 appears in historical contexts and in popular culture (fairy tales, chess: 國際象棋的國王). Distinguish from 皇帝 (emperor) and 總統 (president). In card games, 國王 is the king card.

examples.chinese: 故事裡的國王下令全國舉辦比武大賽，要為公主招親。
examples.pinyin: Gùshi lǐ de guówáng xiàlìng quánguó jǔbàn bǐwǔ dàsài, yào wèi gōngzhǔ zhāoqīn.
examples.english: The king in the story ordered a martial arts tournament across the kingdom to find a husband for the princess.

examples.chinese: 泰國國王在當地受到極高的尊崇，批評王室是違法的行為。
examples.pinyin: Tài guó guówáng zài dāngdì shòudào jí gāo de zūnchóng, pīpíng wángshì shì wéifǎ de xíngwéi.
examples.english: The Thai king is held in extremely high regard locally; criticizing the royal family is illegal.

semanticNote: 果 (result; indeed) + 然 (so; like that) — 'sure enough; as expected; just as predicted.' Expresses that a prior hypothesis or warning has been confirmed by events. Always refers to something previously anticipated, distinguishing it from 竟然 (unexpectedly) which implies surprise.

examples.chinese: 我早就說過這家店的珍奶很好喝，你喝了之後果然也這麼覺得吧？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù shuōguò zhè jiā diàn de zhēnnǎi hěn hǎohē, nǐ hēle zhīhòu guǒrán yě zhème juéde ba?
examples.english: I told you ages ago the bubble tea at this place is great — and sure enough, you think so too after trying it, right?

examples.chinese: 天氣預報說週末會下雨，果然一出門就碰到傾盆大雨。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō zhōumò huì xià yǔ, guǒrán yī chūmén jiù pèngdào qīngpén dàyǔ.
examples.english: The forecast said it would rain on the weekend — sure enough, as soon as we stepped out, we hit a downpour.

semanticNote: 果 (fruit) + 實 (solid; real; fruit/seed) — the fruit or seed of a plant; also used metaphorically for the 'fruits' of labor or effort (勞動的果實). More formal and literary than 水果 (fruit you eat). In botanical usage, includes nuts, berries, and grains.

examples.chinese: 秋天到了，山上的樹木結滿了各種顏色的果實。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān dào le, shān shàng de shùmù jié mǎn le gè zhǒng yánsè de guǒshí.
examples.english: Autumn arrived and the trees on the mountain were full of fruits of every color.

examples.chinese: 多年的努力終於有了成果，他們享受著自己辛勤勞動的果實。
examples.pinyin: Duō nián de nǔlì zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ, tāmen xiǎngshòu zhe zìjǐ xīnqín láodòng de guǒshí.
examples.english: Years of effort finally paid off, and they savored the fruits of their hard work.

semanticNote: 過 (exceed) + 分 (portion; measure) — going beyond what is appropriate or acceptable. 你太過分了 (you've gone too far) is a common colloquial expression in Taiwan. As an adverb: 過分強調 (over-emphasize). Implies a moral judgment that a boundary has been crossed.

examples.chinese: 他批評同事的方式太過分了，讓對方當眾出糗非常難堪。
examples.pinyin: Tā pīpíng tóngshì de fāngshì tài guòfèn le, ràng duìfāng dāngzhòng chūqiú fēicháng nánkān.
examples.english: The way he criticized his colleague was way too excessive — making her lose face publicly was very embarrassing.

examples.chinese: 要求員工週末不加班費加班實在過分，難怪大家都想離職。
examples.pinyin: Yāoqiú yuángōng zhōumò bù jiābān fèi jiābān shízài guòfèn, nánguài dàjiā dōu xiǎng lí zhí.
examples.english: Demanding employees work overtime on weekends without pay is truly unreasonable — no wonder everyone wants to quit.

semanticNote: 過 (over; exceed) + 敏 (sensitive; quick) — an allergic reaction or hypersensitivity. 對花粉過敏 (allergic to pollen), 食物過敏 (food allergy), 過敏反應 (allergic reaction). Very common in Taiwan medical and everyday contexts; Taiwan has high rates of atopic conditions.

examples.chinese: 她對海鮮嚴重過敏，每次吃了蝦子皮膚就會起蕁麻疹。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì hǎixiān yánzhòng guòmǐn, měi cì chī le xiāzi pífū jiù huì qǐ qínmázhěn.
examples.english: She is severely allergic to seafood — every time she eats shrimp her skin breaks out in hives.

examples.chinese: 春天花粉多，過敏體質的人最好隨身攜帶抗過敏藥。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān huāfěn duō, guòmǐn tǐzhì de rén zuìhǎo suíshēn xiédài kàng guòmǐn yào.
examples.english: Spring brings lots of pollen; people prone to allergies should carry antihistamines with them at all times.

semanticNote: 過 (pass; exceed) + 期 (period; deadline) — to be past a deadline, expiry date, or due date. 食品過期 (expired food), 簽證過期 (expired visa), 還款過期 (overdue payment). Very practical vocabulary in daily life; in Taiwan food labeling uses 有效日期 (expiry date).

examples.chinese: 買食品前記得檢查有效日期，過期的東西絕對不要吃。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi shípǐn qián jìde jiǎnchá yǒuxiào rìqī, guòqī de dōngxi juéduì bùyào chī.
examples.english: Remember to check the expiry date before buying food — never eat anything that's expired.

examples.chinese: 他的居留證已經過期，必須趕緊到移民署辦理延期手續。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jūliú zhèng yǐjīng guòqī, bìxū gǎnjǐn dào yímín shǔ bànlǐ yánqī shǒuxù.
examples.english: His residence permit has already expired; he must hurry to the Immigration Agency to apply for an extension.

semanticNote: An interjection expressing laughter (哈哈 hāhā) or delight; also the sound of exhaling warm breath (哈氣 to breathe on something to warm it). In Taiwan online communication, 哈哈 is the standard laughter particle (equivalent to 'haha' or 'lol'). 哈 alone can express mild amusement or sycophancy (拍馬屁).

examples.chinese: 他講的笑話真的太好笑了，大家哈哈大笑起來。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎng de xiàohuà zhēnde tài hǎoxiào le, dàjiā hāhā dàxiào qǐlái.
examples.english: The joke he told was genuinely hilarious — everyone burst out laughing.

examples.chinese: 冬天早上，她對著窗玻璃哈了一口氣，用手指畫了個笑臉。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān zǎoshang, tā duìzhe chuāng bōli hā le yī kǒu qì, yòng shǒuzhǐ huà le gè xiàoliǎn.
examples.english: On a winter morning, she breathed on the window glass and drew a smiley face with her finger.

semanticNote: 海 (sea) + 關 (pass; checkpoint) — customs (border inspection service). In Taiwan: 財政部關務署 oversees customs. Travelers returning from abroad must declare goods; the duty-free allowance is NT$20,000. 報關 (to declare) and 過海關 (to clear customs) are common collocations.

examples.chinese: 從日本帶回來的牛肉必須在海關申報，否則會被沒收並罰款。
examples.pinyin: Cóng Rìběn dài huílái de niúròu bìxū zài hǎiguān shēnbào, fǒuzé huì bèi mòshōu bìng fákuǎn.
examples.english: Beef brought back from Japan must be declared at customs; otherwise it will be confiscated and fined.

examples.chinese: 春節前後機場人潮洶湧，過海關往往要等超過一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié qiánhòu jīchǎng rénchāo xiōngyǒng, guò hǎiguān wǎngwǎng yào děng chāoguò yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Around the Lunar New Year, airports are extremely crowded and clearing customs often takes over an hour.

semanticNote: 海 (sea) + 鮮 (fresh; delicious) — seafood (collectively: fish, shellfish, crustaceans, etc.). Taiwan is an island with abundant seafood culture; 海產店 (seafood restaurant), 漁港 (fishing harbor) markets, and dishes like 蚵仔煎 (oyster omelet) and 三杯蝦 are central to local cuisine.

examples.chinese: 基隆廟口夜市有許多攤販賣新鮮的海鮮，吸引大批饕客前來。
examples.pinyin: Jīlóng miào kǒu yèshì yǒu xǔduō tānfàn mài xīnxiān de hǎixiān, xīyǐn dàpī tāokè qiánlái.
examples.english: Keelung's Miaokou night market has many stalls selling fresh seafood, drawing crowds of food lovers.

examples.chinese: 台灣四面環海，海鮮料理種類豐富，價格相對實惠。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān sìmiàn huán hǎi, hǎixiān liàolǐ zhǒnglèi fēngfù, jiàgé xiāngduì shíhuì.
examples.english: Surrounded by the sea on all sides, Taiwan has a rich variety of seafood dishes at relatively affordable prices.

semanticNote: To shout, call out, or yell. 喊人 (call someone over), 喊救命 (shout for help), 喊價 (call out a price; bid at auction). More informal and louder than 叫 in some contexts. In Taiwan youth slang, 喊話 means 'to publicly appeal or address someone' (often via social media).

examples.chinese: 孩子在百貨公司裡和媽媽走散了，嚇得大聲喊救命。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zài bǎihuò gōngsī lǐ hé māma zǒusàn le, xià de dàshēng hǎn jiùmìng.
examples.english: The child got separated from their mother in the department store and screamed for help in panic.

examples.chinese: 教練在場邊大聲喊著戰術，提醒球員注意防守位置。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn zài chǎngbiān dàshēng hǎn zhe zhànshù, tíxǐng qiúyuán zhùyì fángshǒu wèizhì.
examples.english: The coach shouted tactics from the sideline, reminding players to watch their defensive positions.

semanticNote: 行 (trade; profession; háng) + 業 (industry; occupation) — an industry, trade, or line of business. 各行各業 (every walk of life; all industries). Note: 行 here is read háng (not xíng). Common in economic and professional discourse: 服務業 (service industry), 科技業 (tech industry).

examples.chinese: 台灣的半導體行業在全球供應鏈中占有舉足輕重的地位。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de bàndǎotǐ hángyè zài quánqiú gōngyīng liàn zhōng zhànyǒu jǔzúqīngzhòng de dìwèi.
examples.english: Taiwan's semiconductor industry holds a pivotal position in the global supply chain.

examples.chinese: 她換了好幾個行業，從餐飲業到IT，最後決定創業。
examples.pinyin: Tā huàn le hǎo jǐ gè hángyè, cóng cānyǐn yè dào IT, zuìhòu juédìng chuàngyè.
examples.english: She switched through several industries — from F&B to IT — before finally deciding to start her own business.

semanticNote: 豪 (grand; heroic; extravagant) + 華 (magnificent; splendid) — luxurious; lavish; extravagant. 豪華飯店 (luxury hotel), 豪華版 (deluxe edition), 豪華裝潢 (lavish interior design). Always carries a connotation of high-end expense. More elevated than 高級 (high-class).

examples.chinese: 他為了慶祝公司上市，在台北最豪華的飯店訂了一整層包廂宴請員工。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi le qìngzhù gōngsī shàngshì, zài Táiběi zuì háohuá de fàndiàn dìng le yī zhěng céng bāoxiāng yànqǐng yuángōng.
examples.english: To celebrate the company's IPO, he booked an entire floor of private rooms at Taipei's most luxurious hotel to treat his employees.

examples.chinese: 這台豪華遊覽車配備全皮座椅與個人娛樂螢幕，乘坐起來非常舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái háohuá yóulǎnchē pèibèi quán pí zuòyǐ yǔ gèrén yúlè yínmù, chéngzuò qǐlái fēicháng shūshì.
examples.english: This luxury tour bus is equipped with full leather seats and personal entertainment screens, making for a very comfortable ride.

semanticNote: 好 (to like; hào) + 客 (guest) — hospitable; fond of entertaining guests. Note: 好 is read hào (4th tone) because it functions as a verb meaning 'to love/like.' 台灣人以好客聞名 (Taiwanese are known for their hospitality) is a widely shared sentiment. Distinct from 友善 (friendly) — 好客 specifically involves welcoming guests.

examples.chinese: 台灣人以熱情好客著稱，外國遊客來了通常都被台灣人的親切所感動。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén yǐ rèqíng hàokè zhùchēng, wàiguó yóukè lái le tōngcháng dōu bèi Táiwān rén de qīnqiè suǒ gǎndòng.
examples.english: Taiwanese people are known for their warm hospitality; foreign visitors are usually moved by their friendliness.

examples.chinese: 老奶奶非常好客，每次有人來訪，她一定要留人吃飯才罷手。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo nǎinai fēicháng hàokè, měi cì yǒu rén lái fǎng, tā yīdìng yào liú rén chīfàn cái bà shǒu.
examples.english: Grandma is extremely hospitable — whenever anyone visits, she insists they stay for a meal.

semanticNote: 合 (accord with; fit) + 法 (law; method) — lawful; legal; in accordance with the law. 合法經營 (operating legally), 合法身份 (legal status). Antonym: 非法 (illegal). In Taiwan legal discourse, 合法 implies compliance with the ROC legal system. Often appears in discussions of immigration, business licenses, and civil rights.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，同性伴侶依法登記結婚是合法的，台灣是亞洲第一個通過同婚的地區。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, tóngxìng bànlǚ yīfǎ dēngjì jiéhūn shì héfǎ de, Táiwān shì Yàzhōu dì yī gè tōngguò tónghūn de dìqū.
examples.english: In Taiwan, same-sex couples can legally register their marriage — Taiwan was the first place in Asia to legalize same-sex marriage.

examples.chinese: 請確認所有進口文件齊全，確保整個交易過程合法合規。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng quèrèn suǒyǒu jìnkǒu wénjiàn qíquán, quèbǎo zhěnggè jiāoyì guòchéng héfǎ hé guī.
examples.english: Please ensure all import documents are in order to guarantee the entire transaction is lawful and compliant.

semanticNote: 合 (accord with) + 理 (reason; logic; principle) — rational; reasonable; fair. 合理的要求 (a reasonable request), 合理的價格 (a fair price), 不合理 (unreasonable). Very common in negotiation, workplace, and consumer contexts. Implies logical and moral acceptability, not just legality.

examples.chinese: 這個薪水對這個職位來說不太合理，同行業的薪資應該更高才對。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīnshuǐ duì zhège zhíwèi lái shuō bù tài hélǐ, tóng hángyè de xīnzī yīnggāi gèng gāo cái duì.
examples.english: This salary is not very reasonable for this position — compensation in the same industry should be higher.

examples.chinese: 她的建議相當合理，大家討論後一致同意採納。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiànyì xiāngdāng hélǐ, dàjiā tǎolùn hòu yīzhì tóngyì cǎinà.
examples.english: Her suggestion was quite reasonable; after discussion, everyone agreed unanimously to adopt it.

semanticNote: 合 (join; agree) + 同 (same; together) — a formal contract or agreement. In Taiwan, 合約 (héyuē) is more commonly used than 合同 in everyday speech, though both are understood. 簽合同/合約 (sign a contract), 違反合同 (breach of contract). 合同 is more Mainland-standard; 合約 is the Taiwan preference.

examples.chinese: 在正式開始工作之前，雙方必須先簽訂合同，明確工作內容與薪資。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì kāishǐ gōngzuò zhīqián, shuāngfāng bìxū xiān qiāndìng hétong, míngquè gōngzuò nèiróng yǔ xīnzī.
examples.english: Before officially starting work, both parties must sign a contract specifying the job content and salary.

examples.chinese: 律師仔細審閱合同的每一條款，確保客戶的權益受到保障。
examples.pinyin: Lǜshī zǐxì shěnyuè hétong de měi yī tiáokuǎn, quèbǎo kèhù de quányì shòudào bǎozhàng.
examples.english: The lawyer carefully reviewed every clause of the contract to ensure the client's rights were protected.

semanticNote: 合 (together) + 影 (image; shadow; photo) — to take a group photo or be photographed together. 合影留念 (take a commemorative group photo) is a set phrase used at events, graduations, and tourist spots. As a noun: 這張合影 (this group photo). Very common at Taiwanese school events and official ceremonies.

examples.chinese: 畢業典禮結束後，全班同學和老師一起在校門口合影留念。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ jiéshù hòu, quánbān tóngxué hé lǎoshī yīqǐ zài xiào ménkǒu héyǐng liúniàn.
examples.english: After the graduation ceremony, the whole class took a commemorative group photo with the teacher at the school gate.

examples.chinese: 粉絲見到偶像後立刻要求合影，偶像非常親切地答應了。
examples.pinyin: Fěnsī jiàndào ǒuxiàng hòu lìkè yāoqiú héyǐng, ǒuxiàng fēicháng qīnqiè de dāyìng le.
examples.english: Fans immediately asked for a photo with the idol upon seeing them, and the idol kindly agreed.

semanticNote: 合 (join; combine) + 作 (do; work) — to cooperate, collaborate. 合作愉快 (pleasant collaboration — said at the end of a deal), 合作關係 (partnership), 國際合作 (international cooperation). In Taiwan business culture, 合作 implies mutual benefit and sustained partnership rather than a one-off arrangement.

examples.chinese: 兩家公司達成合作協議，共同開發新一代半導體製程技術。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī dáchéng hézuò xiéyì, gòngtóng kāifā xīn yīdài bàndǎotǐ zhìchéng jìshù.
examples.english: The two companies reached a cooperation agreement to jointly develop next-generation semiconductor fabrication technology.

examples.chinese: 這次展覽是學校與在地藝術家合作的成果，吸引了不少參觀者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn shì xuéxiào yǔ zàidì yìshùjiā hézuò de chéngguǒ, xīyǐn le bùshǎo cānguānzhě.
examples.english: This exhibition is the result of collaboration between the school and local artists, attracting quite a few visitors.

semanticNote: 何 (why; what) + 必 (must; necessarily) — 'why should; there's no need to.' A rhetorical expression expressing that something is unnecessary or pointless. 你何必這樣做呢？ (Why do you need to do it this way?) Often used to gently discourage or express resignation. More literary than 不必 (don't need to).

examples.chinese: 既然結果都一樣，何必花那麼多時間和精力去爭論？
examples.pinyin: Jìrán jiéguǒ dōu yīyàng, hébì huā nàme duō shíjiān hé jīnglì qù zhēnglùn?
examples.english: Since the outcome is the same either way, why bother spending so much time and energy arguing?

examples.chinese: 你何必在意別人的眼光，做自己覺得對的事就好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hébì zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, zuò zìjǐ juéde duì de shì jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Why should you care what others think? Just do what you believe is right.

semanticNote: 何 (what) + 況 (situation; moreover) — 'let alone; much less; not to mention.' Introduces a stronger or more extreme case to reinforce the previous point. Used in both positive and negative arguments: 大人都跑不完，何況小孩。 (Even adults can't finish it, let alone children.) More formal than 更別說.

examples.chinese: 這道題連教授都覺得難，何況是剛入學的大一新生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí lián jiàoshòu dōu juéde nán, hékuàng shì gāng rùxué de dàyī xīnshēng.
examples.english: Even the professor finds this problem difficult, let alone freshmen who just started university.

examples.chinese: 光是一個人環島就已經很不容易了，何況還要帶著孩子。
examples.pinyin: Guāng shì yī gè rén huán dǎo jiù yǐjīng hěn bù róngyì le, hékuàng hái yào dài zhe háizi.
examples.english: Cycling around the island alone is already very challenging, let alone doing it while bringing children along.

semanticNote: 和 (harmony; together) + 平 (peaceful; flat; equal) — peace; peaceful. 維護和平 (uphold peace), 和平談判 (peace negotiations), 和平統一 (peaceful reunification — a politically charged phrase in the Taiwan context). Also appears in place names: 和平島 (Heping Island, Keelung). The opposite is 戰爭 (war).

examples.chinese: 台灣海峽兩岸的和平穩定，對整個亞太地區都至關重要。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān Hǎixiá liǎng'àn de hépíng wěndìng, duì zhěnggè Yàtài dìqū dōu zhìguān zhòngyào.
examples.english: Peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait is critically important for the entire Asia-Pacific region.

examples.chinese: 她致力於推動校園中的和平文化，反對任何形式的霸凌行為。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhìlì yú tuīdòng xiàoyuán zhōng de hépíng wénhuà, fǎnduì rènhé xíngshì de bàlíng xíngwéi.
examples.english: She is dedicated to promoting a culture of peace on campus and opposes all forms of bullying.

semanticNote: 核 (core; pit; nucleus) + 心 (heart; center) — the core, nucleus, or central element of something. 核心價值 (core values), 核心技術 (core technology), 核心成員 (core members). Widespread in corporate, academic, and political language. 核 alone can mean nuclear (核電廠), but 核心 is not nuclear-related.

examples.chinese: 台積電的核心競爭力在於其領先全球的晶片製造技術。
examples.pinyin: Táijī Diàn de héxīn jìngzhēnglì zàiyú qí lǐngxiān quánqiú de jīngpiàn zhìzào jìshù.
examples.english: TSMC's core competitive advantage lies in its world-leading chip manufacturing technology.

examples.chinese: 這本書的核心論點是：科技並不能解決所有的社會問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de héxīn lùndiǎn shì: kējì bìng bù néng jiějué suǒyǒu de shèhuì wèntí.
examples.english: The central argument of this book is that technology alone cannot solve all social problems.

semanticNote: To hate; to resent; to feel bitterness about. 恨不得 (wish one could; so eager it's like hatred) — a commonly misunderstood compound: 恨不得立刻飛過去 (can't wait to fly there immediately). 怨恨 (grudge; resentment), 仇恨 (hatred based on enmity). Different from 討厭 (dislike) in degree of intensity.

examples.chinese: 她恨不得立刻衝去機場，因為太想念在海外留學的孩子了。
examples.pinyin: Tā hènbude lìkè chōng qù jīchǎng, yīnwèi tài xiǎngniàn zài hǎiwài liúxué de háizi le.
examples.english: She was dying to rush to the airport — she missed her child studying abroad so much.

examples.chinese: 他對那次不公平的解雇一直耿耿於懷，心中充滿了怨恨。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì nà cì bù gōngpíng de jiěgù yīzhí gěnggěngyúhuái, xīn zhōng chōngmǎn le yuànhèn.
examples.english: He held a lasting grudge over that unfair dismissal, and his heart was filled with resentment.

semanticNote: 猴 (monkey) + 子 (noun suffix) — a monkey. In Taiwan, Formosan macaques (台灣獼猴 Macaca cyclopis) are native and can be seen in mountainous areas like Shoushan (壽山) in Kaohsiung. 猴年 (Year of the Monkey). Colloquially used as an affectionate term for a naughty, energetic child.

examples.chinese: 在壽山自然公園，台灣獼猴非常習慣人類，有時會主動靠近遊客搶食物。
examples.pinyin: Zài Shòushān Zìrán Gōngyuán, Táiwān míhóu fēicháng xíguàn rénlèi, yǒushí huì zhǔdòng kàojìn yóukè qiǎng shíwù.
examples.english: In Shoushan Nature Park, Formosan macaques are very accustomed to humans and sometimes approach visitors to grab food.

examples.chinese: 這孩子調皮得像隻猴子，整天爬上爬下，讓父母操碎了心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè háizi tiáopí de xiàng zhī hóuzi, zhěngtiān pá shàng pá xià, ràng fùmǔ cāo suì le xīn.
examples.english: This child is as mischievous as a monkey, climbing up and down all day and worrying the parents half to death.

semanticNote: 後 (behind; back) + 背 (back of the body) — the back (of the human body). In Taiwan, 後背 or 背部 (bèibù) are both used. 後背包 (backpack) is the common Taiwan term (vs. 雙肩包 in Mainland). Distinct from 後面 (behind a location). Medical usage: 後背疼痛 (back pain).

components.meaning: back (of body); to carry on back

examples.chinese: 長時間坐在辦公桌前工作，容易引起後背和肩頸的酸痛。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān zuò zài bàngōng zhuō qián gōngzuò, róngyì yǐnqǐ hòubèi hé jiānjǐng de suāntòng.
examples.english: Sitting at a desk for long periods easily causes aches in the back and neck and shoulders.

examples.chinese: 她幫朋友在後背畫了一個漂亮的蝴蝶彩繪，大家都讚不絕口。
examples.pinyin: Tā bāng péngyǒu zài hòubèi huà le yī gè piàoliang de húdié cǎihuì, dàjiā dōu zànbù juékǒu.
examples.english: She painted a beautiful butterfly design on her friend's back, and everyone praised it without end.

semanticNote: 後 (after; subsequent) + 果 (result; fruit) — consequences; aftermath. Strongly implies negative or undesirable results: 嚴重的後果 (serious consequences), 自食其果 (reap what you sow; related concept). Very rarely used for positive results — for those, use 成果 (achievements) or 結果 (results).

examples.chinese: 他無視紅燈繼續騎車，後果是撞傷了一位行人，被警察開單。
examples.pinyin: Tā wúshì hóngdēng jìxù qíchē, hòuguǒ shì zhuàng shāng le yī wèi xíngrén, bèi jǐngchá kāi dān.
examples.english: He ignored the red light and kept riding; the consequence was injuring a pedestrian and getting ticketed by police.

examples.chinese: 如果不認真防治登革熱，後果將難以想像，整個社區都可能受到波及。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù rènzhēn fángzhì dēnggérè, hòuguǒ jiāng nányǐ xiǎngxiàng, zhěnggè shèqū dōu kěnéng shòudào bōjí.
examples.english: If dengue fever is not taken seriously, the consequences will be unimaginable — the entire community could be affected.

semanticNote: 呼 (breathe out; call) + 吸 (breathe in; absorb) — to breathe; breathing. The two characters represent exhalation and inhalation respectively. 呼吸新鮮空氣 (breathe fresh air), 呼吸困難 (difficulty breathing), 呼吸道疾病 (respiratory illness). In Taiwan, air quality (PM2.5) is a significant public health concern.

examples.chinese: 瑜伽老師教我們配合動作調整呼吸，讓身心放鬆下來。
examples.pinyin: Yújiā lǎoshī jiào wǒmen pèihé dòngzuò tiáozhěng hūxī, ràng shēn xīn fàngsōng xiàlái.
examples.english: The yoga teacher taught us to coordinate our breathing with the movements to relax body and mind.

examples.chinese: 空污嚴重的日子，醫師建議氣喘患者盡量待在室內以免呼吸道受到刺激。
examples.pinyin: Kōng wū yánzhòng de rìzi, yīshī jiànyì qìchuǎn huànzhě jǐnliàng dāi zài shìnèi yǐmiǎn hūxīdào shòudào cìjī.
examples.english: On days with heavy air pollution, doctors advise asthma patients to stay indoors as much as possible to avoid irritating their airways.

semanticNote: 忽 (suddenly; overlook) + 然 (so; like that) — suddenly; all of a sudden. Very common in narrative contexts. Synonymous with 突然 but slightly more literary; 突然 can be both adverb and adjective (突然的變化 a sudden change), while 忽然 is only adverbial. Both appear in HSK5.

examples.chinese: 正在上課時，教室外面忽然傳來一聲巨響，把全班同學都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngzài shàngkè shí, jiàoshì wàimiàn hūrán chuán lái yī shēng jùxiǎng, bǎ quánbān tóngxué dōu xià le yī tiào.
examples.english: While class was in session, a loud bang suddenly rang out from outside the classroom, startling everyone.

examples.chinese: 她走在街上，忽然想起忘了帶傘，但雨已經下起來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài jiēshang, hūrán xiǎngqǐ wàng le dài sǎn, dàn yǔ yǐjīng xià qǐlái le.
examples.english: She was walking down the street when she suddenly remembered she'd forgotten her umbrella — but the rain had already started.

semanticNote: 忽 (overlook; suddenly) + 視 (look at; regard) — to neglect, ignore, or overlook deliberately or carelessly. 不容忽視 (cannot be ignored — a very common set phrase), 忽視問題 (ignore a problem). Slightly stronger than 不注意 (not pay attention); implies a moral or intellectual failing.

examples.chinese: 許多青少年心理健康問題長期被忽視，直到情況惡化才引起重視。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qīngshàonián xīnlǐ jiànkāng wèntí chángqī bèi hūshì, zhídào qíngkuàng èhuà cái yǐnqǐ zhòngshì.
examples.english: Many adolescent mental health issues are chronically ignored until the situation worsens before attracting attention.

examples.chinese: 台灣的軟實力不容忽視，從影視到美食，都對全球產生了深遠的影響。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de ruǎn shílì bùróng hūshì, cóng yǐngshì dào měishí, dōu duì quánqiú chǎnshēng le shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Taiwan's soft power cannot be ignored — from film and TV to cuisine, it has had a profound global influence.

semanticNote: 胡 (reckless; barbarian; why) + 說 (speak; say) — to talk nonsense; to speak irresponsibly. 你在胡說什麼！ (What nonsense are you talking!) 胡說八道 (talk complete rubbish — a 4-character idiom extension). More emphatic than 亂講 (Taiwan colloquial equivalent). Can express both irritation and disbelief.

examples.chinese: 你不要胡說，這件事根本沒有你說的那麼嚴重！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùyào húshuō, zhè jiàn shì gēnběn méiyǒu nǐ shuō de nàme yánzhòng!
examples.english: Stop talking nonsense — this matter is nowhere near as serious as you're making it sound!

examples.chinese: 媒體上有些評論純粹是胡說八道，根本沒有任何事實根據。
examples.pinyin: Méitǐ shàng yǒuxiē pínglùn chúncuì shì húshuō bādào, gēnběn méiyǒu rènhé shìshí gēnjù.
examples.english: Some commentary in the media is pure rubbish — completely without factual basis.

semanticNote: A narrow lane or alley, particularly associated with traditional Beijing courtyard neighborhoods. The word is of Mongolian origin. In Taiwan, the equivalent concept uses 巷子 (alley) or 小巷 (narrow lane); 胡同 specifically refers to Beijing's historic residential alleys and is used in that cultural/historical context.

examples.chinese: 北京的胡同保留了老城的歷史記憶，但許多已在都市化過程中消失。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng de hútòng bǎoliú le lǎo chéng de lìshǐ jìyì, dàn xǔduō yǐ zài dūshì huà guòchéng zhōng xiāoshī.
examples.english: Beijing's hutongs preserve the historical memory of the old city, but many have disappeared in the process of urbanization.

examples.chinese: 他從小在北京的胡同裡長大，對那裡的一磚一瓦都充滿了感情。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo zài Běijīng de hútòng lǐ zhǎngdà, duì nàlǐ de yī zhuān yī wǎ dōu chōngmǎn le gǎnqíng.
examples.english: He grew up in Beijing's hutongs and has deep affection for every brick and tile of that place.

semanticNote: 壺 — a pot, kettle, or jug for holding liquids. 茶壺 (teapot), 水壺 (water bottle/kettle), 熱水壺 (electric kettle). As a measure word: 一壺茶 (a pot of tea). Taiwan's tea culture is rich; gongfu tea (功夫茶) ceremonies prominently feature the teapot as a central ritual object.

examples.chinese: 阿嬤把泡好的烏龍茶倒進茶壺，端出來給我們慢慢品嚐。
examples.pinyin: Āmā bǎ pào hǎo de wūlóng chá dào jìn cháhú, duān chūlái gěi wǒmen mànmàn pǐncháng.
examples.english: Grandma poured the brewed oolong tea into the teapot and brought it out for us to savor slowly.

examples.chinese: 登山前記得把保溫壺裝滿熱水，在山上喝到熱飲才有體力繼續走。
examples.pinyin: Dēngshān qián jìde bǎ bǎowēn hú zhuāng mǎn rèshuǐ, zài shān shàng hē dào rè yǐn cái yǒu tǐlì jìxù zǒu.
examples.english: Remember to fill your thermos with hot water before hiking — drinking something hot on the mountain gives you the energy to keep going.

semanticNote: 蝴蝶 — butterfly. Taiwan is internationally renowned for its butterfly diversity, with over 400 species; Maolin (茂林) in Kaohsiung is famous for spectacular purple crow butterfly migrations. 蝴蝶效應 (butterfly effect). 蝴蝶結 (bow tie; ribbon bow). 蝴蝶泳 (butterfly stroke in swimming).

examples.chinese: 每年冬季，數以百萬計的紫斑蝶會飛到高雄茂林過冬，蔚為奇觀。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngjì, shù yǐ bǎi wàn jì de zǐ bān dié huì fēi dào Gāoxióng Màolín guòdōng, wèi wéi qíguān.
examples.english: Every winter, millions of purple crow butterflies fly to Maolin in Kaohsiung to overwinter, creating a spectacular sight.

examples.chinese: 花園裡飛舞著各種顏色的蝴蝶，孩子們追著牠們跑，笑得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ fēiwǔ zhe gè zhǒng yánsè de húdié, háizimen zhuī zhe tāmen pǎo, xiào de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Butterflies of every color danced through the garden as the children chased them, laughing with delight.

semanticNote: 糊塗 — confused; muddled; befuddled; in a fog. 真糊塗！(So confused!/What a muddle!) Can describe a person who is habitually confused (他這個人很糊塗) or a temporary state (我最近太累了，腦子有點糊塗). Also 難得糊塗 (a famous calligraphy: 'It is hard to stay confused/carefree' — a Zen-like saying by 鄭板橋).

examples.chinese: 我最近工作太忙，腦子有點糊塗，竟然把會議時間記錯了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn gōngzuò tài máng, nǎozi yǒudiǎn hútu, jìngrán bǎ huìyì shíjiān jì cuò le.
examples.english: I've been so busy lately that my mind got muddled — I actually got the meeting time wrong.

examples.chinese: 這位老先生年紀大了，有時候會糊塗，說著說著就忘記自己在說什麼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo xiānsheng niánjì dà le, yǒushíhòu huì hútu, shuōzhe shuōzhe jiù wàngjì zìjǐ zài shuō shénme.
examples.english: This elderly gentleman is getting on in years and sometimes gets confused — mid-sentence he'll forget what he was saying.

semanticNote: 花 (flower; blossom) + 生 (grow; give birth) — peanut (lit. 'flower that grows underground'). A staple ingredient in Taiwanese cuisine: 花生湯 (peanut soup), 花生糖 (peanut brittle), 刈包 (gua bao with peanut powder). 花生醬 (peanut butter). Commonly found in traditional Taiwanese snacks and festive foods.

examples.chinese: 台南的花生湯是當地知名的早餐，用熟爛的花生加糖熬成，香甜濃郁。
examples.pinyin: Táinán de huāshēng tāng shì dāngdì zhīmíng de zǎocān, yòng shúlàn de huāshēng jiā táng áo chéng, xiāngtián nóngyù.
examples.english: Tainan's peanut soup is a well-known local breakfast — made by simmering soft peanuts with sugar until sweet and rich.

examples.chinese: 廟會時，攤販賣著熱騰騰的花生糖，香氣四溢，讓人忍不住駐足購買。
examples.pinyin: Miàohuì shí, tānfàn mài zhe rè téng téng de huāshēng táng, xiānqì sì yì, ràng rén rěn bú zhù zhùzú gòumǎi.
examples.english: At the temple festival, vendors sold steaming hot peanut brittle, its aroma drifting everywhere and drawing people to stop and buy.

semanticNote: Heteronym: (1) huà — to delimit, assign, or transfer (劃撥 transfer of funds; 劃定 delineate). (2) huá — to row or paddle (划船 row a boat); to scratch (划一根火柴 strike a match); to be worth it (合算/划算 cost-effective). In Taiwan: 划算 (huásuàn, worth the money) is very common colloquially.

examples.chinese: 週末去日月潭划船，湖面平靜，風景美得令人心曠神怡。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò qù Rìyuètán huáchuán, húmiàn píngjìng, fēngjǐng měi de lìng rén xīnkuàng shényí.
examples.english: Rowing a boat on Sun Moon Lake on the weekend — the lake surface was calm and the scenery breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.chinese: 這個套餐含早餐跟停車，真的很划算，比單獨訂房便宜多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tàocān hán zǎocān gēn tíngchē, zhēnde hěn huásuàn, bǐ dāndú dìng fáng piányí duō le.
examples.english: This package includes breakfast and parking — it's really worth it, much cheaper than booking the room alone.

semanticNote: 華 (Chinese; splendid) + 裔 (descendant; posterity) — a person of Chinese descent living outside China, i.e., an overseas Chinese. 台裔 (of Taiwanese descent), 華裔美國人 (Chinese-American). In Taiwan, 華裔 typically refers to ethnic Chinese living abroad, while 外省人 and 本省人 describe internal ethnic distinctions within Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 她是第二代華裔加拿大人，從小在多倫多長大，但一直保持著說中文的習慣。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì dì èr dài Huáyì Jiānádà rén, cóngxiǎo zài Duōlúnduō zhǎngdà, dàn yīzhí bǎochí zhe shuō zhōngwén de xíguàn.
examples.english: She is a second-generation Chinese-Canadian who grew up in Toronto but has always maintained the habit of speaking Chinese.

examples.chinese: 許多華裔科學家在半導體領域作出了重大貢獻，包括多位台灣出身的工程師。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō Huáyì kēxuéjiā zài bàndǎotǐ lǐngyù zuòchū le zhòngdà gòngxiàn, bāokuò duō wèi Táiwān chūshēn de gōngchéngshī.
examples.english: Many scientists of Chinese descent have made significant contributions to the semiconductor field, including several engineers of Taiwanese origin.

semanticNote: Slippery (of surfaces) or crafty/cunning (of people). 地板很滑 (the floor is slippery), 這個人很滑頭 (this person is slippery/crafty). Also: 滑雪 (ski), 滑冰 (ice skate), 滑板 (skateboard), 滑手機 (scroll through one's phone — a very common Taiwan colloquialism). 滑 in phone-scrolling context is a calque from 'swipe.'

examples.chinese: 下雨天地板很滑，請小心不要跌倒，可以換上防滑拖鞋。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ tiān dìbǎn hěn huá, qǐng xiǎoxīn bùyào diédǎo, kěyǐ huàn shàng fáng huá tuōxié.
examples.english: The floor is very slippery on rainy days — please be careful not to fall; you can put on non-slip slippers.

examples.chinese: 他一邊吃飯一邊滑手機，被媽媽罵了好幾次還是改不掉這個習慣。
examples.pinyin: Tā yībiān chīfàn yībiān huá shǒujī, bèi māma mà le hǎo jǐ cì hái shì gǎi bù diào zhège xíguàn.
examples.english: He scrolls through his phone while eating — his mom has scolded him many times but he still can't shake the habit.

semanticNote: 化 (transform; change) + 學 (study; science) — chemistry (the science). 化學反應 (chemical reaction), 化學品 (chemicals), 有機化學 (organic chemistry). Also used metaphorically for interpersonal compatibility: 兩個人很有化學反應 (the two of them have great chemistry). 化學系 is a common university department in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 高中化學課最讓他頭痛的是有機化合物的命名，背了很久都背不起來。
examples.pinyin: Gāozhōng huàxué kè zuì ràng tā tóutòng de shì yǒujī huàhéwù de mìngmíng, bèi le hěn jiǔ dōu bèi bù qǐlái.
examples.english: The most headache-inducing part of high school chemistry for him was naming organic compounds — he studied them for a long time but still couldn't memorize them.

examples.chinese: 這兩位演員在電影裡的化學反應非常自然，讓觀眾都信以為真。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng wèi yǎnyuán zài diànyǐng lǐ de huàxué fǎnyìng fēicháng zìrán, ràng guānzhòng dōu xìn yǐ wéi zhēn.
examples.english: The chemistry between these two actors in the film was completely natural, making audiences believe it was real.

semanticNote: 話 (speech; words) + 題 (topic; subject) — a conversation topic or talking point. 換個話題 (change the subject), 熱門話題 (hot topic), 引發話題 (spark conversation). In Taiwan social media culture, 話題性 (topic-worthiness; how much buzz something generates) is frequently discussed in entertainment and marketing contexts.

examples.chinese: 兩岸關係一直是台灣政治圈中最敏感也最熱門的話題之一。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng'àn guānxi yīzhí shì Táiwān zhèngzhì quān zhōng zuì mǐngǎn yě zuì rèmén de huàtí zhī yī.
examples.english: Cross-strait relations have always been one of the most sensitive and hotly discussed topics in Taiwan's political circles.

examples.chinese: 他故意把話題轉移到工作上，以避免繼續討論那個令他不舒服的問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā gùyì bǎ huàtí zhuǎnyí dào gōngzuò shàng, yǐ bìmiǎn jìxù tǎolùn nà gè lìng tā bù shūfú de wèntí.
examples.english: He deliberately steered the conversation to work to avoid continuing to discuss the topic that made him uncomfortable.

semanticNote: 懷 (hold in the heart; embrace) + 念 (think of; remember; recite) — to miss or cherish the memory of someone or something from the past. 懷念故鄉 (miss one's hometown), 令人懷念 (memorable; worth remembering fondly). More literary and emotionally warm than 想 (to miss/think of); implies a wistful fondness.

examples.chinese: 在海外工作多年，她最懷念的還是媽媽做的家常菜和路邊攤的臭豆腐。
examples.pinyin: Zài hǎiwài gōngzuò duō nián, tā zuì huáiniàn de háishì māma zuò de jiācháng cài hé lùbiān tān de chòudòufu.
examples.english: After years working abroad, what she missed most was still her mom's home cooking and the stinky tofu from street stalls.

examples.chinese: 老一輩的台灣人常常懷念早年夜市的純樸氣氛，覺得現在商業化太多了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo yī bèi de Táiwān rén chángcháng huáiniàn zǎonián yèshì de chúnpǔ qìfēn, juéde xiànzài shāngyèhuà tài duō le.
examples.english: Older Taiwanese often fondly recall the simple atmosphere of night markets in earlier years, feeling that everything is too commercialized now.

semanticNote: 懷 (carry in the womb; to be pregnant) + 孕 (pregnant; nurture in the womb) — to be pregnant; to have conceived. Both characters convey pregnancy, making the meaning doubly clear. 懷孕初期 (early pregnancy), 意外懷孕 (unintended pregnancy). In Taiwan, pregnant women receive a 孕婦手冊 (maternal health handbook) from the health department.

components.meaning: carry in the womb; cherish; embrace

examples.chinese: 她懷孕後，公司依法給予產假，並提供彈性工時讓她能按時去產檢。
examples.pinyin: Tā huáiyùn hòu, gōngsī yīfǎ gěiyǔ chǎnjià, bìng tígōng tánxìng gōngshí ràng tā néng ànshí qù chǎnjiǎn.
examples.english: After she became pregnant, the company provided maternity leave as required by law and offered flexible hours so she could attend prenatal checkups on time.

examples.chinese: 醫師告訴她懷孕期間要避免喝咖啡和酒精，並多補充葉酸。
examples.pinyin: Yīshī gàosù tā huáiyùn qījiān yào bìmiǎn hē kāfēi hé jiǔjīng, bìng duō bǔchōng yèsuān.
examples.english: The doctor told her to avoid coffee and alcohol during pregnancy and to supplement with plenty of folic acid.

semanticNote: 緩 (slow; relax; alleviate) + 解 (loosen; resolve; relieve) — to alleviate, ease, or relieve (pressure, pain, tension). 緩解疼痛 (relieve pain), 緩解壓力 (relieve stress), 緩解交通擁堵 (ease traffic congestion). More formal than 減輕 (reduce) and implies a gradual loosening rather than a complete solution.

examples.chinese: 運動是緩解工作壓力最有效的方式之一，下班後去跑步讓她舒服多了。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng shì huǎnjiě gōngzuò yālì zuì yǒuxiào de fāngshì zhī yī, xiàbān hòu qù pǎobù ràng tā shūfú duō le.
examples.english: Exercise is one of the most effective ways to relieve work stress — going for a run after work made her feel much better.

examples.chinese: 捷運系統的擴建大幅緩解了台北市的交通擁擠問題。
