examples.pinyin: Jié yùn xìtǒng de kuòjiàn dàfú huǎnjiě le Táiběi shì de jiāotōng yōngjǐ wèntí.
examples.english: The expansion of the MRT system has significantly eased traffic congestion problems in Taipei.

semanticNote: 幻 (illusion; fantasy; magical) + 想 (think; imagine) — fantasy, delusion, or daydreaming. Can be neutral (科幻 = science fiction) or negative (脫離現實的幻想 = unrealistic fantasy). 幻想曲 (fantasia in music). Slightly different from 夢想 (dream/aspiration) which is positive and achievable.

examples.chinese: 他從小就幻想有一天能成為太空人，在宇宙中自由漂浮。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù huànxiǎng yǒu yī tiān néng chéngwéi tàikōngrén, zài yǔzhòu zhōng zìyóu piāofú.
examples.english: Ever since childhood, he fantasized about becoming an astronaut one day, floating freely in space.

examples.chinese: 她清楚地知道那只是幻想，現實中兩個人根本不可能在一起。
examples.pinyin: Tā qīngchǔ de zhīdào nà zhǐ shì huànxiǎng, xiànshí zhōng liǎng gè rén gēnběn bù kěnéng zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: She knew clearly it was just a fantasy — in reality, the two of them could never be together.

semanticNote: 慌 (flustered; panicked) + 張 (open; spread; nervous) — flustered; nervous; in a flurry; panicked. Describes outward, visible agitation — shaky hands, rapid speech, forgetting things. 別慌張 (Don't panic!). Different from 緊張 (nervous but more internal/anticipatory); 慌張 implies a loss of composure that others can observe.

examples.chinese: 突然接到面試通知，他慌張得連領帶都打歪了才趕去應徵。
examples.pinyin: Tūrán jiēdào miànshì tōngzhī, tā huāngzhāng de lián lǐngdài dōu dǎ wāi le cái gǎn qù yìngzhēng.
examples.english: Receiving the interview notice suddenly, he was so flustered that he couldn't even get his tie straight before rushing off to apply.

examples.chinese: 遇到緊急狀況時，千萬不要慌張，冷靜地按照逃生指示行動最重要。
examples.pinyin: Yùdào jǐnjí zhuàngkuàng shí, qiānwàn bùyào huāngzhāng, lěngjìng de ànzhào táoshēng zhǐshì xíngdòng zuì zhòngyào.
examples.english: In an emergency, whatever you do, don't panic — the most important thing is to calmly follow the evacuation instructions.

semanticNote: 黃 (yellow) + 金 (gold; metal) — gold. Both literal (黃金價格 gold price; 黃金戒指 gold ring) and figurative (黃金時期 golden period; 黃金地段 prime location). In Taiwan: 黃金葛 (pothos plant, lit. 'golden vine'), 黃金週 (golden week holiday). 投資黃金 (invest in gold) is popular among Taiwanese savers.

examples.chinese: 全球經濟不穩定時，許多投資人選擇購買黃金作為避險資產。
examples.pinyin: Quánqiú jīngjì bù wěndìng shí, xǔduō tóuzī rén xuǎnzé gòumǎi huángjīn zuòwéi bìxiǎn zīchǎn.
examples.english: During periods of global economic instability, many investors choose to buy gold as a safe-haven asset.

examples.chinese: 台北市信義區是房地產的黃金地段，每坪的價格高得驚人。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi shì Xìnyì Qū shì fángdìchǎn de huángjīn dìduàn, měi píng de jiàgé gāo de jīngrén.
examples.english: Xinyi District in Taipei is the prime location for real estate, with per-ping prices that are astonishingly high.

semanticNote: 灰 — ash; dust; gray. As a noun: 煙灰 (cigarette ash), 石灰 (lime/calcium oxide). As an adj: 灰色 (gray color); also 灰心 (discouraged; lose heart). 灰色地帶 (gray area — legal or moral ambiguity) is commonly used in Taiwanese legal and political discourse. 塵灰 means dust.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫失敗後，心情非常灰暗，好幾天都提不起勁來做任何事。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shībài hòu, xīnqíng fēicháng huī'àn, hǎo jǐ tiān dōu tí bù qǐ jìn lái zuò rènhé shì.
examples.english: After his plan failed, his mood was very gloomy — for several days he couldn't muster the energy to do anything.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，整條街都覆蓋著厚厚的一層灰，居民忙著打掃清理。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, zhěng tiáo jiē dōu fùgài zhe hòuhòu de yī céng huī, jūmín máng zhe dǎsǎo qīnglǐ.
examples.english: After the typhoon, the entire street was covered in a thick layer of ash and dust, with residents busy cleaning up.

semanticNote: 灰 (ash; gray) + 塵 (dust; dirt) — dust; fine particulate matter. 滿是灰塵 (covered in dust), 除塵 (remove dust; dust a surface), 吸塵器 (vacuum cleaner). In Taiwan, PM2.5 air quality is closely monitored; 灰塵 in indoor contexts contrasts with 空氣汙染 (air pollution) outdoors.

examples.chinese: 打掃房間時，她把書架上積了好久的灰塵都擦乾淨了。
examples.pinyin: Dǎsǎo fángjiān shí, tā bǎ shūjià shàng jī le hǎo jiǔ de huīchén dōu cā gānjìng le.
examples.english: While cleaning the room, she wiped away all the dust that had accumulated on the bookshelf over a long time.

examples.chinese: 搬進新家後發現到處都是灰塵，大概是空置太久了。
examples.pinyin: Bānjìn xīnjiā hòu fāxiàn dàochù dōu shì huīchén, dàgài shì kōngzhì tài jiǔ le.
examples.english: After moving into the new home they found dust everywhere — probably because it had been vacant for too long.

semanticNote: 灰 (gray; ash; dim) + 心 (heart) — to lose heart; to be discouraged; despondent. 別灰心 (Don't lose heart!/Don't be discouraged!) is a common expression of encouragement. 灰心喪氣 (deflated and despondent — four-character idiom). Implies a dampening of enthusiasm or hope after a setback.

examples.chinese: 考試成績不理想，她感到很灰心，但老師鼓勵她繼續努力。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng, tā gǎndào hěn huīxīn, dàn lǎoshī gǔlì tā jìxù nǔlì.
examples.english: Disappointed with her exam results, she lost heart, but the teacher encouraged her to keep working hard.

examples.chinese: 創業初期屢屢碰壁，很多人會灰心放棄，但他選擇繼續堅持下去。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngyè chūqī lǚlǚ pèngbì, hěn duō rén huì huīxīn fàngqì, dàn tā xuǎnzé jìxù jiānchí xiàqù.
examples.english: Hitting walls repeatedly in the early stages of entrepreneurship, many people lose heart and give up — but he chose to keep going.

semanticNote: 揮 — to wave, brandish, or wield; to wipe away. 揮手 (wave a hand), 揮舞 (brandish; wave dramatically), 揮汗 (wipe away sweat), 揮霍 (squander money recklessly). In music, 揮棒/揮手 refers to a conductor's baton motion. The core image is a sweeping, outward motion of the arm.

components.meaning: wave; brandish; wield; wipe away; scatter

examples.chinese: 火車緩緩開走時，她站在月台上拼命揮手，目送朋友離開。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē huǎnhuǎn kāi zǒu shí, tā zhàn zài yuètái shàng pīnmìng huīshǒu, mùsòng péngyǒu líkāi.
examples.english: As the train slowly pulled away, she stood on the platform waving frantically, watching her friend leave.

examples.chinese: 指揮家揮動指揮棒，一百多名樂手立刻齊心演奏起來。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐhuījiā huīdòng zhǐhuī bàng, yī bǎi duō míng yuèshǒu lìkè qíxīn yǎnzòu qǐlái.
examples.english: The conductor waved the baton and over a hundred musicians immediately began playing in unison.

semanticNote: 恢 (large; restore) + 復 (return; restore; recover) — to recover, resume, or restore. 恢復健康 (recover one's health), 恢復正常 (return to normal), 恢復聯絡 (resume contact). Very versatile: used for physical recovery, restoration of a relationship, reinstatement of a policy, or returning to a prior state.

examples.chinese: 手術後她休養了將近三個月，才完全恢復到可以正常工作的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Shǒushù hòu tā xiūyǎng le jiāngjìn sān gè yuè, cái wánquán huīfù dào kěyǐ zhèngcháng gōngzuò de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: After the surgery she recuperated for nearly three months before fully recovering to the point of being able to work normally.

examples.chinese: 兩岸之間的直航航班在疫情後逐漸恢復，旅客人數也慢慢回升。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng'àn zhījiān de zhí háng hángbān zài yìqíng hòu zhújiàn huīfù, lǚkè rénshù yě mànmàn huí shēng.
examples.english: Direct flights across the strait gradually resumed after the pandemic, and passenger numbers slowly climbed back up.

semanticNote: 匯 (converge; exchange; remit) + 率 (rate; ratio) — exchange rate. 台幣兌美元匯率 (New Taiwan Dollar to USD exchange rate). The NTD (新台幣) is managed by the Central Bank of the ROC (中央銀行). 匯率波動 (exchange rate fluctuation) is a common topic in Taiwan's export-heavy economy.

examples.chinese: 最近台幣升值，匯率變動讓出口商的獲利大幅縮水。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn Táibì shēngzhí, huìlǜ biàndòng ràng chūkǒu shāng de huòlì dàfú suōshuǐ.
examples.english: The NT dollar has appreciated recently; the exchange rate movement has significantly shrunk exporters' profits.

examples.chinese: 出國前最好先查一下匯率，看看現在換外幣划不划算。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó qián zuìhǎo xiān chá yīxià huìlǜ, kàn kàn xiànzài huàn wàibì huá bù huásuàn.
examples.english: Before going abroad, it's best to check the exchange rate first and see whether it's worth exchanging currency now.

semanticNote: 婚 (marriage; wed) + 禮 (ceremony; rite; gift) — a wedding ceremony. In Taiwan, weddings often combine traditional customs (拜堂, 敬茶) with modern banquets (婚宴). 婚禮策劃 (wedding planner), 婚禮主持人 (wedding MC). Distinguish from 婚姻 (the institution of marriage) — 婚禮 is the event itself.

examples.chinese: 他們選在台南的古蹟建築舉辦婚禮，中西合璧的風格讓賓客印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen xuǎn zài Táinán de gǔjī jiànzhú jǔbàn hūnlǐ, zhōng xī hébì de fēnggé ràng bīnkè yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: They chose to hold their wedding at a historic building in Tainan; the blend of Chinese and Western style left a deep impression on guests.

examples.chinese: 婚禮結束後，新人向每桌賓客敬酒致謝，場面溫馨感人。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ jiéshù hòu, xīnrén xiàng měi zhuō bīnkè jìngjiǔ zhìxiè, chǎngmiàn wēnxīn gǎnrén.
examples.english: After the ceremony, the newlyweds toasted every table of guests in gratitude — the scene was warm and touching.

semanticNote: 婚 (wed; marriage) + 姻 (relatives by marriage; matrimony) — marriage as an institution or state of being. 婚姻關係 (marital relationship), 婚姻法 (marriage law), 婚姻平權 (marriage equality). In Taiwan, the Marriage Equality Act (2019) legalized same-sex marriage, making it a landmark in Asia.

examples.chinese: 台灣在2019年通過婚姻平權法案，保障了同性伴侶組成家庭的合法權利。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zài 2019 nián tōngguò hūnyīn píngquán fǎ'àn, bǎozhàng le tóngxìng bànlǚ zǔchéng jiātíng de héfǎ quánlì.
examples.english: Taiwan passed the Marriage Equality Act in 2019, guaranteeing the legal right of same-sex couples to form a family.

examples.chinese: 他們的婚姻已經維持了三十年，彼此尊重與包容是最重要的關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen de hūnyīn yǐjīng wéichí le sānshí nián, bǐcǐ zūnzhòng yǔ bāoróng shì zuì zhòngyào de guānjiàn.
examples.english: Their marriage has lasted thirty years; mutual respect and tolerance are the most important keys.

semanticNote: 活 (alive; lively) + 躍 (leap; jump; energetic) — active, vigorous, or lively. 活躍的市場 (active market), 社交活躍 (socially active), 活躍分子 (activist). As a verb: 他在社群媒體上很活躍 (He is very active on social media). Positive connotation of energetic participation.

examples.chinese: 她在學生社團中非常活躍，幾乎每個活動都少不了她的身影。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéshēng shètuán zhōng fēicháng huóyuè, jīhū měi gè huódòng dōu shǎo bù liǎo tā de shēnyǐng.
examples.english: She is extremely active in student clubs — her presence is seen at almost every event.

examples.chinese: 台灣的公民社會非常活躍，各種倡議團體定期舉辦論壇和遊行。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de gōngmín shèhuì fēicháng huóyuè, gè zhǒng chàngyì tuántǐ dìngqī jǔbàn lùntán hé yóuxíng.
examples.english: Taiwan's civil society is very active, with various advocacy groups regularly holding forums and marches.

semanticNote: 火 (fire) + 柴 (firewood; kindling) — a match (for lighting fire). 划火柴 (strike a match). In Taiwan, matches (火柴) have largely been replaced by lighters (打火機), but are still found and the word remains in common use. 火柴人 (stick figure, lit. 'match-man') is a common informal term.

examples.chinese: 停電時，她翻遍抽屜才找到一盒火柴，點燃蠟燭照明。
examples.pinyin: Tíngdiàn shí, tā fān biàn chōutì cái zhǎodào yī hé huǒchái, diǎnrán làzhú zhàomíng.
examples.english: During the power outage, she rummaged through all the drawers before finding a box of matches to light a candle.

examples.chinese: 野外露營時，火柴和打火機都是必備的工具，以備生火取暖之用。
examples.pinyin: Yěwài lùyíng shí, huǒchái hé dǎhuǒjī dōu shì bìbèi de gōngjù, yǐbèi shēnghuǒ qǔnuǎn zhī yòng.
examples.english: When camping outdoors, both matches and a lighter are essential tools to have on hand for lighting a fire to stay warm.

semanticNote: 伙 (group; partner; meal) + 伴 (companion; accompany) — a partner, companion, or buddy, especially in a shared activity. 合作伙伴 (business partner; partner organization), 旅行伙伴 (travel companion). More informal than 夥伴 but the same word; the simpler character 伙 is Taiwan standard. Implies shared endeavor.

examples.chinese: 他和大學時期的老伙伴一起創業，兩個人優劣互補，合作得很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé dàxué shíqī de lǎo huǒbàn yīqǐ chuàngyè, liǎng gè rén yōu liè hùbǔ, hézuò de hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: He started a business with his old partner from university days — the two complemented each other's strengths and weaknesses and collaborated happily.

examples.chinese: 企業在開拓東南亞市場時，找到可靠的在地伙伴非常關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè zài kāituò Dōngnányà shìchǎng shí, zhǎodào kěkào de zàidì huǒbàn fēicháng guānjiàn.
examples.english: When expanding into Southeast Asian markets, finding reliable local partners is absolutely critical for businesses.

semanticNote: 或 (or; perhaps) + 許 (permit; perhaps) — perhaps; maybe; possibly. More literary and softer than 也許 or 可能; often used to introduce a tentative idea or gently propose an alternative. 或許你是對的 (Perhaps you're right). Frequently appears in written Chinese and formal speech.

examples.chinese: 或許我當初應該選擇不同的路，但現在後悔也沒有用了。
examples.pinyin: Huòxǔ wǒ dāngchū yīnggāi xuǎnzé bùtóng de lù, dàn xiànzài hòuhuǐ yě méiyǒu yòng le.
examples.english: Perhaps I should have chosen a different path back then, but regretting it now is useless.

examples.chinese: 她沉默了很久，或許她根本不知道該如何回答這個問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā chénmò le hěn jiǔ, huòxǔ tā gēnběn bù zhīdào gāi rúhé huídá zhège wèntí.
examples.english: She was silent for a long time — perhaps she simply didn't know how to answer the question.

semanticNote: 機 (machine; opportunity) + 器 (vessel; instrument; device) — a machine or mechanical device. 機器人 (robot), 洗衣機 (washing machine), 機器學習 (machine learning). Broader than 設備 (equipment/facility). In Taiwan's precision machinery (精密機械) manufacturing sector, 機器 is central vocabulary.

examples.chinese: 工廠引進了最新型的自動化機器，大幅提升了生產效率。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng yǐnjìn le zuì xīn xíng de zìdònghuà jīqì, dàfú tíshēng le shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
examples.english: The factory introduced the latest automated machines, significantly improving production efficiency.

examples.chinese: AI技術的進步讓機器能夠識別圖像、理解語言，能力越來越接近人類。
examples.pinyin: AI jìshù de jìnbù ràng jīqì nénggòu shíbié túxiàng, lǐjiě yǔyán, nénglì yuè lái yuè jiējìn rénlèi.
examples.english: Advances in AI technology have enabled machines to recognize images and understand language, with capabilities increasingly approaching those of humans.

semanticNote: 肌 (flesh; muscle) + 肉 (meat; flesh; muscle) — muscle; muscular tissue. 鍛鍊肌肉 (build muscle), 肌肉疼痛 (muscle soreness — 痠痛 DOMS), 核心肌群 (core muscle group). 肌肉男 (muscular man — colloquial). Taiwan's fitness industry has boomed; 健身房 (gym) culture uses 肌肉 frequently.

examples.chinese: 他每天去健身房訓練，肌肉線條越來越明顯，體態也變得更好看。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān qù jiànshēn fáng xùnliàn, jīròu xiàntiáo yuè lái yuè míngxiǎn, tǐtài yě biàn de gèng hǎokàn.
examples.english: He trains at the gym every day; his muscle definition is becoming more and more pronounced and his physique looks better and better.

examples.chinese: 長跑之後肌肉非常痠痛，她用熱敷和伸展來幫助恢復。
examples.pinyin: Cháng pǎo zhīhòu jīròu fēicháng suāntòng, tā yòng rè fū hé shēnzhǎn lái bāngzhù huīfù.
examples.english: After the long run, her muscles were very sore; she used heat packs and stretching to help recover.

semanticNote: 基 (base; foundation) + 本 (root; origin; fundamental) — basic; fundamental; essentially. 基本上 (basically; in essence — extremely common adverb), 基本工資 (minimum wage), 基本人權 (basic human rights). 基本上沒問題 (basically no problem) is a ubiquitous hedge in spoken Taiwan Mandarin.

examples.chinese: 基本上這份合約的條件我都接受，只有一兩個細節想再討論一下。
examples.pinyin: Jīběnshàng zhè fèn héyuē de tiáojiàn wǒ dōu jiēshòu, zhǐyǒu yī liǎng gè xìjié xiǎng zài tǎolùn yīxià.
examples.english: Basically I accept the terms of this contract; there are just one or two details I'd like to discuss further.

examples.chinese: 政府決定調高基本工資，希望改善低薪勞工的生活水準。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng tiáo gāo jīběn gōngzī, xīwàng gǎishàn dī xīn láogōng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn.
examples.english: The government decided to raise the minimum wage, hoping to improve the living standards of low-income workers.

semanticNote: 激 (stir up; arouse; sharp; drastic) + 烈 (fierce; intense; burning; brave) — intense, fierce, or sharp (of competition, argument, combat). 競爭激烈 (fierce competition), 激烈辯論 (heated debate), 激烈運動 (strenuous exercise). Always implies a high degree of energy or intensity; can be used for positive or negative situations.

components.meaning: stir up; arouse; sharp; drastic; stimulate

examples.chinese: 台灣的大學聯考競爭非常激烈，許多學生從高一就開始密集備考。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de dàxué liánkǎo jìngzhēng fēicháng jīliè, xǔduō xuéshēng cóng gāo yī jiù kāishǐ mìjí bèi kǎo.
examples.english: Competition for Taiwan's university entrance exams is extremely fierce; many students begin intensive preparation from their first year of senior high school.

examples.chinese: 兩隊在決賽中打得非常激烈，最終在加時賽中才分出勝負。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng duì zài juésài zhōng dǎ de fēicháng jīliè, zuìzhōng zài jiāshí sài zhōng cái fēn chū shèngfù.
examples.english: The two teams played fiercely in the final, with the winner only decided in extra time.

semanticNote: 及 (reach; attain) + 格 (standard; grid; status) — to pass (an exam or test); to meet the required standard. In Taiwan, the passing grade (及格分數) is typically 60 out of 100. 不及格 (fail to pass). 勉強及格 (barely pass). This is a result verb — there's no progressive form; you either 及格 or 不及格.

examples.chinese: 他數學考了59分，差一分就及格，只能參加補考。
examples.pinyin: Tā shùxué kǎo le 59 fēn, chà yī fēn jiù jígé, zhǐ néng cānjiā bǔkǎo.
examples.english: He scored 59 in math — one point short of passing — so he had to take the makeup exam.

examples.chinese: 這次的體能測驗不及格的同學必須在課後留下來補測。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de tǐnéng cèyàn bù jígé de tóngxué bìxū zài kè hòu liú xiàlái bǔ cè.
examples.english: Students who didn't pass this physical fitness test must stay after class to retake it.

semanticNote: 極 (extreme; pole; utmost) + 其 (its; that) — extremely; exceedingly. Stronger than 很 (very) and 非常 (very/extremely); closer to 'utterly' or 'in the extreme.' 極其複雜 (extremely complex), 極其罕見 (exceedingly rare). More formal and written than 超 (super) in Taiwan slang.

examples.chinese: 這項任務難度極其高，需要同時具備技術、資金與人脈三方面的資源。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng rènwu nándù jíqí gāo, xūyào tóngshí jùbèi jìshù, zījīn yǔ rénmài sān fāngmiàn de zīyuán.
examples.english: This task is extremely difficult, requiring simultaneous access to resources in three areas: technology, funding, and connections.

examples.chinese: 這起事件極其罕見，是台灣有史以來規模最大的網路安全漏洞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shìjiàn jíqí hǎnjiàn, shì Táiwān yǒushǐ yǐlái guīmó zuì dà de wǎnglù ānquán lòudòng.
examples.english: This incident was exceedingly rare — the largest cybersecurity breach in Taiwan's history.

semanticNote: 急 (urgent; hasty) + 忙 (busy; hurried) — hastily; in a hurry; rushing. 急忙趕去 (rush over in a hurry). Implies both urgency and busyness — the person is moving fast because something demands immediate attention. Very similar to 匆忙 (hurriedly) but slightly more emphatic on the sense of urgency.

examples.chinese: 她一接到媽媽昏倒的消息，就急忙放下工作趕去醫院。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī jiēdào māma hūndǎo de xiāoxi, jiù jímáng fàngxià gōngzuò gǎn qù yīyuàn.
examples.english: The moment she heard that her mother had fainted, she hastily dropped her work and rushed to the hospital.

examples.chinese: 公車快到站了，他急忙拿起背包跑向前面的車門。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchē kuài dào zhàn le, tā jímáng ná qǐ bēibāo pǎo xiàng qiánmiàn de chē mén.
examples.english: The bus was about to reach the stop, so he hastily grabbed his backpack and ran toward the front door.

semanticNote: 急 (urgent) + 診 (examine medically; consult a doctor) — emergency medical treatment; the ER (emergency room). 掛急診 (go to the ER; present at the emergency department), 急診室 (emergency room). In Taiwan, the NHI (全民健保) system covers ER visits; 急診 is distinct from 門診 (outpatient clinic).

examples.chinese: 深夜突然發高燒，她只好去掛急診，等了快兩個小時才輪到她。
examples.pinyin: Shēnyè tūrán fā gāoshāo, tā zhǐhǎo qù guà jízhěn, děng le kuài liǎng gè xiǎoshí cái lún dào tā.
examples.english: She suddenly ran a high fever in the middle of the night and had no choice but to go to the ER, waiting nearly two hours for her turn.

examples.chinese: 急診室在週末假日往往人滿為患，醫護人員的工作壓力非常大。
examples.pinyin: Jízhěn shì zài zhōumò jiārì wǎngwǎng rén mǎn wéi huàn, yīhù rényuán de gōngzuò yālì fēicháng dà.
examples.english: Emergency rooms are often overwhelmed on weekends and holidays, putting enormous pressure on medical staff.

semanticNote: 集 (gather; collect) + 合 (combine; join; together) — to assemble, gather, or muster. Used both in everyday contexts (集合出發 gather before departing) and in mathematical usage (集合 = a set in set theory). In military and school contexts: 全體集合！(All assemble!). 集合點 (meeting point; rally point).

examples.chinese: 導遊告訴大家八點整在大廳集合，不要遲到，否則行程會來不及。
examples.pinyin: Dǎoyóu gàosù dàjiā bā diǎn zhěng zài dàtīng jíhé, bùyào chídào, fǒuzé xíngchéng huì lái bù jí.
examples.english: The tour guide told everyone to assemble in the lobby at eight o'clock sharp — don't be late or the itinerary will fall behind.

examples.chinese: 這次活動集合了來自全台各地的青年創業家，共同分享創業經驗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng jíhé le láizì quán Tái gèdì de qīngnián chuàngyèjiā, gòngtóng fēnxiǎng chuàngyè jīngyàn.
examples.english: This event brought together young entrepreneurs from all over Taiwan to share their startup experiences.

semanticNote: 集 (gather; collective) + 體 (body; form; system) — a collective, group, or community acting as one unit. 集體利益 (collective interest), 集體行動 (collective action), 集體記憶 (collective memory). In Taiwan, 集體記憶 is frequently discussed in relation to shared historical experiences of the Taiwanese people.

examples.chinese: 白色恐怖時期的歷史是台灣人集體記憶的一部分，影響了整個社會。
examples.pinyin: Báisè kǒngbù shíqī de lìshǐ shì Táiwān rén jítǐ jìyì de yī bùfèn, yǐngxiǎng le zhěnggè shèhuì.
examples.english: The history of the White Terror era is part of Taiwan's collective memory and has shaped the entire society.

examples.chinese: 工會號召全體員工採取集體行動，向資方爭取更好的薪資待遇。
examples.pinyin: Gōnghuì hàozhào quántǐ yuángōng cǎiqǔ jítǐ xíngdòng, xiàng zīfāng zhēngqǔ gèng hǎo de xīnzī dàiyù.
examples.english: The union called on all employees to take collective action to negotiate better wages and benefits with management.

semanticNote: 集 (gather; collect) + 中 (center; middle) — to concentrate, focus, or centralize. 集中注意力 (focus one's attention), 集中資源 (concentrate resources), 集中管理 (centralized management). As an adj: 集中式 (centralized). The opposite is 分散 (scattered; dispersed). Very common in academic, military, and business usage.

components.meaning: center; middle; in the middle of

examples.chinese: 考前一週，她把所有心力集中在最重要的幾個章節上，不分心做其他事。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo qián yī zhōu, tā bǎ suǒyǒu xīnlì jízhōng zài zuì zhòngyào de jǐ gè zhāngjiē shàng, bù fēn xīn zuò qítā shì.
examples.english: In the week before the exam, she concentrated all her energy on the most important chapters and didn't let herself get distracted.

examples.chinese: 新竹科學園區集中了台灣最多的高科技企業，是名副其實的矽谷。
examples.pinyin: Xīnzhú Kēxué Yuánqū jízhōng le Táiwān zuìduō de gāo kējì qǐyè, shì míngfùqíshí de Guī Gǔ.
examples.english: Hsinchu Science Park concentrates the most high-tech companies in Taiwan — a true Silicon Valley in its own right.

semanticNote: 計 (count; plan; calculate) + 算 (calculate; count; consider; plan) — to calculate, compute, or reckon. 計算機 (calculator; in Taiwan also used for computer, though 電腦 is standard). 計算能力 (computational ability). Also figurative: 他很會計算 (He is calculating/strategic). 計算式 (calculation formula).

examples.chinese: 她在腦中快速計算了一下，估計這趟旅行的總費用大約是三萬台幣。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài nǎo zhōng kuàisù jìsuàn le yīxià, gūjì zhè tàng lǚxíng de zǒng fèiyòng dàyuē shì sān wàn Táibì.
examples.english: She quickly calculated in her head, estimating the total cost of the trip at around NT$30,000.

examples.chinese: 量子電腦的計算速度遠遠超過傳統電腦，能解決過去無法處理的問題。
examples.pinyin: Liàngzǐ diànnǎo de jìsuàn sùdù yuǎnyuǎn chāoguò chuántǒng diànnǎo, néng jiějué guòqù wúfǎ chǔlǐ de wèntí.
examples.english: Quantum computers operate at speeds far beyond traditional computers, capable of solving problems that were previously intractable.

semanticNote: 記 (remember; record; mark) + 錄 (record; copy; register) — to record (as a verb); a record or log (as a noun). 記錄片 (documentary film), 記錄員 (recorder; clerk), 會議記錄 (meeting minutes). Distinct from 紀錄 (ID 2846), which specifically refers to a record or achievement (e.g., 打破紀錄 break a record).

examples.chinese: 她負責把這次會議的重點討論記錄下來，之後整理成書面報告。
examples.pinyin: Tā fùzé bǎ zhè cì huìyì de zhòngdiǎn tǎolùn jìlù xiàlái, zhīhòu zhěnglǐ chéng shūmiàn bàogào.
examples.english: She was responsible for recording the key discussions of this meeting and later organizing them into a written report.

examples.chinese: 這部記錄片真實呈現了台灣原住民族的文化傳承與困境，令人深思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zhēnshí chéngxiàn le Táiwān yuánzhùmínzú de wénhuà chuánchéng yǔ kùnjìng, lìng rén shēnsī.
examples.english: This documentary authentically portrays the cultural inheritance and challenges facing Taiwan's indigenous peoples, offering much to reflect on.

semanticNote: 記 (remember; record) + 憶 (recall; recollect) — memory; to remember. 記憶力 (memory ability/capacity), 短期記憶 (short-term memory), 記憶猶新 (the memory is still fresh). 集體記憶 (collective memory). 記憶卡 (memory card). As a verb: 我記憶得很清楚 (I remember it clearly).

examples.chinese: 阿嬤雖然年紀大了，但對年輕時發生的事情記憶力依然驚人地清晰。
examples.pinyin: Āmā suīrán niánjì dà le, dàn duì niánqīng shí fāshēng de shìqíng jìyìlì yīrán jīngrén de qīngxī.
examples.english: Although grandma is getting on in years, her memory of things that happened in her youth remains astonishingly clear.

examples.chinese: 那段在台東衝浪的時光讓她記憶猶新，每次看到海浪就會想起來。
examples.pinyin: Nà duàn zài Táidōng chōnglàng de shíguāng ràng tā jìyì yóuxīn, měi cì kàndào hǎilàng jiù huì xiǎng qǐlái.
examples.english: Those days surfing in Taitung remain vivid in her memory — whenever she sees ocean waves, the memories come flooding back.

semanticNote: 紀 (discipline; chronicle; age) + 錄 (record) — a record or achievement, especially a record in sports or data. 打破紀錄 (break a record), 世界紀錄 (world record), 歷史紀錄 (historical record). Distinguished from 記錄 (ID 2844) which means 'to record/document'; 紀錄 emphasizes achievement or chronicle. Both are pronounced jìlù.

examples.chinese: 她在全國運動會上打破了女子百米的紀錄，成為全台灣最快的女性跑者。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài quánguó yùndònghuì shàng dǎpò le nǚzǐ bǎimǐ de jìlù, chéngwéi quán Táiwān zuì kuài de nǚxìng pǎozhě.
examples.english: She broke the women's 100-meter record at the National Games, becoming the fastest female runner in all of Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 今年五月台灣的氣溫創下歷史紀錄，連續多天超過攝氏三十八度。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián wǔ yuè Táiwān de qìwēn chuàng xià lìshǐ jìlù, liánxù duō tiān chāoguò shèshì sānshíbā dù.
examples.english: Taiwan's temperatures set a historical record this May, exceeding 38°C for multiple consecutive days.

semanticNote: 紀 (discipline; law; chronicle) + 律 (law; rule; rhythm) — discipline; rules of conduct; organizational regulations. 遵守紀律 (observe discipline), 違反紀律 (violate discipline), 黨紀 (party discipline). More formal and institutional than 規矩 (social convention). In Taiwan schools, 班規 (class rules) is the everyday version.

examples.chinese: 軍人必須嚴格遵守紀律，服從命令是基本的職業要求。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén bìxū yángé zūnshǒu jìlǜ, fúcóng mìnglìng shì jīběn de zhíyè yāoqiú.
examples.english: Soldiers must strictly observe discipline; obeying orders is a fundamental professional requirement.

examples.chinese: 這位教練以嚴格的訓練紀律著稱，但他帶出的球隊成績也始終名列前茅。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoliàn yǐ yángé de xùnliàn jìlǜ zhùchēng, dàn tā dài chū de qiúduì chéngjì yě shǐzhōng míngliè qiánmáo.
examples.english: This coach is known for strict training discipline, but the teams he develops always consistently rank at the top.

semanticNote: 紀 (chronicle; record; mark) + 念 (think of; remember) — to commemorate; a commemoration or keepsake. 紀念碑 (memorial/monument), 紀念品 (souvenir; memento), 紀念日 (anniversary; commemoration day). 合影留念 (take a commemorative photo). In Taiwan: 二二八紀念日 (February 28 Memorial Day) is a national holiday.

examples.chinese: 二二八紀念日是台灣的國定假日，全國以各種活動紀念歷史上的悲劇。
examples.pinyin: Èr'èrbā jìniàn rì shì Táiwān de guódìng jiàrì, quánguó yǐ gèzhǒng huódòng jìniàn lìshǐ shàng de bēijù.
examples.english: February 28th Memorial Day is a national holiday in Taiwan; the whole country marks the historical tragedy with various events.

examples.chinese: 她從九份帶回了一個手工陶瓷小碗作為紀念品，放在書桌上留念。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng Jiǔfèn dài huí le yī gè shǒugōng táocí xiǎo wǎn zuòwéi jìniànpǐn, fàng zài shūzhuō shàng liúniàn.
examples.english: She brought back a handmade ceramic bowl from Jiufen as a souvenir, placing it on her desk as a keepsake.

semanticNote: 繫 (tie; fasten; jì) + 領帶 (necktie) — to tie a necktie. Note: the character 系 here is 繫 (tie, fasten), read jì, not xì (the department/system sense). 打領帶 is the more common Taiwan colloquial alternative. 領帶夾 (tie clip). Formal dress in Taiwan workplaces: men in office settings typically wear ties for presentations and important meetings.

examples.chinese: 他第一次參加正式場合，對著鏡子練習了很久才學會怎麼繫領帶。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì cānjiā zhèngshì chǎnghé, duì zhe jìngzi liànxí le hěn jiǔ cái xuéhuì zěnme jì lǐngdài.
examples.english: Attending a formal occasion for the first time, he practiced in front of the mirror for a long time before learning how to tie a necktie.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上花十分鐘繫好領帶，整理好儀容才出門上班。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang huā shí fēnzhōng jì hǎo lǐngdài, zhěnglǐ hǎo yíróng cái chūmén shàngbān.
examples.english: Dad spends ten minutes every morning tying his tie and getting his appearance in order before heading out to work.

semanticNote: 寂 (silent; still; lonely) + 寞 (desolate; lonely) — lonely; lonesome. 感到寂寞 (feel lonely). Distinguished from 孤獨 (solitary; alone — can be chosen and positive) and 孤單 (alone and helpless). 寂寞 specifically implies an emotional state of longing for company or connection. 耐不住寂寞 (can't stand the loneliness).

examples.chinese: 一個人住在異鄉，逢年過節總是特別寂寞，思念家人的心情難以言表。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè rén zhù zài yìxiāng, féng nián guò jié zǒng shì tèbié jìmò, sīniàn jiārén de xīnqíng nányǐ yán biǎo.
examples.english: Living alone in a foreign place, she always felt especially lonely during festivals and holidays — the longing for family was beyond words.

examples.chinese: 他雖然朋友很多，但在熱鬧的聚會中有時卻感到一種莫名的寂寞。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán péngyǒu hěn duō, dàn zài rènào de jùhuì zhōng yǒushí què gǎndào yī zhǒng mòmíng de jìmò.
examples.english: Though he had many friends, he sometimes felt an inexplicable loneliness even in the midst of lively gatherings.

semanticNote: 夾 (clamp; pinch; sandwich) + 子 (noun suffix) — a clip, clamp, tongs, or folder. Context distinguishes: 髮夾 (hair clip), 迴紋針夾 (binder clip), 資料夾 (document folder — also means a computer folder). 夾子 alone often implies a small clipping device. 筷子夾 (chopstick clip). Very common in office and kitchen contexts.

examples.chinese: 她用夾子把一疊收據夾好，放進資料夾裡等待月底對帳。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng jiāzi bǎ yī dié shōujù jiā hǎo, fàng jìn zīliàojiā lǐ děngdài yuèdǐ duì zhàng.
examples.english: She clipped a stack of receipts together with a clip, filed them in a folder, and waited for the end-of-month reconciliation.

examples.chinese: 媽媽拿起夾子從滾燙的鍋裡把玉米取出來，放在盤子上。
examples.pinyin: Māma ná qǐ jiāzi cóng gǔntàng de guō lǐ bǎ yùmǐ qǔ chūlái, fàng zài pánzi shàng.
examples.english: Mom picked up the tongs and lifted the corn out of the boiling pot, placing it on a plate.

semanticNote: 家 (home; family) + 庭 (courtyard; court; family) — family; household. 家庭主婦 (housewife), 家庭作業 (homework), 家庭暴力 (domestic violence). Slightly more formal than 家 alone; 家庭 emphasizes the institution or unit of family rather than the physical home. 雙薪家庭 (dual-income family) is common in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣現代家庭結構改變了很多，獨居或單親家庭的比例逐年上升。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàndài jiātíng jiégòu gǎibiàn le hěn duō, dú jū huò dānqīn jiātíng de bǐlì zhúnián shàngshēng.
examples.english: The structure of modern families in Taiwan has changed a great deal, with the proportion of single-person or single-parent households rising year by year.

examples.chinese: 她從小在一個充滿愛的家庭中長大，這讓她對未來充滿了信心。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo zài yī gè chōngmǎn ài de jiātíng zhōng zhǎngdà, zhè ràng tā duì wèilái chōngmǎn le xìnxīn.
examples.english: She grew up in a loving family, and this filled her with confidence about the future.

semanticNote: 家 (home) + 務 (affairs; duties; service) — household chores or domestic duties. 做家務 (do chores), 分擔家務 (share household responsibilities). In Taiwan, the unequal distribution of household labor (家務分工) is a frequently discussed gender equality issue. 家務勞動 (domestic labor — in academic/feminist contexts).

examples.chinese: 他們夫妻兩人都有全職工作，所以平等分擔家務，沒有誰應該多做的問題。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen fūqī liǎng rén dōu yǒu quánzhí gōngzuò, suǒyǐ píngděng fēndān jiāwù, méiyǒu shéi yīnggāi duō zuò de wèntí.
examples.english: Both husband and wife hold full-time jobs, so they share household chores equally — there's no question of who should do more.

examples.chinese: 暑假期間，媽媽讓孩子們輪流承擔一些基本家務，培養生活自理能力。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià qījiān, māma ràng háizimen lúnliú chéngdān yīxiē jīběn jiāwù, péiyǎng shēnghuó zìlǐ nénglì.
examples.english: During summer vacation, mom had the children take turns handling basic chores to develop their self-care abilities.

semanticNote: 家 (home) + 鄉 (countryside; hometown; native place) — one's hometown or native place. 思念家鄉 (miss one's hometown), 回鄉 (return to one's hometown). In Taiwan, the concept of 故鄉 (homeland) carries deep emotional weight, especially for families whose ancestors moved from different parts of China or within Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 她在台北工作多年，但一到春節就迫不及待地搭高鐵回到台南的家鄉。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Táiběi gōngzuò duō nián, dàn yī dào Chūnjié jiù pòbùjídài de dā gāotiě huídào Táinán de jiāxiāng.
examples.english: She has worked in Taipei for years, but as soon as the Lunar New Year comes, she can't wait to take the high-speed rail back to her hometown in Tainan.

examples.chinese: 許多在海外工作的台灣人，心中對家鄉始終有一種難以割捨的牽掛。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō zài hǎiwài gōngzuò de Táiwān rén, xīn zhōng duì jiāxiāng shǐzhōng yǒu yī zhǒng nányǐ gēshě de qiānguà.
examples.english: Many Taiwanese working abroad always carry in their hearts an inseparable attachment to their hometown.

semanticNote: 嘉 (excellent; praise; fine) + 賓 (guest; visitor) — an honored or distinguished guest. Common in formal events, TV programs, and ceremonies. 特別嘉賓 (special guest), 節目嘉賓 (show guest). Used in both written invitations and spoken MC announcements. More elevated than 貴賓 (VIP guest) in media contexts.

examples.chinese: 今晚的頒獎典禮邀請了多位影視界的知名嘉賓，現場座無虛席。
examples.pinyin: Jīn wǎn de bānjiǎng diǎnlǐ yāoqǐng le duō wèi yǐngshì jiè de zhīmíng jiābīn, xiànchǎng zuò wú xūxí.
examples.english: Tonight's award ceremony invited several well-known guests from the film and television industry; the venue was packed to capacity.

examples.chinese: 主持人介紹這位特別嘉賓時，台下響起了熱烈的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔchírén jièshào zhè wèi tèbié jiābīn shí, tái xià xiǎng qǐ le rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When the host introduced this special guest, the audience broke into warm applause.

semanticNote: The first of the Ten Heavenly Stems (天干); by extension: first, Class A, top-ranked. 甲等 (Grade A), 甲組 (Group A), 甲骨文 (oracle bone script — lit. 'shell-bone script'). As a measure word: 一甲地 (one jiǎ of land, a traditional Taiwanese land unit = 0.97 hectares). Also means armor (盔甲) and fingernail/toenail (指甲).

components.meaning: first; Class A; armor; shell; nail; Heavenly Stem 1

examples.chinese: 這位選手在全國大賽中獲得甲等獎，是今年成績最優秀的運動員。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuǎnshǒu zài quánguó dàsài zhōng huòdé jiǎděng jiǎng, shì jīnnián chéngjì zuì yōuxiù de yùndòngyuán.
examples.english: This athlete won a Grade-A award at the national competition — the top performer this year.

examples.chinese: 她的指甲留得很長，每兩個星期就會去做一次美甲護理。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhǐjiǎ liú de hěn cháng, měi liǎng gè xīngqī jiù huì qù zuò yī cì měijiǎ hùlǐ.
examples.english: She keeps her nails long and gets a manicure treatment once every two weeks.

semanticNote: 假 (suppose; fake; if) + 如 (like; as if; if) — if; supposing; in case. Introduces a hypothetical condition in the same way as 如果 and 要是, but slightly more formal. 假如有一天... (If one day...). Often appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause. Interchangeable with 假設 (hypothesis) in informal use but 假設 is more academic.

components.meaning: like; as if; if; according to

examples.chinese: 假如明天下雨，我們就把戶外的烤肉活動改到室內舉行。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bǎ hùwài de kǎoròu huódòng gǎi dào shìnèi jǔxíng.
examples.english: If it rains tomorrow, we'll move the outdoor barbecue indoors.

examples.chinese: 假如當初她選擇不同的科系，現在的生活一定會完全不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú dāngchū tā xuǎnzé bùtóng de kēxì, xiànzài de shēnghuó yīdìng huì wánquán bù yīyàng.
examples.english: If she had chosen a different major back then, her life today would certainly be completely different.

semanticNote: 假 (suppose; hypothetical) + 設 (set up; suppose; plan) — to hypothesize; a hypothesis or assumption. 假設我們有無限的資源... (Supposing we had unlimited resources...). 科學假設 (scientific hypothesis). As a conjunction, functions similarly to 假如 but with a more analytical tone. 前提假設 (underlying assumption).

examples.chinese: 老師要求同學針對「假設政府明天宣布免費大學教育」這個題目進行辯論。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú tóngxué zhēnduì 'jiǎshè zhèngfǔ míngtiān xuānbù miǎnfèi dàxué jiàoyù' zhège tímù jìnxíng biànlùn.
examples.english: The teacher asked students to debate on the topic: 'Suppose the government announced free university education tomorrow.'

examples.chinese: 這個實驗的核心假設是：減少糖分攝取可以有效改善代謝症候群。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíyàn de héxīn jiǎshè shì: jiǎnshǎo táng fèn shèqǔ kěyǐ yǒuxiào gǎishàn dàixiè zhènghòuqún.
examples.english: The core hypothesis of this experiment is that reducing sugar intake can effectively improve metabolic syndrome.

semanticNote: 假 (fake; pretend) + 裝 (dress up; pretend; install) — to pretend; to feign; to put on an act. 假裝睡著 (pretend to be asleep), 假裝不知道 (pretend not to know). Common in both literal and figurative senses. More colloquial alternatives in Taiwan: 裝作 or 裝 alone. 別假裝了！(Stop pretending!)

examples.chinese: 她假裝沒看到那條訊息，其實早就讀了好幾遍了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎzhuāng méi kàndào nà tiáo xùnxi, qíshí zǎo jiù dú le hǎo jǐ biàn le.
examples.english: She pretended not to have seen that message, but had actually already read it several times.

examples.chinese: 孩子假裝生病不想去上學，但媽媽一眼就看穿了他的小把戲。
examples.pinyin: Háizi jiǎzhuāng shēngbìng bù xiǎng qù shàngxué, dàn māma yī yǎn jiù kànchuān le tā de xiǎo bǎxì.
examples.english: The child pretended to be sick to avoid going to school, but mom saw through his little trick immediately.

semanticNote: 價 (price; value) + 值 (value; worth; be worth) — value; worth. 有價值 (valuable; worthwhile), 價值觀 (value system; values), 使用價值 (use value), 市場價值 (market value). 核心價值 (core values) is central in Taiwanese democratic discourse: 民主、自由、人權 are often cited as Taiwan's core values.

components.meaning: value; worth; be on duty; equal to

examples.chinese: 民主、自由和人權是台灣社會普遍認可的核心價值。
examples.pinyin: Mínzhǔ, zìyóu hé rénquán shì Táiwān shèhuì pǔbiàn rènkě de héxīn jiàzhí.
examples.english: Democracy, freedom, and human rights are core values universally recognized by Taiwanese society.

examples.chinese: 這幅畫現在的市場價值是當初購入價格的十倍以上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà xiànzài de shìchǎng jiàzhí shì dāngchū gòurù jiàgé de shí bèi yǐshàng.
examples.english: The current market value of this painting is more than ten times the price it was originally purchased for.

semanticNote: 駕 (drive; ride; harness; Your Majesty) + 駛 (drive; speed) — to drive (a vehicle) or pilot (a plane, ship). 駕駛執照 (driver's license — 駕照 for short), 駕駛座 (driver's seat), 飲酒駕車 (drunk driving — 酒駕 for short). In Taiwan, passing the 路考 (road test) is required to obtain 機車 (scooter) or 汽車 (car) licenses.

examples.chinese: 他剛拿到駕照，技術還不熟練，高速公路先不敢去開。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng ná dào jiàzhào, jìshù hái bù shúliàn, gāosù gōnglù xiān bù gǎn qù kāi.
examples.english: He just got his driver's license and isn't yet skilled — he doesn't dare drive on the freeway just yet.

examples.chinese: 台灣的酒駕罰則相當嚴格，初犯就可能被吊銷駕照並面臨刑事責任。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de jiǔjià fázé xiāngdāng yángé, chū fàn jiù kěnéng bèi diàoxiāo jiàzhào bìng miànlín xíngshì zérèn.
examples.english: Taiwan's penalties for drunk driving are quite strict — even a first offense can result in license revocation and criminal liability.

semanticNote: 嫁 — (of a woman) to marry; to take a husband. Paired with 娶 (of a man, to take a wife). 出嫁 (get married — said of the bride), 嫁人 (marry a man), 嫁雞隨雞 (once married, follow your husband — traditional saying). In Taiwan, gender-neutral alternatives like 結婚 are increasingly preferred in everyday speech.

components.meaning: marry (of a woman); give in marriage

examples.chinese: 她三十五歲才嫁人，但她覺得找到對的人比年齡更重要。
examples.pinyin: Tā sānshíwǔ suì cái jià rén, dàn tā juéde zhǎodào duì de rén bǐ niánlíng gèng zhòngyào.
examples.english: She didn't marry until she was thirty-five, but she believed that finding the right person mattered more than age.

examples.chinese: 媽媽希望她能嫁個體貼的人，讓她一生幸福快樂。
examples.pinyin: Māma xīwàng tā néng jià gè tītiē de rén, ràng tā yīshēng xìngfú kuàilè.
examples.english: Mom hoped she would marry a thoughtful and caring person who would make her happy for the rest of her life.

semanticNote: 堅 (firm; hard; solid) + 決 (decide; determined; burst) — resolute; determined; firm in decision. 堅決反對 (firmly oppose), 態度堅決 (resolute attitude). Implies no room for negotiation or change of heart. More forceful than 堅持 (persist); 堅決 is about the firmness of a stance, not just continuing an action.

examples.chinese: 她堅決拒絕了那份薪水低、工時長的工作邀約，寧可繼續找更好的機會。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiānjué jùjué le nà fèn xīnshuǐ dī, gōngshí cháng de gōngzuò yāoyuē, nìngkě jìxù zhǎo gèng hǎo de jīhuì.
examples.english: She firmly declined the job offer with low pay and long hours, preferring to keep looking for something better.

examples.chinese: 政府堅決反對任何破壞台海和平穩定的單方面行動。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiānjué fǎnduì rènhé pòhuài Táihǎi hépíng wěndìng de dānfāngmiàn xíngdòng.
examples.english: The government firmly opposes any unilateral actions that would undermine peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait.

semanticNote: 堅 (firm; solid; steadfast) + 強 (strong; powerful) — strong; staunch; resilient. 性格堅強 (strong character), 堅強的意志 (steely willpower). Has an emotional and moral dimension beyond mere physical strength — implies mental fortitude in the face of hardship. Often used as encouragement: 要堅強！(Stay strong!)

examples.chinese: 她在失去親人後仍然展現出堅強的一面，讓身邊的人都非常佩服。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shīqù qīnrén hòu réngrán zhǎnxiàn chū jiānqiáng de yīmiàn, ràng shēnbiān de rén dōu fēicháng pèifú.
examples.english: Even after losing a loved one, she showed her strong side, earning the deep admiration of everyone around her.

examples.chinese: 孩子，你要堅強，爸爸媽媽永遠都在你身邊支持你。
examples.pinyin: Háizi, nǐ yào jiānqiáng, bàba māma yǒngyuǎn dōu zài nǐ shēnbiān zhīchí nǐ.
examples.english: Be strong, child — mom and dad will always be here by your side supporting you.

semanticNote: 肩 (shoulder) + 膀 (upper arm; wing; shoulder) — the shoulder. 靠在某人的肩膀上 (lean on someone's shoulder), 拍肩膀 (tap someone on the shoulder). Figuratively: 扛在肩膀上 (carry on one's shoulders — take responsibility). 肩膀寬 (broad-shouldered). 肩頸酸痛 is one of the most common workplace complaints in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 她累了一天，靠在男友的肩膀上，很快就睡著了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lèi le yī tiān, kào zài nányǒu de jiānbǎng shàng, hěn kuài jiù shuìzháo le.
examples.english: After a tiring day, she leaned on her boyfriend's shoulder and quickly fell asleep.

examples.chinese: 長時間坐辦公室打電腦，他的肩膀一直很緊繃，常常需要按摩紓緩。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān zuò bàngōngshì dǎ diànnǎo, tā de jiānbǎng yīzhí hěn jǐnbēng, chángcháng xūyào ànmó shūhuǎn.
examples.english: After long hours sitting at an office computer, his shoulders are always very tense and he often needs a massage to relieve them.

semanticNote: 艱 (difficult; hard) + 巨 (huge; enormous; great) — extremely difficult or arduous (of a task or undertaking). 艱巨的任務 (a daunting task), 工程艱巨 (an enormous engineering challenge). Used for tasks that are both difficult and large in scale. More formal than 困難 (difficult); implies the difficulty is of great magnitude.

examples.chinese: 推動教育改革是一項艱巨的任務，涉及政策、資源與文化觀念的全面調整。
examples.pinyin: Tuīdòng jiàoyù gǎigé shì yī xiàng jiānjù de rènwù, shèjí zhèngcè, zīyuán yǔ wénhuà guānniàn de quánmiàn tiáozhěng.
examples.english: Driving educational reform is a daunting task, involving comprehensive adjustments to policy, resources, and cultural attitudes.

examples.chinese: 面對如此艱巨的挑戰，整個團隊選擇同心協力，不輕言放棄。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì rúcǐ jiānjù de tiǎozhàn, zhěnggè tuánduì xuǎnzé tóng xīn xié lì, bù qīng yán fàngqì.
examples.english: Faced with such a formidable challenge, the entire team chose to work together with one heart and not give up easily.

semanticNote: 艱 (difficult; hard) + 苦 (bitter; suffering; hardship) — difficult and full of hardship; arduous. 艱苦的生活 (a hard life), 艱苦奮鬥 (struggle through hardship). Emphasizes the suffering aspect of difficulty, more so than 艱巨 (which emphasizes scale). Often used for prolonged periods of hardship.

examples.chinese: 老一代的台灣人經歷了許多艱苦的歲月，才建立起今天繁榮的社會。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo yīdài de Táiwān rén jīnglì le xǔduō jiānkǔ de suìyuè, cái jiànlì qǐ jīntiān fánróng de shèhuì.
examples.english: The older generation of Taiwanese went through many years of hardship before building today's prosperous society.

examples.chinese: 儘管生活艱苦，她仍然靠著獎學金完成了大學學業，令人欽佩。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shēnghuó jiānkǔ, tā réngrán kào zhe jiǎngxuéjīn wánchéng le dàxué xuéyè, lìng rén qīnpèi.
examples.english: Despite a difficult life, she still completed her university studies on a scholarship — truly admirable.

semanticNote: 兼 (hold concurrently; also; in addition) + 職 (position; duty; job) — a part-time job; to work part-time or hold a concurrent position. 打工兼職 (work a part-time job), 兼職講師 (adjunct lecturer). In Taiwan, many university students do 打工 (part-time work); 兼職 is slightly more formal. Distinct from 打工度假 (working holiday visa).

examples.chinese: 她在本職工作之外還兼職做英文家教，補貼每個月的生活費。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài běnzhí gōngzuò zhīwài hái jiānzhí zuò Yīngwén jiājiào, bǔtiē měi gè yuè de shēnghuó fèi.
examples.english: In addition to her main job, she also does part-time English tutoring to supplement her monthly living expenses.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生利用週末時間兼職，積累社會經驗並為未來求職做準備。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng lìyòng zhōumò shíjiān jiānzhí, jīlěi shèhuì jīngyàn bìng wèi wèilái qiúzhí zuò zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Many university students use their weekends to work part-time, accumulating social experience and preparing for future job hunting.

semanticNote: 撿 — to pick up (something from the ground); to collect. 撿到錢包 (pick up a wallet), 撿垃圾 (pick up litter), 撿便宜 (pick up a bargain; get something cheap — colloquial). Physically: reaching down to collect something. Different from 拿 (take, from a surface at hand) which implies deliberate selection.

components.meaning: pick up; collect from ground; gather

examples.chinese: 他在公園裡撿到一個錢包，馬上送到附近的派出所去歸還。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngyuán lǐ jiǎn dào yī gè qiánbāo, mǎshàng sòng dào fùjìn de pàichūsuǒ qù guīhuán.
examples.english: He picked up a wallet in the park and immediately took it to the nearby police station to return it.

examples.chinese: 環保志工每週末在淡水河岸撿垃圾，希望讓河川環境更乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Huánbǎo zhìgōng měi zhōumò zài Dànshuǐ hé àn jiǎn lājī, xīwàng ràng héchuān huánjìng gèng gānjìng.
examples.english: Environmental volunteers pick up litter along the Danshui riverbank every weekend, hoping to make the river environment cleaner.

semanticNote: 剪 (cut with scissors; trim) + 刀 (knife; blade) — scissors. 一把剪刀 (a pair of scissors — measure word 把). 剪紙 (paper cutting — a traditional folk art). In Taiwan: 布剪刀 (fabric scissors), 手術剪 (surgical scissors). 石頭剪刀布 (Rock-Paper-Scissors — the playground game).

examples.chinese: 她用剪刀把一張紅紙剪成心形，貼在情人節卡片上。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng jiǎndāo bǎ yī zhāng hóng zhǐ jiǎn chéng xīn xíng, tiē zài Qíngrénjié kǎpiàn shàng.
examples.english: She used scissors to cut a piece of red paper into a heart shape and glued it on a Valentine's Day card.

examples.chinese: 美術課上，老師要求每人準備剪刀、膠水和彩色紙來做立體卡片。
examples.pinyin: Měishù kè shàng, lǎoshī yāoqiú měi rén zhǔnbèi jiǎndāo, jiāoshuǐ hé cǎisè zhǐ lái zuò lìtǐ kǎpiàn.
examples.english: In art class, the teacher asked everyone to bring scissors, glue, and colored paper to make 3D cards.

semanticNote: 簡 (brief; simple) + 歷 (experience; go through; calendar) — a résumé or curriculum vitae (CV). In Taiwan, 履歷 (lǚlì) and 履歷表 are the standard terms; 簡歷 is understood but somewhat Mainland-flavored. 求職履歷 (job application résumé). 更新履歷 (update one's résumé). Taiwan job platforms like 104人力銀行 use 履歷.

examples.chinese: 她花了整個週末更新自己的簡歷，把最新的工作經歷和技能都整理進去。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le zhěnggè zhōumò gēngxīn zìjǐ de jiǎnlì, bǎ zuì xīn de gōngzuò jīnglì hé jìnéng dōu zhěnglǐ jìnqù.
examples.english: She spent the whole weekend updating her résumé, organizing her latest work experience and skills into it.

examples.chinese: HR看了數百份簡歷後，只篩選出十位候選人進入面試階段。
examples.pinyin: HR kàn le shùbǎi fèn jiǎnlì hòu, zhǐ shāixuǎn chū shí wèi hòuxuǎnrén jìnrù miànshì jiēduàn.
examples.english: After reviewing hundreds of résumés, HR shortlisted only ten candidates for the interview stage.

semanticNote: 簡 (simple; simply) + 直 (straight; simply; just) — simply; it's just; frankly. Expresses strong emphasis, often with a tone of surprise or exasperation: 簡直不可思議！(Simply unbelievable!). More emphatic than 幾乎 (almost) and 根本 (at all; fundamentally). 簡直是 + noun is a common intensifier pattern.

examples.chinese: 這個價格簡直太貴了，比其他家貴了將近一倍，根本不划算。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàgé jiǎnzhí tài guì le, bǐ qítā jiā guì le jiāngjìn yī bèi, gēnběn bù huásuàn.
examples.english: This price is simply outrageous — nearly double what other places charge, absolutely not worth it.

examples.chinese: 他今天的表現簡直是完美，無論是技術還是心態都達到了最佳狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān de biǎoxiàn jiǎnzhí shì wánměi, wúlùn shì jìshù háishì xīntài dōu dádào le zuì jiā zhuàngtài.
examples.english: His performance today was simply perfect — both his technique and his mindset were at their absolute best.

semanticNote: 建 (build; establish; propose) + 立 (stand; establish; immediately) — to establish, build up, or set up (a system, relationship, institution, etc.). 建立關係 (establish a relationship), 建立信任 (build trust), 建立制度 (establish a system). More abstract than 建設 (construct physical things). Very common in business, political, and interpersonal contexts.

examples.chinese: 兩國透過多年的文化交流，逐漸建立起深厚的友誼與互信。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó tòuguò duō nián de wénhuà jiāoliú, zhújiàn jiànlì qǐ shēnhòu de yǒuyì yǔ hùxìn.
examples.english: Through years of cultural exchange, the two countries gradually built up a deep friendship and mutual trust.

examples.chinese: 創業初期，最重要的事是建立品牌形象，讓顧客對你產生信任感。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngyè chūqī, zuì zhòngyào de shì shì jiànlì pǐnpái xíngxiàng, ràng gùkè duì nǐ chǎnshēng xìnrèn gǎn.
examples.english: In the early stages of starting a business, the most important thing is to establish brand image and earn customers' trust.

semanticNote: 建 (build; establish) + 設 (set up; establish; install) — to build, construct, or develop (cities, infrastructure, systems). 基礎建設 (infrastructure), 建設性批評 (constructive criticism), 城市建設 (urban development). Has a positive, progressive connotation of improvement and development. 建設性 (constructive) is very common.

examples.chinese: 台灣近年大力投資基礎建設，包括道路、捷運系統和再生能源設施。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān jìnnián dàlì tóuzī jīchǔ jiànshè, bāokuò dàolù, jié yùn xìtǒng hé zàishēng néngyuán shèshī.
examples.english: In recent years Taiwan has invested heavily in infrastructure, including roads, MRT systems, and renewable energy facilities.

examples.chinese: 如果有批評，請提出建設性的意見，幫助我們改進，而不是一味地否定。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu pīpíng, qǐng tíchū jiànshèxìng de yìjiàn, bāngzhù wǒmen gǎijìn, ér bùshì yīwèi de fǒudìng.
examples.english: If you have criticism, please offer constructive suggestions to help us improve, rather than just flatly rejecting everything.

semanticNote: 建 (build) + 築 (build; construct) — a building or the act of constructing. 建築師 (architect), 建築風格 (architectural style), 建築工地 (construction site). Taiwan has distinctive architectural heritage: Japanese colonial-era buildings (日治時期建築), modernist 101, and indigenous-inspired designs. 建築系 (architecture department).

examples.chinese: 台南保存了許多台灣日治時期的歷史建築，是研究殖民地建築風格的寶庫。
examples.pinyin: Táinán bǎocún le xǔduō Táiwān rìzhì shíqī de lìshǐ jiànzhù, shì yánjiū zhímíndì jiànzhù fēnggé de bǎokù.
examples.english: Tainan preserves many historic buildings from Taiwan's Japanese colonial period — a treasure trove for studying colonial architectural styles.

examples.chinese: 她從小對建築設計充滿興趣，大學選擇就讀建築系，夢想成為一位建築師。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo duì jiànzhù shèjì chōngmǎn xìngqù, dàxué xuǎnzé jiùdú jiànzhù xì, mèngxiǎng chéngwéi yī wèi jiànzhùshī.
examples.english: She has been fascinated by architectural design since childhood; she chose to study architecture in university, dreaming of becoming an architect.

semanticNote: 健 (healthy; strengthen) + 身 (body) — to work out; fitness training. 健身房 (gym; fitness center), 健身教練 (personal trainer), 健身器材 (gym equipment). Taiwan's fitness culture has boomed since around 2015; gym memberships and CrossFit/瑜伽 studios proliferate in urban areas. 運動健身 (exercise and fitness).

examples.chinese: 他每天下班後都去健身房報到，已經養成了規律運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān xiàbān hòu dōu qù jiànshēn fáng bàodào, yǐjīng yǎngchéng le guīlǜ yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: He heads to the gym every day after work and has already developed the good habit of exercising regularly.

examples.chinese: 疫情期間健身房關閉，許多人改成在家健身，購買了啞鈴和瑜伽墊。
examples.pinyin: Yìqíng qījiān jiànshēn fáng guānbì, xǔduō rén gǎichéng zài jiā jiànshēn, gòumǎi le yǎlíng hé yújiā diàn.
examples.english: With gyms closed during the pandemic, many people switched to working out at home, buying dumbbells and yoga mats.

semanticNote: 鍵 (key; button) + 盤 (plate; tray; disc) — a keyboard (computer or musical). 電腦鍵盤 (computer keyboard), 鋼琴鍵盤 (piano keyboard). 鍵盤俠 (keyboard warrior — someone who fights aggressively online but not in real life) is a common internet term in Taiwan. 鍵盤布局 (keyboard layout; e.g., 注音/倉頡/英文).

examples.chinese: 她換了一個機械式鍵盤，打字的手感和聲音都讓她覺得很舒適。
examples.pinyin: Tā huàn le yī gè jīxiè shì jiànpán, dǎzì de shǒugǎn hé shēngyīn dōu ràng tā juéde hěn shūshì.
examples.english: She switched to a mechanical keyboard and found both the typing feel and the sound very satisfying.

examples.chinese: 很多網路上激烈爭論的人，在現實中其實很膽小，真的是典型的鍵盤俠。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō wǎnglù shàng jīliè zhēnglùn de rén, zài xiànshí zhōng qíshí hěn dǎnxiǎo, zhēnde shì diǎnxíng de jiànpán xiá.
examples.english: Many people who argue fiercely online are actually quite timid in real life — truly typical keyboard warriors.

semanticNote: 講 (talk; speak; pay attention to) + 究 (investigate; study; after all) — to be particular about; to pay attention to quality or detail; fastidious; exquisite. 講究衛生 (be particular about hygiene), 不講究 (not fussy; unpretentious). As an adj: 這家餐廳很講究，食材都是頂級的 (this restaurant is very refined, with premium ingredients throughout).

components.meaning: talk; speak; pay attention to; explain
investigate; study; after all; to the end

examples.chinese: 她在料理上非常講究，每道菜的食材搭配和烹調方式都經過仔細考量。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài liàolǐ shàng fēicháng jiǎngjiu, měi dào cài de shícái dāpèi hé pēngtiáo fāngshì dōu jīngguò zǐxì kǎoliàng.
examples.english: She is very particular about cooking — every dish's ingredient combinations and cooking methods are carefully considered.

examples.chinese: 這家老茶館做事很講究，從茶葉的產地到水溫、茶具都一絲不苟。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo cháguǎn zuòshì hěn jiǎngjiu, cóng cháyè de chǎndì dào shuǐwēn, chájù dōu yīsī bùgǒu.
examples.english: This traditional teahouse is very meticulous — from the origin of the tea leaves to the water temperature and teaware, everything is done with utmost care.

semanticNote: 講 (talk; lecture) + 座 (seat; platform; base) — a lecture, seminar, or lecture series. 舉辦講座 (hold a lecture), 公開講座 (public lecture), 講座教授 (endowed chair professor). In Taiwan, 演講 (speech/lecture) and 講座 are both used, with 講座 implying a more structured, often recurring educational event.

components.meaning: seat; platform; base; measure word for buildings

examples.chinese: 學校這學期邀請了多位業界專家舉辦系列講座，讓學生了解職場的實際狀況。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhè xuéqī yāoqǐng le duō wèi yèjiè zhuānjiā jǔbàn xìliè jiǎngzuò, ràng xuéshēng liǎojiě zhíchǎng de shíjì zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: This semester the school invited several industry experts to hold a series of lectures to give students insight into real workplace conditions.

examples.chinese: 她報名參加了一個關於個人理財的免費講座，學到了很多實用的投資知識。
examples.pinyin: Tā bàomíng cānjiā le yī gè guānyú gèrén lǐcái de miǎnfèi jiǎngzuò, xuédào le hěn duō shíyòng de tóuzī zhīshi.
examples.english: She signed up for a free lecture on personal finance and learned a lot of practical investment knowledge.

semanticNote: 醬 (sauce; paste; condiment) + 油 (oil) — soy sauce. A fundamental condiment in Chinese and Taiwanese cooking. 醬油膏 (thick soy sauce — more viscous, used as dipping sauce; especially popular in Taiwan), 生抽/老抽 (light/dark soy sauce — Cantonese terms). 蘸醬油 (dip in soy sauce). 打醬油 (colloquial: to run an errand; to be a bystander with no opinion).

examples.chinese: 台灣滷肉飯的靈魂是醬油，加入八角和冰糖一起燉，香氣四溢。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān lǔ ròu fàn de línghún shì jiàngyóu, jiārù bājiǎo hé bīngtáng yīqǐ dùn, xiānqì sì yì.
examples.english: The soul of Taiwanese braised pork rice is soy sauce — stewed together with star anise and rock sugar, the aroma fills the air.

examples.chinese: 她蒸了一條新鮮的石斑魚，淋上醬油和薑絲，用滾燙的熱油一澆，香氣撲鼻。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhēng le yī tiáo xīnxiān de shíbān yú, lín shàng jiàngyóu hé jiāngsī, yòng gǔntàng de rè yóu yī jiāo, xiānqì pū bí.
examples.english: She steamed a fresh grouper, drizzled it with soy sauce and ginger slivers, then poured on boiling hot oil — the aroma was irresistible.

semanticNote: 交 (hand over; exchange) + 換 (swap; change) — to exchange or swap. 交換禮物 (exchange gifts), 交換生 (exchange student), 交換意見 (exchange views). Very common in academic, diplomatic, and everyday contexts. In Taiwan, 交換學生計畫 (student exchange programs) to Japan, the US, and Europe are very popular.

examples.chinese: 她去年參加了交換生計畫，在日本的大學念了一學期，收穫豐富。
examples.pinyin: Tā qùnián cānjiā le jiāohuàn shēng jìhuà, zài Rìběn de dàxué niàn le yī xuéqī, shōuhuò fēngfù.
examples.english: She participated in an exchange student program last year, spending a semester at a university in Japan with great benefit.

examples.chinese: 兩位主廚決定互相交換食譜，激盪出新的料理靈感。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng wèi zhǔchú juédìng hùxiāng jiāohuàn shípǔ, jīdàng chū xīn de liàolǐ línggǎn.
examples.english: The two head chefs decided to swap recipes with each other, sparking new culinary inspiration.

semanticNote: 交 (associate; intersect) + 際 (boundary; occasion; between) — social interaction; to socialize; social intercourse. 社交能力/交際能力 (social skills), 交際舞 (ballroom dancing), 不善交際 (not good at socializing). More formal than 社交 (social). Implies deliberate networking or skillful human relations.

examples.chinese: 在商業場合，良好的交際能力往往比學歷更能決定一個人的成功。
examples.pinyin: Zài shāngyè chǎnghé, liánghǎo de jiāojì nénglì wǎngwǎng bǐ xuélì gèng néng juédìng yī gè rén de chénggōng.
examples.english: In business settings, good social skills often determine a person's success more than academic credentials.

examples.chinese: 她性格內向，不善於交際，但在專業能力上表現得十分出色。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìnggé nèixiàng, bù shànyú jiāojì, dàn zài zhuānyè nénglì shàng biǎoxiàn de shífēn chūsè.
examples.english: She has an introverted personality and isn't good at socializing, but she performs brilliantly in her professional capabilities.

semanticNote: 交 (associate; exchange) + 往 (go; toward; past) — to associate with; to have contact with; to date (romantically). 與人交往 (associate with people), 兩人在交往 (the two are dating). The romantic sense — 'to be in a relationship' — is very common in Taiwan everyday speech. 交往對象 (romantic partner).

examples.chinese: 他們從大學認識開始交往，畢業後順理成章地結婚了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cóng dàxué rènshi kāishǐ jiāowǎng, bìyè hòu shùnlǐchéngzhāng de jiéhūn le.
examples.english: They started dating after meeting in university and naturally got married after graduation.

examples.chinese: 她覺得與不同背景的人交往能拓展視野，因此積極參加各種社群活動。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde yǔ bùtóng bèijǐng de rén jiāowǎng néng tuòzhǎn shìyě, yīncǐ jījí cānjiā gèzhǒng shèqún huódòng.
examples.english: She believes that associating with people from different backgrounds broadens one's horizons, so she actively participates in various community activities.

semanticNote: 澆 — to water (plants); to pour liquid onto something; to irrigate. 澆花 (water flowers), 澆水 (pour water), 澆灌 (irrigate). Also figurative: 澆熄熱情 (douse enthusiasm; pour cold water on). 冷水澆頭 (a bucket of cold water — metaphor for discouragement). Taiwan's betel nut and orchid farming industries involve intensive 澆灌.

examples.chinese: 她每天早上起床第一件事就是去澆花，把陽台上的植物照顧得很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang qǐchuáng dì yī jiàn shì jiù shì qù jiāo huā, bǎ yángtái shàng de zhíwù zhàogù de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The first thing she does every morning after getting up is water her plants, keeping everything on the balcony in great shape.

examples.chinese: 農夫趁著清晨涼爽的時候澆灌農田，避免在烈日下水分蒸發太快。
examples.pinyin: Nóngfū chèn zhe qīngchén liángshuǎng de shíhòu jiāoguàn nóngtián, bìmiǎn zài lièrì xià shuǐfèn zhēngfā tài kuài.
examples.english: The farmer took advantage of the cool early morning to irrigate the fields, avoiding the rapid evaporation of water under the blazing sun.

semanticNote: 膠 (glue; rubber; adhesive) + 水 (water; liquid) — liquid glue or gum. In Taiwan: 白膠 (white glue/PVA glue), 強力膠 (super glue), 口紅膠 (glue stick). 膠水 specifically refers to the liquid variety. 黏 (nián, sticky/to stick) is the related verb. Common in school crafts and office supply contexts.

examples.chinese: 她把剪好的紙片一一用膠水黏在海報板上，完成了這份手工作業。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiǎn hǎo de zhǐpiàn yī yī yòng jiāoshuǐ nián zài hǎibào bǎn shàng, wánchéng le zhè fèn shǒugōng zuòyè.
examples.english: She glued the cut paper pieces one by one onto the poster board, completing the handcraft assignment.

examples.chinese: 這瓶膠水已經乾掉了，根本黏不住，要去買新的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè píng jiāoshuǐ yǐjīng gān diào le, gēnběn nián bú zhù, yào qù mǎi xīn de.
examples.english: This bottle of glue has dried out completely — it won't stick at all. Need to buy a new one.

semanticNote: 角 (angle; horn; corner) + 度 (degree; measure; extent) — angle (geometric) or perspective/point of view. 從不同角度思考 (think from different angles), 攝影角度 (camera angle), 幾何角度 (geometric angle). The figurative sense (viewpoint) is far more common in everyday HSK usage than the geometric sense.

examples.chinese: 從消費者的角度來看，這個產品的設計非常貼心，使用起來很順手。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiāofèizhě de jiǎodù lái kàn, zhège chǎnpǐn de shèjì fēicháng tiēxīn, shǐyòng qǐlái hěn shùnshǒu.
examples.english: From the consumer's perspective, this product's design is very thoughtful and easy to use.

examples.chinese: 記者試著從不同角度報導這起事件，盡量呈現各方的聲音。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shì zhe cóng bùtóng jiǎodù bàodǎo zhè qǐ shìjiàn, jǐnliàng chéngxiàn gè fāng de shēngyīn.
examples.english: The journalist tried to cover the incident from different angles, presenting the voices of all sides as much as possible.

semanticNote: 狡 (cunning; crafty — from the 犭 dog radical) + 猾 (crafty; sly — also 犭 dog radical) — crafty; cunning; sly. Both characters have the dog radical, referencing animal-like cleverness used for deception. Always negative. 狡猾的笑容 (a sly smile), 狡猾的商人 (a cunning merchant). Stronger than 聰明 (clever) in implying moral dubiousness.

examples.chinese: 這個商人非常狡猾，合約裡藏了很多讓客戶看不出來的陷阱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shāngrén fēicháng jiǎohuá, héyuē lǐ cáng le hěn duō ràng kèhù kàn bù chūlái de xiànjǐng.
examples.english: This merchant is very cunning — the contract is riddled with traps that customers can't detect.

examples.chinese: 這隻狐狸在童話故事裡總是扮演狡猾的反派，用計謀騙過其他動物。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī húlí zài tónghuà gùshi lǐ zǒng shì bànyǎn jiǎohuá de fǎnpài, yòng jìmóu piàn guò qítā dòngwù.
examples.english: In fairy tales, this fox always plays the cunning villain, using schemes to outwit the other animals.

semanticNote: 教 (teach; education) + 材 (material; timber; talent) — teaching materials; educational resources. 課本/教科書 (textbook), 補充教材 (supplementary materials), 數位教材 (digital learning materials). In Taiwan, 國立編譯館 historically controlled textbook content; curriculum reform 課綱 is a politically sensitive topic.

examples.chinese: 老師自己編寫了一套針對台灣學生的華語教材，比市面上的更貼近生活。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zìjǐ biānxiě le yī tào zhēnduì Táiwān xuéshēng de Huáyǔ jiàocái, bǐ shìmiàn shàng de gèng jiējìn shēnghuó.
examples.english: The teacher compiled their own set of Mandarin teaching materials targeted at Taiwanese students — more true to everyday life than what's commercially available.

examples.chinese: 這學期的歷史教材修訂了台灣史的部分，加入了更多本土觀點。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī de lìshǐ jiàocái xiūdìng le Táiwānshǐ de bùfèn, jiārù le gèng duō běntǔ guāndiǎn.
examples.english: This semester's history teaching materials revised the Taiwan history section, incorporating more local perspectives.

semanticNote: 教 (teach) + 練 (practice; train; drill) — a sports coach, trainer, or instructor. 棒球教練 (baseball coach), 游泳教練 (swimming instructor), 健身教練 (fitness trainer). In Taiwan, baseball (棒球) is the national sport; 教練 is central to its culture. Also used for driving instructors (駕訓班教練).

examples.chinese: 這位棒球教練帶領球隊連續三年奪得全國冠軍，受到全台球迷的愛戴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi bàngqiú jiàoliàn dàilǐng qiúduì liánxù sān nián duódé quánguó guànjūn, shòudào quán Tái qiúmí de àidài.
examples.english: This baseball coach led the team to win the national championship three years running, beloved by fans across Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 她請了一位私人健身教練，希望三個月內練出更好的體態。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐng le yī wèi sīrén jiànshēn jiàoliàn, xīwàng sān gè yuè nèi liàn chū gèng hǎo de tǐtài.
examples.english: She hired a personal fitness trainer, hoping to develop a better physique within three months.

semanticNote: 教 (teach) + 訓 (lecture; train; admonish) — a lesson learned (from experience or punishment); to teach someone a lesson. 吸取教訓 (learn from a lesson), 慘痛的教訓 (a painful lesson). As a verb: 媽媽教訓了他一頓 (Mom gave him a good scolding). Note the neutral tone on 訓 in the compound.

examples.chinese: 這次投資失敗讓他損失慘重，但也讓他吸取了「不要把雞蛋放在同一個籃子裡」的教訓。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tóuzī shībài ràng tā sǔnshī cǎnzhòng, dàn yě ràng tā xīqǔ le 'bùyào bǎ jīdàn fàng zài tóngyī gè lánzi lǐ' de jiàoxun.
examples.english: This failed investment cost him dearly, but it also taught him the lesson of 'don't put all your eggs in one basket.'

examples.chinese: 孩子把新買的手機弄丟了，爸爸很生氣地教訓了他一番，叫他要更小心。
examples.pinyin: Háizi bǎ xīn mǎi de shǒujī nòng diū le, bàba hěn shēngqì de jiàoxùn le tā yī fān, jiào tā yào gèng xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The child lost the newly bought phone, and dad gave him a thorough scolding, telling him to be more careful.

semanticNote: 階 (step; stair; rank) + 段 (section; period; segment) — a stage, phase, or period. 發展階段 (developmental stage), 初步階段 (initial phase), 這個階段 (at this stage). Very common in project management, education, and life-stage discussions. Implies a sequential progression where each stage builds on the previous.

examples.chinese: 產品開發分為三個階段：概念設計、原型測試和正式量產。
examples.pinyin: Chǎnpǐn kāifā fēn wéi sān gè jiēduàn: gàiniàn shèjì, yuánxíng cèshì hé zhèngshì liàngchǎn.
examples.english: Product development is divided into three stages: concept design, prototype testing, and mass production.

examples.chinese: 青少年時期是人生中一個特別敏感的階段，需要家長和學校的共同關注。
examples.pinyin: Qīngshàonián shíqī shì rénshēng zhōng yī gè tèbié mǐngǎn de jiēduàn, xūyào jiāzhǎng hé xuéxiào de gòngtóng guānzhù.
examples.english: Adolescence is a particularly sensitive stage in life, requiring attention from both parents and schools.

semanticNote: Heteronym: (1) jiēshí — to bear fruit (植物結實). (2) jiēshi (neutral 實) — sturdy; solid; well-built; robust (這條繩子很結實). The HSK5 meaning is primarily jiēshi = sturdy/robust. 身體結實 (physically robust/built), 結實的木頭 (solid/sturdy wood). Note the neutral tone marks colloquial pronunciation.

examples.chinese: 他在軍隊服役兩年後，身體變得非常結實，力氣也大了很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jūnduì fúyì liǎng nián hòu, shēntǐ biàn de fēicháng jiēshi, lìqi yě dà le hěn duō.
examples.english: After two years of military service, his body became very sturdy and his strength increased a great deal.

examples.chinese: 這張老木桌做工結實，用了幾十年還完好如初，一點都不鬆動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng lǎo mùzhuō zuògōng jiēshi, yòng le jǐ shí nián hái wánhǎo rú chū, yīdiǎn dōu bù sōngdòng.
examples.english: This old wooden table is solidly crafted — after decades of use it's still as good as new, without any wobble.

semanticNote: 接 (receive; connect;接近) + 觸 (touch; contact) — to come into contact with; to touch; to have access to. 接觸新事物 (exposure to new things), 初次接觸 (first contact/exposure), 皮膚接觸 (skin contact). Broader than physical touch — commonly used for exposure to information, culture, or people.

examples.chinese: 她從小接觸音樂，五歲開始學鋼琴，現在已經是職業鋼琴家了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiēchù yīnyuè, wǔ suì kāishǐ xué gāngqín, xiànzài yǐjīng shì zhíyè gāngqínjiā le.
examples.english: She was exposed to music from a young age, started learning piano at five, and is now a professional pianist.

examples.chinese: 皮膚接觸到這種化學物質後如果出現紅腫，請立刻以大量清水沖洗。
examples.pinyin: Pífū jiēchù dào zhè zhǒng huàxué wùzhí hòu rúguǒ chūxiàn hóngzhǒng, qǐng lìkè yǐ dàliàng qīngshuǐ chōngxǐ.
examples.english: If redness or swelling occurs after skin contact with this chemical, please immediately rinse with plenty of clean water.

semanticNote: 接 (receive; meet) + 待 (treat; wait; attend to) — to receive or welcome guests; to admit visitors. 接待外賓 (receive foreign guests), 接待室 (reception room), 接待人員 (receptionist). In Taiwan's service industry (服務業), 接待 etiquette is important in hotels, offices, and government agencies.

examples.chinese: 市長親自接待了來訪的外國代表團，雙方就合作項目進行了深入討論。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng qīnzì jiēdài le láifǎng de wàiguó dàibiǎotuán, shuāngfāng jiù hézuò xiàngmù jìnxíng le shēnrù tǎolùn.
examples.english: The mayor personally received the visiting foreign delegation, and both sides held in-depth discussions on cooperation projects.

examples.chinese: 飯店的接待人員用流利的英日文接待了來自各國的旅客，表現十分專業。
examples.pinyin: Fàndiàn de jiēdài rényuán yòng liúlì de Yīng Rì wén jiēdài le láizì gèguó de lǚkè, biǎoxiàn shífēn zhuānyè.
examples.english: The hotel's reception staff welcomed guests from various countries in fluent English and Japanese, displaying a highly professional manner.

semanticNote: 接 (approach; connect) + 近 (near; close) — to approach, be close to, or be near. 接近目標 (approach the goal), 接近滿分 (close to a perfect score), 接近事實 (close to the truth). As an adj: 兩人的想法很接近 (their views are very similar). Both spatial and abstract proximity.

examples.chinese: 她的成績已經接近滿分，再多練習幾次應該就能考到一百分。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì yǐjīng jiējìn mǎnfēn, zài duō liànxí jǐ cì yīnggāi jiù néng kǎo dào yī bǎi fēn.
examples.english: Her score is already close to perfect; a few more practice runs and she should be able to hit 100.

examples.chinese: 警察悄悄地接近嫌犯，趁他不注意時將他制服。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá qiāoqiāo de jiējìn xiánfàn, chèn tā bù zhùyì shí jiāng tā zhìfú.
examples.english: The police quietly approached the suspect and subdued him while he was off-guard.

semanticNote: 節 (section; festival; moderate; save) + 省 (economize; province; inspect) — to save or economize (money, time, energy); frugal. 節省時間 (save time), 節省開支 (cut expenses), 節省能源 (conserve energy). 省 alone can mean 'save' colloquially in Taiwan. 節儉 (frugal) is a closely related adjective.

examples.chinese: 她習慣在超市特價時多買一些日常用品，節省每個月的開銷。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài chāoshì tèjià shí duō mǎi yīxiē rìcháng yòngpǐn, jiéshěng měi gè yuè de kāixiāo.
examples.english: She makes a habit of buying extra everyday items when they're on sale at the supermarket to save on monthly expenses.

examples.chinese: 搭乘大眾運輸不僅節省油錢，也能減少碳排放，對環境更友善。
examples.pinyin: Dāchéng dàzhòng yùnshū bùjǐn jiéshěng yóuqián, yě néng jiǎnshǎo tàn páifàng, duì huánjìng gèng yǒushàn.
examples.english: Taking public transportation not only saves fuel costs, it also reduces carbon emissions, making it more environmentally friendly.

semanticNote: 結 (tie; bind; form) + 構 (construct; form; structure) — structure; composition; framework. 句子結構 (sentence structure), 社會結構 (social structure), 骨骼結構 (skeletal structure), 組織結構 (organizational structure). Fundamental term in linguistics, engineering, biology, sociology, and architecture.

examples.chinese: 老師解釋了中文句子結構和英文的不同，幫助外籍學生更快理解語法。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiěshì le zhōngwén jùzi jiégòu hé Yīngwén de bùtóng, bāngzhù wàijí xuéshēng gèng kuài lǐjiě yǔfǎ.
examples.english: The teacher explained the differences between Chinese and English sentence structure, helping foreign students understand grammar more quickly.

examples.chinese: 台灣的人口結構正在快速老化，政府必須及早規劃因應措施。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de rénkǒu jiégòu zhèngzài kuàisù lǎohuà, zhèngfǔ bìxū jízǎo guīhuà yīnyìng cuòshī.
examples.english: Taiwan's population structure is aging rapidly; the government must plan countermeasures at the earliest opportunity.

semanticNote: 結 (bind; form; tie) + 合 (join; combine; together) — to combine, integrate, or unite. 理論結合實際 (combine theory with practice), 結合兩者的優點 (combine the advantages of both), 跨領域結合 (cross-disciplinary integration). Very common in academic, creative, and business discourse. Can also mean marriage/union in classical contexts.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳把台灣傳統小吃和法式料理技法結合起來，創造出獨特的fusion菜單。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bǎ Táiwān chuántǒng xiǎochī hé Fǎshì liàolǐ jìfǎ jiéhé qǐlái, chuàngzào chū dútè de fusion càidān.
examples.english: This restaurant combines traditional Taiwanese street snacks with French culinary techniques, creating a unique fusion menu.

examples.chinese: 她的論文把質性研究與量化分析結合，全面地呈現了研究結果。
examples.pinyin: Tā de lùnwén bǎ zhìxìng yánjiū yǔ liànghuà fēnxī jiéhé, quánmiàn de chéngxiàn le yánjiū jiéguǒ.
examples.english: Her thesis combined qualitative research with quantitative analysis, presenting the research findings comprehensively.

semanticNote: 結 (conclude; end; tie) + 論 (discuss; theory; conclude) — a conclusion or verdict. 得出結論 (reach a conclusion), 下結論 (draw a conclusion; make a judgment), 倉促下結論 (jump to conclusions). 結論是... (the conclusion is...). In academic papers, 結論 is a standard section heading. Often used to wrap up an argument.

examples.chinese: 在所有證據都收集完畢之前，我們不應該倉促地下結論。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu zhèngjù dōu shōují wánbì zhīqián, wǒmen bù yīnggāi cāngcù de xià jiélùn.
examples.english: Before all the evidence has been gathered, we shouldn't rush to draw conclusions.

examples.chinese: 研究團隊在報告的結論部分指出，長期睡眠不足與代謝疾病有顯著相關。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū tuánduì zài bàogào de jiélùn bùfèn zhǐchū, chángqī shuìmián bùzú yǔ dàixiè jíbìng yǒu xiǎnzhù xiāngguān.
examples.english: In the conclusion section of the report, the research team noted a significant correlation between chronic sleep deprivation and metabolic disease.

semanticNote: 結 (settle; conclude) + 帳 (account; bill; ledger) — to pay the bill; to settle accounts; to check out. 結帳 is what you do at a restaurant (埋單 is a Cantonese-influenced alternative also heard in Taiwan), a hotel (辦理退房結帳), or a retail store. 收銀台 (checkout counter). 刷卡結帳 (pay by card).

examples.chinese: 吃完飯後，他搶先一步去結帳，不讓朋友有機會付錢。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn hòu, tā qiǎng xiān yī bù qù jiézhàng, bù ràng péngyǒu yǒu jīhuì fù qián.
examples.english: After finishing the meal, he rushed ahead to pay the bill before his friend had a chance to.

examples.chinese: 超市收銀台結帳時，店員問她要不要集點或使用優惠券。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshì shōuyín tái jiézhàng shí, diànyuán wèn tā yào bú yào jí diǎn huò shǐyòng yōuhuì quàn.
examples.english: At the supermarket checkout, the cashier asked her if she wanted to collect points or use a coupon.

semanticNote: 戒 — to abstain from; to swear off; to guard against; a commandment or precept. 戒菸 (quit smoking), 戒酒 (quit drinking), 戒毒 (quit drugs), 佛教戒律 (Buddhist precepts). Also 戒嚴 (martial law; state of emergency) — historically significant for Taiwan: martial law lasted from 1949–1987, one of the longest in the world.

components.meaning: abstain; swear off; guard against; precept; ring

examples.chinese: 他下定決心戒菸，已經連續三個月沒有抽一根菸了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàdìng juéxīn jiè yān, yǐjīng liánxù sān gè yuè méiyǒu chōu yī gēn yān le.
examples.english: He made up his mind to quit smoking and hasn't smoked a single cigarette for three consecutive months.

examples.chinese: 台灣在1987年解除長達三十八年的戒嚴，是民主化進程中的重要里程碑。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zài 1987 nián jiěchú zhǎngdá sānshíbā nián de jièyán, shì mínzhǔhuà jìnchéng zhōng de zhòngyào lǐchéngbēi.
examples.english: Taiwan lifted martial law in 1987 after thirty-eight years — a major milestone in the democratization process.

semanticNote: 戒 (ring; precept) + 指 (finger; point) — a finger ring. 婚戒 (wedding ring), 訂婚戒指 (engagement ring), 鑽戒 (diamond ring). The character 戒 alone can mean a ring (worn as a reminder of a vow or precept). 右手戒指 vs. 左手無名指 — in Taiwan, engagement rings are traditionally worn on the ring finger of the left hand.

examples.chinese: 他在海邊的夕陽下單膝跪地，拿出一枚鑽戒向她求婚，感動得她流下眼淚。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hǎibiān de xīyáng xià dān xī guì dì, ná chū yī méi zuànjiè xiàng tā qiúhūn, gǎndòng de tā liúxià yǎnlèi.
examples.english: He got down on one knee in the sunset by the sea and brought out a diamond ring to propose — she was moved to tears.

examples.chinese: 她把那枚陪伴她三十年的婚戒輕輕摘下，交給女兒作為傳家之寶。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà méi péibàn tā sānshí nián de hūnjie qīngqīng zhāi xià, jiāo gěi nǚ'ér zuòwéi chuánjiā zhī bǎo.
examples.english: She gently removed the wedding ring that had accompanied her for thirty years and gave it to her daughter as a family heirloom.

semanticNote: 屆 — arrive at (a time); a measure word for events, sessions, terms, and graduating classes. 第三屆 (the third session/edition), 本屆 (this year's; current), 屆時 (when the time comes; by then), 應屆畢業生 (this year's graduates). 屆滿 (term expires). Very common in political, academic, and event contexts in Taiwan.

components.meaning: arrive at; be due; session; term; measure word for events

examples.chinese: 本屆總統大選的投票率創下近年新高，顯示民眾對政治的高度關注。
examples.pinyin: Běn jiè zǒngtǒng dàxuǎn de tóupiào lǜ chuàng xià jìnnián xīngāo, xiǎnshì mínzhòng duì zhèngzhì de gāodù guānzhù.
examples.english: Voter turnout in this year's presidential election hit a recent record high, reflecting the public's high level of political engagement.

examples.chinese: 她是今年的應屆畢業生，正積極投履歷尋找第一份正式工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì jīnnián de yīngjiè bìyèshēng, zhèng jījí tóu lǚlì xúnzhǎo dì yī fèn zhèngshì gōngzuò.
examples.english: She is a new graduate this year, actively submitting résumés in search of her first full-time job.

semanticNote: 借 (borrow; use as a pretext) + 口 (mouth; opening; pretext) — an excuse; a pretext. 找借口 (make up an excuse), 以...為借口 (use ... as an excuse/pretext), 沒有借口 (no excuse). Slightly negative — implies the excuse is not genuine. Different from 理由 (reason), which can be legitimate.

examples.chinese: 他以身體不舒服為借口，其實是不想去那場他早就後悔答應的聚會。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ shēntǐ bù shūfú wéi jièkǒu, qíshí shì bù xiǎng qù nà chǎng tā zǎo jiù hòuhuǐ dāyìng de jùhuì.
examples.english: He used feeling unwell as an excuse — in fact he simply didn't want to go to the gathering he'd long regretted agreeing to.

examples.chinese: 別再找借口了，你明明有時間，只是不想做而已。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài zhǎo jièkǒu le, nǐ míngmíng yǒu shíjiān, zhǐ shì bù xiǎng zuò éryǐ.
examples.english: Stop making excuses — you clearly have the time; you just don't want to do it.

semanticNote: 金 (gold; metal) + 屬 (belong to; category; genus) — metal (as a material category). 金屬材料 (metal materials), 重金屬 (heavy metal — both the chemical category and the music genre), 金屬加工 (metalworking).
