Taiwan is a major producer of precision metal components for electronics and machinery (精密金屬零件).

examples.chinese: 台灣的精密金屬加工產業在全球供應鏈中佔有重要的一席之地。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de jīngmì jīnshǔ jiāgōng chǎnyè zài quánqiú gōngyīng liàn zhōng zhànyǒu zhòngyào de yī xí zhī dì.
examples.english: Taiwan's precision metalworking industry holds an important place in the global supply chain.

examples.chinese: 這款手機採用航太級金屬材料打造機身，質感細膩，非常耐用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī cǎiyòng háng tài jí jīnshǔ cáiliào dǎzào jīshēn, zhìgǎn xìnì, fēicháng nàiyòng.
examples.english: This phone's body is made from aerospace-grade metal, with a refined feel and exceptional durability.

semanticNote: 儘 (as much as possible; to the utmost) + 快 (fast; quick) — as quickly as possible; at the earliest opportunity. 請儘快回覆 (please reply as soon as possible — very common in business email). Synonymous with 盡快. Note: 儘快 (jǐnkuài) and 盡快 (jìnkuài) are variant spellings of the same expression.

components.meaning: as much as possible; to the utmost; despite

examples.chinese: 請儘快把資料傳給我，客戶明天就要開會，我需要提前準備。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jǐnkuài bǎ zīliào chuán gěi wǒ, kèhù míngtiān jiù yào kāihuì, wǒ xūyào tíqián zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Please send me the materials as soon as possible — the client meeting is tomorrow and I need to prepare in advance.

examples.chinese: 颱風即將來襲，政府呼籲民眾儘快完成防颱準備，確保人身安全。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng jíjiāng lái xí, zhèngfǔ hūyù mínzhòng jǐnkuài wánchéng fángtái zhǔnbèi, quèbǎo rénshēn ānquán.
examples.english: With a typhoon imminent, the government urged the public to complete typhoon preparation measures as quickly as possible to ensure personal safety.

semanticNote: 儘 (to the utmost) + 量 (amount; capacity; as much as) — as much as possible; to the best of one's ability. 儘量早點來 (come as early as possible), 儘量避免 (avoid as much as possible). Note pronunciation: jǐnliàng (try one's best) vs. jìnliàng (eat or drink to one's fill — written 盡量 with different tone). The HSK sense is the jǐn- form.

components.meaning: to the utmost; as much as possible

examples.chinese: 醫師建議她儘量多休息、少用眼，讓眼睛有充分的時間恢復。
examples.pinyin: Yīshī jiànyì tā jǐnliàng duō xiūxi, shǎo yòng yǎn, ràng yǎnjīng yǒu chōngfèn de shíjiān huīfù.
examples.english: The doctor advised her to rest as much as possible and reduce eye use, giving her eyes adequate time to recover.

examples.chinese: 我知道你很忙，但還是希望你能儘量撥空來參加這場重要的會議。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nǐ hěn máng, dàn háishì xīwàng nǐ néng jǐnliàng bō kōng lái cānjiā zhè chǎng zhòngyào de huìyì.
examples.english: I know you're very busy, but I still hope you can make time to attend this important meeting if at all possible.

semanticNote: 緊 (tight; tense; urgent) + 急 (urgent; anxious; hasty) — urgent; pressing; emergency. 緊急情況 (emergency), 緊急聯絡人 (emergency contact), 緊急出口 (emergency exit), 緊急避難 (emergency evacuation). Both characters share the urgency meaning, reinforcing the severity. 非緊急 (non-urgent). Taiwan's 119 is the emergency services number.

examples.chinese: 公司接到緊急通知，要求所有員工在下班前完成資料備份，以防系統更新出問題。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiēdào jǐnjí tōngzhī, yāoqiú suǒyǒu yuángōng zài xiàbān qián wánchéng zīliào bèifèn, yǐ fáng xìtǒng gēngxīn chū wèntí.
examples.english: The company received an urgent notice requiring all employees to back up their data before the end of the day to prevent problems during the system update.

examples.chinese: 機艙內的緊急出口位置已標示清楚，請旅客起飛前仔細確認。
examples.pinyin: Jīcāng nèi de jǐnjí chūkǒu wèizhì yǐ biāoshì qīngchǔ, qǐng lǚkè qǐfēi qián zǐxì quèrèn.
examples.english: The locations of emergency exits in the cabin are clearly marked; passengers are asked to confirm them carefully before takeoff.

semanticNote: 謹 (cautious; careful; respectful) + 慎 (careful; prudent; cautious) — cautious; prudent; careful. Both characters convey carefulness, making the word doubly emphatic. 謹慎行事 (act with caution), 謹慎的態度 (a prudent attitude). More formal and positive than 小心 (be careful! — often a warning). Implies wisdom in one's caution.

examples.chinese: 在簽任何合約之前，她都會謹慎地請律師逐條審閱，確保自身權益。
examples.pinyin: Zài qiān rènhé héyuē zhīqián, tā dōu huì jǐnshèn de qǐng lǜshī zhú tiáo shěnyuè, quèbǎo zìshēn quányì.
examples.english: Before signing any contract, she carefully has a lawyer review it clause by clause to ensure her interests are protected.

examples.chinese: 面對複雜的投資市場，謹慎的態度往往比冒進更能保住本金。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì fùzá de tóuzī shìchǎng, jǐnshèn de tàidù wǎngwǎng bǐ màojìn gèng néng bǎozhù běnjīn.
examples.english: When facing a complex investment market, a cautious attitude is often better at preserving capital than reckless boldness.

semanticNote: 盡 (exhaust; to the utmost; jìn) + 力 (strength; effort) — to do one's best; to exert all one's effort. 盡力而為 (do one's best under the circumstances), 我已盡力 (I've done my best). Sincere and full exertion of effort, similar to 全力以赴 but less formal. Note: jìn (4th tone) here, contrasting with 儘快/儘量 which use jǐn (3rd tone).

components.meaning: exhaust; use up; to the utmost; all (jìn)

examples.chinese: 不管結果如何，我都會盡力去做，絕不讓大家失望。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn jiéguǒ rúhé, wǒ dōu huì jìnlì qù zuò, jué bù ràng dàjiā shīwàng.
examples.english: Whatever the outcome, I will do my best and absolutely will not let everyone down.

examples.chinese: 醫生告訴家屬，他們已經盡力搶救，但病人的情況實在太嚴重了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosù jiāshǔ, tāmen yǐjīng jìnlì qiǎngjiù, dàn bìngrén de qíngkuàng shízài tài yánzhòng le.
examples.english: The doctor told the family that they had done everything in their power to save the patient, but the condition was simply too severe.

semanticNote: 進 (enter; advance) + 口 (mouth; opening; entrance) — to import (goods); an import; an entrance. 進口商品 (imported goods), 進口關稅 (import tariff), 禁止進口 (banned from import). Contrasted with 出口 (export). Taiwan's import mix includes energy, raw materials, and luxury goods. 入口 (entrance) is the related spatial term.

examples.chinese: 台灣超過97%的能源依賴進口，因此能源安全是國家的重大課題。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān chāoguò 97% de néngyuán yīlài jìnkǒu, yīncǐ néngyuán ānquán shì guójiā de zhòngdà kètí.
examples.english: Taiwan relies on imports for over 97% of its energy, making energy security a major national challenge.

examples.chinese: 這款日本進口的牛肉品質極佳，在高級餐廳裡非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn Rìběn jìnkǒu de niúròu pǐnzhí jí jiā, zài gāojí cāntīng lǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: This Japanese imported beef is of exceptional quality and is very popular at high-end restaurants.

semanticNote: 近 (near; recent) + 代 (generation; era; dynasty) — modern times (roughly 19th century to early 20th century in Chinese historiography). In ROC/Taiwan academic usage, 近代 (近代史) typically covers 1840–1949, while 現代 (現代史) covers 1949 onward. Distinct from 當代 (contemporary) and 古代 (ancient times).

examples.chinese: 台灣近代史深受殖民統治與戰後政治轉變的影響，是理解現代台灣的關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān jìndài shǐ shēn shòu zhímín tǒngzhì yǔ zhànhòu zhèngzhì zhuǎnbiàn de yǐngxiǎng, shì lǐjiě xiàndài Táiwān de guānjiàn.
examples.english: Taiwan's modern history is deeply shaped by colonial rule and postwar political transformation — key to understanding contemporary Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這堂課主要介紹中國近代史中列強侵略對社會造成的深遠影響。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè zhǔyào jièshào Zhōngguó jìndài shǐ zhōng lièqiáng qīnlüè duì shèhuì zàochéng de shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: This class focuses on the far-reaching impact of imperialist aggression on Chinese society during the modern era.

semanticNote: 經 (scripture; classic; manage) + 典 (classic; canon; ceremony; dictionary) — a classic; a canonical work; classic/timeless. 文學經典 (literary classic), 經典名著 (classic masterwork), 這首歌是經典 (this song is a classic). As an adj: 經典的設計 (a timeless design). Very positive connotation of enduring quality.

examples.chinese: 《紅樓夢》是中國文學的經典，每讀一遍都有不同的感悟。
examples.pinyin: 《Hónglóumèng》 shì Zhōngguó wénxué de jīngdiǎn, měi dú yī biàn dōu yǒu bùtóng de gǎnwù.
examples.english: Dream of the Red Chamber is a classic of Chinese literature — each reading brings different insights.

examples.chinese: 這首五月天的老歌仍是演唱會的經典曲目，每次開唱都讓全場大合唱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu Wǔyuètiān de lǎo gē réng shì yǎnchànghuì de jīngdiǎn qǔmù, měi cì kāi chàng dōu ràng quánchǎng dà héchàng.
examples.english: This old Mayday song remains a concert classic — every time it starts, the whole venue sings along.

semanticNote: 經 (manage; run) + 商 (trade; commerce; merchant; discuss) — to engage in trade or commerce; to do business. 做生意/經商 are near-synonyms in Taiwan, but 經商 sounds more formal. 從商 (enter the business world). 經商之道 (the way of commerce). Many Taiwanese families have a tradition of 經商 going back generations.

examples.chinese: 他大學一畢業就跟著家族經商，學習如何管理傳統製造業。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàxué yī bìyè jiù gēnzhe jiāzú jīng shāng, xuéxí rúhé guǎnlǐ chuántǒng zhìzàoyè.
examples.english: Right after graduating from university, he joined the family business to learn how to manage their traditional manufacturing company.

examples.chinese: 她放棄了穩定的公務員工作，決心自己出來經商，開了一家手工餅乾店。
examples.pinyin: Tā fàngqì le wěndìng de gōngwùyuán gōngzuò, juéxīn zìjǐ chūlái jīng shāng, kāi le yī jiā shǒugōng bǐnggān diàn.
examples.english: She gave up her stable civil servant job and resolved to go into business for herself, opening a handmade cookie shop.

semanticNote: 經 (manage; run) + 營 (manage; run; camp; operate) — to operate or run (a business); to engage in management. 經營餐廳 (run a restaurant), 經營策略 (business strategy), 永續經營 (sustainable management). Has an ongoing, active management connotation — not just ownership. 經營理念 (management philosophy) is frequently cited by Taiwanese business owners.

examples.chinese: 這家米其林餐廳由一對夫妻共同經營，堅持使用在地食材，口碑極佳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā Mǐqílín cāntīng yóu yī duì fūqī gòngtóng jīngyíng, jiānchí shǐyòng zàidì shícái, kǒubēi jí jiā.
examples.english: This Michelin restaurant is run jointly by a couple who insist on using local ingredients — with an excellent reputation.

examples.chinese: 他在零售業深耕多年，對於如何經營客戶關係有一套獨到的方法。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài língshòuyè shēngēng duō nián, duìyú rúhé jīngyíng kèhù guānxi yǒu yī tào dúdào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: He has worked deeply in the retail industry for many years and has developed his own unique approach to managing customer relationships.

semanticNote: 精 (essence; refined; energy; skilled) + 力 (strength; power; force) — energy; vigor; vitality. 精力充沛 (full of energy; energetic), 耗費精力 (expend energy), 精力旺盛 (vigorous; energetic). Refers specifically to personal mental and physical energy, distinct from 力氣 (physical strength) or 能量 (energy in a physics sense).

examples.chinese: 創業初期她把所有的時間和精力都投入到公司上，幾乎沒有休息的時間。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngyè chūqī tā bǎ suǒyǒu de shíjiān hé jīnglì dōu tóurù dào gōngsī shàng, jīhū méiyǒu xiūxi de shíjiān.
examples.english: In the early stages of starting the company, she poured all her time and energy into it, with almost no time to rest.

examples.chinese: 他年過五十，但精力依然充沛，每天打一個小時的羽毛球也不覺得累。
examples.pinyin: Tā nián guò wǔshí, dàn jīnglì yīrán chōngpèi, měitiān dǎ yī gè xiǎoshí de yǔmáoqiú yě bù juéde lèi.
examples.english: He's past fifty but still full of energy — playing badminton for an hour every day doesn't even tire him out.

semanticNote: 精 (essence; refined) + 神 (spirit; god; mind) — spirit; mental state; vigor; essence/gist. 精神好 (in good spirits; alert), 精神崩潰 (mental breakdown), 精神科 (psychiatry), 精神食糧 (spiritual/intellectual nourishment). Also 精神 (jīngshén with 4th tone 神) in some compound words. Covers both psychological state and the abstract spirit of something.

examples.chinese: 睡了一個好覺之後，她整個人精神好多了，工作效率也提升了不少。
examples.pinyin: Shuì le yī gè hǎo jiào zhīhòu, tā zhěnggè rén jīngshen hǎo duō le, gōngzuò xiàolǜ yě tíshēng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: After a good night's sleep, her spirits lifted considerably and her work efficiency improved quite a bit too.

examples.chinese: 台灣的志工精神在重大災難時格外明顯，大批民眾自發組織救援行動。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhìgōng jīngshen zài zhòngdà zāinàn shí géwài míngxiǎn, dàpī mínzhòng zìfā zǔzhī jiùyuán xíngdòng.
examples.english: Taiwan's volunteer spirit is especially evident during major disasters, with large numbers of citizens spontaneously organizing relief efforts.

semanticNote: 酒 (alcohol; liquor) + 吧 (bar — loanword from English, also the sentence-final particle) — a bar (establishment selling drinks). 酒吧街 (bar street), 清吧 (quiet bar), 夜店 (nightclub; more energetic). In Taiwan: 信義區 and 中山區 in Taipei are known for their bar scenes. 吧台 (bar counter). 酒吧文化 began expanding in Taiwan in the 1990s.

examples.chinese: 下班後，同事們相約去附近的酒吧喝一杯，放鬆心情聊聊天。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān hòu, tóngshìmen xiāngyuē qù fùjìn de jiǔbā hē yī bēi, fàngsōng xīnqíng liáoliáo tiān.
examples.english: After work, colleagues arranged to meet at a nearby bar for a drink, relaxing and chatting.

examples.chinese: 台北信義區有許多風格各異的酒吧，從爵士風到復古搖滾應有盡有。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Xìnyì Qū yǒu xǔduō fēnggé gèyì de jiǔbā, cóng juéshì fēng dào fùgǔ yáogǔn yīngyǒujǐnyǒu.
examples.english: Xinyi District in Taipei has many bars of different styles — from jazz to vintage rock, you'll find them all.

semanticNote: 救 — to save, rescue, or assist (someone in danger). 救人 (save a person), 急救 (first aid; emergency rescue), 救護車 (ambulance), 救命！(Help! Save me!). Common in medical, disaster, and figurative contexts: 救場 (save the day; step in for someone). 119 is Taiwan's emergency/fire rescue number.

examples.chinese: 消防員冒著生命危險衝進火場，成功救出了被困在三樓的老人。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán mào zhe shēngmìng wēixiǎn chōng jìn huǒchǎng, chénggōng jiù chū le bèi kùn zài sān lóu de lǎorén.
examples.english: Firefighters risked their lives to rush into the blaze and successfully rescued an elderly person trapped on the third floor.

examples.chinese: 她學過急救課程，在路邊看到有人昏倒，立刻跪下進行心肺復甦術。
examples.pinyin: Tā xuéguò jíjiù kèchéng, zài lùbiān kàndào yǒu rén hūndǎo, lìkè guì xià jìnxíng xīnfèi fùsū shù.
examples.english: Having taken a first aid course, she immediately knelt down and performed CPR when she saw someone collapse by the roadside.

semanticNote: 救 (rescue) + 護 (protect; care for) + 車 (vehicle) — an ambulance. 叫救護車 (call an ambulance), 119救護車 (119 ambulance — Taiwan's emergency number). In Taiwan, ambulances are dispatched by the 消防署 (National Fire Agency). 救護員 (EMT; paramedic). Important to note that Taiwan has universal health insurance covering ambulance transport.

examples.chinese: 路人發現男子突然倒地不起，立刻撥打119叫來救護車。
examples.pinyin: Lùrén fāxiàn nánzǐ tūrán dǎo dì bù qǐ, lìkè bōdǎ 119 jiào lái jiùhùchē.
examples.english: Passersby noticed a man suddenly collapsed on the ground and immediately called 119 to summon an ambulance.

examples.chinese: 救護車鳴笛疾駛而過，其他車輛紛紛讓道，讓其優先通行。
examples.pinyin: Jiùhùchē míng dí jí shǐ ér guò, qítā chēliàng fēnfēn ràng dào, ràng qí yōuxiān tōngxíng.
examples.english: The ambulance sped through with its siren blaring; other vehicles quickly yielded to let it through.

semanticNote: 舅 (mother's brother; uncle) + 舅 (repeated for the noun form) — maternal uncle (mother's brother). In Chinese kinship terminology, maternal and paternal relatives are distinguished: 舅舅 (mother's brother) vs. 伯伯/叔叔 (father's older/younger brother). 舅媽 (wife of maternal uncle). In Taiwan's close-knit family culture, 舅舅 is an important family role.

components.meaning: mother's brother; maternal uncle; wife's brother

examples.chinese: 她的舅舅是一位廚師，每次家族聚會都由他掌廚，大家都非常期待。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiùjiu shì yī wèi chúshī, měi cì jiāzú jùhuì dōu yóu tā zhǎng chú, dàjiā dōu fēicháng qīdài.
examples.english: Her maternal uncle is a chef — every family gathering has him cooking, and everyone looks forward to it greatly.

examples.chinese: 小時候，舅舅常常帶她去漁港看漁船回港，是她最美好的童年回憶之一。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhòu, jiùjiu chángcháng dài tā qù yúgǎng kàn yúchuán huí gǎng, shì tā zuì měihǎo de tóngnián huíyì zhī yī.
examples.english: As a child, her maternal uncle often took her to the fishing harbor to watch the boats come in — one of her fondest childhood memories.

semanticNote: 居 (dwell; unexpectedly) + 然 (so; like that) — unexpectedly; to one's surprise; go so far as to. Always implies that the outcome contradicts expectations. 他居然來了！(He actually showed up! — surprising). Contrasted with 果然 (sure enough — expectation confirmed). 居然 implies reversal; 果然 implies fulfillment.

examples.chinese: 他平時那麼怕生，在派對上居然主動跟陌生人攀談，大家都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā píngshí nàme pà shēng, zài pàiduì shàng jūrán zhǔdòng gēn mòshēng rén pāntán, dàjiā dōu xià le yī tiào.
examples.english: He's normally so shy around strangers, yet at the party he actually took the initiative to chat with people he didn't know — everyone was surprised.

examples.chinese: 這道菜看起來普通，吃了之後居然讓她感動到快哭出來，原來和媽媽做的味道一模一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài kàn qǐlái pǔtōng, chī le zhīhòu jūrán ràng tā gǎndòng dào kuài kū chūlái, yuánlái hé māma zuò de wèidào yīmú yīyàng.
examples.english: The dish looked ordinary, but after eating it she was unexpectedly moved almost to tears — it tasted exactly like her mother's cooking.

semanticNote: 桔 (tangerine) + 子 (noun suffix) — tangerine; mandarin orange. In Taiwan, 橘子 (júzi) is the more standard written form, while 桔子 (jú/jié) appears as a variant. 橘 (jú) is also the color orange. 金桔 (kumquat — a popular Taiwan garden plant and drink ingredient). During Lunar New Year, tangerines (橘子) symbolize good luck because 橘 sounds like 吉 (auspicious).

examples.chinese: 過年時，家家戶戶都會擺上幾顆橘子，象徵大吉大利、新年好運。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián shí, jiājiāhùhù dōu huì bǎi shàng jǐ kē júzi, xiàngzhēng dà jí dà lì, xīnnián hǎoyùn.
examples.english: During the Lunar New Year, every household places out tangerines to symbolize great fortune and good luck for the new year.

examples.chinese: 金桔檸檬是台灣夜市非常受歡迎的飲料，酸甜清爽，很適合夏天喝。
examples.pinyin: Jīnjú níngméng shì Táiwān yèshì fēicháng shòu huānyíng de yǐnliào, suān tián qīngshuǎng, hěn shìhé xiàtiān hē.
examples.english: Kumquat lemonade is a hugely popular drink at Taiwan's night markets — tart, sweet, and refreshing, perfect for summer.

semanticNote: 巨 (huge; enormous; great) + 大 (big; large) — immense; enormous; very large. 巨大的壓力 (enormous pressure), 巨大的變化 (massive change), 造成巨大影響 (have a tremendous impact). More emphatic than 很大 (very big) and 龐大 (massive). Common in formal, journalistic, and academic registers.

examples.chinese: 台灣921大地震造成了巨大的人員傷亡和財物損失，是台灣史上最嚴重的天災之一。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān 921 dà dìzhèn zàochéng le jùdà de rényuán shāngwáng hé cáiwù sǔnshī, shì Táiwān shǐ shàng zuì yánzhòng de tiānzāi zhī yī.
examples.english: The 921 earthquake caused immense casualties and property damage — one of the most devastating natural disasters in Taiwan's history.

examples.chinese: 人工智慧的快速發展對全球各行各業都帶來了巨大的衝擊與機遇。
examples.pinyin: Réngōng zhìhuì de kuàisù fāzhǎn duì quánqiú gèháng gèyè dōu dài lái le jùdà de chōngjí yǔ jīyù.
examples.english: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has brought enormous disruption and opportunity to every industry around the world.

semanticNote: 具 (possess; tool; implement) + 備 (prepare; equip; complete) — to possess; to be equipped with; to have (qualifications, conditions, or capabilities). 具備條件 (meet the conditions), 具備能力 (have the ability), 具備資格 (be qualified). More formal than 有 (have). Frequently used in job requirements: 需具備相關工作經驗。

components.meaning: possess; tool; implement; (measure word for equipment)

examples.chinese: 這個職位要求應徵者具備至少三年的相關工作經驗與良好的溝通能力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhíwèi yāoqiú yìngzhēngzhě jùbèi zhìshǎo sān nián de xiāngguān gōngzuò jīngyàn yǔ liánghǎo de gōutōng nénglì.
examples.english: This position requires candidates to possess at least three years of relevant work experience and strong communication skills.

examples.chinese: 她認為一個好的領導者需要具備同理心、決斷力和持續學習的精神。
examples.pinyin: Tā rènwéi yī gè hǎo de lǐngdǎozhě xūyào jùbèi tónglǐxīn, juéduànlì hé chíxù xuéxí de jīngshen.
examples.english: She believes that a good leader needs to possess empathy, decisiveness, and a spirit of continuous learning.

semanticNote: 具 (possess; concrete) + 體 (body; form; system) — concrete; specific; definite. 具體說明 (explain specifically), 具體措施 (concrete measures), 不夠具體 (not specific enough). As an adverb: 具體來說... (specifically speaking; to be concrete...). Contrasted with 抽象 (abstract). Extremely common in business, academic, and government communication.

examples.chinese: 請你說得具體一點，到底需要我做什麼，這樣我才能有效率地完成。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuō de jùtǐ yīdiǎn, dàodǐ xūyào wǒ zuò shénme, zhèyàng wǒ cái néng yǒuxiàolǜ de wánchéng.
examples.english: Please be more specific — exactly what do you need me to do? That way I can complete it efficiently.

examples.chinese: 政府公布了減碳的具體目標：2030年碳排放量減少50%，2050年達到淨零排放。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ gōngbù le jiǎn tàn de jùtǐ mùbiāo: 2030 nián tàn páifàng liàng jiǎnshǎo 50%, 2050 nián dádào jìng líng páifàng.
examples.english: The government announced specific carbon reduction targets: cut carbon emissions by 50% by 2030 and achieve net-zero by 2050.

semanticNote: 俱 (all together) + 樂 (pleasure; enjoy) + 部 (section; group; department) — a club or organization formed around a shared interest or activity. 讀書俱樂部 (book club), 高爾夫俱樂部 (golf club), 夜店俱樂部 (nightclub). The word 俱樂部 is a phonetic borrowing from 'club.' In Taiwan, 社團 (club — at school) and 協會 (association) are more common alternatives.

examples.chinese: 她加入了學校的攝影俱樂部，每個週末和同學一起出去拍照探索台北。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiārù le xuéxiào de shèyǐng jùlèbù, měi gè zhōumò hé tóngxué yīqǐ chūqù pāizhào tànsuǒ Táiběi.
examples.english: She joined the school's photography club and goes out with classmates every weekend to shoot photos around Taipei.

examples.chinese: 這個讀書俱樂部每月選一本書，成員們在讀完後聚在一起分享心得。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dúshū jùlèbù měi yuè xuǎn yī běn shū, chéngyuánmen zài dú wán hòu jù zài yīqǐ fēnxiǎng xīndé.
examples.english: This book club selects one book per month; after reading it, members gather to share their thoughts.

semanticNote: 據 (according to; base; rely on) + 說 (say; speak) — it is said that; reportedly; allegedly. Introduces information heard from others without personally verifying it. 據說那家店很好吃 (I've heard that restaurant is great). Similar to 聽說 but slightly more formal. Often used in news reporting for unconfirmed information.

components.meaning: according to; base; rely on; evidence

examples.chinese: 據說這間廟有兩百多年的歷史，是附近香火最旺的廟宇之一。
examples.pinyin: Jùshuō zhè jiān miào yǒu liǎng bǎi duō nián de lìshǐ, shì fùjìn xiānghuo zuì wàng de miàoyǔ zhī yī.
examples.english: It is said this temple has over two hundred years of history and is one of the most popular temples in the area.

examples.chinese: 據說那家新開的珍奶店排隊要等一個小時，但喝過的人都說值得。
examples.pinyin: Jùshuō nà jiā xīn kāi de zhēnnǎi diàn páiduì yào děng yī gè xiǎoshí, dàn hē guò de rén dōu shuō zhídé.
examples.english: Reportedly, the queue at that newly opened bubble tea shop is an hour long, but everyone who's tried it says it's worth it.

semanticNote: 捐 — to donate, contribute, or subscribe to (a cause). 捐款 (donate money), 捐血 (donate blood), 捐器官 (donate organs), 捐衣物 (donate clothing). In Taiwan, blood donation (捐血) is actively promoted by the 捐血中心 (Blood Donation Center). Organ donation (器官捐贈) is a sensitive but increasingly discussed topic.

examples.chinese: 八八風災後，全台民眾踴躍捐款，數天內就募集了超過十億元的救災資金。
examples.pinyin: Bābā fēngzāi hòu, quán Tái mínzhòng yǒngyuè juānkuǎn, shù tiān nèi jiù mùjí le chāoguò shí yì yuán de jiùzāi zījīn.
examples.english: After Typhoon Morakot, people across Taiwan donated generously; in just a few days over a billion NT dollars in disaster relief funds were raised.

examples.chinese: 他定期去捐血，認為這是最簡單也最直接能幫助他人的方式。
examples.pinyin: Tā dìngqī qù juān xuè, rènwéi zhè shì zuì jiǎndān yě zuì zhíjiē néng bāngzhù tārén de fāngshì.
examples.english: He donates blood regularly, believing it is the simplest and most direct way to help others.

semanticNote: 決 (decide; determine) + 賽 (competition; race; match) — a final match or championship round. 進入決賽 (advance to the finals), 決賽選手 (finalist), 冠軍決賽 (championship final). Contrasted with 初賽 (preliminary round) and 複賽/準決賽 (semifinal). In Taiwan: 世界棒球經典賽決賽 (World Baseball Classic finals) draws wide attention.

examples.chinese: 台灣棒球代表隊打進了世界大賽的決賽，全國球迷熱血沸騰，守夜收看轉播。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān bàngqiú dàibiǎoduì dǎ jìn le shìjiè dàsài de juésài, quánguó qiúmí rèxuè fèiténg, shǒuyè shōukàn zhuǎnbō.
examples.english: Taiwan's national baseball team made it to the World Series finals; fans across the country were fired up and stayed up all night watching the broadcast.

examples.chinese: 進入決賽的六位選手都是各地的優秀廚師，最終由評審評選出冠軍。
examples.pinyin: Jìnrù juésài de liù wèi xuǎnshǒu dōu shì gèdì de yōuxiù chúshī, zuìzhōng yóu píngshěn píngxuǎn chū guànjūn.
examples.english: The six finalists were all outstanding chefs from various regions, with judges ultimately selecting the champion.

semanticNote: 決 (decide; determine) + 心 (heart; mind; resolve) — determination; resolution; to make up one's mind. 下定決心 (make a firm decision), 充滿決心 (full of determination), 決心已定 (one's mind is made up). 決心書 (written pledge/resolution). As a verb: 她決心要改變 (she is determined to change).

examples.chinese: 她下定決心要在三十歲前完成一次馬拉松，並開始了嚴格的訓練計畫。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàdìng juéxīn yào zài sānshí suì qián wánchéng yī cì mǎlāsōng, bìng kāishǐ le yángé de xùnliàn jìhuà.
examples.english: She made up her mind to complete a marathon before she turned thirty and began a rigorous training plan.

examples.chinese: 面對強大的對手，球隊充滿決心地踏上賽場，沒有人想輕易放棄。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì qiángdà de duìshǒu, qiúduì chōngmǎn juéxīn de tà shàng sàichǎng, méiyǒu rén xiǎng qīngyì fàngqì.
examples.english: Facing powerful opponents, the team took to the field full of determination — no one was willing to give up easily.

semanticNote: 角 (role; angle; horn; jué) + 色 (color; appearance; sex; role) — a role or character (in a film, play, game, or social context). 扮演角色 (play a role), 主角 (main character), 配角 (supporting role), 反派角色 (villain role). Also used figuratively: 在這件事中扮演重要角色 (play an important role in this matter).

examples.chinese: 她在這部台劇中扮演一位堅強的女性角色，演技獲得觀眾的高度好評。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè bù tái jù zhōng bànyǎn yī wèi jiānqiáng de nǚxìng juésè, yǎnjì huòdé guānzhòng de gāodù hǎopíng.
examples.english: She plays a strong female character in this Taiwanese drama, and her acting has received high praise from viewers.

examples.chinese: 政府在促進兩岸和平方面扮演著至關重要的角色，不可輕忽。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài cùjìn liǎng'àn hépíng fāngmiàn bànyǎn zhe zhìguān zhòngyào de juésè, bùkě qīnghū.
examples.english: The government plays a critically important role in promoting cross-strait peace and must not be taken lightly.

semanticNote: 絕 (cut off; absolute; extreme; exhausted) + 對 (correct; face; toward; pair) — absolute; definite; absolutely. 絕對不行 (absolutely not), 絕對正確 (absolutely correct), 絕對優勢 (absolute advantage). As an intensifying adverb, 絕對 is stronger and more definitive than 一定 (certainly) and 肯定 (definitely).

components.meaning: cut off; absolute; extreme; unique; exhausted

examples.chinese: 這件事我絕對不會妥協，因為這涉及到原則問題，不是可以讓步的地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ juéduì bù huì tuǒxié, yīnwèi zhè shèjí dào yuánzé wèntí, bùshì kěyǐ ràngbù de dìfang.
examples.english: I will absolutely not compromise on this — it's a matter of principle, not something I can give ground on.

examples.chinese: 到了台南，絕對要去吃一碗正宗的牛肉湯，這是行家的共識。
examples.pinyin: Dào le Táinán, juéduì yào qù chī yī wǎn zhèngzōng de niúròu tāng, zhè shì hángjiā de gòngshí.
examples.english: When you get to Tainan, you absolutely must have a bowl of authentic beef soup — that's the consensus among those who know.

semanticNote: 軍 (army; military) + 事 (affair; matter; event) — military affairs; military matters. 軍事基地 (military base), 軍事演習 (military exercise/drill), 軍事同盟 (military alliance). In the Taiwan context, cross-strait military tensions (軍事對峙) and US arms sales (軍售) are frequently discussed. Taiwan's conscription system (義務役) involves all male citizens.

examples.chinese: 台灣持續增加國防預算，加強軍事實力以應對潛在的安全威脅。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān chíxù zēngjiā guófáng yùsuàn, jiāqiáng jūnshì shílì yǐ yìngduì qiánzài de ānquán wēixié.
examples.english: Taiwan continues to increase its defense budget, strengthening its military capabilities to address potential security threats.

examples.chinese: 他在服役期間受過嚴格的軍事訓練，退伍後體能和紀律都保持得很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fúyì qījiān shòuguò yángé de jūnshì xùnliàn, tuì wǔ hòu tǐnéng hé jìlǜ dōu bǎochí de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He received rigorous military training during his service; after discharge, his physical fitness and discipline remained excellent.

semanticNote: 均 (equal; even; all) + 勻 (even; smooth; well-distributed) — even; well-distributed; uniform. 分佈均勻 (evenly distributed), 加熱均勻 (heat evenly), 膚色均勻 (even skin tone). Used in cooking, manufacturing, statistics, and beauty contexts. Contrasted with 不均勻 (uneven; lumpy).

examples.chinese: 製作麵包時，要把奶油均勻地塗在麵糰表面，這樣烤出來的顏色才會漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhìzuò miànbāo shí, yào bǎ nǎiyóu jūnyún de tú zài miàntuán biǎomiàn, zhèyàng kǎo chūlái de yánsè cái huì piàoliang.
examples.english: When making bread, spread the butter evenly over the surface of the dough so the baked color will turn out beautiful.

examples.chinese: 她每天使用防曬乳，臉上的膚色均勻又透亮，比同齡人看起來年輕許多。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān shǐyòng fángshài rǔ, liǎn shàng de fūsè jūnyún yòu tòuliàng, bǐ tónglíng rén kàn qǐlái niánqīng xǔduō.
examples.english: She uses sunscreen every day; her complexion is even and radiant, making her look much younger than her peers.

semanticNote: 卡 (card; clip; checkpoint; loanword for 'car'/'truck') + 車 (vehicle) — a truck (large goods vehicle). 大卡車 (big rig; heavy truck), 小卡車 (pickup truck; light truck), 卡車司機 (truck driver). 卡 here is a phonetic borrowing. In Taiwan, 台灣好行 tour buses and freight 卡車 share major highways. Truck drivers (卡車司機) are an important part of the logistics workforce.

examples.chinese: 一輛滿載貨物的大卡車在山路上拋錨，導致後方車輛大排長龍。
examples.pinyin: Yī liàng mǎnzài huòwù de dà kǎchē zài shānlù shàng pāo máo, dǎozhì hòufāng chēliàng dà pái cháng lóng.
examples.english: A large truck loaded with cargo broke down on a mountain road, causing a long line of vehicles behind it.

examples.chinese: 夜間，高速公路上的貨運卡車特別多，司機們趁夜間路況較好時趕路。
examples.pinyin: Yèjiān, gāosù gōnglù shàng de huòyùn kǎchē tèbié duō, sījīmen chèn yèjiān lù kuàng jiào hǎo shí gǎn lù.
examples.english: At night, there are especially many freight trucks on the highway as drivers take advantage of better traffic conditions to make their run.

semanticNote: 開 (open; start) + 發 (develop; send out; start) — to develop or exploit (resources, software, land, etc.). 軟體開發 (software development), 開發新市場 (develop new markets), 房地產開發 (real estate development), 開發中國家 (developing countries). One of the most common terms in Taiwan's tech industry.

components.meaning: develop; send out; start; emit; hair

examples.chinese: 台灣的科技公司在AI晶片開發領域投入了大量資源，競爭激烈。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de kējì gōngsī zài AI jīngpiàn kāifā lǐngyù tóurù le dàliàng zīyuán, jìngzhēng jīliè.
examples.english: Taiwan's tech companies have poured substantial resources into AI chip development, where competition is fierce.

examples.chinese: 政府計劃開發花東地區的觀光資源，同時注重生態保育與原住民族文化保存。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà kāifā Huā Dōng dìqū de guānguāng zīyuán, tóngshí zhùzhòng shēngtài bǎoyù yǔ yuánzhùmínzú wénhuà bǎocún.
examples.english: The government plans to develop tourism resources in the Hualien-Taitung region while prioritizing ecological conservation and indigenous cultural preservation.

semanticNote: 開 (open) + 放 (release; let go; open) — open; open-minded; liberal; to open up (a restriction or space). 開放政策 (open policy), 思想開放 (open-minded), 開放給民眾參觀 (open to the public for visiting). In Taiwan: 開放政府資料 (open government data), 市場開放 (market liberalization). Contrasted with 保守 (conservative).

components.meaning: release; let go; open; put; graze

examples.chinese: 台灣社會相對開放，對於多元文化、性別議題和新思想的接受度都相當高。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì xiāngduì kāifàng, duìyú duōyuán wénhuà, xìngbié yìtí hé xīn sīxiǎng de jiēshòu dù dōu xiāngdāng gāo.
examples.english: Taiwanese society is relatively open, with quite high acceptance of multiculturalism, gender issues, and new ideas.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，這座公園重新對外開放，市民紛紛前來散步放鬆。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, zhè zuò gōngyuán chóngxīn duì wài kāifàng, shìmín fēnfēn qiánlái sànbù fàngsōng.
examples.english: After the typhoon, this park reopened to the public, with citizens streaming in to take walks and relax.

semanticNote: 開 (open) + 幕 (curtain; backdrop; act of a play) + 式 (ceremony; style; formula) — an opening ceremony. 運動會開幕式 (sports meet opening ceremony), 奧運開幕式 (Olympic opening ceremony), 展覽開幕式 (exhibition opening). Contrasted with 閉幕式 (closing ceremony). 開幕式表演 (opening ceremony performance).

examples.chinese: 台灣燈會的開幕式吸引了數萬名民眾到場觀看，現場煙火燦爛，燈海壯觀。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān Dēnghuì de kāimùshì xīyǐn le shù wàn míng mínzhòng dàochǎng guānkàn, xiànchǎng yānhuǒ cànlàn, dēnghǎi zhuànguān.
examples.english: The opening ceremony of the Taiwan Lantern Festival attracted tens of thousands of people; the fireworks were dazzling and the sea of lanterns magnificent.

examples.chinese: 全運會開幕式由各縣市代表隊依序入場，展現了台灣各地多元的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Quán yùnhuì kāimùshì yóu gè xiàn shì dàibiǎoduì yīxù rùchǎng, zhǎnxiàn le Táiwān gèdì duōyuán de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: At the National Games opening ceremony, teams from each county and city entered in sequence, showcasing the diverse cultural characteristics of different parts of Taiwan.

semanticNote: 開 (open; boil) + 水 (water) — boiled water; water that has been boiled. 喝開水 (drink boiled water), 燒開水 (boil water). In Taiwan, drinking boiled or filtered water (過濾水) is the norm; tap water (自來水) is technically drinkable in Taipei but many still boil or filter it. 開水機 (hot water dispenser — found in every school, office, and hospital).

examples.chinese: 學校走廊上設有開水機，學生可以隨時接熱水或溫水來喝。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zǒuláng shàng shè yǒu kāishuǐjī, xuéshēng kěyǐ suíshí jiē rèshuǐ huò wēnshuǐ lái hē.
examples.english: The school hallway has a hot water dispenser where students can get hot or warm boiled water at any time.

examples.chinese: 出門前她泡了一杯茶，把剩下的開水倒進保溫瓶帶著走。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián tā pào le yī bēi chá, bǎ shèngxia de kāishuǐ dào jìn bǎowēn píng dài zhe zǒu.
examples.english: Before heading out, she brewed a cup of tea and poured the remaining boiled water into a thermos to take with her.

semanticNote: 砍 — to chop, hack, or cut (with a blade or axe). 砍樹 (chop down a tree), 砍價 (haggle; negotiate a lower price — very colloquial in Taiwan), 砍一刀 (cut once; take a slice — also slang for 'share a red-envelope or money request' in online games/apps). The colloquial 砍價 sense is extremely common in Taiwan market culture.

components.meaning: chop; hack; cut with a blade

examples.chinese: 工人用電鋸把被颱風吹倒的大樹砍成幾段，方便清運。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrén yòng diànjù bǎ bèi táifēng chuī dǎo de dà shù kǎn chéng jǐ duàn, fāngbiàn qīng yùn.
examples.english: Workers used a chainsaw to chop the tree felled by the typhoon into several sections for easier removal.

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西可以試著砍價，老闆通常會讓步一點，這是一種樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi kěyǐ shì zhe kǎnjià, lǎobǎn tōngcháng huì ràngbù yīdiǎn, zhè shì yī zhǒng lèqù.
examples.english: When shopping at night markets, you can try haggling — the vendor usually budges a little, and it's all part of the fun.

semanticNote: 看 (look) + 不起 (not able to; can't afford) — to look down upon; to despise; to hold in contempt. 別看不起人 (Don't look down on people). The opposite is 看得起 (to think highly of; to respect). A common social register marker — in Taiwan, 瞧不起 is a near-synonym. Related: 自視過高 (think too highly of oneself).

components.meaning: cannot; not able to; unworthy of

examples.chinese: 她從來不看不起任何人，認為每個人都有自己的價值和潛力。
examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái bù kàn bu qǐ rènhé rén, rènwéi měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí hé qiánlì.
examples.english: She never looks down on anyone, believing that every person has their own value and potential.

examples.chinese: 他因為家境不好曾被同學看不起，但這反而激勵了他更努力向上。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi jiājìng bù hǎo céng bèi tóngxué kàn bu qǐ, dàn zhè fǎn'ér jīlì le tā gèng nǔlì xiàng shàng.
examples.english: He was once looked down upon by classmates because of his poor family circumstances, but this actually spurred him to work even harder.

semanticNote: 看 (see; look) + 望 (look toward; hope; visit) — to visit (someone); to call on someone (often an elder, patient, or someone in need). 探望 is a close synonym. 看望病人 (visit a patient), 看望父母 (visit one's parents). More formal and considerate-sounding than 去看 (go see). Implies care and a meaningful visit.

examples.chinese: 她每個月都會抽時間回台南看望外婆，順便帶一些台北的特產。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi gè yuè dōu huì chōu shíjiān huí Táinán kànwàng wàipó, shùnbiàn dài yīxiē Táiběi de tèchǎn.
examples.english: She makes time every month to go back to Tainan to visit her maternal grandmother, bringing along some Taipei specialties.

examples.chinese: 地震過後，志工團體前往受災鄉鎮看望獨居老人，確認他們的安危。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu, zhìgōng tuántǐ qiánwǎng shòuzāi xiāngzhèn kànwàng dújū lǎorén, quèrèn tāmen de ānwēi.
examples.english: After the earthquake, volunteer groups visited disaster-stricken townships to call on elderly people living alone and confirm their safety.

semanticNote: 靠 — to lean on; to depend on; to be near; to trust. 靠牆站 (stand against the wall), 靠朋友的幫助 (rely on friends' help), 靠近 (approach; be close to), 靠邊停車 (pull over). 靠得住 (dependable; trustworthy — colloquial). 可靠 (reliable) uses this character. In Taiwan public transit: 靠站 (pull into the station).

components.meaning: lean on; rely on; near; depend on; trust

examples.chinese: 她靠著自己的努力考上了醫學系，沒有靠任何人的關係。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zhe zìjǐ de nǔlì kǎo shàng le yīxué xì, méiyǒu kào rènhé rén de guānxi.
examples.english: She got into medical school through her own hard work, without relying on any connections.

examples.chinese: 公車靠站後，乘客依序下車，不推不擠，秩序井然。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchē kào zhàn hòu, chéngkè yīxù xià chē, bù tuī bù jǐ, zhìxù jǐngrán.
examples.english: After the bus pulled into the stop, passengers disembarked in order without pushing or jostling — all perfectly orderly.

semanticNote: 顆 — measure word for small, round, or bead-like objects: seeds, pills, bullets, stars, teeth, hearts (figuratively), and small fruit. 一顆心 (a heart), 一顆星 (a star), 一顆牙 (a tooth), 一顆藥 (a pill), 一顆鑽石 (a diamond). Contrasted with 粒 (grained, tinier things like rice or sand) and 個 (general).

components.meaning: measure word for small round objects; grain; kernel

examples.chinese: 醫師開了三顆藥讓她在睡前服用，說可以幫助睡眠。
examples.pinyin: Yīshī kāi le sān kē yào ràng tā zài shuì qián fúyòng, shuō kěyǐ bāngzhù shuìmián.
examples.english: The doctor prescribed three pills for her to take before bed, saying they would help with sleep.

examples.chinese: 她在布農族文化村看到了一顆顆形狀奇特的原住民傳統珠子，色彩繽紛。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Bùnóng zú wénhuà cūn kàndào le yī kē kē xíngzhuàng qítè de yuánzhùmínzú chuántǒng zhūzi, sècǎi bīnfēn.
examples.english: At the Bunun cultural village she saw beads of unique shapes from indigenous traditional crafts, in a riot of colors.

semanticNote: 可 (can; may; worth) + 見 (see; visible; appear) — it is clear that; it can be seen that; evidently. Used to introduce a logical conclusion drawn from evidence: 由此可見... (it can be seen from this that...). More formal than 所以 (therefore) and implies the conclusion is visually or logically apparent from what was just stated.

examples.chinese: 他三更半夜還在燈下苦讀，可見他對這次考試有多重視。
examples.pinyin: Tā sāngēng bànyè hái zài dēng xià kǔ dú, kějiàn tā duì zhè cì kǎoshì yǒu duō zhòngshì.
examples.english: He was still studying by lamplight in the dead of night — it's clear how seriously he takes this exam.

examples.chinese: 這道菜供不應求，可見它的口味已經得到了廣大消費者的認可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài gōng bù yìng qiú, kějiàn tā de kǒuwèi yǐjīng dédào le guǎngdà xiāofèizhě de rènkě.
examples.english: This dish can't keep up with demand — it's evident that its flavor has earned the approval of consumers far and wide.

semanticNote: 可 (can; worth) + 靠 (rely on; depend on) — reliable; dependable; trustworthy. 可靠的朋友 (a reliable friend), 可靠的消息來源 (a reliable source of information), 可靠度 (reliability). The antonym is 不可靠 (unreliable). In Taiwan tech contexts, 系統可靠度 (system reliability) is important in hardware/software engineering discussions.

components.meaning: rely on; depend on; lean on; near

examples.chinese: 他是個非常可靠的人，答應過的事從來不會爽約，大家都很信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè fēicháng kěkào de rén, dāyìng guò de shì cónglái bù huì shuǎngyuē, dàjiā dōu hěn xìnrèn tā.
examples.english: He is an extremely reliable person — he never breaks a promise he's made, and everyone trusts him greatly.

examples.chinese: 在選擇資訊來源時，必須確認其是否可靠，避免被假新聞誤導。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuǎnzé zīxùn láiyuán shí, bìxū quèrèn qí shìfǒu kěkào, bìmiǎn bèi jiǎ xīnwén wùdǎo.
examples.english: When choosing information sources, you must verify whether they are reliable to avoid being misled by fake news.

semanticNote: 可 (can; worth; -able) + 怕 (fear; dread; be afraid) — terrible; awful; frightening; scary. 真可怕！(How frightening!/That's awful!) Can describe physical danger (這條路夜裡很可怕) or extreme severity (後果很可怕). Also used hyperbolically in Taiwan casual speech: 這道題難得可怕 (This problem is ridiculously hard).

examples.chinese: 颱風過境時，窗外的風聲大得可怕，整棟樓都在搖晃。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòjìng shí, chuāng wài de fēngshēng dà de kěpà, zhěng dòng lóu dōu zài yáohuàng.
examples.english: When the typhoon passed through, the sound of the wind outside was terrifying — the whole building was shaking.

examples.chinese: 網路霸凌的殺傷力可怕，已有多起青少年因此輕生的悲劇發生。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù bàlíng de shāshānglì kěpà, yǐ yǒu duō qǐ qīngshàonián yīncǐ qīngshēng de bēijù fāshēng.
examples.english: The destructive power of cyberbullying is frightening — there have already been multiple tragedies of young people taking their own lives because of it.

semanticNote: 克 — (1) gram (unit of weight, from French 'gramme'). (2) To overcome; to restrain; to conquer. 克服困難 (overcome difficulties), 克己 (restrain oneself), 千克 (kilogram). As a weight unit: 一百克糖 (100 grams of sugar). The dual meaning is unrelated in etymology; the weight sense is a phonetic borrowing.

examples.chinese: 食譜上寫著需要200克的低筋麵粉，她仔細用電子秤量好了再加入。
examples.pinyin: Shípǔ shàng xiě zhe xūyào 200 kè de dī jīn miànfěn, tā zǐxì yòng diànzǐ chèng liáng hǎo le zài jiārù.
examples.english: The recipe called for 200 grams of cake flour; she carefully weighed it on a digital scale before adding it.

examples.chinese: 她花了好幾個月才克服對公開演講的恐懼，現在能自信地在台上發言了。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le hǎo jǐ gè yuè cái kèfú duì gōngkāi yǎnjiǎng de kǒngjù, xiànzài néng zìxìn de zài tái shàng fāyán le.
examples.english: It took her several months to overcome her fear of public speaking; now she can confidently speak on stage.

semanticNote: 克 (overcome; restrain) + 服 (submit; comply; convince; clothing) — to overcome or surmount (a difficulty, fear, or obstacle). 克服困難 (overcome difficulties), 克服恐懼 (conquer a fear), 克服障礙 (surmount obstacles). Implies active effort against resistance. A common encouragement phrase: 只要努力，一定能克服！

examples.chinese: 雖然語言是一大障礙，但她憑著毅力克服了，終於在國外站穩了腳步。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán yǔyán shì yī dà zhàng'ài, dàn tā píng zhe yìlì kèfú le, zhōngyú zài guówài zhàn wěn le jiǎobù.
examples.english: Although language was a major barrier, she overcome it through sheer perseverance and finally found her footing abroad.

examples.chinese: 這次的工程難度很高，但工程師團隊發揮創意，逐一克服了所有技術問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de gōngchéng nándù hěn gāo, dàn gōngchéngshī tuánduì fāhuī chuàngyì, zhúyī kèfú le suǒyǒu jìshù wèntí.
examples.english: This project was highly challenging, but the engineering team applied creativity to overcome every technical problem one by one.

semanticNote: 刻 (carve; engrave; moment; harsh) + 苦 (bitter; hard; suffering) — hardworking; assiduous; willing to endure hardship for a goal. 刻苦學習 (study diligently through hardship), 刻苦耐勞 (industrious and patient — a common praise). Implies both determination and willingness to endure physical or mental discomfort. More formal than 勤奮 (diligent).

examples.chinese: 他家境貧寒，但靠著刻苦求學的精神考上了頂尖大學，令師長刮目相看。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiājìng pínhán, dàn kào zhe kèkǔ qiúxué de jīngshen kǎo shàng le dǐngjiān dàxué, lìng shīzhǎng guāmù xiāng kàn.
examples.english: His family was poor, but through an assiduous spirit of hard study he got into a top university, earning the admiration of teachers and elders.

examples.chinese: 這位藝術家多年來刻苦磨練技藝，作品終於在國際展覽上獲得了肯定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā duō nián lái kèkǔ mólián jìyì, zuòpǐn zhōngyú zài guójì zhǎnlǎn shàng huòdé le kěndìng.
examples.english: This artist spent years painstakingly honing their craft, and their works finally received recognition at an international exhibition.

semanticNote: 客 (guest; visitor; objective — as opposed to the subject) + 觀 (view; observe; perspective) — objective; impartial; unbiased. 客觀評估 (objective assessment), 保持客觀 (remain objective), 客觀事實 (objective facts). Contrasted with 主觀 (subjective). Widely used in journalism, academic writing, legal reasoning, and everyday debate in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 記者的報導應該力求客觀，呈現各方立場，而不是只報導單一觀點。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě de bàodǎo yīnggāi lìqiú kèguān, chéngxiàn gè fāng lìchǎng, ér bùshì zhǐ bàodǎo dānyī guāndiǎn.
examples.english: Journalists' reporting should strive to be objective, presenting all sides' positions rather than covering only a single viewpoint.

examples.chinese: 請你客觀地評估一下自己的能力，不要過度自信，也不要妄自菲薄。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ kèguān de pínggū yīxià zìjǐ de nénglì, bùyào guòdù zìxìn, yě bùyào wàng zì fěi bó.
examples.english: Please make an objective assessment of your own abilities — don't be overconfident, but don't sell yourself short either.

semanticNote: 課 (class; lesson; subject; tax) + 程 (procedure; distance; schedule; course) — a course, curriculum, or class schedule. 修課程 (take a course), 課程設計 (curriculum design), 學程 (program of study). In Taiwan: 108課綱 (the 2019 curriculum guidelines — a major curriculum reform in Taiwan's K-12 education).

examples.chinese: 她這學期選了五門課程，包括統計學、行銷學和一門日文選修課。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè xuéqī xuǎn le wǔ mén kèchéng, bāokuò tǒngjìxué, xíngxiāoxué hé yī mén rìwén xuǎnxiū kè.
examples.english: This semester she enrolled in five courses, including statistics, marketing, and one Japanese elective.

examples.chinese: 108課綱強調素養導向，希望學生不只記知識，更要學習如何應用和思考。
examples.pinyin: 108 kè gāng qiángdiào sùyǎng dǎoxiàng, xīwàng xuéshēng bùzhǐ jì zhīshi, gèng yào xuéxí rúhé yìngyòng hé sīkǎo.
examples.english: The 108 Curriculum Guidelines emphasize competency-oriented learning, hoping students not only memorize knowledge but also learn how to apply and think critically.

semanticNote: 空 (empty; sky; space; free time) + 間 (space; room; between) — space (physical, temporal, or metaphorical). 生活空間 (living space), 創作空間 (creative space), 外太空 (outer space). 空間感 (sense of space — in interior design). In Taiwan urban contexts, 居住空間不足 (insufficient living space) is a real issue given high housing costs.

components.meaning: empty; sky; space; free time; in vain

examples.chinese: 台北的房價高得嚇人，很多人只能在市中心租很小的空間居住。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi de fángjià gāo de xiàrén, hěn duō rén zhǐ néng zài shì zhōngxīn zū hěn xiǎo de kōngjiān jūzhù.
examples.english: Housing prices in Taipei are alarmingly high; many people can only afford to rent a very small space in the city center.

examples.chinese: 她把客廳重新佈置了一番，創造出更多收納空間，整體感覺寬敞多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ kètīng chóngxīn bùzhì le yī fān, chuàngzào chū gèng duō shōunà kōngjiān, zhěngtǐ gǎnjué kuānchǎng duō le.
examples.english: She redecorated the living room to create more storage space; the overall feel is much more spacious now.

semanticNote: 空 (empty; free time) + 閒 (leisure; idle; free) — free time; leisure; idle. 利用空閒時間 (use one's free time), 空閒的時候 (when one is free), 有空閒 (have leisure). Written 空閒 (with 閒); some write 空暇 (variant). In Taiwan: 有空嗎？(Are you free? — very common) uses the related 有空 pattern.

examples.chinese: 她利用工作之餘的空閒時間學攝影，現在已經拍得相當不錯了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng gōngzuò zhī yú de kòngxián shíjiān xué shèyǐng, xiànzài yǐjīng pāi de xiāngdāng bùcuò le.
examples.english: She uses her free time outside of work to learn photography and has already gotten quite good at it.

examples.chinese: 週末有空閒的時候，他喜歡騎腳踏車到淡水沿河邊騎一圈，放鬆心情。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò yǒu kòngxián de shíhòu, tā xǐhuān qí jiǎotàchē dào Dànshuǐ yán hébiān qí yī quān, fàngsōng xīnqíng.
examples.english: When he has free time on weekends, he likes to ride his bicycle along the Danshui riverside for a loop to relax.

semanticNote: 控 (control; accuse; restrict) + 制 (system; regulate; make; limit) — to control; to regulate; to hold in check. 自我控制 (self-control), 遙控 (remote control), 控制情緒 (control one's emotions), 控制成本 (control costs). In medicine: 血糖控制 (blood sugar management). One of the most versatile verbs in formal Mandarin.

examples.chinese: 她學會了控制自己在壓力下的情緒反應，不再容易被小事激怒。
examples.pinyin: Tā xuéhuì le kòngzhì zìjǐ zài yālì xià de qíngxù fǎnyìng, bù zài róngyì bèi xiǎoshì jīnù.
examples.english: She has learned to control her emotional reactions under pressure and no longer gets easily angered by small things.

examples.chinese: 政府透過稅收政策控制房地產市場的過度炒作，穩定住宅價格。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tòuguò shuìshōu zhèngcè kòngzhì fángdìchǎn shìchǎng de guòdù chǎozuò, wěndìng zhùzhái jiàgé.
examples.english: The government uses tax policies to control speculative overheating in the real estate market and stabilize residential prices.

semanticNote: 口 (mouth; taste) + 味 (flavor; taste; smell) — a person's taste preferences; a flavor profile. 口味重 (strong-flavored; likes bold flavors), 口味清淡 (light palate), 合口味 (to one's liking; suits one's taste). Extends metaphorically to aesthetic preferences: 這部電影很合我的口味 (This film is right up my alley).

examples.chinese: 南部人口味偏甜，北部人口味偏鹹，這是台灣飲食文化中有趣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Nán bù rén kǒuwèi piān tián, běi bù rén kǒuwèi piān xián, zhè shì Táiwān yǐnshí wénhuà zhōng yǒuqù de chāyì.
examples.english: People in southern Taiwan tend to prefer sweeter flavors while northerners lean saltier — an interesting difference in Taiwan's food culture.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜非常合她的口味，特別是那道三杯雞，鮮香濃郁，讓她念念不忘。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài fēicháng hé tā de kǒuwèi, tèbié shì nà dào sān bēi jī, xiān xiāng nóngyù, ràng tā niànniàn bù wàng.
examples.english: The food at this restaurant suits her taste perfectly — especially the three-cup chicken, fragrant and rich, which she can't stop thinking about.

semanticNote: 誇 — to praise; to boast; to exaggerate. 誇獎 (praise; compliment), 誇大 (exaggerate; overstate), 誇口 (boast), 誇張 (exaggerated; over the top). In Taiwan, 誇張 is very common in casual speech: 你太誇張了！(You're too much!/That's excessive!). The simplified form 夸 = traditional 誇.

examples.chinese: 老師誇獎他這次報告做得非常出色，還在全班面前特別表揚了他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī kuājiǎng tā zhè cì bàogào zuò de fēicháng chūsè, hái zài quánbān miànqián tèbié biǎoyáng le tā.
examples.english: The teacher praised his report as exceptional and even gave him special recognition in front of the whole class.

examples.chinese: 他這個人喜歡誇大其詞，說的話不可盡信，要自己去判斷。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège rén xǐhuān kuādà qí cí, shuō de huà bù kě jìn xìn, yào zìjǐ qù pànduàn.
examples.english: He tends to exaggerate — don't take everything he says at face value; you need to judge for yourself.

semanticNote: 會 (can; meeting; accounting) + 計 (count; calculate; plan) — an accountant; the field of accounting. 會計師 (CPA; certified accountant), 會計系 (accounting department), 財務會計 (financial accounting), 管理會計 (managerial accounting). In Taiwan, the 會計師考試 is a highly competitive national licensing exam. Note the unusual pronunciation: kuài (not huì) for 會 in this compound.

examples.chinese: 她考取了會計師執照後，在一家四大事務所擔任審計員，薪資相當優渥。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎoqǔ le kuàijìshī zhízhào hòu, zài yī jiā sì dà shìwùsuǒ dānrèn shěnjì yuán, xīnzī xiāngdāng yōuwò.
examples.english: After obtaining her CPA license, she worked as an auditor at one of the Big Four firms with a very competitive salary.

examples.chinese: 每年到了報稅季，許多小企業主都會找會計師協助處理繁複的稅務申報。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dào le bàoshuì jì, xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè zhǔ dōu huì zhǎo kuàijìshī xiézhù chǔlǐ fánfù de shuìwù shēnbào.
examples.english: Every year when tax season arrives, many small business owners hire accountants to help handle the complex tax filings.

semanticNote: 寬 — wide; broad; lenient; relaxed; width. 道路很寬 (the road is wide), 心胸寬廣 (broad-minded), 待人寬容 (lenient toward others). 寬頻 (broadband internet — common in Taiwan tech contexts). 加寬 (widen). Antonym: 窄 (narrow). 寬裕 (well-off; comfortable financially).

examples.chinese: 這條河在雨季時水量暴漲，河面變得非常寬，一眼望不到對岸。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé zài yǔjì shí shuǐliàng bào zhǎng, hémiàn biàn de fēicháng kuān, yī yǎn wàng bù dào duì'àn.
examples.english: During the rainy season, this river swells dramatically and the surface becomes so wide you can't see the opposite bank at a glance.

examples.chinese: 她待人處事非常寬容，從不計較別人的小錯誤，因此朋友很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā dài rén chǔshì fēicháng kuānróng, cóng bù jìjiào biérén de xiǎo cuòwù, yīncǐ péngyǒu hěn duō.
examples.english: She is very tolerant and forgiving in dealing with people, never dwelling on others' minor mistakes — which is why she has so many friends.

semanticNote: 昆 (insect; multitude; descendants) + 蟲 (insect; worm; creature) — insect; bug (entomological term for the class Insecta). 昆蟲學 (entomology), 昆蟲生態 (insect ecology). Taiwan has exceptional insect biodiversity, including the world-famous Formosan stag beetle (台灣鍬形蟲) and diverse butterflies and beetles celebrated in local nature culture.

examples.chinese: 台灣的昆蟲種類非常豐富，是昆蟲研究者和愛好者的天堂。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de kūnchóng zhǒnglèi fēicháng fēngfù, shì kūnchóng yánjiū zhě hé àihào zhě de tiāntáng.
examples.english: Taiwan has an extraordinary variety of insects — it's a paradise for entomologists and insect enthusiasts alike.

examples.chinese: 孩子在公園裡發現了一隻角鍬形蟲，興奮地拿去給爸爸看。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zài gōngyuán lǐ fāxiàn le yī zhī jiǎo qiāo xíng chóng, xīngfèn de ná qù gěi bàba kàn.
examples.english: The child found a stag beetle in the park and excitedly brought it to show dad.

semanticNote: 擴 (expand; enlarge; spread) + 大 (big; make bigger) — to enlarge; to expand; to extend (scope, scale, or influence). 擴大生產 (expand production), 擴大影響力 (expand influence), 擴大規模 (scale up). Contrasted with 縮小 (reduce; shrink). Very common in business, political, and academic discourse.

examples.chinese: 這家台灣品牌計劃在東南亞擴大市場版圖，明年將在越南開設首家門市。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā Táiwān pǐnpái jìhuà zài Dōngnányà kuòdà shìchǎng bǎntú, míngnián jiāng zài Yuènán kāishè shǒu jiā ménshì.
examples.english: This Taiwanese brand plans to expand its market footprint in Southeast Asia, opening its first store in Vietnam next year.

examples.chinese: 火勢因強風迅速擴大，消防員趕緊請求支援控制局面。
examples.pinyin: Huǒshì yīn qiángfēng xùnsù kuòdà, xiāofángyuán gǎnjǐn qǐngqiú zhīyuán kòngzhì júmiàn.
examples.english: The fire spread rapidly due to strong winds, and firefighters urgently called for reinforcements to control the situation.

semanticNote: 辣 (spicy; pungent; hot) + 椒 (pepper; chili) — hot pepper; chili pepper. 辣椒醬 (chili sauce), 紅辣椒 (red chili), 青辣椒 (green chili). Taiwan's culinary tradition includes moderate use of chili, especially in 麻辣鍋 (Sichuan-style hot pot) which has grown enormously popular. 辣度 (spiciness level) options are common on menus.

examples.chinese: 她吃東西很能吃辣，點菜的時候一定要加辣椒，否則覺得沒味道。
examples.pinyin: Tā chī dōngxi hěn néng chī là, diǎn cài de shíhòu yīdìng yào jiā làjiāo, fǒuzé juéde méi wèidào.
examples.english: She has a high tolerance for spice and always asks for chili peppers when ordering — otherwise she feels the food has no flavor.

examples.chinese: 台灣的麻辣鍋店越開越多，連不怎麼吃辣的人也被那香氣吸引進去嘗試。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de málà guō diàn yuè kāi yuè duō, lián bù zěnme chī là de rén yě bèi nà xiānqì xīyǐn jìnqù chángshì.
examples.english: Mala hot pot restaurants are proliferating across Taiwan; even people who don't usually eat spicy food are drawn in by the aroma to give it a try.

semanticNote: 攔 — to block; to intercept; to cut off; to stop someone. 攔住去路 (block someone's way), 攔截 (intercept), 攔車 (flag down a car/taxi). 攔路搶劫 (highway robbery). In Taiwan, 攔計程車 or 路邊攔車 describes hailing a taxi on the street (though apps like LINE TAXI/Uber are now more common).

components.meaning: block; intercept; cut off; stop; hinder

examples.chinese: 她在路邊努力揮手攔計程車，等了快十分鐘才攔到一台。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài lùbiān nǔlì huīshǒu lán jìchéngchē, děng le kuài shí fēnzhōng cái lán dào yī tái.
examples.english: She waved vigorously at the roadside to flag down a taxi and waited nearly ten minutes before catching one.

examples.chinese: 保全人員攔住了試圖強行闖入的人，並要求他出示有效的入場證件。
examples.pinyin: Bǎoquán rényuán lán zhù le shìtú qiángxíng chuǎngrù de rén, bìng yāoqiú tā chūshì yǒuxiào de rùchǎng zhèngjiàn.
examples.english: Security personnel blocked the person attempting to force their way in and demanded they present valid entry credentials.

semanticNote: 爛 — overcooked; rotten; soft and mushy; terrible (colloquial). 肉燉得很爛 (the meat is braised until very tender), 蘋果爛掉了 (the apple has rotted), 爛電影 (a terrible film). In Taiwan casual speech: 這個爛透了！(This is utterly terrible!) Very versatile — both literal (rotten food) and figurative (poor quality).

components.meaning: overcooked; rotten; soft; mushy; terrible; brilliant (ironic)

examples.chinese: 阿嬤燉的豬腳軟爛入味，筷子一夾就骨肉分離，令人垂涎三尺。
examples.pinyin: Āmā dùn de zhū jiǎo ruǎn làn rù wèi, kuàizi yī jiā jiù gǔ ròu fēnlí, lìng rén chuíxián sān chǐ.
examples.english: Grandma's braised pork knuckle is tender and flavorful — just one touch of the chopsticks and the meat falls off the bone, making mouths water.

examples.chinese: 他覺得那部電影劇情爛透了，浪費了兩個小時卻看不到任何有意思的內容。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde nà bù diànyǐng jùqíng làn tòu le, làngfèi le liǎng gè xiǎoshí què kàn bù dào rènhé yǒu yìsi de nèiróng.
examples.english: He thought the film's plot was utterly terrible — two hours wasted without a single interesting moment.

semanticNote: 朗 (bright; clear; clear-voiced) + 讀 (read; study) — to read aloud; to recite. 朗讀課文 (read the text aloud), 大聲朗讀 (read aloud in a loud voice). In Taiwan's education system, 朗讀 is a fundamental skill in Chinese language class. 朗讀比賽 (oral reading competition) is common at the elementary school level.

examples.chinese: 老師要求同學把這首唐詩有感情地朗讀出來，讓大家感受到詩的意境。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú tóngxué bǎ zhè shǒu Táng shī yǒu gǎnqíng de lǎngdú chūlái, ràng dàjiā gǎnshòu dào shī de yìjìng.
examples.english: The teacher asked students to read this Tang poem aloud with feeling, so everyone could experience the poem's artistic conception.

examples.chinese: 她每天早上花十分鐘朗讀英文文章，用這個方法鍛鍊口語和語感。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang huā shí fēnzhōng lǎngdú Yīngwén wénzhāng, yòng zhège fāngfǎ duànliàn kǒuyǔ hé yǔgǎn.
examples.english: She spends ten minutes every morning reading English articles aloud, using this method to train her speaking ability and language sense.

semanticNote: 勞 (labor; toil; tired) + 動 (move; action) — (physical) labor; to work; to toil. 勞動節 (Labor Day — May 1 in Taiwan, a public holiday), 勞動條件 (working conditions), 勞動市場 (labor market), 勞工 (worker; laborer). In Taiwan, labor rights (勞工權益) and minimum wage (基本工資) are frequent policy debates.

examples.chinese: 五一勞動節這天，全台灣的勞工朋友們應該好好休息，享受這個假期。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ yī láodòng jié zhè tiān, quán Táiwān de láogōng péngyǒumen yīnggāi hǎohǎo xiūxi, xiǎngshòu zhège jiàqī.
examples.english: On May Day, workers across Taiwan should rest well and enjoy the holiday.

examples.chinese: 這份工作需要大量的體力勞動，她每天下班後都累得話都說不出來。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò xūyào dàliàng de tǐlì láodòng, tā měitiān xiàbān hòu dōu lèi de huà dōu shuō bù chūlái.
examples.english: This job requires a great deal of physical labor — every day after work she's so tired she can barely speak.

semanticNote: 勞 (trouble; labor) + 駕 (drive; Your Highness; harness) — 'Excuse me' (when asking someone to move or do something); 'Would you kindly...' A polite set expression: 勞駕，請讓一下 (Excuse me, could you make way?). More formal than 不好意思 (excuse me) and slightly archaic/formal in Taiwan usage. Often heard in service contexts.

examples.chinese: 他禮貌地說：「勞駕，請問廁所在哪個方向？」陌生人友善地指了指右邊。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǐmào de shuō: 'Láojià, qǐngwèn cèsuǒ zài nǎge fāngxiàng?' Mòshēng rén yǒushàn de zhǐ le zhǐ yòubiān.
examples.english: He politely said, 'Excuse me, could you tell me which way the restroom is?' The stranger kindly pointed to the right.

examples.chinese: 「勞駕，麻煩您把椅子往前移一點，讓我過一下好嗎？」
examples.pinyin: 'Láojià, máfan nín bǎ yǐzi wǎng qián yí yīdiǎn, ràng wǒ guò yīxià hǎo ma?'
examples.english: 'Excuse me, would you mind moving your chair forward a bit so I can get through?'

semanticNote: 老 (old; common) + 百 (hundred) + 姓 (surname; common people) — ordinary people; the common folk; civilians. 百姓 literally means 'the hundred surnames,' i.e., the general public. 為老百姓著想 (think of ordinary people), 老百姓的心聲 (the voice of the people). Neutral to slightly sympathetic register; used in political discourse to contrast with 官員 (officials) or 富豪 (the wealthy).

examples.chinese: 政府的政策應該以老百姓的生活需求為出發點，而不是只顧及財團利益。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ de zhèngcè yīnggāi yǐ lǎobǎixìng de shēnghuó xūqiú wéi chūfādiǎn, ér bùshì zhǐ gù jí cáituán lìyì.
examples.english: Government policies should start from the everyday needs of ordinary people, not just cater to the interests of big corporations.

examples.chinese: 房價高漲讓許多老百姓感到壓力沉重，租屋或買屋都是一大難題。
examples.pinyin: Fángjià gāo zhǎng ràng xǔduō lǎobǎixìng gǎndào yālì chénzhòng, zū wū huò mǎi wū dōu shì yī dà nántí.
examples.english: Soaring housing prices are putting enormous pressure on ordinary people — whether to rent or buy is a major challenge.

semanticNote: 老 (old; experienced; prefix) + 板 (board; plank; boss) — boss; proprietor; shopkeeper. 老闆 is the traditional character spelling (with 闆). Very common in Taiwan daily life: addressing a restaurant or shop owner directly as 老闆！(Hey boss!) is standard and not rude. 大老闆 (big boss; magnate). 老闆娘 (female boss; proprietress).

examples.chinese: 她在夜市擺攤的時候，客人都親切地叫她「老闆娘」，她覺得很有成就感。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yèshì bǎi tān de shíhòu, kèrén dōu qīnqiè de jiào tā 'lǎobǎnniáng', tā juéde hěn yǒu chéngjiùgǎn.
examples.english: When she ran her stall at the night market, customers would warmly call her 'boss lady,' and she found it very fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 年底業績好，老闆決定給全體員工發放一個月薪資的年終獎金，大家都很開心。
examples.pinyin: Niándǐ yèjì hǎo, lǎobǎn juédìng gěi quántǐ yuángōng fāfàng yī gè yuè xīnzī de niánzhōng jiǎngjīn, dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: With strong year-end performance, the boss decided to give all employees a year-end bonus of one month's salary — everyone was thrilled.

semanticNote: 老 (old; familiar prefix) + 婆 (old woman; wife) — wife (informal/colloquial). More casual than 太太 (Mrs.; wife — formal) or 妻子 (wife — neutral-formal). Very common in Taiwan spoken Mandarin. 老公 (husband — informal counterpart). 老婆大人 (a respectful-teasing term: 'Her Majesty my wife'). Used affectionately without negative connotation.

examples.chinese: 他每天下班前都會打電話給老婆，問問需不需要帶什麼東西回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān xiàbān qián dōu huì dǎ diànhuà gěi lǎopó, wènwèn xūyào bù xūyào dài shénme dōngxi huíjiā.
examples.english: Every day before leaving work, he calls his wife to ask if she needs him to bring anything home.

examples.chinese: 他在朋友面前總是誇自己的老婆廚藝一流，連餐廳大廚都比不上。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài péngyǒu miànqián zǒng shì kuā zìjǐ de lǎopó chúyì yīliú, lián cāntīng dàchú dōu bǐ bú shàng.
examples.english: In front of friends he always brags that his wife's cooking is first-class — even restaurant chefs can't match her.

semanticNote: 老 (old; established; genuine) + 實 (solid; honest; real) — honest; sincere; simple-minded; well-behaved. 老實說 (to be honest; honestly speaking), 老實人 (an honest, guileless person), 老實待著 (stay put and behave). Can carry a slightly patronizing nuance: 這孩子很老實 (This child is very well-behaved/guileless). Not the same as 誠實 (honest) — 老實 implies simplicity of character.

examples.chinese: 老實說，我覺得這個計畫有很大的風險，但我不確定該怎麼跟老闆開口。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshi shuō, wǒ juéde zhège jìhuà yǒu hěn dà de fēngxiǎn, dàn wǒ bù quèdìng gāi zěnme gēn lǎobǎn kāikǒu.
examples.english: To be honest, I think this plan carries a lot of risk, but I'm not sure how to bring it up with the boss.

examples.chinese: 他這個人老實，不懂得說謊，什麼事都藏不住，一看臉色就知道。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège rén lǎoshi, bù dǒngde shuōhuǎng, shénme shì dōu cáng bú zhù, yī kàn liǎnsè jiù zhīdào.
examples.english: He's an honest, guileless person who doesn't know how to lie — he can't hide anything; one look at his face tells you everything.

semanticNote: 老 (old; established) + 鼠 (rat; mouse) — a rat or mouse. 老鼠夾 (mousetrap), 滑鼠 (computer mouse — Taiwan standard; Mainland uses 鼠標). 老鼠屎 (a bad apple; lit. 'mouse droppings'). The Year of the Rat (鼠年) in the Chinese zodiac. 像老鼠過街 (like a rat crossing the street — everybody wants to hit it; describes someone universally despised).

examples.chinese: 夜市的食品攤必須保持清潔，否則很容易引來老鼠，影響食品安全。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì de shípǐn tān bìxū bǎochí qīngjié, fǒuzé hěn róngyì yǐnlái lǎoshǔ, yǐngxiǎng shípǐn ānquán.
examples.english: Night market food stalls must be kept clean, otherwise they easily attract rats, posing a food safety risk.

examples.chinese: 她的電腦滑鼠壞掉了，移動游標變得很卡，嚴重影響工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Tā de diànnǎo huáshǔ huài diào le, yídòng yóubiāo biàn de hěn kǎ, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Her computer mouse broke; moving the cursor became very laggy, seriously affecting her work efficiency.

semanticNote: 姥 (maternal grandmother; old woman) + 姥 (repeated) — maternal grandmother (mother's mother). A warm, informal term primarily used in northern China and common in Mainland Mandarin. In Taiwan, the standard terms are 外婆 (wàipó) or 阿嬤 (Taiwanese). 姥姥 is understood in Taiwan via Mandarin education but 外婆/阿嬤 are the everyday Taiwan equivalents.

examples.chinese: 她從小跟姥姥一起住，受到外婆的悉心照料，兩人感情非常深厚。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo gēn lǎolao yīqǐ zhù, shòudào wàipó de xīxīn zhàolào, liǎng rén gǎnqíng fēicháng shēnhòu.
examples.english: She grew up living with her maternal grandmother, who took care of her with great devotion; the two share a very deep bond.

examples.chinese: 春節期間，她帶著孩子回到家鄉探望姥姥，老人家看到重孫子笑得合不攏嘴。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié qījiān, tā dài zhe háizi huídào jiāxiāng tànwàng lǎolao, lǎorénjiā kàndào zhòng sūnzi xiào de hé bù lǒng zuǐ.
examples.english: During the Lunar New Year, she brought her child back to her hometown to visit grandma; the old lady couldn't stop smiling when she saw her great-grandchild.

semanticNote: 樂 (happy; enjoy; lè) + 觀 (view; perspective) — optimistic; hopeful. 保持樂觀 (maintain optimism), 樂觀態度 (optimistic attitude), 盲目樂觀 (blindly optimistic). Contrasted with 悲觀 (pessimistic). Taiwan's national character is often described as 樂觀 — the resilience after typhoons, earthquakes, and economic downturns is frequently cited.

examples.chinese: 她面對各種困難時總是保持樂觀，認為任何問題都有解決的方法。
examples.pinyin: Tā miànduì gèzhǒng kùnnán shí zǒng shì bǎochí lèguān, rènwéi rènhé wèntí dōu yǒu jiějué de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: When faced with all kinds of difficulties, she always stays optimistic, believing every problem has a solution.

examples.chinese: 醫師說雖然病情複雜，但他對治療結果持審慎樂觀的態度。
examples.pinyin: Yīshī shuō suīrán bìngqíng fùzá, dàn tā duì zhìliáo jiéguǒ chí shěnshèn lèguān de tàidù.
examples.english: The doctor said that although the condition is complex, he takes a cautiously optimistic view of the treatment outcome.

semanticNote: 雷 — thunder; a thunderbolt. 打雷 (thunder; for thunder to strike), 雷聲 (sound of thunder), 雷雨 (thunderstorm), 避雷針 (lightning rod). Taiwan has frequent thunderstorms, especially in summer afternoons. Slang: 踩雷 (step on a landmine — find out something is terrible after trying it; e.g., a disappointing restaurant) is very common in Taiwan online culture.

examples.chinese: 夏天午後台灣常常打雷下雨，出門一定要帶傘，否則很容易被淋濕。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān wǔhòu Táiwān chángcháng dǎléi xià yǔ, chūmén yīdìng yào dài sǎn, fǒuzé hěn róngyì bèi lín shī.
examples.english: Taiwan frequently has thunder and rain on summer afternoons — you must bring an umbrella when going out, otherwise you'll easily get soaked.

examples.chinese: 這家網紅推薦的餐廳讓他大失所望，果然是踩雷了，食物難吃到無法形容。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā wǎng hóng tuījiàn de cāntīng ràng tā dà shī suǒ wàng, guǒrán shì cǎi léi le, shíwù nánchī dào wúfǎ xíngróng.
examples.english: The restaurant recommended by that online influencer was a total letdown — sure enough, it was a dud, with food that was indescribably bad.

semanticNote: 類 (category; kind; similar) + 型 (type; model; form) — type; category; kind. 電影類型 (film genre), 人物類型 (character type), 什麼類型的人 (what type of person). Very common in everyday categorization: 你喜歡哪種類型的音樂？(What type of music do you like?) More specific than 種類 (variety/kind — broader categories).

examples.chinese: 她喜歡看各種類型的電影，從恐怖片到紀錄片都能接受，唯獨不喜歡愛情片。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān kàn gèzhǒng lèixíng de diànyǐng, cóng kǒngbù piān dào jìlùpiàn dōu néng jiēshòu, wéidú bù xǐhuān àiqíng piān.
examples.english: She enjoys watching all types of films, from horror to documentary — the only genre she doesn't like is romance.

examples.chinese: 這台電子零件分類機可以辨識不同類型的零件，並自動分揀歸類。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànzǐ língjiàn fēnlèi jī kěyǐ biànshí bùtóng lèixíng de língjiàn, bìng zìdòng fēnjiǎn guīlèi.
examples.english: This electronic parts sorter can identify different types of components and automatically sort and categorize them.

semanticNote: 冷 (cold) + 淡 (thin; bland; light; indifferent) — cold; indifferent; cool in manner; to treat coldly. 態度冷淡 (a cold/indifferent attitude), 市場冷淡 (sluggish market), 冷淡待之 (treat with indifference). Both of people (emotionally distant) and of situations (lacking activity or enthusiasm). Contrasted with 熱情 (warm and enthusiastic).

examples.chinese: 他第一次去那家店消費時，服務態度非常冷淡，讓他感到很不受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì qù nà jiā diàn xiāofèi shí, fúwù tàidù fēicháng lěngdàn, ràng tā gǎndào hěn bù shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The first time he patronized that store, the service attitude was very cold, making him feel unwelcome.

examples.chinese: 她對前男友突然傳來的訊息保持冷淡，只回了一個字：「好。」
examples.pinyin: Tā duì qián nányǒu tūrán chuán lái de xùnxi bǎochí lěngdàn, zhǐ huí le yī gè zì: 'hǎo.'
examples.english: She responded to the message her ex-boyfriend suddenly sent with cool indifference, replying with just one word: 'OK.'

semanticNote: 釐 (tiny unit; one-thousandth) + 米 (meter — loanword) — centimeter (cm). 公分 (gōngfēn) is the standard Taiwan term for centimeter; 厘米 is understood but slightly Mainland-flavored in Taiwan usage. 身高幾公分？ (How tall are you in centimeters? — standard Taiwan phrasing). 毫米 (millimeter), 公尺 (meter).

examples.chinese: 她的身高是165公分，在台灣女性中算是偏高的。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngāo shì 165 gōngfēn, zài Táiwān nǚxìng zhōng suàn shì piān gāo de.
examples.english: She is 165 centimeters tall, which is considered above average for women in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這塊布料的寬度是120厘米，剛好可以裁成兩件上衣的用料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bùliào de kuāndù shì 120 límǐ, gānghǎo kěyǐ cái chéng liǎng jiàn shàngyī de yòngliào.
examples.english: This piece of fabric is 120 centimeters wide, just enough to cut out material for two tops.

semanticNote: 離 (separate; leave) + 婚 (marriage; wed) — to divorce; to get divorced. 辦理離婚 (go through divorce proceedings), 離婚率 (divorce rate), 協議離婚 (divorce by mutual agreement). Taiwan has a relatively high divorce rate in Asia. In Taiwan, a divorce can be registered administratively (協議離婚 at the 戶政事務所) or through court proceedings.

examples.chinese: 他們結婚七年後決定離婚，雙方協議好財產分配和孩子的監護權。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jiéhūn qī nián hòu juédìng líhūn, shuāngfāng xiéyì hǎo cáichǎn fēnpèi hé háizi de jiānhùquán.
examples.english: They decided to divorce after seven years of marriage, having mutually agreed on the division of assets and custody of the children.

examples.chinese: 在台灣辦理協議離婚可以直接到戶政事務所辦理，不一定要上法院。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān bànlǐ xiéyì líhūn kěyǐ zhíjiē dào hùzhèng shìwùsuǒ bànlǐ, bù yīdìng yào shàng fǎyuàn.
examples.english: In Taiwan, a divorce by mutual agreement can be processed directly at the household registration office — going to court isn't necessary.

semanticNote: 梨 — a pear. 梨山 (Li-shan, a famous mountain area in Taichung known for fruit cultivation, especially pears and apples at high altitude), 水梨 (juicy pear), 鳳梨 (pineapple — lit. 'phoenix pear'). Pears (梨) are a homophone for 離 (separate/leave), making them taboo in some festive gift contexts (giving pears = inviting separation).

examples.chinese: 梨山出產的高山水梨香甜多汁，是台灣秋季最受歡迎的水果之一。
examples.pinyin: Lí shān chūchǎn de gāoshān shuǐlí xiāngtián duōzhī, shì Táiwān qiūjì zuì shòu huānyíng de shuǐguǒ zhī yī.
examples.english: The alpine pears grown in Lishan are sweet and juicy — one of Taiwan's most popular fruits in autumn.

examples.chinese: 送禮時要避免送梨，因為「梨」跟「離」同音，有分離的不吉利意味。
examples.pinyin: Sòng lǐ shí yào bìmiǎn sòng lí, yīnwèi 'lí' gēn 'lí' tóngyīn, yǒu fēnlí de bù jílì yìwèi.
examples.english: Avoid giving pears as gifts because 梨 (pear) sounds like 離 (to separate), giving it an inauspicious connotation of parting.

semanticNote: 理 (principle; reason; manage) + 論 (theory; discuss; by) — theory; a theoretical framework. 理論上 (in theory; theoretically), 理論與實踐 (theory and practice), 語言學理論 (linguistic theory). 理論上沒問題 (in theory it's fine — often used to hedge before pointing out a problem). Contrasted with 實際 (practical/actual).

components.meaning: theory; discuss; argument; by the basis of

examples.chinese: 理論上這個方法可行，但在實際執行中可能會遇到各種預料之外的困難。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng zhège fāngfǎ kěxíng, dàn zài shíjì zhíxíng zhōng kěnéng huì yùdào gèzhǒng yùliào zhī wài de kùnnán.
examples.english: In theory this method is feasible, but in actual implementation you're likely to encounter all kinds of unexpected difficulties.

examples.chinese: 她的博士論文探討了語言習得理論在雙語教育中的應用，獲得委員會的高度評價。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bóshì lùnwén tàntǎo le yǔyán xídé lǐlùn zài shuāngyǔ jiàoyù zhōng de yìngyòng, huòdé wěiyuánhuì de gāodù píngjià.
examples.english: Her doctoral thesis explored the application of language acquisition theory in bilingual education and received high praise from the committee.

semanticNote: 理 (principle; reason) + 由 (cause; reason; from) — a reason; grounds; justification. 充分的理由 (sufficient reasons), 沒有理由 (no reason; there is no reason), 理由充分 (well-reasoned). More positive than 借口 (excuse — implies insincerity). 理由 can be legitimate (有充分理由 with good reason) or questionable (找理由 find a reason/make an excuse).

examples.chinese: 她給出了充分的理由說明為什麼這個計畫需要延後執行，大家都表示理解。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi chū le chōngfèn de lǐyóu shuōmíng wèishénme zhège jìhuà xūyào yánhòu zhíxíng, dàjiā dōu biǎoshì lǐjiě.
examples.english: She provided sufficient reasons to explain why the plan needed to be delayed, and everyone expressed understanding.

examples.chinese: 沒有任何理由可以為霸凌行為辯護，這一點不容爭辯。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rènhé lǐyóu kěyǐ wèi bàlíng xíngwéi biànhù, zhè yīdiǎn bùróng zhēngbiàn.
examples.english: There is no reason that can justify bullying behavior — on this point, there is no room for debate.

semanticNote: 力 (strength; power) + 量 (amount; capacity; measure) — power; force; strength (physical or metaphorical). 力量強大 (great strength/power), 愛的力量 (the power of love), 聚集力量 (gather strength), 力量懸殊 (a great disparity in power). More abstract and potentially figurative than 力氣 (physical strength of muscles).

examples.chinese: 在最艱難的時候，是家人的支持給了她堅持下去的力量。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuì jiānnán de shíhòu, shì jiārén de zhīchí gěi le tā jiānchí xiàqù de lìliang.
examples.english: At the most difficult moments, it was her family's support that gave her the strength to keep going.

examples.chinese: 台灣的公民社會展現了強大的集體力量，成功推動了多項重要的社會改革。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de gōngmín shèhuì zhǎnxiàn le qiángdà de jítǐ lìliang, chénggōng tuīdòng le duō xiàng zhòngyào de shèhuì gǎigé.
examples.english: Taiwan's civil society has demonstrated powerful collective strength, successfully driving forward several important social reforms.

semanticNote: 立 (stand; immediately; set up) + 即 (immediately; that is; approach) — immediately; at once. More formal and emphatic than 馬上 (right away — colloquial). 立即生效 (take effect immediately), 立即行動 (take immediate action), 立即停止 (stop immediately). Common in official notices, legal language, and urgent situations.

components.meaning: immediately; that is; approach; even if

examples.chinese: 接獲報案後，警察立即趕赴現場，在不到五分鐘內就到達了。
examples.pinyin: Jiēhuò bàoàn hòu, jǐngchá lìjí gǎnfù xiànchǎng, zài bù dào wǔ fēnzhōng nèi jiù dàodá le.
examples.english: Upon receiving the report, police immediately rushed to the scene, arriving in under five minutes.

examples.chinese: 如果發現食品有異味或變色，應立即停止食用，以免食物中毒。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ fāxiàn shípǐn yǒu yì wèi huò biànsè, yīng lìjí tíngzhǐ shíyòng, yǐmiǎn shíwù zhòngdú.
examples.english: If food has an off smell or has discolored, stop eating it immediately to avoid food poisoning.

semanticNote: 立 (stand; immediately) + 刻 (carve; moment; immediately) — immediately; at once; right away. Synonymous with 立即 and 馬上, but 立刻 is the most common in everyday spoken Taiwan Mandarin. 立刻去做 (do it right now), 立刻回覆 (reply immediately). Slightly less formal than 立即; more colloquial than 即刻.

examples.chinese: 她一聽說媽媽住院了，立刻放下手邊的工作，趕去醫院探視。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī tīng shuō māma zhùyuàn le, lìkè fàng xià shǒubiān de gōngzuò, gǎn qù yīyuàn tànshì.
examples.english: The moment she heard her mom had been hospitalized, she immediately dropped what she was doing and rushed to the hospital.

examples.chinese: 老闆看完提案後立刻點頭同意，讓她驚喜交加，沒想到這麼快就過關了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn kàn wán tí'àn hòu lìkè diǎntóu tóngyì, ràng tā jīngxǐ jiāojiā, méi xiǎngdào zhème kuài jiù guò guān le.
examples.english: The boss immediately nodded in approval after reading the proposal — she was both shocked and delighted, not expecting it to sail through so quickly.

semanticNote: 利 (profit; benefit; sharp) + 潤 (moist; smooth; profit; enrich) — profit (the financial gain after expenses). 淨利潤 (net profit), 毛利潤 (gross profit), 利潤率 (profit margin), 追求利潤 (pursue profit). Central vocabulary in business and economics. In Taiwan, 毛利 and 淨利 are common in financial reporting.

examples.chinese: 這款產品的利潤率很高，每賣出一件幾乎有50%的毛利，是公司的主力商品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn de lìrùn lǜ hěn gāo, měi mài chū yī jiàn jīhū yǒu 50% de máolì, shì gōngsī de zhǔlì shāngpǐn.
examples.english: This product has a very high profit margin — almost 50% gross margin per unit — making it the company's main revenue driver.

examples.chinese: 公司去年的利潤大幅成長，主要歸功於海外市場業績的顯著提升。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī qùnián de lìrùn dàfú chéngzhǎng, zhǔyào guīgōng yú hǎiwài shìchǎng yèjì de xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
examples.english: The company's profits grew significantly last year, mainly thanks to a notable improvement in overseas market performance.

semanticNote: 利 (profit; interest) + 息 (rest; breath; interest; reproduce) — interest (on a loan or deposit). 年利息 (annual interest), 利息率/利率 (interest rate), 房貸利息 (mortgage interest), 活期存款利息 (savings account interest). In Taiwan, the Central Bank (中央銀行) sets benchmark interest rates. 複利 (compound interest) is important in financial literacy discussions.

examples.chinese: 他把錢存入定期存款，每年可以獲得固定的利息，比活期存款划算。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ qián cún rù dìngqī cúnkuǎn, měi nián kěyǐ huòdé gùdìng de lìxī, bǐ huóqī cúnkuǎn huásuàn.
examples.english: He put his money in a fixed-term deposit; he can earn a fixed amount of interest each year, which is more worth it than a regular savings account.

examples.chinese: 信用卡的利息通常很高，如果沒有每月繳清，累積下來的利息會非常可觀。
examples.pinyin: Xìnyòngkǎ de lìxī tōngcháng hěn gāo, rúguǒ méiyǒu měi yuè jiǎo qīng, lèijī xiàlái de lìxī huì fēicháng kěguān.
examples.english: Credit card interest is usually very high; if you don't pay in full every month, the accumulated interest can become very substantial.

semanticNote: 利 (profit; benefit) + 益 (benefit; profit; increasingly) — benefit; interest; profit (usually abstract or in someone's interest). 公共利益 (public interest), 個人利益 (personal interest), 維護利益 (protect interests), 利益衝突 (conflict of interest). More abstract than 利潤 (financial profit). 利害關係人 (stakeholder) is common in corporate governance.
