examples.chinese: 政府官員必須避免利益衝突，不能在決策過程中謀取個人私利。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ guānyuán bìxū bìmiǎn lìyì chōngtú, bù néng zài juécè guòchéng zhōng móuqǔ gèrén sīlì.
examples.english: Government officials must avoid conflicts of interest and must not pursue personal gain in the decision-making process.

examples.chinese: 這項新政策的出發點是保護勞工利益，確保他們的薪資和工作環境都受到法律保障。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè de chūfādiǎn shì bǎohù láogōng lìyì, quèbǎo tāmen de xīnzī hé gōngzuò huánjìng dōu shòudào fǎlǜ bǎozhàng.
examples.english: This new policy's starting point is to protect workers' interests, ensuring that their wages and working environment are protected by law.

semanticNote: 利 (benefit; profit; use) + 用 (use; apply; employ) — to use; to make use of; to exploit. Can be neutral (利用時間 use one's time) or negative (利用朋友 exploit a friend). Context determines the moral register. 充分利用 (make full use of), 利用機會 (take advantage of an opportunity), 被利用 (be used/exploited by someone).

examples.chinese: 她利用通勤時間在捷運上聽英文Podcast，把零碎時間都充分利用起來。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng tōngqín shíjiān zài jié yùn shàng tīng Yīngwén Podcast, bǎ língsuì shíjiān dōu chōngfèn lìyòng qǐlái.
examples.english: She uses her commute time on the MRT to listen to English podcasts, making full use of every spare moment.

examples.chinese: 後來她才發現，那個人一直在利用她的善意，從未真心對待過她。
examples.pinyin: Hòulái tā cái fāxiàn, nà gè rén yīzhí zài lìyòng tā de shànyì, cóng wèi zhēnxīn duìdài guò tā.
examples.english: She only realized later that the person had been exploiting her goodwill all along, never treating her sincerely.

semanticNote: 連 (even; connect; in succession) + 忙 (busy; hurried) — promptly; at once; hastily (with a sense of haste due to urgency or courtesy). 連忙道謝 (hurriedly express thanks), 連忙解釋 (quickly explain), 連忙站起來 (quickly stand up). Slightly more formal and narrative than 趕緊 (hurry and do); often used in storytelling.

examples.chinese: 老師一走進教室，原本嘰嘰喳喳的同學們連忙安靜下來，坐好準備上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yī zǒu jìn jiàoshì, yuánběn jījīzhāzhā de tóngxuémen liánmáng ānjìng xiàlái, zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi shàngkè.
examples.english: The moment the teacher walked into the classroom, the chattering students quickly quieted down and sat up ready for class.

examples.chinese: 他一不小心把咖啡打翻在桌上，連忙拿紙巾擦拭，希望不要弄髒重要文件。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī bù xiǎoxīn bǎ kāfēi dǎ fān zài zhuō shàng, liánmáng ná zhǐjīn cāshì, xīwàng bùyào nòng zāng zhòngyào wénjiàn.
examples.english: He accidentally knocked his coffee over onto the desk and quickly grabbed tissue to wipe it up, hoping important documents wouldn't be stained.

semanticNote: 連 (connect; in succession) + 續 (continue; follow; add) — continuous; in succession; successively. 連續劇 (TV drama series — 台灣連續劇 are famous, especially prime-time dramas), 連續三天 (three consecutive days), 連續不斷 (uninterrupted). 連續劇 (soap opera/drama serial) is a major part of Taiwan's media culture.

examples.chinese: 她最近迷上了一部台灣連續劇，每天連續看了好幾集才肯去睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn mí shàng le yī bù Táiwān liánxùjù, měitiān liánxù kàn le hǎo jǐ jí cái kěn qù shuìjiào.
examples.english: She's recently gotten hooked on a Taiwanese drama series, watching several episodes in a row every day before finally going to sleep.

examples.chinese: 台灣連續多天高溫破紀錄，氣象局呼籲民眾做好防暑措施。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān liánxù duō tiān gāowēn pò jìlù, qìxiàngjú hūyù mínzhòng zuò hǎo fángshu cuòshī.
examples.english: Taiwan broke high-temperature records for multiple consecutive days; the weather bureau urged the public to take heatstroke prevention measures.

semanticNote: 聯 (link; join; unite) + 合 (join; combine; together) — to unite; to combine; an alliance; joint. 聯合國 (United Nations), 聯合聲明 (joint statement), 聯合作戰 (joint operations). Taiwan's complex relationship with the UN (ROC was expelled in 1971) makes 聯合國 politically loaded in Taiwan. 聯合報 is a major Taiwan newspaper.

examples.chinese: 幾個民間團體聯合發表聲明，要求政府正視高齡化社會的長照問題。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ gè mínjiān tuántǐ liánhé fābiǎo shēngmíng, yāoqiú zhèngfǔ zhèngshì gāolínghuà shèhuì de zhǎngzhào wèntí.
examples.english: Several civil society organizations jointly issued a statement calling on the government to seriously address long-term care issues in an aging society.

examples.chinese: 台灣無法成為聯合國成員國，但仍積極透過各種國際組織參與全球事務。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān wúfǎ chéngwéi Liánhéguó chéngyuán guó, dàn réng jījí tòuguò gèzhǒng guójì zǔzhī cānyù quánqiú shìwù.
examples.english: Taiwan cannot become a UN member state but continues to actively participate in global affairs through various international organizations.

semanticNote: 戀 (love; yearn; be attached to) + 愛 (love; like; cherish) — romantic love; to be in love; a love affair. 談戀愛 (be in a romantic relationship; date), 初戀 (first love), 熱戀 (passionate love; head over heels). Note the mandatory apostrophe between 戀 (liàn) and 愛 (ài) — 'ài' starts with a vowel following another syllable, requiring 'liàn'ài' not 'liànài'.

components.meaning: love; yearn for; be attached to
love; like; cherish; be fond of

examples.chinese: 她和男友從大學時代就開始談戀愛，如今已經在一起八年了，感情非常穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé nányǒu cóng dàxué shídài jiù kāishǐ tán liàn'ài, rújīn yǐjīng zài yīqǐ bā nián le, gǎnqíng fēicháng wěndìng.
examples.english: She and her boyfriend started dating back in university days; they've been together eight years now, with a very stable relationship.

examples.chinese: 初戀的感覺最令人難忘，即使多年後回想起來，心裡仍然會悸動。
examples.pinyin: Chūliàn de gǎnjué zuì lìng rén nánwàng, jíshǐ duō nián hòu huíxiǎng qǐlái, xīn lǐ réngrán huì jìdòng.
examples.english: The feeling of first love is the most unforgettable — even when you look back on it years later, your heart still stirs.

semanticNote: 良 (good; fine; virtuous) + 好 (good; well) — good; favorable; excellent. More formal than 好 alone. 良好的關係 (a good relationship), 身體狀況良好 (in good health), 成績良好 (good academic performance), 表現良好 (performing well). Often appears in formal evaluations, official reports, and medical or educational contexts.

examples.chinese: 台灣與許多民主國家維持良好的外交實質關係，即使沒有正式邦交也不例外。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǔ xǔduō mínzhǔ guójiā wéichí liánghǎo de wàijiāo shízhì guānxi, jíshǐ méiyǒu zhèngshì bāngjiāo yě bù lìwài.
examples.english: Taiwan maintains good substantive diplomatic relations with many democracies, even those without formal diplomatic ties.

examples.chinese: 她定期健康檢查，結果顯示各項指標均在良好範圍之內，醫師對她的生活習慣表示肯定。
examples.pinyin: Tā dìngqī jiànkāng jiǎnchá, jiéguǒ xiǎnshì gè xiàng zhǐbiāo jūn zài liánghǎo fànwéi zhī nèi, yīshī duì tā de shēnghuó xíguàn biǎoshì kěndìng.
examples.english: She gets regular health checkups; the results show all her indicators are within good ranges, and the doctor affirmed her lifestyle habits.

semanticNote: 糧 (grain; provisions; food) + 食 (eat; food; meal) — grain; foodstuffs; cereals. 糧食危機 (food crisis), 糧食安全 (food security), 儲備糧食 (stockpile food). Taiwan's food self-sufficiency rate is relatively low; 糧食安全 has been a growing policy topic. 精製米 (polished rice) is Taiwan's staple grain. Note: 食 here is read shi (neutral tone) in this compound.

examples.chinese: 全球氣候變遷對農業造成嚴重衝擊，糧食安全問題已成為各國政府的重大挑戰。
examples.pinyin: Quánqiú qìhòu biànqiān duì nóngyè zàochéng yánzhòng chōngjí, liángshi ānquán wèntí yǐ chéngwéi gèguó zhèngfǔ de zhòngdà tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Global climate change has dealt a serious blow to agriculture, and food security has become a major challenge for governments around the world.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後農作物損失慘重，政府緊急調撥儲備糧食，確保民生供應不中斷。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu nóngzuòwù sǔnshī cǎnzhòng, zhèngfǔ jǐnjí diàobō chǔbèi liángshi, quèbǎo mínshēng gōngyìng bù zhōngduàn.
examples.english: After the typhoon, crop losses were severe; the government urgently released stockpiled grain reserves to ensure uninterrupted supply for daily life.

semanticNote: 亮 — bright; light; shiny; to light up; to reveal. 燈亮了 (the light came on), 聲音宏亮 (a resounding voice), 眼睛發亮 (eyes lighting up), 亮點 (highlight; bright spot). In Taiwan: 天亮了 (it's dawn/daylight). 亮相 (make a public appearance; debut — theatrical origin). Used both literally and figuratively.

components.meaning: bright; light; shiny; clear; loud (of voice)

examples.chinese: 一打開禮物，她的眼睛立刻亮了起來，笑著說這正是她想要的。
examples.pinyin: Yī dǎkāi lǐwù, tā de yǎnjīng lìkè liàng le qǐlái, xiào zhe shuō zhè zhèng shì tā xiǎng yào de.
examples.english: The moment she opened the gift, her eyes lit up and she smiled, saying it was exactly what she wanted.

examples.chinese: 颱風後停電三天，電力終於恢復的那一刻，整個社區的燈同時亮起，大家歡呼雀躍。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng hòu tíngdiàn sān tiān, diànlì zhōngyú huīfù de nà yī kè, zhěnggè shèqū de dēng tóngshí liàng qǐ, dàjiā huānhū quèyuè.
examples.english: Three days after the typhoon left the power out, the moment electricity was finally restored, lights across the entire community came on simultaneously and everyone cheered with joy.

semanticNote: 了 (finish; settle; liǎo) + 不起 (cannot; unworthy of) — incredible; extraordinary; amazing; great. 真了不起！(That's amazing!/How impressive!) Always positive. The literal meaning is 'beyond what can be finished/resolved' — i.e., something so great it's beyond ordinary measure. Colloquial and warm. Contrasted with the ironic usage 有什麼了不起！(So what's so great about that?!).

components.meaning: cannot; not able to; beyond what can be...

examples.chinese: 她一個人帶著兩個孩子，還同時完成了碩士學位，真的很了不起。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī gè rén dài zhe liǎng gè háizi, hái tóngshí wánchéng le shuòshì xuéwèi, zhēnde hěn liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: She raised two children on her own while simultaneously completing her master's degree — truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 台積電能在如此短的時間內研發出3奈米製程，這個成就真的了不起。
examples.pinyin: Táijīdiàn néng zài rúcǐ duǎn de shíjiān nèi yánfā chū 3 nàimǐ zhìchéng, zhège chéngjiù zhēnde liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: For TSMC to develop a 3-nanometer process in such a short time — that achievement is truly extraordinary.

semanticNote: 列 (row; column; train) + 車 (vehicle; car) — a train (railway term). More formal than 火車 (everyday word for train). 高鐵列車 (high-speed rail train), 普通列車 (regular train), 列車長 (train conductor/chief). In Taiwan, 台灣高鐵 (THSR) connects Taipei to Kaohsiung in 90 minutes; the station announcement voice is an iconic part of Taiwan travel culture.

examples.chinese: 高鐵列車每隔十五到二十分鐘一班，讓南北通勤變得極為便利。
examples.pinyin: Gāotiě lièchē měi gé shíwǔ dào èrshí fēnzhōng yī bān, ràng nán běi tōngqín biàn de jí wéi biànlì.
examples.english: High-speed rail trains run every fifteen to twenty minutes, making north-south commuting extremely convenient.

examples.chinese: 她在月台上目送列車緩緩駛離，心中帶著一股難以言說的不捨。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yuètái shàng mùsòng lièchē huǎnhuǎn shǐ lí, xīn zhōng dài zhe yī gǔ nányǐ yán shuō de bùshě.
examples.english: She watched from the platform as the train slowly pulled away, carrying in her heart an indescribable reluctance to part.

semanticNote: 臨 (approach; face; be about to) + 時 (time; moment) — temporary; makeshift; at the time; at the last minute. 臨時通知 (last-minute notice), 臨時工 (temporary worker), 臨時起意 (act on a sudden impulse). 臨時 can describe planned temporariness (臨時措施 temporary measures) or unplanned urgency (臨時有事 something came up last minute).

components.meaning: approach; face; overlook; be about to; copy

examples.chinese: 她接到臨時通知說會議提前了一個小時，只好匆匆趕過去，連午飯都沒吃完。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiēdào línshí tōngzhī shuō huìyì tíqián le yī gè xiǎoshí, zhǐhǎo cōngcōng gǎn guòqù, lián wǔfàn dōu méi chī wán.
examples.english: She received last-minute notice that the meeting had been moved up an hour, so she had to rush over without even finishing her lunch.

examples.chinese: 活動場地臨時更換，主辦單位緊急通知所有報名者新的地點與交通方式。
examples.pinyin: Huódòng chǎngdì línshí gēnghuàn, zhǔbàn dānwèi jǐnjí tōngzhī suǒyǒu bàomíng zhě xīn de dìdiǎn yǔ jiāotōng fāngshì.
examples.english: The event venue was changed at the last minute; the organizers urgently notified all registrants of the new location and transportation options.

semanticNote: 靈 (quick; spirit; efficacious) + 活 (alive; lively; flexible) — flexible; nimble; agile. 靈活應變 (adapt flexibly), 思維靈活 (flexible thinking), 靈活的工時安排 (flexible work hours). In Taiwan's startup and tech culture, 靈活 is a highly valued workplace trait. Antonym: 死板 (rigid; inflexible).

examples.chinese: 她在危機處理上表現得非常靈活，能根據情況快速調整策略，化險為夷。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wēijī chǔlǐ shàng biǎoxiàn de fēicháng línghuó, néng gēnjù qíngkuàng kuàisù tiáozhěng cèlüè, huà xiǎn wéi yí.
examples.english: She is extremely flexible in crisis management, able to quickly adjust her strategy according to the situation and turn danger into safety.

examples.chinese: 這家公司提供靈活的上班時間，讓員工可以根據個人情況選擇上下班的時段。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tígōng línghuó de shàngbān shíjiān, ràng yuángōng kěyǐ gēnjù gèrén qíngkuàng xuǎnzé shàng xiàbān de shíduan.
examples.english: This company offers flexible working hours, letting employees choose their start and end times according to their personal circumstances.

semanticNote: 鈴 — a bell; a ring (sound). 電鈴 (electric bell; doorbell), 門鈴 (doorbell), 鈴聲 (ringtone; bell sound), 手鈴 (handbell), 腳鈴 (anklet bells). 下課鈴 (end-of-class bell — a familiar sound in Taiwan's school system). 鈴鼓 (tambourine). The bell motif is common in Buddhist and temple contexts in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 下課鈴一響，教室裡的學生立刻活絡起來，收拾書包準備下課。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè líng yī xiǎng, jiàoshì lǐ de xuéshēng lìkè huóluò qǐlái, shōushi shūbāo zhǔnbèi xiàkè.
examples.english: The moment the end-of-class bell rang, students in the classroom immediately came alive, packing their bags to leave.

examples.chinese: 她去按了好幾次門鈴，但裡面沒有任何動靜，看來屋裡沒有人。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù àn le hǎo jǐ cì ménlíng, dàn lǐmiàn méiyǒu rènhé dòngzhìng, kànlái wū lǐ méiyǒu rén.
examples.english: She rang the doorbell several times, but there was no sound from inside — it seemed no one was home.

semanticNote: 零 (zero; odd; fragment; spare) + 件 (piece; item; document) — a spare part; component; part. 汽車零件 (auto parts), 電子零件 (electronic components), 精密零件 (precision parts). Taiwan's precision machinery industry (精密機械) produces many of the world's electronic and mechanical components. 替換零件 (replacement parts).

examples.chinese: 這台老機車的零件已經停產多年，要找到原廠零件進行維修非常困難。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái lǎo jīchē de língjiàn yǐjīng tíngchǎn duō nián, yào zhǎodào yuánchǎng língjiàn jìnxíng wéixiū fēicháng kùnnán.
examples.english: Parts for this old scooter have been discontinued for years — finding genuine manufacturer parts for repairs is extremely difficult.

examples.chinese: 台灣的電子零件供應商遍布全球供應鏈，為全球消費電子產業提供關鍵組件。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de diànzǐ língjiàn gōngyìng shāng biànbù quánqiú gōngyīng liàn, wèi quánqiú xiāofèi diànzǐ chǎnyè tígōng guānjiàn zǔjiàn.
examples.english: Taiwan's electronic component suppliers are spread throughout the global supply chain, providing critical components to the worldwide consumer electronics industry.

semanticNote: 零 (scattered; odd; spare) + 食 (food; eat) — snacks; junk food; munchies. 吃零食 (snack; eat snacks), 健康零食 (healthy snacks), 夜市零食 (night market snacks). Taiwan's night market snack culture is world-famous: 雞排 (chicken steak), 珍珠奶茶 (bubble tea), 臭豆腐, 車輪餅 are iconic. Office 零食 sharing is a common team-bonding practice.

examples.chinese: 她在辦公桌旁放了一罐堅果，說是用健康的零食代替下午容易吃的垃圾食物。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàngōng zhuō páng fàng le yī guàn jiānguǒ, shuō shì yòng jiànkāng de língshí dàitì xiàwǔ róngyì chī de lājī shíwù.
examples.english: She kept a jar of nuts next to her desk, saying she was replacing the junk food she tended to eat in the afternoon with a healthy snack.

examples.chinese: 夜市裡的各種零食讓她眼花撩亂，每走幾步就忍不住停下來買一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ de gèzhǒng língshí ràng tā yǎn huā liáoluàn, měi zǒu jǐ bù jiù rěn bú zhù tíng xiàlái mǎi yī yàng.
examples.english: The variety of snacks at the night market dazzled her; every few steps she couldn't resist stopping to buy something.

semanticNote: 領 (lead; receive; collar; territory) + 導 (guide; lead; conduct) — to lead; a leader; leadership. 政治領導人 (political leader), 公司領導階層 (company leadership), 領導風格 (leadership style), 領導力 (leadership ability). In Taiwan's democratic context, 領導 implies accountable, elected leadership, distinct from 統治 (rule/domination).

examples.chinese: 她帶領團隊度過了最艱困的時期，以卓越的領導力贏得了全體員工的尊重。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàilǐng tuánduì dùguò le zuì jiānkùn de shíqī, yǐ zhuōyuè de lǐngdǎo lì yíngdé le quántǐ yuángōng de zūnzhòng.
examples.english: She led the team through the most difficult period, earning the respect of all employees with outstanding leadership.

examples.chinese: 民主社會的領導人由人民選舉產生，任期結束後必須接受選民的課責。
examples.pinyin: Mínzhǔ shèhuì de lǐngdǎo rén yóu rénmín xuǎnjǔ chǎnshēng, rènqī jiéshù hòu bìxū jiēshòu xuǎnmín de kèzé.
examples.english: Leaders in a democratic society are elected by the people and must be held accountable to voters after their term ends.

semanticNote: 領 (territory; lead) + 域 (region; domain; boundary) — a domain; sphere; field (of study or activity). 研究領域 (research field), 各個領域 (various fields), 在這個領域 (in this field/domain). Very common in academic, professional, and journalistic contexts. More formal than 行業 (industry) — 領域 can be intellectual or creative, not just commercial.

examples.chinese: 她在人工智慧領域深耕多年，是業界公認的專家，常受邀出席國際學術研討會。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài réngōng zhìhuì lǐngyù shēngēng duō nián, shì yèjiè gōngrèn de zhuānjiā, cháng shòu yāo chūxí guójì xuéshù yántǎo huì.
examples.english: She has worked in the artificial intelligence field for many years and is an industry-recognized expert, frequently invited to international academic conferences.

examples.chinese: 台灣在醫療器材領域的發展非常快速，多款產品已取得美歐市場的認證。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zài yīliáo qìcái lǐngyù de fāzhǎn fēicháng kuàisù, duō kuǎn chǎnpǐn yǐ qǔdé Měi Ōu shìchǎng de rènzhèng.
examples.english: Taiwan's development in the medical device field has been extremely rapid; multiple products have already obtained certification in the US and European markets.

semanticNote: 瀏 (clear; flowing; browse) + 覽 (view; look at; read) — to browse; to skim through; to glance over. 瀏覽網頁 (browse web pages), 瀏覽器 (web browser — 瀏覽器 is the standard Taiwan term for 'browser'), 快速瀏覽 (quickly browse/skim). Central to internet usage vocabulary in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 她習慣早上起床後先瀏覽一遍新聞標題，大概了解今天的重要事件。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zǎoshang qǐchuáng hòu xiān liúlǎn yī biàn xīnwén biāotí, dàgài liǎojiě jīntiān de zhòngyào shìjiàn.
examples.english: She has a habit of first browsing through news headlines after waking up each morning to get a rough idea of the day's important events.

examples.chinese: 他用手機瀏覽各大購物平台，比較同款商品的價格，找到最划算的一家下單。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒujī liúlǎn gè dà gòuwù píngtái, bǐjiào tóng kuǎn shāngpǐn de jiàgé, zhǎodào zuì huásuàn de yī jiā xià dān.
examples.english: He browsed various major shopping platforms on his phone, comparing prices for the same product, and placed an order with the most affordable one.

semanticNote: 流 (flow; spread; circulate) + 傳 (pass on; transmit; spread) — to spread; to circulate; to be handed down. 流傳已久 (has been circulating for a long time), 廣泛流傳 (spread widely), 民間流傳的故事 (a folk story passed down). Implies a natural, organic spreading of information, legend, or culture. Distinct from 傳播 (broadcasting; media dissemination).

examples.chinese: 這首民謠在台灣民間流傳已有百年以上的歷史，歌詞記錄了先民的生活點滴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu mínyáo zài Táiwān mínjiān liúchuán yǐ yǒu bǎi nián yǐshàng de lìshǐ, gēcí jìlù le xiānmín de shēnghuó diǎndī.
examples.english: This folk song has been circulating among the Taiwanese people for over a hundred years; its lyrics record the daily life of the early settlers.

examples.chinese: 網路上流傳一則假消息，聲稱台北將發生大地震，引發不少市民恐慌。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shàng liúchuán yī zé jiǎ xiāoxi, chēngchēng Táiběi jiāng fāshēng dà dìzhèn, yǐnfā bùshǎo shìmín kǒnghuāng.
examples.english: A piece of fake news circulated online claiming a major earthquake was about to hit Taipei, causing panic among quite a few residents.

semanticNote: 流 (flow; shed) + 淚 (tear; teardrop) — to shed tears; to weep. 感動得流淚 (moved to tears), 流下眼淚 (tears flow down), 不禁流淚 (couldn't help crying). More literary than 哭 (cry/weep); 流淚 emphasizes the tears themselves rather than the full act of crying. 熱淚盈眶 (eyes brimming with hot tears — a related set phrase).

examples.chinese: 看到畢業典禮上老師哽咽致詞，台下許多同學忍不住跟著流淚。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng lǎoshī gěngye zhìcí, tái xià xǔduō tóngxué rěn bú zhù gēnzhe liúlèi.
examples.english: Seeing the teacher choke up during their graduation speech, many students in the audience couldn't help shedding tears too.

examples.chinese: 她讀到那封多年前外婆留下的信，忍不住流淚，深深感受到家人的愛與期盼。
examples.pinyin: Tā dú dào nà fēng duō nián qián wàipó liú xià de xìn, rěn bú zhù liúlèi, shēnshēn gǎnshòu dào jiārén de ài yǔ qīpàn.
examples.english: When she read the letter her grandmother had left years ago, she couldn't help shedding tears, deeply moved by the love and hope of family.

semanticNote: 龍 — a dragon. In Chinese culture, the dragon (龍) is auspicious, representing power, good luck, and the emperor. Very different from the Western dragon. 龍年 (Year of the Dragon — one of the most popular birth years in Chinese culture), 龍舟 (dragon boat — 端午節 dragon boat racing is a major Taiwan festival). 龍眼 (longan fruit — lit. 'dragon eye').

examples.chinese: 端午節的龍舟比賽是台灣的重要傳統活動，吸引全家大小到河邊觀看。
examples.pinyin: Duānwǔ jié de lóngzhōu bǐsài shì Táiwān de zhòngyào chuántǒng huódòng, xīyǐn quánjiā dàxiǎo dào hébiān guānkàn.
examples.english: Dragon boat racing during the Dragon Boat Festival is an important traditional event in Taiwan, drawing whole families to the riverside to watch.

examples.chinese: 龍年出生的孩子被認為特別有福氣，許多夫妻都會計劃在龍年生孩子。
examples.pinyin: Lóng nián chūshēng de háizi bèi rènwéi tèbié yǒu fúqì, xǔduō fūqī dōu huì jìhuà zài lóng nián shēng háizi.
examples.english: Children born in the Year of the Dragon are considered especially blessed; many couples plan to have children in a Dragon Year.

semanticNote: 漏 — to leak; to let out; to leave out (accidentally). 漏水 (water leak), 漏氣 (air leak), 漏掉 (accidentally omit; miss), 不漏痕跡 (leave no trace). Also 漏斗 (funnel). In Taiwan: 抓漏 (fix a water leak — a common building maintenance service) and 掛一漏萬 (leave out countless things). The physical and abstract senses are both common.

components.meaning: leak; let out; omit; funnel; clepsydra

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，屋頂開始漏水，必須儘快找師傅來修繕，不然牆壁都會發霉。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, wūdǐng kāishǐ lòushuǐ, bìxū jǐnkuài zhǎo shīfu lái xiūshàn, bùrán qiángbì dōu huì fā méi.
examples.english: After the typhoon, the roof started leaking; they must find someone to repair it as soon as possible, otherwise the walls will get moldy.

examples.chinese: 她整理報告時不小心漏掉了第三頁的內容，幸好主管在送出前發現了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhěnglǐ bàogào shí bù xiǎoxīn lòudiào le dì sān yè de nèiróng, xìnghǎo zhǔguǎn zài sòng chū qián fāxiàn le.
examples.english: While organizing the report she accidentally left out the third page's content — fortunately her supervisor noticed before it was sent out.

semanticNote: 陸 (land; continental; six) + 地 (ground; earth; land) — dry land (as opposed to the sea or air). 陸地面積 (land area), 登陸 (make landfall; land troops). In Taiwan's geopolitical context, 陸地 is straightforwardly geographical; 中國大陸 (the Chinese mainland) uses 陸 in a different compound. 上陸 is the Japanese-influenced term for going ashore (used in military/naval contexts).

examples.chinese: 這隻海龜在產卵季爬上陸地，把蛋埋在沙灘上，之後又回到海洋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī hǎiguī zài chǎnluǎn jì pá shàng lùdì, bǎ dàn mái zài shātān shàng, zhīhòu yòu huídào hǎiyáng.
examples.english: During nesting season, this sea turtle crawled ashore, buried its eggs in the sand, then returned to the ocean.

examples.chinese: 颱風即將登陸，預計在陸地上滯留兩天，帶來大量降雨和強風。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng jíjiāng dēnglù, yùjì zài lùdì shàng zhìliú liǎng tiān, dài lái dàliàng jiàngyǔ hé qiángfēng.
examples.english: The typhoon is about to make landfall and is expected to linger over land for two days, bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds.

semanticNote: 陸 (land; one after another) + 續 (continue; follow; extend) — in turn; successively; one after another; gradually. 陸續到達 (arrive one after another), 陸續開始 (begin successively), 陸續完成 (complete one by one). Implies things happening in sequence without a long gap, not simultaneously. More orderly than 紛紛 (one after another — more chaotic).

examples.chinese: 婚宴開始前，賓客們陸續入座，服務生為每桌倒上迎賓飲料。
examples.pinyin: Hūnyàn kāishǐ qián, bīnkèmen lùxù rù zuò, fúwùshēng wèi měi zhuō dào shàng yíngbīn yǐnliào.
examples.english: Before the wedding banquet began, guests took their seats one after another as servers poured welcome drinks for each table.

examples.chinese: 演唱會結束後，觀眾陸續離場，捷運站一時之間擠滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì jiéshù hòu, guānzhòng lùxù lí chǎng, jié yùn zhàn yī shí zhījiān jǐ mǎn le rén.
examples.english: After the concert ended, the audience filed out one after another, and the MRT station was momentarily packed with people.

semanticNote: 錄 (record; enroll; accept) + 取 (take; select; obtain) — to recruit; to admit; to accept (into a school or position). 錄取通知書 (admission notice), 被錄取 (be admitted/accepted), 錄取率 (acceptance rate). In Taiwan: 大學分發入學 (university placement admission). 學測 and 指考 determine which universities accept students. 被台大錄取 (accepted by NTU) is a proud milestone.

examples.chinese: 她收到台大醫學系的錄取通知，全家人都高興得不知如何是好。
examples.pinyin: Tā shōudào Tái Dà yīxué xì de lùqǔ tōngzhī, quánjiā rén dōu gāoxìng de bù zhī rúhé shì hǎo.
examples.english: She received the acceptance notice from NTU's medical school; the whole family was so thrilled they didn't know what to do with themselves.

examples.chinese: 這家公司每年從全台錄取不超過十名管理培訓生，競爭非常激烈。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī měi nián cóng quán Tái lùqǔ bù chāoguò shí míng guǎnlǐ péixùn shēng, jìngzhēng fēicháng jīliè.
examples.english: This company recruits no more than ten management trainees from all over Taiwan each year — competition is extremely fierce.

semanticNote: 錄 (record) + 音 (sound; voice; music) — to record (sound); a sound recording. 錄音筆 (digital voice recorder), 錄音室 (recording studio), 錄音訊息 (voice message). In Taiwan's music industry (流行音樂), 錄音 is central. 語音信箱 uses recordings. 偷錄音 (secretly record audio) is a privacy concern.

examples.chinese: 會議結束後，她把今天的錄音整理成文字，做成詳細的會議紀錄。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, tā bǎ jīntiān de lùyīn zhěnglǐ chéng wénzì, zuò chéng xiángxì de huìyì jìlù.
examples.english: After the meeting, she transcribed today's recording into text to create a detailed set of meeting minutes.

examples.chinese: 他花了整整一個月在錄音室錄製這張專輯，力求每一首歌都達到最完美的效果。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le zhěngzhěng yī gè yuè zài lùyīn shì lùzhì zhè zhāng zhuānjí, lìqiú měi yī shǒu gē dōu dádào zuì wánměi de xiàoguǒ.
examples.english: He spent a full month in the recording studio producing this album, striving to achieve the most perfect result for every song.

semanticNote: 輪 (wheel; turn; rotate; shift) + 流 (flow; circulate; in turn) — to take turns; to alternate; to rotate (duties, positions, etc.). 輪流值班 (take turns on duty), 輪流做 (take turns doing), 輪流發言 (take turns speaking). Very common in group settings. The image of a rotating wheel conveys orderly rotation.

components.meaning: flow; circulate; in turn; class; spread

examples.chinese: 家裡三個孩子輪流洗碗，這樣誰也不用每天都做同一件事。
examples.pinyin: Jiā lǐ sān gè háizi lúnliú xǐ wǎn, zhèyàng shéi yě bùyòng měitiān dōu zuò tóngyī jiàn shì.
examples.english: The three children at home take turns washing dishes so no one has to do the same thing every day.

examples.chinese: 公司的主管職位每兩年輪流由不同部門的資深員工擔任，以促進組織流動。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhíwèi měi liǎng nián lúnliú yóu bùtóng bùmén de zīshēn yuángōng dānrèn, yǐ cùjìn zǔzhī liúdòng.
examples.english: The company's management position rotates every two years among senior employees from different departments to promote organizational mobility.

semanticNote: 論 (discuss; theory; essay) + 文 (writing; language; culture; essay) — a thesis; academic paper; treatise. 碩士論文 (master's thesis), 博士論文 (doctoral dissertation), 學術論文 (academic paper), 發表論文 (publish a paper). In Taiwan, university graduation often requires a 畢業論文 (graduation thesis). SCI/SSCI papers are valued in academic promotion.

examples.chinese: 她花了兩年時間完成碩士論文，研究台灣年輕人的政治認同與國族意識。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le liǎng nián shíjiān wánchéng shuòshì lùnwén, yánjiū Táiwān niánqīngrén de zhèngzhì rèntóng yǔ guózú yìshí.
examples.english: She spent two years completing her master's thesis, researching the political identity and national consciousness of young people in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 教授要求學生在學期末提交一篇兩萬字的學術論文，並附上完整的參考文獻。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu yāoqiú xuéshēng zài xuéqī mò tíjiāo yī piān liǎng wàn zì de xuéshù lùnwén, bìng fùshàng wánzhěng de cānkǎo wénxiàn.
examples.english: The professor required students to submit a 20,000-character academic paper at the end of the semester, complete with a full bibliography.

semanticNote: 邏 (logic; filter; patrol) + 輯 (compile; collect; logic) — logic (the intellectual discipline and the quality of reasoning). 邏輯思維 (logical thinking), 邏輯錯誤 (logical error/fallacy), 符合邏輯 (logically consistent). A phonetic borrowing from the Greek/English 'logic' via Japanese. Very common in academic, critical thinking, and everyday debate contexts.

examples.chinese: 他的論點聽起來頭頭是道，但仔細分析後發現其中有幾個明顯的邏輯錯誤。
examples.pinyin: Tā de lùndiǎn tīng qǐlái tóu tóu shì dào, dàn zǐxì fēnxī hòu fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu jǐ gè míngxiǎn de luóji cuòwù.
examples.english: His argument sounded very convincing, but close analysis revealed several obvious logical flaws.

examples.chinese: 學好數學和程式設計能培養嚴謹的邏輯思維，對各個領域的學習都有幫助。
examples.pinyin: Xué hǎo shùxué hé chéngshì shèjì néng péiyǎng yánjǐn de luóji sīwéi, duì gège lǐngyù de xuéxí dōu yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: Learning math and programming well can cultivate rigorous logical thinking, which benefits learning in every field.

semanticNote: 落 (fall; lag; drop) + 後 (behind; after; back) — to fall behind; backward; underdeveloped. 技術落後 (technologically behind), 成績落後 (academically behind), 落後地區 (underdeveloped regions), 不甘落後 (unwilling to fall behind). Both literal (fall behind in a race) and figurative (culturally or technologically behind) senses are common.

examples.chinese: 她比其他同學學得慢，但她不甘落後，每天都花額外的時間複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ qítā tóngxué xué de màn, dàn tā bù gān luòhòu, měitiān dōu huā éwài de shíjiān fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: She learned more slowly than her classmates, but unwilling to fall behind, she spent extra time every day reviewing her schoolwork.

examples.chinese: 台灣的部分偏遠地區在數位基礎設施方面仍然相對落後，需要政府積極投入改善。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de bùfèn piānyuǎn dìqū zài shùwèi jīchǔ shèshī fāngmiàn réngrán xiāngduì luòhòu, xūyào zhèngfǔ jījí tóurù gǎishàn.
examples.english: Some of Taiwan's remote areas remain relatively underdeveloped in digital infrastructure and need active government investment to improve.

semanticNote: 罵 — to scold; to curse; to verbally abuse. 挨罵 (get scolded), 罵人 (curse at someone; scold someone), 罵髒話 (use profanity), 被老師罵 (get scolded by the teacher). Can range from gentle parental correction to harsh verbal abuse. In Taiwan casual speech: 被罵慘了 (got thoroughly chewed out). The character 罵 shows two mouths (口口) under 网 — graphically depicting two people yelling.

examples.chinese: 孩子把媽媽剛洗好的白衣服弄髒了，被罵了一頓，委屈地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Háizi bǎ māma gāng xǐ hǎo de bái yīfú nòng zāng le, bèi mà le yī dùn, wěiqu de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: The child dirtied the white clothes mom had just washed, got a good scolding, and burst into aggrieved tears.

examples.chinese: 他在網路上發文批評某款遊戲，被一群熱情的粉絲狂罵，讓他大感意外。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǎnglù shàng fā wén pīpíng mǒu kuǎn yóuxì, bèi yī qún rèqíng de fěnsī kuáng mà, ràng tā dà gǎn yìwài.
examples.english: He posted a critical review of a video game online and got ferociously cursed out by a group of passionate fans — it came as a great shock.

semanticNote: 麥克風 — microphone. A full phonetic borrowing from 'microphone.' 話筒 (huàtǒng) is a partial synonym (also means receiver/handset). 無線麥克風 (wireless mic), 麥克風架 (mic stand), 搶麥克風 (grab the mic). In Taiwan's KTV culture, 麥克風 is central to the karaoke experience. 自由麥 (open mic) events are popular in venues.

examples.chinese: 演講前，工作人員幫他調整好麥克風的高度，確保每位觀眾都能清楚聽到他的聲音。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng qián, gōngzuò rényuán bāng tā tiáozhěng hǎo màikèfēng de gāodù, quèbǎo měi wèi guānzhòng dōu néng qīngchǔ tīngdào tā de shēngyīn.
examples.english: Before the speech, staff adjusted the microphone height for him to ensure every audience member could clearly hear his voice.

examples.chinese: 她在KTV和朋友搶麥克風，兩個人你唱一段我唱一段，玩得不亦樂乎。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài KTV hé péngyǒu qiǎng màikèfēng, liǎng gè rén nǐ chàng yī duàn wǒ chàng yī duàn, wán de bù yì lè hū.
examples.english: She and her friend fought over the microphone at karaoke — taking turns singing a verse each, having a blast.

semanticNote: 饅頭 — a steamed bun or roll (without filling, unlike 包子 which has filling). In Taiwan, 饅頭 is a staple bread item in 早餐店 (breakfast shops). 手工饅頭 (handmade steamed buns), 黑糖饅頭 (brown sugar steamed bun). 饅頭 is an early loanword — the word predates the Han period and may have Mongolian origins.

examples.chinese: 台灣早餐店賣的饅頭口感鬆軟，搭配一杯豆漿，是許多人最喜愛的早餐組合。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zǎocān diàn mài de mántou kǒugǎn sōng ruǎn, dāpèi yī bēi dòujiāng, shì xǔduō rén zuì xǐ'ài de zǎocān zǔhé.
examples.english: The steamed buns sold at Taiwan breakfast shops are soft and fluffy; paired with a cup of soy milk, it's many people's favorite breakfast combination.

examples.chinese: 她在市場買了一袋現做的黑糖饅頭，還沒到家就忍不住撕開袋子吃了一個。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shìchǎng mǎi le yī dài xiàn zuò de hēitáng mántou, hái méi dào jiā jiù rěn bú zhù sī kāi dàizi chī le yī gè.
examples.english: She bought a bag of freshly made brown sugar steamed buns at the market and couldn't resist tearing open the bag to eat one before even getting home.

semanticNote: 滿 (full; filled; satisfied) + 足 (enough; foot; sufficient) — to satisfy; to meet (needs, requirements); satisfied; content. 滿足需求 (meet needs), 感到滿足 (feel satisfied/content), 不滿足現狀 (not satisfied with the status quo). Both as a verb (satisfy someone) and as an adj (feeling satisfied). 知足常樂 (contentment brings happiness — a proverb).

examples.chinese: 看到孩子健康快樂地成長，她就感到非常滿足，覺得所有的辛苦都值得。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào háizi jiànkāng kuàilè de chéngzhǎng, tā jiù gǎndào fēicháng mǎnzú, juéde suǒyǒu de xīnkǔ dōu zhídé.
examples.english: Seeing her child grow up healthy and happy, she feels deeply satisfied and believes all the hard work was worth it.

examples.chinese: 這家飯店的服務非常細心，幾乎能滿足賓客提出的每一個合理要求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de fúwù fēicháng xìxīn, jīhū néng mǎnzú bīnkè tíchū de měi yī gè hélǐ yāoqiú.
examples.english: This hotel's service is extremely attentive — it can meet nearly every reasonable request made by guests.

semanticNote: 毛 (hair; fur; rough; defect) + 病 (illness; disease; defect) — a fault; a bad habit; a shortcoming; a malfunction (of a machine). 壞毛病 (a bad habit), 有毛病 (have a problem; be broken/faulty — colloquial), 這台機器又有毛病了 (this machine is acting up again). Very colloquial. 你有毛病！(You're crazy/there's something wrong with you! — mild insult in Taiwan).

components.meaning: hair; fur; rough; negligent; defect; cent

examples.chinese: 他有個壞毛病，說話常常說到一半就轉移話題，讓人摸不著頭緒。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu gè huài máobìng, shuōhuà chángcháng shuō dào yī bàn jiù zhuǎnyí huàtí, ràng rén mō bù zhe tóuxù.
examples.english: He has a bad habit of switching topics mid-sentence, leaving people completely lost.

examples.chinese: 這台影印機又出毛病了，每印兩張就卡紙，讓大家工作的效率大打折扣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái yǐngyìn jī yòu chū máobìng le, měi yìn liǎng zhāng jiù qiā zhǐ, ràng dàjiā gōngzuò de xiàolǜ dà dǎ zhékòu.
examples.english: The photocopier is acting up again — jamming every two pages, seriously cutting into everyone's productivity.

semanticNote: 矛 (spear) + 盾 (shield) — contradiction; conflict; contradictory. The word comes from the classic paradox: 'What happens when an unstoppable spear meets an impenetrable shield?' 自相矛盾 (self-contradictory), 內心矛盾 (conflicted internally), 矛盾心理 (ambivalent feelings). Both logical contradiction and emotional conflict.

examples.chinese: 她對這份工作的感情非常矛盾，一方面不想離開同事，另一方面又迫切希望轉換跑道。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhè fèn gōngzuò de gǎnqíng fēicháng máodùn, yī fāngmiàn bù xiǎng líkāi tóngshì, lìng yī fāngmiàn yòu pòqiē xīwàng zhuǎnhuàn pǎodào.
examples.english: Her feelings about this job are deeply conflicted — on one hand she doesn't want to leave her colleagues, on the other she desperately wants to change careers.

examples.chinese: 政府的政策有時候存在內部矛盾，導致不同部門的措施互相抵消，效果大打折扣。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ de zhèngcè yǒushíhòu cúnzài nèibù máodùn, dǎozhì bùtóng bùmén de cuòshī hùxiāng dǐxiāo, xiàoguǒ dà dǎ zhékòu.
examples.english: Government policies sometimes contain internal contradictions, causing measures from different departments to cancel each other out and greatly reducing their effectiveness.

semanticNote: 冒 (brave; emit; risk; bold) + 險 (danger; risk;险) — to take a risk; to venture; an adventure. 冒險精神 (spirit of adventure), 不值得冒險 (not worth the risk), 冒生命危險 (risk one's life). As an adj/n: 冒險故事 (adventure story). Can be positive (adventurous spirit) or cautionary (reckless risk-taking) depending on context.

components.meaning: brave; emit; risk; bold; falsely claim

examples.chinese: 他決定放棄穩定的工作去創業，朋友都說他在冒險，但他覺得值得一試。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng fàngqì wěndìng de gōngzuò qù chuàngyè, péngyǒu dōu shuō tā zài màoxiǎn, dàn tā juéde zhídé yī shì.
examples.english: He decided to give up his stable job to start a business; friends all said he was taking a risk, but he felt it was worth a try.

examples.chinese: 在台灣東部的秀姑巒溪泛舟是刺激又帶點冒險的活動，吸引不少戶外愛好者。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān dōngbù de Xiùgū Luán Xī fàn zhōu shì cìjī yòu dài diǎn màoxiǎn de huódòng, xīyǐn bùshǎo hùwài àihào zhě.
examples.english: White-water rafting on the Xiuguluan River in eastern Taiwan is a thrilling and somewhat adventurous activity that attracts many outdoor enthusiasts.

semanticNote: 貿 (trade; exchange) + 易 (exchange; trade; easy; change) — (commercial) trade. 國際貿易 (international trade), 貿易順差/逆差 (trade surplus/deficit), 貿易戰 (trade war), 貿易夥伴 (trade partner). Taiwan's economy is highly trade-dependent; 貿易 statistics are closely watched. 自由貿易協定 (FTA — free trade agreement) is an ongoing policy discussion.

examples.chinese: 台灣是一個高度依賴對外貿易的小型開放經濟體，出口占GDP相當大的比例。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yī gè gāodù yīlài duì wài màoyì de xiǎoxíng kāifàng jīngjìtǐ, chūkǒu zhàn GDP xiāngdāng dà de bǐlì.
examples.english: Taiwan is a small open economy highly dependent on foreign trade, with exports accounting for a considerable portion of GDP.

examples.chinese: 美中貿易戰的持續影響了全球供應鏈的布局，也讓台灣廠商面臨了新的機遇與挑戰。
examples.pinyin: Měizhōng màoyì zhàn de chíxù yǐngxiǎng le quánqiú gōngyīng liàn de bùjú, yě ràng Táiwān chǎngshāng miànlín le xīn de jīyù yǔ tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: The ongoing US-China trade war has affected the layout of global supply chains and has presented Taiwan's manufacturers with both new opportunities and challenges.

semanticNote: 眉 (eyebrow; margin) + 毛 (hair; fur) — eyebrow(s). 眉毛修整 (eyebrow grooming), 眉開眼笑 (beaming with joy — eyebrows raised and eyes smiling), 眉頭一皺 (frown; furrow one's brow). In Taiwan's beauty industry, 紋眉 (eyebrow tattooing/microblading) and 飄眉 (feather brow technique) are popular cosmetic procedures.

examples.chinese: 她去做了飄眉，省去了每天畫眉毛的時間，整體妝容看起來更自然。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù zuò le piāo méi, shěngqù le měitiān huà méimao de shíjiān, zhěngtǐ zhuāngróng kàn qǐlái gèng zìrán.
examples.english: She got microbladed eyebrows, saving the time of drawing them on every day; her overall makeup looks more natural now.

examples.chinese: 他一聽到壞消息，眉頭立刻皺了起來，陷入了深思。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī tīngdào huài xiāoxi, méitóu lìkè zhòu le qǐlái, xiànrù le shēnsī.
examples.english: The moment he heard the bad news, his brow immediately furrowed as he fell into deep thought.

semanticNote: 媒 (matchmaker; media; intermediary) + 體 (body; form; system; medium) — (news) media; a medium. 大眾媒體 (mass media), 社群媒體 (social media), 媒體自由 (press freedom), 媒體識讀 (media literacy). Taiwan has a vibrant and sometimes chaotic media landscape; press freedom is a core democratic value frequently discussed. 媒體識讀教育 (media literacy education) is a growing curriculum area.

examples.chinese: 在資訊爆炸的時代，媒體識讀能力變得越來越重要，幫助人們辨別真假新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zài zīxùn bàozhà de shídài, méitǐ shídú nénglì biàn de yuè lái yuè zhòngyào, bāngzhù rénmen biànbié zhēn jiǎ xīnwén.
examples.english: In an era of information overload, media literacy is becoming increasingly important, helping people distinguish real news from fake.

examples.chinese: 台灣的媒體自由在亞洲名列前茅，記者有相對充分的空間報導各類議題。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de méitǐ zìyóu zài Yàzhōu míngliè qiánmáo, jìzhě yǒu xiāngduì chōngfèn de kōngjiān bàodǎo gè lèi yìtí.
examples.english: Taiwan's press freedom ranks among the highest in Asia; journalists have relatively ample space to report on all kinds of issues.

semanticNote: 煤 (coal; soot) + 炭 (charcoal; carbon; coal) — coal (the fossil fuel). 燃煤發電 (coal-fired power generation), 減少煤炭使用 (reduce coal consumption). Taiwan is a major importer of coal (石炭 is another term). Energy policy — the balance between nuclear, coal, and renewables — is a major political debate in Taiwan. 廢核減煤 (phase out nuclear and coal) vs. energy security is ongoing.

examples.chinese: 台灣的燃煤電廠是空氣污染的主要來源之一，環保團體持續要求政府加速去煤化。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de rán méi diànchǎng shì kōngqì wūrǎn de zhǔyào láiyuán zhī yī, huánbǎo tuántǐ chíxù yāoqiú zhèngfǔ jiāsù qù méi huà.
examples.english: Taiwan's coal-fired power plants are one of the main sources of air pollution; environmental groups continue to pressure the government to accelerate coal phase-out.

examples.chinese: 全球許多國家正在積極轉型，以再生能源取代煤炭，實現能源去碳化的目標。
examples.pinyin: Quánqiú xǔduō guójiā zhèngzài jījí zhuǎnxíng, yǐ zàishēng néngyuán qǔdài méitàn, shíxiàn néngyuán qù tàn huà de mùbiāo.
examples.english: Many countries around the world are actively transitioning away from coal to renewable energy to achieve the goal of decarbonizing their energy supplies.

semanticNote: Covers painting, sculpture, calligraphy, and graphic arts collectively — the 'fine arts' as taught in school. In Taiwan school contexts, 美術課 is the standard art class. Distinct from 藝術 (art broadly, including performing arts). 美術館 is an art museum (not a gallery — 畫廊 handles that).

examples.chinese: 她從小就喜歡畫畫，高中選擇了美術班。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuān huàhuà, gāozhōng xuǎnzé le měishùbān.
examples.english: She loved drawing from a young age and chose the fine arts track in high school.

examples.chinese: 台北市立美術館這次的特展吸引了很多人排隊參觀。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Shìlì Měishùguǎn zhècì de tèzhǎn xīyǐn le hěnduō rén páiduì cānguān.
examples.english: The special exhibition at the Taipei Fine Arts Museum drew long queues of visitors.

semanticNote: Personal magnetism or the allure of a place or thing — charisma that draws others in. Can describe a person (她很有魅力), a city (這座城市的魅力), or even an idea. Not used for physical beauty alone — 魅力 implies a pull that goes beyond appearance.

examples.chinese: 他說話的方式很有魅力，每次演講都能讓台下的人全神貫注。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de fāngshì hěn yǒu mèilì, měicì yǎnjiǎng dōu néng ràng táixià de rén quánshénguànzhù.
examples.english: His way of speaking is truly charismatic — every speech keeps the audience completely absorbed.

examples.chinese: 台南這座城市的魅力在於它將古蹟與美食融合得恰到好處。
examples.pinyin: Táinán zhè zuò chéngshì de mèilì zàiyú tā jiāng gǔjī yǔ měishí rónghé de qiàdàohǎochù.
examples.english: Tainan's charm lies in how perfectly it blends historic sites with great food.

semanticNote: As a noun: a cherished dream or aspiration (她的夢想是成為醫生). As a verb: to dream of, often with a sense of longing that may or may not be realistic. Warmer and more personal than 目標 (goal) — 夢想 carries emotional investment. 夢想成真 (dreams come true) is a fixed phrase.

components.meaning: to think; to wish; to miss

examples.chinese: 她從小的夢想是登上玉山頂，去年終於實現了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng shì dēng shàng Yùshān dǐng, qùnián zhōngyú shíxiàn le.
examples.english: Her childhood dream was to summit Jade Mountain, and she finally achieved it last year.

examples.chinese: 別只是夢想，要踏出第一步才能讓計畫成真。
examples.pinyin: Bié zhǐshì mèngxiǎng, yào tà chū dì yī bù cái néng ràng jìhuà chénggēn.
examples.english: Don't just dream — you have to take the first step to make a plan real.

semanticNote: As a noun: a secret (保守秘密 — keep a secret; 洩漏秘密 — leak a secret). As an adjective: secret, confidential (秘密會議 — secret meeting). Covers personal secrets, classified information, and hidden facts alike. Stronger and more formal than saying something is 不公開的.

examples.chinese: 她把這件事當作秘密，從來沒有告訴過任何人。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè jiàn shì dàngzuò mìmì, cónglái méiyǒu gàosuguo rènhé rén.
examples.english: She kept this matter a secret and never told anyone.

examples.chinese: 政府召開秘密會議，討論台海局勢的最新動態。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhàokāi mìmì huìyì, tǎolùn Táihǎi júshì de zuìxīn dòngtài.
examples.english: The government held a secret meeting to discuss the latest developments in the Taiwan Strait situation.

semanticNote: Secretary in an administrative/organizational sense — handles correspondence, scheduling, and coordination for an executive or official body. In Taiwan government and corporate contexts, 秘書 can be a senior role (秘書長 — Secretary-General). Not used for a keyboard/typing secretary (打字員) or a school secretary (幹事/組長).

examples.chinese: 她擔任董事長的私人秘書已經十年了，處理各種事務非常得力。
examples.pinyin: Tā dānrèn dǒngshìzhǎng de sīrén mìshu yǐjīng shí nián le, chǔlǐ gèzhǒng shìwù fēicháng délì.
examples.english: She has been the chairman's personal secretary for ten years and handles all kinds of matters with great efficiency.

examples.chinese: 請先聯絡我的秘書，確認時間後再安排會面。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiān liánluò wǒ de mìshu, quèrèn shíjiān hòu zài ānpái huìmiàn.
examples.english: Please contact my secretary first, and we'll arrange a meeting once the time is confirmed.

semanticNote: Close and intimate — used for relationships, cooperation, or attention. 關係密切 (closely related), 密切合作 (work closely together), 密切關注 (closely monitor/watch). Implies active, ongoing closeness rather than mere proximity. Often used in formal or news contexts: 密切注意疫情發展 — closely monitoring disease developments.

examples.chinese: 兩岸學術機構長期保持密切的合作關係。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng'àn xuéshù jīgòu chángqī bǎochí mìqiè de hézuò guānxi.
examples.english: Academic institutions on both sides of the strait have long maintained close cooperative ties.

examples.chinese: 請密切注意颱風動向，隨時準備應變。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng mìqiè zhùyì táifēng dòngxiàng, suíshí zhǔnbèi yìngbiàn.
examples.english: Please closely monitor the typhoon's path and be ready to respond at any time.

semanticNote: Honeybee specifically — the bee that produces honey (蜂蜜) and pollinates crops. 蜜蜂 is the common term; 蜂 alone appears in compounds (蜂巢 hive, 蜂王 queen bee, 蜂蜜 honey). In Taiwan, bee farming is concentrated in the south, and 龍眼蜜 (longan honey) is a prized local product.

examples.chinese: 農夫說蜜蜂對農作物的授粉非常重要，不能隨便使用農藥。
examples.pinyin: Nóngfū shuō mìfēng duì nóngzuòwù de shòufěn fēicháng zhòngyào, bù néng suíbiàn shǐyòng nóngyào.
examples.english: The farmer said honeybees are crucial for pollinating crops, so pesticides can't be used carelessly.

examples.chinese: 台灣南部的龍眼蜜蜂農每年夏天都非常忙碌。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù de lóngyǎn mì fēngnóng měinián xiàtiān dōu fēicháng mánglù.
examples.english: Longan honey beekeepers in southern Taiwan are extremely busy every summer.

semanticNote: To face or confront something — used for challenges, facts, situations, and people. Implies a direct, often courageous engagement rather than avoidance. 面對現實 (face reality), 面對困難 (confront difficulties). More active than 面臨 (which means being up against something, often passive/situational).

examples.chinese: 面對失敗，最重要的是從中學習，而不是一蹶不振。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì shībài, zuì zhòngyào de shì cóng zhōng xuéxí, ér bù shì yījuébùzhèn.
examples.english: When facing failure, the most important thing is to learn from it, not to collapse under it.

examples.chinese: 她鼓起勇氣，決定直接面對與朋友之間的誤會。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǔqǐ yǒngqì, juédìng zhíjiē miànduì yǔ péngyǒu zhījiān de wùhuì.
examples.english: She gathered her courage and decided to confront the misunderstanding with her friend directly.

semanticNote: Surface area — the two-dimensional extent of a space, region, or object. Used in math (計算面積), geography (台灣的面積約為36,000平方公里), and real estate (這間公寓的室內面積是28坪). In Taiwan, floor area is typically measured in 坪 (ping, ~3.3 m²) in everyday usage, but official statistics use 平方公里 or 平方公尺.

examples.chinese: 這間套房的室內面積只有十五坪，但格局規劃得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān tàofáng de shìnèi miànjī zhǐyǒu shíwǔ píng, dàn géjú guīhuà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This studio apartment is only 15 ping in area, but the layout is well planned.

examples.chinese: 台灣的陸地面積雖然不大，但地形複雜、生態多樣。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de lùdì miànjī suīrán bù dà, dàn dìxíng fùzá, shēngtài duōyàng.
examples.english: Although Taiwan's land area isn't large, its terrain is complex and its ecology is diverse.

semanticNote: To be confronted by or faced with — often used for external pressures, challenges, or situations the subject finds themselves in. More passive/situational than 面對 (which implies active engagement). 面臨困境 (facing a difficult situation), 面臨選擇 (be confronted with a choice), 面臨挑戰 (face challenges).

components.meaning: to face; to arrive at; to be on the verge of

examples.chinese: 許多中小企業在疫情後面臨資金周轉的困難。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō zhōngxiǎo qǐyè zài yìqíng hòu miànlín zījīn zhōuzhuǎn de kùnnán.
examples.english: Many small and medium-sized businesses faced cash flow difficulties after the pandemic.

examples.chinese: 這家老字號餐廳面臨房租大漲的壓力，不得不考慮遷址。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎozìhào cāntīng miànlín fángzū dà zhǎng de yālì, bùdé bù kǎolǜ qiān zhǐ.
examples.english: This long-established restaurant faced surging rent pressure and had to consider relocating.

semanticNote: Slim and shapely — used to describe a person's figure, specifically a slender, well-proportioned build. Carries a positive, admiring connotation (unlike 瘦 which is simply 'thin'). Almost always applies to women in practice, though grammatically unrestricted. 保持苗條 (stay trim) is a common collocation.

examples.chinese: 她每天早上去公園跑步，身材一直保持得很苗條。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshàng qù gōngyuán pǎobù, shēncái yīzhí bǎochí de hěn miáotiao.
examples.english: She goes jogging in the park every morning and has always kept a slim figure.

examples.chinese: 媽媽說與其追求苗條，不如注重健康才是正確的態度。
examples.pinyin: Māma shuō yǔqí zhuīqiú miáotiao, bùrú zhùzhòng jiànkāng cái shì zhèngquè de tàidù.
examples.english: Mom said that rather than chasing slimness, focusing on health is the right attitude.

semanticNote: To describe or depict in writing or speech — capturing details of appearance, scene, emotion, or character. A core literary term: 心理描寫 (psychological depiction), 環境描寫 (scene-setting description), 細膩的描寫 (nuanced portrayal). More specific to descriptive/narrative writing than 描述 (describe facts) or 說明 (explain).

components.meaning: to trace; to depict; to sketch

examples.chinese: 這部小說對台灣鄉村生活的描寫非常細膩，讓人有身歷其境的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō duì Táiwān xiāngcūn shēnghuó de miáoxiě fēicháng xìnì, ràng rén yǒu shēnlìqíjìng de gǎnjué.
examples.english: This novel's depiction of rural Taiwan life is so detailed that it makes readers feel they're there in person.

examples.chinese: 老師要求我們用一段文字描寫夜市的熱鬧景象。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen yòng yī duàn wénzì miáoxiě yèshì de rènào jǐngxiàng.
examples.english: The teacher asked us to write a paragraph describing the lively scene of a night market.

semanticNote: Sensitive — both physically (皮膚敏感 — sensitive skin) and emotionally (他很敏感，一說就生氣). Also used for politically or socially delicate topics: 敏感話題 (sensitive topic), 敏感時期 (sensitive period). The political usage is common in cross-strait and election contexts in Taiwan. 過於敏感 means overly sensitive/touchy.

examples.chinese: 她的皮膚很敏感，一換季就容易過敏發癢。
examples.pinyin: Tā de pífū hěn mǐngǎn, yī huànjì jiù róngyì guòmǐn fāyǎng.
examples.english: Her skin is very sensitive — she tends to break out in itchy rashes whenever the seasons change.

examples.chinese: 選舉前夕，媒體對任何政治敏感話題的報導都格外謹慎。
examples.pinyin: Xuǎnjǔ qiányī, méitǐ duì rènhé zhèngzhì mǐngǎn huàtí de bàodǎo dōu géwài jǐnshèn.
examples.english: On the eve of the election, the media was especially cautious about reporting on politically sensitive topics.

semanticNote: Name brand / designer brand — a prestigious label, whether fashion (名牌包 — designer handbag), consumer electronics, or any high-prestige product. In Taiwan, 名牌 often implies luxury import brands (LV, Gucci, etc.). Also literally means 'name tag' (會議名牌 — conference name badge) — context distinguishes the two meanings.

examples.chinese: 她買的那個名牌包花了她好幾個月的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi de nà ge míngpái bāo huā le tā hǎo jǐ ge yuè de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: The designer handbag she bought cost her several months' salary.

examples.chinese: 開會前請先在桌上擺好名牌，讓大家知道彼此的座位。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián qǐng xiān zài zhuō shàng bǎi hǎo míngpái, ràng dàjiā zhīdào bǐcǐ de zuòwèi.
examples.english: Please place the name badges on the table before the meeting starts so everyone knows where to sit.

semanticNote: Business card — the small card exchanged in professional introductions. In Taiwan (and Chinese business culture broadly), exchanging 名片 is a formal ritual: presented and received with both hands, read carefully before setting down. 交換名片 (exchange cards) is standard at any professional meeting. Digital business cards (電子名片) are increasingly common.

examples.chinese: 在台灣的商業場合，雙手遞交名片是基本的禮儀。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān de shāngyè chǎnghé, shuāngshǒu dìjiāo míngpiàn shì jīběn de lǐyí.
examples.english: In Taiwanese business settings, presenting a business card with both hands is basic etiquette.

examples.chinese: 他的名片上印著三個頭銜，讓我一時不知該如何稱呼他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de míngpiàn shàng yìnzhe sān ge tóuxián, ràng wǒ yīshí bù zhī gāi rúhé chēnghu tā.
examples.english: His business card had three titles printed on it, and I wasn't sure at first how to address him.

semanticNote: Famous scenic spots and historic sites — a fixed four-character phrase that typically appears as a set, covering both natural attractions (名勝) and human-made cultural heritage (古蹟). In Taiwan, 古蹟 is a formal legal classification (文化資產保存法) for protected historic buildings. The compound is standard in tourism and cultural heritage discourse.

examples.chinese: 台南是台灣保存最多名勝古蹟的城市，每年吸引大批觀光客。
examples.pinyin: Táinán shì Táiwān bǎocún zuìduō míngshènggǔjì de chéngshì, měinián xīyǐn dà pī guānguāngkè.
examples.english: Tainan is the city in Taiwan with the most famous scenic spots and historic sites, drawing large numbers of tourists every year.

examples.chinese: 旅行社安排了三天的行程，帶我們參觀當地的名勝古蹟。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíngshè ānpái le sān tiān de xíngchéng, dài wǒmen cānguān dāngdì de míngshènggǔjì.
examples.english: The travel agency arranged a three-day itinerary to take us to the local famous scenic spots and historic sites.

semanticNote: Clear and definite — leaving no room for ambiguity. As adjective: 立場明確 (a clear-cut position), 目標明確 (well-defined goals). As verb: 明確表示 (to make clear), 明確說明 (to clearly explain). Used heavily in formal, legal, and policy contexts. Stronger than 清楚 (clear in a general sense) — 明確 implies precision and deliberateness.

examples.chinese: 合約中必須明確說明雙方的責任與義務，避免日後糾紛。
examples.pinyin: Héyuē zhōng bìxū míngquè shuōmíng shuāngfāng de zérèn yǔ yìwù, bìmiǎn rìhòu jiūfēn.
examples.english: The contract must clearly specify the responsibilities and obligations of both parties to avoid future disputes.

examples.chinese: 她明確表示不接受這個條件，談判陷入僵局。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngquè biǎoshì bù jiēshòu zhège tiáojiàn, tánpàn xiànrù jiāngjú.
examples.english: She made it clear she would not accept the terms, and the negotiation reached a deadlock.

semanticNote: Clear; obvious; noticeable — something that stands out and is easy to perceive. 明顯的差別 (obvious difference), 明顯改善 (noticeable improvement), 效果明顯 (the effect is evident). Very common in both spoken and written Chinese. Stronger than 清楚 in the sense of being readily apparent to observation, not just comprehensible.

examples.chinese: 戒糖兩個月後，她的皮膚狀況有了明顯的改善。
examples.pinyin: Jiè táng liǎng ge yuè hòu, tā de pífū zhuàngkuàng yǒu le míngxiǎn de gǎishàn.
examples.english: After two months off sugar, her skin condition showed a noticeable improvement.

examples.chinese: 從數據來看，南北部的薪資差距依然相當明顯。
examples.pinyin: Cóng shùjù lái kàn, nánběibù de xīnzī chājù yīrán xiāngdāng míngxiǎn.
examples.english: Looking at the data, the wage gap between northern and southern Taiwan is still quite pronounced.

semanticNote: A star — celebrity in entertainment, sports, or occasionally business. In Taiwan, 明星 most often means a pop/music star (歌星), actor (影星), or sports celebrity. 明星學校 (elite school) is a common extended usage — a school famous for academic performance. Not used for literal astronomical stars (那是 星星/恆星).

examples.chinese: 她從小就夢想成為明星，高中畢業後就去報考了演藝學院。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù mèngxiǎng chéngwéi míngxīng, gāozhōng bìyè hòu jiù qù bàokǎo le yǎnyì xuéyuàn.
examples.english: She dreamed of becoming a star from childhood and applied to a performing arts school right after graduating high school.

examples.chinese: 那所明星高中的學測成績年年名列前茅，擠破頭想進去的學生不計其數。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ míngxīng gāozhōng de xuéchèe chéngjī niánnián míngliè qiánmáo, jǐ pò tóu xiǎng jìnqù de xuéshēng bùjìqíshù.
examples.english: That elite high school tops the GSAT rankings year after year, and countless students are desperate to get in.

semanticNote: An order or command — issued by authority (上級命令, 軍事命令). As verb: to order someone to do something. Implies hierarchical authority and expected compliance. More forceful than 要求 (request) or 吩咐 (instruct). Also used in computing: 指令/命令 for commands in programming or CLI contexts.

components.meaning: to order; to command; to cause

examples.chinese: 長官命令部隊在天亮前完成陣地的部署。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎngguān mìnglìng bùduì zài tiān liàng qián wánchéng zhèndì de bùshǔ.
examples.english: The commanding officer ordered the troops to complete the positioning before dawn.

examples.chinese: 系統提示輸入命令後按下Enter鍵即可執行。
examples.pinyin: Xìtǒng tíshì shūrù mìnglìng hòu àn xià Enter jiàn jí kě zhíxíng.
examples.english: The system prompts you to enter the command and press Enter to execute.

semanticNote: Fate; destiny — the larger arc of one's life, as if determined by forces beyond individual control. 掌握自己的命運 (take control of your own fate), 悲慘的命運 (tragic fate), 共同命運 (shared destiny). Philosophical and often weighty. In Taiwan's political discourse, 台灣的命運 (Taiwan's fate/destiny) is a recurring phrase.

examples.chinese: 她不相信命運是天注定的，認為努力可以改變一切。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiāngxìn mìngyùn shì tiānzhùdìng de, rènwéi nǔlì kěyǐ gǎibiàn yīqiè.
examples.english: She doesn't believe fate is predetermined and thinks hard work can change everything.

examples.chinese: 這部電影探討了個人意志與命運之間永恆的衝突。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng tàntǎo le gèrén yìzhì yǔ mìngyùn zhījiān yǒnghéng de chōngtū.
examples.english: This film explores the eternal conflict between individual will and fate.

semanticNote: To touch or feel with the hand — can be tactile exploration (摸黑 — feel around in the dark), affectionate touching (摸摸頭 — pat on the head), or cautious investigation (摸清情況 — get a feel for the situation). Also colloquially: to fish for/find by feel (從包包裡摸出手機). More physical and exploratory than 碰 (touch/bump) or 觸 (touch/contact).

components.meaning: to feel; to touch; to grope

examples.chinese: 小孩子伸手去摸熱鍋，被媽媽及時拉開了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo háizi shēnshǒu qù mō rè guō, bèi māma jíshí lā kāi le.
examples.english: The child reached out to touch the hot pot and was pulled away by her mother just in time.

examples.chinese: 他在黑暗中摸索了半天，才找到牆上的電燈開關。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hēi'àn zhōng mōsuǒ le bàntiān, cái zhǎodào qiáng shàng de diàndēng kāiguān.
examples.english: He fumbled around in the dark for a good while before finding the light switch on the wall.

semanticNote: To imitate or copy — can be admiring (向大師模仿學習 — learn by imitating masters) or pejorative (只知道模仿，沒有創意 — just copies, no originality). Covers impersonation, mimicry, and stylistic emulation. 模仿秀 (impersonation/impression show) is a popular variety TV format in Taiwan.

components.meaning: to imitate; to copy; to resemble

examples.chinese: 他模仿知名歌手的聲音非常像，在網路上爆紅了。
examples.pinyin: Tā mófǎng zhīmíng gēshǒu de shēngyīn fēicháng xiàng, zài wǎnglù shàng bào hóng le.
examples.english: His impression of a famous singer was spot-on and went viral online.

examples.chinese: 語言學習初期常常需要大量模仿母語者的發音和語調。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán xuéxí chūqī chángcháng xūyào dàliàng mófǎng mǔyǔzhě de fāyīn hé yǔdiào.
examples.english: In the early stages of language learning, you often need to extensively imitate native speakers' pronunciation and intonation.

semanticNote: Vague; blurry; indistinct — applies to vision (影像模糊 — blurry image), memory (記憶有些模糊 — memory is a bit hazy), statements (說法模糊 — vague statement), or boundaries (界線模糊 — blurred boundaries). As a verb: to blur or obscure (刻意模糊界線 — deliberately blur the line). Opposite of 明確/清晰.

examples.chinese: 照片拍得太模糊了，根本看不清楚臉。
examples.pinyin: Zhàopiàn pāi de tài móhu le, gēnběn kàn bù qīngchǔ liǎn.
examples.english: The photo came out too blurry to make out any faces at all.

examples.chinese: 他的回答刻意模糊，讓記者無法得到明確的答案。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huídá kèyì móhu, ràng jìzhě wúfǎ dédào míngquè de dá'àn.
examples.english: His answer was deliberately vague, leaving reporters unable to get a clear response.

semanticNote: Fashion model — from French/English 'model'. In Taiwan, 模特兒 (mótèr) is the full form; 模特 is the shortened mainland-influenced form that has also entered Taiwan usage. Covers runway models (走秀模特), commercial models (廣告模特), and figure models for art (人體模特). Not used for 3D scale models (模型) or role models (榜樣).

examples.chinese: 她在大學時兼職擔任模特兒，拍了不少廣告。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué shí jiānzhí dānrèn mótèr, pāi le bùshǎo guǎnggào.
examples.english: She worked part-time as a model during college and shot quite a few advertisements.

examples.chinese: 這次時裝週有超過五十位國際模特參與走秀。
examples.pinyin: Zhècì shízhuāng zhōu yǒu chāoguò wǔshí wèi guójì mótè cānyù zǒuxiù.
examples.english: This fashion week featured more than fifty international models walking the runway.

semanticNote: Motorcycle / motorbike — from English 'motor'. In Taiwan, the preferred everyday term is 機車 (jīchē) or 摩托車 interchangeably; 機車 is overwhelmingly dominant in spoken usage and also colloquially means 'annoying/difficult' (他真機車). 重型機車 (heavy motorcycle, 550cc+) requires a special license in Taiwan. Scooters (速克達) are the most common type.

examples.chinese: 台灣的機車密度是全球數一數二的高，上下班時間路上全是摩托車。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de jīchē mìdù shì quánqiú shǔyīshǔ'èr de gāo, shàngxiàbān shíjiān lùshàng quánshì mótuōchē.
examples.english: Taiwan's motorcycle density is among the highest in the world — the roads are packed with motorcycles during rush hour.

examples.chinese: 他騎摩托車上班，省了很多通勤時間和停車費。
examples.pinyin: Tā qí mótuōchē shàngbān, shěng le hěnduō tōngqín shíjiān hé tíngchē fèi.
examples.english: He rides his motorcycle to work, saving a lot of commute time and parking fees.

semanticNote: Strange; unfamiliar — applied to people (陌生人 — stranger), places (陌生的城市 — unfamiliar city), or feelings/situations (感到陌生 — feel like a stranger). Not the same as 奇怪 (weird/odd) — 陌生 is about unfamiliarity, not strangeness of character. 對…感到陌生 (feel unfamiliar with...) is a common pattern.

examples.chinese: 剛到新學校的第一個星期，她對周圍的一切都感到陌生。
examples.pinyin: Gāng dào xīn xuéxiào de dì yī ge xīngqī, tā duì zhōuwéi de yīqiè dōu gǎndào mòshēng.
examples.english: In her first week at the new school, everything around her felt unfamiliar.

examples.chinese: 不要輕易相信陌生人，尤其是在網路上主動接觸你的人。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào qīngyì xiāngxìn mòshēngrén, yóuqí shì zài wǎnglù shàng zhǔdòng jiēchù nǐ de rén.
examples.english: Don't trust strangers easily, especially people who reach out to you on the internet.

semanticNote: A certain; some — used as a determiner before nouns to refer to an unspecified particular person, place, time, or thing. 某人 (a certain person), 某天 (one day / a certain day), 某種程度 (to a certain extent). Can imply the referent is known but being withheld (法院審理某案件 — the court heard a certain case). Very common in formal and written Chinese.

examples.chinese: 報導中提到某企業主涉嫌詐欺，但並未公布其姓名。
examples.pinyin: Bàodǎo zhōng tídào mǒu qǐyè zhǔ shèxián zhàqī, dàn bìng wèi gōngbù qí xìngmíng.
examples.english: The report mentioned that a certain business owner was suspected of fraud but did not disclose their name.

examples.chinese: 在某種程度上，她說的話是有道理的。
examples.pinyin: Zài mǒu zhǒng chéngdù shàng, tā shuō de huà shì yǒu dàolǐ de.
examples.english: To a certain extent, what she said makes sense.

semanticNote: Wood; timber; a piece of wood. Refers to the physical material or a cut piece, rather than a living tree (樹木) or lumber (木料 in construction). Colloquially also means a wooden, expressionless, or slow-witted person: 他這個人太木頭了 (he's such a blockhead). 木頭人 (wooden person) is used for someone stiff or unresponsive.

examples.chinese: 師傅用一塊老木頭雕刻出了一尊精緻的媽祖神像。
examples.pinyin: Shīfu yòng yī kuài lǎo mùtou diāokè chū le yī zūn jīngzhì de Māzǔ shénxiàng.
examples.english: The master craftsman carved an exquisite Mazu statue from a piece of aged wood.

examples.chinese: 你怎麼這麼木頭，她那麼明顯的暗示你都沒察覺嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème mùtou, tā nàme míngxiǎn de ànshì nǐ dōu méi chájué ma?
examples.english: How can you be so oblivious? She was dropping such obvious hints and you didn't even notice?

semanticNote: Target; goal; objective — concrete and often measurable. 設定目標 (set a goal), 達成目標 (achieve a goal), 學習目標 (learning objective), 攻擊目標 (military target). More specific and action-oriented than 夢想 (dream) or 理想 (ideal). Commonly used in education, business, and military contexts.

examples.chinese: 她把今年的目標寫在便條紙上貼到書桌前，提醒自己每天努力。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ jīnnián de mùbiāo xiě zài biàntiáozhǐ shàng tiē dào shūzhuō qián, tíxǐng zìjǐ měitiān nǔlì.
examples.english: She wrote her goals for the year on a sticky note and put it in front of her desk as a daily reminder to keep working hard.

examples.chinese: 公司今年的銷售目標是比去年成長百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián de xiāoshòu mùbiāo shì bǐ qùnián chéngzhǎng bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
examples.english: The company's sales target this year is to grow 20% compared to last year.

semanticNote: Catalog; table of contents; directory. In print: the 目錄 at the front of a book lists chapters and page numbers. In computing: a folder/directory in a file system (資料夾/目錄). In Taiwan, library and database catalogs are called 目錄 or 書目. Covers both analog and digital organizational listings.

examples.chinese: 這本食譜的目錄分得很清楚，依照食材種類排列，查找非常方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shípǔ de mùlù fēn de hěn qīngchǔ, yīzhào shícái zhǒnglèi páiliè, cházhǎo fēicháng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: The table of contents in this cookbook is very well organized, arranged by ingredient type and easy to look things up.

examples.chinese: 請在電腦的根目錄下新建一個資料夾，把所有檔案整理進去。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài diànnǎo de gēn mùlù xià xīnjiàn yī ge zīliàojiā, bǎ suǒyǒu dàng'àn zhěnglǐ jìnqù.
examples.english: Please create a new folder in the computer's root directory and organize all the files into it.

semanticNote: At present; currently; right now — slightly more formal than 現在. Common in reports, news, and official statements: 目前為止 (as of now / so far), 目前的狀況 (the current situation). Implies this may change — a snapshot of the present. Interchangeable with 現在 in most contexts but preferred in formal writing.

examples.chinese: 目前疫苗接種率已達八成，疫情控制情況良好。
examples.pinyin: Mùqián yìmiáo jiēzhòng lǜ yǐ dá bāchéng, yìqíng kòngzhì qíngkuàng liánghǎo.
examples.english: The vaccination rate has currently reached 80% and the epidemic control situation is good.

examples.chinese: 他目前住在台北，正在準備考律師執照。
examples.pinyin: Tā mùqián zhù zài Táiběi, zhèngzài zhǔnbèi kǎo lǜshī zhízhào.
examples.english: He's currently living in Taipei and preparing for the bar exam.

semanticNote: Even if; even though; no matter how — introduces a concessive condition. 哪怕再難，也要堅持 (even if it's ever so hard, you have to persist). Often followed by 也/都 in the main clause. More colloquial and emphatic than 即使 or 就算. Used to stress that the main clause holds true regardless of an extreme hypothetical.

examples.chinese: 哪怕明天下大雨，她也說一定要去參加這場音樂會。
examples.pinyin: Nǎpà míngtiān xià dàyǔ, tā yě shuō yīdìng yào qù cānjiā zhè chǎng yīnyuèhuì.
examples.english: Even if it pours tomorrow, she says she'll definitely go to the concert.

examples.chinese: 哪怕只有一點點希望，我們也要繼續努力下去。
examples.pinyin: Nǎpà zhǐyǒu yī diǎndiǎn xīwàng, wǒmen yě yào jìxù nǔlì xiàqù.
examples.english: Even if there's only the slimmest hope, we'll keep working hard.

semanticNote: No wonder; it's not surprising that — expresses realization that something now makes sense in light of new information. 難怪他今天心情不好，原來昨晚沒睡好 (no wonder he's in a bad mood today — turns out he didn't sleep well last night). Can open a sentence (難怪她不來…) or follow the explanation (他剛失業，難怪心情差). Very common in casual conversation.

examples.chinese: 難怪這家店的生意這麼好，原來食材都是當天新鮮到貨的。
examples.pinyin: Nánguài zhè jiā diàn de shēngyì zhème hǎo, yuánlái shícái dōu shì dàngtiān xīnxiān dàohuò de.
examples.english: No wonder this place is doing such great business — their ingredients are all delivered fresh on the day.

examples.chinese: 她昨晚熬夜到三點，難怪今天上課一直打瞌睡。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuówǎn áoyè dào sān diǎn, nánguài jīntiān shàngkè yīzhí dǎ kēshuì.
examples.english: She was up until 3am last night, no wonder she kept dozing off in class today.

semanticNote: Hard to avoid; inevitable under the circumstances — suggests that something unpleasant or regrettable is to be expected and shouldn't be judged too harshly. 難免會犯錯 (mistakes are inevitable), 難免讓人擔心 (it's understandable that people worry). Often softens criticism or consoles: 初學者難免 (beginners can't help it).

examples.chinese: 剛開始學語言，發音不標準是難免的，重要的是不要害怕開口。
examples.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ xué yǔyán, fāyīn bù biāozhǔn shì nánmiǎn de, zhòngyào de shì bùyào hàipà kāikǒu.
examples.english: When you're just starting to learn a language, imperfect pronunciation is unavoidable — what matters is not being afraid to speak.

examples.chinese: 遇到這種情況，難免會感到沮喪，但要調整心態繼續前進。
examples.pinyin: Yùdào zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng, nánmiǎn huì gǎndào jǔsàng, dàn yào tiáozhěng xīntài jìxù qiánjìn.
examples.english: Facing a situation like this, it's hard not to feel discouraged, but you have to adjust your mindset and press on.

semanticNote: Head (colloquial); brains; mental capacity. 腦袋 is informal — more colorful than 頭 alone. 腦袋不好使 (brain not working well), 動動腦袋 (use your head), 腦袋空空 (empty-headed). Can mean the physical head (磕了腦袋 — bumped my head) or intelligence (她腦袋很好 — she's sharp). Distinctly colloquial; formal writing uses 頭腦 or 大腦.

examples.chinese: 你腦袋裡在想什麼？這種決定明明可以再想清楚一點。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nǎodai lǐ zài xiǎng shénme? Zhè zhǒng juédìng míngmíng kěyǐ zài xiǎng qīngchǔ yīdiǎn.
examples.english: What's going on in your head? You could clearly have thought this decision through more carefully.

examples.chinese: 老師說多讀書多思考，才能讓腦袋越用越靈光。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō duō dúshū duō sīkǎo, cái néng ràng nǎodai yuè yòng yuè língguāng.
examples.english: The teacher said reading more and thinking more is what keeps the mind sharp the more you use it.

semanticNote: Internal; interior; inside (of an organization, system, or space). 內部會議 (internal meeting), 內部問題 (internal issue), 內部資料 (internal documents). Contrasts with 外部 (external). In organizational contexts, 內部 often implies confidentiality or things not meant for public view. Common in corporate, governmental, and military language.

examples.chinese: 這份報告是內部文件，請勿對外流傳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào shì nèibù wénjiàn, qǐng wù duìwài liúchuán.
examples.english: This report is an internal document — please do not share it externally.

examples.chinese: 公司內部出現了嚴重的意見分歧，導致決策遲遲無法通過。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī nèibù chūxiàn le yánzhòng de yìjiàn fēnqí, dǎozhì juécè chíchí wúfǎ tōngguò.
examples.english: Serious internal disagreements emerged within the company, causing decisions to be delayed indefinitely.

semanticNote: Internal medicine — the medical specialty dealing with non-surgical treatment of internal organs: heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, etc. In Taiwan hospitals, 內科 is typically subdivided (心臟內科, 胸腔內科, 腸胃內科, etc.). Contrasts with 外科 (surgery). When you have a general illness and don't know which department to go to, reception often directs you to 內科.

examples.chinese: 他因為長期胸悶去掛了內科，醫生建議他做進一步的心臟檢查。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chángqī xiōngmèn qù guà le nèikē, yīshēng jiànyì tā zuò jìnyībù de xīnzàng jiǎnchá.
examples.english: He went to see an internal medicine doctor for chronic chest tightness, and the doctor recommended a more detailed cardiac examination.

examples.chinese: 請問掛號處在哪裡？我想掛內科的號。
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn guàhào chù zài nǎlǐ? Wǒ xiǎng guà nèikē de hào.
examples.english: Excuse me, where is the registration desk? I'd like to register for internal medicine.

semanticNote: Tender; young and delicate — for food (肉嫩 — tender meat, 豆腐很嫩 — silky tofu), plants (嫩芽 — new shoots), skin (皮膚嫩 — soft skin), or young/inexperienced people (他還嫩 — he's still green/wet behind the ears). The food sense is very common in cooking contexts. The 'inexperienced' sense is colloquial and slightly dismissive.

examples.chinese: 這家牛排館的菲力牛排口感非常嫩，入口即化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā niúpái guǎn de fēilì niúpái kǒugǎn fēicháng nèn, rùkǒu jí huà.
examples.english: The filet mignon at this steakhouse is incredibly tender — it practically melts in your mouth.

examples.chinese: 你才剛進公司三個月，很多事還嫩著，多跟老員工學習一下。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cái gāng jìn gōngsī sān ge yuè, hěnduō shì hái nènzhe, duō gēn lǎo yuángōng xuéxí yīxià.
examples.english: You've only been with the company three months — you're still green in many ways, so learn more from the veteran staff.

semanticNote: Capable; competent; able to get things done. Implies practical effectiveness and reliability, not just intelligence. 她很能幹 (she's very capable), 能幹的助理 (a competent assistant). A common compliment in professional and family contexts. Slightly more colloquial than 有能力 but very natural across registers.

examples.chinese: 她是公司裡最能幹的業務員，每季業績都排在前三名。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gōngsī lǐ zuì nénggàn de yèwùyuán, měi jì yèjī dōu pái zài qián sān míng.
examples.english: She's the most capable salesperson in the company, consistently ranking in the top three every quarter.

examples.chinese: 媽媽一個人把我們三兄弟拉拔大，真的非常能幹。
examples.pinyin: Māma yī ge rén bǎ wǒmen sān xiōngdì lābá dà, zhēnde fēicháng nénggàn.
examples.english: Mom raised the three of us brothers on her own — she's truly incredibly capable.

semanticNote: Energy resources; power sources — encompasses fossil fuels, renewable energy, nuclear power, etc. A key policy topic in Taiwan: 能源轉型 (energy transition), 再生能源 (renewable energy), 能源自主 (energy independence). Taiwan imports ~98% of its energy, so 能源安全 (energy security) is a major political concern. 能源危機 (energy crisis) is a common compound.

examples.chinese: 台灣積極推動能源轉型，計畫在二○二五年前大幅提高再生能源的比例。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān jījí tuīdòng néngyuán zhuǎnxíng, jìhuà zài èr líng èr wǔ nián qián dàfú tígāo zàishēng néngyuán de bǐlì.
examples.english: Taiwan is actively promoting an energy transition, with plans to significantly increase the share of renewable energy before 2025.

examples.chinese: 核能是否應該繼續使用，至今仍是台灣社會爭議不斷的能源政策話題。
examples.pinyin: Hénéng shìfǒu yīnggāi jìxù shǐyòng, zhìjīn réng shì Táiwān shèhuì zhēngyì bùduàn de néngyuán zhèngcè huàtí.
examples.english: Whether nuclear power should continue to be used remains a contentious energy policy topic in Taiwanese society.

semanticNote: Era; decade; period — refers to a span of time characterized by shared features, especially historical periods. 八○年代 (the 1980s), 戰後年代 (postwar era), 那個年代 (that era/those times). More evocative than 時期 — 年代 carries the sense of a time defined by its spirit or culture. Also used for decade within a century: 七○年代 = the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 台灣七、八○年代的經濟奇蹟讓這個小島成為亞洲四小龍之一。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān qī, bā líng niándài de jīngjì qíjì ràng zhège xiǎo dǎo chéngwéi Yàzhōu sì xiǎo lóng zhī yī.
examples.english: Taiwan's economic miracle of the 1970s and 1980s turned this small island into one of the Four Asian Tigers.

examples.chinese: 那個年代的人普遍節儉，很少有人願意花錢外出吃飯。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge niándài de rén pǔbiàn jiéjiǎn, hěnshǎo yǒu rén yuànyì huā qián wàichū chīfàn.
examples.english: People in that era were generally frugal — very few were willing to spend money eating out.

semanticNote: Age — especially used when referring to someone's age in a social or relational context. 年紀大了 (getting on in years), 年紀輕輕 (at such a young age), 同年紀 (same age). More conversational than 年齡 (which is used in official/medical contexts). 你幾歲? is direct; 你年紀多大? is slightly softer.

examples.chinese: 她年紀這麼小就能獨立創業，真的讓人佩服。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánjì zhème xiǎo jiù néng dúlì chuàngyè, zhēnde ràng rén pèifu.
examples.english: That she could start her own business at such a young age is truly impressive.

examples.chinese: 上了年紀之後，身體各方面都需要更加注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Shàng le niánjì zhīhòu, shēntǐ gè fāngmiàn dōu xūyào gèngjiā zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As you get older, you need to take better care of every aspect of your health.

semanticNote: Three main senses: (1) to read aloud (念書 — study; 念課文 — read the text aloud); (2) to study at (他念台大 — he goes to NTU); (3) to miss or think of someone with longing (念家 — miss home; 念舊 — cherish old memories). The 'study at' sense is very common in Taiwan: 你念哪間學校? (Which school do you go to?). Context distinguishes the three senses clearly.

components.meaning: thought; to read aloud; to miss; to study

examples.chinese: 老師要求學生把課文大聲念出來，練習發音和語調。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng bǎ kèwén dàshēng niàn chūlái, liànxí fāyīn hé yǔdiào.
examples.english: The teacher asked students to read the text aloud to practice pronunciation and intonation.

examples.chinese: 出國留學後，他時常念著家鄉的滷肉飯和臭豆腐。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué hòu, tā shícháng niànzhe jiāxiāng de lǔròufàn hé chòudòufu.
examples.english: After going abroad to study, he often found himself missing the braised pork rice and stinky tofu from home.

semanticNote: Would rather; prefer to — expresses a willingness to accept one option over another, usually the lesser of two evils. 寧可…也不… (would rather … than …). Often signals a principled or stubborn preference: 寧可不吃飯也不低頭 (would rather starve than bow down). Interchangeable with 寧願 in most cases; 寧可 is slightly more formal.

examples.chinese: 她寧可一個人住，也不想跟不合得來的人當室友。
examples.pinyin: Tā nìngkě yī ge rén zhù, yě bù xiǎng gēn bù hé de lái de rén dāng shìyǒu.
examples.english: She'd rather live alone than be roommates with someone she doesn't get along with.

examples.chinese: 這件事寧可多花時間做好，也不要草草了事留下後患。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nìngkě duō huā shíjiān zuò hǎo, yě bùyào cǎocǎo liǎoshì liú xià hòuhuàn.
examples.english: It's better to take more time and do this properly than to rush through it and leave problems for later.

semanticNote: Jeans — denim trousers, literally 'cowboy pants'. 牛仔 (cowboy) + 褲 (trousers). In Taiwan, commonly shortened to 牛仔褲 or just 牛仔. Comes in many styles: 直筒牛仔褲 (straight-leg), 喇叭褲 (flared), 緊身牛仔褲 (skinny jeans). Ubiquitous casual wear. Note: pinyin is niúzǎikù (not a typo — 仔 here reads zǎi in this compound).

examples.chinese: 她配了一件白襯衫和一條淡藍色的牛仔褲，簡單又好看。
examples.pinyin: Tā pèi le yī jiàn bái chènshān hé yī tiáo dàn lán sè de niúzǎikù, jiǎndān yòu hǎokàn.
examples.english: She paired a white shirt with light blue jeans — simple but great-looking.

examples.chinese: 牛仔褲在洗衣前最好先翻面，這樣顏色比較不容易退。
examples.pinyin: Niúzǎikù zài xǐyī qián zuìhǎo xiān fān miàn, zhèyàng yánsè bǐjiào bù róngyì tuì.
examples.english: It's best to turn jeans inside out before washing so the color doesn't fade as easily.
