semanticNote: To confirm; to verify — checking and affirming that something is correct or that an agreement holds. 確認訂單 (confirm an order), 確認身分 (verify identity), 確認收到 (confirm receipt), 請確認 (please confirm). Very common in business, e-commerce, and logistics. Slightly more about verification/double-checking than 確定 (which leans toward deciding or being certain).

components.meaning: to recognize; to identify; to admit

examples.chinese: 下訂單後系統會自動發一封確認信到您的電子信箱。
examples.pinyin: Xià dìng dān hòu xìtǒng huì zìdòng fā yī fēng quèrèn xìn dào nín de diànzǐ xìnxiāng.
examples.english: After placing your order, the system will automatically send a confirmation email to your inbox.

examples.chinese: 請在出發前再次確認護照和機票都備妥了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài chūfā qián zàicì quèrèn hùzhào hé jīpiào dōu bèi tuǒ le.
examples.english: Please double-check that your passport and flight tickets are all in order before you leave.

semanticNote: Crowd; group; flock — a collection of people, animals, or things. As measure word: 一群人 (a group of people), 一群鳥 (a flock of birds), 一群羊 (a flock of sheep). As noun: 群體 (a group/community), 群眾 (the masses), 社群 (social community). In the digital age: 群組/群 (group chat — 加入群 means 'join the group chat').

examples.chinese: 一群高中生穿著制服結伴去夜市玩，笑聲不斷。
examples.pinyin: Yī qún gāozhōngshēng chuānzhe zhìfú jiébàn qù yèshì wán, xiàoshēng bùduàn.
examples.english: A group of high school students in uniforms headed to the night market together, laughing all the way.

examples.chinese: 他加入了一個攝影愛好者的Line群，每週都會分享作品互相交流。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiārù le yī ge shèyǐng àihàozhě de Line qún, měi zhōu dōu huì fēnxiǎng zuòpǐn hùxiāng jiāoliú.
examples.english: He joined a Line group for photography enthusiasts and shares work with members every week for mutual feedback.

semanticNote: To burn; combustion — the chemical process of burning, or the act of something being on fire. 燃燒殆盡 (burn to nothing), 燃燒熱情 (burn with passion), 燃燒彈 (incendiary bomb). Also used figuratively for intense passion or effort: 燃燒自己的生命 (burn one's life away — give everything). In physics: 燃燒反應 (combustion reaction).

examples.chinese: 篝火在夜空下燃燒，大家圍坐在旁邊唱歌，氣氛非常熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Gōuhuǒ zài yè kōng xià ránshāo, dàjiā wéi zuò zài pángbiān chànggē, qìfēn fēicháng rènào.
examples.english: The bonfire burned under the night sky as everyone sat around it singing — the atmosphere was lively and warm.

examples.chinese: 消防隊員冒著生命危險進入燃燒中的大樓，搶救被困的居民。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofáng duìyuán màozhe shēngmìng wēixiǎn jìnrù ránshāo zhōng de dàlóu, qiǎngjiù bèi kùn de jūmín.
examples.english: Firefighters risked their lives to enter the burning building to rescue trapped residents.

semanticNote: To wind; to go around; to coil; to detour. 繞圈子 (go in circles; be roundabout/evasive), 繞道 (take a detour), 繞著走 (walk around it), 繞遠路 (take the long way around). Figuratively: 說話繞彎子 (speak in a roundabout way). 繞口令 (tongue twister — 'wind-mouth-order') is a fun compound. Implies circular or surrounding movement.

components.meaning: to wind; to coil; to go around; to revolve

examples.chinese: 因為道路施工，她不得不繞道走，多花了二十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi dàolù shīgōng, tā bùdébù ràodào zǒu, duō huā le èrshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: Because of road construction, she had to take a detour and it took an extra twenty minutes.

examples.chinese: 有話直說，別繞彎子了，我不喜歡拐彎抹角。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu huà zhí shuō, bié rào wānzi le, wǒ bù xǐhuān guǎi wān mò jiǎo.
examples.english: Just say what you mean — stop beating around the bush. I don't like roundabout talk.

semanticNote: To love ardently; passionate devotion — a deep, enthusiastic love for something (not someone romantically). 熱愛生命 (love life ardently), 熱愛工作 (have a passion for work), 對音樂充滿熱愛 (full of passionate love for music). More intense and sustained than 喜歡 (like). The apostrophe separates the syllables /-è/ and /ài/.

components.meaning: love; to love; to be fond of

examples.chinese: 她熱愛登山，每逢假日就帶著背包出發，挑戰不同的山岳。
examples.pinyin: Tā rè'ài dēngshān, měi féng jiǎrì jiù dài zhe bèibāo chūfā, tiǎozhàn bùtóng de shānyuè.
examples.english: She is passionate about mountaineering — every holiday she packs her bag and sets off to challenge different peaks.

examples.chinese: 對於熱愛台灣文化的外國人來說，台南是一座充滿驚喜的城市。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú rè'ài Táiwān wénhuà de wàiguórén lái shuō, Táinán shì yī zuò chōngmǎn jīngxǐ de chéngshì.
examples.english: For foreigners who are passionate about Taiwanese culture, Tainan is a city full of pleasant surprises.

semanticNote: Warm; enthusiastic; fervent — intense and passionate in a positive, active sense. 熱烈歡迎 (warmly welcome — the standard phrase at events and ceremonies), 熱烈鼓掌 (enthusiastic applause), 熱烈討論 (heated/lively discussion), 熱烈的掌聲 (warm applause). Often used in formal announcements: 請給予熱烈的掌聲 (please give a warm round of applause).

examples.chinese: 頒獎典禮上，每位得獎者上台時都獲得了熱烈的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Bānjiǎng diǎnlǐ shàng, měi wèi déjiǎng zhě shàng tái shí dōu huòdé le rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: At the awards ceremony, each recipient received enthusiastic applause when they took the stage.

examples.chinese: 這個議題引發了熱烈的討論，各方意見分歧，難以達成共識。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yìtí yǐnfā le rèliè de tǎolùn, gèfāng yìjiàn fēnqí, nányǐ dáchéng gòngshí.
examples.english: This issue sparked a heated debate, with widely divergent opinions and difficulty reaching consensus.

semanticNote: Enthusiastic; warmhearted; zealous — actively willing to help or participate. 熱心腸 (big heart; generous spirit), 熱心公益 (enthusiastic about public welfare/charity), 熱心助人 (eager to help others). Implies both the warmth of heart and the active willingness to get involved. A consistently admired trait in Taiwan's community and civic culture.

examples.chinese: 她是個非常熱心的人，鄰居有任何需要幫忙的地方她都搶著去幫。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge fēicháng rèxīn de rén, línjū yǒu rènhé xūyào bāngmáng de dìfāng tā dōu qiǎngzhe qù bāng.
examples.english: She's an extremely warm-hearted person — whenever a neighbor needs help with anything, she's always the first to offer.

examples.chinese: 他退休後積極投入社區服務，熱心參與各種公益活動。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu jījí tóurù shèqū fúwù, rèxīn cānyù gèzhǒng gōngyì huódòng.
examples.english: After retiring, he actively dedicated himself to community service and enthusiastically participates in all kinds of public welfare activities.

semanticNote: Talent; a talented person — someone with exceptional skills or abilities, especially in a professional context. 培育人才 (nurture talent), 引進人才 (attract talent), 留住人才 (retain talent), 人才外流 (brain drain — a major concern in Taiwan). 人才庫 (talent pool). In Taiwan's technology sector, the competition to attract and retain 人才 from TSMC and other firms is an active economic policy issue.

examples.chinese: 台灣的半導體產業之所以領先全球，很大程度上靠的是大量的頂尖人才。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de bàndǎotǐ chǎnyè zhīsuǒyǐ lǐngxiān quánqiú, hěn dà chéngdù shàng kào de shì dàliàng de dǐngjiān réncái.
examples.english: Taiwan's semiconductor industry leads the world largely because of its large pool of top-tier talent.

examples.chinese: 公司積極提升薪資福利，希望在激烈的市場競爭中留住優秀的人才。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jījí tíshēng xīnzī fúlì, xīwàng zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng liúzhù yōuxiù de réncái.
examples.english: The company is actively raising salaries and benefits, hoping to retain excellent talent amid fierce market competition.

semanticNote: Population — the number of people in a place. 人口增長 (population growth), 人口老化 (aging population), 人口密度 (population density — Taiwan's is very high), 人口外流 (population outflow). Taiwan's 少子化 (declining birth rate) and 高齡化 (aging population) are major policy challenges. 人口普查 (census) is conducted periodically.

components.meaning: mouth; opening; entrance; (measure word for people in a household)

examples.chinese: 台灣人口老化的速度很快，預計在未來二十年內成為超高齡社會。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rénkǒu lǎohuà de sùdù hěn kuài, yùjì zài wèilái èrshí nián nèi chéngwéi chāo gāolíng shèhuì.
examples.english: Taiwan's population is aging rapidly and is expected to become a super-aged society within the next twenty years.

examples.chinese: 台北市的人口密度位居全球前列，市區內的交通壓力因此非常大。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi shì de rénkǒu mìdù wèijū quánqiú qiánliè, shìqū nèi de jiāotōng yālì yīncǐ fēicháng dà.
examples.english: Taipei's population density ranks among the highest in the world, creating immense traffic pressure within the city.

semanticNote: Humanity; the human race; mankind — all humans as a species. 人類歷史 (human history), 人類共同的命運 (humanity's shared fate), 對人類的貢獻 (contribution to humanity), 人工智慧對人類的影響 (AI's impact on humanity). More formal and philosophical than 人 (people) or 人們 (people, plural). 人類學 (anthropology).

examples.chinese: 氣候變遷是人類在二十一世紀所面臨的最大共同挑戰之一。
examples.pinyin: Qìhòu biànqiān shì rénlèi zài èrshíyī shìjì suǒ miànlín de zuìdà gòngtóng tiǎozhàn zhī yī.
examples.english: Climate change is one of the greatest shared challenges humanity faces in the twenty-first century.

examples.chinese: 人工智慧的快速發展正在改變人類工作與生活的方式。
examples.pinyin: Réngōng zhìhuì de kuàisù fāzhǎn zhèngzài gǎibiàn rénlèi gōngzuò yǔ shēnghuó de fāngshì.
examples.english: The rapid development of artificial intelligence is changing the way humanity works and lives.

semanticNote: Renminbi (RMB) — the official currency of the People's Republic of China, literally 'people's currency'. The base unit is the 元/圓 (yuán), colloquially called 塊. In Taiwan, 人民幣 is used in cross-strait trade contexts and by Taiwanese businesses operating in China. Abbreviated 人民幣 or RMB; the international code is CNY. Distinct from 新台幣 (NTD — Taiwan's currency, nicknamed 台幣).

examples.chinese: 她去中國出差前，先去銀行換了一些人民幣備用。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù Zhōngguó chūchāi qián, xiān qù yínháng huàn le yīxiē rénmínbì bèiyòng.
examples.english: Before her business trip to China, she went to the bank to exchange some Renminbi to have on hand.

examples.chinese: 兩岸貿易通常以美元或人民幣結算，不直接用新台幣。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng'àn màoyì tōngcháng yǐ Měiyuán huò rénmínbì jiésuàn, bù zhíjiē yòng xīn Táibì.
examples.english: Cross-strait trade is usually settled in US dollars or Renminbi, not directly in New Taiwan Dollars.

semanticNote: Human life; one's life as a whole — the totality of a person's existence and experience. 人生觀 (outlook on life; philosophy of life), 人生經歷 (life experiences), 人生的意義 (the meaning of life), 人生如戲 (life is like a play). More philosophical and reflective than 生活 (daily life) or 生命 (life as a biological fact). Commonly used in speeches, reflections, and literature.

components.meaning: life; to live; to be born

examples.chinese: 他在退休感言中說，最無悔的人生決定是選擇了教育這條路。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài tuìxiū gǎnyán zhōng shuō, zuì wú huǐ de rénshēng juédìng shì xuǎnzé le jiàoyù zhè tiáo lù.
examples.english: In his retirement speech, he said the life decision he regrets least was choosing the path of education.

examples.chinese: 年輕的時候多嘗試，多失敗，才能豐富自己的人生閱歷。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīng de shíhòu duō chángshì, duō shībài, cái néng fēngfù zìjǐ de rénshēng yuèlì.
examples.english: Try more things and fail more when you're young — that's how you enrich your life experience.

semanticNote: Personnel; human resources; also: human affairs/worldly matters. 人事部門 (HR department), 人事調動 (personnel transfer), 人事異動 (personnel changes), 不省人事 (be unconscious — 'unaware of human affairs'). In organizations, 人事行政 handles hiring, transfers, and payroll. In Taiwan government, the 銓敘部 (Ministry of Civil Service) handles public-sector personnel.

examples.chinese: 公司最近進行了一次大規模的人事調整，多個部門的主管都換了人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn jìnxíng le yī cì dàguīmó de rénshì tiáozhěng, duō ge bùmén de zhǔguǎn dōu huàn le rén.
examples.english: The company recently underwent a major personnel reshuffle, with managers in multiple departments being replaced.

examples.chinese: 有關薪資和年假的問題，請直接洽詢人事部門。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān xīnzī hé nián jià de wèntí, qǐng zhíjiē qiàxún rénshì bùmén.
examples.english: For questions about salary and annual leave, please consult the HR department directly.

semanticNote: Figure; personage; character — a notable person in real life or a fictional character in a story. 歷史人物 (historical figure), 文學人物 (literary character), 重要人物 (important figure), 反派人物 (villain character). In art and literature, 人物描寫 (character description/portrayal) is a key narrative technique. 人物誌 (profile/biography in a publication).

examples.chinese: 這部歷史劇中的人物刻畫非常立體，讓觀眾產生強烈的代入感。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù lìshǐ jù zhōng de rénwù kèhuà fēicháng lìtǐ, ràng guānzhòng chǎnshēng qiángliè de dàirù gǎn.
examples.english: The characters in this historical drama are very three-dimensional, creating a strong sense of immersion for viewers.

examples.chinese: 鄭成功是台灣史上最重要的歷史人物之一，對這片土地影響深遠。
examples.pinyin: Zhèng Chénggōng shì Táiwān shǐ shàng zuì zhòngyào de lìshǐ rénwù zhī yī, duì zhè piàn tǔdì yǐngxiǎng shēnyuǎn.
examples.english: Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong) is one of the most important historical figures in Taiwan's history, with a profound and lasting influence on this land.

semanticNote: Staff; personnel; crew — the people who form a group, team, or organization for a specific purpose. 工作人員 (staff/crew), 急救人員 (emergency personnel), 軍事人員 (military personnel), 參與人員 (participants), 隨行人員 (accompanying staff). More functional/role-based than 人才 (talent) — 人員 just means the people filling the roles.

examples.chinese: 活動當天將有五十名工作人員在現場協助維持秩序。
examples.pinyin: Huódòng dàngtiān jiāng yǒu wǔshí míng gōngzuò rényuán zài xiànchǎng xiézhù wéichí zhìxù.
examples.english: On the day of the event, fifty staff members will be on-site to help maintain order.

examples.chinese: 地震發生後，搜救人員立即進入災區展開搜尋行動。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, sōujiù rényuán lìjí jìnrù zāiqū zhǎnkāi sōuxún xíngdòng.
examples.english: After the earthquake struck, rescue personnel immediately entered the disaster zone to begin search operations.

semanticNote: Cannot help but; unable to hold back — being unable to suppress an urge, feeling, or action. 忍不住笑 (can't help laughing), 忍不住哭 (can't hold back tears), 忍不住說 (can't help saying). A very common colloquial expression. The potential complement structure: 忍得住 (can hold back) vs. 忍不住 (can't hold back). Often followed by a verb describing what one couldn't suppress.

components.meaning: to endure; to bear; to suppress
to hold; to stop; resultative complement

examples.chinese: 看到那隻小貓用爪子玩毛線球的樣子，她忍不住笑出聲來。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào nà zhī xiǎo māo yòng zhuǎzi wán máoxiànqiú de yàngzi, tā rěn bu zhù xiào chū shēng lái.
examples.english: Seeing the kitten batting at a ball of yarn with its paws, she couldn't help bursting out laughing.

examples.chinese: 電影結局太感人，整個放映廳的觀眾都忍不住掉眼淚。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng jiéjú tài gǎnrén, zhěnge fàngyìngtīng de guānzhòng dōu rěn bu zhù diào yǎnlèi.
examples.english: The ending of the film was so moving that the entire theater audience couldn't hold back their tears.

semanticNote: Daily; everyday; routine. 日常生活 (daily life), 日常用品 (everyday items), 日常開銷 (daily expenses), 日常作息 (daily routine). In social media, 日常 is used as a noun to mean 'everyday life / daily moments' — posting one's 日常 (sharing everyday life photos/videos). Covers the unremarkable, recurring fabric of everyday existence.

examples.chinese: 她喜歡把自己的日常生活拍成短影片，分享給網路上的追蹤者。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān bǎ zìjǐ de rìcháng shēnghuó pāi chéng duǎn yǐngpiàn, fēnxiǎng gěi wǎnglù shàng de zhuīzōng zhě.
examples.english: She likes to film her daily life into short videos to share with her followers online.

examples.chinese: 養成良好的日常作息是維持身心健康最基本的方法。
examples.pinyin: Yǎngchéng liánghǎo de rìcháng zuòxī shì wéichí shēnxīn jiànkāng zuì jīběn de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Developing a good daily routine is the most fundamental way to maintain physical and mental health.

semanticNote: Schedule; itinerary — a planned sequence of activities or events for a period. 行程日程 (travel itinerary), 工作日程 (work schedule), 排入日程 (put on the schedule), 日程滿檔 (schedule fully packed). In Taiwan's government and business world, 議程 (agenda) is used for meeting agenda, while 日程 covers the broader schedule. 日程表 (schedule sheet/chart).

examples.chinese: 總統出訪期間的日程安排非常緊湊，幾乎沒有空閒時間。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chūfǎng qījiān de rìchéng ānpái fēicháng jǐncòu, jīhū méiyǒu kòngxián shíjiān.
examples.english: The schedule during the president's overseas visit is extremely tight, with almost no free time.

examples.chinese: 她把這週的工作日程全部寫在行事曆上，以免遺漏任何重要的事項。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè zhōu de gōngzuò rìchéng quánbù xiě zài xíngshìlì shàng, yǐmiǎn yílòu rènhé zhòngyào de shìxiàng.
examples.english: She wrote out her entire work schedule for the week in her planner so she wouldn't miss any important items.

semanticNote: Calendar — a chart or system for tracking days, weeks, and months. 掛曆 (wall calendar), 桌曆 (desk calendar), 農民曆 (farmer's almanac — the traditional Taiwanese lunar calendar still widely used for auspicious dates). In Taiwan, 農曆 (lunar calendar) coexists with the solar calendar. Digital 行事曆 (planner/calendar app) has largely replaced paper for scheduling.

examples.chinese: 她在辦公桌上放了一本桌曆，每天翻到新的一頁記事。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàngōngzhuō shàng fàng le yī běn zhuōlì, měitiān fān dào xīn de yī yè jìshì.
examples.english: She keeps a desk calendar on her office desk and flips to a new page each day to jot things down.

examples.chinese: 很多台灣家庭在過年前會去廟裡拿一本農民曆，查看新年的吉日良辰。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō Táiwān jiātíng zài guònián qián huì qù miào lǐ ná yī běn nóngmínlì, cháchá xīnnián de jírì liángchén.
examples.english: Many Taiwanese families go to the temple before the New Year to get a farmer's almanac and look up auspicious days for the coming year.

semanticNote: Date — a specific calendar date (year/month/day). 到期日 (due date/expiry date), 出發日期 (departure date), 截止日期 (deadline), 日期格式 (date format — Taiwan uses 民國year/月/日 for official documents). In everyday context, 哪一天 (which day) is casual while 日期 is more formal. 有效日期 (expiry date on food/medicine).

examples.chinese: 請在表格上填寫今天的日期，然後簽名送交給承辦人員。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé shàng tiánxiě jīntiān de rìqī, ránhòu qiānmíng sòngjiāo gěi chéngbàn rényuán.
examples.english: Please fill in today's date on the form, then sign it and hand it to the staff in charge.

examples.chinese: 這瓶藥的有效日期到明年三月底，還可以繼續使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè píng yào de yǒuxiào rìqī dào míngnián sān yuè dǐ, hái kěyǐ jìxù shǐyòng.
examples.english: This medicine's expiry date is the end of March next year, so it can still be used.

semanticNote: Daily necessities; everyday household goods — items used regularly in daily life such as soap, toothpaste, laundry detergent, toilet paper, etc. 生活日用品 (daily household necessities), 日用品賣場 (household goods store). In Taiwan, large-format hypermarkets like 家樂福 (Carrefour) and 全聯 (PX Mart) are the primary sources for 日用品.

examples.chinese: 她每個月月初都會去全聯採購一個月份的日用品，一次買齊比較省錢。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè yuè chū dōu huì qù Quánlián cǎigòu yī ge yuèfèn de rìyòngpǐn, yīcì mǎi qí bǐjiào shěng qián.
examples.english: At the beginning of each month she goes to PX Mart to stock up on a month's worth of household goods — buying everything at once saves money.

examples.chinese: 搬進新家後，洗衣精、廁所清潔劑這些日用品都要重新採購一批。
examples.pinyin: Bān jìn xīn jiā hòu, xǐyī jīng, cèsuǒ qīngjiéjì zhèxiē rìyòngpǐn dōu yào chóngxīn cǎigòu yī pī.
examples.english: After moving into the new place, you have to restock all the daily necessities like laundry detergent and toilet bowl cleaner.

semanticNote: Days; date; time; life/livelihood. 好日子 (good days; a good life), 過日子 (get by; live one's life), 苦日子 (hard times), 這幾天/這些日子 (these days/lately). More colloquial and emotionally warm than 時間 (time) or 日期 (date). 日子 implies lived time — the texture of daily life. 選個好日子 (pick a good date — often for important events).

examples.chinese: 退休後的日子過得很悠閒，每天早起去公園打太極，下午就跟老朋友喝茶聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tuìxiū hòu de rìzi guò de hěn yōuxián, měitiān zǎoqǐ qù gōngyuán dǎ tàijí, xiàwǔ jiù gēn lǎo péngyǒu hē chá liáotiān.
examples.english: Life after retirement is very leisurely — waking up early to practice tai chi in the park, then having tea and chatting with old friends in the afternoon.

examples.chinese: 那段失業的日子真的很難熬，幸好家人一直在身邊支持他。
examples.pinyin: Nà duàn shīyè de rìzi zhēnde hěn nán'áo, xìnghǎo jiārén yīzhí zài shēnbiān zhīchí tā.
examples.english: Those days of unemployment were truly difficult to get through — fortunately his family was always there to support him.

semanticNote: How; in what way; what — used in questions about manner, condition, or opinion. 如何處理 (how to handle), 你認為如何? (What do you think?), 不知如何是好 (don't know what to do). More formal than 怎麼 or 怎樣. Common in titles, reports, and formal inquiries. 如何…都 (no matter how…) is a pattern: 如何努力都不夠 (no matter how hard you try, it's never enough).

examples.chinese: 這次的客訴事件應該如何處理，管理層需要盡快做出決定。
examples.pinyin: Zhècì de kèsù shìjiàn yīnggāi rúhé chǔlǐ, guǎnlǐ céng xūyào jǐnkuài zuòchū juédìng.
examples.english: Management needs to quickly decide how to handle this customer complaint incident.

examples.chinese: 面對失敗，如何調整心態重新出發，才是最關鍵的課題。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì shībài, rúhé tiáozhěng xīntài chóngxīn chūfā, cái shì zuì guānjiàn de kètí.
examples.english: When facing failure, the most critical question is how to readjust your mindset and start again.

semanticNote: Nowadays; at present; these days — with an implicit contrast to how things were before. 如今社會 (today's society), 如今已不同了 (things are different now), 如今回想起來 (looking back now). More literary and reflective than 現在 or 目前. Often appears in narrative or reflective writing when looking back or commenting on how times have changed.

examples.chinese: 如今台灣的手搖飲料文化已傳遍全球，珍珠奶茶成為台灣最知名的代表之一。
examples.pinyin: Rújīn Táiwān de shǒu yáo yǐnliào wénhuà yǐ chuánbiàn quánqiú, zhēnzhū nǎichá chéngwéi Táiwān zuì zhīmíng de dàibiǎo zhī yī.
examples.english: Nowadays Taiwan's hand-shaken beverage culture has spread around the world, with bubble tea becoming one of Taiwan's most famous cultural ambassadors.

examples.chinese: 如今回想起當年白手起家的艱辛，他感慨萬千。
examples.pinyin: Rújīn huíxiǎng qǐ dāngnián báishǒuqǐjiā de jiānxīn, tā gǎnkǎi wànqiān.
examples.english: Looking back now at the hardships of building something from nothing all those years ago, he is filled with deep emotion.

semanticNote: Soft; tender; weak — physical softness (軟麵包 — soft bread), figurative weakness (心軟 — soft-hearted; 軟弱 — weak/spineless), or gentle approach (軟性勸說 — gentle persuasion). 軟體 (software), 軟化 (soften). Opposite of 硬 (hard). 耳根子軟 (easily persuaded — literally 'soft earlobes') is a colloquial expression. 軟著陸 (soft landing — economic/aviation term).

examples.chinese: 奶奶做的饅頭特別軟，一口咬下去就像棉花一樣。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zuò de mántou tèbié ruǎn, yī kǒu yǎo xiàqù jiù xiàng miánhuā yīyàng.
examples.english: Grandma's steamed buns are especially soft — biting into one feels like cotton.

examples.chinese: 她對孩子太心軟，總是捨不得拒絕，導致孩子越來越不懂規矩。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì háizi tài xīn ruǎn, zǒng shì shě bu de jùjué, dǎozhì háizi yuèláiyuè bù dǒng guīju.
examples.english: She's too soft-hearted with her child, always unable to say no, which has made the child increasingly undisciplined.

semanticNote: Software — computer programs and applications. 應用軟體 (application software), 軟體工程師 (software engineer), 開源軟體 (open-source software), 防毒軟體 (antivirus software). In Taiwan, 軟體 (ruǎntǐ) is the standard term; 軟件 (ruǎnjiàn) is the mainland form that has entered Taiwan usage through tech industry contexts. Taiwan has a significant software development industry alongside its hardware/semiconductor sector.

examples.chinese: 他每天使用這款軟體管理任務，效率大幅提升。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān shǐyòng zhè kuǎn ruǎntǐ guǎnlǐ rènwù, xiàolǜ dàfú tíshēng.
examples.english: He uses this software to manage tasks every day and his efficiency has improved dramatically.

examples.chinese: 公司決定將老舊的財務軟體升級為更符合現代需求的新系統。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng jiāng lǎojiù de cáiwù ruǎntǐ shēngjí wéi gèng fúhé xiàndài xūqiú de xīn xìtǒng.
examples.english: The company decided to upgrade its outdated financial software to a new system that better meets modern needs.

semanticNote: Weak; feeble — physical weakness (身體弱 — physically weak), comparative inferiority (實力弱 — weaker in ability), or young/immature (老弱婦孺 — the elderly, weak, women, and children). 弱點 (weakness/weak point), 弱勢 (disadvantaged/vulnerable), 弱勢群體 (vulnerable groups). Opposite of 強 (strong). 強弱 (strength and weakness; relative strength).

examples.chinese: 她生病之後身體很弱，需要好好休養一段時間才能恢復。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngbìng zhīhòu shēntǐ hěn ruò, xūyào hǎohǎo xiūyǎng yī duàn shíjiān cái néng huīfù.
examples.english: Her body was very weak after her illness and she needed to rest for a good while before recovering.

examples.chinese: 政府承諾加強保障弱勢群體的基本生活需求，不讓任何人落入貧困。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò jiāqiáng bǎozhàng ruòshì qúntǐ de jīběn shēnghuó xūqiú, bù ràng rènhé rén luòrù pínkùn.
examples.english: The government pledged to strengthen protection of vulnerable groups' basic needs and ensure no one falls into poverty.

semanticNote: To sprinkle; to spray; to spill. 灑水 (sprinkle/spray water), 灑花 (scatter flowers), 灑脫 (free and easy — unencumbered, used as an adj). Can be intentional (灑農藥 — spray pesticide) or accidental (把湯灑掉了 — spilled the soup). The traditional character 灑 has the water radical 氵; the simplified 洒 is a distinct character with slightly different history but same function.

components.meaning: to sprinkle; to scatter; to spill

examples.chinese: 她一不小心把果汁灑在白色的桌布上，急忙拿紙巾擦拭。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī bù xiǎoxīn bǎ guǒzhī sǎ zài báisè de zhuābù shàng, jímáng ná zhǐjīn cāshì.
examples.english: She accidentally spilled juice on the white tablecloth and hurried to blot it with a napkin.

examples.chinese: 婚禮上，賓客向新人灑花瓣，祝福他們幸福美滿。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ shàng, bīnkè xiàng xīnrén sǎ huābàn, zhùfú tāmen xìngfú měimǎn.
examples.english: At the wedding, guests scattered flower petals over the newlyweds, wishing them happiness and a beautiful life together.

semanticNote: Throat; voice. 嗓子痛 (sore throat), 嗓子啞了 (voice is hoarse), 嗓子好 (good voice/beautiful voice). Colloquial and vivid — preferred in spoken Mandarin over 喉嚨 (throat, medical/anatomical). 嗓音 is more formal for 'voice quality'. In Taiwan, 嗓子 and 喉嚨 are both common. 清嗓子 (clear one's throat) is a common action.

examples.chinese: 他最近講話太多，嗓子都啞了，醫生建議他多喝水多休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn jiǎnghuà tài duō, sǎngzi dōu yǎ le, yīshēng jiànyì tā duō hē shuǐ duō xiūxi.
examples.english: He's been talking too much lately and his voice has gone hoarse — the doctor advised him to drink more water and rest.

examples.chinese: 這位歌手的嗓子渾厚有力，每次開口都讓觀眾如癡如醉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gēshǒu de sǎngzi húnhòu yǒulì, měicì kāikǒu dōu ràng guānzhòng rúchī rúzuì.
examples.english: This singer's voice is rich and powerful — every time she starts singing the audience is captivated.

semanticNote: Color; tint; hue — can be literal (鮮豔的色彩 — vivid colors) or figurative (政治色彩 — political coloring; 地方色彩 — local flavor). In art and design: 色彩搭配 (color coordination), 色彩學 (color theory). The figurative use is common in discussing ideological or cultural character: 具有濃厚的台灣本土色彩 (strongly colored by Taiwan's local identity).

examples.chinese: 原住民族的傳統服飾色彩鮮豔，圖騰設計充滿文化意涵。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhùmín zú de chuántǒng fúshì sècǎi xiānyàn, túténg shèjì chōngmǎn wénhuà yìhán.
examples.english: The traditional dress of Taiwan's indigenous peoples is vibrantly colored, and the totem designs are full of cultural meaning.

examples.chinese: 這部電影帶有強烈的政治色彩，在上映前就引發了廣泛的討論。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng dài yǒu qiángliè de zhèngzhì sècǎi, zài shàngyìng qián jiù yǐnfā le guǎngfàn de tǎolùn.
examples.english: This film has a strong political coloring and sparked widespread discussion even before its release.

semanticNote: To kill; to murder — ending a life. 殺人 (kill a person), 殺蟲劑 (insecticide — kills insects), 被殺 (be killed). Also in extended uses: 殺價 (bargain aggressively / haggle down — 'kill the price'), 殺時間 (kill time). In Taiwan, capital punishment remains legal but rarely carried out; 廢除死刑 (abolish the death penalty) is an ongoing debate.

components.meaning: to kill; to slaughter; to reduce

examples.chinese: 法院判定他犯下殺人罪，判處無期徒刑。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn pàndìng tā fàn xià shārén zuì, pànchǔ wújì túxíng.
examples.english: The court found him guilty of murder and sentenced him to life imprisonment.

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西可以試著殺個價，老闆通常有一點降價的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi kěyǐ shìzhe shā ge jià, lǎobǎn tōngcháng yǒu yīdiǎn jiàngjià de kōngjiān.
examples.english: When buying things at the night market, you can try to bargain — vendors usually have a little room to come down on the price.

semanticNote: Desert — an arid region with little to no rainfall and sparse vegetation. 撒哈拉沙漠 (Sahara Desert), 沙漠化 (desertification), 沙漠氣候 (desert climate). Taiwan has no desert due to its subtropical climate and ample rainfall. Often appears in geographic and environmental contexts. 沙漠 typically implies sand; 荒漠 (wasteland/barren land) is a broader term for arid terrain.

examples.chinese: 她報名參加了一個穿越撒哈拉沙漠的極地馬拉松，挑戰自我極限。
examples.pinyin: Tā bàomíng cānyù le yī ge chuānyuè Sāhālā shāmò de jídì mǎlāsōng, tiǎozhàn zìwǒ jíxiàn.
examples.english: She signed up for an ultramarathon across the Sahara Desert to push her personal limits.

examples.chinese: 全球暖化導致部分半乾旱地區出現沙漠化的危機，值得高度關注。
examples.pinyin: Quánqiú nuǎnhuà dǎozhì bùfèn bàn gāná dìqū chūxiàn shāmòhuà de wēijī, zhídé gāodù guānzhù.
examples.english: Global warming is causing desertification crises in some semi-arid regions — a situation deserving of serious attention.

semanticNote: Sandy beach — a beach with sand, as opposed to rocky shores. 去沙灘玩 (go play at the beach), 沙灘排球 (beach volleyball), 白沙灘 (white sand beach). Taiwan has diverse beaches: 墾丁 (Kenting) in the south is famous for sandy beaches; 東海岸 (East Coast) has more varied terrain. Not used for riverbanks (河岸/河床).

examples.chinese: 暑假和朋友去墾丁，在沙灘上曬太陽、戲水，玩得非常開心。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià hé péngyǒu qù Kěndīng, zài shātān shàng shài tàiyáng, xìshuǐ, wán de fēicháng kāixīn.
examples.english: During summer break she went to Kenting with friends, sunbathing and splashing around at the beach — everyone had a great time.

examples.chinese: 清晨的沙灘幾乎沒有人，只有海浪聲和腳印，讓人感到無比寧靜。
examples.pinyin: Qīngchén de shātān jīhū méiyǒu rén, zhǐyǒu hǎilàng shēng hé jiǎoyìn, ràng rén gǎndào wúbǐ níngjìng.
examples.english: The beach in the early morning was almost deserted — just the sound of waves and footprints in the sand, bringing a sense of absolute tranquility.

semanticNote: Foolish; stupid; simple-minded. Can be affectionately teasing (你真傻 — you're such a goofball) or straightforwardly critical (她太傻了，被騙了 — she was too foolish and got scammed). 傻瓜 (fool; also: camera that operates automatically, 傻瓜相機). 傻笑 (giggle foolishly; grin stupidly). 裝傻 (play dumb). More colloquial and softer than 蠢 (stupid, harsher).

examples.chinese: 她傻乎乎地笑著，完全不知道大家在笑她說錯話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǎhūhū de xiàozhe, wánquán bù zhīdào dàjiā zài xiào tā shuō cuò huà le.
examples.english: She grinned away goofily, completely unaware that everyone was laughing because she'd said the wrong thing.

examples.chinese: 他被同一個手法騙了兩次，大家都說他真的太傻了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi tóng yī ge shǒufǎ piàn le liǎng cì, dàjiā dōu shuō tā zhēnde tài shǎ le.
examples.english: He got scammed by the same trick twice — everyone said he really was too naive.

semanticNote: To dry in the sun; to bask; to sun. 曬太陽 (bask in the sun), 曬衣服 (hang clothes out to dry), 曬穀子 (sun-dry grain), 防曬 (sun protection). In social media usage: 曬 has taken on the meaning of 'showing off / sharing publicly' (曬幸福 — show off your happiness online; 曬照 — post photos). This modern sense is very common in everyday digital Taiwan Mandarin.

components.meaning: to sun; to dry in the sun; to bask; to show off online

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的陽光很強，出門前一定要做好防曬，以免曬傷。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de yángguāng hěn qiáng, chūmén qián yīdìng yào zuò hǎo fángsài, yǐmiǎn shàishāng.
examples.english: The summer sun in Taiwan is very strong — always protect yourself from UV rays before going out to avoid sunburn.

examples.chinese: 她在社群媒體上曬出新買的包包，引來朋友們紛紛留言恭喜。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shèqún méitǐ shàng shài chū xīn mǎi de bāobāo, yǐn lái péngyǒu men fēnfēn liúyán gōngxǐ.
examples.english: She posted a photo of her newly purchased bag on social media, drawing a flurry of congratulatory comments from friends.

semanticNote: To delete; to remove — eliminating content from a document, database, or digital device. 刪除文件 (delete a file), 刪除帳號 (delete an account), 刪除記錄 (delete records), 無法刪除 (cannot delete; indelible). In editing: 刪除多餘的內容 (delete unnecessary content). In everyday life: 把那段對話截圖刪掉 (delete that chat screenshot). Very common in the digital age.

components.meaning: to delete; to strike out; to edit
to remove; to eliminate; except; division (math)

examples.chinese: 她不小心把重要的工作文件刪除了，幸好有備份可以還原。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ zhòngyào de gōngzuò wénjiàn shānchú le, xìnghǎo yǒu bèifèn kěyǐ huányuán.
examples.english: She accidentally deleted an important work document — fortunately there was a backup to restore it from.

examples.chinese: 請仔細確認後再刪除，因為這個動作無法復原。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zǐxì quèrèn hòu zài shānchú, yīnwèi zhège dòngzuò wúfǎ fùyuán.
examples.english: Please confirm carefully before deleting, as this action cannot be undone.

semanticNote: Lightning — the electrical discharge seen during thunderstorms. 打雷閃電 (thunder and lightning — the two often mentioned together). In Taiwan's typhoon season, lightning strikes are common. Figurative uses: 閃電般的速度 (lightning speed), 閃電結婚 (whirlwind marriage — marry very quickly). 閃電 can also describe something very fast: 閃電般離開 (leave in a flash).

components.meaning: to flash; to dodge; to gleam

examples.chinese: 颱風來臨前，天空突然烏雲密布，接著打雷閃電，大雨傾盆而下。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng láilín qián, tiānkōng túrán wūyún mìbù, jiēzhe dǎléi shǎndiàn, dàyǔ qīngpén ér xià.
examples.english: Before the typhoon arrived, the sky suddenly filled with dark clouds, followed by thunder and lightning, then torrential rain.

examples.chinese: 他以閃電般的速度完成了任務，讓所有人都大吃一驚。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ shǎndiàn bān de sùdù wánchéng le rènwù, ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu dà chī yī jīng.
examples.english: He completed the task at lightning speed, stunning everyone.

semanticNote: Fan — a hand-held fan for creating airflow. 摺扇 (folding fan), 羽毛扇 (feather fan), 紙扇 (paper fan). In Taiwan's temple culture, fans are associated with Zhong Kui (鍾馗), and traditional painted folding fans are a craft item. 一把扇子 (one fan — 把 is the measure word). Distinct from 電扇/電風扇 (electric fan) and 風扇 (fan, mechanical).

examples.chinese: 老奶奶坐在廟口搖著扇子，一邊看著廟埕上的熱鬧景象。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo nǎinai zuò zài miào kǒu yáozhe shànzi, yībiān kànzhe miào chéng shàng de rènào jǐngxiàng.
examples.english: The old grandmother sat at the temple entrance fanning herself, watching the lively scene in the temple courtyard.

examples.chinese: 這把手繪折扇是她在鶯歌陶瓷老街買到的，做工非常精緻。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ shǒuhuì zhéshàn shì tā zài Yīnggē táocí lǎojiē mǎidào de, zuògōng fēicháng jīngzhì.
examples.english: This hand-painted folding fan was something she found at Yingge's old ceramics street — the craftsmanship is exquisite.

semanticNote: Good-natured; kind-hearted; benevolent — a deeply positive character trait encompassing genuine moral goodness. 心地善良 (kind at heart), 善良的人 (a good person), 本性善良 (good by nature). More profound and moral than 和善 (amiable/pleasant) — 善良 implies genuine goodness of character, not just pleasant manner. A high compliment in Chinese culture.

examples.chinese: 她是個非常善良的人，總是把別人的需要放在自己前面。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge fēicháng shànliáng de rén, zǒng shì bǎ biérén de xūyào fàng zài zìjǐ qiánmiàn.
examples.english: She's a truly kind-hearted person who always puts others' needs before her own.

examples.chinese: 善良不代表軟弱，有時候維護善良需要更大的勇氣。
examples.pinyin: Shànliáng bù dàibiǎo ruǎnruò, yǒushíhòu wéihù shànliáng xūyào gèng dà de yǒngqì.
examples.english: Being kind-hearted doesn't mean being weak — sometimes upholding goodness requires even greater courage.

semanticNote: To be good at; to excel at — a consistent skill or talent in a particular area. 善於溝通 (good at communicating), 善於分析 (skilled at analysis), 善於學習 (adept at learning). Followed by a verb or verb phrase. Implies habitual skill, not just occasional performance. 不善於 (not good at; weak in) is the negative form. More formal than 很會 (really good at).

components.meaning: at; in; on; compared to; to; from

examples.chinese: 她非常善於與人溝通，無論在哪個場合都能讓人感到輕鬆自在。
examples.pinyin: Tā fēicháng shànyú yǔ rén gōutōng, wúlùn zài nǎge chǎnghé dōu néng ràng rén gǎndào qīngsōng zìzài.
examples.english: She's very good at communicating with people — in any setting she puts others at ease.

examples.chinese: 他善於把複雜的技術問題轉化成一般人能理解的語言，是個很棒的老師。
examples.pinyin: Tā shànyú bǎ fùzá de jìshù wèntí zhuǎnhuà chéng yībān rén néng lǐjiě de yǔyán, shì ge hěn bàng de lǎoshī.
examples.english: He's skilled at translating complex technical problems into language ordinary people can understand — he's a wonderful teacher.

semanticNote: To injure; to harm; injury; harm. 造成傷害 (cause harm), 身體傷害 (physical injury), 心理傷害 (psychological harm), 傷害感情 (hurt someone's feelings). Used for physical harm (vehicle accident causing 傷害), emotional damage (言語傷害 — verbal harm), and legal concepts (故意傷害罪 — intentional bodily harm). 自我傷害 (self-harm) is a mental health term.

components.meaning: wound; injury; to hurt; to harm

examples.chinese: 批評可以幫助人進步，但惡意的批評只會傷害對方，毫無建設性。
examples.pinyin: Pīpíng kěyǐ bāngzhù rén jìnbù, dàn èyì de pīpíng zhǐ huì shānghài duìfāng, háowú jiànshèxìng.
examples.english: Criticism can help people improve, but malicious criticism only harms the other person and is entirely unconstructive.

examples.chinese: 車禍造成的身體傷害已經痊癒，但心理創傷仍需要一段時間來修復。
examples.pinyin: Chēhuò zàochéng de shēntǐ shānghài yǐjīng quányù, dàn xīnlǐ chuāngshāng réng xūyào yī duàn shíjiān lái xiūfù.
examples.english: The physical injuries from the car accident have healed, but the psychological trauma still needs time to recover.

semanticNote: Goods; commodity; merchandise — items produced for sale. 商品展示 (product display), 商品質量 (product quality), 農產品/農業商品 (agricultural commodities), 快速消費品 (fast-moving consumer goods). In Taiwan, 商品責任 (product liability) is a legal concept. More formal than 東西 (things/stuff) — 商品 implies market exchange. 商品化 (commodification) is a sociological term.

examples.chinese: 這個線上平台的商品種類非常多，從食品到電子產品應有盡有。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiànshàng píngtái de shāngpǐn zhǒnglèi fēicháng duō, cóng shípǐn dào diànzǐ chǎnpǐn yīngyǒu jìnyǒu.
examples.english: This online platform has an enormous variety of goods, from food to electronics — everything you could ask for.

examples.chinese: 消費者購買瑕疵商品後，可依法要求退換或賠償。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofèizhě gòumǎi xiácī shāngpǐn hòu, kě yī fǎ yāoqiú tuìhuàn huò péicháng.
examples.english: Consumers who purchase defective goods may by law demand a return, exchange, or compensation.

semanticNote: Business affairs; commercial activities — the practical side of commerce. 商務出差 (business trip), 商務艙 (business class on a plane), 商務中心 (business center), 電子商務 (e-commerce). In Taiwan, 商務部 refers to the US Department of Commerce in news contexts (Taiwan has 經濟部). 商務旅行 (business travel) is very common in cross-strait and international trade contexts.

components.meaning: affairs; duties; to be engaged in

examples.chinese: 她常年往返台灣和日本處理商務，對兩地的企業文化都非常了解。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángnián wǎngfǎn Táiwān hé Rìběn chǔlǐ shāngwù, duì liǎng dì de qǐyè wénhuà dōu fēicháng liǎojiě.
examples.english: She shuttles between Taiwan and Japan year-round for business and is very familiar with the corporate cultures of both places.

examples.chinese: 這家飯店設有完善的商務中心，提供影印、傳真和視訊會議室等設備。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn shèyǒu wánshàn de shāngwù zhōngxīn, tígōng yǐngyìn, chuánzhēn hé shìxùn huìyì shì děng shèbèi.
examples.english: This hotel has a well-equipped business center offering photocopying, fax, and video conferencing room facilities.

semanticNote: Commerce; business; commercial — the field of trade and economic activity. 商業區 (commercial district), 商業活動 (business activities), 商業模式 (business model), 商業電影 (commercial film — as opposed to art film). In Taiwan, 商業周刊 (Business Weekly) and 天下雜誌 (CommonWealth) are major business publications. 商業化 (commercialization) is often used critically.

examples.chinese: 台北東區是商業最繁榮的地段，各種名牌店和餐廳林立。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi dōngqū shì shāngyè zuì fánróng de dìduàn, gèzhǒng míngpái diàn hé cāntīng línlì.
examples.english: The East District of Taipei is the most commercially vibrant area, lined with designer stores and restaurants of all kinds.

examples.chinese: 她認為這部電影太商業化，缺乏藝術深度，只是為了票房。
examples.pinyin: Tā rènwéi zhè bù diànyǐng tài shāngyèhuà, quēfá yìshù shēndù, zhǐshì wèile piào fáng.
examples.english: She felt this film was too commercialized, lacking artistic depth and made purely for box office returns.

semanticNote: To be fooled; to be deceived; to fall for a trick. 上當受騙 (be cheated/swindled), 別上當 (don't fall for it), 已經上當了 (already been tricked). Very colloquial. Often used after the fact: 她才發現自己上當了 (she just realized she'd been fooled). Common in online scam and fraud contexts: 詐騙上當 (fall for a scam). Note: the skeleton uses 'shàng dàng' with a space but it's a compound verb.

components.meaning: to go up; to fall into (a trap)
trap; to be taken in; appropriate

examples.chinese: 他接到一通電話說自己中了大獎，結果就這樣上當被騙了幾萬元。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiēdào yī tōng diànhuà shuō zìjǐ zhòng le dà jiǎng, jiéguǒ jiùzhèyàng shàngdàng bèi piàn le jǐ wàn yuán.
examples.english: He received a call saying he'd won a big prize, and ended up falling for it and being scammed out of tens of thousands of dollars.

examples.chinese: 網路上這類「限時優惠」廣告通常都是陷阱，千萬別上當。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shàng zhè lèi 'xiànshí yōuhuì' guǎnggào tōngcháng dōu shì xiànjǐng, qiānwàn bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: 'Limited-time offer' ads like this online are usually a trap — whatever you do, don't fall for it.

semanticNote: Snake; serpent. Taiwan has a rich snake fauna including the venomous 百步蛇 (Taiwanese habu) and 雨傘節 (banded krait). Snakes appear in Taiwanese folk religion and culture — 蛇形 (snake shape) in architecture, 蛇形地 (snake-shaped terrain). In the Chinese zodiac: 蛇年 (Year of the Snake). 打草驚蛇 (beat the grass to scare the snake — warn the enemy — is a common idiom).

examples.chinese: 在山區健行時要特別小心，台灣有幾種毒蛇可能出沒在步道旁。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānqū jiànxíng shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn, Táiwān yǒu jǐ zhǒng dúshé kěnéng chūmò zài bùdào páng.
examples.english: Be especially careful when hiking in mountain areas — several venomous snake species in Taiwan may lurk alongside trails.

examples.chinese: 她在花園裡翻土時看到一條小蛇，嚇得驚叫了出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài huāyuán lǐ fāntǔ shí kàndào yī tiáo xiǎo shé, xià de jīngjiào le chūlái.
examples.english: While turning soil in the garden, she spotted a small snake and screamed in fright.

semanticNote: To hate to part with; to be reluctant to give up or use; to be loath to. 捨不得離開 (can't bear to leave), 捨不得花錢 (hate to spend money), 捨不得丟掉 (can't bring yourself to throw it away), 捨不得孩子 (can't bear to be parted from the child). Implies a combination of attachment and reluctance — not about physical inability but emotional unwillingness.

components.meaning: to give up; to abandon; to be willing to part with

examples.chinese: 她在台南生活了十年，離開的時候捨不得那裡的一切，尤其是每天早餐吃的虱目魚粥。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Táinán shēnghuó le shí nián, líkāi de shíhòu shěbude nàlǐ de yīqiè, yóuqí shì měitiān zǎocān chī de shīmùyú zhōu.
examples.english: She lived in Tainan for ten years and couldn't bear to leave any of it behind when she went — especially the milkfish porridge she had for breakfast every day.

examples.chinese: 爸爸捨不得花大錢幫自己買衣服，但給孩子買東西卻毫不手軟。
examples.pinyin: Bàba shěbude huā dà qián bāng zìjǐ mǎi yīfú, dàn gěi háizi mǎi dōngxi què háo bù shǒuruǎn.
examples.english: Dad is reluctant to spend much money on clothes for himself, but he doesn't hold back at all when buying things for the kids.

semanticNote: Equipment; facilities; installations — physical tools, machines, or infrastructure used for a purpose. 醫療設備 (medical equipment), 教學設備 (teaching equipment), 健身設備 (gym equipment), 設備維修 (equipment maintenance). 設備 tends to refer to larger, more specialized items; 工具 (tools) for smaller, more manual items; 器材 (apparatus/gear) overlaps with both.

components.meaning: to set up; to establish; to install

examples.chinese: 這家診所的醫療設備非常先進，連高科技影像檢查機器都有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhěnsuǒ de yīliáo shèbèi fēicháng xiānjìn, lián gāokējì yǐngxiàng jiǎnchá jīqì dōu yǒu.
examples.english: This clinic's medical equipment is very advanced — they even have high-tech medical imaging machines.

examples.chinese: 辦公室的舊設備已經影響到工作效率，是時候更新升級了。
examples.pinyin: Bàngōngshì de jiù shèbèi yǐjīng yǐngxiǎng dào gōngzuò xiàolǜ, shì shíhòu gēngxīn shēngjí le.
examples.english: The outdated equipment in the office has already started affecting work efficiency — it's time for an upgrade.

semanticNote: To design; design — the planning and creation of visual, functional, or conceptual solutions. 室內設計 (interior design), 平面設計 (graphic design), 服裝設計 (fashion design), 設計師 (designer). Taiwan has a strong design culture — 台灣設計館 and 設計之都 (design capital designations). Also used figuratively: 設計陷阱 (set a trap — 'design' a snare).

examples.chinese: 她大學念的是工業設計，畢業後進入一家科技公司擔任產品設計師。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàxué niàn de shì gōngyè shèjì, bìyè hòu jìnrù yī jiā kējì gōngsī dānrèn chǎnpǐn shèjì shī.
examples.english: She studied industrial design in university and after graduating joined a tech company as a product designer.

examples.chinese: 這個手機的外觀設計非常簡潔流線，拿在手上非常舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī de wàiguān shèjì fēicháng jiǎnjié liúxiàn, ná zài shǒu shàng fēicháng shūshì.
examples.english: The exterior design of this phone is very clean and streamlined — it feels very comfortable in the hand.

semanticNote: Facilities; installations — infrastructure and amenities built for specific purposes. 公共設施 (public facilities), 醫療設施 (medical facilities), 體育設施 (sports facilities), 軍事設施 (military installations). Slightly broader than 設備 — 設施 covers the built environment and infrastructure, while 設備 focuses on equipment/machines. 基礎設施 (infrastructure) is a key policy term.

components.meaning: to set up; to install; to establish
to carry out; to implement; facility

examples.chinese: 這座公園的無障礙設施做得很好，輪椅使用者可以自由進出各個區域。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gōngyuán de wúzhàng'ài shèshī zuò de hěn hǎo, lúnyǐ shǐyòngzhě kěyǐ zìyóu jìnchū gège qūyù.
examples.english: The accessibility facilities in this park are very well done — wheelchair users can freely access all areas.

examples.chinese: 偏遠地區的醫療設施不足，政府正積極投入資源改善。
examples.pinyin: Piānyuǎn dìqū de yīliáo shèshī bùzú, zhèngfǔ zhèng jījí tóurù zīyuán gǎishàn.
examples.english: Medical facilities in remote areas are inadequate, and the government is actively investing resources to improve the situation.

semanticNote: To shoot; shooting — discharging a projectile weapon. 射擊訓練 (shooting training), 射擊比賽 (shooting competition — an Olympic sport), 精準射擊 (precision shooting). In military contexts: 開槍射擊 (open fire). In Taiwan, shooting sports are practiced competitively. Also in video games: 射擊遊戲 (shooter game — FPS etc.).

components.meaning: to shoot; to fire; to emit
to strike; to hit; to attack

examples.chinese: 她代表台灣參加國際射擊錦標賽，在女子步槍項目中獲得銀牌。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàibiǎo Táiwān cānyù guójì shèjī jǐnbiāosài, zài nǚzǐ bùqiāng xiàngmù zhōng huòdé yínpái.
examples.english: She represented Taiwan in the international shooting championship and won a silver medal in the women's rifle event.

examples.chinese: 警察接受定期的射擊訓練，確保在緊急情況下能夠精準應對。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá jiēshòu dìqī de shèjī xùnliàn, quèbǎo zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià nénggòu jīngzhǔn yìngduì.
examples.english: Police receive regular shooting training to ensure they can respond accurately in emergency situations.

semanticNote: Photography; to photograph; cinematography. 攝影師 (photographer; cinematographer), 攝影展 (photography exhibition), 新聞攝影 (photojournalism), 電影攝影 (film cinematography). In everyday use: 我在攝影 (I'm taking photos). Taiwan has a rich photography culture and several prestigious photography competitions. 攝影機 (movie camera); 相機/照相機 is the still camera.

components.meaning: to take a photo; to take in; to absorb

examples.chinese: 她的攝影作品以台灣農村景致為主題，曾在誠品書店辦過個展。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shèyǐng zuòpǐn yǐ Táiwān nóngcūn jǐngzhì wéi zhǔtí, céng zài Chéngpǐn shūdiàn bànguo gèzhǎn.
examples.english: Her photography work focuses on Taiwan's rural landscapes — she once held a solo exhibition at Eslite Bookstore.

examples.chinese: 請問這裡可以攝影嗎？還是有限制不能拍照？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhèlǐ kěyǐ shèyǐng ma? Háishì yǒu xiànzhì bù néng pāizhào?
examples.english: Excuse me, can we take photographs here, or are there restrictions against it?

semanticNote: To stretch; to extend — extending a limb, object, or reach. 伸手 (reach out; extend a hand), 伸腿 (stretch one's legs), 伸展 (stretch; extend), 伸出援手 (extend a helping hand — figurative). 伸懶腰 (stretch after sitting/waking — a very common daily action). Cannot be used for the extension of concepts (延伸 handles that).

components.meaning: to stretch; to extend; to reach

examples.chinese: 坐了兩個小時之後，她站起來伸了個懶腰，活動一下筋骨。
examples.pinyin: Zuò le liǎng ge xiǎoshí zhīhòu, tā zhàn qǐlái shēn le ge lǎnyāo, huódòng yīxià jīngǔ.
examples.english: After sitting for two hours, she stood up and had a good stretch to loosen up her muscles.

examples.chinese: 在陌生人有困難的時候伸出援手，是一件非常有意義的事。
examples.pinyin: Zài mòshēngrén yǒu kùnnán de shíhòu shēn chū yuánshǒu, shì yī jiàn fēicháng yǒu yìyì de shì.
examples.english: Extending a helping hand to a stranger in difficulty is a very meaningful thing to do.

semanticNote: Figure; build; stature — the overall shape and proportions of a person's body. 身材好 (good figure), 身材高挑 (tall and slender), 身材魁梧 (big-built and imposing), 保持身材 (keep one's figure/stay in shape). Refers to the visual impression of the whole body shape, not just height (身高) or weight (體重). Often used in appearance-based descriptions.

examples.chinese: 她靠著規律運動和健康飲食，把身材保持得非常好。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàozhe guīlǜ yùndòng hé jiànkāng yǐnshí, bǎ shēncái bǎochí de fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: Through regular exercise and healthy eating, she has maintained a very good figure.

examples.chinese: 選手的身材高大、體格健壯，一走出來就讓對手感到壓力。
examples.pinyin: Xuǎnshǒu de shēncái gāodà, tǐgé jiànzhuàng, yī zǒu chūlái jiù ràng duìshǒu gǎndào yālì.
examples.english: The athlete's tall, powerfully built frame put pressure on the opponent the moment he stepped out.

semanticNote: Identity; status; capacity — who one is in terms of social role, legal standing, or credentials. 身分證 (national ID card — a key document in Taiwan; every citizen carries one), 身份驗證 (identity verification), 外交官身份 (diplomatic status), 以…身份 (in the capacity of…). In Taiwan, 中華民國國民身分證 is the standard form of ID. 雙重身份 (dual identity).

examples.chinese: 在台灣，身分證是最常用的身份證明文件，辦任何事都可能需要出示。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shēnfènzhèng shì zuì cháng yòng de shēnfèn zhèngmíng wénjiàn, bàn rènhé shì dōu kěnéng xūyào chūshì.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the national ID card is the most commonly used form of identification — you may need to show it for almost anything.

examples.chinese: 她以觀察員的身份出席了這次國際會議，全程未發表任何意見。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ guānchá yuán de shēnfèn chūxí le zhècì guójì huìyì, quánchéng wèi fābiǎo rènhé yìjiàn.
examples.english: She attended the international conference in the capacity of an observer and did not express any opinions throughout.

semanticNote: Profound; deep — leaving a strong impression or going to the heart of something. 印象深刻 (leave a deep impression), 深刻的道理 (a profound truth), 深刻的批評 (incisive criticism), 體會深刻 (deeply feel/understand). 給我留下深刻印象 (left a deep impression on me) is a very common idiom-like phrase. More about depth of thought or impression than physical depth.

examples.chinese: 這次的演講讓我印象深刻，她對這個議題的分析非常到位。
examples.pinyin: Zhècì de yǎnjiǎng ràng wǒ yìngxiàng shēnkè, tā duì zhège yìtí de fēnxī fēicháng dàowèi.
examples.english: This speech left a deep impression on me — her analysis of the issue was spot-on.

examples.chinese: 經歷過那次低谷，她對人生有了更深刻的體會和理解。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìguò nàcì dīgǔ, tā duì rénshēng yǒu le gèng shēnkè de tǐhuì hé lǐjiě.
examples.english: Having gone through that low point, she gained a much more profound understanding and appreciation of life.

semanticNote: Myth; mythology. 希臘神話 (Greek mythology), 原住民族神話 (indigenous peoples' myths), 神話故事 (mythological story). Also figuratively: 創造了一個神話 (created a legend/myth — achieved something seemingly impossible), 這只是個神話 (that's just a myth — not true). Taiwan's indigenous peoples have rich oral mythological traditions.

examples.chinese: 台灣各原住民族都有自己獨特的神話傳說，描述人類的起源和土地的故事。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān gè yuánzhùmín zú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de shénhuà chuánshuō, miáoshù rénlèi de qǐyuán hé tǔdì de gùshi.
examples.english: Each of Taiwan's indigenous peoples has its own unique myths and legends, describing the origins of humanity and the stories of the land.

examples.chinese: 台積電的崛起被許多人稱為台灣科技業的一個現代神話。
examples.pinyin: Táijī diàn de juéqǐ bèi xǔduō rén chēng wéi Táiwān kējì yè de yī ge xiàndài shénhuà.
examples.english: TSMC's rise is called by many a modern myth of Taiwan's technology industry.

semanticNote: Mysterious; mystical — having an air of mystery that is hard to explain or understand. 神秘的微笑 (mysterious smile), 充滿神秘感 (full of a sense of mystery), 神秘力量 (mysterious force), 神秘失蹤 (mysterious disappearance). Can be positive (intriguing/enigmatic) or negative (suspicious/murky). 神秘學 (occultism/mysticism).

examples.chinese: 台灣有很多神秘的古蹟和傳說，吸引許多人來探訪背後的故事。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu hěnduō shénmì de gǔjī hé chuánshuō, xīyǐn xǔduō rén lái tànfǎng bèihòu de gùshi.
examples.english: Taiwan has many mysterious historic sites and legends, attracting many people to explore the stories behind them.

examples.chinese: 他就是有那種神秘的氣質，讓人忍不住想多了解他。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiùshì yǒu nà zhǒng shénmì de qìzhì, ràng rén rěn bu zhù xiǎng duō liǎojiě tā.
examples.english: He just has that mysterious quality that makes you can't help but want to know more about him.

semanticNote: To rise; to hoist; to promote; liter. 太陽升起 (the sun rises), 升旗 (raise the flag — a solemn ceremony in Taiwan schools and military), 升職/升遷 (get promoted), 升學 (advance to a higher level of schooling). As measure word: 一升水 (one liter of water). 升溫 (temperature rising; warming of relations). 升學壓力 (pressure to advance academically — a major social issue in Taiwan).

components.meaning: to rise; to hoist; to promote; liter

examples.chinese: 台灣學生的升學壓力很大，許多人從國中就開始補習為考試做準備。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xuéshēng de shēngxué yālì hěn dà, xǔduō rén cóng guózhōng jiù kāishǐ bǔxí wèi kǎoshì zuò zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Academic advancement pressure is intense for students in Taiwan — many start cram school from junior high to prepare for exams.

examples.chinese: 他努力工作了三年，終於在今年獲得升職，成為部門主管。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì gōngzuò le sān nián, zhōngyú zài jīnnián huòdé shēngzhí, chéngwéi bùmén zhǔguǎn.
examples.english: After three years of hard work, he finally got promoted this year to become department head.

semanticNote: To produce; to manufacture; production; also to give birth. 工業生產 (industrial production), 生產線 (production line), 生產力 (productivity/productive capacity), 生產成本 (production cost). The 'give birth' sense: 她快要生產了 (she's about to give birth). Taiwan's manufacturing sector — especially semiconductors — is a cornerstone of its economy. 生產過剩 (overproduction).

components.meaning: to produce; to give birth; raw; alive
to produce; property; assets; to give birth

examples.chinese: 這家工廠每天生產超過十萬片晶片，供應全球各大電子品牌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng měitiān shēngchǎn chāoguò shí wàn piàn jīnpiàn, gōngyìng quánqiú gèdà diànzǐ pǐnpái.
examples.english: This factory produces more than 100,000 chips a day, supplying major electronics brands around the world.

examples.chinese: 她預產期快到了，已經辦完請假手續在家等待生產。
examples.pinyin: Tā yùchǎnqī kuài dào le, yǐjīng bàn wán qǐngjià shǒuxù zài jiā děngdài shēngchǎn.
examples.english: Her due date is approaching — she's already completed the leave paperwork and is home waiting to give birth.

semanticNote: Vivid; lively; animated — used for descriptions, presentations, or storytelling that feel alive and engaging. 生動的描述 (vivid description), 生動的表達方式 (lively way of expressing things), 他說話很生動 (he speaks in a vivid/animated way). High praise for a teacher, speaker, or writer. Opposite of 枯燥 (dry/boring). Also: 生動的表情 (expressive face).

examples.chinese: 這位老師上課非常生動有趣，學生都很喜歡聽他講課。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī shàngkè fēicháng shēngdòng yǒuqù, xuéshēng dōu hěn xǐhuān tīng tā jiǎngkè.
examples.english: This teacher's classes are very lively and engaging — students all love listening to him teach.

examples.chinese: 她用生動的語言描述了在玉山頂上看到日出的震撼感受。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shēngdòng de yǔyán miáoshù le zài Yùshān dǐng shàng kàndào rìchū de zhènhàn gǎnshòu.
examples.english: She vividly described the overwhelming feeling of watching the sunrise from the summit of Jade Mountain.

semanticNote: To grow; to grow up — applies to plants, organisms, and people developing over time. 在台灣生長 (grow up in Taiwan), 植物生長 (plant growth), 生長環境 (growing environment), 生長速度 (growth rate). For people, 生長 can refer to childhood development or the formative environment (生長背景 — background/upbringing). Distinct from 增長 (increase, quantitative growth).

components.meaning: to live; to grow; to be born

examples.chinese: 這種植物需要充足的日照才能正常生長，不適合放在陰暗的角落。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù xūyào chōngzú de rìzhào cái néng zhèngcháng shēngzhǎng, bù shìhé fàng zài yīn'àn de jiǎoluò.
examples.english: This plant needs plenty of sunlight to grow properly — it's not suited for a dark corner.

examples.chinese: 她在台東原住民部落生長，對山林和大海有著深厚的感情。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Táidōng yuánzhùmín bùluò shēngzhǎng, duì shānlín hé dàhǎi yǒuzhe shēnhòu de gǎnqíng.
examples.english: She grew up in an indigenous Amis village in Taitung and has a deep emotional attachment to the mountains and the sea.

semanticNote: Tone — the pitch contour used to distinguish words in tonal languages. Mandarin has 4 tones + neutral tone: 第一聲 (1st tone, high level), 第二聲 (2nd tone, rising), 第三聲 (3rd tone, dipping), 第四聲 (4th tone, falling), 輕聲 (neutral/light tone). Taiwanese Hokkien has 7+ tones. 聲調 is central to Chinese language learning — incorrect tones cause misunderstandings (mā/má/mǎ/mà = mother/hemp/horse/scold).

examples.chinese: 學習中文最難的部分之一就是聲調，說錯了可能意思完全不同。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí Zhōngwén zuì nán de bùfèn zhī yī jiùshì shēngdiào, shuō cuò le kěnéng yìsi wánquán bùtóng.
examples.english: One of the hardest parts of learning Chinese is the tones — getting them wrong can make the meaning completely different.

examples.chinese: 她花了大量時間練習普通話的四個聲調，終於能夠說得自然流利了。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le dàliàng shíjiān liànxí pǔtōnghuà de sì ge shēngdiào, zhōngyú nénggòu shuō de zìrán liúlì le.
examples.english: She spent a great deal of time practicing the four tones of Mandarin and finally achieved a natural, fluent delivery.

semanticNote: Rope; cord; string. 繩子 covers a range of thicknesses: thin string (細繩子), thick rope (粗繩子). 跳繩 (jump rope — a common activity), 繩結 (knot), 拉繩子 (pull the rope). In Taiwan's outdoor culture, 攀岩繩 (climbing rope) and 固定繩 (fixed rope) appear in mountaineering contexts. 繩 alone appears in compounds; 繩子 is the colloquial full form.

examples.chinese: 她用繩子把包裹紮緊，確保寄送過程中不會散掉。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shéngzi bǎ bāoguǒ zā jǐn, quèbǎo jìsòng guòchéng zhōng bù huì sàn diào.
examples.english: She tied the package tight with rope to make sure it wouldn't come apart during shipping.

examples.chinese: 小朋友拿著一條跳繩在操場上玩耍，跳得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyǒu ná zhe yī tiáo tiàoshéng zài cāochǎng shàng wánshuǎ, tiào de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The little kids were playing with a jump rope on the playground, happily jumping away.

semanticNote: To omit; to leave out; abbreviation — removing something non-essential. 省略掉細節 (omit details), 省略符號 (ellipsis — …), 說話省略主語 (omit the subject in speech — very common in Chinese). In grammar and editing, 省略 is key: Chinese frequently omits subjects, objects, or elements that are clear from context. 縮寫 (abbreviation by shortening) vs. 省略 (omission in context).

components.meaning: to summarize; to omit; strategy; roughly

examples.chinese: 報告中不必要的背景資訊可以省略，直接進入核心內容。
examples.pinyin: Bàogào zhōng bù bìyào de bèijǐng zīxùn kěyǐ shěnglüè, zhíjiē jìnrù héxīn nèiróng.
examples.english: Unnecessary background information in the report can be omitted — go straight to the core content.

examples.chinese: 中文句子常常省略主語，需要從上下文才能判斷是誰在做這個動作。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwén jùzi chángcháng shěnglüè zhǔyǔ, xūyào cóng shàngxiàwén cái néng pànduàn shì shuí zài zuò zhège dòngzuò.
examples.english: Chinese sentences frequently omit the subject — you need context to determine who is performing the action.

semanticNote: Victory; triumph — achieving a win in competition, conflict, or struggle. 取得勝利 (achieve victory), 贏得勝利 (win a victory), 最終勝利 (ultimate victory), 勝利歡呼 (victory cheers). More formal and weighty than 贏 (to win). Used in sports (比賽勝利), military (戰爭勝利), and political contexts. 勝利的喜悅 (the joy of victory).

components.meaning: to win; to surpass; victory; excellent

examples.chinese: 台灣代表隊在這次世界大學運動會上取得了多項勝利，令國人振奮。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān dàibiǎoduì zài zhècì Shìjiè Dàxué Yùndònghuì shàng qǔdé le duō xiàng shènglì, lìng guórén zhènfèn.
examples.english: The Taiwan delegation won multiple victories at this World University Games, exciting the whole country.

examples.chinese: 比賽結束後，勝利的球員們激動地抱在一起，慶祝這得來不易的成果。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù hòu, shènglì de qiúyuán men jīdòng de bào zài yīqǐ, qìngzhù zhè délái bù yì de chénguǒ.
examples.english: After the match ended, the victorious players embraced each other excitedly, celebrating this hard-earned result.

semanticNote: Insomnia; to be unable to sleep. 長期失眠 (chronic insomnia), 因壓力失眠 (insomnia due to stress), 失眠症 (insomnia disorder). A very common complaint in Taiwan's high-stress work culture. 睡不著 (can't fall asleep) is the colloquial expression; 失眠 is more formal and clinical. 安眠藥 (sleeping pills) are commonly sought out.

components.meaning: to lose; to miss; to fail

examples.chinese: 她最近工作壓力很大，已經連續失眠好幾個晚上了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì hěn dà, yǐjīng liánxù shīmián hǎo jǐ ge wǎnshàng le.
examples.english: She's been under a lot of work pressure lately and has had several consecutive nights of insomnia.

examples.chinese: 長期失眠不只影響精神，也會對心臟和免疫系統造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī shīmián bù zhǐ yǐngxiǎng jīngshén, yě huì duì xīnzàng hé miǎnyì xìtǒng zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: Chronic insomnia doesn't just affect mental energy — it also causes harm to the heart and immune system.

semanticNote: To lose — permanently losing something that was once possessed. 失去機會 (lose an opportunity), 失去信心 (lose confidence), 失去聯繫 (lose touch/contact), 失去生命 (lose one's life). More permanent and irreversible than 丟掉 (lose or throw away, physical objects). 失去 applies to abstract things (opportunities, feelings, relationships) as well as concrete ones.

components.meaning: to lose; to miss; to fail
to go away; to remove; away

examples.chinese: 她因為輕信謠言而失去了一個重要的朋友，事後非常後悔。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi qīngxìn yáoyán ér shīqù le yī ge zhòngyào de péngyǒu, shìhòu fēicháng hòuhuǐ.
examples.english: She lost an important friend by too readily believing a rumor and deeply regretted it afterward.

examples.chinese: 不要讓眼前的挫折讓你失去對未來的信心。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào ràng yǎnqián de cuòzhé ràng nǐ shīqù duì wèilái de xìnxīn.
examples.english: Don't let the setbacks in front of you make you lose confidence in the future.

semanticNote: To lose one's job; unemployment. 失業率 (unemployment rate), 長期失業 (long-term unemployment), 申請失業給付 (apply for unemployment benefits). In Taiwan, 就業服務站 (employment service centers) and 失業給付 (unemployment benefits, administered through 勞動部/Ministry of Labor) support displaced workers. 結構性失業 (structural unemployment) is a policy concept.

examples.chinese: 疫情期間有許多餐飲業從業人員失業，政府緊急推出紓困方案。
examples.pinyin: Yìqíng qījiān yǒu xǔduō cānyǐn yè cóngyè rényuán shīyè, zhèngfǔ jǐnjí tuīchū shūkùn fāng'àn.
examples.english: Many workers in the food and beverage industry lost their jobs during the pandemic, and the government urgently rolled out relief measures.

examples.chinese: 他失業半年後終於找到了新工作，整個人精神好了很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā shīyè bànnián hòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le xīn gōngzuò, zhěngrén jīngshén hǎo le hěnduō.
examples.english: After six months of unemployment he finally found a new job, and his whole spirit lifted considerably.

semanticNote: Poem; poetry; verse. 寫詩 (write poetry), 讀詩 (read poetry), 古詩 (classical Chinese poetry — Tang/Song poetry is a staple of Taiwan's secondary education curriculum), 現代詩 (modern poetry), 詩集 (collection of poems). Taiwan has a rich modern poetry tradition. 詩人 (poet). 詩意 (poetic quality/spirit) is used figuratively: 充滿詩意 (poetic/evocative).

examples.chinese: 李白的詩充滿浪漫主義色彩，是台灣國中生必背的古詩之一。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ Bái de shī chōngmǎn làngmàn zhǔyì sècǎi, shì Táiwān guózhōngshēng bì bèi de gǔshī zhī yī.
examples.english: Li Bai's poetry is full of romantic spirit and is one of the classical poems that Taiwan junior high students are required to memorize.

examples.chinese: 她利用午休時間寫詩，把工作中的壓力轉化成文字釋放出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng wǔxiū shíjiān xiě shī, bǎ gōngzuò zhōng de yālì zhuǎnhuà chéng wénzì shìfàng chūlái.
examples.english: She uses her lunch breaks to write poetry, channeling her work stress into words and releasing it that way.

semanticNote: Lion. Not native to Asia — lions (獅子) in Chinese culture are mostly known through 石獅子 (stone lion guardian statues) placed at temple or palace entrances, which are omnipresent in Taiwan's temples and official buildings. 舞獅 (lion dance) is a key festivity in Taiwan's Lunar New Year and temple festivals. 獅子座 (Leo — zodiac sign). 獅子山 is also a district name in Hong Kong.

examples.chinese: 廟宇門口通常擺放著一對石獅子，象徵鎮守和保護。
examples.pinyin: Miàoyǔ ménkǒu tōngcháng bǎifàng zhe yī duì shí shīzi, xiàngzhēng zhènshou hé bǎohù.
examples.english: Temple entrances typically have a pair of stone lions placed at them, symbolizing guardianship and protection.

examples.chinese: 廟會的舞獅表演非常精彩，舞者的動作靈活生動，引得圍觀民眾不斷叫好。
examples.pinyin: Miàohuì de wǔshī biǎoyǎn fēicháng jīngcǎi, wǔzhě de dòngzuò línghuó shēngdòng, yǐn de wéiguān mínzhòng bùduàn jiào hǎo.
examples.english: The lion dance performance at the temple festival was spectacular — the performers' movements were agile and vivid, drawing continuous cheers from the watching crowd.

semanticNote: Moist; humid; damp in a comfortable, non-excessive way. 空氣濕潤 (moist air), 皮膚濕潤 (moisturized skin), 濕潤的氣候 (humid climate). Positive connotation — implies a pleasant, healthy level of moisture (unlike 潮濕 which suggests excessive, uncomfortable dampness). Taiwan's climate is generally 濕潤, especially in the north and east.

components.meaning: moist; smooth; to moisten; to lubricate

examples.chinese: 花蓮的氣候濕潤多雨，非常適合蕨類植物生長。
examples.pinyin: Huālián de qìhòu shīrùn duōyǔ, fēicháng shìhé juèlèi zhíwù shēngzhǎng.
examples.english: Hualien's climate is moist and rainy, making it perfect for ferns to grow.

examples.chinese: 護膚品廣告強調能保持肌膚長時間濕潤，讓皮膚不再乾燥緊繃。
examples.pinyin: Hùfūpǐn guǎnggào qiángdiào néng bǎochí jīfū cháng shíjiān shīrùn, ràng pífū bù zài gānzào jǐnbēng.
examples.english: The skincare ad claims it can keep skin moist for hours, preventing dryness and tightness.

semanticNote: Stone; rock. 石頭路 (stone path/cobblestone road), 石頭屋 (stone house), 踢到石頭 (kick a stone). Also in game names: 剪刀石頭布 (rock-paper-scissors, literally 'scissors-stone-cloth'). Colloquially: 心裡像壓了一塊大石頭 (heart feels like a big stone is pressing on it — feel a heavy burden). Taiwan's geology produces distinctive stones, especially 花蓮大理石 (Hualien marble).

components.meaning: head; top; end; suffix for nouns

examples.chinese: 孩子在溪邊撿了一堆各式各樣的石頭，說要帶回家當寶貝收藏。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zài xī biān jiǎn le yī duī gè shì gèyàng de shítou, shuō yào dài huíjiā dāng bǎobèi shōucáng.
examples.english: The child picked up a pile of all kinds of stones by the stream, saying they wanted to take them home as treasure.

examples.chinese: 花蓮盛產大理石，當地許多建築和工藝品都以此為材料。
examples.pinyin: Huālián shèngchǎn dàlǐshí, dāngdì xǔduō jiànzhù hé gōngyìpǐn dōu yǐ cǐ wéi cáiliào.
examples.english: Hualien is abundant in marble, and many local buildings and craft products use it as a material.

semanticNote: Time difference; jet lag. 時差 means both the difference in time zones (台灣和紐約差十二個小時 — Taiwan and New York are 12 hours apart) and the physiological jet lag from crossing time zones (倒時差 — get over jet lag). 倒時差 is very common for frequent travelers between Taiwan and the US or Europe. 調整時差 (adjust to the time difference).

examples.chinese: 她剛從美國回來，還在倒時差，白天精神不好，晚上又睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng cóng Měiguó huílái, hái zài dào shíchā, báitiān jīngshén bù hǎo, wǎnshàng yòu shuì bù zháo.
examples.english: She just got back from the States and is still getting over jet lag — groggy during the day and unable to sleep at night.

examples.chinese: 台灣和英國有八個小時的時差，視訊會議的時間安排需要特別注意。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hé Yīngguó yǒu bā ge xiǎoshí de shíchā, shìxùn huìyì de shíjiān ānpái xūyào tèbié zhùyì.
examples.english: There's an eight-hour time difference between Taiwan and the UK, so scheduling video conferences requires special attention.

semanticNote: Age; era; the times — a period defined by its dominant characteristics. 數位時代 (the digital age), 後疫情時代 (the post-pandemic era), 民主時代 (the democratic era), 與時代脫節 (out of touch with the times). 時代的眼淚 (tears of an era — nostalgic phrase for something that defined a generation, popular in Taiwan social media). More about cultural character than 時期 (time period, more neutral).

examples.chinese: 我們正處於一個人工智慧快速改變各行各業的時代。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèng chǔyú yī ge réngōng zhìhuì kuàisù gǎibiàn gè háng gè yè de shídài.
examples.english: We are living in an era when artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming every industry.

examples.chinese: 那首歌是很多七年級生的青春記憶，被稱為一個時代的象徵。
examples.pinyin: Nà shǒu gē shì hěnduō qī niánjí shēng de qīngchūn jìyì, bèi chēng wéi yī ge shídài de xiàngzhēng.
examples.english: That song is a youth memory for many millennials in Taiwan and is called a symbol of an era.

semanticNote: Moment; constantly; at all times. As noun: 重要的時刻 (an important moment), 歷史性時刻 (historic moment). As adverb: 時刻保持警惕 (be vigilant at all times), 時刻準備 (always be ready). More formal and emphatic than 時候 (time/moment). 時刻表 (timetable/schedule — e.g., 高鐵時刻表 HSR timetable).

examples.chinese: 那個拿到金牌的時刻，她的眼淚忍不住流了下來。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge ná dào jīnpái de shíkè, tā de yǎnlèi rěn bu zhù liú le xiàlái.
examples.english: At the moment she received the gold medal, she couldn't hold back her tears.

examples.chinese: 作為急診護理師，她必須時刻保持高度警覺，隨時應對突發狀況。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi jízhěn hùlǐshī, tā bìxū shíkè bǎochí gāodù jǐngjué, suíshí yìngduì tūfā zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: As an emergency nurse, she must stay highly alert at all times and be ready to respond to sudden situations at any moment.

semanticNote: Fashionable; trendy; stylish — following the latest fashion or trends. 很時髦 (very trendy), 時髦打扮 (fashionable dress), 趕時髦 (follow trends/keep up with fashion). Slightly more colloquial and personality-focused than 時尚 (fashion as a field or phenomenon). 時髦 implies the person is actively keeping up with what's in vogue.

components.meaning: hair flowing from the mane; fashionable

examples.chinese: 她每季都會更新衣櫥，追求最時髦的流行款式。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi jì dōu huì gēngxīn yīchú, zhuīqiú zuì shímáo de liúxíng kuǎnshì.
examples.english: She updates her wardrobe every season, always chasing the trendiest styles.

examples.chinese: 爸爸穿上了媽媽幫他挑的新款外套，說自己終於跟得上時髦了。
examples.pinyin: Bàba chuān shàng le māma bāng tā tiāo de xīn kuǎn wàitào, shuō zìjǐ zhōngyú gēn de shàng shímáo le.
examples.english: Dad put on the new jacket Mom picked out for him and said he was finally keeping up with fashion.

semanticNote: Period; phase — a span of time in history or a process, usually defined by specific characteristics. 青春期 (adolescence — a time period), 戰爭時期 (wartime), 殖民時期 (colonial period), 台灣戒嚴時期 (the martial law period in Taiwan, 1949–1987). More neutral and chronological than 時代 (era, which emphasizes cultural character). 發展時期 (development phase).

examples.chinese: 台灣戒嚴時期長達三十八年，對當代台灣的政治和社會有深遠的影響。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān jiè'yán shíqī cháng dá sānshíbā nián, duì dāngdài Táiwān de zhèngzhì hé shèhuì yǒu shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Taiwan's martial law period lasted thirty-eight years and had a profound influence on contemporary Taiwan's politics and society.

examples.chinese: 孩子在青春期的情緒容易波動，父母的理解和支持非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zài qīngchūnqī de qíngxù róngyì bōdòng, fùmǔ de lǐjiě hé zhīchí fēicháng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Children's emotions are prone to fluctuation during adolescence — parents' understanding and support are very important.

semanticNote: Fashion; fashionable; trendy. As noun: 時尚界 (the fashion world), 時尚週 (fashion week), 時尚雜誌 (fashion magazine). As adjective: 時尚的穿著 (fashionable clothing). More institutional/industry-focused than 時髦 — 時尚 refers to the fashion industry and aesthetic trend system; 時髦 describes a person actively following trends. 時尚感 (sense of style).

examples.chinese: 台灣設計師在國際時尚界越來越受到矚目，多次登上國際伸展台。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shèjì shī zài guójì shíshàng jiè yuèlái yuè shòudào zhǔmù, duōcì dēng shàng guójì shēnzhǎntái.
examples.english: Taiwanese designers are attracting increasing attention in the international fashion world, with multiple appearances on international runways.

examples.chinese: 她穿衣服很有時尚感，總能把平價服飾搭配出高級的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuān yīfú hěn yǒu shíshàng gǎn, zǒng néng bǎ píngjià fúshì dāpèi chū gāojí de gǎnjué.
examples.english: She has a great sense of style — she can always make affordable clothing look high-end.

semanticNote: Truth; the truth; what one really thinks. 說實話 (tell the truth), 實話實說 (speak the truth plainly), 說句實話 (to tell you the truth / honestly speaking). Very colloquial. Often used to preface a frank or potentially uncomfortable statement: 說實話，我覺得這個計畫有點問題 (to be honest, I think there's a problem with this plan).

examples.chinese: 說實話，這份報告還有很多地方需要改進，現在還差得遠。
examples.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, zhè fèn bàogào hái yǒu hěnduō dìfāng xūyào gǎijìn, xiànzài hái chà de yuǎn.
examples.english: To be honest, this report still has many areas that need improvement — it's still far from done.

examples.chinese: 她最欣賞他的一點就是敢說實話，從不拐彎抹角。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì xīnshǎng tā de yī diǎn jiùshì gǎn shuō shíhuà, cóng bù guǎi wān mò jiǎo.
examples.english: What she admires most about him is that he has the courage to tell the truth and never beats around the bush.

semanticNote: Practice; to put into practice; to carry out. 實踐理想 (put ideals into practice), 在實踐中學習 (learn through practice), 理論與實踐 (theory and practice). More action-oriented and ideologically significant than 練習 (practice/drill for skill). In Chinese Marxist discourse, 實踐 (praxis) has philosophical weight. In everyday use: 實踐承諾 (keep a promise).

components.meaning: to tread; to carry out; to fulfil

examples.chinese: 學了很多理論卻不去實踐，永遠學不會真正的技能。
examples.pinyin: Xué le hěnduō lǐlùn què bù qù shíjiàn, yǒngyuǎn xué bù huì zhēnzhèng de jìnéng.
examples.english: You can learn all the theory you like, but without putting it into practice you'll never acquire real skills.

examples.chinese: 她把環保理念融入日常生活，用行動實踐自己的承諾。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ huánbǎo lǐniàn róngrù rìcháng shēnghuó, yòng xíngdòng shíjiàn zìjǐ de chéngnuò.
examples.english: She integrates environmental values into her daily life, fulfilling her commitment through action.

semanticNote: Internship; to intern; to practice in a professional setting. 實習生 (intern), 實習期間 (internship period), 暑期實習 (summer internship), 醫院實習 (hospital internship). In Taiwan, university internships are often required for certain programs (education, medicine, law). 實習薪資 (intern compensation) is a recurring labor policy debate. Note: the skeleton spells it shíxí (corrected from any space).

examples.chinese: 她在大四的時候去了一家廣告公司實習，學到了很多課堂上學不到的東西。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàsì de shíhòu qù le yī jiā guǎnggào gōngsī shíxí, xuédào le hěnduō kètáng shàng xué bù dào de dōngxi.
examples.english: She did an internship at an advertising company in her senior year and learned many things that couldn't be taught in the classroom.

examples.chinese: 實習是從學校到職場的重要過渡，讓學生提前體驗真實的工作環境。
examples.pinyin: Shíxí shì cóng xuéxiào dào zhíchǎng de zhòngyào guòdù, ràng xuéshēng tíqián tǐyàn zhēnshí de gōngzuò huánjìng.
examples.english: Internships are an important transition from school to the workplace, giving students an early experience of a real work environment.

semanticNote: To achieve; to realize; to implement — making something real that was previously only a plan or dream. 實現夢想 (realize a dream), 實現目標 (achieve a goal), 難以實現 (hard to achieve), 尚未實現 (not yet realized). More definitive than 完成 (complete a task) — 實現 implies bringing something from the realm of aspiration into reality.

examples.chinese: 她苦讀多年，終於實現了出國留學的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǔdú duō nián, zhōngyú shíxiàn le chūguó liúxué de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: After years of hard study, she finally realized her dream of going abroad to study.

examples.chinese: 政府承諾在任期內實現零碳排放的目標，但外界對此仍有疑慮。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò zài rèn qī nèi shíxiàn líng tàn páifàng de mùbiāo, dàn wàijiè duì cǐ réng yǒu yílǜ.
examples.english: The government pledged to achieve zero carbon emissions within its term, but there remains public skepticism about this.

semanticNote: Experiment; to experiment; test. 做實驗 (conduct an experiment), 實驗室 (laboratory), 科學實驗 (science experiment), 實驗性 (experimental). In Taiwan schools, 實驗課 (lab class) is a required component of science education. Also used figuratively: 社會實驗 (social experiment), 政策實驗 (policy experiment). 動物實驗 (animal testing) is a controversial topic.

components.meaning: to examine; to test; to verify

examples.chinese: 化學實驗課上，學生必須穿戴護目鏡和實驗衣，確保安全。
examples.pinyin: Huàxué shíyàn kè shàng, xuéshēng bìxū chuān dài hùmùjìng hé shíyànyī, quèbǎo ānquán.
examples.english: In chemistry lab class, students must wear goggles and lab coats to ensure safety.

examples.chinese: 研究團隊進行了多組對照實驗，最終得出了令人信服的結果。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū tuánduì jìnxíng le duō zǔ duìzhào shíyàn, zuìzhōng déchū le lìng rén xìnfú de jiéguǒ.
examples.english: The research team conducted multiple sets of controlled experiments and ultimately arrived at convincing results.

semanticNote: Practical; functional; utilitarian — useful for actual everyday purposes. 實用的工具 (practical tool), 注重實用性 (emphasize practicality), 實用主義 (pragmatism). A high compliment in Taiwanese consumer culture: 這個東西很實用 (this thing is really practical). Contrasts with 好看但不實用 (looks nice but isn't practical). Taiwan's 3C電子市場 (electronics market) culture prizes 實用性.

examples.chinese: 她挑選禮物特別注重實用性，認為送人的東西用得到比好看更重要。
examples.pinyin: Tā tiāoxuǎn lǐwù tèbié zhùzhòng shíyòngxìng, rènwéi sòng rén de dōngxi yòng de dào bǐ hǎokàn gèng zhòngyào.
examples.english: She places special emphasis on practicality when choosing gifts, believing that something useful is more important than something attractive.

examples.chinese: 這款多功能背包設計非常實用，適合上班族、學生和旅行者使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn duō gōngnéng bēibāo shèjì fēicháng shíyòng, shìhé shàngbān zú, xuéshēng hé lǚxíng zhě shǐyòng.
examples.english: This multi-function backpack is very practically designed and suitable for office workers, students, and travelers alike.

semanticNote: Food — edible items in general. 食物過敏 (food allergy), 天然食物 (natural food), 食物浪費 (food waste), 食物鏈 (food chain). Slightly more formal and general than 食品 (food products/processed food) or 飯菜 (food/dishes cooked). In nutrition and medical contexts, 食物 is standard. 食物安全 (food safety) is a significant consumer and policy concern in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 她對花生嚴重過敏，出門前一定會確認食物成分，以免發生危險。
