examples.pinyin: Tā duì huāshēng yánzhòng guòmǐn, chūmén qián yīdìng huì quèrèn shíwù chéngfèn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
examples.english: She has a severe peanut allergy and always checks food ingredients before going out to avoid any danger.

examples.chinese: 減少食物浪費是每個人都可以為環境出一份力的小事。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎnshǎo shíwù làngfèi shì měi ge rén dōu kěyǐ wèi huánjìng chū yī fèn lì de xiǎoshì.
examples.english: Reducing food waste is a small thing everyone can do to contribute to the environment.

semanticNote: To exert all one's strength; to try very hard — putting maximum physical or mental effort into something. 使勁兒推 (push with all your might), 使勁兒說 (shout out loud). Very colloquial, with the erhua (r-suffix) characteristic of northern Mandarin. In Taiwan, 使勁 without the r-suffix is more common. 加油 (cheer up / try harder) is the more everyday Taiwan equivalent in most contexts.

components.meaning: to use; to make; to send

examples.chinese: 他使勁地推著卡車的車門，終於把卡住的門打開了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǐjìn de tuīzhe kǎchē de chē mén, zhōngyú bǎ kǎ zhù de mén dǎkāi le.
examples.english: He pushed on the truck door with all his might and finally got the stuck door open.

examples.chinese: 比賽最後一圈，她使勁向前衝，以些微差距贏得了第一名。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài zuìhòu yī quān, tā shǐjìn xiàng qián chōng, yǐ xiē wēi chājù yíngdé le dì yī míng.
examples.english: On the final lap of the race, she surged forward with everything she had and won first place by a slim margin.

semanticNote: From beginning to end; all along; throughout — consistently, without change. 始終如一 (consistent from beginning to end — a compliment about reliability), 始終保持 (always maintain), 始終相信 (believe all along). More formal than 一直 (always/all the time). 始終如一 is a very common idiom. Emphasizes temporal consistency over the entire span.

examples.chinese: 無論遇到多大的困難，她始終沒有放棄自己的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào duō dà de kùnnán, tā shǐzhōng méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: No matter what difficulties she encountered, she never gave up on her dreams throughout it all.

examples.chinese: 他始終如一地對待每一位員工，不因對方職位高低而有所差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǐzhōng rú yī de duìdài měi yī wèi yuángōng, bù yīn duìfāng zhíwèi gāodī ér yǒusuǒ chāyì.
examples.english: He treats every employee consistently from first to last, showing no difference based on their rank.

semanticNote: Soldier; enlisted man — a low-ranking member of an army. 士兵訓練 (soldier training), 役男/士兵 (conscript/soldier — Taiwan has compulsory military service, 義務役). In Taiwan, 義務役士兵 (conscript soldiers) serve for four months (since 2024: 一年). 國軍士兵 (ROC Armed Forces soldiers). More formal than 阿兵哥 (colloquial Taiwan term for a soldier/GI).

examples.chinese: 在台灣，滿十八歲的男性公民依法須服義務役，成為預備士兵。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, mǎn shíbā suì de nánxìng gōngmín yī fǎ xū fú yìwù yì, chéngwéi yùbèi shìbīng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, male citizens who turn eighteen are legally required to serve in compulsory military service as reserve soldiers.

examples.chinese: 演習中，士兵們全副武裝，模擬在各種複雜地形下作戰的情境。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnxí zhōng, shìbīng men quán fù wǔzhuāng, mónǐ zài gèzhǒng fùzá dìxíng xià zuòzhàn de qíngjìng.
examples.english: During the drill, the soldiers were in full gear, simulating combat scenarios across various complex terrains.

semanticNote: Market — both a physical marketplace and an abstract economic market. 傳統市場 (traditional market — wet market, like Taipei's 東門市場), 超市 (supermarket), 國際市場 (international market), 市場佔有率 (market share), 市場經濟 (market economy). In Taiwan, traditional markets (傳統市場/菜市場) are an important cultural institution for daily shopping, especially for fresh produce.

examples.chinese: 台灣的傳統市場早晨非常熱鬧，各攤位的叫賣聲此起彼落，充滿生活氣息。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de chuántǒng shìchǎng zǎochén fēicháng rènào, gè tānwèi de jiàomài shēng cǐqǐbǐluò, chōngmǎn shēnghuó qìxī.
examples.english: Taiwan's traditional markets are very lively in the morning, with vendors calling out from every stall, full of the bustle of daily life.

examples.chinese: 這家公司正在積極開拓東南亞市場，計畫在三個國家設立分公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài jījí kāituò Dōngnányà shìchǎng, jìhuà zài sān ge guójiā shèlì fēn gōngsī.
examples.english: The company is actively expanding into Southeast Asian markets, with plans to establish branches in three countries.

semanticNote: Seems as if; just like; like (a comparison particle). Used after a noun or verb phrase to indicate resemblance or likeness: 像飛一樣似的 (as if flying), 她哭了似的臉 (a face like she'd been crying), 大雨似的 (like a downpour). More literary and emphatic than just 像. Often combined with 像…一樣 for full effect: 像夢一樣似的 (as if it were a dream).

examples.chinese: 他急急忙忙地跑出去，像著了火似的，也不知道出了什麼事。
examples.pinyin: Tā jí jí mángmáng de pǎo chūqù, xiàng zháo le huǒ sìde, yě bù zhīdào chū le shénme shì.
examples.english: He rushed out in a frantic hurry, as if he were on fire — nobody knew what had happened.

examples.chinese: 她聽到這個消息，臉色一下子白了，像要暈倒似的。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, liǎnsè yīxiàzi bái le, xiàng yào yūndǎo sìde.
examples.english: When she heard the news, her face went pale all at once, as if she were about to faint.

semanticNote: Fact; the facts; in fact. 事實上 (in fact; actually — a very common discourse marker), 面對事實 (face the facts), 以事實為依據 (based on facts), 顛覆事實 (distort the facts). In Taiwan's media and legal contexts: 查明事實 (ascertain the facts). 事實勝於雄辯 (facts speak louder than words — set phrase).

examples.chinese: 事實上，這個謠言早就被專家闢謠，只是網路上還在繼續流傳。
examples.pinyin: Shìshí shàng, zhège yáoyán zǎo jiù bèi zhuānjia pìyáo, zhǐshì wǎnglù shàng hái zài jìxù liúchuán.
examples.english: In fact, this rumor was debunked by experts long ago — it's just still circulating online.

examples.chinese: 在法庭上，律師必須以事實和證據說話，不能只靠口才取勝。
examples.pinyin: Zài fǎtíng shàng, lǜshī bìxū yǐ shìshí hé zhèngjù shuōhuà, bù néng zhǐ kào kǒucái qǔshèng.
examples.english: In court, lawyers must speak with facts and evidence — they can't win by eloquence alone.

semanticNote: Things; objects; matters — everything in the world, tangible and intangible. 新事物 (new things), 各種事物 (all kinds of things), 認識事物 (understand things). More philosophical and broad than 東西 (stuff/things in a concrete sense). Often paired with verbs of cognition or perception: 觀察事物 (observe things), 理解事物 (understand things). Frequently used in educational and philosophical contexts.

examples.chinese: 對新事物保持開放的心態，是持續成長進步的重要關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Duì xīn shìwù bǎochí kāifàng de xīntài, shì chíxù chéngzhǎng jìnbù de zhòngyào guānjiàn.
examples.english: Maintaining an open attitude toward new things is an important key to continuous growth and improvement.

examples.chinese: 老師希望學生從多角度看待事物，不要只有單一的思考方式。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng xuéshēng cóng duō jiǎodù kàndài shìwù, bùyào zhǐyǒu dānyī de sīkǎo fāngshì.
examples.english: The teacher hopes students look at things from multiple angles and don't rely on only one way of thinking.

semanticNote: In advance; beforehand; prior to — doing something before the main event as preparation. 事先通知 (notify in advance), 事先準備 (prepare in advance), 事先確認 (confirm beforehand), 未事先告知 (without prior notice). More formal than 提前 (ahead of time) and specifically emphasizes preparation before a specific event, not just earliness.

examples.chinese: 如果要更改預約時間，請事先至少提前二十四小時告知，謝謝配合。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yào gēnggǎi yùyuē shíjiān, qǐng shìxiān zhìshǎo tíqián èrshísì xiǎoshí gàozhī, xièxiè pèihé.
examples.english: If you need to change your appointment time, please notify us at least 24 hours in advance. Thank you for your cooperation.

examples.chinese: 他事先做了充分的準備，所以報告進行得非常順利。
examples.pinyin: Tā shìxiān zuò le chōngfèn de zhǔnbèi, suǒyǐ bàogào jìnxíng de fēicháng shùnlì.
examples.english: He prepared thoroughly in advance, so the presentation went very smoothly.

semanticNote: Exam paper; test paper — the printed question sheet or answer booklet used in examinations. 發試卷 (hand out exam papers), 收試卷 (collect exam papers), 批改試卷 (grade exam papers). In Taiwan's high-stakes exam culture, 學測試卷 (GSAT exam papers) and 指考試卷 (university entrance exam papers) are analyzed and discussed extensively after each exam.

examples.chinese: 老師一宣布要發試卷，全班立刻安靜下來，緊張地等待自己的成績。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yī xuānbù yào fā shìjuàn, quán bān lìkè ānjìng xiàlái, jǐnzhāng de děngdài zìjǐ de chéngjì.
examples.english: The moment the teacher announced she was handing back the exam papers, the whole class fell silent and anxiously waited for their scores.

examples.chinese: 學測結束後，各科試卷迅速在網路上流傳，學生和家長紛紛對答案。
examples.pinyin: Xuécè jiéshù hòu, gè kē shìjuàn xùnsù zài wǎnglù shàng liúchuán, xuéshēng hé jiāzhǎng fēnfēn duì dá'àn.
examples.english: After the GSAT, exam papers for each subject quickly circulated online, with students and parents rushing to check their answers.

semanticNote: Harvest; to harvest; gain; acquisition — both literal harvest of crops (秋天收穫 — autumn harvest) and figurative gains from effort (這次旅行收穫很大 — this trip yielded a lot). 大豐收 (bumper harvest), 有所收穫 (gain something valuable). In Taiwan agriculture: 稻米收穫 (rice harvest), 蔬果收穫 (vegetable/fruit harvest).

components.meaning: to receive; to collect; to harvest

examples.chinese: 這次研討會讓她收穫很多，不只學到了新知識，也認識了很多業界前輩。
examples.pinyin: Zhècì yántǎohuì ràng tā shōuhuò hěnduō, bù zhǐ xuédào le xīn zhīshì, yě rènshí le hěnduō yèjiè qiánbèi.
examples.english: This seminar was very rewarding for her — she not only gained new knowledge but also got to know many industry veterans.

examples.chinese: 梨山的果農今年收穫豐碩，蘋果和水蜜桃的品質都比往年好。
examples.pinyin: Líshān de guǒnóng jīnnián shōuhuò fēngshuò, píngguǒ hé shuǐmìtáo de pǐnzhì dōu bǐ wǎngnián hǎo.
examples.english: Lishan's fruit growers had a bountiful harvest this year — the quality of both apples and white peaches was better than in previous years.

semanticNote: Receipt — a document confirming payment was received. 開收據 (issue a receipt), 要求收據 (ask for a receipt), 保存收據 (keep the receipt). In Taiwan, 統一發票 (uniform invoice/receipt — Taiwan's national receipt lottery system) replaces the simple receipt in most retail contexts; consumers are encouraged to collect 發票 as they may win prizes. A receipt for services is often a 收據; retail uses 發票.

components.meaning: evidence; receipt; to occupy; to base on

examples.chinese: 付款後記得索取收據，以便日後報帳或有糾紛時作為憑證。
examples.pinyin: Fùkuǎn hòu jìde suǒqǔ shōujù, yǐbiàn rìhòu bàozhàng huò yǒu jiūfēn shí zuòwéi píngzhèng.
examples.english: Remember to ask for a receipt after paying so you have proof for expense reimbursement or in case of a dispute.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，大部分的商店會開統一發票，別忘了把發票留下來對獎。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, dàbùfèn de shāngdiàn huì kāi tǒngyī fāpiào, bié wàng le bǎ fāpiào liúxiàlái duìjiǎng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, most shops issue uniform invoices — don't forget to keep your invoice to check if you've won a prize.

semanticNote: Handmade; handicraft; manual work. 手工藝品 (handicraft items), 手工製作 (handmade), 純手工 (completely handmade — a quality/premium label), 手工皮革 (handcrafted leather). In Taiwan, 手工業 (handicraft industry) and artisanal goods 手工食品 (handmade food) are increasingly valued as boutique products. 手工費 (labor charge for skilled handwork).

examples.chinese: 她用了三個月時間純手工縫製了一件旗袍，做工精緻令人讚嘆。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng le sān ge yuè shíjiān chún shǒugōng féngzhì le yī jiàn qípáo, zuògōng jīngzhì lìng rén zàntàn.
examples.english: She spent three months entirely by hand sewing a qipao — the craftsmanship was exquisite and admirable.

examples.chinese: 鶯歌老街的手工陶瓷店琳瑯滿目，每件作品都有獨特的藝術風格。
examples.pinyin: Yīnggē lǎojiē de shǒugōng táocí diàn línlángmǎnmù, měi jiàn zuòpǐn dōu yǒu dútè de yìshù fēnggé.
examples.english: Yingge's old street is full of handcrafted ceramics shops, with every piece having a unique artistic style.

semanticNote: Surgery; surgical operation. 進行手術 (perform surgery), 術後護理 (post-surgery care), 開心手術 (open-heart surgery), 微創手術 (minimally invasive surgery). In Taiwan, the National Health Insurance (全民健保) covers most surgeries. 手術室 (operating room), 外科手術 (surgical operation). 動手術 (undergo/perform surgery — colloquial compound) is very common.

examples.chinese: 醫生說他的膝蓋傷勢嚴重，需要立即進行手術才能恢復正常行走。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā de xīgài shāngshì yánzhòng, xūyào lìjí jìnxíng shǒushù cái néng huīfù zhèngcháng xíngzǒu.
examples.english: The doctor said his knee injury was serious and he needed immediate surgery to restore normal walking.

examples.chinese: 她在手術後休養了一個月，終於可以出院回家繼續康復。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shǒushù hòu xiūyǎng le yī ge yuè, zhōngyú kěyǐ chūyuàn huíjiā jìxù kāngfù.
examples.english: She recuperated for a month after the surgery and was finally able to leave the hospital to continue her recovery at home.

semanticNote: Glove; mitten. 戴手套 (wear gloves), 橡皮手套 (rubber gloves), 工作手套 (work gloves), 棒球手套 (baseball glove), 拳擊手套 (boxing gloves). In Taiwan's mild winters, 保暖手套 (warm gloves) are used mainly in high-altitude areas or during cold spells. Medical 手套 (medical gloves) became universally familiar during the pandemic.

components.meaning: cover; case; sleeve; set; to cover

examples.chinese: 她去合歡山賞雪時，戴了厚手套、圍巾和帽子，把自己包得嚴嚴實實的。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù Héhuān shān shǎng xuě shí, dài le hòu shǒutào, wéijīn hé màozi, bǎ zìjǐ bāo de yán yán shíshí de.
examples.english: When she went to see the snow on Hehuanshan, she wore thick gloves, a scarf, and a hat, bundling herself up completely.

examples.chinese: 廚師在處理食材時必須戴上衛生手套，以確保食品的清潔衛生。
examples.pinyin: Chúshī zài chǔlǐ shícái shí bìxū dài shàng wèishēng shǒutào, yǐ quèbǎo shípǐn de qīngjié wèishēng.
examples.english: Chefs must wear sanitary gloves when handling food ingredients to ensure food hygiene.

semanticNote: Formalities; procedure; steps required to complete a process. 辦手續 (take care of the formalities), 入境手續 (immigration/entry procedures), 結婚手續 (marriage registration procedures), 繁瑣的手續 (complicated/burdensome procedures). A very common word in bureaucratic, legal, and administrative contexts in Taiwan. 簡化手續 (simplify procedures) is a common government promise.

examples.chinese: 出國前要先辦好簽證和護照等相關手續，以免到了機場才發現問題。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó qián yào xiān bàn hǎo qiānzhèng hé hùzhào děng xiāngguān shǒuxù, yǐmiǎn dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn wèntí.
examples.english: Before going abroad, complete all the necessary formalities like visas and passports in advance, so you don't discover problems at the airport.

examples.chinese: 在台灣辦理結婚登記的手續很簡單，只需攜帶雙方的身分證和印章前往戶政事務所。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān bànlǐ jiéhūn dēngjì de shǒuxù hěn jiǎndān, zhǐ xū xiédài shuāngfāng de shēnfènzhèng hé yīnzhāng qiánwǎng hùzhèng shìwùsuǒ.
examples.english: The procedure for registering a marriage in Taiwan is very simple — just bring both parties' ID cards and personal seals to the household registration office.

semanticNote: Finger. 食指 (index finger), 中指 (middle finger), 無名指 (ring finger), 小指 (little finger), 大拇指/拇指 (thumb). 手指頭 is the colloquial variant. 指紋 (fingerprint). In Taiwan, gestures are important: pointing with the index finger (食指) can be rude; pointing with the whole hand is more polite. 手指甲 (fingernail).

examples.chinese: 她彈鋼琴的手指非常靈活，能輕鬆彈奏高難度的樂曲。
examples.pinyin: Tā tán gāngqín de shǒuzhǐ fēicháng línghuó, néng qīngsōng tánzòu gāo nándù de yuèqǔ.
examples.english: Her fingers are very nimble on the piano — she can effortlessly play highly difficult pieces.

examples.chinese: 他不小心被廚房的刀割到了手指，血流個不停，只好去急診縫了幾針。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bèi chúfáng de dāo gēdào le shǒuzhǐ, xuèliú ge bùtíng, zhǐhǎo qù jízhěn fèng le jǐ zhēn.
examples.english: He accidentally cut his finger with a kitchen knife and couldn't stop the bleeding, so he had to go to the emergency room for stitches.

semanticNote: Head; chief; first; measure word for songs and poems. As noun/prefix: 首相 (prime minister), 首都 (capital city), 首席 (chief/lead, as in 首席執行官 CEO). As measure word: 一首歌 (a song), 一首詩 (a poem), 兩首歌 (two songs). The measure word sense is essential — always use 首 for poems and songs in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 她在卡拉OK點了三首歌，結果唱到大家都不想走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài kǎlāOK diǎn le sān shǒu gē, jiéguǒ chàng dào dàjiā dōu bù xiǎng zǒu le.
examples.english: She ordered three songs at karaoke and ended up singing until nobody wanted to leave.

examples.chinese: 這首詩是李白的名作，語言優美，意境深遠，至今仍廣為傳誦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī shì Lǐ Bái de míngzuò, yǔyán yōuměi, yìjìng shēnyuǎn, zhìjīn réng guǎngwéi chuánsòng.
examples.english: This poem is one of Li Bai's famous works — beautiful in language and deep in mood — and is still widely recited today.

semanticNote: Life span; life expectancy. 平均壽命 (average life expectancy), 延長壽命 (extend lifespan), 產品壽命 (product lifespan). Taiwan's average life expectancy is among the highest in Asia (about 80+ years), thanks to 全民健保 (National Health Insurance) and lifestyle factors. Also used for objects: 電池壽命 (battery life), 建築壽命 (building lifespan).

examples.chinese: 台灣人的平均壽命逐年提升，健保制度和生活品質的提升是主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén de píngjūn shòumìng zhúnián tíshēng, jiànbǎo zhìdù hé shēnghuó pǐnzhì de tíshēng shì zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: The average life expectancy of Taiwanese people is increasing year by year, with the health insurance system and improved quality of life being the main reasons.

examples.chinese: 這款電動車的電池壽命據廠商說可以達到十年，吸引不少消費者購買。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn diàndòngchē de diànchí shòumìng jù chǎngshāng shuō kěyǐ dádào shí nián, xīyǐn bùshǎo xiāofèizhě gòumǎi.
examples.english: The battery life of this electric vehicle is claimed by the manufacturer to last ten years, attracting many consumers to purchase it.

semanticNote: To be injured; to sustain injuries — physical harm from accidents, violence, or disasters. 受傷住院 (be injured and hospitalized), 輕傷/重傷 (lightly injured/seriously injured), 情感受傷 (emotionally hurt — figurative). Very common in news: 車禍受傷 (injured in a car accident). In Taiwan, 機車事故受傷 (motorcycle accident injuries) are a significant public health concern.

components.meaning: to receive; to suffer; to sustain

examples.chinese: 他在打球時不小心受傷，右腳踝扭傷，需要休息兩週。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dǎqiú shí bù xiǎoxīn shòushāng, yòu jiǎohuái niǔshāng, xūyào xiūxi liǎng zhōu.
examples.english: He accidentally got injured while playing ball — a sprained right ankle that needs two weeks of rest.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，救難人員清點受傷人數，共有十七人需要送往醫院治療。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, jiùnàn rényuán qīngdiǎn shòushāng rénshù, gòng yǒu shíqī rén xūyào sòng wǎng yīyuàn zhìliáo.
examples.english: After the typhoon, rescue personnel tallied up the injured — a total of seventeen people needed to be sent to hospital for treatment.

semanticNote: Bookshelf; bookcase. 書架上 (on the bookshelf), 整理書架 (tidy the bookshelf), 一排書架 (a row of bookshelves). In Taiwan's reading culture, 誠品書店 (Eslite Bookstore) is famous for its beautiful floor-to-ceiling bookshelves and 24-hour branches. 書架 can also be digital: 電子書架 (digital bookshelf on an e-reader).

examples.chinese: 她的書架上整整齊齊地排列著各種文學和歷史書籍，顯示出她廣泛的閱讀興趣。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shūjià shàng zhěngzhěngqíqí de páiliè zhe gèzhǒng wénxué hé lìshǐ shūjí, xiǎnshì chū tā guǎngfàn de yuèdú xìngqù.
examples.english: Her bookshelf is neatly lined with all kinds of literary and historical books, revealing her wide-ranging reading interests.

examples.chinese: 他去誠品花了整個下午在書架前翻翻看看，最後買了三本回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù Chéngpǐn huā le zhěnge xià wǔ zài shūjià qián fān fān kànkàn, zuìhòu mǎi le sān běn huíjiā.
examples.english: He spent the whole afternoon at Eslite browsing along the shelves and ended up buying three books to take home.

semanticNote: Comb; hairbrush. 梳子梳頭 (comb one's hair), 木梳 (wooden comb), 塑膠梳子 (plastic comb). The act of combing: 梳頭髮 (comb hair). In Taiwan temple culture, 梳子 sometimes appears as a ritual or gift item. A basic everyday object with a long history in Chinese culture — 木梳 (wooden combs) are traditional craft items.

examples.chinese: 她早上出門前一定會拿梳子把頭髮梳整齊，從不蓬頭垢面出現在人前。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǎoshàng chūmén qián yīdìng huì ná shūzi bǎ tóufa shū zhěngqí, cóng bù péngtóugòumiàn chūxiàn zài rén qián.
examples.english: She always combs her hair neatly before going out in the morning and never appears unkempt in front of others.

examples.chinese: 這把老木梳是奶奶傳給她的，雖然用了幾十年，表面已經磨得光滑發亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ lǎo mùshū shì nǎinai chuán gěi tā de, suīrán yòng le jǐshí nián, biǎomiàn yǐjīng mó de guānghuá fāliàng.
examples.english: This old wooden comb was passed down to her from her grandmother — even after decades of use, the surface is polished to a smooth shine.

semanticNote: Comfortable; cozy; snug — a pleasant state of physical or environmental ease. 舒適的環境 (comfortable environment), 住得很舒適 (live very comfortably), 舒適感 (sense of comfort), 舒適圈 (comfort zone — a very popular contemporary term). 舒適圈 (comfort zone) is widely discussed in Taiwan's self-development and career culture: 走出舒適圈 (step out of your comfort zone).

examples.chinese: 這間咖啡廳的環境非常舒適，燈光柔和、音樂輕鬆，很適合在這裡工作或閱讀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān kāfēitīng de huánjìng fēicháng shūshì, dēngguāng róuhé, yīnyuè qīngsōng, hěn shìhé zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò huò yuèdú.
examples.english: The atmosphere in this café is very comfortable — soft lighting, relaxed music, perfect for working or reading here.

examples.chinese: 她決定走出舒適圈，辭掉穩定的工作去創業，雖然有風險，但她覺得值得。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng zǒu chū shūshì quān, cí diào wěndìng de gōngzuò qù chuàngyè, suīrán yǒu fēngxiǎn, dàn tā juéde zhídé.
examples.english: She decided to step out of her comfort zone, quit her stable job, and start a business — risky, but she felt it was worth it.

semanticNote: To input; to enter (data); input; also to import (goods or resources). 輸入資料 (enter data), 鍵盤輸入 (keyboard input), 輸入法 (input method — IME, e.g., 注音輸入法, 倉頡, 拼音輸入法), 輸入能源 (import energy), 人才引進/輸入 (importing/bringing in talent). In Taiwan, 注音輸入法 and 倉頡輸入法 are traditional; 拼音輸入法 is increasingly used especially by younger users.

components.meaning: to transport; to lose; to transmit; to enter

examples.chinese: 請在空格中輸入您的使用者名稱和密碼，然後按下登入鍵。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài kōnggé zhōng shūrù nín de shǐyòngzhě míngchēng hé mìmǎ, ránhòu àn xià dēngrù jiàn.
examples.english: Please enter your username and password in the fields, then press the login button.

examples.chinese: 台灣有許多人習慣用注音輸入法打字，不太習慣換成拼音輸入法。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu xǔduō rén xíguàn yòng zhùyīn shūrùfǎ dǎzì, bù tài xíguàn huànchéng pīnyīn shūrùfǎ.
examples.english: Many people in Taiwan are used to typing with the zhuyin input method and find it hard to switch to a pinyin input method.

semanticNote: Vegetables; produce — edible plants. 新鮮蔬菜 (fresh vegetables), 有機蔬菜 (organic vegetables), 吃蔬菜 (eat vegetables). Taiwan produces a wide variety of vegetables year-round due to its climate diversity: 高山蔬菜 (highland vegetables from Alishan, Lishan) are prized for quality. 蔬菜攤 (vegetable stall at the market).

examples.chinese: 梨山出產的高山蔬菜因為氣候涼爽、日夜溫差大，品質特別好，甜度也較高。
examples.pinyin: Líshān chūchǎn de gāoshān shūcài yīnwèi qìhòu liángshuǎng, rìyè wēnchā dà, pǐnzhì tèbié hǎo, tiándù yě jiào gāo.
examples.english: The highland vegetables produced in Lishan are especially high quality and sweeter due to the cool climate and large day-night temperature differential.

examples.chinese: 她每天去菜市場買當天新鮮到貨的蔬菜，堅持讓家人吃最新鮮的食材。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān qù càishìchǎng mǎi dàngtiān xīnxiān dàohuò de shūcài, jiānchí ràng jiārén chī zuì xīnxiān de shícái.
examples.english: She goes to the market every day to buy that day's fresh vegetables, insisting that her family eat the freshest ingredients.

semanticNote: Proficient; skilled; practiced — having mastery of a skill through experience and repetition. 熟練的技術 (skilled technique), 操作熟練 (proficient operation), 越來越熟練 (getting more and more proficient). Unlike 擅長 (excel at something by talent), 熟練 emphasizes repeated practice leading to smooth, confident execution. Common in workplace and skills training contexts.

examples.chinese: 她在這家工廠工作了五年，操作機器的技術非常熟練，速度也很快。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè jiā gōngchǎng gōngzuò le wǔ nián, cāozuò jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn, sùdù yě hěn kuài.
examples.english: She's worked at this factory for five years — her technique for operating the machines is very proficient and her speed is fast.

examples.chinese: 剛開始學習時進度很慢，但只要持續練習，就能越來越熟練。
examples.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ xuéxí shí jìndù hěn màn, dàn zhǐyào chíxù liànxí, jiù néng yuèlái yuè shúliàn.
examples.english: Progress is slow when you first start learning, but as long as you keep practicing, you'll get more and more proficient.

semanticNote: To belong to; to be part of; to pertain to — expressing ownership, membership, or classification. 這本書屬於我 (this book belongs to me), 台灣屬於亞太地區 (Taiwan belongs to the Asia-Pacific region), 這個問題屬於個人隱私 (this matter pertains to personal privacy). Less personal than 是…的 (is...); 屬於 implies formal membership or categorization.

components.meaning: to belong to; category; to be part of

examples.chinese: 這塊土地依法屬於原住民族的傳統領域，不得任意開發。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài tǔdì yī fǎ shǔyú yuánzhùmín zú de chuántǒng lǐngyù, bùdé rènyì kāifā.
examples.english: This land legally belongs to the indigenous peoples' traditional territory and cannot be developed at will.

examples.chinese: 他的新專輯屬於流行搖滾風格，兼具旋律感和實驗精神。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xīn zhuānjí shǔyú liúxíng yáogǔn fēnggé, jiān jù xuánlǜ gǎn hé shíyàn jīngshén.
examples.english: His new album belongs to the pop-rock genre, combining both melodic sensibility and an experimental spirit.

semanticNote: Computer mouse — the pointing device used to control a computer cursor. 無線鼠標 (wireless mouse), 光學鼠標 (optical mouse), 點擊鼠標 (click the mouse). In Taiwan, 滑鼠 (huáshǔ) is the preferred term for computer mouse; 鼠標 (shǔbiāo) is the mainland Chinese term that has entered usage. Both are understood. 人體工學滑鼠 (ergonomic mouse).

examples.chinese: 他長時間使用滑鼠，手腕開始出現疼痛，醫生建議他換成符合人體工學的鼠標。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángshíjiān shǐyòng huáshǔ, shǒuwàn kāishǐ chūxiàn téngtòng, yīshēng jiànyì tā huànchéng fúhé réntǐ gōngxué de shǔbiāo.
examples.english: After prolonged mouse use his wrist started hurting, and the doctor recommended he switch to an ergonomic mouse.

examples.chinese: 滑鼠沒電了嗎？你可以試試把電池換一下，或者換一條USB線看看。
examples.pinyin: Huáshǔ méi diàn le ma? Nǐ kěyǐ shìshì bǎ diànchí huàn yīxià, huòzhě huàn yī tiáo USB xiàn kànkàn.
examples.english: Is the mouse out of battery? You can try replacing the batteries, or swap out the USB cable and see.

semanticNote: Three readings: (1) shù — number, numeral (整數 whole number; 數字 numeral); (2) shǔ — to count (數一數 count them; 數不清 innumerable); (3) shuò — frequently, repeatedly (rare at this level, in set phrases like 數見不鮮 commonplace). The shù/shǔ distinction is important: 數字 (shù — numerals) vs. 數一數 (shǔ — count). Both are very common.

examples.chinese: 她從小數學就很好，對數字有特別敏銳的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo shùxué jiù hěn hǎo, duì shùzì yǒu tèbié mǐnruì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: She's been good at math since childhood and has an especially sharp sense for numbers.

examples.chinese: 老師讓孩子們把籃子裡的蘋果一個一個地數清楚，再告訴她總共有幾個。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng háizi men bǎ lánzi lǐ de píngguǒ yī ge yī ge de shǔ qīngchǔ, zài gàosù tā zǒnggòng yǒu jǐ ge.
examples.english: The teacher had the children count the apples in the basket one by one and then tell her the total.

semanticNote: Data; numbers; statistics. 數據分析 (data analysis), 大數據 (big data), 數據中心 (data center), 數據安全 (data security). In Taiwan's tech and government sectors, 數據 is central to policy decisions, business intelligence, and research. 個人資料/數據保護 (personal data protection) is governed by 個人資料保護法 (Personal Data Protection Act). 據數據顯示 (according to data shows) is a common academic/news phrase.

components.meaning: evidence; data; to occupy; according to

examples.chinese: 根據最新數據，台灣的電動機車市佔率已超過百分之十五。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zuìxīn shùjù, Táiwān de diàndòng jīchē shì zhàn lǜ yǐ chāoguò bǎifēnzhī shíwǔ.
examples.english: According to the latest data, electric scooters' market share in Taiwan has already exceeded 15%.

examples.chinese: 這家公司建立了完整的顧客數據庫，幫助行銷團隊進行精準的消費者分析。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jiànlì le wánzhěng de gùkè shùjùkù, bāngzhù xíngxiāo tuánduì jìnxíng jīngzhǔn de xiāofèizhě fēnxī.
examples.english: This company has built a comprehensive customer database to help the marketing team conduct precise consumer analysis.

semanticNote: Digital — relating to digital technology. 數碼相機 (digital camera), 數碼產品 (digital products). In Taiwan, 數位 (shùwèi) is the standard official and common term for 'digital' (數位轉型 — digital transformation, 數位部 — Ministry of Digital Affairs), while 數碼 (shùmǎ) is the mainland form that appears in some products and brand names. Both are understood.

examples.chinese: 台灣成立了數位部，專責推動政府和社會各面向的數位轉型。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān chénglì le Shùwèi bù, zhuānzé tuīdòng zhèngfǔ hé shèhuì gèfāngxiàng de shùwèi zhuǎnxíng.
examples.english: Taiwan established the Ministry of Digital Affairs, specifically responsible for promoting digital transformation across government and society.

examples.chinese: 智慧型手機的普及讓傳統數碼相機的市場大幅萎縮。
examples.pinyin: Zhìhuìxíng shǒujī de pǔjí ràng chuántǒng shùmǎ xiàngjī de shìchǎng dàfú wěisuō.
examples.english: The proliferation of smartphones has caused the market for traditional digital cameras to shrink considerably.

semanticNote: To fall down; to slip and fall; to tumble. 不小心摔倒 (accidentally fall), 摔倒受傷 (fall and get injured), 老人容易摔倒 (elderly people are prone to falling). Very common — simple physical falls. 跌倒 (diédǎo) is a near-synonym; 摔倒 often implies a more sudden/forceful fall, while 跌倒 can be gentler. 防跌 (fall prevention) is a major geriatric concern in Taiwan.

components.meaning: to fall; to throw; to smash
to fall; to collapse; upside down

examples.chinese: 地板剛拖完還很滑，她一不小心摔倒了，腿上瘀了一大塊。
examples.pinyin: Dìbǎn gāng tuō wán hái hěn huá, tā yī bù xiǎoxīn shuāidǎo le, tuǐ shàng yū le yī dà kuài.
examples.english: The floor was still slippery right after mopping — she slipped and fell, leaving a large bruise on her leg.

examples.chinese: 老人家行走時要特別小心，下雨天路面濕滑，很容易摔倒受傷。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorénjiā xíngzǒu shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn, xià yǔ tiān lùmiàn shī huá, hěn róngyì shuāidǎo shòushāng.
examples.english: Elderly people should be especially careful when walking — rainy days make surfaces slippery and it's easy to fall and get hurt.

semanticNote: To throw; to fling; to swing; to shake off. 甩手 (fling the hand; wash one's hands of something), 甩掉 (shake off; get rid of), 甩尾巴 (wag a tail). Colloquially: 甩了他/她 (dump him/her — break up with), 甩鍋 (pass the buck — throw the wok/blame onto someone else). 甩鍋 has become very popular in Taiwan social and political discourse.

components.meaning: to fling; to throw; to swing; to dump

examples.chinese: 他運球突破防線後，一個急轉身甩開了防守球員，直接上籃得分。
examples.pinyin: Tā yùnqiú tūpò fángsian hòu, yī ge jí zhuǎn shēn shuǎi kāi le fángshǒu qiúyuán, zhíjiē shàng lán défen.
examples.english: After dribbling through the defense, he did a quick spin to shake off the defender and went straight up for the layup.

examples.chinese: 出了這麼大的錯誤，主管不應該甩鍋給下屬，而應該承擔責任。
examples.pinyin: Chū le zhème dà de cuòwù, zhǔguǎn bù yīnggāi shuǎiguō gěi xiàshǔ, ér yīnggāi chéngdān zérèn.
examples.english: After such a major mistake, the manager shouldn't pass the buck to subordinates but should take responsibility.

semanticNote: Both sides; both parties — the two participants in a negotiation, agreement, conflict, or relationship. 雙方同意 (both parties agree), 雙方簽約 (both parties sign), 兩岸雙方 (both sides of the strait), 雙方家長 (both families). Common in legal, diplomatic, and interpersonal contexts. 三方 (trilateral) and 多方 (multilateral) are extensions.

examples.chinese: 合約在雙方確認無誤後正式簽署，合作關係正式確立。
examples.pinyin: Héyuē zài shuāngfāng quèrèn wúwù hòu zhèngshì qiānshǔ, hézuò guānxi zhèngshì quèlì.
examples.english: The contract was formally signed after both parties confirmed there were no errors, officially establishing the cooperative relationship.

examples.chinese: 這場球賽雙方實力相當，從頭打到尾都無法拉開差距。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng qiúsài shuāngfāng shílì xiāngdāng, cóng tóu dǎ dào wěi dōu wúfǎ lā kāi chājù.
examples.english: Both teams in this match were evenly matched — from start to finish neither side could pull ahead.

semanticNote: Tax. 所得稅 (income tax), 營業稅 (business tax/VAT), 關稅 (customs duty/tariff), 遺產稅 (inheritance tax), 繳稅 (pay tax), 報稅 (file taxes). In Taiwan, individual income tax filing season is May each year (報稅季). Taiwan's tax system is administered by the 財政部國稅局 (National Taxation Bureau). 節稅/避稅 (tax planning/avoidance) vs. 逃稅 (tax evasion).

examples.chinese: 台灣每年五月是個人綜合所得稅的申報期，很多人需要補繳稅或等待退稅。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān měinián wǔ yuè shì gèrén zōnghé suǒdéshuì de shēnbào qī, hěnduō rén xūyào bǔ jiǎo shuì huò děngdài tuì shuì.
examples.english: May each year is personal income tax filing season in Taiwan — many people need to pay additional tax or wait for a refund.

examples.chinese: 這家公司的稅務問題非常複雜，需要專業的稅務顧問協助處理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de shuìwù wèntí fēicháng fùzá, xūyào zhuānyè de shuìwù gùwèn xiézhù chǔlǐ.
examples.english: This company's tax issues are very complex and require a professional tax consultant to assist with handling them.

semanticNote: Can't say for sure; perhaps; maybe — expressing uncertainty about a possibility. 說不定他已經到了 (maybe he's already arrived), 說不定會下雨 (it might rain — can't be sure). More colloquial and conversational than 也許 (perhaps) or 可能 (possibly). The literal meaning is 'can't say for certain' — implying something is possible but unknown. Often goes at the start of a clause.

examples.chinese: 說不定他只是塞車所以遲到了，先等一等再說吧。
examples.pinyin: Shuōbudìng tā zhǐshì sāichē suǒyǐ chídào le, xiān děng yī děng zài shuō ba.
examples.english: Maybe he's just stuck in traffic and running late — let's wait a bit before assuming anything.

examples.chinese: 天氣預報說明天可能下雨，說不定又是一個颱風要來了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān kěnéng xià yǔ, shuōbudìng yòu shì yī ge táifēng yào lái le.
examples.english: The weather forecast says it might rain tomorrow — maybe there's another typhoon coming.

semanticNote: To persuade; to convince — using words or reasoning to change someone's mind. 說服力 (persuasiveness; power of persuasion), 難以說服 (hard to persuade), 被說服了 (was convinced). Implies a successful outcome — unlike 勸 (advise/urge, not necessarily successful). 說服力強 (highly persuasive). In legal/negotiation contexts: 說服陪審團 (convince the jury).

components.meaning: to obey; to submit; to convince

examples.chinese: 他花了一整個下午說服媽媽讓他去參加暑假的登山活動。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le yī zhěnge xiàwǔ shuōfú māma ràng tā qù cānyù shǔjià de dēngshān huódòng.
examples.english: He spent the whole afternoon persuading his mom to let him join the summer mountaineering activity.

examples.chinese: 這份報告的論點很有說服力，連一直反對的委員最後也被說服了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de lùndiǎn hěn yǒu shuōfúlì, lián yīzhí fǎnduì de wěiyuán zuìhòu yě bèi shuōfú le.
examples.english: The arguments in this report are very persuasive — even the committee members who had been opposed were ultimately convinced.

semanticNote: Silk — the luxurious fabric made from silkworm cocoons. 絲綢之路 (Silk Road), 真絲綢 (real silk), 絲綢製品 (silk products). Historically, silk was China's most famous export and defines the Silk Road trade routes. In Taiwan, 絲巾 (silk scarf) and 絲綢旗袍 (silk qipao) are traditional luxury items. 人造絲 (artificial silk/rayon) is an imitation.

examples.chinese: 她買了一條真絲綢圍巾送給媽媽當母親節禮物，手感柔軟光滑，非常高雅。
examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yī tiáo zhēn sīchóu wéijīn sòng gěi māma dāng Mǔqīnjié lǐwù, shǒugǎn róuruǎn guānghuá, fēicháng gāoyǎ.
examples.english: She bought a real silk scarf to give to her mom for Mother's Day — soft and smooth to the touch, very elegant.

examples.chinese: 古代的絲綢之路不只是貿易的通道，也是東西方文化交流的橋樑。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài de Sīchóu zhī lù bù zhǐshì màoyì de tōngdào, yě shì dōngxī fāng wénhuà jiāoliú de qiáoliáng.
examples.english: The ancient Silk Road was not only a trade route but also a bridge for cultural exchange between East and West.

semanticNote: The slightest; a bit; at all — used in negative constructions to mean 'not the slightest bit; not at all'. 絲毫不差 (not off by a hair's breadth — exact), 絲毫不介意 (don't mind in the least), 絲毫沒有 (there isn't even a trace of). Always in emphasis — either perfect precision (絲毫不差) or complete absence (絲毫不猶豫 — without the slightest hesitation). Very literary.

components.meaning: fine hair; the smallest unit; not in the least

examples.chinese: 她面對眾多批評，絲毫不受影響，依然堅持自己的立場。
examples.pinyin: Tā miànduì zhòngduō pīpíng, sīháo bù shòu yǐngxiǎng, yīrán jiānchí zìjǐ de lìchǎng.
examples.english: Facing a barrage of criticism, she was not affected in the slightest and continued to hold to her position.

examples.chinese: 這篇文章絲毫沒有誇大其詞，每一個數據都有可靠的來源佐證。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng sīháo méiyǒu kuādà qící, měi yī ge shùjù dōu yǒu kěkào de láiyuán zuǒzhèng.
examples.english: This article doesn't exaggerate even the slightest — every piece of data is backed by a reliable source.

semanticNote: Private (citizen); personal; individual — relating to one individual rather than the public or an organization. 私人企業 (private enterprise), 私人信件 (personal letters), 私人事務 (personal affairs), 私人時間 (personal time). 私人化 (privatization in a personal sense). Contrasts with 公共 (public) and 國營/官方 (state-owned/official). 私人的事不要問 (don't ask about private matters).

examples.chinese: 這是他的私人信件，請不要未經同意就打開來看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì tā de sīrén xìnjiàn, qǐng bùyào wèijīng tóngyì jiù dǎkāi lái kàn.
examples.english: These are his personal letters — please don't open them without permission.

examples.chinese: 她在公私之間分得很清楚，工作時間絕不處理私人事務。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōng sī zhījiān fēn de hěn qīngchǔ, gōngzuò shíjiān jué bù chǔlǐ sīrén shìwù.
examples.english: She keeps a very clear line between public and private — she absolutely does not handle personal matters during work hours.

semanticNote: To reflect on; to think carefully about; thoughtful consideration. 深入思考 (think deeply), 獨立思考 (think independently), 思考能力 (thinking ability), 批判性思考 (critical thinking). More deliberate and structured than 想 (think, casual). 思考 implies effortful, reflective cognition. 批判性思考 is a major educational emphasis in Taiwan's curriculum reform.

components.meaning: to consider; to examine; to test

examples.chinese: 在做重大決定之前，一定要給自己足夠的時間好好思考。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuò zhòngdà juédìng zhīqián, yīdìng yào gěi zìjǐ zúgòu de shíjiān hǎohǎo sīkǎo.
examples.english: Before making a major decision, you must give yourself enough time to think it through carefully.

examples.chinese: 這門課訓練學生獨立思考，而不是只接受老師給的標準答案。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè xùnliàn xuéshēng dúlì sīkǎo, ér bù shì zhǐ jiēshòu lǎoshī gěi de biāozhǔn dá'àn.
examples.english: This course trains students to think independently, rather than just accepting the standard answers given by the teacher.

semanticNote: Thought; thinking; ideology; ideas. 思想自由 (freedom of thought), 進步的思想 (progressive ideas), 孔子思想 (Confucian thought), 思想體系 (system of thought/ideology). More formal and philosophical than 想法 (ideas, casual). In political contexts: 思想控制 (thought control). Taiwan's intellectual life features lively 思想辯論 (ideological debates) on democracy, identity, and values.

examples.chinese: 台灣的民主化過程伴隨著思想的解放，人們開始自由表達各種不同的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de mínzhǔhuà guòchéng bànsuí zhe sīxiǎng de jiěfàng, rénmen kāishǐ zìyóu biǎodá gèzhǒng bùtóng de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: Taiwan's democratization was accompanied by a liberation of thought, as people began freely expressing diverse viewpoints.

examples.chinese: 儒家思想對台灣的家庭觀念和教育文化仍有深遠的影響。
examples.pinyin: Rújiā sīxiǎng duì Táiwān de jiātíng guānniàn hé jiàoyù wénhuà réng yǒu shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Confucian thought still has a profound influence on family values and educational culture in Taiwan.

semanticNote: To tear (something) — ripping paper, fabric, or other material by pulling. 撕碎 (tear to pieces), 撕掉 (tear off), 撕票 (kill a hostage — 'tear the ticket', old gangster term), 撕破臉 (have a falling out — 'tear the face', lose all pretense of civility). 撕 implies a tearing motion; 剪 (cut with scissors) and 割 (cut with a blade) are distinct.

examples.chinese: 她氣憤地把那封信撕成碎片，扔進了垃圾桶。
examples.pinyin: Tā qìfèn de bǎ nà fēng xìn sī chéng suìpiàn, rēng jìn le lèsètǒng.
examples.english: In anger, she tore the letter to pieces and threw it in the trash.

examples.chinese: 包裝上有一條撕開線，順著這條線輕輕一撕就能開封。
examples.pinyin: Bāozhuāng shàng yǒu yī tiáo sī kāi xiàn, shùnzhe zhè tiáo xiàn qīngqīng yī sī jiù néng kāifēng.
examples.english: There's a tear-open line on the packaging — just gently tear along it and it opens.

semanticNote: It seems; as if; seemingly — hedging a statement with uncertainty. 似乎有點不對勁 (something seems off), 他似乎知道了 (he seems to know), 似乎沒有人在 (it seems like no one is there). More formal than 好像 (seems like, casual). Common in academic writing, formal reports, and literary prose. 似乎 expresses inference based on indirect evidence.

examples.chinese: 她說話的語氣似乎有些不對，但我也說不清楚哪裡不對。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de yǔqì sìhū yǒuxiē bù duì, dàn wǒ yě shuō bù qīngchǔ nǎlǐ bù duì.
examples.english: Her tone of voice seemed somehow off, but I couldn't quite put my finger on what it was.

examples.chinese: 今天的會議氣氛似乎比平常嚴肅了許多，不知道發生了什麼事。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de huìyì qìfēn sìhū bǐ píngcháng yánsù le xǔduō, bù zhīdào fāshēng le shénme shì.
examples.english: The atmosphere at today's meeting seemed much more serious than usual — I wonder what happened.

semanticNote: To search; to look for — scanning an area or database for something. 搜索引擎 (search engine — Google, etc.), 網路搜索 (internet search), 搜索結果 (search results), 警方搜索 (police search/raid). In digital life: 用Google搜索 (search with Google) is universal in Taiwan, though 搜尋 (sōuxún) is the more standard Taiwan Chinese term for 'search'. 搜索和逮捕令 (search and arrest warrant).

components.meaning: to search; to look for; to rummage
to search; rope; chain; to demand

examples.chinese: 她在搜索引擎輸入關鍵字，很快就找到了她想要的資料。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài sōusuǒ yǐnqíng shūrù guānjiàncí, hěn kuài jiù zhǎodào le tā xiǎng yào de zīliào.
examples.english: She typed the keywords into the search engine and quickly found the information she was looking for.

examples.chinese: 警察接獲報案後，立即展開大規模搜索，尋找失蹤的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá jiēhuò bào'àn hòu, lìjí zhǎnkāi dàguīmó sōusuǒ, xúnzhǎo shīzōng de háizi.
examples.english: After receiving the report, police immediately launched a large-scale search to find the missing child.

semanticNote: Dormitory; student housing; barracks. 學生宿舍 (student dormitory), 住宿舍 (live in a dorm), 男女生宿舍 (male/female dorms). In Taiwan's universities, 宿舍 is competitive — spots are limited and allocated by lottery or academic year. 宿舍規定 (dormitory rules). Company dormitories (員工宿舍) are provided by some manufacturers, especially in export processing zones.

components.meaning: to lodge; overnight stay; old; dormitory

examples.chinese: 她大一抽到了學校宿舍的籤，不用在外面找房子，省了很多生活費。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàyī chōu dào le xuéxiào sùshè de qiān, bù yòng zài wàimiàn zhǎo fángzi, shěng le hěnduō shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: She won the lottery for a university dorm room in her first year, so she didn't have to find housing off-campus and saved a lot on living expenses.

examples.chinese: 宿舍裡住著來自全台各地的室友，大家背景不同，相處起來特別有趣。
examples.pinyin: Sùshè lǐ zhùzhe lái zì quán Tái gèdì de shìyǒu, dàjiā bèijǐng bùtóng, xiāngchǔ qǐlái tèbié yǒuqù.
examples.english: The dormitory was full of roommates from all over Taiwan — everyone had different backgrounds, which made living together especially interesting.

english: on one's person; with one; carried along
semanticNote: Always modifies actions involving things you carry or take with you personally. 隨身攜帶 (carry on one's person) is the standard collocation. In Taiwan, commonly seen on notices like 隨身行李 (carry-on baggage) at 桃園機場.

examples.chinese: 出門前記得把健保卡隨身帶著。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián jìdé bǎ jiànbǎokǎ suíshēn dàizhe.
examples.english: Remember to carry your health insurance card with you before going out.

examples.chinese: 他習慣隨身帶一本小筆記本，隨時記下靈感。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn suíshēn dài yī běn xiǎo bǐjìběn, suíshí jìxià línggǎn.
examples.english: He makes a habit of carrying a small notebook with him to jot down ideas at any moment.

english: at any time; whenever; as needed
semanticNote: Indicates availability or occurrence without constraint of time. Pairs naturally with 可以, 都, 歡迎. Compare 隨手 (without extra effort) — 隨時 is about timing, 隨手 is about convenience of action.

examples.chinese: 如果有問題，隨時可以打電話給我。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu wèntí, suíshí kěyǐ dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ.
examples.english: If you have questions, feel free to call me at any time.

examples.chinese: 颱風季節天氣變化快，出門前隨時注意中央氣象局的預報。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng jìjié tiānqì biànhuà kuài, chūmén qián suíshí zhùyì zhōngyāng qìxiàngjú de yùbào.
examples.english: During typhoon season the weather changes quickly — always check the Central Weather Bureau forecast before heading out.

english: without extra trouble; conveniently; while one is at it
semanticNote: Describes doing something casually or incidentally with minimal effort — the action requires no special detour. Common in polite requests: 隨手關燈 (turn off the light when you leave). Distinct from 順便 (while you're at it, en route to somewhere).

examples.chinese: 離開辦公室時，請隨手把燈關掉。
examples.pinyin: Líkāi bàngōngshì shí, qǐng suíshǒu bǎ dēng guāndiào.
examples.english: When you leave the office, please turn off the lights on your way out.

examples.chinese: 他隨手把外套丟在椅子上，結果找了半天才想起來。
examples.pinyin: Tā suíshǒu bǎ wàitào diū zài yǐzi shàng, jiéguǒ zhǎole bàntiān cái xiǎng qǐlái.
examples.english: He carelessly tossed his jacket on a chair and then spent ages trying to remember where he'd put it.

english: broken; shattered; to break into pieces; smashed
semanticNote: Functions as both adjective (碎片 — fragments) and result complement (打碎 — smash to pieces, 摔碎 — drop and shatter). In Taiwan, 碎碎念 (mutter endlessly) is a colloquial expression for nagging.

examples.chinese: 杯子從桌上滑落，摔得粉碎。
examples.pinyin: Bēizi cóng zhuō shàng huá luò, shuāi de fěnsuì.
examples.english: The cup slipped off the table and shattered into pieces.

examples.chinese: 地震後窗戶的玻璃全都碎了，地板上一片碎玻璃。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu chuānghù de bōli quán dōu suì le, dìbǎn shàng yī piàn suì bōli.
examples.english: After the earthquake all the window glass was shattered, the floor covered in broken glass.

english: to lose; to suffer loss; loss (financial or otherwise)
semanticNote: Covers both the verb (suffer a loss) and the noun (the loss itself). Often collocates with 造成損失 (cause losses), 彌補損失 (make up for losses). In business contexts, 損失慘重 (suffer heavy losses) is a set phrase.

examples.chinese: 這場颱風造成農業損失超過十億元。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng táifēng zàochéng nóngyè sǔnshī chāoguò shí yì yuán.
examples.english: This typhoon caused agricultural losses exceeding one billion NT dollars.

examples.chinese: 公司因為合約糾紛蒙受了不小的損失。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yīnwèi héyuē jiūfēn méngshòule bù xiǎo de sǔnshī.
examples.english: The company suffered considerable losses due to a contract dispute.

english: to shorten; to cut down; to reduce (time/distance)
semanticNote: Takes a time or distance object: 縮短時間, 縮短距離, 縮短差距 (narrow the gap). The opposite is 延長 (extend). Common in Taiwan policy and infrastructure contexts: 高鐵縮短了南北的距離.

examples.chinese: 高鐵大幅縮短了台北到高雄的通勤時間。
examples.pinyin: Gāotiě dàfú suōduǎnle Táiběi dào Gāoxióng de tōngqín shíjiān.
examples.english: The high-speed rail significantly shortened the commute time between Taipei and Kaohsiung.

examples.chinese: 我們改進了流程，把審核時間從兩週縮短到三天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gǎijìnle liúchéng, bǎ shěnhé shíjiān cóng liǎng zhōu suōduǎn dào sān tiān.
examples.english: We improved the process and shortened the review time from two weeks to three days.

english: place; that which; (mw for houses/institutions); particle marking noun phrases from verbs
semanticNote: Three main uses: (1) measure word for buildings/institutions — 一所學校, 一所醫院; (2) particle in 所+V structure nominalizing a verb — 所說的話 (what was said), 所做的事 (what was done); (3) in 所以 (therefore). The 所+V pattern is formal/written register.

examples.chinese: 他所說的話讓在場的每個人都感到震驚。
examples.pinyin: Tā suǒ shuō de huà ràng zàichǎng de měi gè rén dōu gǎndào zhènjīng.
examples.english: What he said shocked everyone present.

examples.chinese: 這一所小學已有五十年歷史，是社區的重要地標。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yī suǒ xiǎoxué yǐ yǒu wǔshí nián lìshǐ, shì shèqū de zhòngyào dìbiāo.
examples.english: This elementary school has a fifty-year history and is an important landmark in the community.

semanticNote: Noun (門鎖 — door lock) and verb (鎖門 — lock the door). In digital contexts, 鎖定 means to lock/freeze (a screen, position, account). 銷 (xiāo, to melt/cancel) is a different character despite similar sound.

examples.chinese: 出門前記得把大門鎖好，台北有些社區最近有小偷。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián jìdé bǎ dàmén suǒ hǎo, Táiběi yǒuxiē shèqū zuìjìn yǒu xiǎotōu.
examples.english: Remember to lock the front door before going out — some Taipei neighborhoods have had break-ins recently.

examples.chinese: 他找了半天才發現鑰匙還插在鎖上。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎole bàntiān cái fāxiàn yàoshi hái chā zài suǒ shàng.
examples.english: He searched for ages before realizing the key was still in the lock.

english: steps; flight of steps; (fig.) a face-saving way out of a difficult situation
semanticNote: Literal sense: stone/concrete steps leading up to an entrance. Extended sense: 給對方一個台階下 (give the other party a graceful exit) — crucial in Taiwan's face-conscious social culture. The figurative use is equally common as the literal.

examples.chinese: 廟門前有一排台階，上去就是香客休息的廣場。
examples.pinyin: Miào mén qián yǒu yī pái táijiē, shàngqù jiùshì xiāngkè xiūxi de guǎngchǎng.
examples.english: In front of the temple gate there's a row of steps leading up to a plaza where worshippers rest.

examples.chinese: 談判陷入僵局，雙方都需要一個台階才能繼續對話。
examples.pinyin: Tánpàn xiànrù jiāngjú, shuāngfāng dōu xūyào yī gè táijiē cái néng jìxù duìhuà.
examples.english: The negotiations hit a deadlock — both sides needed a face-saving way out before talks could continue.

english: tai chi; taijiquan (Chinese martial art and exercise system)
semanticNote: A traditional Chinese internal martial art emphasizing slow, flowing movements. In Taiwan, extremely popular as morning exercise, especially among older adults in public parks (公園). 打太極拳 is the standard verb collocation.

examples.chinese: 每天清晨，大安森林公園裡都有人在打太極拳。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān qīngchén, Dà'ān sēnlín gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu rén zài dǎ tàijíquán.
examples.english: Every morning there are people practicing tai chi in Da'an Forest Park.

examples.chinese: 阿嬤說打太極拳讓她的關節不再那麼痛了。
examples.pinyin: Āmā shuō dǎ tàijíquán ràng tā de guānjié bù zài nàme tòng le.
examples.english: Grandma says practicing tai chi has made her joints much less painful.

semanticNote: Polite/formal term for another man's wife or for addressing a married woman. One's own wife is more commonly called 老婆 (colloquial) or 內人 (formal self-reference). 太太 alone can mean 'Mrs. [surname]'. Register is respectful rather than intimate.

examples.chinese: 王先生，您太太打電話來說晚餐不用等她了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng, nín tàitai dǎ diànhuà lái shuō wǎncān búyòng děng tā le.
examples.english: Mr. Wang, your wife called to say not to wait for her for dinner.

examples.chinese: 李太太在社區很熱心，常常幫鄰居處理大小事。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ tàitai zài shèqū hěn rèxīn, chángcháng bāng línjū chǔlǐ dàxiǎo shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Li is very active in the community and often helps neighbors with all sorts of matters.

english: to negotiate; to hold talks; negotiation
semanticNote: Formal term for structured negotiations between parties, especially in political, labor, or business contexts. 談判桌 (negotiating table) is a common metonym. In Taiwan, frequently appears in labor-management (勞資談判) and cross-strait (兩岸談判) contexts.

examples.chinese: 工會和資方經過三輪談判，終於達成協議。
examples.pinyin: Gōnghuì hé zīfāng jīngguò sān lún tánpàn, zhōngyú dáchéng xiéyì.
examples.english: After three rounds of negotiations, the union and management finally reached an agreement.

examples.chinese: 這次貿易談判的結果將影響兩岸的經貿關係。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì màoyì tánpàn de jiéguǒ jiāng yǐngxiǎng liǎng'àn de jīngmào guānxi.
examples.english: The outcome of these trade negotiations will affect cross-strait economic and trade relations.

semanticNote: Positive descriptor for someone who speaks openly without concealment. Synonymous with 直率 and 坦白, but 坦率 is slightly more formal. In Taiwan's indirect communication culture, being described as 坦率 is a compliment implying trustworthiness.

examples.chinese: 她為人坦率，有什麼說什麼，從不拐彎抹角。
examples.pinyin: Tā wéirén tǎnshuài, yǒu shéme shuō shéme, cóng bù guǎiwānmòjiǎo.
examples.english: She is frank by nature — she says what she means and never beats around the bush.

examples.chinese: 坦率地說，這個方案還有不少需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Tǎnshuài de shuō, zhège fāng'àn hái yǒu bùshǎo xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Frankly speaking, this proposal still has quite a few areas that need improvement.

english: scalding hot; to scald; to burn; to iron (clothes); to perm (hair)
semanticNote: Multiple uses: (1) describe something dangerously hot — 湯很燙 (the soup is scalding); (2) to scald someone — 被熱水燙到; (3) to iron clothes — 燙衣服; (4) to perm hair — 燙頭髮/燙髮. Collocates with 熱水 (hot water) and 衣服 (clothes) frequently in daily life.

examples.chinese: 這碗熱湯剛上桌，小心燙！
examples.pinyin: Zhè wǎn rètāng gāng shàng zhuō, xiǎoxīn tàng!
examples.english: This bowl of hot soup just arrived — careful, it's scalding!

examples.chinese: 她去髮廊燙了個捲髮，整個人看起來煥然一新。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù fàláng tàngle gè juǎnfà, zhěnggè rén kàn qǐlái huànrányīxīn.
examples.english: She went to the salon and got her hair permed — she looks like a completely new person.

english: to flee; to escape; to run away
semanticNote: Base verb for fleeing; typically implies urgency or fear. Common compounds: 逃跑 (flee/bolt), 逃避 (evade/shirk), 逃脫 (escape/break free), 逃學 (skip school/truant), 逃稅 (evade taxes). All carry a sense of evasion.

examples.chinese: 火災發生時，大家都從安全門逃了出去。
examples.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng shí, dàjiā dōu cóng ānquánmén táo le chūqù.
examples.english: When the fire broke out, everyone escaped through the emergency exit.

examples.chinese: 那隻鸚鵡趁主人開籠時逃了出去，在附近的公園被發現。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī yīngwǔ chèn zhǔrén kāi lóng shí táo le chūqù, zài fùjìn de gōngyuán bèi fāxiàn.
examples.english: The parrot escaped when its owner opened the cage and was found in a nearby park.

english: to evade; to escape from; to shirk; to avoid (responsibility)
semanticNote: Stronger psychological connotation than plain 逃 — implies deliberately avoiding a duty, problem, or confrontation. 逃避責任 (shirk responsibility) and 逃避現實 (escape from reality) are fixed collocations. More negative in register than 躲避.

examples.chinese: 逃避問題解決不了問題，反而會讓事情越來越糟。
examples.pinyin: Táobì wèntí jiějué bù liǎo wèntí, fǎn'ér huì ràng shìqíng yuèláiyuè zāo.
examples.english: Evading a problem doesn't solve it — it only makes things worse.

examples.chinese: 他一遇到壓力就用打遊戲來逃避，這習慣得改。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī yùdào yālì jiù yòng dǎ yóuxì lái táobì, zhè xíguàn děi gǎi.
examples.english: Whenever he's under stress he retreats into gaming to escape — that habit needs to change.

semanticNote: The peach is deeply symbolic in Chinese culture: longevity (壽桃), spring (桃花), and romance (桃花運 — romantic luck). In Taiwan, 水蜜桃 (juicy peaches from 拉拉山 or 梨山) are famous summer produce. 桃園 (Peach Garden) — a major city in Taiwan — takes its name from the fruit.

examples.chinese: 拉拉山的水蜜桃又甜又多汁，每年產季都吸引大批遊客。
examples.pinyin: Lālāshān de shuǐmìtáo yòu tián yòu duōzhī, měi nián chǎnjì dōu xīyǐn dàpī yóukè.
examples.english: The juicy peaches from Lala Mountain are sweet and full of juice — they draw huge crowds every harvest season.

examples.chinese: 外婆親手做的壽桃包子是家裡每次慶生的必備點心。
examples.pinyin: Wàipó qīnshǒu zuò de shòutáo bāozi shì jiālǐ měi cì qìngshēng de bìbèi diǎnxīn.
examples.english: Grandma's handmade longevity peach buns are a must-have treat at every family birthday celebration.

semanticNote: Usually applied to children in an affectionate or mildly reproachful tone — not as severe as 壞 (bad). 這孩子真淘氣 implies fond exasperation. Also used for playful adults. Contrast with 乖 (well-behaved/obedient), which is the antonym.

examples.chinese: 這個小鬼頭真淘氣，把妹妹的玩具全拆了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoguǐtóu zhēn táoqì, bǎ mèimei de wánjù quán chāi le.
examples.english: That little rascal is so naughty — he took apart all his sister's toys.

examples.chinese: 老師說他小時候很淘氣，沒想到長大後成了工程師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō tā xiǎoshíhòu hěn táoqì, méi xiǎngdào zhǎngdà hòu chéngle gōngchéngshī.
examples.english: His teacher said he was very mischievous as a child — who would have thought he'd grow up to be an engineer.

english: to bargain; to haggle over a price; to negotiate terms
semanticNote: Literally 'ask price, return price' — describes the back-and-forth of price negotiation. Common at traditional markets (傳統市場), 夜市, and 廟口市集. In formal or figurative contexts, means negotiating terms (條件) rather than price. Department stores and chain shops in Taiwan typically have fixed prices (不二價).

examples.chinese: 在傳統市場買東西，討價還價是很正常的事。
examples.pinyin: Zài chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi dōngxi, tǎo jià huán jià shì hěn zhèngcháng de shì.
examples.english: Haggling over prices at a traditional market is completely normal.

examples.chinese: 談合約不是在菜市場，別老想著討價還價。
examples.pinyin: Tán héyuē bú shì zài càishìchǎng, bié lǎo xiǎngzhe tǎo jià huán jià.
examples.english: Negotiating a contract isn't like bargaining at a vegetable market — stop trying to nickel-and-dime every clause.

english: cover; case; set; to slip over; to harness; (mw for sets/suites)
semanticNote: Versatile: (1) measure word — 一套西裝 (a suit), 一套公寓 (an apartment unit); (2) verb — 套上外套 (slip on a coat); (3) noun — 外套 (overcoat), 手套 (gloves), 枕頭套 (pillowcase). 套話 means empty/formulaic talk.

examples.chinese: 他買了一套新西裝準備參加下週的面試。
examples.pinyin: Tā mǎile yī tào xīn xīzhuāng zhǔnbèi cānjiā xià zhōu de miànshì.
examples.english: He bought a new suit to prepare for next week's interview.

examples.chinese: 這套公寓有三房兩廳，採光非常好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù yǒu sān fáng liǎng tīng, cǎiguāng fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: This apartment unit has three bedrooms and two living areas and gets excellent natural light.

semanticNote: Implies a positive or at least neutral distinctive quality. 地方特色 (local character/flavor) is ubiquitous in Taiwan tourism and food writing. Slightly warmer than 特點 (feature/characteristic), which is more neutral. 特色料理 = signature/specialty cuisine.

examples.chinese: 鶯歌以陶瓷工藝聞名，是台灣重要的文化特色之一。
examples.pinyin: Yīnggē yǐ táocí gōngyì wénmíng, shì Táiwān zhòngyào de wénhuà tèsè zhī yī.
examples.english: Yingge is famous for its ceramics craftsmanship — it's one of Taiwan's important cultural distinguishing features.

examples.chinese: 這家小吃店的特色是用阿嬤傳下來的古法熬湯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn de tèsè shì yòng āmā chuán xiàlái de gǔfǎ áo tāng.
examples.english: The distinguishing feature of this snack shop is its broth, slow-cooked using a traditional recipe passed down from Grandma.

semanticNote: Describes something that departs markedly from the norm — can be positive (特殊才能 — exceptional talent) or situational (特殊情況 — exceptional circumstances). In Taiwan law and policy, 特殊教育 refers to special-needs education (資源班/特教班).

examples.chinese: 她有一種特殊的能力，能記住每個學生的名字和座位。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yī zhǒng tèshū de nénglì, néng jìzhù měi gè xuéshēng de míngzì hé zuòwèi.
examples.english: She has a special ability — she can remember every student's name and seat.

examples.chinese: 遇到特殊情況，學校可以向教育局申請彈性處理。
examples.pinyin: Yùdào tèshū qíngkuàng, xuéxiào kěyǐ xiàng jiàoyùjú shēnqǐng tánxìng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: In exceptional circumstances, schools can apply to the Department of Education for flexible handling.

semanticNote: More analytical than 特色 — used in scientific, descriptive, or diagnostic contexts to enumerate defining properties. 生物特徵 (biometric features), 人物特徵 (character traits in literature), 外形特徵 (physical characteristics). Common in police reports, biology, and literary analysis.

examples.chinese: 警方請目擊者描述嫌疑人的外形特徵。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng qǐng mùjízhě miáoshù xiányírén de wàixíng tèzhēng.
examples.english: Police asked the witness to describe the physical characteristics of the suspect.

examples.chinese: 台灣黑熊最明顯的特徵是胸前那塊白色的V形斑紋。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hēixióng zuì míngxiǎn de tèzhēng shì xiōng qián nà kuài báisè de V xíng bānwén.
examples.english: The most distinctive feature of the Formosan black bear is the white V-shaped marking on its chest.

english: to love dearly; to dote on; to be very fond of
semanticNote: Expresses warm, protective affection — typical of the love grandparents feel for grandchildren, or parents for young children. Stronger and more tender than 喜歡; less formal than 愛護. 疼 alone means 'to ache/pain' — the compound 疼愛 metaphorically captures how love can feel achingly deep. Apostrophe required: téng'ài.

examples.chinese: 阿公最疼愛小孫女，什麼都捨不得讓她受委屈。
examples.pinyin: Āgōng zuì téng'ài xiǎo sūnnǚ, shéme dōu shěbùdé ràng tā shòu wěiqu.
examples.english: Grandpa dotes on his little granddaughter the most and can't bear to see her suffer the slightest grievance.

examples.chinese: 父母疼愛孩子是天性，但過度溺愛反而對孩子不好。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ téng'ài háizi shì tiānxìng, dàn guòdù nì'ài fǎn'ér duì háizi bù hǎo.
examples.english: It's natural for parents to love their children dearly, but excessive spoiling is actually harmful to the child.

english: to advocate; to promote; to encourage
semanticNote: Used for officially or publicly promoting values, practices, or behaviors — stronger and more top-down than 鼓勵 (encourage). Government campaigns 提倡 healthy living, recycling, etc. Common collocations: 提倡節能減碳, 提倡運動, 提倡環保.

examples.chinese: 政府近年大力提倡垃圾減量，鼓勵民眾自備購物袋。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìnnián dàlì tíchàng lājī jiǎnliàng, gǔlì mínzhòng zìbèi gòuwùdài.
examples.english: The government has been strongly promoting waste reduction and encouraging people to bring their own shopping bags.

examples.chinese: 學校提倡閱讀風氣，每班設有班級圖書角。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào tíchàng yuèdú fēngqì, měi bān shè yǒu bānjí túshū jiǎo.
examples.english: The school promotes a reading culture and has set up a class library corner in every classroom.

semanticNote: The structural skeleton of a piece of writing or speech — what you write before you write. 列提綱 (draw up an outline) is standard academic process in Taiwan schools. Broader than just 'outline' — also used for briefing documents and agenda frameworks.

examples.chinese: 老師要求我們在寫作文前先列出提綱，再開始寫。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen zài xiě zuòwén qián xiān lièchū tígāng, zài kāishǐ xiě.
examples.english: The teacher asked us to draw up an outline before writing our composition.

examples.chinese: 他在演講前準備了一份簡單的提綱，確保重點不會遺漏。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yǎnjiǎng qián zhǔnbèile yī fèn jiǎndān de tígāng, quèbǎo zhòngdiǎn bú huì yílòu.
examples.english: Before the speech he prepared a simple outline to make sure no key points were missed.

english: to ask a question; to put questions to; questioning
semanticNote: Formal register — used in classroom, press conference, or Q&A contexts. 請同學提問 (please ask questions). Differs from 問 (casual asking) in that 提問 implies a structured or public act of questioning. Also used as a noun: 開放提問 (open Q&A).

examples.chinese: 演講結束後，主持人開放現場觀眾提問。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, zhǔchírén kāifàng xiànchǎng guānzhòng tíwèn.
examples.english: After the lecture, the host opened the floor for questions from the audience.

examples.chinese: 他習慣在課前先準備好幾個提問，讓討論更有深度。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài kè qián xiān zhǔnbèi hǎo jǐ gè tíwèn, ràng tǎolùn gèng yǒu shēndù.
examples.english: He makes a habit of preparing a few questions before class to give the discussion more depth.

english: title; topic; subject; question (on a test)
semanticNote: Three main uses: (1) title of a work — 文章題目; (2) topic/subject of discussion — 辯論題目; (3) exam question — 考試題目, 數學題目. The last is extremely common in Taiwan's exam-heavy education system. 出題目 (set questions) and 解題目 (solve problems) are standard.

examples.chinese: 學測國文的作文題目每年都讓考生又驚又喜。
examples.pinyin: Xuécè guówén de zuòwén tímù měi nián dōu ràng kǎoshēng yòu jīng yòu xǐ.
examples.english: The GSAT Chinese essay topic surprises and delights test-takers every year.

examples.chinese: 這道數學題目看起來簡單，但陷阱很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào shùxué tímù kàn qǐlái jiǎndān, dàn xiànjǐng hěn duō.
examples.english: This math problem looks simple, but it's full of traps.

english: to realize through experience; to come to understand; personal understanding
semanticNote: Combines lived experience with intellectual understanding — not just knowing but knowing-through-doing. Often used in reflective writing: 我的體會是… (my understanding from experience is…). Deeper than 理解 (understand intellectually). 心得體會 is a common compound for personal reflections.

examples.chinese: 當了父母才能真正體會養育孩子的辛苦與喜悅。
examples.pinyin: Dāngle fùmǔ cái néng zhēnzhèng tǐhuì yǎngyù háizi de xīnkǔ yǔ xǐyuè.
examples.english: Only after becoming a parent can you truly understand the hardship and joy of raising a child.

examples.chinese: 他在演講中分享了在部落服務兩年的深刻體會。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yǎnjiǎng zhōng fēnxiǎngle zài bùluò fúwù liǎng nián de shēnkè tǐhuì.
examples.english: In his speech he shared the profound understanding he gained from two years of service in an Indigenous community.

english: considerate; thoughtful; to show consideration for others
semanticNote: Describes someone who is attentive to others' feelings and needs and acts on that awareness. High praise in Taiwan's relational culture — 體貼的人 is an ideal partner trait. More proactive than 貼心 (warm/close to one's heart); implies observable actions, not just feelings.

examples.chinese: 他非常體貼，每次約會都記得女友不能吃辣。
examples.pinyin: Tā fēicháng tǐtiē, měi cì yuēhuì dōu jìdé nǚyǒu bù néng chī là.
examples.english: He's very considerate — every time they go on a date he remembers that his girlfriend can't eat spicy food.

examples.chinese: 這家旅館的服務很體貼，房間裡連眼藥水都準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚguǎn de fúwù hěn tǐtiē, fángjiān lǐ lián yǎnyàoshuǐ dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: The service at this hotel is incredibly thoughtful — the room even has eye drops ready.

english: to embody; to reflect; to manifest; to give expression to
semanticNote: Used when an abstract quality is made concrete and visible through something specific. 體現了…的精神 (embodies the spirit of…) is a common construction in formal writing and speeches. Slightly more literary than 表現.

examples.chinese: 這棟建築的設計體現了台灣傳統與現代的完美融合。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng jiànzhú de shèjì tǐxiànle Táiwān chuántǒng yǔ xiàndài de wánměi rónghé.
examples.english: The design of this building embodies a perfect fusion of Taiwanese tradition and modernity.

examples.chinese: 他的行動體現了對社區的責任感，值得大家學習。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xíngdòng tǐxiànle duì shèqū de zérèngǎn, zhídé dàjiā xuéxí.
examples.english: His actions embody a sense of responsibility toward the community — something worth everyone learning from.

semanticNote: Emphasizes direct, embodied participation — you do it yourself rather than watching or reading about it. 親身體驗 (first-hand experience) is common. In Taiwan's tourism and education contexts: 文化體驗 (cultural experience), 農場體驗 (farm experience) are popular programs.

examples.chinese: 學校安排學生到原住民部落體驗傳統文化和射箭。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào ānpái xuéshēng dào yuánzhùmín bùluò tǐyàn chuántǒng wénhuà hé shèjiàn.
examples.english: The school arranged for students to visit an Indigenous community to experience traditional culture and archery firsthand.

examples.chinese: 來台灣一定要體驗一次廟會的熱鬧氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yīdìng yào tǐyàn yīcì miàohuì de rènào qìfēn.
examples.english: If you come to Taiwan, you must experience the lively atmosphere of a temple festival at least once.

semanticNote: Neutral and universal — the physical sky above. Common in poetry and everyday description. 藍天 (blue sky) and 天空放晴 (sky clears up) are common in Taiwan weather contexts. Slightly more poetic than just 天 alone.

examples.chinese: 東北季風過後，天空格外清澈，可以遠眺雪山山脈。
examples.pinyin: Dōngběi jìfēng guòhòu, tiānkōng géwài qīngchè, kěyǐ yuǎntiào Xuěshān shānmài.
examples.english: After the northeast monsoon passes, the sky is unusually clear and you can see the Snow Mountain range in the distance.

examples.chinese: 平溪天燈節時，無數天燈緩緩升上夜空，景色壯觀。
examples.pinyin: Píngxī tiāndēng jié shí, wúshù tiāndēng huǎnhuǎn shēng shàng yèkōng, jǐngsè zhuàngguān.
examples.english: At Pingxi's Sky Lantern Festival, countless lanterns slowly rise into the night sky — a spectacular sight.

semanticNote: Can be neutral/positive (the charming innocence of a child) or gently critical (naïve thinking in an adult). 天真爛漫 (carefree and innocent) is a positive set phrase for children. Saying an adult is 太天真了 carries a note of gentle mockery — 'you're being unrealistically idealistic'.

examples.chinese: 小女孩天真的笑容讓所有人都心情大好。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo nǚhái tiānzhēn de xiàoróng ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu xīnqíng dà hǎo.
examples.english: The little girl's innocent smile put everyone in a great mood.

examples.chinese: 你以為談個合約三天就能搞定？也太天真了吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǐwéi tán gè héyuē sān tiān jiù néng gǎodìng? Yě tài tiānzhēn le ba.
examples.english: You think you can wrap up a contract negotiation in three days? That's a bit naïve.

semanticNote: Similar to 淘氣 but slightly stronger — implies a habit of playful rule-breaking that can be endearing or mildly frustrating. 調皮搗蛋 (mischievous and troublemaking) is a common intensified form. Often used affectionately for children; for adults it implies immaturity.

examples.chinese: 那個小朋友很調皮，總是趁老師轉身時做鬼臉。
examples.pinyin: Nàgè xiǎopéngyǒu hěn tiáopí, zǒng shì chèn lǎoshī zhuǎnshēn shí zuò guǐliǎn.
examples.english: That kid is very mischievous — always making faces the moment the teacher turns around.

examples.chinese: 他小時候調皮搗蛋，現在卻是全班最認真的學生。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhòu tiáopí dǎodàn, xiànzài què shì quán bān zuì rènzhēn de xuéshēng.
examples.english: He was a troublemaker as a kid, but now he's the most diligent student in the class.

english: to adjust; to revise; to readjust; adjustment
semanticNote: Broad term for making modifications to bring something into better alignment — schedule (調整時間), plan (調整方案), price (調整價格), policy (調整政策). More deliberate and systematic than 改變. 微調 is a lighter version: minor tweaking.

examples.chinese: 因應疫情，學校調整了學期課程和考試時程。
examples.pinyin: Yīnyìng yìqíng, xuéxiào tiáozhěngle xuéqī kèchéng hé kǎoshì shíchéng.
examples.english: In response to the epidemic, the school adjusted the semester curriculum and exam schedule.

examples.chinese: 中央銀行宣布調整利率，以應對通膨壓力。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyāng yínháng xuānbù tiáozhěng lìlǜ, yǐ yìngduì tōngpéng yālì.
examples.english: The central bank announced an interest rate adjustment to deal with inflationary pressure.

semanticNote: Both a verb (challenge someone/something) and a noun (a challenge). 迎接挑戰 (rise to a challenge) is a common motivational phrase. 接受挑戰 (accept a challenge). In modern usage also refers to internet challenge trends (挑戰活動).

examples.chinese: 創業初期充滿挑戰，但他憑著韌性一步步克服。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngyè chūqī chōngmǎn tiǎozhàn, dàn tā píngzhe rènxìng yī bù bù kèfú.
examples.english: The early days of starting his business were full of challenges, but he overcame them one by one through sheer resilience.

examples.chinese: 她決定挑戰自己，報名參加了鐵人三項比賽。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, bàomíng cānjiāle tiěrén sānxiàng bǐsài.
examples.english: She decided to challenge herself and signed up for a triathlon.

semanticNote: Expresses what is typical or habitual under normal conditions. Very common in everyday speech and writing. Synonymous with 一般來說 (generally speaking) but more concise. Can modify verbs (通常不吃早餐) or serve as an adjective (通常情況下 — under ordinary circumstances).

examples.chinese: 我通常七點起床，但假日會多睡一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng qī diǎn qǐchuáng, dàn jiàrì huì duō shuì yīgè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven, but on weekends I sleep in an extra hour.

examples.chinese: 台灣的颱風通常在七到九月最為頻繁。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de táifēng tōngcháng zài qī dào jiǔ yuè zuì wéi pínfán.
examples.english: Typhoons in Taiwan are typically most frequent between July and September.

semanticNote: In Taiwan, 統一 carries heavy political weight as a reference to cross-strait unification — distinct from 獨立 (independence). In non-political contexts: standardize (統一規格), make uniform (統一格式). 統一超商 (7-Eleven in Taiwan) takes its name from the word.

examples.chinese: 公司決定統一所有分店的制服款式，提升品牌形象。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng tǒngyī suǒyǒu fēndiàn de zhìfú kuǎnshì, tíshēng pǐnpái xíngxiàng.
examples.english: The company decided to unify the uniform style across all branches to enhance brand image.

examples.chinese: 兩岸統一問題至今仍是台灣政治討論中最敏感的話題之一。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng'àn tǒngyī wèntí zhìjīn réng shì Táiwān zhèngzhì tǎolùn zhōng zuì mǐngǎn de huàtí zhī yī.
examples.english: Cross-strait unification remains one of the most sensitive topics in Taiwan's political discourse.

semanticNote: Encompasses physical and emotional pain/suffering. 痛苦的 modifies nouns: 痛苦的回憶 (painful memories), 痛苦的經歷. As a noun: 承受痛苦 (endure suffering). Stronger and more encompassing than 難受 (feel bad) or 不舒服 (uncomfortable).

examples.chinese: 失去至親是人生中最痛苦的經歷之一。
examples.pinyin: Shīqù zhìqīn shì rénshēng zhōng zuì tòngkǔ de jīnglì zhī yī.
examples.english: Losing a loved one is one of the most painful experiences in life.

examples.chinese: 她花了幾年時間才從那段痛苦的感情中走出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle jǐ nián shíjiān cái cóng nà duàn tòngkǔ de gǎnqíng zhōng zǒu chūlái.
examples.english: It took her several years to recover from that painful relationship.

english: very happy; delighted; to one's heart's content; straightforward
semanticNote: Two distinct senses: (1) intensely satisfying/enjoyable — 玩得很痛快 (had a great time to one's heart's content); (2) straightforward and decisive — 這人做事很痛快 (this person acts decisively). The second sense overlaps with 乾脆. Context usually makes the meaning clear.

examples.chinese: 考完最後一科，他和同學痛快地吃了一頓大餐。
examples.pinyin: Kǎowán zuìhòu yī kē, tā hé tóngxué tòngkuai de chīle yī dùn dàcān.
examples.english: After finishing the last exam, he and his classmates enjoyed a big satisfying meal.

examples.chinese: 老闆說話很痛快，當場就拍板決定了合作條件。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shuōhuà hěn tòngkuai, dāngchǎng jiù pāibǎn juédìngle hézuò tiáojiàn.
examples.english: The boss was very decisive — he settled the terms of cooperation on the spot.

english: to steal; to pilfer; stealthily; on the sly
semanticNote: Covers both literal theft (偷東西) and figurative sneaky action (偷看 — peek; 偷聽 — eavesdrop; 偷懶 — slack off; 偷笑 — laugh to oneself). The figurative uses are very common and not necessarily negative in tone.

examples.chinese: 有人把停在捷運站外的腳踏車偷走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén bǎ tíng zài jiéyùn zhàn wài de jiǎotàchē tōuzǒu le.
examples.english: Someone stole the bicycle parked outside the MRT station.

examples.chinese: 他趁老闆不注意，偷偷地溜出去買飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tā chèn lǎobǎn bù zhùyì, tōutōu de liū chūqù mǎi yǐnliào.
examples.english: He slipped out on the sly to buy a drink while the boss wasn't watching.

english: to throw into; to invest; to be absorbed in; input; investment
semanticNote: Three uses: (1) physically put into — 投入資金 (invest capital); (2) psychologically absorbed — 他聽得很投入 (he was completely absorbed in listening); (3) noun — 研發投入 (R&D investment). The sense of deep engagement/absorption is distinctly Chinese.

examples.chinese: 她對音樂的熱情讓她全心投入每次的練習。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì yīnyuè de rèqíng ràng tā quánxīn tóurù měi cì de liànxí.
examples.english: Her passion for music makes her throw herself completely into every practice session.

examples.chinese: 政府宣布增加對半導體研發的投入，鞏固台灣的科技優勢。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù zēngjiā duì bàndǎotǐ yánfā de tóurù, gǒnggù Táiwān de kējì yōushì.
examples.english: The government announced increased investment in semiconductor R&D to consolidate Taiwan's technological edge.

semanticNote: Standard business term. 投資報酬率 (ROI), 外資 (foreign investment), 投資風險 (investment risk). In Taiwan, 台積電 is often discussed as a major recipient of global investment. 投資理財 (invest and manage finances) is a common phrase in personal finance content.

examples.chinese: 他把多年的積蓄投資在股市，結果虧損慘重。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ duōnián de jīxù tóuzī zài gǔshì, jiéguǒ kuīsǔn cǎnzhòng.
examples.english: He invested his years of savings in the stock market and ended up with heavy losses.

examples.chinese: 近年來，外資對台灣半導體產業的投資持續增加。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, wàizī duì Táiwān bàndǎotǐ chǎnyè de tóuzī chíxù zēngjiā.
examples.english: In recent years, foreign investment in Taiwan's semiconductor industry has continued to grow.

semanticNote: Literal (透明玻璃 — clear glass) and figurative (資訊透明 — information transparency; 透明化 — make transparent/open). The figurative sense is prominent in Taiwan's political discourse: 政府施政應該透明 (government operations should be transparent/open).

examples.chinese: 這家公司的財務報告完全公開，運作非常透明。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de cáiwù bàogào wánquán gōngkāi, yùnzuò fēicháng tòumíng.
examples.english: This company's financial reports are fully public — its operations are very transparent.

examples.chinese: 蜻蜓的翅膀薄如蟬翼，幾乎是完全透明的。
examples.pinyin: Qīngtíng de chìbǎng báo rú chányì, jīhū shì wánquán tòumíng de.
examples.english: Dragonfly wings are as thin as cicada wings — almost completely transparent.

english: prominent; outstanding; to stand out; to give prominence to
semanticNote: As an adjective: describes something or someone that stands markedly above the rest — 成績突出 (outstanding results), 突出的才能 (exceptional talent). As a verb: to highlight or emphasize — 突出重點 (highlight the key points). Also literal: 突出的岩石 (protruding rock).

examples.chinese: 他在這次學測中表現突出，獲得了台大醫學系的錄取。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè cì xuécè zhōng biǎoxiàn tūchū, huòdéle Tái Dà yīxuéxì de lùqǔ.
examples.english: He performed outstandingly in this GSAT and was admitted to NTU's medical school.

examples.chinese: 簡報中要突出最重要的三點，不要讓聽眾迷失在細節裡。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎnbào zhōng yào tūchū zuì zhòngyào de sān diǎn, bùyào ràng tīngzhòng míshī zài xìjié lǐ.
examples.english: In the presentation, highlight the three most important points — don't let the audience get lost in the details.

semanticNote: Covers agricultural land, real estate, and national territory. 土地公 (Earth God) is one of the most widely worshipped deities in Taiwan, with a small shrine (土地公廟) found in nearly every neighborhood. 土地改革 (land reform) shaped modern Taiwan's agricultural history.

examples.chinese: 台灣山多平地少，可耕土地相當有限。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shān duō píngdì shǎo, kě gēng tǔdì xiāngdāng yǒuxiàn.
examples.english: Taiwan is mountainous with little flat land, so arable land is quite limited.

examples.chinese: 屋子旁邊有一塊小土地，他打算開墾成菜園。
examples.pinyin: Wūzi pángbiān yǒu yī kuài xiǎo tǔdì, tā dǎsuàn kāikěn chéng càiyuán.
examples.english: There's a small plot of land beside the house that he plans to clear and turn into a vegetable garden.

semanticNote: Standard Mandarin word for potato. In Taiwan, 馬鈴薯 (mǎlíngshu) is also commonly used, especially in formal or school contexts — both are understood. 花生 (peanut) is called 土豆 in some Southern Min / Taiwanese contexts, which can cause confusion. 薯條 (fries) and 薯片 (chips) are the processed forms.

examples.chinese: 媽媽燉了一鍋排骨土豆湯，香氣從廚房飄了出來。
examples.pinyin: Māma dùnle yī guō páigǔ tǔdòu tāng, xiānqì cóng chúfáng piāo le chūlái.
examples.english: Mom braised a pot of spare rib and potato soup — the aroma drifted out from the kitchen.

examples.chinese: 這道咖哩加了大量土豆和紅蘿蔔，口感很紮實。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào gālí jiāle dàliàng tǔdòu hé hóngluóbo, kǒugǎn hěn zhāshi.
examples.english: This curry has lots of potato and carrot added — the texture is hearty and substantial.

english: tǔ: to spit; to let out | tù: to vomit; to throw up
semanticNote: Two pronunciations: 吐 (tǔ) = emit/expel voluntarily — 吐口水 (spit), 吐出來 (spit it out); 吐 (tù) = vomit involuntarily — 他吐了 (he threw up). The distinction is tonal. In Taiwan, 嘔吐 is the formal medical term for vomiting.
