examples.chinese: 上台報告時他緊張到說不出話，只能深呼吸把緊張吐出去。
examples.pinyin: Shàngtái bàogào shí tā jǐnzhāng dào shuō bù chū huà, zhǐ néng shēn hūxī bǎ jǐnzhāng tǔ chūqù.
examples.english: When presenting on stage he was so nervous he couldn't speak — he could only take deep breaths to breathe out the tension.

examples.chinese: 他暈車暈得很厲害，上山的路上吐了好幾次。
examples.pinyin: Tā yùnchē yùn de hěn lìhài, shàng shān de lùshàng tùle hǎo jǐ cì.
examples.english: He gets very carsick — he threw up several times on the road up the mountain.

semanticNote: Common pet in Taiwan; also a zodiac animal (兔年). 兔子不吃窩邊草 (a rabbit doesn't eat the grass near its own burrow) is a proverb meaning don't get romantically involved with people close to you. 玉兔 is the jade rabbit said to live on the moon in Chinese mythology.

examples.chinese: 妹妹養了一隻白色的兔子，每天放學回來就去餵牠吃紅蘿蔔。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei yǎngle yī zhī báisè de tùzi, měitiān fàngxué huílái jiù qù wèi tā chī hóngluóbo.
examples.english: My sister keeps a white rabbit and feeds it carrots every day after coming home from school.

examples.chinese: 中秋節的月亮又大又圓，爸爸說上面住著玉兔。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié de yuèliang yòu dà yòu yuán, bàba shuō shàngmiàn zhùzhe yùtù.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn moon was huge and full — Dad said the jade rabbit lives up there.

english: group; ball; organization; (mw for ball-shaped objects); to unite
semanticNote: As a noun: organization or group — 旅行團 (tour group), 藝術團 (arts troupe). As a measure word: 一團毛線 (a ball of yarn), 一團糟 (a complete mess). 團圓 (reunion, especially family reunion at Mid-Autumn Festival) is a key cultural concept.

examples.chinese: 他參加了一個旅行團，跟著導遊走遍了南台灣的景點。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiāle yī gè lǚxíngtuán, gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒubiànle nán Táiwān de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: He joined a tour group and visited scenic spots throughout southern Taiwan with a guide.

examples.chinese: 中秋節是一家人團圓的好時機，烤肉賞月缺一不可。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì yī jiā rén tuányuán de hǎo shíjī, kǎoròu shǎng yuè quē yī bù kě.
examples.english: Mid-Autumn Festival is a great time for family reunion — barbecue and moon-gazing are both non-negotiable.

english: to decline; to refuse (politely); to turn down
semanticNote: Politely declining a request, invitation, or responsibility. 婉言推辭 (politely/gently decline) is a common formal phrase. Distinct from 拒絕 (reject, blunter) — 推辭 implies softer, more face-preserving refusal. In Taiwan's social culture, knowing how to 推辭 gracefully is important.

examples.chinese: 他以身體不適為由推辭了這次的頒獎晚宴。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ shēntǐ bùshì wéiyóu tuīcíle zhè cì de bānjiǎng wǎnyàn.
examples.english: He declined the award banquet on the grounds of not feeling well.

examples.chinese: 鄰居熱情邀請他吃飯，他實在推辭不掉，只好留下來。
examples.pinyin: Línjū rèqíng yāoqǐng tā chīfàn, tā shízài tuīcí bù diào, zhǐhǎo liú xiàlái.
examples.english: The neighbor warmly invited him to dinner — he simply couldn't decline and had to stay.

english: to promote; to popularize; to spread (a practice, product, or idea)
semanticNote: Implies active effort to increase the reach of something — 推廣閱讀 (promote reading), 推廣在地農產品 (promote locally grown produce), 推廣電子支付 (promote digital payment). Common in government campaigns and NGO work in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 農委會積極推廣台灣在地農產品，鼓勵消費者多買本土蔬果。
examples.pinyin: Nóngwěihuì jījí tuīguǎng Táiwān zàidì nóngchǎnpǐn, gǔlì xiāofèizhě duō mǎi běntǔ shūguǒ.
examples.english: The Council of Agriculture actively promotes Taiwan's locally grown produce and encourages consumers to buy more domestic fruits and vegetables.

examples.chinese: 這個非營利組織致力於推廣環保購物袋的使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fēiyínglì zǔzhī zhìlì yú tuīguǎng huánbǎo gòuwùdài de shǐyòng.
examples.english: This non-profit organization is dedicated to promoting the use of eco-friendly shopping bags.

semanticNote: Standard term for recommending a person, product, or option. 推薦信 (recommendation letter) is crucial in Taiwan's academic and job application processes. 強力推薦 (highly recommend) and 誠心推薦 (sincerely recommend) are intensified forms.

examples.chinese: 教授為他寫了一封有力的推薦信，幫助他申請上了理想的研究所。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu wèi tā xiěle yī fēng yǒulì de tuījiànxìn, bāngzhù tā shēnqǐng shàngle lǐxiǎng de yánjiūsuǒ.
examples.english: The professor wrote him a strong recommendation letter that helped him get into his dream graduate program.

examples.chinese: 你有沒有推薦的台南小吃？我下週要去玩。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu tuījiàn de Táinán xiǎochī? Wǒ xià zhōu yào qù wán.
examples.english: Do you have any recommended Tainan snacks? I'm going to visit next week.

english: to retreat; to withdraw; to decline; to return (goods); to cancel
semanticNote: Core verb for moving backward or reversing a process. Common compounds: 退步 (regress), 退休 (retire), 退費/退款 (refund), 退貨 (return goods), 退出 (withdraw from), 後退 (step back). Opposite of 進 (advance/enter).

examples.chinese: 他訂了一間民宿，但因為計畫改變，只好退訂。
examples.pinyin: Tā dìngle yī jiān mínsù, dàn yīnwèi jìhuà gǎibiàn, zhǐhǎo tuì dìng.
examples.english: He had booked a B&B, but because his plans changed he had to cancel the reservation.

examples.chinese: 部隊受命後退，重新佈署防線。
examples.pinyin: Bùduì shòumìng hòu tuì, chóngxīn bùshǔ fángsxiàn.
examples.english: The troops were ordered to fall back and redeploy the defense line.

english: to regress; to deteriorate; to fall behind; regression
semanticNote: Opposite of 進步 (make progress). Applied to skills, grades, health, or social development. 成績退步了 (grades have dropped). In interpersonal contexts, also means to take a step back / make a concession — 你退一步，我退一步 (if you give a little, I'll give a little).

examples.chinese: 這學期他的數學成績明顯退步，老師決定約家長談談。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī tā de shùxué chéngjì míngxiǎn tuìbù, lǎoshī juédìng yuē jiāzhǎng tántán.
examples.english: His math grades have clearly deteriorated this semester — the teacher decided to schedule a meeting with his parents.

examples.chinese: 談判雙方各退一步，才有可能達成最終協議。
examples.pinyin: Tánpàn shuāngfāng gè tuì yī bù, cái yǒu kěnéng dáchéng zuìzhōng xiéyì.
examples.english: Both parties in the negotiation need to give a little ground before a final agreement becomes possible.

semanticNote: Standard term for leaving the workforce after a career. 退休金 (pension/retirement payment), 強制退休年齡 (mandatory retirement age). Taiwan public servants have a 18% preferential savings rate on retirement pensions (十八趴), a topic of long political debate. 退休生活 (life in retirement).

examples.chinese: 爸爸今年六十五歲，終於可以辦理退休手續了。
examples.pinyin: Bàba jīnnián liùshíwǔ suì, zhōngyú kěyǐ bànlǐ tuìxiū shǒuxù le.
examples.english: Dad turns sixty-five this year and can finally process his retirement paperwork.

examples.chinese: 她退休後搬到花蓮，過著悠閒的田園生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu bāndào Huālián, guòzhe yōuxián de tiányuán shēnghuó.
examples.english: After retiring, she moved to Hualien and lives a leisurely rural life.

english: crooked; askew; tilted; devious; to tilt; to lean
semanticNote: Physical sense: 掛歪了 (hung crookedly), 帽子戴歪了 (hat on sideways). Figurative sense: 歪理 (specious reasoning), 走歪路 (go down a crooked path). In Taiwan colloquial speech, 歪 can mean to recline casually — 他歪在沙發上 (he's sprawled on the sofa).

examples.chinese: 你的領帶歪了，快在進會議室前整一下。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de lǐngdài wāi le, kuài zài jìn huìyìshì qián zhěng yīxià.
examples.english: Your tie is crooked — fix it quickly before going into the meeting room.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子學習成績不好，還老愛走歪路，讓家人很擔心。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi xuéxí chéngjì bù hǎo, hái lǎo ài zǒu wāilù, ràng jiārén hěn dānxīn.
examples.english: The child's grades are poor and he keeps going down the wrong path, which worries his family greatly.

semanticNote: Taiwan standard: 外公 (maternal grandfather) and 外婆 (maternal grandmother), contrasting with 爺爺/奶奶 (paternal grandparents). The 外 prefix signals the mother's side. In some Southern Min-influenced families in Taiwan, 阿公 (āgōng) is used for both sides colloquially.

examples.chinese: 小時候暑假都在外公家過，他教我釣魚和種菜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhòu shǔjià dōu zài wàigōng jiā guò, tā jiāo wǒ diào yú hé zhòng cài.
examples.english: I used to spend every summer holiday at my maternal grandfather's house — he taught me to fish and grow vegetables.

examples.chinese: 外公今年八十歲了，身體還是很硬朗。
examples.pinyin: Wàigōng jīnnián bāshí suì le, shēntǐ háishi hěn yìnglǎng.
examples.english: My maternal grandfather is eighty this year and still in excellent health.

semanticNote: Taiwan's 外交 situation is uniquely complex — Taiwan is not a UN member and maintains formal diplomatic relations with only a small number of countries, while conducting substantive unofficial relations with most others through bodies like the American Institute in Taiwan (AIT). 外交部 is Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

examples.chinese: 台灣的外交處境特殊，在國際社會中面臨重重挑戰。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de wàijiāo chǔjìng tèshū, zài guójì shèhuì zhōng miànlín chóngchóng tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Taiwan's diplomatic situation is unique — it faces layered challenges in the international community.

examples.chinese: 他在外交部擔任翻譯，需要同時精通中、英、日三種語言。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wàijiāobù dānrèn fānyì, xūyào tóngshí jīngtōng zhōng, yīng, rì sān zhǒng yǔyán.
examples.english: He works as a translator at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, which requires mastery of Chinese, English, and Japanese.

semanticNote: Describes something or someone meeting every standard with nothing lacking. Can be used literally or hyperbolically in praise. 追求完美 (pursue perfection) and 完美主義者 (perfectionist) are common phrases. Contrast 完善 (comprehensive/well-rounded but with room for improvement) and 完整 (complete/intact).

examples.chinese: 這場演出從舞台設計到演員表演都近乎完美。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǎnchū cóng wǔtái shèjì dào yǎnyuán biǎoyǎn dōu jìnhū wánměi.
examples.english: This performance was near perfect, from the stage design to the actors' performances.

examples.chinese: 她是個完美主義者，一份報告要修改十幾遍才滿意。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè wánměi zhǔyìzhě, yī fèn bàogào yào xiūgǎi shí jǐ biàn cái mǎnyì.
examples.english: She's a perfectionist — she revises a report more than a dozen times before she's satisfied.

english: perfect; well-rounded; to improve; to make more complete
semanticNote: As an adjective: comprehensive and well-functioning but not necessarily flawless — 制度完善 (well-developed system), 配套完善 (comprehensive supporting measures). As a verb: 完善制度 (improve/refine the system). More about thoroughness of coverage than flawless beauty. Closer to 'well-rounded/comprehensive' than 完美.

examples.chinese: 台灣的全民健保制度雖然完善，仍有持續改進的空間。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de quánmín jiànbǎo zhìdù suīrán wánshàn, réng yǒu chíxù gǎijìn de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Although Taiwan's National Health Insurance system is comprehensive, there is still room for continuous improvement.

examples.chinese: 公司正在完善內部稽核流程，以符合新的法規要求。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài wánshàn nèibù jīhé liúchéng, yǐ fúhé xīn de fǎguī yāoqiú.
examples.english: The company is improving its internal audit procedures to comply with new regulatory requirements.

semanticNote: Emphasizes that nothing is missing or damaged — all parts are present. 資料完整 (complete data), 完整的紀錄 (intact record), 保持完整 (keep intact). More structural than 完美 (perfect beauty) — something can be 完整 without being beautiful.

examples.chinese: 請確認文件是否完整，缺少任何一份都可能影響申請。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng quèrèn wénjiàn shìfǒu wánzhěng, quēshǎo rènhé yī fèn dōu kěnéng yǐngxiǎng shēnqǐng.
examples.english: Please verify that the documents are complete — a missing piece could affect the application.

examples.chinese: 這套古典傢俱保存完整，是難得一見的骨董。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào gǔdiǎn jiājù bǎocún wánzhěng, shì nándéyījiàn de gǔdǒng.
examples.english: This set of classical furniture is in pristine condition — a rare antique.

semanticNote: Standard word for toys. 玩具店 (toy shop); 玩具車 (toy car). 玩 (play) + 具 (implement/tool) — literally 'play implement'. In Taiwan, 玩具反斗城 was the well-known toy chain. Also used metaphorically: 他把感情當玩具 (he treats relationships like a toy/plaything).

examples.chinese: 孩子的玩具堆滿了整個房間，踩到積木很痛。
examples.pinyin: Háizi de wánjù duī mǎnle zhěnggè fángjiān, cǎi dào jīmù hěn tòng.
examples.english: The child's toys are piled all over the room — stepping on a building block really hurts.

examples.chinese: 她長大後才明白，那些在舊家的玩具承載著多少童年的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎngdà hòu cái míngbái, nàxiē zài jiùjiā de wánjù chéngzàizhe duōshǎo tóngnián de huíyì.
examples.english: It was only after she grew up that she realized how many childhood memories those old toys from her former home held.

english: just in case; in the unlikely event that; if by any chance
semanticNote: Introduces a low-probability but consequential contingency — 萬一下雨怎麼辦 (what if it rains?). Used in risk-management thinking and cautious planning. Literal meaning: 'one in ten thousand'. Often triggers a contingency clause: 萬一…就… (if [unlikely event]… then…).

examples.chinese: 出門爬山記得帶雨衣，萬一變天也不怕。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén páshān jìdé dài yǔyī, wànyī biàn tiān yě bù pà.
examples.english: Remember to bring a rain jacket when you go hiking — just in case the weather changes.

examples.chinese: 萬一找不到工作，他還有一筆存款可以撐上幾個月。
examples.pinyin: Wànyī zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò, tā hái yǒu yī bǐ cúnkuǎn kěyǐ chēng shàng jǐ gè yuè.
examples.english: In the unlikely event he can't find work, he still has savings to tide him over for a few months.

semanticNote: Literal meaning: prince or king's son. In pop culture and romantic contexts, 白馬王子 (Prince Charming, lit. white-horse prince) is the idealized romantic hero of fairy tales and romances. Widely used in Taiwan's entertainment and youth culture.

examples.chinese: 她從小就夢想有一天能遇見自己的白馬王子。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù mèngxiǎng yǒu yītiān néng yùjiàn zìjǐ de báimǎ wángzǐ.
examples.english: Ever since she was little, she dreamed of one day meeting her Prince Charming.

examples.chinese: 這部童話故事講的是一位王子拯救公主的冒險。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù tónghuà gùshì jiǎng de shì yī wèi wángzǐ zhěngjiù gōngzhǔ de màoxiǎn.
examples.english: This fairy tale is about the adventures of a prince rescuing a princess.

semanticNote: General term for any network, including the internet (網路/網絡). In Taiwan, 網路 (wǎnglù) is the more common written form in everyday contexts; 網絡 tends to appear in mainland-influenced or formal technical writing. 社交網絡 (social network), 網絡安全 (cybersecurity).

examples.chinese: 現代人的生活幾乎離不開網路，從購物到繳費都在線上完成。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén de shēnghuó jīhū lí bù kāi wǎnglù, cóng gòuwù dào jiǎofèi dōu zài xiànshàng wánchéng.
examples.english: Modern life is nearly inseparable from the internet — everything from shopping to paying bills is done online.

examples.chinese: 公司的網絡安全出現漏洞，資訊部門緊急處理中。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǎngluò ānquán chūxiàn lòudòng, zīxùn bùmén jǐnjí chǔlǐ zhōng.
examples.english: There's a vulnerability in the company's network security — the IT department is dealing with it urgently.

english: to go back and forth; round trip; to and fro
semanticNote: Used for travel or communication that goes both ways. 往返票 (round-trip ticket), 往返台北高雄 (commute between Taipei and Kaohsiung). In business, 往返信件 (back-and-forth correspondence). Also literal: 人群在兩地之間往返 (crowds moving between two places).

examples.chinese: 他每天搭高鐵往返台北和新竹上班，通勤時間約一小時。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān dā gāotiě wǎngfǎn Táiběi hé Xīnzhú shàngbān, tōngqín shíjiān yuē yī xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He commutes by high-speed rail between Taipei and Hsinchu every day — about an hour each way.

examples.chinese: 這趟旅遊買的是往返機票，回程在下週六。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tàng lǚyóu mǎi de shì wǎngfǎn jīpiào, huíchéng zài xià zhōuliù.
examples.english: The tickets for this trip are round-trip — the return flight is next Saturday.

english: to endanger; to harm; to jeopardize; harm; hazard
semanticNote: Implies serious potential or actual harm to health, safety, or society. 危害健康 (endanger health), 危害社會 (harm to society), 危害環境 (environmental hazard). More severe than 傷害 (hurt/injure) in scope — often institutional or systemic.

examples.chinese: 長時間使用手機對視力造成的危害不可忽視。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān shǐyòng shǒujī duì shìlì zàochéng de wēihài bùkě hūshì.
examples.english: The harm that prolonged mobile phone use causes to eyesight must not be overlooked.

examples.chinese: 工廠排放廢水危害了下游的農業用水，引發居民抗議。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng páifàng fèishuǐ wēihàile xiàyóu de nóngyè yòngshuǐ, yǐnfā jūmín kàngyì.
examples.english: The factory's wastewater discharge endangered downstream agricultural water, triggering protests from local residents.

semanticNote: Implies applying pressure or intimidation to coerce action. 威脅恐嚇 (threaten and intimidate) is a legal term in Taiwan criminal law. 軍事威脅 (military threat) is common in cross-strait reporting. Differs from 危害 (actual harm) — 威脅 is the coercive pressure or potential danger.

examples.chinese: 他因為拒絕行賄而受到黑道的威脅，只好向警方報案。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi jùjué xínghui ér shòudào hēidào de wēixié, zhǐhǎo xiàng jǐngfāng bào'àn.
examples.english: After refusing to pay a bribe, he was threatened by organized crime and had no choice but to report it to the police.

examples.chinese: 網路詐騙的威脅日益嚴重，民眾需提高警覺。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhàpiàn de wēixié rìyì yánzhòng, mínzhòng xū tígāo jǐngjué.
examples.english: The threat of online fraud is growing increasingly serious — people need to stay vigilant.

semanticNote: A gentle, controlled smile — more refined than 笑 (laugh/grin broadly). 微微一笑 (smile faintly). As a noun: 燦爛的微笑 (brilliant smile), 友善的微笑 (friendly smile). Taiwan's tourism marketing once used the slogan '微笑台灣' — both because Taiwanese people are known for their friendliness and because the island's shape resembles a smiling face.

examples.chinese: 她對每一位客人都報以親切的微笑，讓人如沐春風。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì měi yī wèi kèrén dōu bào yǐ qīnqiè de wēixiào, ràng rén rú mù chūnfēng.
examples.english: She greeted every guest with a warm smile that made people feel as though they were bathed in spring sunshine.

examples.chinese: 他試著微笑，但眼神卻透露出深藏的悲傷。
examples.pinyin: Tā shìzhe wēixiào, dàn yǎnshén què tòulòu chū shēncáng de bēishāng.
examples.english: He tried to smile, but his eyes betrayed a deep underlying sadness.

english: to violate; to go against; to break (a rule or law)
semanticNote: Used when an action contravenes laws, rules, regulations, or principles. 違反法律 (violate the law), 違反規定 (break the rules), 違反職業道德 (violate professional ethics). More formal than 不遵守 (not follow). Opposite of 遵守 (comply with/abide by).

examples.chinese: 隨地亂丟垃圾違反環保法規，可以開罰。
examples.pinyin: Suídì luàn diū lājī wéifǎn huánbǎo fǎguī, kěyǐ kāi fá.
examples.english: Littering violates environmental regulations and can result in a fine.

examples.chinese: 任何違反工作倫理的行為都可能導致嚴重的職業後果。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé wéifǎn gōngzuò lúnlǐ de xíngwéi dōu kěnéng dǎozhì yánzhòng de zhíyè hòuguǒ.
examples.english: Any conduct that violates professional ethics can lead to serious career consequences.

semanticNote: A winter accessory wrapped around the neck. In Taiwan, scarves are worn more for fashion than warmth in the mild lowland climate, but are practical in Taipei winters (which can drop to 10°C or below) and essential in mountain areas. 圍 (wrap around) + 巾 (cloth/kerchief).

examples.chinese: 冬天的台北冷得讓人出門一定要戴圍巾。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de Táiběi lěng de ràng rén chūmén yīdìng yào dài wéijīn.
examples.english: Taipei winters are cold enough that you absolutely need a scarf when you go out.

examples.chinese: 她送了男朋友一條親手編織的圍巾當聖誕禮物。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòngle nán péngyǒu yī tiáo qīnshǒu biānzhī de wéijīn dāng shèngdàn lǐwù.
examples.english: She gave her boyfriend a hand-knitted scarf as a Christmas gift.

english: to revolve around; to surround; to center on
semanticNote: Literal: to go around or encircle (地球圍繞太陽轉 — the Earth revolves around the Sun). Figurative: to center on or focus on a topic (圍繞著這個問題討論了很久 — discussed at length around this issue). Both uses are common.

examples.chinese: 地球圍繞太陽公轉一圈需要大約三百六十五天。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú wéirào tàiyáng gōngzhuǎn yī quān xūyào dàyuē sānbǎi liùshíwǔ tiān.
examples.english: It takes the Earth approximately 365 days to complete one revolution around the Sun.

examples.chinese: 這場討論圍繞著如何提升學生學習動機展開。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng tǎolùn wéiràozhe rúhé tíshēng xuéshēng xuéxí dòngjī zhǎnkāi.
examples.english: This discussion centered on how to improve students' motivation to learn.

english: only; sole; the one and only
semanticNote: Strong exclusive emphasis — the only one, with no alternative or equal. 唯一的選擇 (the only choice), 唯一的方法 (the only way), 唯一的兒子 (the only son). More emphatic than 只有 (only have) — 唯一 has a finalizing, absolute feel.

examples.chinese: 他是家裡唯一的男孩，從小承受著傳宗接代的壓力。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì jiālǐ wéiyī de nánhái, cóngxiǎo chéngshòuzhe chuánzōngjiēdài de yālì.
examples.english: He is the only boy in the family and has carried the pressure of continuing the family line since childhood.

examples.chinese: 在那個年代，廣播是人們獲得資訊的唯一管道。
examples.pinyin: Zài nàgè niándài, guǎngbō shì rénmen huòdé zīxùn de wéiyī guǎndào.
examples.english: In that era, radio was the only channel through which people could get information.

english: to maintain; to repair; to service; maintenance; repair
semanticNote: Covers both routine maintenance (定期維修 — scheduled maintenance) and repair of something broken (送去維修 — send for repair). 維修人員 (maintenance/repair staff), 免費維修 (free servicing). Common in contexts of vehicles, appliances, and infrastructure.

examples.chinese: 冷氣機每年夏天前都應該送去維修保養一次。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqìjī měi nián xiàtiān qián dōu yīnggāi sòng qù wéixiū bǎoyǎng yīcì.
examples.english: Air conditioners should be sent in for servicing and maintenance once before every summer.

examples.chinese: 這段高速公路正在進行維修工程，請提早出發。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn gāosù gōnglù zhèngzài jìnxíng wéixiū gōngchéng, qǐng tí zǎo chūfā.
examples.english: This section of the expressway is undergoing maintenance work — please depart early.

semanticNote: Reserved for things of exceptional historical, moral, or human significance — 偉大的人物 (great figures), 偉大的發現 (magnificent discovery), 偉大的母愛 (the greatness of maternal love). In Taiwan, used without the political freight it carries in mainland discourse. Overuse can make it sound clichéd.

examples.chinese: 老師說，偉大不在於出身，而在於你如何對待他人。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, wěidà bú zàiyú chūshēn, ér zàiyú nǐ rúhé duìdài tārén.
examples.english: The teacher said greatness lies not in where you come from, but in how you treat others.

examples.chinese: 她用一生照顧病重的丈夫，這種付出令人感受到偉大的人性光輝。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng yīshēng zhàogù bìngzhòng de zhàngfū, zhè zhǒng fùchū lìng rén gǎnshòu dào wěidà de rénxìng guānghuī.
examples.english: She devoted her whole life to caring for her gravely ill husband — this dedication shows the magnificent light of humanity.

english: tail; (fig.) loose end; follower who trails behind
semanticNote: Literal: an animal's tail. Figurative: 甩掉尾巴 (shake off someone following you), 留下尾巴 (leave loose ends). 翹尾巴 (lift one's tail — become conceited) is a colloquial idiom. In Taiwan, 尾牙 (the last 牙 of the year, a year-end company banquet) is a different compound.

examples.chinese: 小狗一見到主人回來就用力搖尾巴，高興得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu yī jiàn dào zhǔrén huílái jiù yònglì yáo wěiba, gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The puppy wagged its tail furiously the moment it saw its owner come home — it was absolutely ecstatic.

examples.chinese: 這件事情還有一些尾巴沒有處理好，要再花時間收尾。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng hái yǒu yīxiē wěiba méiyǒu chǔlǐ hǎo, yào zài huā shíjiān shōuwěi.
examples.english: There are still some loose ends on this matter that haven't been tied up — it'll take more time to wrap things up.

english: feel wronged; aggrieved; to put someone in a difficult position; grievance
semanticNote: The feeling of being treated unfairly or suffering an undeserved slight — a key concept in Taiwan's emotionally expressive culture. 受委屈 (feel wronged/suffer an injustice), 委屈你了 (sorry for putting you in a difficult spot). Can also mean to wrongly accuse: 別委屈了好人 (don't wrong innocent people).

examples.chinese: 她一個人默默哭，顯然心裡有很多委屈沒說出口。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīgèrén mòmò kū, xiǎnrán xīnlǐ yǒu hěn duō wěiqu méi shuō chūkǒu.
examples.english: She cried alone in silence — it was clear she had a lot of unexpressed grievance pent up inside.

examples.chinese: 你這次為了大局忍下來，真的委屈你了，謝謝你的體諒。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè cì wèile dàjú rěn xiàlái, zhēnde wěiqu nǐ le, xièxiè nǐ de tǐliàng.
examples.english: You put up with it this time for the sake of the bigger picture — it truly put you in a difficult position. Thank you for your understanding.

english: not necessarily; may not be; need not
semanticNote: Expresses the idea that something is not guaranteed or certain — often challenges an assumption. 成績好未必有前途 (good grades don't necessarily mean a bright future). Equivalent to 不一定 but slightly more formal. Used to introduce nuance or push back on overgeneralization.

examples.chinese: 貴的東西未必就好，要根據自己的需求選擇。
examples.pinyin: Guì de dōngxi wèibì jiù hǎo, yào gēnjù zìjǐ de xūqiú xuǎnzé.
examples.english: Expensive things are not necessarily good — you need to choose based on your own needs.

examples.chinese: 他外表看起來很冷漠，但未必是真的不在乎。
examples.pinyin: Tā wàibiǎo kàn qǐlái hěn lěngmò, dàn wèibì shì zhēnde bù zàihū.
examples.english: He may look indifferent on the outside, but that doesn't necessarily mean he truly doesn't care.

semanticNote: Standard word for 'the future'. 對未來的期待 (expectations for the future), 未來的發展 (future development). In Taiwan's tech and startup discourse, 未來感 (futuristic feel) is a design/branding term. As an adjective: 未來的趨勢 (upcoming trend).

examples.chinese: 她對未來充滿信心，計畫畢業後去矽谷發展。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì wèilái chōngmǎn xìnxīn, jìhuà bìyè hòu qù Guīgǔ fāzhǎn.
examples.english: She is full of confidence about the future and plans to head to Silicon Valley after graduation.

examples.chinese: 台灣的未來發展與半導體產業的競爭力密不可分。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de wèilái fāzhǎn yǔ bàndǎotǐ chǎnyè de jìngzhēnglì mì bù kě fēn.
examples.english: Taiwan's future development is inseparably tied to the competitiveness of its semiconductor industry.

english: to be located at; to be situated at
semanticNote: Formal verb indicating geographical or physical location — more written/formal than 在. 位於台北市中心 (located in the center of Taipei). Common in official descriptions, travel writing, and geography. The subject is always a place or institution.

examples.chinese: 故宮博物院位於台北市士林區，是台灣最重要的文化地標之一。
examples.pinyin: Gùgōng bówùyuàn wèiyú Táiběi shì Shìlín qū, shì Táiwān zuì zhòngyào de wénhuà dìbiāo zhī yī.
examples.english: The National Palace Museum is located in Shilin District, Taipei — one of Taiwan's most important cultural landmarks.

examples.chinese: 這家新開的咖啡廳位於永康街巷弄裡，環境清幽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xīn kāi de kāfēitīng wèiyú Yǒngkāng jiē xiàngnòng lǐ, huánjìng qīngyōu.
examples.english: This newly opened café is tucked away in an alley off Yongkang Street — the environment is quiet and peaceful.

semanticNote: Covers physical location (你站的位置 — where you're standing), seat (坐位 is interchangeable), and abstract position (在公司的位置 — position in the company). 占位置 (take up space/hold a position). Very common in everyday and workplace use.

examples.chinese: 你坐的位置剛好在舞台正前方，視野一定很好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò de wèizhi gānghǎo zài wǔtái zhèng qiánfāng, shìyě yīdìng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: Your seat is right in front of the stage — you must have a great view.

examples.chinese: 請把書放回原來的位置，不然下次找不到。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū fàng huí yuánlái de wèizhi, bùrán xià cì zhǎo bù dào.
examples.english: Please put the book back in its original place, otherwise we won't be able to find it next time.

semanticNote: The organ. 胃痛 (stomachache), 胃炎 (gastritis), 胃潰瘍 (gastric ulcer). Colloquially, 傷胃 (bad for the stomach) is commonly said of spicy, acidic, or cold foods. 台灣胃 is an informal term for a palate accustomed to Taiwanese food.

examples.chinese: 他常常一壓力大就胃痛，醫生建議他少吃刺激性食物。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng yī yālì dà jiù wèitòng, yīshēng jiànyì tā shǎo chī cìjīxìng shíwù.
examples.english: He often gets stomachaches when he's under stress — the doctor recommended he eat less irritating food.

examples.chinese: 空腹喝黑咖啡很傷胃，最好先吃點東西墊一下。
examples.pinyin: Kōngfù hē hēi kāfēi hěn shāng wèi, zuìhǎo xiān chī diǎn dōngxi diàn yīxià.
examples.english: Drinking black coffee on an empty stomach is hard on the stomach — better to eat something first.

semanticNote: Literal: appetite for food — 胃口好/差 (good/poor appetite). Figurative: taste or interest in something — 這項目不合我的胃口 (this project isn't to my taste). 吊胃口 (whet the appetite, tease/tantalize) is a common idiom for building anticipation.

examples.chinese: 生病的時候胃口很差，連平時最愛的滷肉飯都吃不下。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhòu wèikǒu hěn chà, lián píngshí zuì ài de lǔròufàn dōu chī bù xià.
examples.english: When you're sick your appetite is terrible — you can't even eat your favorite braised pork rice.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜單新奇有趣，一看就吊起了我的胃口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de càidān xīnqí yǒuqù, yī kàn jiù diào qǐle wǒ de wèikǒu.
examples.english: The restaurant's menu is novel and interesting — just reading it whetted my appetite.

semanticNote: Covers physical warmth (溫暖的陽光 — warm sunlight) and emotional warmth (讓人感到溫暖 — makes one feel warm/cared for). 溫暖人心 (warm people's hearts) is a common expression. In Taiwan, winter in the south is described as 溫暖; northern Taiwan winters are damp and cool.

examples.chinese: 台南的冬天比台北溫暖許多，不太需要穿厚外套。
examples.pinyin: Táinán de dōngtiān bǐ Táiběi wēnnuǎn xǔduō, bù tài xūyào chuān hòu wàitào.
examples.english: Tainan's winters are much warmer than Taipei's — you don't really need to wear a thick coat.

examples.chinese: 鄰居送來一碗自製湯圓，這份溫暖讓她感動得想哭。
examples.pinyin: Línjū sòng lái yī wǎn zìzhì tāngyuán, zhè fèn wēnnuǎn ràng tā gǎndòng de xiǎng kū.
examples.english: A neighbor brought over a bowl of homemade tang yuan — the warmth of the gesture moved her to tears.

english: gentle; tender; soft; mild in manner
semanticNote: Describes a person's manner as warm and gentle — often an ideal personality trait in Taiwan's cultural context, especially applied to women but not exclusively. 溫柔的聲音 (gentle voice), 溫柔以待 (treat with gentleness). Contrast 強硬 (tough/firm) or 粗暴 (rough/violent).

examples.chinese: 她說話很溫柔，從不對任何人大聲嚷嚷。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn wēnróu, cóng bù duì rènhé rén dàshēng rāngrāng.
examples.english: She speaks very gently and never raises her voice at anyone.

examples.chinese: 在那個緊張的夜晚，媽媽溫柔地握著他的手，陪他度過。
examples.pinyin: Zài nàgè jǐnzhāng de yèwǎn, māma wēnróu de wòzhe tā de shǒu, péi tā dùguò.
examples.english: On that tense night, his mother gently held his hand and stayed with him through it.

semanticNote: Covers both physical documents (紙本文件 — paper documents) and digital files (電子文件 — electronic files). 辦理文件 (process documents), 文件夾 (folder/binder). In Taiwan bureaucratic contexts, gathering and submitting 文件 is a major part of official applications (戶籍、移民、建照等).

examples.chinese: 申請身分證補發需要帶哪些文件，可以上戶政事務所網站查詢。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng shēnfèn zhèng bǔ fā xūyào dài nǎxiē wénjiàn, kěyǐ shàng hùzhèng shìwùsuǒ wǎngzhàn cháxún.
examples.english: You can check the Household Registration Office website to find out which documents are needed to apply for a replacement ID card.

examples.chinese: 他不小心把重要的文件刪掉了，幸好電腦有自動備份功能。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bǎ zhòngyào de wénjiàn shāndiào le, xìnghǎo diànnǎo yǒu zìdòng bèifèn gōngnéng.
examples.english: He accidentally deleted an important file — fortunately the computer has an auto-backup function.

semanticNote: Encompasses pens, pencils, notebooks, rulers, correction tape, etc. 文具店 (stationery shop) — a staple of Taiwan neighborhoods and school culture. Taiwan has a strong stationery culture with well-known chains like 金興發 and 誠品文具.

examples.chinese: 開學前媽媽帶我去文具店買了一整套新文具。
examples.pinyin: Kāixué qián māma dài wǒ qù wénjùdiàn mǎile yī zhěng tào xīn wénjù.
examples.english: Before the school term started, Mom took me to the stationery shop to buy a full set of new supplies.

examples.chinese: 這家文具店賣的修正帶種類多得讓人選不完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā wénjùdiàn mài de xiūzhèngdài zhǒnglèi duō de ràng rén xuǎn bù wán.
examples.english: The variety of correction tape sold at this stationery shop is so extensive you can't possibly choose just one.

semanticNote: As a noun: a civilization or cultural system — 中華文明 (Chinese civilization), 古文明 (ancient civilization). As an adjective: civilized/civil in behavior — 文明行為 (civilized conduct), 請文明用路 (please drive/walk civilly). Both senses are common in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣原住民族擁有豐富的傳統文明，包含語言、歌謠和祭典。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yuánzhùmín zú yōngyǒu fēngfù de chuántǒng wénmíng, bāohán yǔyán, gēyáo hé jìdiǎn.
examples.english: Taiwan's Indigenous peoples have rich traditional civilizations that include languages, songs, and rituals.

examples.chinese: 請文明排隊，不要插隊。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng wénmíng páiduì, bùyào chāduì.
examples.english: Please queue civilly and don't cut in line.

semanticNote: The field of literary arts. 台灣文學 (Taiwanese literature) is a rich field encompassing Hokkien, Japanese-era, and Mandarin literary traditions. 文學獎 (literary prize) — Taiwan has numerous prestigious ones including the 時報文學獎 and 林榮三文學獎. 文學系 (Chinese/literature department in university).

examples.chinese: 她從小愛看書，大學選擇就讀台大中文系，專攻現代文學。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo ài kànshū, dàxué xuǎnzé jiùdú Tái Dà Zhōngwénxì, zhuān gōng xiàndài wénxué.
examples.english: She loved reading from a young age and chose to study Chinese Literature at NTU, specializing in modern literature.

examples.chinese: 台灣文學博物館位於台南，展示了豐富的本土文學史料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān wénxué bówùguǎn wèiyú Táinán, zhǎnshìle fēngfù de běntǔ wénxué shǐliào.
examples.english: The Taiwan Literature Museum is located in Tainan and displays rich historical materials on Taiwan's native literature.

english: characters; script; writing system; written language
semanticNote: Refers to the writing system as a whole — 中文文字 (Chinese script), 象形文字 (pictographic writing). In Taiwan, 正體中文文字 (Traditional Chinese characters) is used officially. Distinct from 文章 (a piece of writing/article) — 文字 is the system/characters, not the content.

examples.chinese: 漢字是世界上最古老的文字系統之一，至今仍在使用。
examples.pinyin: Hànzì shì shìjiè shàng zuì gǔlǎo de wénzì xìtǒng zhī yī, zhìjīn réng zài shǐyòng.
examples.english: Chinese characters are one of the world's oldest writing systems and remain in use to this day.

examples.chinese: 設計師說，好的文字排版能大幅提升讀者的閱讀體驗。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī shuō, hǎo de wénzì páibǎn néng dàfú tíshēng dúzhě de yuèdú tǐyàn.
examples.english: The designer said that good typography can significantly improve the reader's reading experience.

english: to smell; to hear; news; reputation
semanticNote: In modern Mandarin primarily means 'to smell' — 聞到香味 (smell a fragrance). Historical/formal sense: 'to hear/learn of' — preserved in compounds like 新聞 (news, lit. 'newly heard'), 見聞 (what one sees and hears), 醜聞 (scandal). Both senses coexist in modern usage.

examples.chinese: 走進廟裡，立刻聞到一股香火繚繞的氣味。
examples.pinyin: Zǒu jìn miào lǐ, lìkè wéndào yī gǔ xiānghǔo liáorào de qìwèi.
examples.english: Walking into the temple, you immediately smell the lingering scent of incense.

examples.chinese: 這件醜聞一出，公司股價立刻大跌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chǒuwén yī chū, gōngsī gǔjià lìkè dà diē.
examples.english: As soon as the scandal broke, the company's share price dropped sharply.

semanticNote: Standard Mandarin for a kiss. 親吻 (kiss affectionately), 初吻 (first kiss), 吻別 (kiss goodbye). In Taiwan pop culture, the 吻戲 (kissing scene) in dramas is a notable cultural focus. Also used in 嘴吻 (lips/mouth area) in literary or medical contexts.

examples.chinese: 他在機場出口看到女友後，激動地給了她一個長長的吻。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jīchǎng chūkǒu kàn dào nǚyǒu hòu, jīdòng de gěi le tā yī gè cháng cháng de wěn.
examples.english: When he saw his girlfriend at the airport exit, he was so moved he gave her a long, lasting kiss.

examples.chinese: 她在孩子的額頭上輕輕地吻了一下，說晚安。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài háizi de étóu shàng qīngqīng de wěnle yīxià, shuō wǎn'ān.
examples.english: She gently kissed the child on the forehead and said goodnight.

semanticNote: Describes physical, political, economic, or emotional stability. 穩定的工作 (stable job — highly valued in Taiwan's salaried work culture), 情緒穩定 (emotionally stable), 局勢穩定 (the situation is stable). As a verb: 穩定物價 (stabilize prices), 穩定情緒 (calm emotions).

examples.chinese: 他找到一份收入穩定的公務員工作，家人都很放心。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎodào yī fèn shōurù wěndìng de gōngwùyuán gōngzuò, jiārén dōu hěn fàngxīn.
examples.english: He found a stable-income civil service job and his family is much relieved.

examples.chinese: 安慰了她半個小時之後，她的情緒才逐漸穩定下來。
examples.pinyin: Ānwèile tā bàn gè xiǎoshí zhī hòu, tā de qíngxù cái zhújiàn wěndìng xiàlái.
examples.english: After half an hour of comforting her, her emotions gradually began to stabilize.

english: to greet; to send regards to; greeting
semanticNote: A formal or warm expression of sending greetings, often through an intermediary — 請代我問候你的父母 (please send my regards to your parents). More deliberate and formal than 打招呼 (say hi). 節日問候 (holiday greetings). 問候信 (greeting card/letter).

examples.chinese: 請代我問候王老師，祝她身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dài wǒ wènhòu Wáng lǎoshī, zhù tā shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Please send my regards to Teacher Wang and wish her good health.

examples.chinese: 每逢過年，他都會給海外的老朋友發一封問候信。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng guònián, tā dōu huì gěi hǎiwài de lǎo péngyǒu fā yī fēng wènhòu xìn.
examples.english: Every Lunar New Year, he sends a greeting letter to old friends overseas.

semanticNote: Standard word for bedroom. 主臥室 (master bedroom), 客臥 (guest bedroom). In Taiwan's densely built urban housing, bedroom size and count significantly affect apartment prices — 三房兩廳 (3 bedrooms, 2 living areas) is the standard family configuration.

examples.chinese: 她把臥室重新粉刷了一遍，換上了淡藍色的牆壁。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ wòshì chóngxīn fěnshuāle yī biàn, huànshàngle dàn lán sè de qiángbì.
examples.english: She repainted the bedroom and switched to light blue walls.

examples.chinese: 這套公寓有兩個臥室，一間朝東，一間朝西。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù yǒu liǎng gè wòshì, yī jiān cháo dōng, yī jiān cháo xī.
examples.english: This apartment has two bedrooms — one facing east, one facing west.

semanticNote: Standard greeting gesture in formal and business contexts. 握手言和 (shake hands and make peace), 握手致意 (shake hands as a greeting). In Taiwan, handshakes are used in professional settings; bowing is rarer than in Japan. Post-pandemic, fist bumps became an alternative.

examples.chinese: 兩位候選人在辯論前握了握手，氣氛表面上相當友善。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng wèi hòuxuǎnrén zài biànlùn qián wòle wò shǒu, qìfēn biǎomiàn shàng xiāngdāng yǒushàn.
examples.english: The two candidates shook hands before the debate — the atmosphere was superficially quite friendly.

examples.chinese: 面試結束後，他和主管握手道謝，感謝對方給予機會。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì jiéshù hòu, tā hé zhǔguǎn wòshǒu dàoxiè, gǎnxiè duìfāng jǐyǔ jīhuì.
examples.english: After the interview ended, he shook hands with the manager to express thanks for the opportunity.

semanticNote: Colloquial term for a room or small house. Less formal than 房子 (house) or 房間 (room). Conveys a more intimate, lived-in sense. 屋子裡 (inside the room), 一間小屋子 (a small room/house). Common in storytelling and colloquial description.

examples.chinese: 外面下大雨，他縮在小小的屋子裡聽著雨聲發呆。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià dàyǔ, tā suō zài xiǎoxiǎo de wūzi lǐ tīngzhe yǔshēng fādāi.
examples.english: Outside it was pouring — he huddled in his small room, zoning out to the sound of the rain.

examples.chinese: 整間屋子都是他自己佈置的，每個角落都很有個人風格。
examples.pinyin: Zhěng jiān wūzi dōu shì tā zìjǐ bùzhì de, měi gè jiǎoluò dōu hěn yǒu gèrén fēnggé.
examples.english: He decorated the whole room himself — every corner has a distinctive personal style.

english: helpless; having no choice; can't help it; (used as conj.) unfortunately; however
semanticNote: Captures a sense of resigned helplessness — you wish you could do otherwise but circumstances prevent it. 無奈之舉 (an act done out of helplessness). As a conjunction (more formal/written): 我很想去，無奈時間不允許 (I'd love to go, but unfortunately time doesn't permit).

components.meaning: how; what to do; put up with

examples.chinese: 他其實不想離開台灣，但工作機會在國外，也只能無奈接受。
examples.pinyin: Tā qíshí bù xiǎng líkāi Táiwān, dàn gōngzuò jīhuì zài guówài, yě zhǐ néng wúnài jiēshòu.
examples.english: He actually didn't want to leave Taiwan, but the work opportunity was abroad — he had no choice but to accept it with resignation.

examples.chinese: 看著孩子整天玩手機，父母一臉無奈，卻又不知道怎麼溝通。
examples.pinyin: Kànzhe háizi zhěngtiān wán shǒujī, fùmǔ yī liǎn wúnài, què yòu bù zhīdào zěnme gōutōng.
examples.english: Watching their child play with the phone all day, the parents looked helplessly resigned, not knowing how to communicate.

semanticNote: Hyperbolic expression meaning an extremely large, uncountable quantity. 無數次 (countless times), 無數的星星 (innumerable stars). More emphatic than 很多 and implies genuine vastness or abundance. Common in literary and descriptive contexts.

examples.chinese: 在山頂俯瞰城市，夜晚無數的燈光閃爍，美得令人窒息。
examples.pinyin: Zài shāndǐng fǔkàn chéngshì, yèwǎn wúshù de dēngguāng shǎnshuò, měi de lìng rén zhìxī.
examples.english: Looking down at the city from the mountain summit, the countless twinkling lights at night are breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.chinese: 她為了這個目標努力了無數次，終於在今天取得了突破。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile zhège mùbiāo nǔlìle wúshù cì, zhōngyú zài jīntiān qǔdéle túpò.
examples.english: She worked toward this goal countless times and finally achieved a breakthrough today.

english: doesn't matter; indifferent; be of no consequence
semanticNote: Can mean genuine indifference (we both win/lose equally) or easygoing acceptance — 你決定，我無所謂 (you decide, I don't mind). Can also imply irresponsibility: 他對什麼都無所謂 (he's indifferent to everything — often negative). Tone and context determine whether it's easygoing or careless.

examples.chinese: 去哪吃飯我無所謂，你決定吧。
examples.pinyin: Qù nǎ chīfàn wǒ wúsuǒwèi, nǐ juédìng ba.
examples.english: I don't mind where we eat — you decide.

examples.chinese: 他對公司的規定一副無所謂的態度，讓主管很頭痛。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōngsī de guīdìng yī fù wúsuǒwèi de tàidù, ràng zhǔguǎn hěn tóuténg.
examples.english: His dismissive attitude toward company regulations gives his manager a headache.

semanticNote: Encompasses the full range of Chinese martial arts traditions — 功夫 (kung fu) is a subset. In Taiwan, 武術 is practiced as sport, art, and cultural heritage. 武術比賽 (martial arts competition). Distinct from 太極拳 (a specific internal style). 武俠小說 (martial arts fiction) is a hugely popular genre in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 他從小練武術，後來代表台灣參加了亞洲武術錦標賽。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo liàn wǔshù, hòulái dàibiǎo Táiwān cānjiāle yàzhōu wǔshù jǐnbiāosài.
examples.english: He trained in martial arts from a young age and later represented Taiwan in the Asian Martial Arts Championships.

examples.chinese: 金庸的武俠小說在台灣擁有一大批忠實讀者。
examples.pinyin: Jīn Yōng de wǔxiá xiǎoshuō zài Táiwān yōngyǒu yī dàpī zhōngshí dúzhě.
examples.english: Jin Yong's martial arts novels have a large and devoted readership in Taiwan.

semanticNote: Classical/formal negation used exclusively in written prohibitions and warnings. Never used in casual speech — 不要 or 別 serve that function. Common in public signs: 請勿吸菸 (No Smoking), 請勿飲食 (No eating or drinking), 請勿觸摸 (Please do not touch). Also in 勿忘 (do not forget), 切勿 (absolutely must not).

examples.chinese: 展覽館內請勿拍照，以保護文物。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎnlǎnguǎn nèi qǐng wù pāizhào, yǐ bǎohù wénwù.
examples.english: Photography is not permitted inside the exhibition hall to protect the artifacts.

examples.chinese: 捷運車廂內請勿飲食，這是基本的公共禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn chēxiāng nèi qǐng wù yǐnshí, zhè shì jīběn de gōnggòng lǐmào.
examples.english: Please refrain from eating or drinking in the MRT carriage — this is basic public etiquette.

semanticNote: The academic subject of physics (物理學). In Taiwan's high school system, 物理 is a core science subject alongside 化學 (chemistry) and 生物 (biology). 物理治療 (physical therapy) is a different compound. 量子物理 (quantum physics), 應用物理 (applied physics).

examples.chinese: 他高中時物理成績很差，大學卻選擇念電機系，還是要補很多基礎。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāozhōng shí wùlǐ chéngjì hěn chà, dàxué què xuǎnzé niàn diànjīxì, háishi yào bǔ hěn duō jīchǔ.
examples.english: His physics grades in high school were terrible, but he chose electrical engineering in university — he still has a lot of foundational gaps to fill.

examples.chinese: 台積電的晶片製程仰賴精密的量子物理原理。
examples.pinyin: Táijīdiàn de jīngpiàn zhìchéng yǎnglài jīngmì de liàngzǐ wùlǐ yuánlǐ.
examples.english: TSMC's chip manufacturing processes rely on precise principles of quantum physics.

english: matter; substance; material; material (as opposed to spiritual)
semanticNote: In physics: matter/substance (物質世界 — the material world). In everyday use: material goods or conditions (物質生活 — material life, 物質條件 — material conditions). The contrast 物質 vs. 精神 (material vs. spiritual) is a common philosophical pairing in Chinese discourse.

examples.chinese: 現代台灣人的物質生活比上一代改善了很多，但壓力也更大了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài Táiwān rén de wùzhì shēnghuó bǐ shàng yīdài gǎishànle hěn duō, dàn yālì yě gèng dà le.
examples.english: Modern Taiwanese people's material standard of living has improved greatly compared to the previous generation, but the stress is also greater.

examples.chinese: 化學課教我們，所有物質都由原子和分子構成。
examples.pinyin: Huàxué kè jiāo wǒmen, suǒyǒu wùzhì dōu yóu yuánzǐ hé fēnzǐ gòuchéng.
examples.english: Chemistry class taught us that all matter is composed of atoms and molecules.

semanticNote: 大霧 (dense fog), 霧霾 (smog, lit. fog-haze), 起霧 (fog rolling in). In Taiwan, mountain areas like 阿里山 are famous for 雲霧 (cloud and mist). Coastal 霧 is common in northern Taiwan in winter. 霧裡看花 (looking at flowers through fog — seeing things unclearly) is a common idiom.

examples.chinese: 阿里山清晨的雲霧繚繞，讓人感覺像是置身仙境。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān qīngchén de yúnwù liáorào, ràng rén gǎnjué xiàng shì zhìshēn xiānjìng.
examples.english: The swirling clouds and mist on Alishan in the early morning make you feel like you're in a fairyland.

examples.chinese: 今天霧很大，開車上山時能見度不到十公尺，要格外小心。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wù hěn dà, kāichē shàng shān shí néng jiàn dù bù dào shí gōngchǐ, yào géwài xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The fog is very thick today — visibility while driving up the mountain is under ten meters, so be extra careful.

english: to absorb; to draw on; to learn from; to assimilate
semanticNote: Emphasizes actively drawing in something beneficial — 吸取教訓 (learn a lesson from experience; draw on a lesson) is an extremely common collocation. Slightly more volitional than 吸收 — you actively select and internalize. Common in educational and self-improvement contexts.

examples.chinese: 這次失敗讓他吸取了很多教訓，決定重新調整策略。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài ràng tā xīqǔle hěn duō jiàoxùn, juédìng chóngxīn tiáozhěng cèlüè.
examples.english: This failure taught him many lessons and he decided to completely revise his strategy.

examples.chinese: 創業者要善於吸取前輩的經驗，少走冤枉路。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngyè zhě yào shàn yú xīqǔ qiánbèi de jīngyàn, shǎo zǒu yuānwāng lù.
examples.english: Entrepreneurs should be good at drawing on the experience of predecessors to avoid unnecessary pitfalls.

english: to absorb; to take in; to ingest; to recruit (members)
semanticNote: Broader than 吸取 — covers physical absorption (植物吸收水分 — plants absorb water), mental assimilation (吸收知識 — absorb knowledge), and organizational recruiting (吸收新成員 — recruit new members). More neutral and automatic in connotation than the active 吸取.

examples.chinese: 早上曬太陽可以幫助皮膚吸收維生素D。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang shài tàiyáng kěyǐ bāngzhù pífū xīshōu wéishēngsù D.
examples.english: Getting sun in the morning helps the skin absorb vitamin D.

examples.chinese: 孩子的大腦在幼兒期吸收資訊的速度驚人。
examples.pinyin: Háizi de dànǎo zài yòu'ér qī xīshōu zīxùn de sùdù jīngrén.
examples.english: The speed at which a child's brain absorbs information during early childhood is astonishing.

semanticNote: Encompasses theatrical drama broadly — 歌劇 (opera), 話劇 (spoken drama), 歌仔戲 (Taiwanese opera). In Taiwan, 歌仔戲 is the beloved local form of 戲劇. 戲劇性 (dramatic) is commonly used as an adjective: 戲劇性的轉折 (dramatic turn of events).

examples.chinese: 台灣的歌仔戲是融合閩南語和本土元素的傳統戲劇形式。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de gēzǎixì shì rónghé Mǐnnányǔ hé běntǔ yuánsù de chuántǒng xìjù xíngshì.
examples.english: Taiwan's gezaixi is a traditional theatrical form that blends Hokkien and local Taiwanese elements.

examples.chinese: 這場比賽最後幾分鐘出現了戲劇性的大逆轉，觀眾全都沸騰了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài zuìhòu jǐ fēnzhōng chūxiànle xìjùxìng de dà nìzhuǎn, guānzhòng quán dōu fèiténg le.
examples.english: A dramatic reversal in the final minutes of the match sent the crowd into a frenzy.

english: xì: system; department/faculty; relate to | jì: to tie; fasten
semanticNote: Two readings: 系 (xì) as noun — university department (中文系, 電機系), system (太陽系 — solar system), lineage; 系 (jì) as verb — to tie or fasten (系鞋帶 — tie shoelaces). In Taiwan, 學系 or simply 系 is how university departments are referred to.

examples.chinese: 她考上了台大法律系，全家都為她驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎo shàngle Tái Dà fǎlǜ xì, quánjiā dōu wèi tā jiāo'ào.
examples.english: She passed the entrance exam for NTU's law department — the whole family is proud of her.

examples.chinese: 出門前記得把安全帽的扣子系好。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián jìdé bǎ ānquánmào de kòuzi jì hǎo.
examples.english: Before going out, remember to fasten the strap on your helmet.

semanticNote: The small points that make up the full picture. 注重細節 (pay attention to detail) is a valued professional trait in Taiwan workplaces. 細節決定成敗 (details determine success or failure) is a common saying. Contrast 大局 (the big picture).

examples.chinese: 這份合約的細節很多，簽名前一定要仔細看清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn héyuē de xìjié hěn duō, qiānmíng qián yīdìng yào zǐxì kàn qīngchǔ.
examples.english: This contract has many details — make sure to read it carefully before signing.

examples.chinese: 她是個注重細節的人，連簡報的字型和間距都要反覆確認。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè zhùzhòng xìjié de rén, lián jiǎnbào de zìxíng hé jiànjù dōu yào fǎnfù quèrèn.
examples.english: She's someone who pays close attention to detail — she double-checks even the font and spacing in presentations.

english: blind; recklessly; randomly; to no purpose
semanticNote: Literal: 瞎子 (blind person), 瞎眼 (blind eyes). Colloquial adverbial use is very common: 瞎說 (talk nonsense), 瞎猜 (guess randomly), 瞎搞 (mess around without purpose), 瞎忙 (be busy for nothing). This colloquial use is more common in everyday Taiwan speech than the literal sense.

examples.chinese: 你別瞎猜了，直接去問他本人就知道了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié xiā cāi le, zhíjiē qù wèn tā běnrén jiù zhīdào le.
examples.english: Stop guessing randomly — just go ask him directly and you'll know.

examples.chinese: 他忙了一整天，結果什麼都沒完成，真是瞎忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā mángle yī zhěng tiān, jiéguǒ shéme dōu méi wánchéng, zhēn shì xiā máng.
examples.english: He was busy all day and accomplished nothing — a complete waste of effort.

semanticNote: Standard digital term. 下載應用程式 (download an app), 下載速度 (download speed). Opposite: 上傳 (upload). In Taiwan, 下載 is the standard term used across all contexts. Common collocations: 免費下載 (free download), 非法下載 (illegal download).

examples.chinese: 你可以在App Store上免費下載這款健身應用程式。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài App Store shàng miǎnfèi xiàzǎi zhè kuǎn jiànshēn yìngyòng chéngshì.
examples.english: You can download this fitness app for free on the App Store.

examples.chinese: 非法下載有版權的音樂或電影在台灣是違法的。
examples.pinyin: Fēifǎ xiàzǎi yǒu bǎnquán de yīnyuè huò diànyǐng zài Táiwān shì wéifǎ de.
examples.english: Illegally downloading copyrighted music or movies is against the law in Taiwan.

english: xià: to frighten; to scare; to startle | hè: to intimidate; to threaten
semanticNote: Two tones, two uses: 嚇 (xià) — to startle or frighten, usually unintentional or mild (把我嚇了一跳 — gave me a fright); 嚇 (hè) — to intimidate deliberately (恐嚇 — threaten/intimidate). The xià reading is by far more common in everyday speech.

examples.chinese: 他突然從門後跳出來，把我嚇了一大跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán cóng mén hòu tiào chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī dà tiào.
examples.english: He suddenly jumped out from behind the door and gave me a huge fright.

examples.chinese: 她看到蟑螂嚇得大叫，整個樓層的人都跑過來看。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn dào zhāngláng xià de dà jiào, zhěnggè lóucéng de rén dōu pǎo guòlái kàn.
examples.english: She screamed in terror when she saw a cockroach — everyone on the whole floor came running.

semanticNote: A structured program for children or young people during summer vacation. In Taiwan, summer camps range from language-learning camps (英語夏令營) to sports, arts, and science camps. Often organized by schools, churches (教會), or government youth organizations. 冬令營 is the winter equivalent.

examples.chinese: 媽媽幫我報名了英語夏令營，地點在台東，為期兩週。
examples.pinyin: Māma bāng wǒ bàomíng le yīngyǔ xiàlìngyíng, dìdiǎn zài Táidōng, wéiqī liǎng zhōu.
examples.english: Mom signed me up for an English summer camp in Taitung — it runs for two weeks.

examples.chinese: 那次夏令營讓他第一次學會了獨立生活，回來後整個人成熟了很多。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì xiàlìngyíng ràng tā dì yī cì xuéhuìle dúlì shēnghuó, huílái hòu zhěnggèrén chéngshú le hěn duō.
examples.english: That summer camp was the first time he learned to live independently — when he came back he had matured a great deal.

semanticNote: Describes colors that are saturated and vibrant — 鮮豔的花朵 (vividly colored flowers), 顏色鮮豔 (brightly colored). Applied to clothing, flowers, decorations. The antonym is 暗淡 (dull/dim). Common in descriptions of 廟會 decorations and traditional costumes.

examples.chinese: 廟會上的旗幟和燈籠顏色鮮豔，讓整條街道喜氣洋洋。
examples.pinyin: Miàohuì shàng de qízhì hé dēnglóng yánsè xiānyàn, ràng zhěng tiáo jiēdào xǐqì yángyáng.
examples.english: The brightly colored flags and lanterns at the temple fair filled the whole street with a festive atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 她穿了一件鮮豔的紅色洋裝，在人群中格外顯眼。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuānle yī jiàn xiānyàn de hóngsè yángzhuāng, zài rénqún zhōng géwài xiǎnyǎn.
examples.english: She wore a vivid red dress that made her stand out conspicuously in the crowd.

english: to seem; to appear; to look (a certain way)
semanticNote: Used when something gives an impression or appears to be a certain way — based on observable evidence. 顯得很疲憊 (looks/seems very tired), 顯得格外重要 (appears especially important). Differs from 看起來 (look) in being slightly more formal and often used in written or analytical contexts.

examples.chinese: 他連日加班，整個人顯得非常憔悴。
examples.pinyin: Tā liánrì jiābān, zhěnggèrén xiǎnde fēicháng qiáocuì.
examples.english: He's been working overtime day after day — he looks utterly haggard.

examples.chinese: 在這個場合，穿得太隨便會顯得不夠尊重。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège chǎnghé, chuān de tài suíbiàn huì xiǎnde bùgòu zūnzhòng.
examples.english: At this occasion, dressing too casually would appear disrespectful.

semanticNote: Used when something is self-evident from the available evidence. 顯然他不知道 (it's obviously he didn't know), 顯然這個方法行不通 (it's clear this method won't work). More conclusive and assertive than 好像 (seems like). Common in logical argumentation and analytical writing.

examples.chinese: 他上台的時候臉都紅了，顯然非常緊張。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngtái de shíhòu liǎn dōu hóng le, xiǎnrán fēicháng jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: His face turned red when he went on stage — it was obvious he was very nervous.

examples.chinese: 這個解釋顯然站不住腳，沒有人相信他說的話。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiěshì xiǎnrán zhàn bù zhù jiǎo, méiyǒu rén xiāngxìn tā shuō de huà.
examples.english: This explanation obviously doesn't hold up — no one believed what he said.

english: to show; to display; to indicate; display
semanticNote: Used both for technology displaying information (螢幕顯示 — screen displays; 顯示器 — monitor/display) and for abstract evidence showing something (數據顯示 — data shows/indicates). 顯示 is more formal than 表示 (indicate/express) and often signals objective evidence.

examples.chinese: 最新調查數據顯示，台灣民眾對健保制度的滿意度相當高。
examples.pinyin: Zuìxīn diàochá shùjù xiǎnshì, Táiwān mínzhòng duì jiànbǎo zhìdù de mǎnyìdù xiāngdāng gāo.
examples.english: The latest survey data shows that public satisfaction with Taiwan's health insurance system is quite high.

examples.chinese: 手機螢幕顯示電量只剩下五趴，得趕緊找地方充電。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī yíngmù xiǎnshì diànliàng zhǐ shèng xià wǔ pā, děi gǎnjǐn zhǎo dìfāng chōngdiàn.
examples.english: The phone screen shows only 5% battery left — I need to find somewhere to charge it fast.

semanticNote: In Taiwan's administrative structure, 縣 (county) is a key tier — e.g., 花蓮縣, 屏東縣, 南投縣. Counties are subdivided into 鄉 (townships) and 鎮 (towns). Major cities have been upgraded to 直轄市 (special municipalities), but 縣 remains important for most of Taiwan's geographic area.

examples.chinese: 花蓮縣地廣人稀，自然景觀壯麗，是登山客的天堂。
examples.pinyin: Huālián xiàn dì guǎng rén xī, zìrán jǐngguān zhuànglì, shì dēngshān kè de tiāntáng.
examples.english: Hualien County is vast and sparsely populated, with magnificent natural scenery — a paradise for hikers.

examples.chinese: 苗栗縣每年舉辦的桐花祭吸引大批遊客前往賞花。
examples.pinyin: Miáolì xiàn měi nián jǔbàn de tónghuā jì xīyǐn dàpī yóukè qiánwǎng shǎnghuā.
examples.english: The Tung Blossom Festival held in Miaoli County every year attracts large numbers of visitors for flower viewing.

english: modern times; the modern era; modern; contemporary
semanticNote: As a noun: 現代 (modern times, roughly 20th century to present). As an adjective: modern/contemporary — 現代建築 (modern architecture), 現代化 (modernization). In Taiwan's literary context, 現代詩 (modern poetry) is a major genre. 現代人 (modern people, people of today).

examples.chinese: 台灣現代建築融合了東西方元素，很多作品都獲得國際獎項。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàndài jiànzhú rónghéle dōngxī fāng yuánsù, hěn duō zuòpǐn dōu huòdé guójì jiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: Taiwan's modern architecture blends Eastern and Western elements, and many works have won international awards.

examples.chinese: 現代人生活節奏快，許多人選擇在網路上購物和辦理銀行事務。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén shēnghuó jiézòu kuài, xǔduō rén xuǎnzé zài wǎnglù shàng gòuwù hé bànlǐ yínháng shìwù.
examples.english: Modern people have fast-paced lives — many choose to shop and do their banking online.

semanticNote: As a noun: 現實 is the real world as opposed to ideals or imagination — 面對現實 (face reality), 逃避現實 (escape from reality). As an adjective: 現實的考量 (practical considerations), or critically: 這個人很現實 (this person is very materialistic/self-interested). The adjective sense can be mildly pejorative.

examples.chinese: 夢想固然重要，但也要顧及現實的條件和限制。
examples.pinyin: Mèngxiǎng gùrán zhòngyào, dàn yě yào gùjí xiànshí de tiáojiàn hé xiànzhì.
examples.english: Dreams are important, but you also need to take into account the practical conditions and constraints of reality.

examples.chinese: 她說他太現實，眼裡只有錢，讓她很失望。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā tài xiànshí, yǎn lǐ zhǐ yǒu qián, ràng tā hěn shīwàng.
examples.english: She said he's too materialistic — all he sees is money — and she was very disappointed in him.

semanticNote: Refers to an observable occurrence or pattern — social, natural, or psychological. 社會現象 (social phenomenon), 自然現象 (natural phenomenon), 普遍現象 (widespread phenomenon). In academic and journalistic writing, 這一現象 (this phenomenon) is a standard framing device.

examples.chinese: 少子化是台灣目前最嚴重的社會現象之一，政府持續研擬因應對策。
examples.pinyin: Shǎozǐhuà shì Táiwān mùqián zuì yánzhòng de shèhuì xiànxiàng zhī yī, zhèngfǔ chíxù yányì yīnyìng duìcè.
examples.english: Declining birth rates are one of Taiwan's most serious social phenomena — the government continues to devise countermeasures.

examples.chinese: 彩虹是陽光透過水珠折射所產生的自然現象。
examples.pinyin: Cǎihóng shì yángguāng tòuguò shuǐzhū zhéshè suǒ chǎnshēng de zìrán xiànxiàng.
examples.english: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon produced by sunlight refracting through water droplets.

english: to restrict; to limit; to place restrictions on; restriction; limitation
semanticNote: Covers legal, technical, and social restrictions. 限制條件 (conditions/restrictions), 年齡限制 (age restriction), 解除限制 (lift restrictions). In Taiwan's media context, 限制級 is the R-equivalent rating for films. Opposite: 解除限制, 放寬限制 (loosen restrictions).

examples.chinese: 這個停車場對車輛高度有限制，超過兩公尺的車無法進入。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tíngchēchǎng duì chēliàng gāodù yǒu xiànzhì, chāoguò liǎng gōngchǐ de chē wúfǎ jìnrù.
examples.english: This parking lot has a height restriction on vehicles — cars taller than two meters cannot enter.

examples.chinese: 政府宣布解除口罩限制後，街頭的氣氛明顯輕鬆了許多。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù jiěchú kǒuzhào xiànzhì hòu, jiētóu de qìfēn míngxiǎn qīngsōng le xǔduō.
examples.english: After the government announced the lifting of mask restrictions, the atmosphere on the streets noticeably relaxed.

english: to get along; to interact; to live together
semanticNote: Describes the quality of interaction between people who share space or time. 相處融洽 (get along harmoniously), 相處愉快 (enjoy each other's company), 難以相處 (difficult to get along with). Important in describing relationships — roommates, colleagues, family.

components.meaning: be in; get along; manage; place

examples.chinese: 她和室友相處得很好，兩個人常常一起做飯聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé shìyǒu xiāngchǔ de hěn hǎo, liǎng gèrén chángcháng yīqǐ zuòfàn liáotiān.
examples.english: She gets along very well with her roommate — the two of them often cook and chat together.

examples.chinese: 同事之間要互相尊重，才能在職場上和諧相處。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì zhī jiān yào hùxiāng zūnzhòng, cái néng zài zhíchǎng shàng héxié xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: Colleagues need to respect one another in order to coexist harmoniously in the workplace.

english: quite; considerably; fairly; equivalent to; appropriate
semanticNote: As an adverb: 相當好 (quite good), 相當重要 (considerably important) — a mid-level intensifier, stronger than 比較 but softer than 非常. As adjective: 相當於 (equivalent to), 工資相當 (comparable wages). Very versatile and common.

examples.chinese: 這道數學題對國中生來說相當有難度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào shùxué tí duì guózhōngshēng lái shuō xiāngdāng yǒu nándù.
examples.english: This math problem is quite challenging for a junior high school student.

examples.chinese: 台灣的生活費相當於歐洲二線城市的水準，CP值很高。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de shēnghuófèi xiāngdāng yú Ōuzhōu èr xiàn chéngshì de shuǐzhǔn, CP zhí hěn gāo.
examples.english: The cost of living in Taiwan is equivalent to a second-tier European city, making it excellent value.

english: relative; comparatively; facing each other; relatively
semanticNote: Two senses: (1) relative/comparative — 相對而言 (relatively speaking), 相對優勢 (comparative advantage); (2) face each other physically — 兩人相對而坐 (the two sat facing each other). 相對論 is Einstein's theory of relativity. Common in analytical and academic contexts.

examples.chinese: 相對於其他城市，台北的交通算是相對便利。
examples.pinyin: Xiāngduì yú qítā chéngshì, Táiběi de jiāotōng suàn shì xiāngduì biànlì.
examples.english: Compared to other cities, Taipei's transportation is relatively convenient.

examples.chinese: 兩個候選人在辯論台上相對而立，互不相讓。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng gè hòuxuǎnrén zài biànlùntái shàng xiāngduì ér lì, hù bù xiāng ràng.
examples.english: The two candidates stood facing each other on the debate stage, neither willing to give ground.

english: related; relevant; correlated; to be connected to
semanticNote: Used to describe things that are connected or relevant to each other. 相關部門 (relevant authorities/departments), 相關資料 (related materials), 密切相關 (closely related). Very common in formal and bureaucratic writing — 請洽相關單位 (please contact the relevant department).

examples.chinese: 申請工作簽證的相關文件請在出發前備齊。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng gōngzuò qiānzhèng de xiāngguān wénjiàn qǐng zài chūfā qián bèiqí.
examples.english: Please prepare all documents relevant to applying for a work visa before departure.

examples.chinese: 研究發現，睡眠品質與心理健康密切相關。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū fāxiàn, shuìmián pǐnzhì yǔ xīnlǐ jiànkāng mìqiē xiāngguān.
examples.english: Research has found that sleep quality is closely correlated with mental health.

semanticNote: Describes a resemblance between two things or people — 外形相似 (similar in appearance), 想法相似 (similar ideas). More focused on overall likeness than 類似 (similar in type/category). 兩個人長得很相似 (the two look very much alike).

examples.chinese: 這對雙胞胎長得非常相似，連他們的老師都分不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de fēicháng xiāngsì, lián tāmen de lǎoshī dōu fēn bù qīngchǔ.
examples.english: These twins look so similar that even their teacher can't tell them apart.

examples.chinese: 台灣和日本的飲食文化在很多方面都相似，互相影響很深。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hé Rìběn de yǐnshí wénhuà zài hěn duō fāngmiàn dōu xiāngsì, hùxiāng yǐngxiǎng hěn shēn.
examples.english: Taiwan and Japan's food cultures are similar in many respects — the mutual influence between them runs deep.

semanticNote: In Taiwan, 香腸 refers specifically to the grilled Taiwanese pork sausage — a sweet, garlicky style distinct from Western sausages. Ubiquitous at 夜市, 廟口, and sporting events. Commonly grilled on sticks alongside 糯米腸 (sticky rice sausage). 台式香腸 is a beloved street food icon.

examples.chinese: 逛夜市時，烤香腸的香味讓人忍不住停下腳步。
examples.pinyin: Guàng yèshì shí, kǎo xiāngcháng de xiāngwèi ràng rén rěn bù zhù tíng xià jiǎobù.
examples.english: When wandering through the night market, the aroma of grilled sausage makes it impossible to walk past without stopping.

examples.chinese: 台式香腸帶有一點甜味和蒜香，配上生蒜片一起吃最對味。
examples.pinyin: Táishì xiāngcháng dài yǒu yīdiǎn tiánwèi hé suàn xiāng, pèi shàng shēng suànpiàn yīqǐ chī zuì duì wèi.
examples.english: Taiwanese-style sausage has a slight sweetness and garlic fragrance — eating it with raw garlic slices is the perfect pairing.

english: to enjoy; to take pleasure in; enjoyment
semanticNote: Implies actively deriving pleasure from something. 享受生活 (enjoy life), 享受美食 (enjoy good food), 享受假期 (enjoy a vacation). As a noun: 這是一種享受 (this is a pleasure/enjoyment). Slightly more indulgent in connotation than plain 喜歡.

examples.chinese: 退休後，她終於可以慢下來好好享受生活了。
examples.pinyin: Tuìxiū hòu, tā zhōngyú kěyǐ màn xiàlái hǎohǎo xiǎngshòu shēnghuó le.
examples.english: After retiring, she can finally slow down and truly enjoy life.

examples.chinese: 在老街喝一杯現煮的珍珠奶茶，是生活中簡單的小享受。
examples.pinyin: Zài lǎojiē hē yī bēi xiàn zhǔ de zhēnzhū nǎichá, shì shēnghuó zhōng jiǎndān de xiǎo xiǎngshòu.
examples.english: Drinking a freshly brewed bubble tea on the old street is one of life's simple little pleasures.

english: to miss; to long for; to think of with longing
semanticNote: Expresses heartfelt longing for a person or place — deeper and more emotional than simply 想 (think of). 想念家人 (miss family), 想念故鄉 (long for one's hometown). 思念 is a literary/written synonym; 想念 is the more common spoken form.

examples.chinese: 留學的第一個月最難熬，每天都想念媽媽煮的菜。
examples.pinyin: Liúxué de dì yī gè yuè zuì nánáo, měitiān dōu xiǎngniàn māma zhǔ de cài.
examples.english: The first month of studying abroad is the hardest — you miss your mom's cooking every single day.

examples.chinese: 好幾年沒回花蓮了，真的很想念那裡的太平洋海岸。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ nián méi huí Huālián le, zhēnde hěn xiǎngniàn nàlǐ de Tàipíngyáng hǎi'àn.
examples.english: I haven't been back to Hualien in years — I really miss the Pacific coastline there.

semanticNote: The mental act of forming a picture of something not directly experienced. 想像力 (imagination/power of imagination). 難以想像 (hard to imagine) and 不可想像 (unimaginable) are common constructions. Note: both 想象 and 想像 are used in Taiwan, with 想像 being slightly more common in traditional character writing.

examples.chinese: 很難想像沒有網路的現代生活會是什麼樣子。
examples.pinyin: Hěn nán xiǎngxiàng méiyǒu wǎnglù de xiàndài shēnghuó huì shì shéme yàngzi.
examples.english: It's hard to imagine what modern life without the internet would be like.

examples.chinese: 她有豐富的想像力，從小就愛編各種奇幻故事。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu fēngfù de xiǎngxiànglì, cóngxiǎo jiù ài biān gèzhǒng qíhuàn gùshì.
examples.english: She has a rich imagination and has loved making up all kinds of fantasy stories since she was little.

english: item; sum (of money); (mw for items, clauses, tasks); nape of the neck
semanticNote: As measure word: 一項任務 (one task), 一項規定 (one regulation), 幾項要求 (several requirements). 項目 (project/item). The anatomical sense (nape of neck) is rare in modern usage. Very common in lists and official documents: 以下幾項 (the following items).

examples.chinese: 申請入學需要準備以下三項文件：成績單、推薦信和個人自述。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng rùxué xūyào zhǔnbèi yǐxià sān xiàng wénjiàn: chéngjīdān, tuījiànxìn hé gèrén zìshù.
examples.english: Applying for admission requires preparing the following three documents: transcript, recommendation letter, and personal statement.

examples.chinese: 這次比賽共設有五項獎項，每項都有豐厚的獎金。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài gòng shè yǒu wǔ xiàng jiǎngxiàng, měi xiàng dōu yǒu fēnghòu de jiǎngjīn.
examples.english: This competition has five award categories in total, each with a generous cash prize.

semanticNote: A piece of jewelry worn around the neck. 金項鍊 (gold necklace), 玉項鍊 (jade necklace). In Taiwan's gift-giving culture, jade and gold jewelry including 項鍊 are popular gifts for significant life events (graduations, weddings, birthdays). 莫泊桑 wrote the famous story 《項鍊》 (The Necklace).

examples.chinese: 她脖子上戴的那條翡翠項鍊是外婆傳下來的。
examples.pinyin: Tā bózi shàng dài de nà tiáo fěicuì xiàngliàn shì wàipó chuán xiàlái de.
examples.english: The jadeite necklace she's wearing around her neck was passed down from her maternal grandmother.

examples.chinese: 他在情人節送了她一條金項鍊，上面刻著她的名字。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài qíngrén jié sòngle tā yī tiáo jīn xiàngliàn, shàngmiàn kèzhe tā de míngzì.
examples.english: He gave her a gold necklace for Valentine's Day with her name engraved on it.

semanticNote: Broad usage: (1) project/program — 建設項目 (construction project), 研究項目 (research project); (2) sports event — 游泳項目 (swimming event), 田徑項目 (track and field events). 項目管理 (project management) is a core business concept. Very common in formal and professional contexts.

examples.chinese: 這個政府項目預計投入五十億元，改善偏鄉地區的道路和醫療設施。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngfǔ xiàngmù yùjì tóurù wǔshí yì yuán, gǎishàn piānyāng dìqū de dàolù hé yīliáo shèshī.
examples.english: This government project plans to invest five billion NT dollars to improve roads and medical facilities in rural areas.

examples.chinese: 她擅長游泳中的自由式項目，曾代表學校參加全國比賽。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàncháng yóuyǒng zhōng de zìyóushì xiàngmù, céng dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài.
examples.english: She excels in the freestyle swimming event and has represented her school in the national competition.

semanticNote: The traditional Chinese strategy board game, distinct from international chess. Played on a 9×10 board with pieces including 車 (chariot), 馬 (horse), 砲 (cannon), 兵 (soldier). Widely played in Taiwan, especially by older generations in parks and community centers. 下象棋 (play Chinese chess).

examples.chinese: 公園裡幾位老先生圍在石桌旁下象棋，看熱鬧的人也不少。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ jǐ wèi lǎo xiānshēng wéi zài shí zhuō páng xià xiàngqí, kàn rènào de rén yě bùshǎo.
examples.english: Several elderly men gathered around a stone table in the park playing Chinese chess, with a sizable crowd watching.

examples.chinese: 爺爺從小就學下象棋，棋力很高，鄰居沒有人下得過他。
examples.pinyin: Yéye cóngxiǎo jiù xué xià xiàngqí, qílì hěn gāo, línjū méiyǒu rén xià de guò tā.
examples.english: Grandpa learned Chinese chess from a young age and is highly skilled — none of the neighbors can beat him.

semanticNote: Both verb (象徵著希望 — symbolizes hope) and noun (和平的象徵 — a symbol of peace). Rich in Taiwan's cultural life: the 玉山 (Jade Mountain) symbolizes Taiwan's spirit; 梅花 (plum blossom) is Taiwan's national flower and symbolizes resilience. 象徵性 (symbolic, as in a token gesture).

examples.chinese: 梅花是中華民國的國花，象徵著在逆境中堅強的精神。
examples.pinyin: Méihuā shì Zhōnghuá Mínguó de guóhuā, xiàngzhēngzhe zài nìjìng zhōng jiānqiáng de jīngshén.
examples.english: The plum blossom is the Republic of China's national flower, symbolizing the spirit of resilience in adversity.

examples.chinese: 白鴿在許多文化中都是和平的象徵。
examples.pinyin: Bái gē zài xǔduō wénhuà zhōng dōu shì hépíng de xiàngzhēng.
examples.english: The white dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures.

english: to consume; to spend; consumption; expenditure
semanticNote: Economic term for consumer spending. 消費者 (consumer), 消費水準 (consumption level), 刺激消費 (stimulate consumption). In Taiwan, 消費稅 (consumption/sales tax) is embedded in prices (內含稅). 消費者保護法 (Consumer Protection Act) is an important piece of Taiwan legislation.

examples.chinese: 政府推出消費券刺激內需，鼓勵民眾在本地消費。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tuīchū xiāofèiquàn cìjī nèixū, gǔlì mínzhòng zài běndì xiāofèi.
examples.english: The government launched consumption vouchers to stimulate domestic demand and encourage people to spend locally.

examples.chinese: 他習慣記帳，每個月清楚掌握自己的消費狀況。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn jìzhàng, měi gè yuè qīngchǔ zhǎngwò zìjǐ de xiāofèi zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: He makes a habit of keeping accounts — he has a clear grasp of his monthly spending every month.

semanticNote: Literal: the biological process of digesting food — 幫助消化 (aid digestion), 消化不良 (indigestion/dyspepsia). Figurative: process/absorb information — 這麼多內容我一時消化不了 (I can't absorb so much content all at once). Both uses are common in everyday speech.

examples.chinese: 吃完大餐後散散步，有助於消化。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán dàcān hòu sàn sàn bù, yǒu zhùyú xiāohuà.
examples.english: Taking a walk after a big meal helps with digestion.

examples.chinese: 老師一次講了太多新概念，學生來不及消化。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yīcì jiǎngle tài duō xīn gàiniàn, xuéshēng lái bù jí xiāohuà.
examples.english: The teacher introduced too many new concepts at once — the students couldn't absorb it all in time.

semanticNote: Describes a negative, defeatist, or passive attitude. 消極的態度 (negative attitude), 消極怠工 (work passively/go slow). Opposite of 積極 (positive/proactive). In Taiwan's educational context, 消極 is regularly contrasted with 積極 as an undesirable vs. desirable trait.

examples.chinese: 他最近對工作很消極，什麼事都提不起勁來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì gōngzuò hěn xiāojí, shéme shì dōu tí bù qǐ jìn lái.
examples.english: He's been very apathetic about work lately — he can't seem to muster enthusiasm for anything.

examples.chinese: 面對困難時保持消極只會讓問題更難解決。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnán shí bǎochí xiāojí zhǐ huì ràng wèntí gèng nán jiějué.
examples.english: Staying passive in the face of difficulties only makes problems harder to solve.

english: to disappear; to vanish; to fade away
semanticNote: Can describe the disappearance of a person (他消失了幾天 — he disappeared for a few days), a phenomenon (霧消失了 — the fog disappeared), or an emotion (痛苦慢慢消失 — the pain slowly faded). 無影無蹤地消失 (disappear without a trace) is a common intensified form.

examples.chinese: 太陽升起後，山谷裡的晨霧很快就消失了。
examples.pinyin: Tàiyáng shēngqǐ hòu, shāngǔ lǐ de chénwù hěn kuài jiù xiāoshī le.
examples.english: Once the sun rose, the morning mist in the valley quickly disappeared.

examples.chinese: 他突然從朋友圈消失，電話不接、訊息也不回。
examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán cóng péngyǒu quān xiāoshī, diànhuà bù jiē, xùnxī yě bù huí.
examples.english: He suddenly vanished from his social circle — not answering calls or replying to messages.

semanticNote: Business and commercial term: 銷售業績 (sales performance), 銷售額 (sales revenue), 銷售策略 (sales strategy). More formal than 賣 (sell). 業務員/銷售員 (salesperson). Taiwan's semiconductor exports are often discussed in terms of 銷售量 and 銷售額.

examples.chinese: 這款手機上市第一週銷售量就突破了十萬台。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī shàngshì dì yī zhōu xiāoshòuliàng jiù tūpòle shí wàn tái.
examples.english: This phone's sales exceeded 100,000 units in the first week after launch.

examples.chinese: 她在科技公司擔任銷售工程師，負責向企業客戶介紹產品。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài kējì gōngsī dānrèn xiāoshòu gōngchéngshī, fùzé xiàng qǐyè kèhù jièshào chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: She works as a sales engineer at a tech company, responsible for introducing products to corporate clients.

semanticNote: The staple grain for flour-based foods. Taiwan imports most of its wheat from the US, Canada, and Australia. 小麥粉 (wheat flour), 全麥 (whole wheat). Used in 麵條, 饅頭, 包子, and Western baked goods. The local 小麥 grown in 台南 and 嘉義 is gaining popularity as a craft ingredient.

examples.chinese: 台南東山有農民嘗試在地種植小麥，開發本土的全麥麵包。
examples.pinyin: Táinán Dōngshān yǒu nóngmín chángshì zàidì zhòngzhí xiǎomài, kāifā běntǔ de quánmài miànbāo.
examples.english: Farmers in Dongshan, Tainan are experimenting with growing wheat locally to develop domestic whole wheat bread.

examples.chinese: 麵條是由小麥磨成的麵粉製作的，是很多台灣人的主食之一。
examples.pinyin: Miàntiáo shì yóu xiǎomài mó chéng de miànfěn zhìzuò de, shì hěn duō Táiwān rén de zhǔshí zhī yī.
examples.english: Noodles are made from flour milled from wheat — they are one of many Taiwanese people's staple foods.

semanticNote: Describes someone unwilling to spend or share. 小氣鬼 (miser, cheapskate). Can also mean petty/narrow-minded in behavior — 你不要這麼小氣 (don't be so petty about it). In Taiwan's social culture where generosity (大方) is valued, being called 小氣 is mildly unflattering. Antonym: 大方 (generous/gracious).

examples.chinese: 他請客卻只點最便宜的菜，同事都說他有點小氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐngkè què zhǐ diǎn zuì piányí de cài, tóngshì dōu shuō tā yǒudiǎn xiǎoqì.
examples.english: He was treating everyone but only ordered the cheapest dishes — his coworkers all said he was a bit stingy.

examples.chinese: 別這麼小氣，多分你妹妹一塊蛋糕又不會怎樣。
examples.pinyin: Bié zhème xiǎoqì, duō fēn nǐ mèimei yī kuài dàngāo yòu bù huì zěnyàng.
examples.english: Don't be so stingy — sharing one more piece of cake with your sister won't hurt.

english: filial; filially obedient; to show filial piety
semanticNote: Central Confucian virtue — 孝順 encompasses respecting, caring for, and obeying one's parents and elders. In Taiwan, 孝順 is still a highly valued trait and shapes expectations around elder care (many families prefer home care over nursing homes). 不孝 (unfilial) carries significant social stigma.

examples.chinese: 他每個月都會把薪水的一部分交給父母，是出了名的孝順。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi gè yuè dōu huì bǎ xīnshuǐ de yī bùfèn jiāo gěi fùmǔ, shì chūle míng de xiàoshùn.
examples.english: Every month he gives a portion of his salary to his parents — he's famous for his filial devotion.

examples.chinese: 台灣很多家庭選擇自己照顧年老的父母，而不是送去安養院，這體現了孝順的傳統觀念。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hěn duō jiātíng xuǎnzé zìjǐ zhàogù niánlǎo de fùmǔ, ér bú shì sòng qù ān yǎngyuàn, zhè tǐxiànle xiàoshùn de chuántǒng guānniàn.
examples.english: Many Taiwanese families choose to care for their elderly parents themselves rather than sending them to a nursing home — this reflects the traditional value of filial piety.

semanticNote: The ratio of output to input — how effectively something gets done. 工作效率 (work efficiency), 提高效率 (improve efficiency), 效率低落 (low efficiency). Taiwan's tech industry and government reform discussions frequently invoke 效率 as a goal. Contrast 效果 (effectiveness/result).

examples.chinese: 導入AI工具之後，這個部門的工作效率提高了將近三成。
examples.pinyin: Dǎorù AI gōngjù zhī hòu, zhège bùmén de gōngzuò xiàolǜ tígāole jiāng jìn sān chéng.
examples.english: After introducing AI tools, this department's work efficiency improved by nearly thirty percent.

examples.chinese: 她做事效率很高，別人要花一天做的事，她上午就做完了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì xiàolǜ hěn gāo, biérén yào huā yī tiān zuò de shì, tā shàngwǔ jiù zuò wán le.
examples.english: She works with high efficiency — what takes others a whole day, she finishes by morning.

english: to rest; to take a break; to stop; to go to bed
semanticNote: More colloquial than 休息 (rest). Used in spoken language: 歇一歇 (rest a bit), 歇腳 (rest one's feet, stop for a break while traveling), 歇業 (close a business). In northern Taiwanese Mandarin, 歇 can mean 'go to bed' in the evening: 早點歇吧 (go to bed early).

examples.chinese: 爬了兩個小時的山路，大家都累了，在涼亭歇了一會兒。
examples.pinyin: Páile liǎng gè xiǎoshí de shān lù, dàjiā dōu lèi le, zài liángtíng xiēle yīhuìr.
examples.english: After two hours of hiking, everyone was tired and rested for a while in the pavilion.

examples.chinese: 老闆說今天訂單少，讓員工早點歇工回家。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shuō jīntiān dìngdān shǎo, ràng yuángōng zǎodiǎn xiē gōng huíjiā.
examples.english: The boss said orders were light today and let employees knock off early and go home.

english: slanting; tilted; oblique; to tilt; diagonal
