semanticNote: Describes anything not horizontal or vertical — 斜坡 (slope), 斜線 (diagonal line), 斜眼看 (look askance at). 斜 can be a verb of position: 他把帽子斜戴著 (he wore his hat tilted). In typography and math: 斜體 (italics), 斜角 (oblique angle).

examples.chinese: 這棟老房子的地板有點斜，放圓形的東西會滾走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo fángzi de dìbǎn yǒudiǎn xié, fàng yuánxíng de dōngxi huì gǔn zǒu.
examples.english: The floor of this old house is slightly tilted — round objects will roll away.

examples.chinese: 照片拍得有點斜，下次要注意水平線。
examples.pinyin: Zhàopiàn pāi de yǒudiǎn xié, xià cì yào zhùyì shuǐpíngxiàn.
examples.english: The photo came out a bit crooked — pay attention to the horizon line next time.

semanticNote: Refers to the craft and act of writing — 寫作能力 (writing ability), 寫作技巧 (writing skills), 寫作風格 (writing style). In Taiwan's education system, 作文/寫作 is a scored component of the 學測 (GSAT). Creative and literary writing is covered: 寫作坊 (writing workshop).

examples.chinese: 她從高中就熱愛寫作，後來成了知名的小說家。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng gāozhōng jiù rèài xiězuò, hòulái chéngle zhīmíng de xiǎoshuōjiā.
examples.english: She fell in love with writing in high school and later became a well-known novelist.

examples.chinese: 學測的國文寫作題要求考生在有限的時間內完成一篇有結構的文章。
examples.pinyin: Xuécè de guówén xiězuò tí yāoqiú kǎoshēng zài yǒuxiàn de shíjiān nèi wánchéng yī piān yǒu jiégòu de wénzhāng.
examples.english: The GSAT Chinese writing question requires test-takers to complete a structured essay within a limited time.

semanticNote: Two readings: 血 (xuè) — formal/written (血型 — blood type, 血壓 — blood pressure, 流血 — bleed); 血 (xiě) — colloquial northern Mandarin variant (流了很多血 — bled a lot). 獻血 (donate blood) — Taiwan has active blood donation campaigns. 血汗工廠 (sweatshop, lit. blood-and-sweat factory) is a common critical term.

examples.chinese: 捐血一袋救人一命，台灣捐血活動的參與率很高。
examples.pinyin: Juān xuè yī dài jiù rén yī mìng, Táiwān juānxuè huódòng de cānyù lǜ hěn gāo.
examples.english: Donating one bag of blood saves a life — participation rates in Taiwan's blood donation campaigns are very high.

examples.chinese: 他不小心被刀割傷了手，流了不少血。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn bèi dāo gēshāngle shǒu, liúle bùshǎo xiě.
examples.english: He accidentally cut his hand with a knife and bled quite a lot.

semanticNote: Both the field of psychology (心理學) and an adjective modifier (心理狀態 — mental state, 心理健康 — mental health, 心理諮商 — counseling/psychological consultation). Mental health awareness has grown significantly in Taiwan in recent years, with 心理諮商 becoming more normalized.

examples.chinese: 學校設有心理諮商室，同學有壓力可以預約晤談。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào shè yǒu xīnlǐ zīshāng shì, tóngxué yǒu yālì kěyǐ yùyuē wùtán.
examples.english: The school has a counseling room — students under stress can make an appointment to talk with a counselor.

examples.chinese: 他的心理狀態不太穩定，醫生建議他定期接受心理治療。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xīnlǐ zhuàngtài bú tài wěndìng, yīshēng jiànyì tā dìqī jiēshòu xīnlǐ zhìliáo.
examples.english: His mental state has been unstable — the doctor recommended regular psychological therapy.

semanticNote: The physical heart organ — 心臟病 (heart disease), 心臟手術 (heart surgery), 心臟跳動 (heartbeat). 心臟 is also used colloquially: 他心臟很大顆 (he has a big heart — nerves of steel, not easily scared). The Taiwan 全民健保 covers cardiac care extensively.

examples.chinese: 爺爺因為心臟病住院，醫生說需要做支架手術。
examples.pinyin: Yéye yīnwèi xīnzàngbìng zhùyuàn, yīshēng shuō xūyào zuò zhījià shǒushù.
examples.english: Grandpa was hospitalized for heart disease — the doctor said he needs a stent procedure.

examples.chinese: 運動員的心臟普遍比一般人更強壯，每分鐘跳動次數也較少。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng yuán de xīnzàng pǔbiàn bǐ yībān rén gèng qiángzhuàng, měi fēnzhōng tiàodòng cìshù yě jiào shǎo.
examples.english: Athletes' hearts are generally stronger than average people's, and their resting heart rate is also lower.

english: to appreciate; to admire; to enjoy (art, scenery, music)
semanticNote: Implies an aesthetic or intellectual appreciation — 欣賞音樂 (appreciate music), 欣賞美景 (enjoy beautiful scenery), 欣賞一個人 (admire a person). More elevated than 喜歡 (like) — 欣賞 suggests thoughtful engagement with something's qualities. 我很欣賞你 is a genuine compliment.

examples.chinese: 她很欣賞他做事認真、不計較個人得失的精神。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xīnshǎng tā zuòshì rènzhēn, bù jìjiào gèrén déshī de jīngshén.
examples.english: She greatly admires his conscientious approach to work and his indifference to personal gain or loss.

examples.chinese: 合歡山是欣賞台灣高山星空的絕佳地點，每年吸引大批攝影愛好者。
examples.pinyin: Héhuān shān shì xīnshǎng Táiwān gāoshān xīngkōng de juéjiā dìdiǎn, měi nián xīyǐn dàpī shèyǐng àihào zhě.
examples.english: Hehuan Mountain is an excellent location for appreciating Taiwan's high-altitude starry sky — it attracts many photography enthusiasts every year.

semanticNote: Both physical signals (手機訊號 — mobile phone signal; 交通信號 — traffic signal) and figurative signs (發出信號 — send a signal/warning). In Taiwan, 訊號 is the more common written form for electronic/mobile signals; 信號 and 訊號 are used somewhat interchangeably.

examples.chinese: 爬到山頂附近時手機完全沒有信號，只能靠對講機聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Pá dào shāndǐng fùjìn shí shǒujī wánquán méiyǒu xìnhào, zhǐ néng kào duìjiǎng jī liánluò.
examples.english: When we got near the mountain summit, the phone had no signal at all — we could only communicate by walkie-talkie.

examples.chinese: 他頻繁遲到是一個信號，說明他對這份工作已經失去了熱情。
examples.pinyin: Tā pínfán chídào shì yī gè xìnhào, shuōmíng tā duì zhè fèn gōngzuò yǐjīng shīqùle rèqíng.
examples.english: His frequent lateness is a signal that he has already lost his enthusiasm for this job.

english: to trust; to have confidence in; trust
semanticNote: The foundation of relationships in both personal and professional life. 建立信任 (build trust), 失去信任 (lose trust), 信任危機 (crisis of trust). In Taiwan's political context, 民眾對政府的信任度 (public trust in the government) is a frequently surveyed metric.

examples.chinese: 信任是一段關係的基礎，一旦破壞了很難修復。
examples.pinyin: Xìnrèn shì yī duàn guānxi de jīchǔ, yīdàn pòhuài le hěn nán xiūfù.
examples.english: Trust is the foundation of a relationship — once broken, it's very hard to repair.

examples.chinese: 老闆很信任他，讓他獨立負責這個重要項目。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn xìnrèn tā, ràng tā dúlì fùzé zhège zhòngyào xiàngmù.
examples.english: The boss trusts him greatly and has put him in sole charge of this important project.

english: to move; to take action; action; operation
semanticNote: Covers both physical mobility (行動不便 — mobility impaired) and purposeful action (採取行動 — take action; 軍事行動 — military operation). 行動電話 (mobile phone, lit. action phone) is the Taiwan term for 手機. 行動力 (ability to take action; drive).

examples.chinese: 光說不做沒有用，現在是採取行動的時候了。
examples.pinyin: Guāng shuō bù zuò méiyǒu yòng, xiànzài shì cǎiqǔ xíngdòng de shíhòu le.
examples.english: Just talking without doing is useless — now is the time to take action.

examples.chinese: 他因為車禍導致行動不便，需要靠輪椅出行。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chēhuò dǎozhì xíngdòng bùbiàn, xūyào kào lúnyǐ chūxíng.
examples.english: He has mobility difficulties due to a car accident and needs a wheelchair to get around.

semanticNote: People on foot in traffic contexts. 行人穿越道 (pedestrian crossing), 行人優先 (pedestrians have right of way). In Taiwan, road safety for pedestrians is an ongoing public concern — 斑馬線 (zebra crossing) enforcement has been tightened in recent years. 行人徒步區 (pedestrian zone).

examples.chinese: 在台灣，車輛在行人穿越道前必須讓行人先行。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, chēliàng zài xíngrén chuānyuèdào qián bìxū ràng xíngrén xiān xíng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, vehicles must yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.

examples.chinese: 西門町一帶設有行人徒步區，假日時人潮非常洶湧。
examples.pinyin: Xīméndīng yīdài shè yǒu xíngrén túbùqū, jiàrì shí réncháo fēicháng xiōngyǒng.
examples.english: The Ximending area has a pedestrian zone — crowds are overwhelming on weekends.

semanticNote: The outward expression of someone's choices and character. 不當行為 (inappropriate behavior), 行為舉止 (behavior and manner), 行為準則 (code of conduct). In Taiwan's legal system, 行為 is a key concept — 刑事行為 (criminal act). 行為藝術 (performance art).

examples.chinese: 老師說，言行一致才是真正有品格的行為。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, yán xíng yīzhì cái shì zhēnzhèng yǒu pǐngé de xíngwéi.
examples.english: The teacher said that matching words with actions is the truly characterful way to behave.

examples.chinese: 校規明確規定哪些行為是不被允許的，違反者將受到處分。
examples.pinyin: Xiào guī míngquè guīdìng nǎxiē xíngwéi shì bù bèi yǔnxǔ de, wéifǎn zhě jiāng shòudào chǔfèn.
examples.english: School rules clearly specify which behaviors are not permitted — those who violate them will face disciplinary action.

english: to form; to take shape; to develop into
semanticNote: Describes the process of something coming into being or taking its final form, often gradually. 形成共識 (reach a consensus), 形成對比 (form a contrast), 形成習慣 (form a habit). Common in academic, scientific, and analytical writing.

examples.chinese: 台灣獨特的飲食文化是由原住民、漢人、日本和外省文化共同形成的。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān dútè de yǐnshí wénhuà shì yóu yuánzhùmín, Hànrén, Rìběn hé wàishěng wénhuà gòngtóng xíngchéng de.
examples.english: Taiwan's unique food culture was formed from the combined influences of Indigenous, Han Chinese, Japanese, and mainland immigrant cultures.

examples.chinese: 良好的生活習慣需要長時間培養才能形成。
examples.pinyin: Liánghǎo de shēnghuó xíguàn xūyào cháng shíjiān péiyǎng cái néng xíngchéng.
examples.english: Good lifestyle habits take a long time to cultivate before they form.

english: to describe; to depict; appearance; description
semanticNote: As a verb: 形容詞 (adjective, lit. appearance-describing word). 難以形容 (hard to describe) and 無法形容 (indescribable) are very common expressions for intense experiences. 形容 implies verbal/written description of qualities or appearance.

examples.chinese: 她聽到這個消息後的表情，真的讓人難以形容。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīng dào zhège xiāoxi hòu de biǎoqíng, zhēnde ràng rén nányǐ xíngróng.
examples.english: The expression on her face when she heard the news was truly indescribable.

examples.chinese: 這道甜點入口即化，用任何語言都難以形容那份細膩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tiándiǎn rùkǒu jí huà, yòng rènhé yǔyán dōu nányǐ xíngróng nà fèn xìnì.
examples.english: This dessert melts in your mouth — no language can adequately describe its delicacy.

semanticNote: The outward structure or format of something, as opposed to its content (內容). 走形式 (go through the motions, do something for form's sake — superficial), 形式多樣 (diverse in format). 形式主義 (formalism) is used critically. Important distinction: 形式 (form) vs. 形勢 (situation/circumstances).

examples.chinese: 這次的頒獎典禮形式簡單，但意義深重。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de bānjiǎng diǎnlǐ xíngshì jiǎndān, dàn yìyì shēnzhòng.
examples.english: This award ceremony was simple in format but deeply meaningful.

examples.chinese: 他批評說，這場會議不過是走形式，根本沒有實際討論。
examples.pinyin: Tā pīpíng shuō, zhè chǎng huìyì búguò shì zǒu xíngshì, gēnběn méiyǒu shíjì tǎolùn.
examples.english: He criticized that the meeting was nothing more than going through the motions — there was no real discussion at all.

english: situation; circumstances; terrain; state of affairs
semanticNote: The current state of circumstances, especially in political, military, or economic contexts. 形勢嚴峻 (the situation is serious/grim), 形勢好轉 (the situation is improving), 台海形勢 (cross-strait situation). Must be distinguished in writing from 形式 (form/format) — same pronunciation, different characters.

examples.chinese: 台海形勢近年來持續緊張，各方都在密切關注局勢發展。
examples.pinyin: Táihǎi xíngshì jìnnián lái chíxù jǐnzhāng, gèfāng dōu zài mìqiē guānzhù júshì fāzhǎn.
examples.english: Cross-strait tensions have remained elevated in recent years — all parties are closely watching how the situation develops.

examples.chinese: 公司面對市場形勢的急劇變化，必須盡快調整策略。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī miànduì shìchǎng xíngshì de jíjù biànhuà, bìxū jǐnkuài tiáozhěng cèlüè.
examples.english: The company is facing rapidly changing market conditions and must adjust its strategy as soon as possible.

semanticNote: Both the literal shape/figure of something or someone, and the abstract public image or reputation: 公司形象 (company image), 品牌形象 (brand image), 個人形象 (personal image). 塑造形象 (build/shape an image). Common in PR, marketing, and character analysis in literature.

examples.chinese: 這次醜聞嚴重損害了公司的品牌形象，公關部門緊急發布聲明。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chǒuwén yánzhòng sǔnhài le gōngsī de pǐnpái xíngxiàng, gōngguān bùmén jǐnjí fābù shēngmíng.
examples.english: The scandal severely damaged the company's brand image — the PR department urgently issued a statement.

examples.chinese: 這部電影把台灣的城市生活刻劃得非常真實，形象生動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bǎ Táiwān de chéngshì shēnghuó kèhuà de fēicháng zhēnshí, xíngxiàng shēngdòng.
examples.english: This film portrays urban life in Taiwan with great authenticity — the images are vivid and lifelike.

semanticNote: The physical shape or outline of an object. 各種形狀 (various shapes), 心形 (heart shape), 圓形 (circular shape). Used in design, math (幾何形狀 — geometric shapes), and everyday description. More specifically visual than 形式 (form/format) or 形象 (image).

examples.chinese: 台灣的形狀有點像一片葉子，從衛星圖上看非常美麗。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xíngzhuàng yǒudiǎn xiàng yī piàn yèzi, cóng wèixīng tú shàng kàn fēicháng měilì.
examples.english: Taiwan's shape is somewhat like a leaf — it looks beautiful from satellite imagery.

examples.chinese: 幼兒園老師教小朋友辨認各種形狀，如圓形、三角形和正方形。
examples.pinyin: Yòu'éryuán lǎoshī jiāo xiǎopéngyǒu biànrèn gèzhǒng xíngzhuàng, rú yuánxíng, sānjiǎoxíng hé zhèngfāngxíng.
examples.english: Kindergarten teachers teach children to recognize various shapes, such as circles, triangles, and squares.

english: fortunately; luckily; it's a good thing that
semanticNote: Used to express relief that something bad was avoided or that something helpful happened. 幸虧你提醒我 (it's a good thing you reminded me). Slightly stronger than 幸好 — both are common in Taiwan. Always followed by a clause explaining what fortunate circumstance occurred.

examples.chinese: 幸虧我帶了雨傘，不然今天回家一定全身濕透。
examples.pinyin: Xìngkuī wǒ dài le yǔsǎn, bùrán jīntiān huíjiā yīdìng quánshēn shī tòu.
examples.english: It's a good thing I brought an umbrella — otherwise I would have been completely soaked on the way home today.

examples.chinese: 幸虧路人及時撥打119，傷者才獲得了救治。
examples.pinyin: Xìngkuī lùrén jíshí bō dǎ 119, shāngzhě cái huòdé le jiùzhì.
examples.english: Fortunately, a passer-by called 119 in time — that's how the injured person received treatment.

semanticNote: Describes a person as lucky or a situation as fortunate. 幸運的是 (fortunately; luckily), 幸運兒 (lucky person, someone fate favors), 幸運數字 (lucky number). In Taiwan, number 8 (八, bā) is considered especially 幸運 due to its resemblance to 發 (prosper). Cf. 幸虧 (it's lucky that) which is more about narrow escape.

examples.chinese: 他考試前一天才臨時抱佛腳，卻考過了，真的很幸運。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎoshì qián yī tiān cái línshí bào fójiǎo, què kǎo guò le, zhēnde hěn xìngyùn.
examples.english: He crammed the night before the exam and still passed — he really lucked out.

examples.chinese: 幸運的是，地震發生時大多數居民都已撤離，傷亡較少。
examples.pinyin: Xìngyùn de shì, dìzhèn fāshēng shí dàduōshù jūmín dōu yǐ chèlí, shāngyáng jiào shǎo.
examples.english: Fortunately, most residents had already evacuated when the earthquake struck, so casualties were relatively low.

semanticNote: The fundamental nature or essence of something — 問題的性質 (the nature of the problem), 不同性質的工作 (work of different natures), 化學性質 (chemical properties). Slightly more abstract and analytical than 特點 (characteristic) or 特色 (distinguishing feature).

examples.chinese: 這件事的性質已經不是普通的糾紛，而是涉及刑事責任的問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de xìngzhì yǐjīng bú shì pǔtōng de jiūfēn, ér shì shèjí xíngshì zérèn de wèntí.
examples.english: The nature of this matter is no longer an ordinary dispute — it involves criminal liability.

examples.chinese: 不同性質的工作對人的要求也不同，選擇前要充分了解自己。
examples.pinyin: Bùtóng xìngzhì de gōngzuò duì rén de yāoqiú yě bùtóng, xuǎnzé qián yào chōngfèn liǎojiě zìjǐ.
examples.english: Work of different natures makes different demands on a person — you need to understand yourself fully before making a choice.

semanticNote: Literal: brothers (兄 = older brother, 弟 = younger brother). Colloquially in Taiwan: 兄弟! is a warm address among close male friends — similar to 'bro'. 義兄弟 (sworn brothers), 兄弟情 (brotherhood/camaraderie). 兄弟 can also refer to organized crime groups (兄弟 as triad slang), context-dependent.

examples.chinese: 他和哥哥從小感情很好，長大後依然是最親密的兄弟。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé gēge cóngxiǎo gǎnqíng hěn hǎo, zhǎngdà hòu yīrán shì zuì qīnmì de xiōngdì.
examples.english: He and his older brother have been close since childhood and remain the closest of brothers as adults.

examples.chinese: 那幾個從高中就認識的朋友，多年後依然兄弟相稱，情誼深厚。
examples.pinyin: Nà jǐ gè cóng gāozhōng jiù rènshí de péngyǒu, duō nián hòu yīrán xiōngdì xiāng chēng, qíngyì shēnhòu.
examples.english: Those friends who met in high school still call each other brothers years later — the bond between them runs deep.

semanticNote: The chest area of the body — 胸口 (chest), 胸部 (chest/breast), 胸腔 (thoracic cavity). Figurative: 胸懷大志 (harbor great ambitions; have a broad vision), 胸有成竹 (have a plan already worked out, lit. have bamboo in one's chest). The figurative uses are very common in formal Chinese.

examples.chinese: 他跑完馬拉松後胸口劇烈起伏，大口大口地喘著氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo wán mǎlāsōng hòu xiōngkǒu jùliè qǐfú, dà kǒu dà kǒu de chuǎnzhe qì.
examples.english: After finishing the marathon, his chest heaved violently as he gasped for breath.

examples.chinese: 她胸懷大志，一心想要改變台灣的教育制度。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiōnghuái dàzhì, yīxīn xiǎngyào gǎibiàn Táiwān de jiàoyù zhìdù.
examples.english: She harbors great ambitions and is determined to change Taiwan's education system.

semanticNote: Refers to free time and relaxing activities — 休閒活動 (leisure activities), 休閒娛樂 (recreation and entertainment). As an adjective: 休閒服裝 (casual wear), 休閒農場 (leisure farm — hugely popular in Taiwan for weekend outings). 休閒 culture is well-developed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣各地有許多休閒農場，讓都市人可以在假日接觸自然。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān gèdì yǒu xǔduō xiūxián nóngchǎng, ràng dūshì rén kěyǐ zài jiàrì jiēchù zìrán.
examples.english: There are many leisure farms around Taiwan where city dwellers can connect with nature on weekends.

examples.chinese: 週末他喜歡穿上休閒服，在市區的咖啡館裡消磨一個下午。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò tā xǐhuān chuān shàng xiūxián fú, zài shìqū de kāfēiguǎn lǐ xiāomó yīgè xiàwǔ.
examples.english: On weekends he likes to put on casual clothes and spend an afternoon at a café in the city.

english: to revise; to amend; to modify; to alter
semanticNote: Used for making corrections or changes to text, plans, laws, or designs. 修改文章 (revise an article), 修改法規 (amend regulations), 修改計畫 (revise a plan). More targeted than 改變 (change fundamentally) — 修改 implies adjusting within an existing structure. Very common in academic and professional writing.

examples.chinese: 老師把作文發回來讓同學根據批改意見修改。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zuòwén fā huí lái ràng tóngxué gēnjù pīgǎi yìjiàn xiūgǎi.
examples.english: The teacher returned the essays for students to revise based on the written feedback.

examples.chinese: 這份合約還需要修改幾個條款，雙方律師都在審閱中。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn héyuē hái xūyào xiūgǎi jǐ gè tiáokuǎn, shuāngfāng lǜshī dōu zài shěnyuè zhōng.
examples.english: Several clauses in this contract still need to be amended — both parties' lawyers are reviewing it.

semanticNote: Describes a person who is genuinely open to learning from others and accepting feedback without ego. 虛心接受批評 (humbly accept criticism), 虛心請教 (humbly seek advice). A highly valued virtue in Confucian-influenced Taiwan culture. Antonym: 自以為是 (self-righteous) or 驕傲 (arrogant).

examples.chinese: 他能有今天的成就，在於他始終保持虛心，不斷向前輩學習。
examples.pinyin: Tā néng yǒu jīntiān de chéngjiù, zàiyú tā shǐzhōng bǎochí xūxīn, búduàn xiàng qiánbèi xuéxí.
examples.english: His success today comes from always staying modest and continuously learning from those more experienced.

examples.chinese: 收到客戶的負面回饋，她虛心接受，馬上著手改進產品。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào kèhù de fùmiàn huíkuì, tā xūxīn jiēshòu, mǎshàng zhuóshǒu gǎijìn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Upon receiving negative feedback from customers, she humbly accepted it and immediately began improving the product.

english: to narrate; to recount; narration; account
semanticNote: The act of telling or recounting events in sequence. 敘述事件經過 (recount the sequence of events). 敘述者 (narrator) in literary analysis. More formal than 說 (say/tell) — used in testimony, storytelling, and academic contexts. 第一人稱敘述 (first-person narration) is a literary term.

examples.chinese: 警察請目擊者冷靜地敘述整個事件的經過。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá qǐng mùjízhě lěngjìng de xùshù zhěnggè shìjiàn de jīngguò.
examples.english: Police asked the witness to calmly recount the entire course of events.

examples.chinese: 這篇散文用細膩的筆觸敘述了作者童年在鄉下的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān sǎnwén yòng xìnì de bǐchù xùshùle zuòzhě tóngnián zài xiāngxià de shēnghuó.
examples.english: This prose piece recounts the author's rural childhood with delicate, nuanced prose.

english: to announce; to declare; to proclaim
semanticNote: An official or public announcement — 宣布結果 (announce the results), 宣布開幕 (declare open), 宣布緊急狀態 (declare a state of emergency). More formal and public than 通知 (notify). In Taiwan, 中選會宣布選舉結果 (the Central Election Commission announces election results) is a familiar phrase.

examples.chinese: 選舉結束後，開票結果顯示現任市長獲勝，並隨即宣布連任。
examples.pinyin: Xuǎnjǔ jiéshù hòu, kāipiào jiéguǒ xiǎnshì xiànrèn shìzhǎng huòshèng, bìng suíjí xuānbù liánrèn.
examples.english: After the election, ballot counting results showed the incumbent mayor won, and he immediately announced re-election.

examples.chinese: 公司今天宣布將在台南設立新的研發中心，預計創造五百個就業機會。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīntiān xuānbù jiāng zài Táinán shèlì xīn de yánfā zhōngxīn, yùjì chuàngzào wǔbǎi gè jiùyè jīhuì.
examples.english: The company today announced it will establish a new R&D center in Tainan, expected to create five hundred jobs.

english: to publicize; to promote; propaganda; publicity
semanticNote: Can mean legitimate promotion/publicity (宣傳活動 — promotional campaign, 宣傳環保觀念 — spread environmental awareness) or political propaganda (政治宣傳). In Taiwan, the word carries both neutral and pejorative senses depending on context. 反宣傳 (counter-propaganda). More neutral than in English 'propaganda'.

examples.chinese: 政府透過各種媒體宣傳節能減碳的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tòuguò gèzhǒng méitǐ xuānchuán jiénéng jiǎntàn de zhòngyào xìng.
examples.english: The government uses various media channels to publicize the importance of energy saving and carbon reduction.

examples.chinese: 他懷疑那份報告只是政治宣傳，並不代表真實情況。
examples.pinyin: Tā huáiyí nà fèn bàogào zhǐ shì zhèngzhì xuānchuán, bìng bù dàibiǎo zhēnshí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: He suspected that the report was just political propaganda and didn't represent the true situation.

english: educational background; academic qualifications; school record
semanticNote: The level and record of formal education someone has completed. 高學歷 (high level of education), 學歷要求 (educational requirements), 學歷社會 (a society where academic credentials determine opportunities — often used critically in Taiwan). 大學學歷 (bachelor's degree qualification).

examples.chinese: 台灣是學歷社會，很多工作對求職者的學歷有明確要求。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì xuélì shèhuì, hěn duō gōngzuò duì qiúzhí zhě de xuélì yǒu míngquè yāoqiú.
examples.english: Taiwan is a credential-conscious society — many jobs have explicit educational requirements for applicants.

examples.chinese: 他雖然學歷不高，但憑著豐富的實務經驗，在業界非常受到重視。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán xuélì bù gāo, dàn píngzhe fēngfù de shíwù jīngyàn, zài yèjiè fēicháng shòudào zhòngshì.
examples.english: Although his educational qualifications aren't high, his extensive practical experience makes him highly respected in the industry.

semanticNote: The realm of scholarly/scientific inquiry. 學術研究 (academic research), 學術界 (academia), 學術論文 (academic paper/thesis), 學術自由 (academic freedom). In Taiwan, top universities publish in international peer-reviewed journals as part of 學術評鑑 (academic evaluation). 學術交流 (academic exchange).

examples.chinese: 他在學術界享有很高的聲譽，論文被國際期刊多次引用。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéshù jiè xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù, lùnwén bèi guójì qīkān duō cì yǐnyòng.
examples.english: He enjoys a high reputation in academia — his papers have been cited many times by international journals.

examples.chinese: 這場學術研討會匯聚了兩岸三地的頂尖學者，共同探討氣候變遷議題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng xuéshù yántǎo huì huìjùle liǎng'àn sān dì de dǐngjiān xuézhě, gòngtóng tàntǎo qìhòu biànqiān yìtí.
examples.english: This academic symposium brought together top scholars from across the Taiwan Strait to jointly explore climate change issues.

semanticNote: Refers to depth of accumulated knowledge and learning — more holistic and experiential than 知識 (knowledge facts). 有學問的人 (a learned person), 做學問 (pursue scholarship/learning). Often implies wisdom through study: 學問深厚 (profound learning). The -wen ending is unstressed in pronunciation.

examples.chinese: 老教授一生做學問，雖然著作等身，仍然保持謙遜的態度。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo jiàoshòu yīshēng zuò xuéwen, suīrán zhùzuò děng shēn, réngrán bǎochí qiānxùn de tàidù.
examples.english: The old professor devoted his life to scholarship — despite a lifetime of publications, he remained humble.

examples.chinese: 光會背書沒用，真正的學問要在生活中慢慢體會。
examples.pinyin: Guāng huì bèishū méiyòng, zhēnzhèng de xuéwen yào zài shēnghuó zhōng mànmàn tǐhuì.
examples.english: Just memorizing isn't enough — true learning has to be slowly understood through lived experience.

english: to look for; to seek; to search for
semanticNote: More deliberate and persistent than casual 找 (look for). Implies an active quest — 尋找工作 (seek employment), 尋找答案 (seek answers), 尋找人生意義 (search for the meaning of life). Common in formal, literary, and journalistic writing. 尋找失蹤兒童 (search for a missing child).

examples.chinese: 她在異鄉尋找屬於自己的生活節奏，花了整整兩年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yìxiāng xúnzhǎo shǔyú zìjǐ de shēnghuó jiézòu, huāle zhěngzhěng liǎng nián.
examples.english: She spent a full two years searching for her own rhythm of life in a foreign place.

examples.chinese: 警方正在全力尋找失蹤的登山隊員，山區搜救行動持續進行中。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài quánlì xúnzhǎo shīzōng de dēngshān duìyuán, shānqū sōujiù xíngdòng chíxù jìnxíng zhōng.
examples.english: Police are searching with full force for the missing climber — mountain rescue operations are ongoing.

english: to inquire; to ask about; to query
semanticNote: Formal register for asking questions in a deliberate, often investigative or customer-service context. 向客服詢問 (inquire with customer service), 詢問詳情 (inquire about details). More official than 問 (ask). In Taiwan government and business, 敬請詢問 (please feel free to inquire) is a polite formulaic expression.

examples.chinese: 如需進一步了解，歡迎電話或親臨櫃台詢問。
examples.pinyin: Rú xū jìnyībù liǎojiě, huānyíng diànhuà huò qīnlín guìtái xúnwèn.
examples.english: For further information, please feel free to call or come to the counter to inquire in person.

examples.chinese: 她向房東詢問了合約細節，確認一切符合自己的需求後才簽名。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng fángdōng xúnwènle héyuē xìjié, quèrèn yīqiē fúhé zìjǐ de xūqiú hòu cái qiānmíng.
examples.english: She inquired with the landlord about the contract details and only signed after confirming everything met her needs.

english: to train; to drill; training; exercise
semanticNote: Systematic practice to build skills, physical fitness, or discipline. 體能訓練 (physical training), 職業訓練 (vocational training), 訓練有素 (well-trained). In Taiwan, 義務役 (compulsory military service) includes 基礎訓練. Sports training: 每日訓練 (daily training regimen).

examples.chinese: 國家代表隊的選手每天要進行六個小時的高強度訓練。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā dàibiǎo duì de xuǎnshǒu měitiān yào jìnxíng liù gè xiǎoshí de gāo qiángdù xùnliàn.
examples.english: National team athletes undergo six hours of high-intensity training every day.

examples.chinese: 公司為新進員工安排了為期兩週的入職訓練課程。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèi xīnjìn yuángōng ānpáile wéiqī liǎng zhōu de rùzhí xùnliàn kèchéng.
examples.english: The company arranged a two-week onboarding training program for new employees.

semanticNote: Describes speed, especially of events or changes — 迅速反應 (respond rapidly), 迅速發展 (develop rapidly), 迅速蔓延 (spread swiftly). More formal and emphatic than 快 (fast). Common in news reporting and official contexts to convey urgency and decisiveness.

examples.chinese: 台積電迅速回應市場需求，在短短半年內擴充了產能。
examples.pinyin: Táijīdiàn xùnsù huíyìng shìchǎng xūqiú, zài duǎnduǎn bàn nián nèi kuòchōngle chǎnnéng.
examples.english: TSMC rapidly responded to market demand and expanded its production capacity within just half a year.

examples.chinese: 火災發生後，消防員迅速趕到現場，在半小時內將火勢控制住。
examples.pinyin: Huǒzāi fāshēng hòu, xiāofáng yuán xùnsù gǎndào xiànchǎng, zài bàn xiǎoshí nèi jiāng huǒshì kòngzhì zhù.
examples.english: After the fire broke out, firefighters rapidly arrived on the scene and brought the blaze under control within half an hour.

semanticNote: Money held as security for rental of property, equipment, or utilities. 退還押金 (return the deposit), 沒收押金 (forfeit the deposit). In Taiwan, renting an apartment typically requires 2 months' rent as 押金. Also used for utilities (水電押金) and equipment rentals.

components.meaning: hold in custody; detain; mortgage; deposit

examples.chinese: 租這間公寓需要付兩個月的押金，搬出時只要沒有損毀就全額退還。
examples.pinyin: Zū zhè jiān gōngyù xūyào fù liǎng gè yuè de yājīn, bān chū shí zhǐyào méiyǒu sǔnhuǐ jiù quán'é tuìhuán.
examples.english: Renting this apartment requires a two-month security deposit — as long as there's no damage when you move out, it will be fully refunded.

examples.chinese: 他退租後等了一個多月，房東才把押金退回來。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuì zū hòu děngle yī gè duō yuè, fángdōng cái bǎ yājīn tuì huílái.
examples.english: After he moved out, he waited over a month before the landlord returned the deposit.

semanticNote: The teeth. 刷牙齒 (brush teeth), 蛀牙 (tooth decay/cavity), 假牙 (dentures), 矯正牙齒 (get braces). In Taiwan, dental care is partially covered by 全民健保 for basic procedures. 看牙醫 (visit the dentist) is a common context. 牙 alone is also used (刷牙 — brush teeth).

examples.chinese: 牙醫說她有兩顆蛀牙，需要補牙，下次要好好刷牙。
examples.pinyin: Yáyī shuō tā yǒu liǎng kē zhùyá, xūyào bǔyá, xià cì yào hǎohǎo shuāyá.
examples.english: The dentist said she has two cavities that need filling — she needs to brush her teeth properly from now on.

examples.chinese: 小孩換牙是正常現象，乳牙脫落後恆牙就會長出來。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohái huànyá shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng, rǔyá tuōluò hòu héngyá jiù huì zhǎng chūlái.
examples.english: It's normal for children to lose their baby teeth — once the milk teeth fall out, permanent teeth will grow in.

english: to extend; to prolong; to lengthen
semanticNote: Extend something in time or space — 延長期限 (extend a deadline), 延長簽證 (extend a visa), 延長賽 (overtime in sports). Opposite: 縮短 (shorten). In Taiwan's work culture, 延長工時 (extend working hours) relates to ongoing debates about labor rights.

examples.chinese: 球賽在一百二十分鐘後仍然平手，只好進入延長賽。
examples.pinyin: Qiúsài zài yī bǎi èrshí fēnzhōng hòu réngrán píngshǒu, zhǐhǎo jìnrù yáncháng sài.
examples.english: The match was still tied after 120 minutes, so it had to go into overtime.

examples.chinese: 她的簽證快到期了，需要向移民署申請延長。
examples.pinyin: Tā de qiānzhèng kuài dàoqī le, xūyào xiàng yímín shǔ shēnqǐng yáncháng.
examples.english: Her visa is almost expired — she needs to apply for an extension with the National Immigration Agency.

semanticNote: Describes a grave, formal, or serious manner — 嚴肅的表情 (stern expression), 態度嚴肅 (serious attitude), 嚴肅對待 (treat seriously). Also used of topics: 嚴肅的問題 (a serious issue). The opposite is 輕鬆 (relaxed) or 活潑 (lively). 嚴肅認真 is a common paired phrase.

examples.chinese: 法院是嚴肅的場合，所有人進入時都必須保持安靜。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn shì yánsù de chǎnghé, suǒyǒu rén jìnrù shí dōu bìxū bǎochí ānjìng.
examples.english: A court is a solemn place — everyone must maintain silence when they enter.

examples.chinese: 老師的表情突然嚴肅起來，教室裡頓時安靜了許多。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de biǎoqíng tūrán yánsù qǐlái, jiàoshì lǐ dùnshí ānjìng le xǔduō.
examples.english: The teacher's expression suddenly turned serious — the classroom instantly became much quieter.

english: to give a speech; to lecture; speech; lecture
semanticNote: A formal public address. 發表演講 (give a speech), 演講比賽 (speech competition — very common in Taiwan schools), 演講稿 (speech script), 主題演講 (keynote speech). TED演講 (TED Talk) has popularized the format in Taiwan. 演說 is a near-synonym, slightly more formal.

examples.chinese: 她代表班上參加全校演講比賽，講的主題是台灣的環保挑戰。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàibiǎo bān shàng cānjiā quánxiào yǎnjiǎng bǐsài, jiǎng de zhǔtí shì Táiwān de huánbǎo tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: She represented her class in the school speech competition — her topic was Taiwan's environmental challenges.

examples.chinese: 那位創業家的演講深深打動了在場的每一位聽眾。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi chuàngyè jiā de yǎnjiǎng shēnshēn dǎdòngle zàichǎng de měi yī wèi tīngzhòng.
examples.english: The entrepreneur's speech deeply moved every member of the audience present.

semanticNote: A formal group meal, typically for celebration or official entertainment. 國宴 (state banquet), 婚宴 (wedding banquet — major social event in Taiwan with set menus and karaoke), 告別宴 (farewell banquet). 辦桌 (bàn zhuō) is the traditional Taiwanese open-air banquet style, a cultural institution.

examples.chinese: 婚宴上共有三十桌賓客，場面相當盛大。
examples.pinyin: Hūnyàn shàng gòng yǒu sānshí zhuō bīnkè, chǎngmiàn xiāngdāng shèngdà.
examples.english: The wedding banquet had thirty tables of guests — quite a grand occasion.

examples.chinese: 公司年終尾牙宴會在台北的五星級飯店舉行，今年規模特別大。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī niánzhōng wěiyá yànhuì zài Táiběi de wǔ xīng jí fàndiàn jǔxíng, jīnnián guīmó tèbié dà.
examples.english: The company's year-end banquet was held at a five-star hotel in Taipei — this year's was especially large in scale.

semanticNote: An outdoor platform attached to a building. In Taiwan, 陽台 is important for laundry drying (晾衣服) — clothes dryers are less common due to climate. Many older Taiwan apartments have enclosed balconies. 陽台花園 (balcony garden) is popular for urban dwellers with limited outdoor space.

examples.chinese: 她習慣把洗好的衣服晾在陽台上，讓太陽曬乾。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn bǎ xǐ hǎo de yīfu liàng zài yángtái shàng, ràng tàiyáng shài gān.
examples.english: She makes a habit of hanging washed clothes on the balcony to dry in the sun.

examples.chinese: 住在高樓層的好處是陽台視野很開闊，天氣好時可以遠眺山景。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài gāo lóucéng de hǎochu shì yángtái shìyě hěn kāikuò, tiānqì hǎo shí kěyǐ yuǎntiào shānjǐng.
examples.english: The advantage of living on a high floor is that the balcony view is wide open — on a clear day you can see the mountains in the distance.

semanticNote: Physical sensation of itching — 皮膚很癢 (skin is itchy), 被蚊子咬癢了 (bitten by a mosquito and itchy). Figurative: 心癢 (feel an itch/urge to do something). In Taiwan's subtropical climate, mosquito bites (蚊子咬) are a year-round source of 癢. 止癢藥膏 (anti-itch cream).

examples.chinese: 蚊子在夜裡叮了他好幾口，早上起來腿上一片癢。
examples.pinyin: Wénzi zài yèlǐ dīngle tā hǎo jǐ kǒu, zǎoshang qǐlái tuǐ shàng yīpiàn yǎng.
examples.english: Mosquitoes bit him several times in the night — when he woke up in the morning his legs were a itchy mess.

examples.chinese: 她對花粉過敏，春天時眼睛和皮膚都會很癢。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì huāfěn guòmǐn, chūntiān shí yǎnjīng hé pífū dōu huì hěn yǎng.
examples.english: She's allergic to pollen — in spring her eyes and skin become very itchy.

semanticNote: The external design or style of an object. 款式 is more common in fashion contexts (clothing style/cut), while 樣式 is broader — used for furniture, architecture, documents. 樣式多樣 (variety of styles). In digital contexts: CSS 樣式 (stylesheet). Both 款式 and 樣式 are used in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這家傢俱店提供多種樣式的書桌，可以根據房間大小選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiājù diàn tígōng duō zhǒng yàngshì de shūzhuō, kěyǐ gēnjù fángjiān dàxiǎo xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This furniture store offers many styles of desks to choose from based on room size.

examples.chinese: 她設計的婚禮邀請函樣式很獨特，讓每位收到的賓客都印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Tā shèjì de hūnlǐ yāoqǐnghan yàngshì hěn dútè, ràng měi wèi shōudào de bīnkè dōu yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: The wedding invitation she designed has a very distinctive style — every guest who received one was deeply impressed.

semanticNote: Anatomically: the waist/lower back area — 腰痛 (lower back pain), 扭到腰 (throw out one's back). Figurative: 腰包 (money/wallet — 腰包鼓鼓 means flush with cash), 半腰 (mid-slope, midway). Lower back pain is extremely common in Taiwan's office-worker and manual-labor populations.

examples.chinese: 他長期久坐辦公室，導致嚴重的腰痛，只好去做復健。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángqī jiǔ zuò bàngōngshì, dǎozhì yánzhòng de yāotòng, zhǐhǎo qù zuò fùjiàn.
examples.english: Years of sitting at a desk have given him severe lower back pain — he had no choice but to go for rehabilitation.

examples.chinese: 跳舞的時候不小心扭到腰，痛到站不起來。
examples.pinyin: Tiàowǔ de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn niǔ dào yāo, tòng dào zhàn bù qǐlái.
examples.english: He threw out his back while dancing — it hurt so badly he couldn't stand up.

english: to shake; to rock; to sway; to wave
semanticNote: A gentle to moderate back-and-forth movement. 搖頭 (shake one's head), 搖籃 (cradle/rocking chair), 搖尾巴 (wag the tail), 搖擺 (sway/oscillate). In Taiwan, 搖滾樂 (rock music, lit. shaking-rolling music) uses this character. 地震時大地搖晃 (the ground shook during the earthquake).

examples.chinese: 地震來的時候，整棟大樓猛烈搖晃，窗戶上的東西全掉了下來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn lái de shíhòu, zhěng dòng dàlóu měngliè yáohuàng, chuānghù shàng de dōngxi quán diào le xiàlái.
examples.english: When the earthquake hit, the whole building shook violently and everything on the windowsills fell off.

examples.chinese: 她搖了搖頭，表示對這個結果並不滿意。
examples.pinyin: Tā yáo le yáo tóu, biǎoshì duì zhège jiéguǒ bìng bù mǎnyì.
examples.english: She shook her head, indicating she wasn't satisfied with the result.

english: to bite; to nip; to grip with the teeth
semanticNote: The act of biting with teeth. 狗咬人 (dog bites person), 咬傷 (bite wound). Figurative: 咬牙 (grit one's teeth, persist through hardship — very common), 咬緊牙關 (clench one's teeth and persevere). 蚊子咬 (mosquito bite) is ubiquitous in Taiwan's warm climate.

examples.chinese: 路上遇到陌生的狗要小心，不要伸手去摸，以免被咬。
examples.pinyin: Lùshàng yùdào mòshēng de gǒu yào xiǎoxīn, bùyào shēnshǒu qù mō, yǐmiǎn bèi yǎo.
examples.english: Be careful when you encounter a strange dog on the street — don't reach out to pet it or you might get bitten.

examples.chinese: 這段時間很辛苦，但她咬緊牙關撐了下來，終於看到了曙光。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn shíjiān hěn xīnkǔ, dàn tā yǎo jǐn yáguān chēngle xiàlái, zhōngyú kàn dào le shǔguāng.
examples.english: This period was very hard, but she gritted her teeth and held on — and finally began to see the light at the end of the tunnel.

english: otherwise; or else; how about; or alternatively
semanticNote: Colloquial conjunction offering an alternative or suggesting a consequence. Two main uses: (1) 要不然 (otherwise/or else) — 快走，要不然就遲到了; (2) 要不 before a suggestion — 要不我們去吃火鍋吧 (how about we go have hotpot). Very common in Taiwan everyday speech.

examples.chinese: 快點出發吧，要不一會兒塞車就來不及了。
examples.pinyin: Kuài diǎn chūfā ba, yàobù yīhuìr sāi chē jiù lái bù jí le.
examples.english: Let's get going — otherwise we'll get caught in traffic and won't make it in time.

examples.chinese: 外面下雨了，要不我們就在家叫外送算了？
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, yàobù wǒmen jiù zài jiā jiào wàisòng suàn le?
examples.english: It's raining outside — how about we just order delivery and stay home?

semanticNote: The operational activities and professional duties of a company or role. 業務員 (sales rep/business staff), 業務範圍 (scope of business), 核心業務 (core business). In Taiwan companies, the 業務部 (sales/business development department) is distinct from the 行銷部 (marketing dept.).

examples.chinese: 他從事業務工作十年，最擅長開發新客戶和維繫客戶關係。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngshì yèwù gōngzuò shí nián, zuì shàncháng kāifā xīn kèhù hé wéixì kèhù guānxi.
examples.english: He's been in sales for ten years — his specialty is developing new clients and maintaining client relationships.

examples.chinese: 公司的業務範圍從台灣逐漸拓展到東南亞市場。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de yèwù fànwéi cóng Táiwān zhújiàn tuòzhǎn dào dōngnányà shìchǎng.
examples.english: The company's business operations have gradually expanded from Taiwan into Southeast Asian markets.

semanticNote: Business余: time outside one's main occupation. 業餘愛好 (hobby/leisure pursuit), 業餘歌手 (amateur singer), 業餘時間 (spare time). In Taiwan's competitive culture, 業餘 can carry a slight connotation of 'not quite professional' — but also more recently, the positive sense of doing something for passion rather than money.

examples.chinese: 他白天是工程師，業餘時間卻是一位技術精湛的業餘攝影師。
examples.pinyin: Tā báitiān shì gōngchéngshī, yèyú shíjiān què shì yī wèi jìshù jīngzhàn de yèyú shèyǐngshī.
examples.english: By day he's an engineer, but in his spare time he's a highly skilled amateur photographer.

examples.chinese: 她在業餘時間學了三年古箏，現在已經能在朋友面前表演了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yèyú shíjiān xuéle sān nián gǔzhēng, xiànzài yǐjīng néng zài péngyǒu miànqián biǎoyǎn le.
examples.english: She studied the guzheng in her spare time for three years and can now perform in front of friends.

semanticNote: The period of darkness — 深夜 (deep night/late night), 夜晚 (nighttime), 通宵達旦 (through the night). In Taiwan, 夜市 (night market) is arguably the most iconic use of 夜 in daily life — a core cultural institution. 夜生活 (nightlife) is vibrant in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市文化舉世聞名，一到夜晚整個廣場燈火通明、人聲鼎沸。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì wénhuà jǔshì wénmíng, yī dào yèwǎn zhěnggè guǎngchǎng dēnghuǒ tōngmíng, rénshēng dǐngfèi.
examples.english: Taiwan's night market culture is world-famous — as night falls the whole square blazes with lights and buzzes with people.

examples.chinese: 她習慣在深夜寫作，說夜的靜謐讓她思緒更清晰。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn zài shēnyè xiězuò, shuō yè de jìnì ràng tā sīxù gèng qīngxī.
examples.english: She makes a habit of writing late at night, saying the stillness of night makes her thoughts clearer.

english: (for) a lifetime; all one's life; forever
semanticNote: Refers to one's entire lifespan. 一輩子的承諾 (a lifelong commitment), 做一輩子的朋友 (be friends for life), 一輩子難忘 (unforgettable for a lifetime). Used to emphasize the permanence or significance of something — common in emotional and romantic contexts.

examples.chinese: 他說要和她做一輩子的朋友，這句話她到現在還記得。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō yào hé tā zuò yíbèizi de péngyǒu, zhè jù huà tā dào xiànzài hái jìdé.
examples.english: He said he wanted to be her friend for life — she still remembers those words to this day.

examples.chinese: 一輩子只愛一個人，說起來容易，做起來卻很難。
examples.pinyin: Yíbèizi zhǐ ài yī gè rén, shuō qǐlái róngyì, zuò qǐlái què hěn nán.
examples.english: Loving only one person for a lifetime is easy to say, but very hard to do.

english: once (something happens); in case; if ever; as soon as
semanticNote: A formal conditional conjunction meaning 'once [condition] is met, then [consequence] follows'. 一旦決定就不要反悔 (once decided, don't regret it), 一旦發生火災 (in the event of a fire). Slightly more formal than 如果 (if) — implies a threshold-crossing event.

examples.chinese: 一旦養成壞習慣，要改掉就需要花很長的時間。
examples.pinyin: Yídàn yǎngchéng huài xíguàn, yào gǎi diào jiù xūyào huā hěn cháng de shíjiān.
examples.english: Once a bad habit is formed, it takes a long time to break.

examples.chinese: 一旦簽了合約，雙方就都有法律義務要履行。
examples.pinyin: Yídàn qiānle héyuē, shuāngfāng jiù dōu yǒu fǎlǜ yìwù yào lǚxíng.
examples.english: Once the contract is signed, both parties have legal obligations to fulfill.

english: uniformly; without exception; all; across the board
semanticNote: Indicates that something applies equally to all without exception. 一律禁止 (uniformly prohibited), 一律處理 (handled uniformly), 一律半價 (all at half price). Common in official regulations and announcements: 遲交作業一律扣分 (all late assignments will have points deducted). Emphasizes no special cases.

examples.chinese: 入場須出示健康証明，所有人一律不得例外。
examples.pinyin: Rùchǎng xū chūshì jiànkāng zhèngmíng, suǒyǒu rén yílǜ bùdé lìwài.
examples.english: Entry requires a health certificate — no exceptions for anyone.

examples.chinese: 周年慶期間，全館商品一律打八折。
examples.pinyin: Zhōuniánqìng qījiān, quán guǎn shāngpǐn yílǜ dǎ bā zhé.
examples.english: During the anniversary sale, all items in the store are uniformly 20% off.

english: repeatedly; again and again; time after time
semanticNote: Emphasizes an action done multiple times, usually with a sense of persistence or frustration. 一再強調 (repeatedly emphasize), 一再失敗 (fail again and again), 一再要求 (demand repeatedly). Slightly more emphatic than 反覆 (repeatedly) — often implies someone keeps doing something despite expectations otherwise.

examples.chinese: 她一再告訴他要按時吃藥，但他總是忘記。
examples.pinyin: Tā yízài gàosù tā yào ànshí chī yào, dàn tā zǒng shì wàngjì.
examples.english: She repeatedly told him to take his medicine on time, but he always forgot.

examples.chinese: 儘管一再面對挫折，他仍然沒有放棄追求自己的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yízài miànduì cuòzhé, tā réngrán méiyǒu fàngqì zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Despite facing setbacks again and again, he never gave up pursuing his dream.

semanticNote: Everything aligns or agrees — 意見一致 (unanimous opinion), 行動一致 (act in unison), 口徑一致 (speak with one voice). 全體一致通過 (passed unanimously). Also: 言行一致 (words and actions align) — a character ideal in Taiwan's Confucian-influenced culture.

examples.chinese: 委員會對這項提案一致表示支持，投票結果全票通過。
examples.pinyin: Wěiyuánhuì duì zhè xiàng tí'àn yīzhì biǎoshì zhīchí, tóupiào jiéguǒ quán piào tōngguò.
examples.english: The committee expressed unanimous support for the proposal — it passed with a full vote.

examples.chinese: 他說一套做一套，言行不一致，讓同事們對他失去了信任。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō yī tào zuò yī tào, yán xíng bù yīzhì, ràng tóngshìmen duì tā shīqùle xìnrèn.
examples.english: He says one thing and does another — his words and actions don't align, and his colleagues have lost trust in him.

english: still; as before; as always; unchanged
semanticNote: Formal/literary adverb meaning things remain as they were. 依然如故 (still the same as before). More written than 還是 or 仍然 — the three are nearly synonymous, but 依然 carries a slightly more poetic or nostalgic tone. Common in narrative writing and journalism.

examples.chinese: 多年過後，她依然記得那個夏天和他一起看海的下午。
examples.pinyin: Duō nián guòhòu, tā yīrán jìdé nàgè xiàtiān hé tā yīqǐ kàn hǎi de xiàwǔ.
examples.english: Years later, she still remembers that summer afternoon watching the sea together with him.

examples.chinese: 儘管環境改變了很多，他對音樂的熱情依然不減。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn huánjìng gǎibiànle hěn duō, tā duì yīnyuè de rèqíng yīrán bùjiǎn.
examples.english: Despite many changes in circumstances, his passion for music remains undiminished.

english: to move; to shift; mobile; movement
semanticNote: Physical movement of objects or people. 移動電話 (mobile phone — the formal term used in regulations; 手機 is colloquial). 中華電信/台灣大哥大 are mobile carriers in Taiwan. 移動式 (portable/mobile). Also used for subtle shifts: 別移動！(Don't move!)

examples.chinese: 警察命令所有人不要移動，等候進一步指示。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá mìnglìng suǒyǒu rén bùyào yídòng, děnghòu jìnyībù zhǐshì.
examples.english: The police ordered everyone not to move and to wait for further instructions.

examples.chinese: 這張桌子太重了，兩個人一起才能移動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi tài zhòng le, liǎng gè rén yīqǐ cái néng yídòng.
examples.english: This table is too heavy — it takes two people to move it.

english: to immigrate; to emigrate; immigrant; migrant
semanticNote: Both the act of migration and the person who migrates. 移民署 (National Immigration Agency) manages immigration in Taiwan. Taiwan has significant immigrant communities — especially 新住民 (new immigrants, esp. Southeast Asian spouses). 技術移民 (skilled migration). Brain drain concerns: 人才移民海外.

examples.chinese: 他和家人移民到加拿大已經十年了，但仍對台灣念念不忘。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé jiārén yímín dào Jiānádà yǐjīng shí nián le, dàn réng duì Táiwān niànniàn bù wàng.
examples.english: He and his family immigrated to Canada ten years ago, but he still thinks of Taiwan fondly.

examples.chinese: 台灣有許多來自東南亞的新住民，為社會注入了多元的文化元素。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu xǔduō láizì dōngnányà de xīn zhùmín, wèi shèhuì zhùrùle duōyuán de wénhuà yuánsù.
examples.english: Taiwan has many new immigrants from Southeast Asia who have infused society with diverse cultural elements.

semanticNote: Expresses regret about something that didn't happen or went wrong. 深感遺憾 (deeply regret), 令人遺憾 (regrettable), 留下遺憾 (leave regrets behind). In diplomatic language, 表示遺憾 (express regret) is a softer form of criticism. More formal than 可惜 (what a pity).

examples.chinese: 她沒能在阿公去世前見到最後一面，這成了她一生最大的遺憾。
examples.pinyin: Tā méi néng zài āgōng qùshì qián jiàn dào zuìhòu yī miàn, zhè chéngle tā yīshēng zuì dà de yíhàn.
examples.english: She wasn't able to see her grandfather one last time before he passed away — this became the greatest regret of her life.

examples.chinese: 很遺憾，您應徵的職位已由他人錄取，感謝您的參與。
examples.pinyin: Hěn yíhàn, nín yìngzhēng de zhíwèi yǐ yóu tārén lùqǔ, gǎnxiè nín de cānyù.
examples.english: We regret to inform you that the position you applied for has been filled by another candidate. Thank you for your participation.

semanticNote: A question or area of uncertainty in one's mind. 毫無疑問 (without a doubt — very common phrase), 存有疑問 (have doubts/questions), 解答疑問 (answer questions/doubts). In grammar: 疑問句 (interrogative sentence). 毫無疑問 is one of the most common four-character phrases in formal Chinese.

examples.chinese: 毫無疑問，台積電是台灣最具代表性的企業之一。
examples.pinyin: Háo wú yíwèn, Táijīdiàn shì Táiwān zuì jù dàibiǎoxìng de qǐyè zhī yī.
examples.english: Without a doubt, TSMC is one of Taiwan's most representative companies.

examples.chinese: 如果對課程內容有任何疑問，歡迎隨時舉手發問。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ duì kèchéng nèiróng yǒu rènhé yíwèn, huānyíng suíshí jǔshǒu fāwèn.
examples.english: If you have any questions about the course content, feel free to raise your hand at any time.

english: second (in a series); the second Heavenly Stem; B (grade/category)
semanticNote: The second of the Ten Heavenly Stems (天干). Used in sequences like 甲乙丙丁 (A/B/C/D equivalent). 乙組 (Group B), 乙型 (Type B), 乙肝 (Hepatitis B). In Taiwan school grading, 甲 (A) and 乙 (B) appear in some contexts. 乙方 means 'Party B' in contracts.

components.meaning: second; twist; the second heavenly stem

examples.chinese: 合約中甲方是委託人，乙方是承包商，雙方責任各有明定。
examples.pinyin: Héyuē zhōng jiǎfāng shì wěituō rén, yǐfāng shì chéngbāoshāng, shuāngfāng zérèn gèyǒu míngdìng.
examples.english: In the contract, Party A is the client and Party B is the contractor — each party's responsibilities are clearly defined.

examples.chinese: 他的成績屬於乙等，表現中上，還有進步空間。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì shǔyú yǐ děng, biǎoxiàn zhōngshàng, hái yǒu jìnbù kōngjiān.
examples.english: His grades fall in the second tier — above average performance, but still room to improve.

english: as well as; and; along with
semanticNote: Formal written conjunction connecting nouns or noun phrases — more formal than 和 (and) or 還有 (and also). 台北、台中以及高雄 (Taipei, Taichung, and Kaohsiung). Common in official documents, academic writing, and formal announcements. Not used in casual conversation.

components.meaning: use; by means of; according to
reach; catch up; and; as well as

examples.chinese: 本次活動歡迎學生、家長以及社區居民共同參與。
examples.pinyin: Běn cì huódòng huānyíng xuéshēng, jiāzhǎng yǐjí shèqū jūmín gòngtóng cānyù.
examples.english: This event welcomes students, parents, and community residents to participate together.

examples.chinese: 報名所需文件包括身分證、學歷證明以及兩吋照片兩張。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng suǒ xū wénjiàn bāokuò shēnfènzhèng, xuélì zhèngmíng yǐjí liǎng cùn zhàopiàn liǎng zhāng.
examples.english: Documents required for registration include an ID card, proof of education, and two 2-inch photos.

english: since (a point in time); ever since
semanticNote: Used after a time expression to mean 'since that point up to now'. 自古以來 (since ancient times), 近年以來 (in recent years), 工作以來 (since starting work). Always looks backward in time. Compare 以後 (after/from now on) which looks forward.

examples.chinese: 他入伍以來，每週都會寫信給父母報平安。
examples.pinyin: Tā rùwǔ yǐlái, měi zhōu dōu huì xiě xìn gěi fùmǔ bào píng'ān.
examples.english: Ever since enlisting, he writes a letter home to his parents every week to let them know he's safe.

examples.chinese: 近十年以來，台灣的觀光產業成長了將近兩倍。
examples.pinyin: Jìn shí nián yǐlái, Táiwān de guānguāng chǎnyè chéngzhǎngle jiāng jìn liǎng bèi.
examples.english: Over the past decade, Taiwan's tourism industry has nearly doubled in size.

semanticNote: The Chinese counting unit for 10^8. Essential for large numbers: 台灣人口約兩千三百萬 (23 million), 國家預算超過兩兆元 (over 2 trillion NT). In everyday use: 台積電市值超過十兆元，超過XX億美元. The grouping system is in 萬 (10,000) units, not thousands.

examples.chinese: 台灣一年的半導體出口額超過一千億美元。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yī nián de bàndǎotǐ chūkǒu é chāoguò yīqiān yì měiyuán.
examples.english: Taiwan's annual semiconductor exports exceed one hundred billion US dollars.

examples.chinese: 這次地震造成的財產損失初步估計超過五十億新台幣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn zàochéng de cáichǎn sǔnshī chūbù gūjì chāoguò wǔshí yì xīn Táibì.
examples.english: Preliminary estimates put the property damage from this earthquake at over five billion NT dollars.

semanticNote: Two related senses: (1) legal/moral obligation — 納稅義務 (tax obligation), 履行義務 (fulfill obligations); (2) voluntary/unpaid service — 義務工作者 (volunteer). 義務役 (compulsory military service in Taiwan — required for eligible males). 義務教育 (compulsory education — 9 years in Taiwan).

examples.chinese: 繳稅是每個公民的義務，也是維持社會運作的基石。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎo shuì shì měi gè gōngmín de yìwù, yěshì wéichí shèhuì yùnzuò de jīshí.
examples.english: Paying taxes is every citizen's duty and the cornerstone of maintaining a functioning society.

examples.chinese: 台灣男性年滿十八歲後，必須服一定期間的義務役。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánxìng nián mǎn shíbā suì hòu, bìxū fú yīdìng qījiān de yìwùyì.
examples.english: Male Taiwanese citizens must complete a period of compulsory military service after turning eighteen.

english: to discuss; to comment; to talk about; discussion; opinion
semanticNote: Often implies informal discussion or commentary — sometimes with a gossiping or criticizing undertone. 議論紛紛 (much discussion/heated debate; tongues wagging) is a common set phrase. In formal contexts: 議論文 (argumentative essay) is a major writing genre in Taiwan's 國文 curriculum.

examples.chinese: 這件事一出，網路上議論紛紛，各種說法都有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yī chū, wǎnglù shàng yìlùn fēnfēn, gèzhǒng shuōfǎ dōu yǒu.
examples.english: As soon as this happened, it sparked a storm of online discussion with all sorts of opinions flying around.

examples.chinese: 寫一篇好的議論文，需要有清晰的論點和充分的佐證。
examples.pinyin: Xiě yī piān hǎo de yìlùnwén, xūyào yǒu qīngxī de lùndiǎn hé chōngfèn de zuǒzhèng.
examples.english: Writing a good argumentative essay requires clear arguments and sufficient supporting evidence.

semanticNote: As a noun: an unplanned harmful event — 交通意外 (traffic accident), 工安意外 (workplace accident). As adjective: unexpected — 意外的結果 (unexpected result), 讓人意外 (surprising). 保險公司提供意外保障 (insurance companies offer accident coverage). Distinct from 事故 (incident/mishap, more formal).

examples.chinese: 她在下班路上遭遇了一場意外，所幸只有輕傷。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xiàbān lùshàng zāoyùle yī chǎng yìwài, suǒxìng zhǐyǒu qīngshāng.
examples.english: She was involved in an accident on her way home from work — fortunately only minor injuries.

examples.chinese: 他突然宣布辭職，讓所有同事都感到非常意外。
examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán xuānbù cízhí, ràng suǒyǒu tóngshì dōu gǎndào fēicháng yìwài.
examples.english: He suddenly announced his resignation, which took all his colleagues completely by surprise.

semanticNote: The deeper meaning or significance of something — 有意義 (meaningful), 沒有意義 (meaningless), 重大意義 (great significance). Broader than 意思 (meaning/idea) — 意義 implies value and importance, while 意思 is more about content. 人生的意義 (the meaning of life) is a perennial topic.

examples.chinese: 這座紀念館的意義不僅在於保存歷史，更在於讓後人不忘記這段傷痛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò jìniànguǎn de yìyì bùjǐn zàiyú bǎocún lìshǐ, gèng zàiyú ràng hòurén bù wàngjì zhè duàn shāngtòng.
examples.english: The significance of this memorial museum lies not just in preserving history, but in ensuring future generations don't forget this painful chapter.

examples.chinese: 他覺得整天做重複的工作很沒有意義，開始思考要不要轉職。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédé zhěngtiān zuò chóngfù de gōngzuò hěn méiyǒu yìyì, kāishǐ sīkǎo yào búyào zhuǎnzhí.
examples.english: He felt that spending all day doing repetitive work was meaningless and began thinking about whether to change careers.

english: therefore; as a result; thus; consequently
semanticNote: Formal written conjunction introducing a result or consequence. 因而導致 (resulting in; leading to), 因而得名 (hence the name). More formal and literary than 所以 (so/therefore). Common in academic and analytical writing. Apostrophe required in pinyin: yīn'ér.

examples.chinese: 他長期熬夜工作，身體因而每況愈下，最終不得不住院。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángqī áoyè gōngzuò, shēntǐ yīn'ér měikuàngyùxià, zuìzhōng bùdébù zhùyuàn.
examples.english: He worked late nights for a prolonged period, and as a result his health deteriorated progressively until he finally had to be hospitalized.

examples.chinese: 這座城市以生產鳳梨酥著名，因而被稱為「鳳梨酥之都」。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǐ shēngchǎn fènglísū zhùmíng, yīn'ér bèi chēngwéi 'fènglísū zhī dū'.
examples.english: This city is famous for producing pineapple cakes, and hence has been dubbed the 'pineapple cake capital.'

semanticNote: One of the variables or contributing elements in a situation. 關鍵因素 (key factor), 影響因素 (influencing factors), 多種因素 (multiple factors). Very common in analytical, academic, and journalistic writing. 風險因素 (risk factor) is common in medical and business contexts.

examples.chinese: 影響房價的因素很多，包括地點、交通和學區。
examples.pinyin: Yǐngxiǎng fángjià de yīnsù hěn duō, bāokuò dìdiǎn, jiāotōng hé xuéqū.
examples.english: There are many factors affecting housing prices, including location, transportation, and school district.

examples.chinese: 研究指出，遺傳只是其中一個因素，生活方式的影響同樣不可忽視。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū zhǐchū, yíchuán zhǐ shì qízhōng yī gè yīnsù, shēnghuó fāngshì de yǐngxiǎng tóngyàng bùkě hūshì.
examples.english: Research indicates that genetics is just one factor — the influence of lifestyle is equally impossible to ignore.

semanticNote: The precious metal (化學元素 Ag). 銀行 (bank, lit. silver-establishment), 銀白色 (silver-white), 銀牌 (silver medal). In Taiwan, 銀髮族 (silver-haired generation — senior citizens) is a widely used demographic term. 銀婚 (silver anniversary — 25 years of marriage).

examples.chinese: 台灣的銀髮族人口快速增加，長照需求也隨之上升。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yínfā zú rénkǒu kuàisù zēngjiā, zhǎngzhào xūqiú yě suízhī shàngshēng.
examples.english: Taiwan's senior population is growing rapidly, and demand for long-term care is rising accordingly.

examples.chinese: 她在運動會的跳高比賽中獲得了銀牌，非常開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yùndònghuì de tiàogāo bǐsài zhōng huòdéle yínpái, fēicháng kāixīn.
examples.english: She won the silver medal in the high jump at the sports meet and was very happy.

semanticNote: The process of reproducing text or images. 印刷廠 (print shop/printing factory), 印刷品 (printed matter), 數位印刷 (digital printing). Taiwan has a significant printing industry. 古騰堡 (Gutenberg) and 活版印刷 (movable type printing — invented in China) are historical references.

examples.chinese: 這本書印刷精美，紙質和裝幀都是一流的水準。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yìnshuā jīngměi, zhǐzhì hé zhuāngzhēn dōu shì yīliú de shuǐzhǔn.
examples.english: This book is beautifully printed — the paper quality and binding are both first-rate.

examples.chinese: 婚禮邀請卡需要提前兩個月送印刷廠，確保時間充裕。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ yāoqǐngkǎ xūyào tíqián liǎng gè yuè sòng yìnshuāchǎng, quèbǎo shíjiān chōngyù.
examples.english: Wedding invitations need to be sent to the printer two months in advance to ensure there's enough time.

semanticNote: Used exclusively to describe males — an attractive, well-featured man. 英俊瀟灑 (handsome and graceful) is a common four-character complement. For women, 漂亮/美麗 are used instead. 英俊的外表 (handsome appearance). Less common than 帥 (handsome) in everyday Taiwan speech; 英俊 is slightly more formal.

examples.chinese: 她第一眼見到他就被他英俊的外表和從容的氣質吸引了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī yǎn jiàn dào tā jiù bèi tā yīngjùn de wàibiǎo hé cóngróng de qìzhì xīyǐnle.
examples.english: The moment she first saw him, she was drawn in by his handsome appearance and composed demeanor.

examples.chinese: 那位年輕演員英俊帥氣，剛出道就吸引了大批粉絲。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi niánqīng yǎnyuán yīngjùn shuàiqì, gāng chūdào jiù xīyǐnle dàpī fěnsī.
examples.english: That young actor is strikingly handsome — he attracted a huge following of fans right from his debut.

semanticNote: A person of great valor, virtue, or achievement. 英雄主義 (heroism), 英雄好漢 (heroes and brave men), 落難英雄 (hero in distress). 英雄所見略同 (great minds think alike, lit. heroes see things the same way). In Taiwan, 英雄 is used in both sincere praise and popular culture (comic-book heroes, action films).

examples.chinese: 消防員在火場裡奮不顧身地救人，被大家稱為真正的英雄。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofáng yuán zài huǒchǎng lǐ fènbùgùshēn de jiùrén, bèi dàjiā chēng wéi zhēnzhèng de yīngxióng.
examples.english: Firefighters who recklessly save lives inside burning buildings are called true heroes by everyone.

examples.chinese: 亂世出英雄，每個時代都有它自己的傳奇人物。
examples.pinyin: Luànshì chū yīngxióng, měi gè shídài dōu yǒu tā zìjǐ de chuánqí rénwù.
examples.english: Heroes emerge in turbulent times — every era has its own legendary figures.

english: to welcome; to greet; to meet; to go out to receive
semanticNote: Actively going to meet or receive someone or something. 迎接客人 (welcome guests), 迎接挑戰 (meet a challenge head-on), 迎接新年 (welcome the new year). More proactive than 歡迎 (welcome passively/say welcome). Common in both literal and figurative contexts.

examples.chinese: 全家人到機場迎接從海外回來的奶奶，場面非常溫馨。
examples.pinyin: Quánjiā rén dào jīchǎng yíngjiē cóng hǎiwài huílái de nǎinai, chǎngmiàn fēicháng wēnxīn.
examples.english: The whole family went to the airport to welcome Grandma back from overseas — it was a very heartwarming scene.

examples.chinese: 面對未來的挑戰，我們應該積極樂觀地迎接。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì wèilái de tiǎozhàn, wǒmen yīnggāi jījí lèguān de yíngjiē.
examples.english: We should greet the challenges of the future with a positive and optimistic attitude.

semanticNote: Nutritional value and the substances that sustain health. 營養豐富 (nutritionally rich), 均衡營養 (balanced nutrition), 營養不良 (malnutrition). Taiwan's school lunch programs (學校午餐) are evaluated for 營養均衡. 營養師 (registered dietitian).

examples.chinese: 青少年正在發育，飲食需要特別注重營養均衡。
examples.pinyin: Qīngshàonián zhèngzài fāyù, yǐnshí xūyào tèbié zhùzhòng yíngyǎng jūnhéng.
examples.english: Teenagers are in a period of development — their diet needs to pay particular attention to balanced nutrition.

examples.chinese: 虱目魚富含蛋白質和DHA，是台灣南部非常有營養的傳統食材。
examples.pinyin: Shīmùyú fùhán dànbáizhì hé DHA, shì Táiwān nánbù fēicháng yǒu yíngyǎng de chuántǒng shícái.
examples.english: Milkfish is rich in protein and DHA — it's a very nutritious traditional food ingredient in southern Taiwan.

english: to do business; to operate; business operations
semanticNote: The act of a business being open and conducting transactions. 營業時間 (business hours), 暫停營業 (temporarily closed), 正常營業中 (open for business as normal). 停業/歇業 (close down a business). Common on shop signs in Taiwan: 本店24小時營業 (open 24 hours).

examples.chinese: 這家便利商店全年無休，二十四小時營業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā biànlì shāngdiàn quánnián wú xiū, èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè.
examples.english: This convenience store operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

examples.chinese: 受颱風影響，全市大多數店家今日暫停營業。
examples.pinyin: Shòu táifēng yǐngxiǎng, quánshì dàduōshù diànjiā jīnrì zànting yíngyè.
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, most shops in the city are temporarily closed today.

semanticNote: The dark silhouette cast by blocking light. 影子很長 (the shadow is long), 踩著影子 (step on a shadow). Figurative: 連影子都沒有 (not a trace; nowhere to be found), 在她的影響下成長 (grew up in her shadow/influence). 影子政府 (shadow government) is a political term.

examples.chinese: 傍晚時分，落日把兩個人的影子拉得很長。
examples.pinyin: Bàngwǎn shífēn, luòrì bǎ liǎng gèrén de yǐngzi lā de hěn cháng.
examples.english: At dusk, the setting sun stretched the shadows of the two of them out very long.

examples.chinese: 我找了他一整天，連影子都沒見到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎole tā yī zhěng tiān, lián yǐngzi dōu méi jiàn dào.
examples.english: I looked for him all day and couldn't find even a trace of him.

english: to cope with; to deal with; to handle; to do perfunctorily
semanticNote: Two senses: (1) cope with a difficult situation — 應付危機 (handle a crisis), 應付考試 (get through an exam); (2) do something just to get by without real effort — 他只是隨便應付一下 (he just dealt with it half-heartedly). The second sense implies superficiality. Context determines which is meant.

examples.chinese: 她一個人要應付三個孩子，還要兼顧工作，真的很辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīgèrén yào yìngfu sān gè háizi, hái yào jiāngù gōngzuò, zhēnde hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.english: Having to handle three children on her own while also keeping up with work — it's truly tough for her.

examples.chinese: 他交出來的報告明顯是在應付差事，連格式都沒對齊。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāo chūlái de bàogào míngxiǎn shì zài yìngfu chāishì, lián géshì dōu méi duìqí.
examples.english: The report he submitted was obviously done perfunctorily — even the formatting wasn't aligned.

english: to apply; to use; application; app
semanticNote: Both 'to apply in practice' (應用科學 — applied science, 應用到工作上 — apply to work) and 'application/app' (手機應用程式 — mobile app, commonly abbreviated as App in Taiwan). 應用程式 is the formal term; everyone just says App in daily speech. 應用力學 (applied mechanics).

examples.chinese: 他把課堂上學到的統計知識應用到市場調查中，得出了有趣的結論。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ kètáng shàng xué dào de tǒngjì zhīshí yìngyòng dào shìchǎng diàochá zhōng, dé chūle yǒuqù de jiélùn.
examples.english: He applied the statistical knowledge learned in class to a market survey and reached interesting conclusions.

examples.chinese: 這款應用程式可以幫助你追蹤每日的健康數據和步數。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yìngyòng chéngshì kěyǐ bāngzhù nǐ zhuīzōng měirì de jiànkāng shùjù hé bùshù.
examples.english: This application can help you track your daily health data and step count.

semanticNote: Physical hardness (硬木 — hardwood; 硬幣 — coin, lit. hard currency) and figurative firmness (態度強硬 — take a firm stance; 硬撐 — force oneself to keep going; 硬著頭皮 — steel oneself/grit one's teeth to do something). Opposite: 軟 (soft). 過硬 (excellent, rock-solid — skills or relationships).

examples.chinese: 這張床墊太硬，睡了一晚腰都痛了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng chuángdiàn tài yìng, shuìle yī wǎn yāo dōu tòng le.
examples.english: This mattress is too hard — after sleeping on it one night my lower back ached.

examples.chinese: 他硬是撐著完成了最後五公里的馬拉松，感動了所有觀眾。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìng shì chēngzhe wánchéngle zuìhòu wǔ gōnglǐ de mǎlāsōng, gǎndòngle suǒyǒu guānzhòng.
examples.english: He forced himself through the final five kilometers of the marathon, moving the entire crowd.

semanticNote: Computer hardware — the physical components of a computer system (CPU, RAM, motherboard, etc.). Opposite: 軟體/軟件 (software). In Taiwan, 硬體 (yìngtǐ) is the more common traditional-character form; 硬件 is also understood. 硬體設備 (hardware equipment). Taiwan's TSMC and related companies are central to global hardware production.

examples.chinese: 他的電腦跑得很慢，技術人員建議他升級硬體記憶體。
examples.pinyin: Tā de diànnǎo pǎo de hěn màn, jìshù rényuán jiànyì tā shēngjí yìngtǐ jìyìtǐ.
examples.english: His computer runs very slowly — the technician recommended upgrading the hardware memory.

examples.chinese: 台灣在全球電腦硬體供應鏈中扮演著不可或缺的角色。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zài quánqiú diànnǎo yìngtǐ gōngyìng liàn zhōng bànyǎnzhe bùkě huòquē de juésè.
examples.english: Taiwan plays an indispensable role in the global computer hardware supply chain.

semanticNote: A warm physical embrace. 給一個擁抱 (give a hug), 緊緊擁抱 (hug tightly). Figuratively: 擁抱新技術 (embrace new technology), 擁抱改變 (embrace change). Physical affection is generally more reserved in public in Taiwan than in Western countries, so 擁抱 in public signals a close relationship.

components.meaning: hold in arms; hug; carry; cherish

examples.chinese: 久別重逢，兩個好友在機場出口緊緊地擁抱在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ bié chóngféng, liǎng gè hǎoyǒu zài jīchǎng chūkǒu jǐnjǐn de yōngbào zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: Reunited after a long time apart, the two close friends held each other in a tight embrace at the airport exit.

examples.chinese: 面對數位化浪潮，企業必須積極擁抱新科技才能保持競爭力。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì shùwèihuà làngcháo, qǐyè bìxū jījí yōngbào xīn kējì cái néng bǎochí jìngzhēnglì.
examples.english: Facing the wave of digitalization, companies must actively embrace new technology in order to remain competitive.

english: crowded; congested; to push; to jostle
semanticNote: Describes a space or situation where too many people/things are packed together. 人群擁擠 (crowded crowd), 交通擁擠 (traffic congestion), 擁擠不堪 (hopelessly crowded). Taipei during rush hour (上下班時間) on the MRT is a classic 擁擠 context. Synonym: 擁塞 (congested).

examples.chinese: 假日的九份老街擁擠不堪，走路都需要肩並肩地前進。
examples.pinyin: Jiàrì de Jiǔfèn lǎojiē yōngjǐ bùkān, zǒulù dōu xūyào jiān bìng jiān de qiánjìn.
examples.english: Jiufen's old street is hopelessly crowded on weekends — you have to shuffle along shoulder-to-shoulder.

examples.chinese: 他不喜歡擁擠的地方，假日寧可待在家裡看書。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuān yōngjǐ de dìfāng, jiàrì nìngkě dāi zài jiālǐ kànshū.
examples.english: He doesn't like crowded places and would rather stay home reading on weekends.

semanticNote: The inner strength to face fear or difficulty. 鼓起勇氣 (summon the courage), 缺乏勇氣 (lack courage), 有勇氣去嘗試 (have the courage to try). 勇氣 is distinguished from 勇敢 (brave as an adjective) — 勇氣 is the noun/quality itself. A core virtue praised in Taiwan's education.

examples.chinese: 她鼓起勇氣，當眾說出了自己的想法，贏得了大家的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǔqǐ yǒngqì, dāngzhòng shuōchūle zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, yíngdéle dàjiā de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: She summoned the courage to speak her mind in front of everyone and earned a round of applause.

examples.chinese: 失敗之後重新站起來，需要的不只是能力，更需要勇氣。
examples.pinyin: Shībài zhīhòu chóngxīn zhàn qǐlái, xūyào de bù zhǐ shì nénglì, gèng xūyào yǒngqì.
examples.english: Getting back up after failure takes not just ability, but above all courage.

english: hardworking; diligent; studious; to study hard
semanticNote: Describes someone who applies sustained effort to study or work. 很用功的學生 (a very diligent student). In Taiwan's exam-focused culture, 用功 is a key virtue — parents and teachers frequently exhort children to 好好用功 (study hard). 用功讀書 = study diligently. Skeleton pinyin has a space: yòng gōng.

examples.chinese: 學測前三個月他每天用功讀書到深夜，最後考出了理想的成績。
examples.pinyin: Xuécè qián sān gè yuè tā měitiān yòng gōng dúshū dào shēnyè, zuìhòu kǎo chūle lǐxiǎng de chéngjì.
examples.english: He studied diligently until late at night every day for the three months before the GSAT — and in the end scored his ideal result.

examples.chinese: 她從小就很用功，老師和父母都對她的努力讚不絕口。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yòng gōng, lǎoshī hé fùmǔ dōu duì tā de nǔlì zàn bù jué kǒu.
examples.english: She has been diligent since childhood — teachers and parents alike can't stop praising her hard work.

semanticNote: What something is used for. 多種用途 (multiple uses/purposes), 特殊用途 (special purpose), 沒有用途 (no use/useless). 用途廣泛 (widely applicable) is a common phrase for versatile tools or materials. More formal than 用法 (usage/method of use).

examples.chinese: 這種特殊材料用途廣泛，可以用在建築、醫療和航空領域。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tèshū cáiliào yòngtú guǎngfàn, kěyǐ yòng zài jiànzhú, yīliáo hé hángkōng lǐngyù.
examples.english: This special material has a wide range of uses — it can be applied in construction, medicine, and aviation.

examples.chinese: 芭樂在台灣不只是水果，葉子還有藥用用途。
examples.pinyin: Bālè zài Táiwān bù zhǐ shì shuǐguǒ, yèzi hái yǒu yàoyòng yòngtú.
examples.english: Guava in Taiwan isn't just a fruit — its leaves also have medicinal uses.

semanticNote: A discounted price or preferential treatment. 優惠券 (coupon/voucher), 優惠價格 (discounted price), 享有優惠 (enjoy preferential treatment). In Taiwan's consumer culture, 優惠活動 (promotional offers) are ubiquitous — from 7-Eleven points to credit card cashback. 敬老優惠 (senior discount) is widely available on transit.

examples.chinese: 持學生證可以享有捷運票價的優惠，比一般票便宜兩成。
examples.pinyin: Chí xuéshēngzhèng kěyǐ xiǎngyǒu jiéyùn piàojià de yōuhuì, bǐ yībān piào piányí liǎng chéng.
examples.english: Students with a student ID can enjoy a discounted MRT fare — 20% cheaper than the regular price.

examples.chinese: 這個月刷指定信用卡消費滿兩千元，可以獲得額外的現金回饋優惠。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè shuā zhǐdìng xìnyòngkǎ xiāofèi mǎn liǎng qiān yuán, kěyǐ huòdé éwài de xiànjīn huíkuì yōuhuì.
examples.english: Spending over NT$2,000 with a designated credit card this month earns extra cashback rewards.

semanticNote: Describes graceful, refined beauty — more elegant than plain 美麗 (beautiful). 優美的舞姿 (graceful dance posture), 優美的旋律 (beautiful melody), 文字優美 (beautifully written prose). Often applied to artistic or natural beauty that has a quality of refinement. 環境優美 (pleasant environment) is common in real estate and tourism.

examples.chinese: 池上的稻田景色優美，每年秋天都吸引大批攝影師前往取景。
examples.pinyin: Chíshàng de dàotián jǐngsè yōuměi, měi nián qiūtiān dōu xīyǐn dàpī shèyǐngshī qiánwǎng qǔjǐng.
examples.english: The rice paddy scenery of Chishang is beautiful — every autumn it attracts large numbers of photographers to capture the scene.

examples.chinese: 她的鋼琴演奏技巧純熟，音色優美，聽完讓人如沐春風。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gāngqín yǎnzòu jìqiǎo chúnshú, yīnsè yōuměi, tīng wán ràng rén rú mù chūnfēng.
examples.english: Her piano playing is technically accomplished and tonally beautiful — listening to it feels like basking in a spring breeze.

semanticNote: A position of strength relative to others. 競爭優勢 (competitive advantage), 發揮優勢 (leverage one's advantages), 技術優勢 (technological edge). Taiwan's 護國神山 (TSMC) is often described as Taiwan's most critical 優勢 in the global economy. Opposite: 劣勢 (disadvantage).

examples.chinese: 台灣在半導體製造上具有明顯的技術優勢，吸引了全球企業的關注。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zài bàndǎotǐ zhìzào shàng jùyǒu míngxiǎn de jìshù yōushì, xīyǐnle quánqiú qǐyè de guānzhù.
examples.english: Taiwan has a clear technological advantage in semiconductor manufacturing, drawing the attention of companies worldwide.

examples.chinese: 她的語言優勢讓她在外商公司的面試中脫穎而出。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǔyán yōushì ràng tā zài wàishāng gōngsī de miànshì zhōng tuōyǐng'érchū.
examples.english: Her language advantage allowed her to stand out in interviews with foreign companies.

english: long-standing; long-established; of long duration; ancient
semanticNote: Describes things with a long, distinguished history — typically institutions, traditions, or cultures. 歷史悠久 (with a long history) is perhaps the most common collocation. Always positive in connotation — implies depth and continuity, not just oldness. 悠久的文化傳統 (long-standing cultural tradition).

examples.chinese: 孔廟是台南歷史悠久的地標之一，也是全台最早的孔廟。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng miào shì Táinán lìshǐ yōujiǔ de dìbiāo zhī yī, yěshì quán Tái zuì zǎo de Kǒng miào.
examples.english: The Confucius Temple is one of Tainan's most historically enduring landmarks — also the oldest Confucius Temple in all of Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣的茶文化歷史悠久，從清代就開始發展，至今仍是日常生活的一部分。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de chá wénhuà lìshǐ yōujiǔ, cóng Qīng dài jiù kāishǐ fāzhǎn, zhìjīn réng shì rìcháng shēnghuó de yī bùfèn.
examples.english: Taiwan's tea culture has a long history — it began developing during the Qing dynasty and remains part of everyday life to this day.

english: to hesitate; to be undecided; hesitant; wavering
semanticNote: The state of being unable to make up one's mind. 猶豫不決 (hesitant and indecisive) is a very common four-character phrase. 毫不猶豫 (without a moment's hesitation) is the emphatic positive form. 猶豫了很久 (hesitated for a long time). Captures the internal conflict of weighing options.

components.meaning: still; just like; as if; hesitate

examples.chinese: 他猶豫了很久，最後還是決定接受這個工作機會。
examples.pinyin: Tā yóuyùle hěn jiǔ, zuìhòu háishi juédìng jiēshòu zhège gōngzuò jīhuì.
examples.english: After hesitating for a long time, he finally decided to accept the job offer.

examples.chinese: 遇到緊急情況，她毫不猶豫地撥打了119求救。
examples.pinyin: Yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng, tā háo bù yóuyù de bōdǎle 119 qiújiù.
examples.english: When the emergency arose, she called 119 for help without a moment's hesitation.

semanticNote: Cooking method where food is submerged in hot oil. 油炸食品 (deep-fried food), 油炸雞排 (deep-fried chicken cutlet — Taiwan's beloved street food). Taiwan's 雞排 is a cultural icon: enormous, crispy, often served with basil. 酥炸 (lightly battered and fried) is a variant. Taiwan's health authorities periodically caution against 油炸 overconsumption.

examples.chinese: 台灣夜市最受歡迎的小吃之一就是炸得金黃酥脆的大雞排。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yèshì zuì shòu huānyíng de xiǎochī zhī yī jiùshì zhá de jīnhuáng sūcuì de dà jīpái.
examples.english: One of Taiwan's most popular night market snacks is the golden-crispy deep-fried chicken cutlet.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議他少吃油炸食品，多攝取蔬菜和水果。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā shǎo chī yóuzhá shípǐn, duō shèqǔ shūcài hé shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: The doctor advised him to eat less deep-fried food and consume more vegetables and fruit.

english: to tour; to go sightseeing; sightseeing; tour
semanticNote: Leisurely sightseeing — 遊覽名勝 (tour scenic spots), 遊覽車 (tour bus — a familiar sight at Taiwan's tourist destinations). More leisurely and scenic-focused than 參觀 (visit, usually with an educational purpose). 一日遊 (one-day tour) and 遊覽行程 (sightseeing itinerary) are common in Taiwan tourism.

examples.chinese: 他們搭遊覽車環島，花了八天時間遊覽了台灣各地的名勝。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen dā yóulǎnchē huán dǎo, huāle bā tiān shíjiān yóulǎnle Táiwān gèdì de míngshèng.
examples.english: They took a tour bus around the island and spent eight days sightseeing at famous spots all over Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 墾丁國家公園是南台灣最受歡迎的遊覽目的地之一。
examples.pinyin: Kěndīng guójiā gōngyuán shì nán Táiwān zuì shòu huānyíng de yóulǎn mùdìdì zhī yī.
examples.english: Kenting National Park is one of the most popular sightseeing destinations in southern Taiwan.

semanticNote: Something that works in one's favor or creates benefit. 有利條件 (favorable conditions), 有利於健康 (beneficial to health), 對談判有利 (favorable for negotiations). Opposite: 不利 (unfavorable; disadvantageous). Common in strategic, diplomatic, and business analysis.

examples.chinese: 適當運動對於維持心血管健康非常有利。
examples.pinyin: Shìdàng yùndòng duìyú wéichí xīnxuèguǎn jiànkāng fēicháng yǒulì.
examples.english: Moderate exercise is highly beneficial for maintaining cardiovascular health.

examples.chinese: 目前的匯率對台灣出口商有利，訂單量也因此增加。
examples.pinyin: Mùqián de huìlǜ duì Táiwān chūkǒushāng yǒulì, dìngdān liàng yěyīncǐ zēngjiā.
examples.english: The current exchange rate is favorable for Taiwanese exporters, and order volumes have increased as a result.

semanticNote: Early childhood education institution for children typically aged 2–6. In Taiwan, 幼兒園 (formerly called 幼稚園 — now the official term is 幼兒園 following 2012 legislation) covers ages 2–6, with 公立幼兒園 (public) and 私立幼兒園 (private). High demand for spots in good public kindergartens. Apostrophe required in pinyin: yòu'éryuán.

examples.chinese: 她的兒子明年就要上幼兒園了，她正在比較附近幾所的教學品質。
examples.pinyin: Tā de érzi míngnián jiù yào shàng yòu'éryuán le, tā zhèngzài bǐjiào fùjìn jǐ suǒ de jiàoxué pǐnzhì.
examples.english: Her son starts kindergarten next year — she's currently comparing the teaching quality of several nearby schools.

examples.chinese: 公立幼兒園的費用比私立便宜很多，但名額有限，需要提前抽籤。
examples.pinyin: Gōnglì yòu'éryuán de fèiyòng bǐ sīlì piányí hěn duō, dàn míng'é yǒuxiàn, xūyào tíqián chōuqiān.
examples.english: Public kindergartens are much cheaper than private ones, but spots are limited and require advance lottery entry.

english: entertainment; recreation; to entertain; to amuse
semanticNote: Leisure and entertainment broadly — 娛樂產業 (entertainment industry), 娛樂節目 (entertainment program), 娛樂至死 (amusing ourselves to death — Neil Postman's phrase, widely cited).
