Taiwan has a vibrant pop culture and entertainment scene: 台灣娛樂圈 (Taiwan's entertainment world, including idol dramas and music).

examples.chinese: 台灣的娛樂產業以偶像劇和流行音樂在亞洲享有一定的知名度。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yúlè chǎnyè yǐ ǒuxiàngjù hé liúxíng yīnyuè zài yàzhōu xiǎngyǒu yīdìng de zhīmíngdù.
examples.english: Taiwan's entertainment industry has built up a certain reputation in Asia through its idol dramas and pop music.

examples.chinese: 現代人的娛樂方式越來越多元，從串流影片到電競都很受年輕人歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén de yúlè fāngshì yuèláiyuè duōyuán, cóng chuàn liú yǐngpiàn dào diànjìng dōu hěn shòu niánqīngrén huānyíng.
examples.english: Modern people's forms of entertainment are increasingly diverse — from streaming video to e-sports, all are popular among young people.

english: rather than; it would be better to… than to…
semanticNote: A comparative conjunction contrasting two options, always preferring the second. 與其…不如… (rather than X, better to Y). 與其浪費時間，不如好好休息 (rather than waste time, better to get proper rest). More formal than 比起 (compared to). Common in analytical and persuasive writing.

examples.chinese: 與其花時間抱怨，不如想想有什麼具體的解決方法。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqí huā shíjiān bàoyuàn, bùrú xiǎngxiǎng yǒu shéme jùtǐ de jiějué fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Rather than spending time complaining, better to think about what concrete solutions exist.

examples.chinese: 與其讓孩子漫無目的地滑手機，不如帶他去公園動一動。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqí ràng háizi màn wú mùdì de huá shǒujī, bùrú dài tā qù gōngyuán dòng yi dòng.
examples.english: Rather than letting the child mindlessly scroll through the phone, better to take him to the park for some movement.

english: tone; manner of speaking; mood (in grammar)
semanticNote: The manner, tone, or attitude conveyed through speech. 語氣溫和 (gentle tone), 語氣強硬 (firm/harsh tone), 語氣中帶著不滿 (tone tinged with dissatisfaction). In grammar: 語氣詞 (modal particle — 吧、嗎、啊 etc.) and 語氣助詞 (modal/attitude particles). 改變語氣 (change one's tone).

examples.chinese: 她說話的語氣很溫和，即使在批評別人時也不讓人感到難堪。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de yǔqì hěn wēnhé, jíshǐ zài pīpíng biérén shí yě bù ràng rén gǎndào nánkān.
examples.english: Her tone of speech is very gentle — even when criticizing others she doesn't make them feel embarrassed.

examples.chinese: 他說「隨便」的語氣聽起來很冷漠，讓她有些心寒。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō 'suíbiàn' de yǔqì tīng qǐlái hěn lěngmò, ràng tā yǒuxiē xīnhán.
examples.english: The tone in which he said 'whatever' sounded very indifferent and left her feeling somewhat cold.

semanticNote: Maize/corn. Common in Taiwan as a snack (水煮玉米 — boiled corn, 烤玉米 — grilled corn at night markets), ingredient, and feed crop. 玉米粉 (cornstarch/cornflour), 玉米濃湯 (corn chowder). The grilled corn stand (烤玉米) is a common night market fixture. In Taiwan, 嫩玉米 (sweet corn) is the most popular variety.

examples.chinese: 夜市裡烤玉米的香氣四溢，忍不住買了一根。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ kǎo yùmǐ de xiānqì sì yì, rěn bù zhù mǎile yī gēn.
examples.english: The aroma of grilled corn drifted everywhere through the night market — I couldn't resist buying one.

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的玉米又甜又脆，直接水煮就很好吃了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de yùmǐ yòu tián yòu cuì, zhíjiē shuǐ zhǔ jiù hěn hǎo chī le.
examples.english: Taiwan's summer corn is sweet and crisp — it's delicious just boiled in water.

english: to forecast; to predict; forecast; prediction
semanticNote: Primarily used for weather forecasting — 天氣預報 (weather forecast) is the most common collocation. In Taiwan, 中央氣象局 (Central Weather Bureau) provides official forecasts; watching the 天氣預報 before a typhoon is a national ritual. Also used in seismic and economic forecasting.

examples.chinese: 根據氣象局的天氣預報，週末將有颱風登陸，請大家做好準備。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàngjú de tiānqì yùbào, zhōumò jiāng yǒu táifēng dēnglù, qǐng dàjiā zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: According to the Weather Bureau's forecast, a typhoon will make landfall on the weekend — please everyone be prepared.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上都會先看天氣預報，再決定要不要帶傘出門。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì xiān kàn tiānqì yùbào, zài juédìng yào búyào dài sǎn chūmén.
examples.english: Every morning he checks the weather forecast first, then decides whether to bring an umbrella.

english: to reserve; to book; to order in advance; to subscribe
semanticNote: Making a reservation or advance order. 預訂房間 (book a room), 預訂餐廳 (make a restaurant reservation), 預訂車票 (book a train ticket). In Taiwan, booking HSR (高鐵) tickets and popular restaurant tables online is standard practice. 預訂確認 (booking confirmation).

examples.chinese: 熱門餐廳假日常常客滿，最好提前一週預訂。
examples.pinyin: Rèmén cāntīng jiàrì chángcháng kèmǎn, zuìhǎo tíqián yī zhōu yùdìng.
examples.english: Popular restaurants are often fully booked on weekends — it's best to reserve a week in advance.

examples.chinese: 她在網路上預訂了墾丁的民宿，選了海景房。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǎnglù shàng yùdìngle Kěndīng de mínsù, xuǎnle hǎijǐng fáng.
examples.english: She booked a B&B in Kenting online and chose an ocean-view room.

english: to prevent; to guard against; prevention
semanticNote: Taking measures to stop something harmful before it happens. 預防疾病 (prevent disease), 預防針/疫苗 (vaccine/preventive injection), 預防措施 (preventive measures). In Taiwan, 衛福部 (Ministry of Health and Welfare) runs public health 預防 campaigns. 防患於未然 is a related proverb.

examples.chinese: 每年施打流感疫苗是最有效的預防流感方法之一。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián shī dǎ liúgǎn yìmiáo shì zuì yǒuxiào de yùfáng liúgǎn fāngfǎ zhī yī.
examples.english: Getting a flu vaccine every year is one of the most effective ways to prevent influenza.

examples.chinese: 颱風來臨前，居民提前做好防颱措施，以預防可能的災害。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng láilín qián, jūmín tíqián zuò hǎo fángtái cuòshī, yǐ yùfáng kěnéng de zāihài.
examples.english: Before the typhoon arrived, residents took early preventive measures to guard against potential disaster.

semanticNote: January 1st — the Gregorian New Year. In Taiwan, 元旦 is a national holiday. The major New Year celebration is 跨年 (New Year's Eve countdown), with the most famous in Taiwan being the Taipei 101 fireworks. Distinct from 農曆新年/春節 (Lunar New Year), which is the bigger cultural celebration.

examples.chinese: 元旦當天是國定假日，許多政府機關和學校都不上班上課。
examples.pinyin: Yuándàn dāngtiān shì guódìng jiàrì, xǔduō zhèngfǔ jīguān hé xuéxiào dōu bù shàngbān shàngkè.
examples.english: New Year's Day is a national holiday — many government offices and schools don't work or hold classes.

examples.chinese: 每年跨年夜，台北一〇一的煙火總是讓數十萬人在現場歡呼迎接元旦。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián kuàniányè, Táiběi yīlíngyī de yānhuǒ zǒng shì ràng shùshí wàn rén zài xiànchǎng huānhū yíngjiē yuándàn.
examples.english: Every New Year's Eve, the Taipei 101 fireworks draw hundreds of thousands of people to cheer in person as they welcome New Year's Day.

semanticNote: People employed by an organization. 員工福利 (employee benefits), 員工滿意度 (employee satisfaction), 全體員工 (all staff). In Taiwan, 勞基法 (Labor Standards Act) governs employment relationships. 員工旅遊 (company trip) is a common perk. 正式員工 vs. 約聘員工 (permanent vs. contract staff).

examples.chinese: 公司為了提升員工的工作效率，引進了彈性上班制度。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèile tíshēng yuángōng de gōngzuò xiàolǜ, yǐnjìnle tánxìng shàngbān zhìdù.
examples.english: The company introduced a flexible work schedule to improve employee productivity.

examples.chinese: 年底的員工旅遊是公司感謝大家一年辛苦的方式之一。
examples.pinyin: Niándǐ de yuángōng lǚyóu shì gōngsī gǎnxiè dàjiā yī nián xīnkǔ de fāngshì zhī yī.
examples.english: The year-end company trip is one of the ways the company thanks everyone for a year of hard work.

semanticNote: The unprocessed materials used to make something. 食品原料 (food ingredients), 工業原料 (industrial raw materials), 原料成本 (raw material cost). Taiwan's manufacturing sector (半導體, electronics, food) depends heavily on imported 原料. 原料漲價 (rising raw material prices) directly affects production costs.

examples.chinese: 這家手工餅乾店堅持使用台灣在地的農產品作為原料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shǒugōng bǐnggān diàn jiānchí shǐyòng Táiwān zàidì de nóngchǎnpǐn zuòwéi yuánliào.
examples.english: This artisan cookie shop insists on using locally grown Taiwanese agricultural products as ingredients.

examples.chinese: 全球原料短缺影響了台灣多個製造業的生產進度。
examples.pinyin: Quánqiú yuánliào duǎnquē yǐngxiǎngle Táiwān duō gè zhìzàoyè de shēngchǎn jìndù.
examples.english: Global raw material shortages have affected the production schedules of multiple manufacturing sectors in Taiwan.

semanticNote: A fundamental rule or guiding belief. 堅守原則 (uphold principles), 原則問題 (a matter of principle — not negotiable), 有原則的人 (a person of principle). Taiwan's civil society and political discourse frequently invoke 民主原則 (democratic principles) and 法治原則 (rule of law principles). 原則上 (in principle; as a general rule).

examples.chinese: 他是個有原則的人，即使在壓力下也不會做違背良心的事。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè yǒu yuánzé de rén, jíshǐ zài yālì xià yě bù huì zuò wéibèi liángxīn de shì.
examples.english: He's a person of principle — even under pressure he won't do things that go against his conscience.

examples.chinese: 原則上我們支持這項提案，但細節部分還需要進一步討論。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzé shàng wǒmen zhīchí zhè xiàng tí'àn, dàn xìjié bùfèn hái xūyào jìnyībù tǎolùn.
examples.english: In principle we support this proposal, but the details still need further discussion.

english: round; circular; circle; yuan (unit of Chinese currency)
semanticNote: Shape (round/circular), and also the formal monetary unit — 元/圓 are both used for NT dollars (新台幣), with 元 more common in everyday contexts. 圓滿 (satisfactory; complete and successful), 圓滾滾 (round and chubby — cute description). The moon on Mid-Autumn Festival is 又大又圓.

examples.chinese: 中秋節的月亮特別大又圓，全家人圍在一起賞月烤肉。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié de yuèliang tèbié dà yòu yuán, quánjiā rén wéi zài yīqǐ shǎng yuè kǎoròu.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn moon is especially large and round — the whole family gathers to enjoy the moon and barbecue together.

examples.chinese: 這次活動辦得非常圓滿，所有參與者都表示滿意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng bàn de fēicháng yuánmǎn, suǒyǒu cānyù zhě dōu biǎoshì mǎnyì.
examples.english: This event was organized to a very satisfying completion — all participants expressed their satisfaction.

semanticNote: A heartfelt hope or desire for the future. 實現願望 (fulfill a wish), 美好的願望 (beautiful aspiration), 許願 (make a wish — common at temples and on birthdays). In Taiwan, 許願 at 廟宇 (temples) before exams is a cultural practice. 願望清單 (wish list) is the modern consumer term.

components.meaning: hope; expect; look toward; full moon

examples.chinese: 她從小的願望就是成為一名醫生，幫助需要幫助的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo de yuànwàng jiùshì chéngwéi yī míng yīshēng, bāngzhù xūyào bāngzhù de rén.
examples.english: Her wish ever since childhood has been to become a doctor and help people in need.

examples.chinese: 每年媽祖遶境時，信徒們都會向媽祖訴說自己的願望，祈求平安。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián Māzǔ ràojìng shí, xìntúmen dōu huì xiàng Māzǔ sùshuō zìjǐ de yuànwàng, qíqiú píng'ān.
examples.english: Every year during the Matsu pilgrimage, devotees express their wishes to Matsu and pray for safety.

semanticNote: Any instrument used to make music. 彈奏樂器 (play an instrument), 管樂器 (wind instruments), 弦樂器 (string instruments), 打擊樂器 (percussion instruments). Taiwan has a strong tradition of music education — many students learn 鋼琴 (piano), 小提琴 (violin), or traditional instruments like 古箏/二胡. 學樂器 (learn an instrument) is common among school children.

examples.chinese: 她從六歲開始學鋼琴，是所有樂器中她最擅長的。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng liù suì kāishǐ xué gāngqín, shì suǒyǒu yuèqì zhōng tā zuì shàncháng de.
examples.english: She started learning piano at six — it's the instrument she's best at out of all of them.

examples.chinese: 台灣各地的國小普遍設有音樂課，教導學生認識各種樂器。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān gèdì de guóxiǎo pǔbiàn shè yǒu yīnyuè kè, jiàodǎo xuéshēng rènshí gèzhǒng yuèqì.
examples.english: Elementary schools throughout Taiwan universally offer music classes to teach students about various instruments.

english: yūn: dizzy; faint; lose consciousness | yùn: halo; glow
semanticNote: Two readings: 暈 (yūn) = dizzy, faint — 頭暈 (dizzy), 暈車 (carsick), 暈船 (seasick), 暈倒 (faint); 暈 (yùn) = a halo or glow — 月暈 (lunar halo). The yūn reading is by far more common in everyday Taiwan usage. 暈機 (airsick) is also common among Taiwan's busy air traveler population.

examples.chinese: 她體質不好，一坐車就暈車，長途旅行前都要先吃暈車藥。
examples.pinyin: Tā tǐzhì bù hǎo, yī zuò chē jiù yūnchē, chángtú lǚxíng qián dōu yào xiān chī yūnchē yào.
examples.english: She has a sensitive constitution and gets carsick as soon as she's in a vehicle — she always takes motion sickness medicine before long trips.

examples.chinese: 天氣太熱了，她突然頭暈，差點在路上暈倒。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, tā tūrán tóuyūn, chàdiǎn zài lùshàng yūndǎo.
examples.english: The weather was so hot that she suddenly felt dizzy and nearly fainted on the street.

semanticNote: One's fortune or luck. 好運氣 (good luck), 運氣不好 (bad luck), 靠運氣 (rely on luck). In Taiwan's culture, luck is actively cultivated through temple visits, auspicious dates, and lucky numbers. 碰運氣 (try one's luck), 運氣好的話 (with any luck; if lucky). The -qi ending is unstressed (neutral tone).

examples.chinese: 他考試前去廟裡拜拜，希望借借神明的力量讓運氣好一點。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎoshì qián qù miào lǐ bàibài, xīwàng jiè jiè shénmíng de lìliàng ràng yùnqi hǎo yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Before the exam he went to pray at the temple, hoping to borrow some divine power to improve his luck.

examples.chinese: 這次能找到這份工作，一半是實力，一半是運氣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì néng zhǎodào zhè fèn gōngzuò, yī bàn shì shílì, yī bàn shì yùnqi.
examples.english: Landing this job was half ability and half luck.

semanticNote: The movement of goods or people. 貨物運輸 (freight transport), 運輸業 (transportation industry), 大眾運輸 (public transportation). Taiwan's 大眾運輸系統 (public transit system) includes MRT, trains, and buses. 海運 (sea freight), 空運 (air freight) are key for Taiwan's export economy.

examples.chinese: 台灣的出口貨物大多透過基隆港或高雄港進行海運運輸。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de chūkǒu huòwù dàduō tòuguò Jīlóng gǎng huò Gāoxióng gǎng jìnxíng hǎiyùn yùnshū.
examples.english: Most of Taiwan's export goods are shipped by sea through the ports of Keelung or Kaohsiung.

examples.chinese: 地震後道路受損，救災物資的運輸遇到了很大的困難。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu dàolù shòu sǔn, jiùzāi wùzī de yùnshū yùdào le hěn dà de kùnnán.
examples.english: After the earthquake, road damage created major difficulties for transporting disaster relief supplies.

english: to make use of; to apply; to utilize
semanticNote: Purposefully applying knowledge, skills, or resources. 運用知識 (apply knowledge), 靈活運用 (apply flexibly), 善加運用 (make good use of). More deliberate and skillful than plain 用 (use) — implies strategic or creative application. Common in academic and professional contexts.

examples.chinese: 他善於運用統計數據支持自己的論點，讓論文更具說服力。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàn yú yùnyòng tǒngjì shùjù zhīchí zìjǐ de lùndiǎn, ràng lùnwén gèng jù shuōfúlì.
examples.english: He is skilled at using statistical data to support his arguments, making his thesis more persuasive.

examples.chinese: 學語言的關鍵在於靈活運用，而不是死記文法規則。
examples.pinyin: Xué yǔyán de guānjiàn zàiyú línghuo yùnyòng, ér bú shì sǐjì wénfǎ guīzé.
examples.english: The key to language learning lies in flexible application, not rote memorization of grammar rules.

semanticNote: A major harmful event affecting people and property. 天然災害 (natural disaster), 防災 (disaster prevention), 災害應變 (disaster response). Taiwan is particularly disaster-prone: typhoons, earthquakes, and floods make 災害防救 (disaster prevention and relief) a major government priority. 921大地震 is the most significant recent 災害 in collective memory.

examples.chinese: 台灣位於環太平洋地震帶，地震是最常見的天然災害之一。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān wèiyú Huán Tàipíngyáng dìzhèndài, dìzhèn shì zuì chángjiàn de tiānrán zāihài zhī yī.
examples.english: Taiwan is located in the Pacific Ring of Fire — earthquakes are one of the most common natural disasters.

examples.chinese: 921地震造成的災害讓台灣社會深刻認識到防震教育的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èryī dìzhèn zàochéng de zāihài ràng Táiwān shèhuì shēnkè rènshí dào fáng zhèn jiàoyù de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: The devastation of the 921 earthquake made Taiwanese society deeply aware of the importance of earthquake preparedness education.

english: repeatedly; over and over; again and again
semanticNote: Indicates repetition or emphasis through multiple attempts. 再三強調 (emphasize again and again), 再三考慮 (consider repeatedly), 再三叮嚀 (remind repeatedly). More emphatic than 一再 — implies the action has been done at least three times, with each repetition adding urgency.

examples.chinese: 媽媽再三交代要記得帶鑰匙，他還是忘了。
examples.pinyin: Māma zàisān jiāodài yào jìdé dài yàoshi, tā háishi wàng le.
examples.english: Mom reminded him again and again to remember his keys — and he still forgot.

examples.chinese: 老師再三提醒大家，考試時不得使用手機。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zàisān tíxǐng dàjiā, kǎoshì shí bùdé shǐyòng shǒujī.
examples.english: The teacher repeatedly reminded everyone that mobile phones are not permitted during the exam.

english: to care about; to mind; to attach importance to
semanticNote: Expresses caring whether something happens or matters — 不在乎 (don't care; don't mind) is extremely common in spoken Mandarin. 在乎你 (care about you). Positive sense: 他很在乎家人 (he cares deeply about his family). Can be rhetorical: 我才不在乎 (I couldn't care less). -hu ending is a neutral tone.

examples.chinese: 她很在乎別人對她的看法，容易受到批評的影響。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zàihu biérén duì tā de kànfǎ, róngyì shòudào pīpíng de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: She cares a great deal about what others think of her and is easily affected by criticism.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友不在乎你有多少錢，而是在乎你這個人。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu bù zàihu nǐ yǒu duōshǎo qián, ér shì zàihu nǐ zhège rén.
examples.english: A true friend doesn't care about how much money you have — they care about you as a person.

english: to lie in; to rest with; to be in; to depend on
semanticNote: Identifies where something's essence, cause, or responsibility resides. 問題在於… (the problem lies in…), 關鍵在於… (the key is…), 成功在於努力 (success lies in hard work). Very common in analytical and persuasive writing. More formal than 靠 (depend on) in this sense.

examples.chinese: 學習語言的關鍵在於持之以恆，每天練習才能進步。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán de guānjiàn zàiyú chí zhī yǐ héng, měitiān liànxí cái néng jìnbù.
examples.english: The key to language learning lies in consistency — only by practicing every day can you improve.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳成功的祕訣在於食材新鮮、用料實在。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng chénggōng de mìjué zàiyú shícái xīnxiān, yòngliào shízài.
examples.english: The secret to this restaurant's success lies in fresh ingredients and generous portions.

english: to approve; to support; to agree with; to endorse
semanticNote: Expressing positive support for a proposal, idea, or decision. 贊成意見 (approval/supporting opinion), 全票贊成 (unanimous approval), 我贊成這個提案 (I support this proposal). Opposite: 反對 (oppose). Used in voting, debate, and discussion contexts.

examples.chinese: 表決結果：贊成的有十五票，反對的有三票，提案通過。
examples.pinyin: Biǎojué jiéguǒ: zànchéng de yǒu shíwǔ piào, fǎnduì de yǒu sān piào, tí'àn tōngguò.
examples.english: Vote results: fifteen in favor, three opposed — the proposal passes.

examples.chinese: 她贊成在校園內全面禁止手機，認為這樣能讓學生更專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Tā zànchéng zài xiàoyuán nèi quánmiàn jìnzhǐ shǒujī, rènwéi zhèyàng néng ràng xuéshēng gèng zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: She supports a complete ban on mobile phones on school campuses, believing it would help students focus more on their studies.

english: to praise; to admire; to eulogize; praise
semanticNote: Warm, sincere praise or admiration. 讚美詩 (hymn of praise/psalm), 衷心讚美 (sincere praise), 值得讚美 (worthy of praise). More enthusiastic than 稱讚 (commend/praise briefly). In Taiwan's church communities, 讚美詩歌 (praise songs/worship music) is an important genre.

examples.chinese: 觀眾對她的演出報以熱烈掌聲，給予了最真誠的讚美。
examples.pinyin: Guānzhòng duì tā de yǎnchū bào yǐ rèliè zhǎngshēng, jǐyǔle zuì zhēnchéng de zànměi.
examples.english: The audience responded to her performance with enthusiastic applause — the most sincere form of praise.

examples.chinese: 他的作文得到老師的大力讚美，被選為全班的範文。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòwén dédào lǎoshī de dàlì zànměi, bèi xuǎn wéi quán bān de fànwén.
examples.english: His essay received high praise from the teacher and was selected as the model essay for the whole class.

english: terrible; awful; in a bad state; oh no!
semanticNote: Both an adjective (情況很糟糕 — the situation is terrible) and an exclamation of dismay (糟糕！我忘記帶鑰匙了 — Oh no! I forgot my keys!). The exclamatory use is extremely common in everyday Taiwan speech. 真是糟糕 (this is really awful). Stronger than 不好 (not good) but not as strong as 完蛋 (ruined/done for).

examples.chinese: 糟糕！我把手機忘在公車上了，趕快打電話給公車站。
examples.pinyin: Zāogāo! Wǒ bǎ shǒujī wàng zài gōngchē shàng le, gǎnkuài dǎ diànhuà gěi gōngchē zhàn.
examples.english: Oh no! I left my phone on the bus — I need to call the bus station right away.

examples.chinese: 這次的業績真的很糟糕，我們需要認真檢討哪裡出了問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de yèjì zhēnde hěn zāogāo, wǒmen xūyào rènzhēn jiǎntǎo nǎlǐ chū le wèntí.
examples.english: This month's performance results are really terrible — we need to seriously review where things went wrong.

english: to cause; to bring about; to result in; to create
semanticNote: The most common verb for expressing causation of a negative outcome. 造成損失 (cause losses), 造成傷亡 (cause casualties), 造成困擾 (cause trouble/inconvenience). Nearly always used with undesirable consequences, making it more negative than 形成 (form/create) or 帶來 (bring). A go-to verb in news reporting.

examples.chinese: 這場颱風造成全台超過三十億元的農業損失。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng táifēng zàochéng quán tái chāoguò sānshí yì yuán de nóngyè sǔnshī.
examples.english: This typhoon caused over three billion NT dollars of agricultural losses across Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 長期失眠會造成免疫力下降、記憶力減退等多種健康問題。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī shīmián huì zàochéng miǎnyìlì xiàjiàng, jìyìlì jiǎntuì děng duō zhǒng jiànkāng wèntí.
examples.english: Chronic insomnia can cause various health problems including reduced immunity and weakened memory.

english: then; in that case; standard; rule; however; (formal then/but)
semanticNote: Formal conjunction with several uses: (1) logical consequence — 努力則成功 (work hard, then succeed); (2) contrast — 他喜歡運動，她則不然 (he likes sports; she, however, does not); (3) measure word for rules/items: 一則新聞 (one news item), 一則故事 (one story). The contrastive use is very common in formal writing.

examples.chinese: 哥哥擅長理科，妹妹則對文學更有興趣。
examples.pinyin: Gēge shàncháng lǐkē, mèimei zé duì wénxué gèng yǒu xìngqù.
examples.english: The older brother excels at science; the younger sister, on the other hand, has more interest in literature.

examples.chinese: 今天的頭條新聞有一則關於台積電擴廠的重大消息。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tóutiáo xīnwén yǒu yī zé guānyú Táijīdiàn kuòchǎng de zhòngdà xiāoxi.
examples.english: Today's headline news includes a major story about TSMC's factory expansion.

english: to blame; to reproach; to accuse; to criticize
semanticNote: Moral or verbal criticism directed at someone for wrongdoing. 責備孩子 (reproach a child), 遭到責備 (be criticized/blamed). More interpersonally direct than 批評 (criticize in general) — 責備 implies the criticism is personal and moral in nature. 自責 (blame oneself/feel guilty) uses the same 責.

examples.chinese: 她責備了弟弟不照顧好玩具，讓他知道要更負責任。
examples.pinyin: Tā zébèile dìdì bù zhàogù hǎo wánjù, ràng tā zhīdào yào gèng fùzérèn.
examples.english: She reproached her younger brother for not taking care of his toys, letting him know he needs to be more responsible.

examples.chinese: 犯了錯誤，與其被別人責備，不如自己先勇於承認錯誤。
examples.pinyin: Fànle cuòwù, yǔqí bèi biérén zébèi, bùrú zìjǐ xiān yǒngyú chéngrèn cuòwù.
examples.english: When you've made a mistake, it's better to bravely admit it yourself rather than wait to be reproached by others.

english: to pick (flowers/fruit); to pluck; to take off; to select excerpts
semanticNote: Physical picking — 摘花 (pick flowers), 摘水果 (pick fruit), 摘草莓 (pick strawberries). Extended: 摘下眼鏡 (take off glasses), 摘錄 (excerpt; make extracts from). Taiwan has 採摘體驗 (fruit-picking experience) at farm parks — 採草莓/採葡萄 are popular rural activities.

components.meaning: pick; pluck; select; take off; excerpt

examples.chinese: 她從院子裡摘了幾朵玫瑰，插在花瓶裡裝飾客廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yuànzi lǐ zhāile jǐ duǒ méigu, chā zài huāpíng lǐ zhuāngshì kètīng.
examples.english: She picked a few roses from the yard and arranged them in a vase to decorate the living room.

examples.chinese: 苗栗大湖的草莓園開放採摘，吸引了許多親子家庭前往體驗。
examples.pinyin: Miáolì Dàhú de cǎoméi yuán kāifàng cǎizhāi, xīyǐnle xǔduō qīnzǐ jiātíng qiánwǎng tǐyàn.
examples.english: The strawberry farms of Dahu, Miaoli are open for picking — attracting many families with children to come and experience it.

semanticNote: Physical narrowness — 窄巷 (narrow alley), 窄路 (narrow road). Taiwan's old neighborhoods 巷弄 are famously 窄. Figurative: 心胸狹窄 (narrow-minded), 手頭緊 (short of cash, but 窄 alone doesn't commonly mean this in Taiwan). Opposite: 寬 (wide/broad). 窄門 (narrow gate) is also used metaphorically for an extremely competitive path.

examples.chinese: 台南的老街區巷弄很窄，摩托車勉強能通過，汽車根本進不去。
examples.pinyin: Táinán de lǎojiē qū xiàngnòng hěn zhǎi, mótuōchē miǎnqiáng néng tōngguò, qìchē gēnběn jìn bù qù.
examples.english: The alleyways in Tainan's old neighborhoods are very narrow — motorcycles can barely squeeze through, cars can't get in at all.

examples.chinese: 這條山路又窄又彎，會車時需要特別小心慢行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shān lù yòu zhǎi yòu wān, huì chē shí xūyào tèbié xiǎoxīn màn xíng.
examples.english: This mountain road is both narrow and winding — when passing another vehicle you need to go very slowly and carefully.

english: to paste; to stick; to glue; to affix
semanticNote: Attaching something with adhesive. 複製貼上 (copy and paste — ubiquitous digital term), 貼標籤 (affix labels/stickers), 貼海報 (put up posters). In computing, 剪下、複製、貼上 (cut, copy, paste) are standard commands. 粘 and 貼 both relate to adhesion — 粘貼 combines both characters.

examples.chinese: 她把孩子的畫作粘貼在冰箱上，讓家裡充滿溫馨的氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ háizi de huàzuò zhāntiē zài bīngxiāng shàng, ràng jiālǐ chōngmǎn wēnxīn de qìfēn.
examples.english: She pasted the child's artwork on the refrigerator, filling the home with a warm atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 這份報告格式要求不得複製粘貼，所有內容必須自行撰寫。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào géshì yāoqiú bùdé fùzhì zhāntiē, suǒyǒu nèiróng bìxū zìxíng zhuǎnxiě.
examples.english: The format requirements for this report prohibit copy-pasting — all content must be written independently.

english: to spread out; to unfold; to launch; to carry out (in full swing)
semanticNote: Literal: unfold/spread open (展開地圖 — unfold a map). Figurative: 展開討論 (launch a discussion), 展開行動 (take action), 全面展開 (launch in full). 激烈地展開 (unfold intensely). Very common in news reporting to describe the start of activities or investigations. Skeleton pinyin has a space.

examples.chinese: 警方對這起詐騙集團展開全面調查，已逮捕多名嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng duì zhè qǐ zhàpiàn jítuán zhǎn kāi quánmiàn diàochá, yǐ dàibǔ duō míng xiányírén.
examples.english: Police have launched a full investigation into this fraud ring and have already arrested multiple suspects.

examples.chinese: 新課程從下學期起正式展開，涵蓋了更多實務操作的內容。
examples.pinyin: Xīn kèchéng cóng xià xuéqī qǐ zhèngshì zhǎn kāi, hányuànle gèng duō shíwù cāozuò de nèiróng.
examples.english: The new curriculum officially launches next semester and covers more hands-on practical content.

semanticNote: A public display of art, artifacts, or products. 展覽館 (exhibition hall), 藝術展覽 (art exhibition), 世界博覽會 (World Expo). Taiwan has numerous excellent museums: 故宮博物院, 台灣文學館, 奇美博物館. 辦展覽 (hold an exhibition), 參觀展覽 (visit an exhibition). 展 alone often appears in compound forms.

examples.chinese: 故宮博物院每年都會舉辦多場特展，吸引國內外的藝術愛好者。
examples.pinyin: Gùgōng bówùyuàn měi nián dōu huì jǔbàn duō chǎng tèzhǎn, xīyǐn guónèi wài de yìshù àihào zhě.
examples.english: The National Palace Museum holds multiple special exhibitions every year, attracting art enthusiasts from both home and abroad.

examples.chinese: 她的攝影作品在誠品書店的藝廊展覽，為期一個月。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shèyǐng zuòpǐn zài Chéngpǐn shūdiàn de yìláng zhǎnlǎn, wéiqī yī gè yuè.
examples.english: Her photography is on exhibition at the Eslite bookstore's gallery for one month.

english: zhàn: to occupy; to seize; to constitute | zhān: to divine; to foretell
semanticNote: Two readings: 占 (zhàn) — to occupy or make up a portion (占領 — occupy territory; 占百分之三十 — constitute 30%); 占 (zhān) — fortune telling/divination (占卜 — divine/fortune-tell). The zhàn reading is far more common in modern usage. 占便宜 (take advantage; get a good deal) is a common colloquial phrase.

examples.chinese: 服務業產值占台灣GDP的比重超過六成。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyè chǎnzhí zhàn Táiwān GDP de bǐzhòng chāoguò liù chéng.
examples.english: The service sector accounts for over sixty percent of Taiwan's GDP.

examples.chinese: 他去廟裡抽籤問卜，想知道今年的運勢如何。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù miào lǐ chōuqiān wèn zhān, xiǎng zhīdào jīnnián de yùnshì rúhé.
examples.english: He went to the temple to draw fortune sticks and seek a divination, wanting to know his fortunes for this year.

semanticNote: Armed conflict between organized groups. 發動戰爭 (launch a war), 戰爭結束 (end of a war), 冷戰 (Cold War). Taiwan exists in a unique geopolitical situation — the threat of 兩岸戰爭 (cross-strait war) is a recurring topic in national security and political discourse. 戰爭電影 (war film).

examples.chinese: 二戰期間，台灣作為日本殖民地，有許多年輕人被送上戰場。
examples.pinyin: Èr Zhàn qījiān, Táiwān zuòwéi Rìběn zhímíndì, yǒu xǔduō niánqīngrén bèi sòng shàng zhànchǎng.
examples.english: During World War II, Taiwan was under Japanese colonial rule and many young men were sent to the battlefield.

examples.chinese: 戰爭帶來的破壞需要幾代人的努力才能復原。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng dài lái de pòhuài xūyào jǐ dài rén de nǔlì cái néng fùyuán.
examples.english: The destruction brought by war requires the effort of several generations to recover from.

semanticNote: People of an older generation within a family or community. 尊重長輩 (respect one's elders) is a core Confucian value in Taiwan. 長輩的教誨 (the teachings/advice of elders), 在長輩面前 (in the presence of elders). Behavior and speech are expected to be more formal and deferential in front of 長輩.

examples.chinese: 過年時向長輩拜年、說吉祥話是台灣家庭的傳統習俗。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí xiàng zhǎngbèi bàinián, shuō jíxiáng huà shì Táiwān jiātíng de chuántǒng xísú.
examples.english: Paying New Year respects to elders and saying auspicious words during the Lunar New Year is a traditional custom of Taiwanese families.

examples.chinese: 在長輩面前用餐，要等大家都坐好了才能開始吃。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhǎngbèi miànqián yòngcān, yào děng dàjiā dōu zuò hǎo le cái néng kāishǐ chī.
examples.english: When dining in the presence of elders, you should wait until everyone is seated before starting to eat.

english: zhǎng: to rise (prices, water); to go up | zhàng: to swell; to bloat
semanticNote: Two readings: 漲 (zhǎng) — prices or water levels rising (房價上漲 — housing prices rising; 水位上漲 — water level rising); 漲 (zhàng) — to swell physically (肚子脹 — stomach bloated). The price-rising sense is very common in Taiwan's economic reporting: 物價上漲 (prices rising), 通貨膨脹 (inflation).

examples.chinese: 最近原物料成本大漲，許多商家不得不調漲售價。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn yuán wùliào chéngběn dà zhǎng, xǔduō shāngjiā bùdébù tiáozhǎng shòujià.
examples.english: Raw material costs have risen sharply recently — many businesses have had no choice but to raise their prices.

examples.chinese: 颱風帶來的豪雨讓溪流水位迅速上漲，居民已疏散避難。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng dài lái de háoyǔ ràng xīliú shuǐwèi xùnsù shàngzhǎng, jūmín yǐ shūsàn bìnàn.
examples.english: The torrential rain brought by the typhoon caused the river level to rise rapidly — residents have already been evacuated.

english: to grasp; to master; to have in hand; to control
semanticNote: To have firm command of a skill, situation, or resource. 掌握技能 (master a skill), 掌握時機 (seize the moment), 掌握資訊 (have the information in hand). Implies active control and competence — more than simply knowing. 掌握大局 (have the overall situation under control).

components.meaning: palm; control; be in charge of

examples.chinese: 她學鋼琴十年，技術已經掌握得相當純熟了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué gāngqín shí nián, jìshù yǐjīng zhǎngwò de xiāngdāng chúnshú le.
examples.english: After ten years of piano study, she has mastered the technique to a very accomplished level.

examples.chinese: 在談判中，掌握充足的資訊是取得有利地位的關鍵。
examples.pinyin: Zài tánpàn zhōng, zhǎngwò chōngzú de zīxùn shì qǔdé yǒulì dìwèi de guānjiàn.
examples.english: In negotiations, having sufficient information in hand is the key to achieving a favorable position.

semanticNote: A financial account held with a bank or institution. 銀行帳戶 (bank account), 活期帳戶 (checking/current account), 定期帳戶 (fixed-term account), 開設帳戶 (open an account). In digital contexts: 帳號 (account number/username online). Taiwan uses 中文帳戶 as the standard term on banking forms.

examples.chinese: 他在台灣銀行開了一個帳戶，方便管理每月的薪資入帳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Táiwān yínháng kāile yī gè zhànghù, fāngbiàn guǎnlǐ měi yuè de xīnzī rùzhàng.
examples.english: He opened an account at Bank of Taiwan to conveniently manage his monthly salary deposits.

examples.chinese: 請勿將帳戶資料透露給陌生人，以免遭到詐騙。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng wù jiāng zhànghù zīliào tòulù gěi mòshēng rén, yǐmiǎn zāodào zhàpiàn.
examples.english: Please do not reveal your account information to strangers to avoid falling victim to fraud.

english: to receive (guests); to entertain; to treat; hospitality; reception
semanticNote: Hosting and entertaining guests with food, drink, or accommodation. 招待客人 (entertain guests), 熱情招待 (warm hospitality), 招待所 (guesthouse; reception facility). Taiwan's renowned hospitality and warmth (熱情好客) is a cultural pride. 不周之處 (areas where we fell short in hospitality) is a polite formula.

examples.chinese: 她用了一桌豐盛的菜餚熱情招待遠道而來的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòngle yī zhuō fēngshèng de càiyáo rèqíng zhāodài yuǎndào ér lái de péngyǒu.
examples.english: She warmly entertained her friend who had come from afar with a table full of hearty dishes.

examples.chinese: 公司在貴賓抵台後安排了一場正式的晚宴招待。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zài guìbīn dǐ Tái hòu ānpáile yī chǎng zhèngshì de wǎnyàn zhāodài.
examples.english: The company arranged a formal dinner reception after the VIP guests arrived in Taiwan.

english: to catch fire; to ignite; to be on fire
semanticNote: The moment or state of something catching fire. 著火了！(It's on fire!) is an urgent cry. 防止著火 (prevent fire). In Taiwan, kitchen fires (瓦斯爐著火) and electrical fires (電線著火) are common causes of residential fires. 滅火 (extinguish the fire) is the response verb.

examples.chinese: 廚房的油鍋突然著火，她趕緊蓋上鍋蓋並關掉瓦斯。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng de yóuguō tūrán zháohuǒ, tā gǎnjǐn gài shàng guōgài bìng guāndiào wǎsī.
examples.english: The oil pot in the kitchen suddenly caught fire — she quickly covered it with the lid and turned off the gas.

examples.chinese: 消防局呼籲民眾在使用電氣設備時要小心，以免著火釀災。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofángjú hūyù mínzhòng zài shǐyòng diànqì shèbèi shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn zháohuǒ niàng zāi.
examples.english: The fire department urges people to be careful when using electrical equipment to prevent fires from causing disasters.

english: to catch a cold; to catch a chill
semanticNote: Getting sick from exposure to cold — 著涼了 (caught a chill). A very common expression used by Taiwanese parents and grandparents to explain illness or as a warning: 多穿件衣服，小心著涼 (wear an extra layer, be careful not to catch a chill). Distinct from 感冒 (common cold as a condition). Skeleton pinyin has a space.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣變化大，出門要多帶一件外套，以免著涼。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì biànhuà dà, chūmén yào duō dài yī jiàn wàitào, yǐmiǎn zháoliáng.
examples.english: The weather is changeable today — bring an extra jacket when you go out so you don't catch a chill.

examples.chinese: 他昨晚睡覺時窗戶開著，一早就著涼了，現在在發燒。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuówǎn shuìjiào shí chuānghù kāizhe, yīzǎo jiù zháoliáng le, xiànzài zài fāshāo.
examples.english: He slept with the window open last night and caught a chill by morning — he's now running a fever.

english: to convene; to call together; to hold (a meeting)
semanticNote: Formally convening a meeting, conference, or assembly. 召開會議 (convene a meeting), 召開記者會 (hold a press conference), 召開國會 (convene the legislature). Always implies an official or formal gathering. Common in government, business, and news reporting contexts in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 行政院長召開緊急記者會，說明政府對此事件的立場。
examples.pinyin: Xíngzhèngyuánzhǎng zhàokāi jǐnjí jìzhěhuì, shuōmíng zhèngfǔ duì cǐ shìjiàn de lìchǎng.
examples.english: The Premier convened an emergency press conference to explain the government's position on the incident.

examples.chinese: 公司下週一上午召開全體員工大會，請大家準時出席。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xià zhōuyī shàngwǔ zhàokāi quántǐ yuángōng dàhuì, qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí chūxí.
examples.english: The company will hold a full staff meeting Monday morning next week — everyone please attend on time.

semanticNote: Things continuing in their usual manner despite circumstances. 照常上班 (work as usual), 照常營業 (open for business as usual), 照常舉行 (proceed as planned). Very common in Taiwan announcements: after a typhoon warning is lifted, authorities announce 明天照常上班上課 (tomorrow school and work will resume as normal).

components.meaning: according to; shine; follow; as per

examples.chinese: 颱風警報解除後，縣市政府宣布明天照常上班上課。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng jǐngbào jiěchú hòu, xiànshì zhèngfǔ xuānbù míngtiān zhàocháng shàngbān shàngkè.
examples.english: After the typhoon warning was lifted, county and city governments announced that work and school will proceed as normal tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 儘管外面大雨滂沱，活動仍照常在室內進行。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wàimiàn dàyǔ pángtuó, huódòng réng zhàocháng zài shìnèi jìnxíng.
examples.english: Despite the heavy rain outside, the event proceeded as usual indoors.

semanticNote: The academic discipline and the practice of philosophical thinking. 人生哲學 (philosophy of life), 哲學系 (philosophy department), 東方哲學 (Eastern philosophy). Taiwan universities have well-regarded philosophy departments. 哲學思考 (philosophical thinking) is valued in education reform discourse. Also used loosely: 他的生活哲學 (his life philosophy).

examples.chinese: 她大學念的是哲學系，畢業後轉行做了公益法律工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàxué niàn de shì zhéxuéxì, bìyè hòu zhuǎnháng zuòle gōngyì fǎlǜ gōngzuò.
examples.english: She studied in the philosophy department in college and after graduation switched to public interest law work.

examples.chinese: 他的人生哲學很簡單：做自己喜歡的事，對身邊的人好。
examples.pinyin: Tā de rénshēng zhéxué hěn jiǎndān: zuò zìjǐ xǐhuān de shì, duì shēnbiān de rén hǎo.
examples.english: His life philosophy is simple: do what you love and be good to the people around you.

english: directed at; in connection with; targeting; aimed at
semanticNote: Indicates that something is specifically directed at a target. 針對學生 (aimed at students), 針對問題 (in response to the issue), 針對性措施 (targeted measures). Often used in policy, criticism, or marketing: 針對老年人的政策 (policy targeted at seniors). More precise than 對 alone.

examples.chinese: 政府針對弱勢學生推出了多項補助措施，確保教育公平。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhēnduì ruòshì xuéshēng tuīchūle duō xiàng bǔzhù cuòshī, quèbǎo jiàoyù gōngpíng.
examples.english: The government has introduced multiple subsidy measures targeted at disadvantaged students to ensure educational equity.

examples.chinese: 針對這個問題，我們需要召開專門的討論會來尋找解決方案。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnduì zhège wèntí, wǒmen xūyào zhàokāi zhuānmén de tǎolùnhuì lái xúnzhǎo jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: In connection with this issue, we need to convene a dedicated discussion meeting to find a solution.

english: to treasure; to cherish; to value; to appreciate
semanticNote: Actively appreciating and taking care of something precious — 珍惜時間 (cherish time/use time well), 珍惜機會 (treasure the opportunity), 珍惜身邊的人 (cherish the people around you). A common sentiment in graduation speeches and motivational contexts in Taiwan. More active than 重視 (attach importance to).

examples.chinese: 人生苦短，要好好珍惜每一天，不要留下遺憾。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng kǔ duǎn, yào hǎohǎo zhēnxī měi yī tiān, bùyào liú xià yíhàn.
examples.english: Life is short — cherish every single day and don't leave regrets behind.

examples.chinese: 她珍惜這份難得的工作機會，每天全力以赴，從不怠慢。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhēnxī zhè fèn nándé de gōngzuò jīhuì, měitiān quánlì yǐ fù, cóng bù dàimàn.
examples.english: She treasures this rare work opportunity and gives it her all every day, never slacking off.

semanticNote: Factually or emotionally real — 真實的故事 (a true story; based on real events), 還原真實 (restore the truth), 真實感 (sense of realism). In art and media: 紀錄片追求真實性 (documentaries pursue authenticity). More about factual reality than 真誠 (sincere in feeling).

examples.chinese: 這部紀錄片真實地記錄了台灣九二一大地震後的重建過程。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zhēnshí de jìlùle Táiwān jiǔ'èryī dàdìzhèn hòu de chóngjiàn guòchéng.
examples.english: This documentary authentically documents the reconstruction process after Taiwan's 921 earthquake.

examples.chinese: 他說的話聽起來很真實，但調查後才發現不少細節是假的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà tīng qǐlái hěn zhēnshí, dàn diàochá hòu cái fāxiàn bùshǎo xìjié shì jiǎ de.
examples.english: What he said sounded authentic, but after investigation it turned out that many details were false.

semanticNote: Medical diagnosis — identifying a disease or condition. 確診 (confirmed diagnosis), 誤診 (misdiagnosis), 診斷書 (medical certificate/diagnosis report). In Taiwan, seeing a doctor at a 診所 (clinic) or 醫院 (hospital) involves 掛號 → 看診 → 診斷 → 拿藥. Also used figuratively: 診斷問題 (diagnose a problem).

examples.chinese: 醫生初步診斷他患有高血壓，建議他調整飲食和作息。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng chūbù zhěnduàn tā huàn yǒu gāo xuèyā, jiànyì tā tiáozhěng yǐnshí hé zuòxī.
examples.english: The doctor's preliminary diagnosis was hypertension, and he recommended adjusting his diet and daily routine.

examples.chinese: 台灣的全民健保制度讓民眾能夠以低廉的費用接受專業診斷和治療。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de quánmín jiànbǎo zhìdù ràng mínzhòng nénggòu yǐ dīlián de fèiyòng jiēshòu zhuānyè zhěnduàn hé zhìliáo.
examples.english: Taiwan's National Health Insurance system allows people to receive professional diagnosis and treatment at low cost.

english: short period; spell; burst; formation; (mw for gusts, waves, spells)
semanticNote: Measure word for brief spells or waves of something: 一陣風 (a gust of wind), 一陣掌聲 (a burst of applause), 一陣雨 (a brief shower). Also: military formation (陣型, 陣地 — position/front). 陣痛 (labor pains; transition pains). In Taiwan weather reports: 局部陣雨 (isolated showers) is extremely common.

components.meaning: battle line; position; period; (mw for spells/bursts)

examples.chinese: 演講結束後，現場爆發出一陣熱烈的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, xiànchǎng bàofā chū yī zhèn rèliè de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When the speech ended, a burst of enthusiastic applause erupted from the audience.

examples.chinese: 氣象局預報今天下午台北有局部陣雨，出門記得帶傘。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàngjú yùbào jīntiān xiàwǔ Táiběi yǒu júbù zhènyǔ, chūmén jìdé dài sǎn.
examples.english: The Weather Bureau forecasts isolated showers in Taipei this afternoon — remember to bring an umbrella when going out.

semanticNote: Physical vibration or oscillation. 振動頻率 (vibration frequency), 手機振動 (phone vibrating). In physics and engineering, 振動 is a technical term. In everyday Taiwan life: 設為振動模式 (set to vibrate mode). Also: 地震振動 (seismic vibration) — very relevant given Taiwan's earthquake frequency.

examples.chinese: 在開會或電影院時，請把手機設為振動或靜音模式。
examples.pinyin: Zài kāihuì huò diànyǐngyuàn shí, qǐng bǎ shǒujī shè wéi zhèndòng huò jìngyīn móshì.
examples.english: During meetings or at the cinema, please set your phone to vibrate or silent mode.

examples.chinese: 地震時，建築物的振動強度和頻率是判斷損害程度的重要依據。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí, jiànzhú wù de zhèndòng qiángdù hé pínlǜ shì pànduàn sǔnhài chéngdù de zhòngyào yījù.
examples.english: During an earthquake, the intensity and frequency of a building's vibration are important indicators for assessing the degree of damage.

english: to argue; to debate; to dispute; argument; controversy
semanticNote: A back-and-forth argument or controversy over a point. 爭論不休 (argue endlessly without resolution), 引起爭論 (provoke controversy). More heated and adversarial than 討論 (discuss). Taiwan's legislative chamber (立法院) is known for occasional physical confrontations during heated 爭論.

examples.chinese: 這個議題在學術界引起了廣泛的爭論，各方觀點都有支持者。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yìtí zài xuéshùjiè yǐnqǐle guǎngfàn de zhēnglùn, gèfāng guāndiǎn dōu yǒu zhīchí zhě.
examples.english: This issue has provoked widespread controversy in academia — all sides of the argument have their supporters.

examples.chinese: 兩個人在餐桌上爭論政治問題，越講越激動，最後搞得不歡而散。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng gèrén zài cān zhuō shàng zhēnglùn zhèngzhì wèntí, yuè jiǎng yuè jīdòng, zuìhòu gǎo de bù huān ér sàn.
examples.english: The two of them argued about political issues at the dinner table, getting more and more worked up until they parted on bad terms.

english: to strive for; to fight for; to compete for; to try to obtain
semanticNote: Active effort to win, obtain, or achieve something. 爭取權益 (fight for rights/interests), 爭取機會 (strive for opportunities), 爭取時間 (race against time). More purposeful and effortful than 嘗試 (try). A key verb in Taiwan's labor rights, election, and student competition contexts.

examples.chinese: 她積極爭取公費留學的機會，準備了整整半年才完成申請文件。
examples.pinyin: Tā jījí zhēngqǔ gōngfèi liúxué de jīhuì, zhǔnbèile zhěngzhěng bàn nián cái wánchéng shēnqǐng wénjiàn.
examples.english: She actively competed for a government-funded study abroad opportunity and spent a full six months preparing the application documents.

examples.chinese: 工會代表為員工爭取更好的薪資和工作條件，談判持續進行中。
examples.pinyin: Gōnghuì dàibiǎo wèi yuángōng zhēngqǔ gèng hǎo de xīnzī hé gōngzuò tiáojiàn, tánpàn chíxù jìnxíng zhōng.
examples.english: Union representatives are fighting for better wages and working conditions for employees — negotiations are ongoing.

english: to solicit; to seek; to ask for (opinions, consent)
semanticNote: Formally asking for opinions, feedback, or consent. 徵求意見 (solicit opinions/feedback), 徵求同意 (seek consent), 公開徵求 (publicly solicit). In Taiwan's government: 公聽會徵求各方意見 (public hearings to solicit opinions from all sides). More formal than 詢問 (inquire).

examples.chinese: 這項新政策在正式實施前，已廣泛徵求各界的意見。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè zài zhèngshì shíshī qián, yǐ guǎngfàn zhēngqiú gèjiè de yìjiàn.
examples.english: Before formal implementation, this new policy has broadly solicited opinions from all sectors.

examples.chinese: 出版社徵求讀者對新書封面設計的意見，歡迎線上填寫問卷。
examples.pinyin: Chūbǎnshè zhēngqiú dúzhě duì xīnshū fēngmiàn shèjì de yìjiàn, huānyíng xiànshàng tiánxiě wènjuàn.
examples.english: The publisher is soliciting readers' opinions on the new book cover design — fill out the online survey.

english: to open (one's eyes); to stare wide-eyed
semanticNote: Specifically the act of opening or keeping the eyes open — contrasts with 閉 (close). 睜開眼睛 (open one's eyes), 睜眼說瞎話 (lie with one's eyes wide open — blatant lying, lit. open-eyed talking blindness), 睜一隻眼閉一隻眼 (turn a blind eye, lit. open one eye, close one eye — an extremely common idiom).

examples.chinese: 他打了個盹，夢到考試沒準備，猛然睜眼才發現只是個夢。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎle gè dǔn, mèng dào kǎoshì méi zhǔnbèi, měngrán zhēng yǎn cái fāxiàn zhǐ shì gè mèng.
examples.english: He dozed off, dreamed he wasn't prepared for an exam, and jolted awake with a start, only to find it was just a dream.

examples.chinese: 對於這種明顯的違規行為，主管不能再睜一隻眼閉一隻眼了。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhè zhǒng míngxiǎn de wéiguī xíngwéi, zhǔguǎn bùnéng zài zhēng yī zhī yǎn bì yī zhī yǎn le.
examples.english: The manager can no longer turn a blind eye to such an obvious violation.

semanticNote: Emphasizes the totality of something. 整個台灣 (all of Taiwan), 整個過程 (the entire process), 整個人 (the whole person — often used in descriptions: 整個人都崩了 — completely fell apart). Very versatile and extremely common in spoken and written Mandarin.

examples.chinese: 颱風過境後，整個城市一片狼藉，清理工作預計需要幾天。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòjìng hòu, zhěnggè chéngshì yī piàn lángjí, qīnglǐ gōngzuò yùjì xūyào jǐ tiān.
examples.english: After the typhoon passed, the entire city was in shambles — cleanup work is expected to take several days.

examples.chinese: 聽到這個消息後，她整個人愣在那裡，一句話都說不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi hòu, tā zhěnggèrén lèng zài nàlǐ, yī jù huà dōu shuō bù chūlái.
examples.english: When she heard the news, she was frozen in place and couldn't say a single word.

semanticNote: Well-arranged and orderly. 整齊的隊伍 (orderly ranks/queue), 房間整齊 (tidy room), 整齊劃一 (uniform and orderly). In Taiwan's school culture, 整齊的制服 (neat uniforms) and 整齊的隊伍 (orderly lines) are expected. Opposite: 凌亂 (messy/chaotic).

examples.chinese: 她的書桌永遠都收拾得整整齊齊，每樣東西都有固定的位置。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shūzhuō yǒngyuǎn dōu shōushí de zhěngzhěngqíqí, měi yàng dōngxi dōu yǒu gùdìng de wèizhì.
examples.english: Her desk is always kept perfectly tidy — every item has its fixed place.

examples.chinese: 同學們整齊地排隊等候入場，秩序井然。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen zhěngqí de páiduì děnghòu rùchǎng, zhìxù jǐngrán.
examples.english: The students queued in an orderly line waiting to enter — the discipline was impeccable.

english: whole; entirety; overall; as a whole
semanticNote: The complete entity, looked at as a unit. 從整體來看 (looking at it as a whole), 整體規劃 (overall planning), 整體表現 (overall performance). Used in contrast to 個別/局部 (individual/partial). 整體而言 (generally speaking) is a common analytical phrase.

examples.chinese: 整體來說，這次活動辦得相當成功，只有少數細節需要改進。
examples.pinyin: Zhěngtǐ lái shuō, zhè cì huódòng bàn de xiāngdāng chénggōng, zhǐyǒu shǎoshù xìjié xūyào gǎijìn.
examples.english: Overall, this event was quite successful — only a few details need improvement.

examples.chinese: 我們要從整體規劃的角度去看這個項目，而不是只關注個別環節。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào cóng zhěngtǐ guīhuà de jiǎodù qù kàn zhège xiàngmù, ér bú shì zhǐ guānzhù gèbié huánjié.
examples.english: We need to view this project from the perspective of overall planning, not just focus on individual parts.

english: zhèng: straight; correct; main; just (right); currently | zhēng: first lunar month
semanticNote: Multiple uses of zhèng: (1) correct/upright — 正確 (correct), 端正 (upright); (2) main/primary — 正門 (main entrance), 正版 (official/authentic version); (3) adverb of timing — 他正在睡覺 (he is currently sleeping); (4) 正好 (just right; happen to). 正月 (zhēng yuè) = the first month of the lunar calendar.

components.meaning: upright; correct; straight; exactly; main; positive

examples.chinese: 她打電話過來的時候，我正好在洗澡，沒辦法接。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà guòlái de shíhòu, wǒ zhènghǎo zài xǐzǎo, méi bànfǎ jiē.
examples.english: When she called, I happened to be in the shower and couldn't answer.

examples.chinese: 正月初一是農曆新年的第一天，也是最重要的家庭團聚時刻。
examples.pinyin: Zhēngyuè chū yī shì nónglì xīnnián de dì yī tiān, yěshì zuì zhòngyào de jiātíng tuánjù shíkè.
examples.english: The first day of the first lunar month is the first day of the Lunar New Year — and the most important moment for family reunion.

semanticNote: Official documents establishing identity or authorization — ID cards, passports, permits, licenses. In Taiwan, 證件 is a daily necessity: 健保卡 (NHI card), 身分證 (national ID), 護照 (passport). Plural in sense though singular in form.

components.meaning: item; document; measure word for matters

examples.chinese: 請出示您的證件，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng chūshì nín de zhèngjiàn, xièxie.
examples.english: Please show your identification documents, thank you.

examples.chinese: 辦理銀行開戶需要攜帶身分證等相關證件。
examples.pinyin: Bànlǐ yínháng kāihù xūyào xiédài shēnfènzhèng děng xiāngguān zhèngjiàn.
examples.english: Opening a bank account requires bringing your national ID and other relevant documents.

semanticNote: Evidence or proof — physical, documentary, or testimonial. Used in legal, investigative, and everyday argumentative contexts. 拿出證據 (produce evidence) is a common challenge. Distinct from 證明 (proof/certificate, can be a document) — 證據 is always about establishing facts.

examples.chinese: 警方目前還沒有足夠的證據起訴嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng mùqián hái méiyǒu zúgòu de zhèngjù qǐsù xiányírén.
examples.english: The police don't yet have sufficient evidence to indict the suspect.

examples.chinese: 你說我說謊，有什麼證據？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō wǒ shuōhuǎng, yǒu shénme zhèngjù?
examples.english: You say I'm lying — what evidence do you have?

semanticNote: Government — typically the executive branch or the government as a whole. In Taiwan, 政府 refers to the ROC government (中華民國政府). Collocates with 中央政府 (central government), 地方政府 (local government), 政府機關 (government agencies).

examples.chinese: 政府宣布明年調漲基本工資。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù míngnián tiáozhǎng jīběn gōngzī.
examples.english: The government announced it will raise the minimum wage next year.

examples.chinese: 台灣政府積極推動數位轉型政策。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zhèngfǔ jījí tuīdòng shùwèi zhuǎnxíng zhèngcè.
examples.english: The Taiwan government is actively promoting digital transformation policies.

semanticNote: Politics; the political sphere. In Taiwan, 政治 is omnipresent — elections are frequent and public discourse politically engaged. 政治敏感 (politically sensitive) is used for cross-strait topics. Can function as a modifier: 政治人物 (politician), 政治立場 (political stance).

examples.chinese: 他對政治沒什麼興趣，比較關心社會議題。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhèngzhì méi shénme xìngqù, bǐjiào guānxīn shèhuì yìtí.
examples.english: He's not very interested in politics; he cares more about social issues.

examples.chinese: 台灣的政治環境相對開放，言論自由受到保障。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhèngzhì huánjìng xiāngduì kāifàng, yánlùn zìyóu shòudào bǎozhàng.
examples.english: Taiwan's political environment is relatively open, and freedom of speech is protected.

semanticNote: Two readings: zhèng — to earn (money), to make a living (掙錢); zhēng — to struggle, to strive against restraint (掙扎, zhēngzhá). The earning sense is more common in daily speech. Traditional form is 掙.

examples.chinese: 他在台北打兩份工才能掙到足夠的生活費。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Táiběi dǎ liǎng fèn gōng cái néng zhèng dào zúgòu de shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: He works two jobs in Taipei just to earn enough living expenses.

examples.chinese: 魚在網裡拼命掙扎，卻怎麼也逃不出去。
examples.pinyin: Yú zài wǎng lǐ pīnmìng zhēngzhá, què zěnme yě táo bù chūqù.
examples.english: The fish struggled desperately in the net but couldn't escape no matter what.

semanticNote: Versatile: as a verb, 支 means to support, prop up, or pay out (支付). As a noun, a branch or division (支線, branch line). As a measure word, counts long slender objects: 一支筆 (a pen), 一支軍隊 (a military unit). Also appears in 支持 (support) and 支出 (expenditure).

components.meaning: branch; support; pay; measure word for slender objects

examples.chinese: 請問可以用信用卡支付嗎？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn kěyǐ yòng xìnyòngkǎ zhīfù ma?
examples.english: Excuse me, can I pay by credit card?

examples.chinese: 她送了我一支精緻的原子筆作為生日禮物。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng le wǒ yī zhī jīngzhì de yuánzǐbǐ zuòwéi shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: She gave me an elegant ballpoint pen as a birthday gift.

semanticNote: A bank check. Used in business and formal financial contexts. In Taiwan, 支票 remains in use for business-to-business payments, though mobile payment (LINE Pay, 街口支付) dominates retail. 空頭支票 (a rubber check; also figurative: an empty promise) is a useful idiom.

examples.chinese: 公司開了一張五十萬元的支票給廠商。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī kāi le yī zhāng wǔshí wàn yuán de zhīpiào gěi chǎngshāng.
examples.english: The company wrote a 500,000 NT dollar check to the supplier.

examples.chinese: 他說的都是空頭支票，根本不算數。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de dōu shì kōngtóu zhīpiào, gēnběn bù suànshù.
examples.english: Everything he said was just empty promises — none of it counts.

semanticNote: A license or permit issued by an authority — driving license (駕照), business license (營業執照), medical license (醫師執照). In Taiwan, 執照 implies official government certification. Collocates with 取得 (obtain), 撤銷 (revoke), 換發 (renew/reissue).

examples.chinese: 沒有執照就從事醫療行為是違法的。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhízhào jiù cóngshì yīliáo xíngwéi shì wéifǎ de.
examples.english: Practicing medicine without a license is illegal.

examples.chinese: 他剛考到駕照，技術還不太熟練。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng kǎo dào jiàzhào, jìshù hái bú tài shúliàn.
examples.english: He just got his driver's license and his skills aren't very polished yet.

semanticNote: As an adjective: straight, vertical (直線, 直角). As an adverb: directly, continuously, frankly (直說, 一直). Also means frank or straightforward in character (直爽, 直率). Contrasts with 彎 (curved) and 間接 (indirect). In compounds: 直播 (live stream), 直飛 (direct flight).

examples.chinese: 從台北直飛花蓮只要四十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Cóng Táiběi zhí fēi Huālián zhǐ yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: Flying directly from Taipei to Hualien takes only 40 minutes.

examples.chinese: 有什麼問題，你直說就好，不用拐彎抹角。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shénme wèntí, nǐ zhí shuō jiù hǎo, búyòng guǎiwānmòjiǎo.
examples.english: If you have an issue, just say it directly — no need to beat around the bush.

semanticNote: To guide, give direction, mentor — implies active leadership or instruction. 指導教授 (thesis advisor), 指導方針 (guiding principles). More formal than 帶領; implies expertise on the guide's part. Also used as a noun: 在老師的指導下 (under the teacher's guidance).

examples.chinese: 論文寫作過程中，指導教授給了我很大的幫助。
examples.pinyin: Lùnwén xiězuò guòchéng zhōng, zhǐdǎo jiàoshòu gěi le wǒ hěn dà de bāngzhù.
examples.english: During the thesis writing process, my advisor gave me a great deal of help.

examples.chinese: 教練親自指導球員如何改善發球技術。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn qīnzì zhǐdǎo qiúyuán rúhé gǎishàn fāqiú jìshù.
examples.english: The coach personally guided the players on how to improve their serve technique.

semanticNote: To command (military, organizational) or to conduct (an orchestra). As a noun: commander or conductor. 指揮官 (commander), 樂團指揮 (orchestra conductor). Implies authority and coordination. Traditional form: 指揮 (same characters, traditional = simplified here).

examples.chinese: 總指揮站在台上，用指揮棒引導整個樂團。
examples.pinyin: Zǒng zhǐhuī zhàn zài tái shàng, yòng zhǐhuī bàng yǐndǎo zhěnggè yuètuán.
examples.english: The chief conductor stood on the podium, guiding the entire orchestra with his baton.

examples.chinese: 災難發生時，需要有人統一指揮救援行動。
examples.pinyin: Zāinàn fāshēng shí, xūyào yǒu rén tǒngyī zhǐhuī jiùyuán xíngdòng.
examples.english: When a disaster strikes, someone needs to centrally command the rescue operation.

semanticNote: Up to now; until today; so far. Implies something began in the past and continues to the present, or has persisted without resolution. More formal than 到現在. Common in written Chinese and news: 至今仍未解決 (still unresolved to this day).

examples.chinese: 這起懸案至今仍未找到真凶。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ xuán'àn zhì jīn réng wèi zhǎodào zhēnxiōng.
examples.english: The true culprit in this unsolved case still hasn't been found to this day.

examples.chinese: 他們相識三十年，至今依然保持深厚的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen xiāngshí sānshí nián, zhì jīn yīrán bǎochí shēnhòu de yǒuyì.
examples.english: They've known each other for thirty years and still maintain a deep friendship to this day.

semanticNote: As for; as to; regarding a new topic being introduced. Used to pivot to a related but separate matter: 至於那件事，我還沒決定。 Can also mean 'go so far as to' in negative structures: 不至於那麼嚴重 (it can't be that serious). Formal written register.

examples.chinese: 薪水問題我們可以談，至於工作時數，就要看公司規定了。
examples.pinyin: Xīnshuǐ wèntí wǒmen kěyǐ tán, zhìyú gōngzuò shíshù, jiù yào kàn gōngsī guīdìng le.
examples.english: We can discuss the salary; as for working hours, that depends on company policy.

examples.chinese: 不就是考試沒過嗎？不至於這麼難過吧。
examples.pinyin: Bù jiùshì kǎoshì méi guò ma? Bùzhìyú zhème nánguò ba.
examples.english: So you just didn't pass the exam — it can't be that devastating, can it?

semanticNote: Volunteer — someone who offers their time or labor without pay. In Taiwan, 志工 (志願工作者) is the more common shortened form, while 志願者 appears in more formal writing. Common in hospital volunteer programs (醫院志工), community service, and NGO contexts.

examples.chinese: 每年廟會期間都有許多志工協助維持秩序。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián miàohuì qījiān dōu yǒu xǔduō zhìgōng xiézhù wéichí zhìxù.
examples.english: Every year during the temple festival, many volunteers help maintain order.

examples.chinese: 她退休後擔任醫院志願者，陪伴獨居老人。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū hòu dānrèn yīyuàn zhìyuànzhě, péibàn dújū lǎorén.
examples.english: After retiring, she became a hospital volunteer, keeping lonely elderly residents company.

semanticNote: To formulate, lay down, or establish (a plan, policy, law, standard). Implies deliberate, authoritative creation — used for government policy, corporate strategy, and legal frameworks. Distinguish from 制作 (make/produce physical things) and 製造 (manufacture).

examples.chinese: 政府正在制定新的環保法規以減少碳排放。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài zhìdìng xīn de huánbǎo fǎguī yǐ jiǎnshǎo tàn páifàng.
examples.english: The government is formulating new environmental regulations to reduce carbon emissions.

examples.chinese: 公司制定了嚴格的資安政策，保護客戶個資。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhìdìng le yángé de zī'ān zhèngcè, bǎohù kèhù gèzī.
examples.english: The company has established strict information security policies to protect customer personal data.

semanticNote: A system or institution — formal, established rules and organizational structures. 健保制度 (NHI system), 教育制度 (education system), 民主制度 (democratic system). More abstract and structural than 系統 (which can be technical/computational). Implies legitimacy and formality.

examples.chinese: 台灣的全民健保制度讓每個人都能享有基本醫療保障。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de quánmín jiànbǎo zhìdù ràng měi gè rén dōu néng xiǎngyǒu jīběn yīliáo bǎozhàng.
examples.english: Taiwan's National Health Insurance system ensures that everyone can enjoy basic medical coverage.

examples.chinese: 完善的法律制度是維持社會公平正義的基礎。
examples.pinyin: Wánshàn de fǎlǜ zhìdù shì wéichí shèhuì gōngpíng zhèngyì de jīchǔ.
examples.english: A well-developed legal system is the foundation for maintaining social fairness and justice.

semanticNote: To manufacture or make (physical goods) — industrial production sense. Also used figuratively: 製造麻煩 (cause trouble), 製造誤解 (create misunderstanding), 製造氣氛 (create an atmosphere). Traditional form uses 製: 製造. Taiwan's manufacturing prowess (台積電, 精密機械) makes this a culturally resonant word.

examples.chinese: 台積電製造的晶片被應用於全球各地的電子產品中。
examples.pinyin: Táijīdiàn zhìzào de jīnpiàn bèi yìngyòng yú quánqiú gèdì de diànzǐ chǎnpǐn zhōng.
examples.english: Chips manufactured by TSMC are used in electronic products all over the world.

examples.chinese: 請不要製造不必要的誤會，好好溝通才是正確的做法。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào zhìzào bù bìyào de wùhuì, hǎohǎo gōutōng cái shì zhèngquè de zuòfǎ.
examples.english: Please don't create unnecessary misunderstandings — proper communication is the right approach.

semanticNote: To make, produce, or create — commonly applied to media, food, and crafts: 影片製作 (film production), 手工製作 (handmade), 製作料理 (prepare a dish). Less industrial than 製造; more artisanal or creative. Traditional: 製作.

examples.chinese: 這部紀錄片由台灣本土團隊獨立製作完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn yóu Táiwān běntǔ tuánduì dúlì zhìzuò wánchéng.
examples.english: This documentary was independently produced by a local Taiwanese team.

examples.chinese: 她親手製作了一個生日蛋糕送給好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā qīnshǒu zhìzuò le yī gè shēngrì dàngāo sòng gěi hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: She personally made a birthday cake to give to her good friend.

semanticNote: To treat (medically); medical treatment. Used for both physical and psychological conditions: 心理治療 (psychotherapy), 癌症治療 (cancer treatment). In Taiwan's 健保 system, 治療 is a core concept — covered treatments are listed as 給付項目. More clinical than 治 alone.

examples.chinese: 醫生說這種病如果早期發現，治療效果非常好。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhè zhǒng bìng rúguǒ zǎoqī fāxiàn, zhìliáo xiàoguǒ fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: The doctor said if this illness is detected early, the treatment outcome is very good.

examples.chinese: 她接受了半年的心理治療，狀況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiēshòu le bàn nián de xīnlǐ zhìliáo, zhuàngkuàng gǎishàn le bù shǎo.
examples.english: She underwent six months of psychotherapy and her condition improved considerably.

semanticNote: Order; orderly sequence or arrangement — social, procedural, or physical. 維持秩序 (maintain order), 社會秩序 (public order), 排隊秩序 (queuing order). In Taiwan, orderly queuing (排隊文化) is a point of civic pride, making 秩序 a frequently praised or lamented concept.

examples.chinese: 廟會雖然熱鬧，但現場秩序維持得相當好。
examples.pinyin: Miàohuì suīrán rènào, dàn xiànchǎng zhìxù wéichí de xiāngdāng hǎo.
examples.english: Although the temple festival was lively, the on-site order was maintained quite well.

examples.chinese: 請大家依照秩序排隊，不要插隊，謝謝合作。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā yīzhào zhìxù páiduì, búyào chāduì, xièxie hézuò.
examples.english: Please queue in an orderly manner and don't cut in line — thank you for your cooperation.

semanticNote: Wisdom; knowledge combined with deep understanding and experience. More elevated than 知識 (knowledge) or 聰明 (cleverness). Used for both traditional wisdom (老人的智慧) and modern tech: 人工智慧 (artificial intelligence; AI) is ubiquitous in Taiwan's tech sector. Also 智慧城市 (smart city), 智慧手機 (smartphone).

examples.chinese: 人工智慧的發展正在改變各行各業的運作方式。
examples.pinyin: Réngōng zhìhuì de fāzhǎn zhèngzài gǎibiàn gè háng gè yè de yùnzuò fāngshì.
examples.english: The development of artificial intelligence is changing how every industry operates.

examples.chinese: 這位老中醫積累了幾十年的行醫智慧，令人佩服。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo zhōngyī jīlěi le jǐ shí nián de xíngyī zhìhuì, lìng rén pèifú.
examples.english: This veteran TCM doctor has accumulated decades of medical wisdom — truly admirable.

semanticNote: Intermediary; to act as a go-between. 房屋仲介 (real estate agent; 仲介 is the more common Taiwan form), 人力仲介 (labor broker), 中介機構 (intermediary organization). As a verb: 中介雙方 (mediate between two parties). Often used in business and legal contexts.

examples.chinese: 他透過仲介公司在台北找到了一間合適的租屋。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò zhōngjiè gōngsī zài Táiběi zhǎodào le yī jiān héshì de zū wū.
examples.english: Through an intermediary agency, he found a suitable rental apartment in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 這家中介機構協助台灣企業拓展東南亞市場。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhōngjiè jīgòu xiézhù Táiwān qǐyè tuòzhǎn Dōngnányà shìchǎng.
examples.english: This intermediary organization helps Taiwanese companies expand into the Southeast Asian market.

semanticNote: Center; the heart or core of something — physical (台灣的地理中心 is somewhere in Nantou County) or conceptual (研究中心, 文化中心). Also used in compound names: 台北市立美術館 has a nearby 文化中心. Distinct from 中央 (central, administrative/directional).

examples.chinese: 台北車站附近是台北市的商業中心，交通非常便利。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi chēzhàn fùjìn shì Táiběi shì de shāngyè zhōngxīn, jiāotōng fēicháng biànlì.
examples.english: The area near Taipei Main Station is Taipei's commercial center — transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 這所大學設有語言學習中心，提供多種外語課程。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué shèyǒu yǔyán xuéxí zhōngxīn, tígōng duō zhǒng wàiyǔ kèchéng.
examples.english: This university has a language learning center that offers various foreign language courses.

semanticNote: The middle third (days 11–20) of a month. Chinese time reckoning divides months into 上旬 (1st–10th), 中旬 (11th–20th), and 下旬 (21st–end). Rarely used in everyday speech but common in news, schedules, and formal writing: 五月中旬 (mid-May). Useful for reading Taiwanese news and calendars.

examples.chinese: 報告預計在六月中旬完成並提交給主管。
examples.pinyin: Bàogào yùjì zài liùyuè zhōngxún wánchéng bìng tíjiāo gěi zhǔguǎn.
examples.english: The report is expected to be completed and submitted to the supervisor in mid-June.

examples.chinese: 颱風通常在七月中旬到九月下旬最為頻繁。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng tōngcháng zài qīyuè zhōngxún dào jiǔyuè xiàxún zuì wéi pínfán.
examples.english: Typhoons are usually most frequent from mid-July through the last ten days of September.

semanticNote: Kind, category, or type. 種類繁多 (many varieties) is a common expression for Taiwan's diverse food scene or product range. More concrete than 類型 (type, pattern); can refer to biological species, product varieties, or abstract categories. Measure word: 種 (zhǒng).

examples.chinese: 台灣的水果種類豐富，蓮霧、釋迦、芒果都很出名。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de shuǐguǒ zhǒnglèi fēngfù, liánwù, shìjiā, mángguǒ dōu hěn chūmíng.
examples.english: Taiwan has an abundance of fruit varieties — wax apple, sugar apple, and mango are all famous.

examples.chinese: 這間書店的書種類很多，幾乎什麼類型的都有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān shūdiàn de shū zhǒnglèi hěn duō, jīhū shénme lèixíng de dōu yǒu.
examples.english: This bookstore has a wide variety of books — you can find almost any type.

semanticNote: Major; significant; of great importance or consequence. 重大決定 (major decision), 重大事件 (major event), 重大突破 (major breakthrough). Used in serious contexts — rarely trivial. Common in news reporting and formal announcements. Stronger than 重要 (important); implies weight and consequence.

examples.chinese: 這項發現被認為是醫學史上的重大突破。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng fāxiàn bèi rènwéi shì yīxué shǐ shàng de zhòngdà tūpò.
examples.english: This discovery is considered a major breakthrough in medical history.

examples.chinese: 公司面臨重大危機，管理層緊急召開董事會。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī miànlín zhòngdà wēijī, guǎnlǐcéng jǐnjí zhàokāi dǒngshìhuì.
examples.english: The company faced a major crisis, and management urgently convened a board of directors meeting.

semanticNote: Weight — physical mass. 淨重量 (net weight), 超過重量限制 (exceeding weight limit). Used in shipping, fitness, cooking, and aviation. Distinct from 體重 (body weight, for people) and 分量 (portion; significance). Taiwan uses kilograms (公斤) as the standard unit.

examples.chinese: 這個行李箱的重量超過航空公司規定的二十公斤限制。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xínglǐxiāng de zhòngliàng chāoguò hángkōng gōngsī guīdìng de èrshí gōngjīn xiànzhì.
examples.english: This suitcase's weight exceeds the airline's 20-kilogram limit.

examples.chinese: 重量訓練可以增加肌肉量，提升基礎代謝率。
examples.pinyin: Zhòngliàng xùnliàn kěyǐ zēngjiā jīròuliàng, tíshēng jīchǔ dàixièlǜ.
examples.english: Weight training can increase muscle mass and boost your basal metabolic rate.

semanticNote: Thoughtful; considerate; thorough — attending to every detail and every person's needs. 服務周到 (attentive service) is high praise in Taiwan's service culture. 想得很周到 (has thought of everything). Related to 細心 (careful) but 周到 emphasizes comprehensive consideration of others.

examples.chinese: 這家旅館的服務非常周到，連牙膏都幫你準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚguǎn de fúwù fēicháng zhōudào, lián yágāo dōu bāng nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: This hotel's service is extremely attentive — they even prepared toothpaste for you.

examples.chinese: 她安排這次旅行考慮得十分周到，大家玩得都很盡興。
examples.pinyin: Tā ānpái zhè cì lǚxíng kǎolǜ de shífēn zhōudào, dàjiā wán de dōu hěn jìnxīng.
examples.english: She planned this trip with great thoroughness, and everyone had a wonderful time.

semanticNote: Pig; pork (by extension). The pig is one of the twelve zodiac animals (亥, 豬年). 豬肉 is a staple of Taiwanese cuisine — 滷肉飯 (braised pork rice), 排骨 (pork ribs), 豬血糕 (pig blood cake). In colloquial use, 豬 can mildly criticize someone as slow or greedy. Traditional: 豬.

examples.chinese: 台灣的滷肉飯用的是豬五花肉，口感軟嫩入味。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de lǔròufàn yòng de shì zhū wǔhuāròu, kǒugǎn ruǎnnèn rùwèi.
examples.english: Taiwan's braised pork rice uses pork belly — the texture is tender and full of flavor.

examples.chinese: 今年是豬年，媽媽特別買了豬的擺件裝飾家裡。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián shì zhūnián, māmā tèbié mǎi le zhū de bǎijiàn zhuāngshì jiālǐ.
examples.english: This year is the Year of the Pig, so Mom especially bought pig figurines to decorate the house.

semanticNote: Bamboo. Taiwan has extensive bamboo forests, especially in the mountains of Nantou and Alishan. Bamboo is culturally significant — used for 竹編 (bamboo weaving), food (竹筍, bamboo shoots), music (竹笛, bamboo flute), and construction. 竹 also carries connotations of resilience and integrity in classical poetry.

examples.chinese: 阿里山的竹子林在晨霧中格外美麗。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān de zhúzi lín zài chénwù zhōng géwài měilì.
examples.english: The bamboo groves of Alishan are especially beautiful in the morning mist.

examples.chinese: 竹筍是台灣料理中常見的食材，無論炒、煮、燉都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhúsǔn shì Táiwān liàolǐ zhōng chángjiàn de shícái, wúlùn chǎo, zhǔ, dùn dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: Bamboo shoots are a common ingredient in Taiwanese cooking — delicious whether stir-fried, boiled, or stewed.

semanticNote: Step by step; gradually, in stages. Implies methodical, incremental progress — the emphasis is on the sequence of steps. 逐步實施 (implement step by step), 逐步改善 (gradually improve). More deliberate than 漸漸 (gradually); implies a planned process rather than natural drift.

examples.chinese: 政府宣布將逐步開放邊境，恢復正常往來。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xuānbù jiāng zhúbù kāifàng biānjìng, huīfù zhèngcháng wǎnglái.
examples.english: The government announced it will gradually open the borders and restore normal movement.

examples.chinese: 他逐步克服了對公開演講的恐懼，現在已能輕鬆上台。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhúbù kèfú le duì gōngkāi yǎnjiǎng de kǒngjù, xiànzài yǐ néng qīngsōng shàngtái.
examples.english: He gradually overcame his fear of public speaking and can now get on stage with ease.

semanticNote: Gradually; by degrees — implies a smooth, continuous process of change rather than step-by-step stages (unlike 逐步). 逐漸增加 (increase gradually), 逐漸消失 (gradually disappear). More neutral than 慢慢 (slowly); doesn't imply speed, just continuity of change. Traditional: 逐漸.

examples.chinese: 隨著年齡增長，她對傳統文化的興趣逐漸加深。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe niánlíng zēngzhǎng, tā duì chuántǒng wénhuà de xìngqù zhújiàn jiāshēn.
examples.english: As she grew older, her interest in traditional culture gradually deepened.

examples.chinese: 台灣北部的天氣逐漸轉涼，早晚需要加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān běibù de tiānqì zhújiàn zhuǎn liáng, zǎowǎn xūyào jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather in northern Taiwan is gradually turning cooler — you'll need an extra jacket in the morning and evening.

semanticNote: To preside over, host, or manage. 主持會議 (chair a meeting), 主持人 (host/MC/anchor). In Taiwan, 主持人 covers TV hosts (新聞主播), radio presenters, and event emcees. Also means to take charge of an organization or project. Implies leadership and facilitation.

examples.chinese: 她擔任這場婚禮的主持人，把整個典禮安排得井然有序。
examples.pinyin: Tā dānrèn zhè chǎng hūnlǐ de zhǔchírén, bǎ zhěnggè diǎnlǐ ānpái de jǐngrányǒuxù.
examples.english: She served as the MC for the wedding and arranged the entire ceremony in an orderly manner.

examples.chinese: 校長親自主持開學典禮，向全體師生致詞。
examples.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng qīnzì zhǔchí kāixué diǎnlǐ, xiàng quántǐ shīshēng zhìcí.
examples.english: The principal personally presided over the opening ceremony and addressed all teachers and students.

semanticNote: Taking initiative; proactive; voluntary (contrasts with 被動, passive). 主動出擊 (take the initiative and strike), 主動請纓 (volunteer for a task), 主動溝通 (communicate proactively). Highly valued trait in Taiwan's workplace culture — described as 積極主動 (proactive and positive).

examples.chinese: 面試時，主動表達自己的想法往往能給面試官留下好印象。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí, zhǔdòng biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ wǎngwǎng néng gěi miànshìguān liúxià hǎo yìnxiàng.
examples.english: During an interview, proactively expressing your ideas often leaves a good impression on the interviewer.

examples.chinese: 她主動幫忙整理倉庫，讓同事們都很感動。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǔdòng bāngmáng zhěnglǐ cāngkù, ràng tóngshìmen dōu hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: She proactively helped tidy up the storeroom, which really moved her coworkers.

semanticNote: Subjective — based on personal feelings or perspective rather than objective facts. Contrasts with 客觀 (objective). 主觀印象 (subjective impression), 主觀判斷 (subjective judgment). In academic and critical discourse, 主觀 is often used to challenge another's reasoning: 你這樣說太主觀了. Traditional: 主觀.

examples.chinese: 藝術評論難免帶有主觀色彩，每個人的感受都不同。
examples.pinyin: Yìshù pínglùn nánmiǎn dàiyǒu zhǔguān sècǎi, měi gè rén de gǎnshòu dōu bùtóng.
examples.english: Art criticism inevitably has a subjective tinge — everyone's experience is different.

examples.chinese: 法官在審案時應盡量排除個人的主觀情緒。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān zài shěn'àn shí yīng jǐnliàng páichú gèrén de zhǔguān qíngjù.
examples.english: Judges should try to set aside personal subjective feelings when adjudicating cases.

semanticNote: Master; owner; host. 房子的主人 (the owner of the house), 寵物的主人 (a pet's owner), 以地主之誼款待 (host with the generosity of a host). In hosting contexts, 主人 implies warmth and responsibility. Contrasts with 客人 (guest). Also: 做自己命運的主人 (be the master of your own destiny).

examples.chinese: 這隻流浪狗最終找到了一個疼愛牠的好主人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī liúlàng gǒu zuìzhōng zhǎodào le yī gè téng'ài tā de hǎo zhǔrén.
examples.english: This stray dog finally found a loving owner who adores it.

examples.chinese: 身為主人，他一直親切地招待每一位來訪的客人。
examples.pinyin: Shēn wéi zhǔrén, tā yīzhí qīnqiè de zhāodài měi yī wèi láifǎng de kèrén.
examples.english: As the host, he warmly welcomed every visitor who came by.

semanticNote: Director; head of a department or division. Used in schools (班主任, homeroom teacher; 教務主任, academic affairs director), hospitals (科主任, department chief), government agencies (處主任, section chief), and corporations. More specific than 主管 (supervisor). Implies formal appointment.

examples.chinese: 她去年升任研究部主任，負責帶領二十人的團隊。
examples.pinyin: Tā qùnián shēngrèn yánjiūbù zhǔrèn, fùzé dàilǐng èrshí rén de tuánduì.
examples.english: She was promoted to Research Department Director last year, responsible for leading a team of twenty.

examples.chinese: 班主任通知家長，下週一要召開親師座談會。
examples.pinyin: Bān zhǔrèn tōngzhī jiāzhǎng, xià zhōuyī yào zhàokāi qīn-shī zuòtánhuì.
examples.english: The homeroom teacher notified parents that a parent-teacher forum will be held next Monday.

semanticNote: Theme; subject; topic — the central idea of a work, discussion, or event. 主題曲 (theme song), 主題樂園 (theme park), 主題演講 (keynote address). Broader than 話題 (topic of conversation); more about the conceptual core than the surface subject. Traditional: 主題.

examples.chinese: 這部電影的主題是關於家庭和解與自我救贖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zhǔtí shì guānyú jiātíng héjiě yǔ zìwǒ jiùshú.
examples.english: The theme of this film is about family reconciliation and self-redemption.

examples.chinese: 今年的台北國際書展主題是「閱讀的力量」。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de Táiběi guójì shūzhǎn zhǔtí shì 'yuèdú de lìliàng'.
examples.english: This year's Taipei International Book Exhibition theme is 'The Power of Reading.'

semanticNote: Chairperson; chairman; president (of an organization or meeting). 黨主席 (party chair), 會議主席 (meeting chair), 理事會主席 (board chairperson). In Taiwan's political context, 主席 refers to leaders of political parties (民進黨主席, KMT主席) rather than heads of state (those are 總統).

examples.chinese: 民進黨主席今天召開記者會，說明黨的最新立場。
examples.pinyin: Mínzhìndǎng zhǔxí jīntiān zhàokāi jìzhě huì, shuōmíng dǎng de zuìxīn lìchǎng.
examples.english: The DPP chairperson held a press conference today to explain the party's latest position.

examples.chinese: 會議主席宣布討論結束，請大家舉手表決。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zhǔxí xuānbù tǎolùn jiéshù, qǐng dàjiā jǔshǒu biǎojué.
examples.english: The meeting chairperson announced the discussion was over and asked everyone to vote by raising their hands.

semanticNote: To advocate for; to hold a position or viewpoint; a stance or proposition. 主張和平解決 (advocate for peaceful resolution), 表明主張 (state one's position). Used in political debate, philosophy, and everyday argument. More formal than 認為 (think/believe); implies active promotion of a view.

examples.chinese: 他主張應該透過對話而非對抗來解決兩岸問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǔzhāng yīnggāi tòuguò duìhuà ér fēi duìkàng lái jiějué liǎng'àn wèntí.
examples.english: He advocates resolving cross-strait issues through dialogue rather than confrontation.

examples.chinese: 每個人的主張不同，重要的是能尊重彼此的意見。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de zhǔzhāng bùtóng, zhòngyào de shì néng zūnzhòng bǐcǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: Everyone holds different positions — what matters is being able to respect each other's views.
