semanticNote: To boil or cook (in water or liquid). 煮飯 (cook rice/a meal), 煮麵 (cook noodles), 煮湯 (make soup). More specific than 做 (make/do) and 烹飪 (cook, formal); 煮 implies liquid-based cooking. Essential for describing home cooking and 夜市 (night market) food stalls.

examples.chinese: 媽媽每天早上都會煮一鍋熱騰騰的粥給全家人吃。
examples.pinyin: Māmā měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì zhǔ yī guō rè téng téng de zhōu gěi quánjiā rén chī.
examples.english: Mom cooks a pot of piping hot congee for the whole family every morning.

examples.chinese: 他把地瓜和芋頭一起煮，做成台式甜湯。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ dìguā hé yùtou yīqǐ zhǔ, zuòchéng Táishì tiántāng.
examples.english: He boiled sweet potato and taro together to make a Taiwanese-style sweet soup.

semanticNote: To register; registration. Used for company registration (公司注冊), school enrollment (學籍注冊), website signup (網站注冊), and trademark registration (商標注冊). In Taiwan, 公司法 registration is handled through the 經濟部. Online contexts: 帳號注冊 (create an account).

examples.chinese: 想在台灣開公司，必須先到經濟部辦理公司注冊。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng zài Táiwān kāi gōngsī, bìxū xiān dào jīngjìbù bànlǐ gōngsī zhùcè.
examples.english: To open a company in Taiwan, you must first register with the Ministry of Economic Affairs.

examples.chinese: 請先注冊帳號，才能享有會員的各項優惠。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiān zhùcè zhànghào, cái néng xiǎngyǒu huìyuán de gè xiàng yōuhuì.
examples.english: Please register an account first before you can enjoy member benefits.

semanticNote: To wish someone well; blessings; good wishes. Used in festive greetings, farewell messages, and religious contexts. 送上祝福 (send blessings), 衷心的祝福 (heartfelt blessings). In Taiwan, 祝福 appears abundantly during 農曆新年, weddings, and graduation ceremonies. More heartfelt than 祝 alone.

examples.chinese: 婚禮上，親友們紛紛送上對新人的誠摯祝福。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ shàng, qīnyǒumen fēnfēn sòng shàng duì xīnrén de chéngzhì zhùfú.
examples.english: At the wedding, family and friends offered their sincere blessings to the newlyweds one after another.

examples.chinese: 她在臉書上寫道：「祝大家新年快樂，萬事如意！」
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Liǎnshū shàng xiědào: 'Zhù dàjiā xīnnián kuàilè, wànshì rúyì!'
examples.english: She wrote on Facebook: 'Wishing everyone a Happy New Year and may all your wishes come true!'

semanticNote: To grab, clutch, catch, or arrest. Physical: 抓住 (grab hold of), 抓小偷 (catch a thief). Figurative: 抓重點 (grasp the key points), 抓住機會 (seize the opportunity). Also: 抓癢 (scratch an itch). In police/legal contexts, 抓 implies apprehension. Essential action verb.

examples.chinese: 警察在夜市附近抓到了一名扒手。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài yèshì fùjìn zhuā dào le yī míng páshǒu.
examples.english: Police caught a pickpocket near the night market.

examples.chinese: 開會時要抓重點記錄，不需要把每句話都寫下來。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí yào zhuā zhòngdiǎn jìlù, bù xūyào bǎ měi jù huà dōu xiě xiàlái.
examples.english: When taking meeting notes, focus on the key points — you don't need to write down every word.

semanticNote: To grasp firmly; to pay close attention to; to make the most of (time or opportunity). 抓緊時間 (make good use of time; don't waste a moment), 抓緊機會 (seize the opportunity). Often carries urgency. 抓緊！(Hurry up! / Don't let go!). Traditional: 抓緊.

examples.chinese: 考試快到了，要抓緊時間複習，不能再拖了。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kuài dào le, yào zhuājǐn shíjiān fùxí, bù néng zài tuō le.
examples.english: The exam is coming up — you need to make the most of your time and review. You can't keep putting it off.

examples.chinese: 搭高鐵要抓緊，一旦錯過這班車就要再等半小時。
examples.pinyin: Dā gāotiě yào zhuājǐn, yīdàn cuòguò zhè bān chē jiù yào zài děng bàn xiǎoshí.
examples.english: You need to hurry to catch the HSR — if you miss this train, you'll have to wait another half hour.

semanticNote: Expert; specialist — someone with deep professional knowledge. 醫學專家 (medical expert), 法律專家 (legal expert), 經濟學專家 (economics expert). Collocates with 業界 (industry), 學術 (academic), 政府聘請 (government-appointed). In Taiwan's media, 專家 are frequently cited on talk shows and news panels.

examples.chinese: 衛福部邀請多位醫學專家開會，討論疫苗接種策略。
examples.pinyin: Wèifúbù yāoqǐng duō wèi yīxué zhuānjiā kāihuì, tǎolùn yìmiáo jiēzhòng cèlüè.
examples.english: The Ministry of Health and Welfare invited several medical experts to a meeting to discuss vaccine rollout strategies.

examples.chinese: 他是台灣半導體領域的頂尖專家，曾任台積電研究員。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì Táiwān bàndǎotǐ lǐngyù de dǐngjiān zhuānjiā, céng rèn Táijīdiàn yánjiūyuán.
examples.english: He is a top expert in Taiwan's semiconductor field and formerly worked as a researcher at TSMC.

semanticNote: Focused; absorbed; to concentrate one's mind on something. 專心讀書 (study with full concentration), 專心聽講 (listen attentively). Implies mental exclusivity — not doing other things simultaneously. 全心全意 is a more emphatic synonym. Common in educational contexts.

examples.chinese: 上課時請收起手機，專心聽老師講課。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí qǐng shōuqǐ shǒujī, zhuānxīn tīng lǎoshī jiǎngkè.
examples.english: Please put away your phone during class and concentrate on the teacher's lesson.

examples.chinese: 他一旦專心工作起來，連吃飯都忘了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīdàn zhuānxīn gōngzuò qǐlái, lián chīfàn dōu wàng le.
examples.english: Once he gets absorbed in work, he even forgets to eat.

semanticNote: To transform; change direction or nature. 觀念轉變 (shift in mindset), 角色轉變 (change of role), 轉變方向 (change direction). Implies a significant, often fundamental change — more than 改變 (change), which can be minor. Often describes shifts in policy, attitude, or identity.

examples.chinese: 經過這次意外，他的人生觀有了很大的轉變。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì yìwài, tā de rénshēngguān yǒu le hěn dà de zhuǎnbiàn.
examples.english: After this accident, his outlook on life underwent a major transformation.

examples.chinese: 台灣從農業社會轉變為科技島，只花了幾十年的時間。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān cóng nóngyè shèhuì zhuǎnbiàn wéi kējì dǎo, zhǐ huā le jǐ shí nián de shíjiān.
examples.english: Taiwan transformed from an agricultural society to a tech island in just a few decades.

semanticNote: To pass on a message; to relay information to a third party. 請轉告他... (Please tell him...), 麻煩您轉告一聲 (Could you pass along a word?). Used when the original sender cannot reach the recipient directly. Polite and practical — common in workplace and family communication.

examples.chinese: 如果你見到老闆，請幫我轉告他我今天下午請假了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ jiàn dào lǎobǎn, qǐng bāng wǒ zhuǎngào tā wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ qǐngjià le.
examples.english: If you see the boss, please pass on the message that I'm taking the afternoon off today.

examples.chinese: 媽媽請我轉告奶奶，她明天不能去探望了。
examples.pinyin: Māmā qǐng wǒ zhuǎngào nǎinai, tā míngtiān bù néng qù tànwàng le.
examples.english: Mom asked me to relay to Grandma that she won't be able to visit tomorrow.

semanticNote: Multiple senses: (1) to load or pack (裝行李, pack luggage); (2) to dress up or disguise (裝扮, to dress up; 裝成, to disguise as); (3) to pretend (裝病, feign illness; 裝不知道, pretend not to know); (4) to install (裝冷氣, install AC); (5) clothing/costume (民族服裝, ethnic costume). Context determines meaning.

examples.chinese: 他裝作若無其事的樣子，其實心裡很緊張。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuāng zuò ruò wú qí shì de yàngzi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: He pretended to act as if nothing was the matter, but was actually very nervous inside.

examples.chinese: 夏天到了，房東請人來裝了新的冷氣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān dào le, fángdōng qǐng rén lái zhuāng le xīn de lěngqì.
examples.english: Summer arrived, and the landlord had someone come to install new air conditioning.

semanticNote: To decorate; decoration; ornament. 室內裝飾 (interior decoration), 聖誕節裝飾 (Christmas decorations), 裝飾品 (decorative items). In Taiwan, home decoration (裝潢) is a separate, more comprehensive term; 裝飾 refers to embellishments rather than full renovation. Traditional: 裝飾.

examples.chinese: 她用乾燥花和木質小物裝飾了整個書房，感覺很溫馨。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng gānzào huā hé mùzhì xiǎowù zhuāngshì le zhěnggè shūfáng, gǎnjué hěn wēnxīn.
examples.english: She decorated the entire study with dried flowers and wooden items — it feels very cozy.

examples.chinese: 廟口的裝飾燈籠在元宵節夜晚特別漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Miào kǒu de zhuāngshì dēnglóng zài Yuánxiāo jié yèwǎn tèbié piàoliang.
examples.english: The decorative lanterns at the temple entrance are especially beautiful on Lantern Festival night.

semanticNote: To renovate (a building or interior space); renovation. Covers everything from minor refurbishing to full gut renovation. 裝修工程 (renovation project), 裝修費用 (renovation costs). In Taiwan, apartment renovation before moving in is common — 裝修 is part of the standard home-buying experience. More extensive than 裝飾.

examples.chinese: 他們買了新房子，打算花三個月時間進行全面裝修。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen mǎi le xīn fángzi, dǎsuàn huā sān gè yuè shíjiān jìnxíng quánmiàn zhuāngxiū.
examples.english: They bought a new house and plan to spend three months doing a complete renovation.

examples.chinese: 樓上在裝修，每天的敲打聲讓人很難專心工作。
examples.pinyin: Lóu shàng zài zhuāngxiū, měitiān de qiāodǎ shēng ràng rén hěn nán zhuānxīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: The floor above is being renovated — the daily hammering makes it very hard to concentrate on work.

semanticNote: Condition; state; situation — describing the current state of affairs. 身體狀況 (physical condition), 財務狀況 (financial situation), 出狀況 (something went wrong; a problem arose). 出狀況 is especially colloquial and widely used in Taiwan. More dynamic than 情況 — implies something observable and current.

examples.chinese: 病患的狀況已經稍微穩定，不過還需要繼續觀察。
examples.pinyin: Bìnghuàn de zhuàngkuàng yǐjīng shāowéi wěndìng, búguò hái xūyào jìxù guānchá.
examples.english: The patient's condition has stabilized somewhat, but continued observation is still needed.

examples.chinese: 今天路況很差，高速公路出了好幾個狀況，塞了兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān lùkuàng hěn chà, gāosùgōnglù chū le hǎo jǐ gè zhuàngkuàng, sāi le liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Road conditions were bad today — several incidents occurred on the freeway and there was a two-hour backup.

semanticNote: State; condition; mode of being — more abstract than 狀況. Used for mental states (精神狀態, mental state), system states (系統狀態, system status), and physical states (固態, solid state). 線上狀態 (online status), 離線狀態 (offline). In everyday speech: 今天狀態不好 (not feeling great today). Traditional: 狀態.

examples.chinese: 他考前緊張過度，狀態很差，沒考出平常的水準。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎo qián jǐnzhāng guòdù, zhuàngtài hěn chà, méi kǎo chū píngcháng de shuǐzhǔn.
examples.english: He was overly anxious before the exam, in poor shape, and didn't perform to his usual standard.

examples.chinese: 這台電腦的硬碟狀態異常，建議盡快備份資料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo de yìngdié zhuàngtài yìcháng, jiànyì jǐnkuài bèifèn zīliào.
examples.english: The hard drive on this computer shows an abnormal state — it's recommended you back up your data soon.

semanticNote: To hit, collide with, or run into. 撞車 (car crash), 撞牆 (hit a wall; figurative: hit a dead end), 撞到人 (bump into someone). Also used figuratively: 想法撞在一起 (ideas clash). 碰撞 is a more formal synonym. In Taiwan traffic contexts, 車禍 often involves 撞.

examples.chinese: 他騎機車時沒注意紅燈，差點撞上前方的計程車。
examples.pinyin: Tā qí jīchē shí méi zhùyì hóngdēng, chàdiǎn zhuàng shàng qiánfāng de jìchéngchē.
examples.english: He wasn't paying attention to the red light while riding his scooter and nearly crashed into the taxi ahead.

examples.chinese: 在黑暗中走路，她一頭撞上了玻璃門。
examples.pinyin: Zài hēi'àn zhōng zǒulù, tā yī tóu zhuàng shàng le bōlí mén.
examples.english: Walking in the dark, she walked straight into the glass door.

semanticNote: To chase; pursue. Physical: 追小偷 (chase a thief), 追公車 (run after the bus). Romantic: 追女生 (pursue a girl; court someone). Media: 追劇 (binge-watch a drama series — very common in Taiwan). Metaphorical: 追求 (pursue), 追問 (press for an answer). Essential everyday verb.

examples.chinese: 她跑著追上了公車，幸好沒有誤班。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎozhe zhuī shàng le gōngchē, xìnghǎo méiyǒu wùbān.
examples.english: She ran and caught up with the bus — luckily she didn't miss it.

examples.chinese: 最近在追一部台劇，劇情超精彩，一口氣看了六集。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn zài zhuī yī bù Tái jù, jùqíng chāo jīngcǎi, yī kǒuqì kàn le liù jí.
examples.english: I've been binge-watching a Taiwanese drama lately — the plot is incredible, I watched six episodes in one go.

semanticNote: To pursue; seek after — ideals, goals, or relationships. 追求卓越 (pursue excellence), 追求幸福 (pursue happiness), 追求真理 (pursue truth). More elevated than 追 alone; implies aspiration and sustained effort. Also romantic: 追求某人 (court someone). Common in graduation speeches and motivational contexts.

examples.chinese: 她放棄高薪工作，追求自己真正熱愛的音樂夢想。
examples.pinyin: Tā fàngqì gāoxīn gōngzuò, zhuīqiú zìjǐ zhēnzhèng rèài de yīnyuè mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: She gave up a high-paying job to pursue her true passion — her dream of music.

examples.chinese: 台積電不斷追求製程技術的突破，保持全球領先地位。
examples.pinyin: Táijīdiàn búduàn zhuīqiú zhìchéng jìshù de tūpò, bǎochí quánqiú lǐngxiān dìwèi.
examples.english: TSMC continuously pursues breakthroughs in process technology, maintaining its global leadership position.

semanticNote: To consult; seek advice; consultation. 法律諮詢 (legal consultation), 醫療諮詢 (medical consultation), 諮詢服務 (advisory service). Note: Taiwan commonly uses 諮詢 (with 言 radical on 諮), while mainland uses 咨询. Both forms are understood. Common in professional and government service contexts.

examples.chinese: 如果對勞動權益有任何疑問，可以向勞動局免費諮詢。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ duì láodòng quányì yǒu rènhé yíwèn, kěyǐ xiàng láodòng jú miǎnfèi zīxún.
examples.english: If you have any questions about labor rights, you can consult the Labor Bureau for free.

examples.chinese: 購屋前最好先找專業的房產律師進行法律諮詢。
examples.pinyin: Gòu wū qián zuìhǎo xiān zhǎo zhuānyè de fángchǎn lǜshī jìnxíng fǎlǜ zīxún.
examples.english: Before buying a house, it's best to first consult a professional real estate lawyer for legal advice.

semanticNote: Posture; position; pose. 坐姿 (sitting posture), 站姿 (standing posture), 瑜伽姿勢 (yoga pose), 攝影姿勢 (photo pose). In Taiwan's health-conscious context, 姿勢 is important in ergonomics discussions (正確坐姿 for office workers). Traditional: 姿勢.

examples.chinese: 長期保持不良的坐姿容易導致脊椎問題。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī bǎochí bùliáng de zuòzī róngyì dǎozhì jǐzhuī wèntí.
examples.english: Maintaining poor sitting posture for a long time can easily lead to spinal problems.

examples.chinese: 攝影師指導模特兒擺出各種不同的姿勢。
examples.pinyin: Shèyǐngshī zhǐdǎo mótèér bǎi chū gè zhǒng bùtóng de zīshì.
examples.english: The photographer directed the model to pose in various different positions.

semanticNote: Qualifications; eligibility; seniority. 具備資格 (meet the qualifications), 取得資格 (obtain qualification), 沒有資格 (not qualified; also informal: have no right to say/do something). In Taiwan: 考取資格 for professional certifications. Also implies standing: 他沒資格說我 (he has no standing to criticize me).

examples.chinese: 應聘這個職位，需要具備三年以上的相關工作資格。
examples.pinyin: Yìngpìn zhège zhíwèi, xūyào jùbèi sān nián yǐshàng de xiāngguān gōngzuò zīgé.
examples.english: Applying for this position requires at least three years of relevant work qualifications.

examples.chinese: 你自己都做不到，有什麼資格來要求別人？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zìjǐ dōu zuò bú dào, yǒu shénme zīgé lái yāoqiú biérén?
examples.english: You can't even do it yourself — what standing do you have to demand it of others?

semanticNote: Funds; capital; financial resources. 投資資金 (investment capital), 研發資金 (R&D funding), 募集資金 (raise funds). More specific than 錢 (money) — implies a dedicated financial pool for a purpose. Common in business, government budgeting, and nonprofit fundraising. Traditional: 資金.

examples.chinese: 這家新創公司在首輪募資中成功籌得一億元的資金。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xīnchuàng gōngsī zài shǒu lún mùzī zhōng chénggōng chóu dé yī yì yuán de zījīn.
examples.english: This startup successfully raised 100 million NT dollars in its first funding round.

examples.chinese: 政府提撥專項資金，用於改善偏遠地區的教育設施。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tíbō zhuānxiàng zījīn, yòng yú gǎishàn piānyuǎn dìqū de jiàoyù shèshī.
examples.english: The government allocated special funds to improve educational facilities in remote areas.

semanticNote: Data; material; information; resources for reference. 蒐集資料 (collect data/materials), 查閱資料 (look up reference materials), 個人資料 (personal information — the privacy law term). 資料 is broader than 數據 (numerical data, statistics) and 資訊 (information, news). In Taiwan, 個人資料保護法 (Personal Data Protection Act) makes 個人資料 a legal term.

examples.chinese: 請填寫個人資料，包括姓名、出生年月日和聯絡電話。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng tiánxiě gèrén zīliào, bāokuò xìngmíng, chūshēng nián yuè rì hé liánluò diànhuà.
examples.english: Please fill in your personal information, including name, date of birth, and contact number.

examples.chinese: 她花了整個週末蒐集論文所需的參考資料。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le zhěnggè zhōumò sōují lùnwén suǒ xū de cānkǎo zīliào.
examples.english: She spent the entire weekend collecting reference materials for her thesis.

semanticNote: Resources — natural, human, or computational. 自然資源 (natural resources), 人力資源 (human resources; HR), 教育資源 (educational resources), 資源回收 (resource recycling — Taiwan is known for its highly efficient 資源回收 system). In computing: 系統資源 (system resources).

examples.chinese: 台灣資源回收的普及率非常高，垃圾分類已成習慣。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zīyuán huísōu de pújírǜ fēicháng gāo, lājī fēnlèi yǐ chéng xíguàn.
examples.english: Taiwan's resource recycling rate is very high — sorting garbage has already become a habit.

examples.chinese: 偏鄉地區的教育資源嚴重不足，需要政府加大投入。
examples.pinyin: Piānxiāng dìqū de jiàoyù zīyuán yánzhòng bùzú, xūyào zhèngfǔ jiā dà tóurù.
examples.english: Remote rural areas are seriously lacking in educational resources — greater government investment is needed.

semanticNote: Purple; violet. In Chinese culture, purple (紫) is associated with nobility and good fortune — 紫禁城 (Forbidden City, literally Purple Forbidden City). In modern Taiwan: 紫色 (the color purple), 紫外線 (UV rays), 紫菜 (seaweed/nori — used in 紫菜湯). Also 紫砂壺 (Yixing clay teapot) in tea culture.

examples.chinese: 她最喜歡穿紫色的衣服，說這樣顯得氣質高雅。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì xǐhuān chuān zǐsè de yīfú, shuō zhèyàng xiǎnde qìzhì gāoyǎ.
examples.english: She loves wearing purple clothes, saying it gives her an elegant, refined look.

examples.chinese: 夏天紫外線很強，出門前記得擦防曬乳。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān zǐwàixiàn hěn qiáng, chūmén qián jìdé cā fángshài rǔ.
examples.english: UV rays are very strong in summer — remember to apply sunscreen before going out.

semanticNote: Since; ever since — marks the starting point of a continuous situation. 自從那件事之後 (ever since that incident). Used to introduce a past event that led to an ongoing state. More literary than 從 alone. Always followed by a time reference or event, then a result or description of current state.

examples.chinese: 自從換了新工作，她的心情好多了，壓力也小了不少。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng huàn le xīn gōngzuò, tā de xīnqíng hǎo duō le, yālì yě xiǎo le bù shǎo.
examples.english: Ever since she changed jobs, her mood has improved a lot and her stress has decreased considerably.

examples.chinese: 自從搬到台南，他愛上了當地小吃，幾乎每天都去夜市。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng bān dào Táinán, tā àishàng le dāngdì xiǎochī, jīhū měitiān dōu qù yèshì.
examples.english: Ever since moving to Tainan, he has fallen in love with the local street food — he goes to the night market almost every day.

semanticNote: Automatic; spontaneously; of one's own accord. 自動門 (automatic door), 自動販賣機 (vending machine), 自動化 (automation). Also behavioral: 他自動自發地完成工作 (he completed the work on his own initiative). In Taiwan's tech sector, 自動化 is a major focus in manufacturing and services.

examples.chinese: 捷運站的剪票口裝了自動感應門，非常方便。
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn de jiǎnpiào kǒu zhuāng le zìdòng gǎnyìng mén, fēicháng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: The MRT station's ticket gates have automatic sensor doors — very convenient.

examples.chinese: 工廠引進自動化設備後，生產效率提升了三倍。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng yǐnjìn zìdònghuà shèbèi hòu, shēngchǎn xiàolǜ tíshēng le sān bèi.
examples.english: After the factory introduced automated equipment, production efficiency tripled.

semanticNote: To feel proud; a sense of pride. 感到自豪 (feel proud), 引以為豪 (take pride in), 以台灣人為傲 (proud to be Taiwanese). Positive connotation — distinguished from 驕傲 which can mean arrogance. 自豪 is specifically about warranted pride in achievement or identity.

examples.chinese: 她為自己能考上台大醫學院感到非常自豪。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zìjǐ néng kǎo shàng Táidà yīxuéyuàn gǎndào fēicháng zìháo.
examples.english: She is very proud of herself for having been accepted into NTU's medical school.

examples.chinese: 許多台灣人以本土的珍珠奶茶文化為傲，覺得很自豪。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō Táiwānrén yǐ běntǔ de zhēnzhū nǎichá wénhuà wéi ào, juéde hěn zìháo.
examples.english: Many Taiwanese are proud of their home-grown bubble tea culture and feel a strong sense of pride in it.

semanticNote: Self-aware; conscious; self-disciplined; self-motivated. 自覺學習 (study on one's own initiative), 自覺遵守規定 (consciously comply with regulations). Also: to become aware of something (他自覺身體不對勁, he became aware something was wrong with his body). Values-loaded in Taiwan's civic education.

examples.chinese: 好的習慣需要長期自覺地堅持，不是靠別人提醒的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo de xíguàn xūyào chángqī zìjué de jiānchí, bú shì kào biérén tíxǐng de.
examples.english: Good habits require sustained self-discipline over the long term — you can't rely on others to remind you.

examples.chinese: 她自覺身體不對，趕緊去診所掛號看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìjué shēntǐ bú duì, gǎnjǐn qù zhěnsuǒ guàhào kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: She sensed something was off with her body and quickly went to register at the clinic to see a doctor.

semanticNote: Selfish; self-centered. A moral criticism — implies putting one's own interests ahead of others without consideration. 太自私了 (so selfish!), 自私自利 (selfish and calculating). Contrasts with 無私 (selfless) and 大公無私 (impartial; for the public good). Used freely in everyday criticism.

examples.chinese: 只顧自己方便而不管別人感受，實在太自私了。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐ gù zìjǐ fāngbiàn ér bù guǎn biérén gǎnshòu, shízài tài zìsī le.
examples.english: Only caring about your own convenience without regard for others' feelings is truly selfish.

examples.chinese: 他拒絕幫忙，讓大家覺得他是個自私的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā jùjué bāngmáng, ràng dàjiā juéde tā shì gè zìsī de rén.
examples.english: His refusal to help made everyone feel he was a selfish person.

semanticNote: Voluntary; of one's own free will. 自願參加 (voluntarily participate), 自願放棄 (voluntarily give up). Implies no coercion. Legal and formal: 自願原則 (principle of voluntariness). Distinct from 主動 (proactive, taking initiative) — 自願 emphasizes freedom from external pressure. Traditional: 自願.

examples.chinese: 這次加班是自願的，公司不強迫任何人留下來。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jiābān shì zìyuàn de, gōngsī bù qiǎngpò rènhé rén liú xiàlái.
examples.english: This overtime is voluntary — the company isn't forcing anyone to stay.

examples.chinese: 他自願捐出全部獎金，作為獎學金幫助清寒學生。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìyuàn juān chū quánbù jiǎngjīn, zuòwéi jiǎngxuéjīn bāngzhù qīnghán xuéshēng.
examples.english: He voluntarily donated his entire prize money as a scholarship to help students from low-income families.

semanticNote: Letter (of an alphabet). 英文字母 (English letters A–Z), 注音字母 (Zhuyin/Bopomofo symbols — Taiwan's phonetic system), 希臘字母 (Greek letters). In Taiwan, students learn 注音符號 (ㄅㄆㄇㄈ) before pinyin, making 注音字母 a culturally significant term from childhood.

examples.chinese: 台灣的小學生先學注音字母，而不是英文的羅馬拼音。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiǎoxuéshēng xiān xué zhùyīn zìmǔ, ér bú shì yīngwén de luómǎ pīnyīn.
examples.english: Elementary school students in Taiwan first learn the Bopomofo phonetic symbols, not Roman pinyin.

examples.chinese: 她把英文二十六個字母的發音全背起來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yīngwén èrshíliù gè zìmǔ de fāyīn quán bèi qǐlái le.
examples.english: She memorized the pronunciation of all twenty-six letters of the English alphabet.

semanticNote: Subtitles; captions. 中文字幕 (Chinese subtitles), 開字幕 (turn on subtitles), 字幕組 (fansubbing group). In Taiwan, even Mandarin-language broadcasts often display 字幕 — a legacy from when many viewers were more comfortable reading than listening. 台劇字幕 (Taiwan drama subtitles) is a cultural institution.

examples.chinese: 看外國電影時，她習慣開中文字幕以幫助理解。
examples.pinyin: Kàn wàiguó diànyǐng shí, tā xíguàn kāi zhōngwén zìmù yǐ bāngzhù lǐjiě.
examples.english: When watching foreign films, she habitually turns on Chinese subtitles to help with comprehension.

examples.chinese: 這個節目的字幕常有錯字，讓觀眾感到很困惑。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiémù de zìmù cháng yǒu cuòzì, ràng guānzhòng gǎndào hěn kùnhuò.
examples.english: This program's subtitles frequently have typos, which leaves viewers feeling very confused.

semanticNote: Comprehensive; synthesized; to integrate or summarize. 綜合評估 (comprehensive assessment), 綜合報告 (综合 report), 綜合所得稅 (consolidated income tax — the formal name for Taiwan's personal income tax filed annually in May). Traditional: 綜合.

examples.chinese: 每年五月申報綜合所得稅，是台灣納稅人的義務。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián wǔ yuè shēnbào zōnghé suǒdéshuì, shì Táiwān nàshuìrén de yìwù.
examples.english: Filing consolidated income tax every May is the obligation of taxpayers in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這份報告綜合了各部門的意見，提出具體改善建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zōnghé le gè bùmén de yìjiàn, tíchū jùtǐ gǎishàn jiànyì.
examples.english: This report synthesizes input from all departments and puts forward specific improvement recommendations.

semanticNote: Director-general; CEO; president of a corporation or major organization. 執行長 is the more modern equivalent of CEO; 總裁 is more traditional and often refers to the top leader of a conglomerate or political party. 張忠謀董事長 (Morris Chang, TSMC's chairman) is a well-known figure with this level of title.

examples.chinese: 集團總裁親自出席記者會，宣布新的投資計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jítuán zǒngcái qīnzì chūxí jìzhěhuì, xuānbù xīn de tóuzī jìhuà.
examples.english: The group's director-general personally attended the press conference to announce a new investment plan.

examples.chinese: 他二十年前加入這家公司，從基層做起，最後升任總裁。
examples.pinyin: Tā èrshí nián qián jiārù zhè jiā gōngsī, cóng jīcéng zuò qǐ, zuìhòu shēngrèn zǒngcái.
examples.english: He joined the company twenty years ago, starting from the bottom and eventually rising to CEO.

semanticNote: Altogether; in total; in all. 總共花了多少錢? (How much did it cost in total?) Used to sum up a quantity. Interchangeable with 一共 and 共 in most contexts; 總共 is slightly more emphatic. Common in shopping, accounting, and any context involving sums.

examples.chinese: 這次夜市小吃之旅，我總共吃了六樣不同的東西。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yèshì xiǎochī zhī lǚ, wǒ zǒnggòng chī le liù yàng bùtóng de dōngxi.
examples.english: On this night market street food tour, I ate six different things in total.

examples.chinese: 這次旅行總共花了我差不多兩萬塊台幣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng zǒnggòng huā le wǒ chàbuduō liǎng wàn kuài Táibì.
examples.english: This trip cost me about 20,000 NT dollars all told.

semanticNote: Premier; prime minister. In the PRC, 總理 heads the State Council. In Taiwan's ROC system, the equivalent is 行政院長 (Premier of the Executive Yuan) — not called 總理 formally. 總理 appears in reference to foreign heads of government (日本總理, Japan's PM; 英國首相 is also used for UK PM). Cultural awareness: this word signals mainland-oriented or formal international usage.

examples.chinese: 日本總理訪台一事受到各方高度關注。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn zǒnglǐ fǎng Tái yī shì shòudào gèfāng gāodù guānzhù.
examples.english: The matter of Japan's Prime Minister visiting Taiwan attracted a great deal of attention from all sides.

examples.chinese: 兩國總理在峰會上就氣候變遷問題達成共識。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó zǒnglǐ zài fēnghuì shàng jiù qìhòu biànqiān wèntí dáchéng gòngshí.
examples.english: The two countries' prime ministers reached a consensus on climate change at the summit.

semanticNote: At long last; finally; on the whole. Implies relief after a long wait or effort: 總算完成了！(It's finally done!) Carries emotional weight — the speaker has been waiting or struggling. Distinct from 終於 (finally) which is more neutral; 總算 conveys stronger relief or mild exasperation.

examples.chinese: 等了三個月，我的護照總算核發下來了。
examples.pinyin: Děng le sān gè yuè, wǒ de hùzhào zǒngsuàn héfā xiàlái le.
examples.english: After waiting three months, my passport has finally been issued.

examples.chinese: 連續加班了兩個禮拜，這個專案總算在截止日前完成了。
examples.pinyin: Liánxù jiābān le liǎng gè lǐbài, zhège zhuān'àn zǒngsuàn zài jiézhǐ rì qián wánchéng le.
examples.english: After two straight weeks of overtime, the project was finally finished before the deadline.

semanticNote: President (of a country). In Taiwan, 總統 is the head of state — a directly elected position. Taiwan's president plays a central role in cross-strait relations. 中華民國總統 (President of the ROC). Elections are held every four years and generate intense public interest. The Presidential Office (總統府) is on Ketagalan Boulevard in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 台灣總統每四年由全體公民直選產生，選舉氣氛熱烈。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zǒngtǒng měi sì nián yóu quántǐ gōngmín zhíxuǎn chǎnshēng, xuǎnjǔ qìfēn rèliè.
examples.english: Taiwan's president is directly elected by all citizens every four years — election time is always very lively.

examples.chinese: 外國元首訪台時，通常會在總統府進行正式會晤。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguó yuánshǒu fǎng Tái shí, tōngcháng huì zài zǒngtǒngfǔ jìnxíng zhèngshì huìwù.
examples.english: When foreign leaders visit Taiwan, formal meetings are usually held at the Presidential Office.

semanticNote: In a word; in short; in brief; to sum up. Used to summarize what came before or to cut to the conclusion: 總之，你得做個決定。 Can also mean 'anyway' to dismiss details: 總之先做了再說。Very common in both spoken and written Chinese. More conclusive than 反正 (anyway), which carries resignation.

examples.chinese: 這件事情很複雜，總之你只要記住一個原則就好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng hěn fùzá, zǒngzhī nǐ zhǐyào jì zhù yī gè yuánzé jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: This matter is complicated — in short, you just need to remember one principle.

examples.chinese: 不管結果如何，總之我們已經盡力了。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn jiéguǒ rúhé, zǒngzhī wǒmen yǐjīng jìnlì le.
examples.english: Whatever the outcome, in short, we've already done our best.

semanticNote: To prevent; to stop; to block someone from doing something. 阻止犯罪 (prevent crime), 阻止他離開 (stop him from leaving), 阻止不了 (can't be stopped). Implies active intervention. Stronger than 阻礙 (hinder, obstruct) in terms of intent — 阻止 seeks to fully prevent an action.

examples.chinese: 警察及時趕到，阻止了一起搶劫案的發生。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá jíshí gǎn dào, zǔzhǐ le yī qǐ qiǎnjié àn de fāshēng.
examples.english: Police arrived in time and prevented a robbery from taking place.

examples.chinese: 父母多次阻止他辭職創業，但他最後還是做了決定。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ duō cì zǔzhǐ tā cízhí chuàngyè, dàn tā zuìhòu háishì zuò le juédìng.
examples.english: His parents tried many times to stop him from quitting his job to start a business, but he ultimately made his decision.

semanticNote: Group; team; to form/compose; measure word for sets or groups. 分組討論 (group discussion), 組成團隊 (form a team), 一組鑰匙 (a set of keys). In schools and workplaces, 小組 (small group) is ubiquitous for collaborative work. As a verb: 組隊 (form a team), 組織 (organize).

components.meaning: group; compose; measure word for sets

examples.chinese: 老師把全班分成六組，每組負責一個主題報告。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ quánbān fēnchéng liù zǔ, měi zǔ fùzé yī gè zhǔtí bàogào.
examples.english: The teacher divided the whole class into six groups, with each group responsible for one topic presentation.

examples.chinese: 這次運動會要組隊參加，你要不要加入我們？
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yùndònghuì yào zǔduì cānjiā, nǐ yào bú yào jiārù wǒmen?
examples.english: We need to form a team for the sports meet — do you want to join us?

semanticNote: To form; to constitute; to make up. 由…組成 (composed of; made up of) is the standard construction. 委員會由五人組成 (the committee is composed of five people). More specific than 構成 (constitute, often chemical or abstract) — 組成 implies deliberate assembly of parts into a whole.

examples.chinese: 這個合唱團由來自不同縣市的學生組成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège héchàngtuán yóu láizì bùtóng xiànshì de xuéshēng zǔchéng.
examples.english: This choir is composed of students from different counties and cities.

examples.chinese: 水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ fēnzǐ yóu liǎng gè qīng yuánzǐ hé yī gè yǎng yuánzǐ zǔchéng.
examples.english: A water molecule is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

semanticNote: To assemble; combination; ensemble. 組合式家具 (modular furniture), 黃金組合 (a golden combination; a dream team), 字詞組合 (word combination). In music: 組合 often refers to a pop group or band (idol group). Broad usage — from mathematics (排列組合, permutations and combinations) to everyday assembling.

examples.chinese: 這套組合式書架可以根據空間需求自由調整。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào zǔhéshì shūjià kěyǐ gēnjù kōngjiān xūqiú zìyóu tiáozhěng.
examples.english: This modular bookshelf can be freely adjusted according to your space requirements.

examples.chinese: 這首歌由鋼琴和小提琴組合演奏，聽起來非常優美。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē yóu gāngqín hé xiǎotíqín zǔhé yǎnzòu, tīng qǐlái fēicháng yōuměi.
examples.english: This piece is played by a combination of piano and violin — it sounds incredibly beautiful.

semanticNote: To organize; an organization. 組織活動 (organize an event), 非政府組織 (NGO), 組織架構 (organizational structure). Also biological: 肌肉組織 (muscle tissue), 細胞組織 (cell tissue). In Taiwan's civil society, 公民組織 (civic organizations) are a vibrant part of social life. Traditional: 組織.

examples.chinese: 學生會負責組織校內各種文化活動和社團聯合表演。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēnghuì fùzé zǔzhī xiào nèi gè zhǒng wénhuà huódòng hé shètuán liánhé biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: The student council is responsible for organizing various cultural events and joint club performances on campus.

examples.chinese: 這個非政府組織長期為台灣的弱勢族群提供法律援助。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fēi zhèngfǔ zǔzhī chángqī wèi Táiwān de ruòshì zúqún tígōng fǎlǜ yuánzhù.
examples.english: This NGO has long provided legal assistance to disadvantaged groups in Taiwan.

semanticNote: Initially; at first; the very beginning. 最初的計畫 (the original plan), 最初的想法 (the initial idea). Slightly more literary than 一開始 (at the start). Used to contrast present state with how things began: 最初他很反對，後來慢慢接受了。

examples.chinese: 這個品牌最初只是一個家庭式小工廠，現在已發展成跨國企業。
examples.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái zuìchū zhǐshì yī gè jiātíngshì xiǎo gōngchǎng, xiànzài yǐ fāzhǎn chéng kuàguó qǐyè.
examples.english: This brand started out as a small family workshop and has now grown into a multinational company.

examples.chinese: 最初她並不喜歡台南的步調，但住久了就愛上這裡了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìchū tā bìng bù xǐhuān Táinán de bùdiào, dàn zhù jiǔ le jiù àishàng zhèlǐ le.
examples.english: Initially she didn't like Tainan's pace of life, but after living there a while she fell in love with the place.

semanticNote: Drunk; intoxicated. 喝醉 (get drunk), 醉了 (drunk), 爛醉如泥 (dead drunk). Also used metaphorically: 沉醉 (be immersed in; intoxicated by), 醉心 (be captivated by). In Taiwan, KTV and social drinking make 喝醉 a culturally familiar context. Also in food: 醉雞 (drunken chicken, cooked in rice wine).

examples.chinese: 他昨晚在同學婚宴上喝醉了，今天宿醉頭很痛。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuó wǎn zài tóngxué hūnyàn shàng hēzuì le, jīntiān sùzuì tóu hěn tòng.
examples.english: He got drunk at a classmate's wedding banquet last night and has a terrible hangover today.

examples.chinese: 她沉醉在花蓮的美麗山海風景中，完全忘了時間。
examples.pinyin: Tā chénzuì zài Huālián de měilì shānhǎi fēngjǐng zhōng, wánquán wàng le shíjiān.
examples.english: She was immersed in Hualien's beautiful mountain and ocean scenery and completely lost track of time.

semanticNote: To respect; to revere; respectful. 尊敬師長 (respect teachers and elders — a Confucian value central to Taiwan's education), 受人尊敬 (respected by others), 尊敬的…（Dear…, in formal letters). More formal and Confucian in weight than 尊重 (respect someone's rights/choices).

examples.chinese: 他是一位受全校師生尊敬的老教授，桃李滿天下。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yī wèi shòu quánxiào shīshēng zūnjìng de lǎo jiàoshòu, táolǐ mǎn tiānxià.
examples.english: He is a veteran professor respected by all teachers and students at the school, with students all over the world.

examples.chinese: 台灣社會普遍重視尊師重道，老師在學生心中地位很高。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì pǔbiàn zhòngshì zūn shī zhòng dào, lǎoshī zài xuéshēng xīnzhōng dìwèi hěn gāo.
examples.english: Taiwanese society generally values respecting teachers — teachers hold a high place in students' hearts.

semanticNote: To abide by; to comply with; to observe (rules, laws, agreements). 遵守法律 (abide by the law), 遵守規定 (follow the rules), 遵守承諾 (keep a promise). Implies active adherence rather than passive avoidance of violations. Core civic virtue in Taiwan's legal and educational contexts.

examples.chinese: 進入圖書館請遵守館內規定，保持安靜，不要飲食。
examples.pinyin: Jìnrù túshūguǎn qǐng zūnshǒu guǎn nèi guīdìng, bǎochí ānjìng, búyào yǐnshí.
examples.english: Upon entering the library, please abide by the library's rules — keep quiet and refrain from eating or drinking.

examples.chinese: 作為一個公民，遵守法律是最基本的責任。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yī gè gōngmín, zūnshǒu fǎlǜ shì zuì jīběn de zérèn.
examples.english: As a citizen, abiding by the law is the most basic responsibility.

semanticNote: A work (of literature, art, or music). 文學作品 (literary work), 藝術作品 (artwork), 代表作品 (representative work). Can refer to anything created with craft or artistry — from a novel to a sculpture to a software product. 作品集 (portfolio). In Taiwan's active arts scene, 作品 is commonly encountered in galleries, 文學獎 (literary awards), and musician bios.

examples.chinese: 她的攝影作品入選了今年的台北雙年展。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shèyǐng zuòpǐn rùxuǎn le jīnnián de Táiběi shuāngniánzhǎn.
examples.english: Her photographic works were selected for this year's Taipei Biennial.

examples.chinese: 台灣文學館珍藏了許多本土作家的重要作品手稿。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān wénxuéguǎn zhēncáng le xǔduō běntǔ zuòjiā de zhòngyào zuòpǐn shǒugǎo.
examples.english: The Taiwan Literature Museum preserves the manuscripts of many important works by local authors.

semanticNote: Multiple uses: (1) As a preposition: 作為一個學生 (as a student); (2) As a noun: actions and deeds 他的作為令人失望 (his conduct is disappointing); (3) To regard as / treat as: 把他作為朋友 (regard him as a friend). The preposition sense is most common in formal writing. Traditional: 作為.

examples.chinese: 作為一名醫護人員，她把病患的需求永遠放在第一位。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng yīhù rényuán, tā bǎ bìnghuàn de xūqiú yǒngyuǎn fàng zài dì yī wèi.
examples.english: As a medical worker, she always puts patients' needs first.

examples.chinese: 這位官員的不當作為引發了社會各界的強烈批評。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi guānyuán de bùdàng zuòwéi yǐnfā le shèhuì gèjiè de qiángliè pīpíng.
examples.english: This official's improper conduct triggered strong criticism from all sectors of society.

semanticNote: To write an essay; a written composition. 作文課 (composition class), 寫作文 (write an essay), 作文比賽 (essay competition). In Taiwan's education system, 作文 is a significant component of 學測 (GSAT) and is graded on a 6-point scale. Many students find 作文 the most stressful part of Chinese language exams.

examples.chinese: 學測國文的作文題目每年都讓考生又驚又喜，難以預測。
examples.pinyin: Xuécè guówén de zuòwén tímù měi nián dōu ràng kǎoshēng yòu jīng yòu xǐ, nányǐ yùcè.
examples.english: The essay topics in the GSAT Chinese exam always surprise and delight test-takers each year — they're hard to predict.

examples.chinese: 老師請同學以「我的家鄉」為題，寫一篇五百字的作文。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī qǐng tóngxué yǐ 'wǒ de jiāxiāng' wéi tí, xiě yī piān wǔbǎi zì de zuòwén.
examples.english: The teacher asked students to write a 500-character essay on the topic 'My Hometown.'
